Question types and NGN item types
Current formats: multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank (type a number; round at the end), multiple response/SATA, ordered response, hot spot, chart/exhibit, graphic options, audio.
現有題型：選擇題、填空（輸入數字，最後才四捨五入）、多重選擇/SATA、排序題、熱點圖、圖表/檔案題、圖片選項、聽診音檔題。
Question types and NGN item types
Traditional types are scored 0 or 1 (dichotomous, no partial credit).
傳統題型計分為 0 或 1（無部分給分）。
Question types and NGN item types
NGN: each candidate gets 3 unfolding case studies with 6 items each (all six cognitive skills tested), given within the first 85 items; bow-tie and trend stand-alone items may follow.
NGN：每位考生會有 3 個漸進式個案、每個 6 題（涵蓋六項認知技能），出現在前 85 題內；之後可能出現蝴蝶結與趨勢單題。
Question types and NGN item types
NGN item types include highlight in text/table, matrix choice/response, multiple response select N or SATA, grouping, drag-and-drop and drop-down cloze/rationale/in table.
NGN 題型包含文字/表格標示、矩陣選擇/回應、選 N 項或 SATA、分組、拖放與下拉式填空/理由/表格。
Question types and NGN item types
NGN scoring: plus-minus (+/-) for select-any-number items, 0/1 for items like cloze and bow-tie, and rationale scoring for paired answers; most NGN items give partial credit.
NGN 計分：任意選擇題用加減分（負分以 0 計）；填空、蝴蝶結等用 0/1；成對答案用理由計分；多數 NGN 題可部分給分。

Acute epiglottitis: never examine the throat or take a throat culture; keep airway, sit upright, monitor SpO2, have trach tray ready.

Dose formula: Desired/Available x Volume (650 mg of 500 mg/15 mL = 19.5 mL).
劑量公式：需要量 / 現有量 x 容量（650 mg、500 mg/15 mL = 19.5 mL）。

Self-efficacy is a belief in your own ability to carry out particular behaviors; it shapes which behaviors you choose, how long you persevere and how well you perform.
自我效能是相信自己有能力執行特定行為；它影響你選擇的行為、堅持程度與表現品質。
High self-efficacy expectations lead to hard work and persistence; low expectations lead to self-doubt about passing.
高自我效能期望促使努力與堅持；低期望則導致對通過考試的自我懷疑。
Research (Silvestri, Clark and Moonie, 2013) found self-efficacy expectations were an important predictor of NCLEX success.
研究（Silvestri 等，2013）顯示自我效能期望是 NCLEX 成功的重要預測因子。
Self-reflection lets you review past experiences and build confidence about your capabilities.
自我反思讓你回顧過往經驗並建立對能力的信心。
Journal your accomplishments and re-read them whenever doubt appears.

Ask yourself about goal setting: are goals realistic, do you reach them, how do you overcome obstacles?

Calm yourself with slow breathing (inhale through the nose, hold for 4, exhale slowly through the mouth).

Health care disparities and nursing assessment
健康照護不平等與護理評估
COVID-19 is a highly contagious respiratory illness (SARS-CoV) that can affect many body systems; high risk includes older adults, chronic illness, cancer, immunocompromise and minority groups.
COVID-19 為高傳染性呼吸道疾病（SARS-CoV），可影響多個系統；高風險族群含年長者、慢性病、癌症、免疫低下者與少數族群。
Emergency warning signs: trouble breathing, persistent chest pain or pressure, new confusion, inability to stay awake, bluish lips or face.
緊急警訊：呼吸困難、持續胸痛或壓迫感、新發意識混亂、無法保持清醒、嘴唇或臉部發紫。
Prevention: handwashing, mask and eye protection, distancing, avoiding crowds and sick contacts, covering coughs, avoiding touching the face, quarantine.
預防：洗手、口罩與護目、保持距離、避免人群與病人、遮掩咳嗽、避免觸摸臉部、自我隔離。

Minority groups face higher disparities; examples: obesity/diabetes in Hispanic/Latinx; smoking, diabetes, hepatitis B, TB, SIDS in Native Hawaiian/Pacific Islander; diabetes, heart disease, accidents, suicide in Native American/Alaska Native; hypertension, heart disease, asthma in African Americans; cancer, TB, hepatitis in Asian Americans.
少數族群不平等更明顯：拉丁裔肥胖/糖尿病；夏威夷原住民與太平洋島民吸菸、糖尿病、B 肝、結核、SIDS；美洲原住民/阿拉斯加原住民糖尿病、心臟病、意外、自殺；非裔高血壓、心臟病、氣喘；亞裔癌症、結核、肝炎。
Do not use family or friends as interpreters; use designated interpreters. Use cultural responsiveness and teach-back (return demonstration).
不可請家人朋友擔任口譯，應使用指定口譯員。展現文化回應能力並使用回述（回覆示教）。
Fear of stigma reduces access to care; transgender people are less likely to complete screenings such as mammograms, cervical and prostate screening.
害怕汙名化降低就醫；跨性別者較少完成乳房攝影、子宮頸與攝護腺等篩檢。
Concerns: STIs, depression and suicide, bullying and abuse of youth, rejection by family, barriers to child-rearing.
關注議題：性傳染病、憂鬱與自殺、青少年霸凌與虐待、家人排斥、育兒障礙。
Create a welcoming environment, use the client's identified name and pronouns, use inclusive forms and policies, take a careful sexual history.
營造友善環境，使用病人認同的姓名與代名詞，採用包容的表單與政策，詳細詢問性史。
Consider nPEP after possible HIV exposure; monitor transgender hormone therapy (e.g., polycythemia with testosterone); keep age-appropriate screening for retained organs/breast tissue.
可能暴露於 HIV 後考慮 nPEP；追蹤跨性別荷爾蒙治療（如睪固酮造成紅血球增多症）；對保留的器官/乳房組織持續做適齡篩檢。
無家者、社經弱勢與無保險者
Homelessness is linked to early death, malnutrition, STIs, TB and pneumonia, wounds, mental illness and substance abuse; children have asthma, lead poisoning and ear infections.
無家者與早逝、營養不良、性傳染病、結核與肺炎、傷口、精神疾病及物質濫用相關；兒童常有氣喘、鉛中毒與中耳炎。
無家者、社經弱勢與無保險者
Address the client's stated symptom first (e.g., pain with numbness in both feet), assess wounds, establish an emergency contact and follow-up, and connect to resources.
先處理病人主訴（例：雙腳疼痛麻木），評估傷口，建立緊急聯絡人與追蹤，並連結資源。
無家者、社經弱勢與無保險者
Social determinants (education, income, family and social support, community safety) are as important as lifestyle and access to care.
社會決定因素（教育、收入、家庭與社會支持、社區安全）與生活型態及就醫可近性同樣重要。
無家者、社經弱勢與無保險者
Use social work and refer the uninsured to Medicaid or financial services; lack of insurance leads to missed preventive care.
運用社工，並轉介無保險者申請 Medicaid 或財務服務；缺乏保險導致預防照護缺漏。

智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童
Intellectually disabled clients may present atypically; history taking takes more time with questions asked in different ways; assess choking/aspiration risk; behavior change may signal illness.
智能障礙病人症狀可能不典型；問診需花更多時間並以不同方式提問；評估噎嗆/吸入風險；行為改變可能是疾病訊號。
Intellectual disability, abuse and neglect, single parents, foster children
智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童
Abuse victims: bruises (eyes, neck), sprains/fractures, fatigue, PTSD, depression; safety is the priority; nurses are mandated reporters; photograph injuries when needed.
受虐者：瘀傷（眼周、頸部）、扭傷/骨折、疲倦、創傷後壓力症、憂鬱；安全為優先；護理師為強制通報者；必要時拍攝傷處。
Intellectual disability, abuse and neglect, single parents, foster children
智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童
Single parents need a therapeutic relationship and community resources (child care, food security, immunizations); preventive screenings matter.
單親需要治療性關係與社區資源（托育、糧食、疫苗）；預防篩檢很重要。
Intellectual disability, abuse and neglect, single parents, foster children
智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童
Foster children often have unmet physical, mental, behavioral and dental needs; include social workers and community resources.
寄養兒童常有未滿足的身體、心理、行為與牙科需求；需納入社工與社區資源。
Intellectual disability, abuse and neglect, single parents, foster children
智能障礙、虐待與忽略、單親與寄養兒童
Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners
精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人
Mental illness: psychotropic weight gain and metabolic syndrome, diabetes risk, STIs, xerostomia, poor access; screen regularly.
精神疾病：精神科藥物導致體重增加與代謝症候群、糖尿病風險、性傳染病、口乾、就醫困難；需定期篩檢。
Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners
精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人
Older adults: neglect is the most common elder abuse; report suspected abuse; common problems include dementia, falls, depression, osteoporosis.
老年人：忽略是最常見的老人虐待；疑似虐待須通報；常見問題包括失智、跌倒、憂鬱、骨質疏鬆。
Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners
精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人
Veterans: PTSD, moral injury, TBI, substance use and suicide risk, amputations, chemical exposure; treat mental health to reduce suicide risk.
退伍軍人：創傷後壓力症、道德創傷、腦外傷、物質使用與自殺風險、截肢、化學暴露；治療心理健康以降低自殺風險。
Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners
精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人
Prisoners: TB, STIs and infectious disease risk, asthma, diabetes, hypertension, mental illness; facility is usually the only care provider; screening must be thorough and regular.
受刑人：結核、性傳染病與傳染病風險、氣喘、糖尿病、高血壓、精神疾病；矯正機構通常是唯一照護提供者；篩檢須完整且定期。
Mental health, older adults, veterans, prisoners
精神疾病、老年人、退伍軍人、受刑人

Immigrants face language, culture, housing, employment and access barriers; infections include TB, hepatitis, STIs and vaccine-preventable diseases; services must be offered regardless of insurance; provide vaccinations.
移民面臨語言、文化、住房、就業與就醫障礙；感染包括結核、肝炎、性傳染病與疫苗可預防疾病；不論保險均應提供服務並施打疫苗。
Refugees: mental health problems from war, violence and rape are a priority concern.
難民：因戰爭、暴力與性侵造成的心理健康問題是優先關注。
Chronic illness is the leading cause of death and disability; modifiable factors (diet, inactivity, tobacco) vs nonmodifiable (age, genetics).
慢性病為死亡與失能首要原因；可改變因素（飲食、缺乏運動、吸菸）與不可改變因素（年齡、基因）。
Manage the 'big picture', not one illness; use interprofessional collaboration, follow-up (home health) and include the client and supporters in decisions.
管理整體狀況而非單一疾病；跨專業合作、持續追蹤（居家照護），並讓病人與支持者參與決策。
Teach-back (return explanation/demonstration) is the most reliable way to confirm understanding.
回述/回覆示教是確認理解最可靠的方式。
Never use family or friends as interpreters; use agency-designated interpreters.
絕不使用家人或朋友當口譯，應使用機構指定口譯員。
Address transgender clients by their identified name and pronouns.
以跨性別者認同的姓名與代名詞稱呼。
With homeless clients, address the client's reported symptom first to improve return and adherence.
對無家者先處理其主訴，以提高回診與遵從。
Abuse red flags: bruises around eyes, red-purple marks on neck, sprained wrists, PTSD, chronic fatigue.
受虐警訊：眼周瘀傷、頸部紅紫痕、手腕扭傷、創傷後壓力、慢性疲倦。
Nurses are mandated reporters of abuse and neglect; safety is the priority.
護理師是虐待與忽略的強制通報者；安全為優先。
Neglect is the most common type of elder abuse.
忽略是最常見的老人虐待類型。
Veterans: PTSD and suicide risk are the priority concerns.
退伍軍人：創傷後壓力症與自殺風險為優先關注。
Refugees: mental health care is the priority need.
難民：心理健康照護為優先需求。
Prison environments predispose to TB, STIs and other communicable diseases.
監獄環境易導致結核、性傳染病與其他傳染病。
Intellectually disabled clients: allow extra time for history, assess for choking, and watch behavior as a symptom.
智能障礙者：病史採集多給時間、評估噎嗆、並將行為改變視為症狀。
Chronic illness care: look at the big picture, collaborate across providers, involve client and supporters.
慢性病照護：看整體、跨專業合作、讓病人與支持者參與。
COVID-19 emergency signs: dyspnea, chest pain, new confusion, cyanosis.
COVID-19 緊急警訊：呼吸困難、胸痛、新發混亂、發紺。
Social determinants of health matter as much as lifestyle and access to care.
社會決定因素與生活型態及就醫可近性同樣重要。
Which teaching method best confirms a client's understanding when teaching members of a specific population?
針對特定族群衛教時，哪種方法最能確認病人理解？
The nurse cares for a transgender client. Which is most appropriate?
護理師照護一位跨性別病人。何者最恰當？

在無家者外展門診，護理師首先處理哪項發現？

病人因疲倦與呼吸困難就診。哪項發現提示可能受虐需追蹤？
Which conditions are common in foster children? Select all that apply.
寄養兒童常見哪些情況？（複選）
The nurse planning care for a military veteran prioritizes which condition?
照護退伍軍人的護理師優先處理哪項？

哪些措施最能促進多重慢性病病人的遵從？（複選）
Box 5.1 and 5.2: chronic health problems, risk factors and common infectious diseases.
Box 5.1、5.2：慢性病、危險因子與常見傳染病。
Box 5.3: population health needs assessment tool (general background questions).
Box 5.3：族群健康需求評估工具（一般背景問題）。
Box 5.3 continued: targeted questions for living situation, abuse, gender, veterans, incarceration, immigration.
Box 5.3 續：居住、虐待、性別、退伍軍人、監禁、移民等針對性問題。
Box 5.4 and Clinical Judgment box: homelessness and health, priority needs of a homeless client.
Box 5.4 與臨床判斷框：無家與健康、無家病人的優先需求。
Ethics distinguishes right from wrong using a body of knowledge; morals reflect customs or beliefs; values influence decisions; values clarification analyzes your own values.
倫理依知識體系分辨對錯；道德反映習俗或信念；價值觀影響決策；價值澄清是分析自身價值觀。
Principles: autonomy, nonmaleficence (do no harm), beneficence (do good; paternalism is undesirable), justice, veracity (truth), fidelity (keep promises).
原則：自主、不傷害、行善（家長式作風不可取）、公正、誠實、忠誠。
Ethical codes (ICN, ANA) are not legally binding but boards of nursing can discipline unprofessional conduct.
倫理守則（ICN、ANA）無法律效力，但護理委員會可懲處不專業行為。

An ethical dilemma is a conflict between two or more ethical principles with no clearly correct choice; use ethical reasoning (gather data, examine values, state the problem, consider options, negotiate, evaluate).
倫理兩難為兩項以上倫理原則衝突、無明確正解；運用倫理推理（蒐集資料、檢視價值、說明問題、考慮選項、協商、評值）。
An advocate speaks for the client and supports the client's decision even if it conflicts with the nurse's own; ethics committees offer interprofessional consultation.
倡議者為病人發聲並支持其決定（即使與自己意見不同）；倫理委員會提供跨專業諮詢。
The Nurse Practice Act (state statute) sets education requirements, scope of practice, licensure and grounds for discipline; nurses must know their state's act.
護理執業法（州法）規範教育要求、執業範圍、執照與懲處依據；護理師須熟悉所在州法規。

Standards of care define what clients can expect; failing both standards and agency policy makes the nurse clearly liable. Respondeat superior makes the employer liable for employees' negligence within employment.
照護標準界定病人可期待的照護；同時違反標準與機構政策則責任明確。僱主責任原則使僱主需為員工執行職務中的過失負責。
Policies are not laws but courts generally rule against nurses who violate them.
政策不是法律，但法院通常判違反政策的護理師敗訴。
Understaffing: walking out can be abandonment; report short staffing to administration.
人力不足：擅離可能構成遺棄；應向行政單位報告人力不足。

Floating is acceptable; refusal is allowed only with union contract protection or proven lack of knowledge. Tell the supervisor your limits, request a resource nurse and accept patients matching your experience.
調派支援可接受；僅在工會合約保障或能證明缺乏相關知識時方可拒絕。向主管說明限制、要求資源護理師並接受符合經驗的病人。
Discipline reasons: unprofessional conduct, confidentiality breach, insufficient judgment, abuse, unsafe delegation, inaccurate or falsified records, leaving an assignment without notice.
懲處原因：不專業行為、違反保密、判斷不足、虐待病人、不安全委派、記錄不實或偽造、未通知即離開工作。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Negligence is conduct below the standard of care (acts of commission or omission); malpractice is professional negligence.
過失是低於照護標準的行為（作為或不作為）；醫療疏失是專業過失。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Four elements of liability: duty, breach of duty, proximate cause, damage/injury.
責任四要件：義務、違反義務、因果關係、損害。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Negligence examples: medication or IV errors, falls, burns, retained surgical items, failure to monitor, report or delegate properly, incomplete handoff.
過失例子：給藥或輸液錯誤、跌倒、燙傷、手術遺留異物、未監測/通報/適當委派、交班不完整。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Own liability insurance gives the nurse an attorney whose only interest is the nurse; Good Samaritan laws protect those giving reasonable, uncompensated emergency care.
自行投保責任險可有只為護理師利益的律師；好撒馬利亞人法保護提供合理且無償緊急救助者。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Controlled substances: locked, signed out, inventory counted.
管制藥品：上鎖、簽領、清點庫存。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Collective bargaining negotiates wages and conditions; strikes pose a moral dilemma for nurses.
集體協商談判薪資與勞動條件；罷工對護理師是道德困境。
法律責任、過失與醫療疏失
Assault: threat causing fear of harmful contact; battery: touching without consent.
傷害威脅：使人害怕有害接觸；傷害行為：未經同意的觸碰。
Invasion of privacy: violating confidentiality; false imprisonment: preventing a client from leaving or unjustified restraints; a competent client may sign an AMA form.
侵犯隱私：違反保密；非法拘禁：不當阻止離院或無正當臨床需求使用約束；有行為能力者可簽自動出院（AMA）。
Defamation: libel (written) or slander (spoken); fraud: deliberate deception for gain.
毀謗：書面（誹謗）或口頭（誹謗/口誹）；詐欺：蓄意欺騙以牟利。
Exception: acutely disturbed mental health clients who pose risk may need least-restrictive interventions first, then restraint if behavior demands.
例外：急性精神困擾且有危險者，先採最低限制措施，必要時才約束。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
The Patient Care Partnership (formerly Bill of Rights) from the AHA must be posted; related laws include ADA, ACA, Mental Health Systems Act.
美國醫院協會（AHA）的病人照護夥伴關係（原病人權利法案）須張貼；相關法律含 ADA、ACA、心理健康系統法。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
Organ donation: adults 18+ may declare intent; heart, lungs, liver require a ventilated brain-dead donor; request usually by trained provider; no delay in funeral or cost to family.
器官捐贈：18 歲以上成人可表達意願；心、肺、肝需來自使用呼吸器的腦死者；通常由受訓人員提出請求；不延誤喪禮且家屬無費用。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
Informed consent is the provider's responsibility (risks, benefits, alternatives, consequences of refusal); the nurse witnesses the signature.
知情同意由醫師負責說明（風險、益處、替代方案與拒絕後果）；護理師見證簽名。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書

Consent must be voluntary, witnessed, signed by a competent adult; not valid if sedated, unconscious, intoxicated or demented without a legal representative. Use a professional interpreter when needed.
同意須自願、有見證、由有行為能力的成人簽署；鎮靜、昏迷、醉酒或失智而無法定代理人時無效。需要時使用專業口譯。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
Emergencies waive consent; clients may refuse information or withdraw consent anytime; if a client changes their mind before surgery, hold prep and notify the surgeon.
緊急情況可免同意；病人可拒絕資訊或隨時撤回同意；術前病人改變心意，應暫停術前準備並通知外科醫師。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
Minors need parent/guardian consent except in emergencies, emancipated minors, or services like STI, HIV, birth control, pregnancy, substance abuse and psychiatric care in many states.
未成年人需父母或監護人同意，除非緊急、已解除監護的未成年人，或多州允許自行同意的服務（性傳染病、HIV、避孕、懷孕、物質濫用、精神科）。
Patient rights, organ donation and consents
病人權利、器官捐贈與同意書
HIPAA protects personal health information (PHI); clients may inspect, request amendment, request disclosure list, restrict use and file complaints.
HIPAA 保護個人健康資訊（PHI）；病人可查閱、要求修正、索取揭露清單、限制使用並提出申訴。
PHI may be used for treatment, payment and operations, emergencies, public health, legal proceedings and with signed authorization.
PHI 可用於治療、付款與營運、緊急狀況、公共衛生、法律程序，及經簽署授權。
Only staff involved in care may access records; share information only on a need-to-know basis in private areas.
僅參與照護者可取得記錄；僅在有必要時於私密場所分享。
Privacy violations include posting on social media, photographs, open curtains, overheard interviews and unauthorized record access; never share passwords.
侵犯隱私包括社群媒體貼文、拍照、未拉簾、談話被聽到、未授權查閱記錄；絕不分享密碼。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Occurrence (incident) reports: factual, not copied or mentioned in the chart; chart the event itself; reassess the client; notify the provider.
事件報告：客觀陳述，不影印也不在病歷提及；病歷中記錄事件本身；再評估病人；通知醫師。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Carry out prescriptions unless inappropriate or inaccurate; if unclear or unusually high, do not give it and contact the prescriber, then the supervisor.
執行醫囑，除非不適當或不正確；若不清楚或劑量異常，不給藥並聯絡開醫囑者，再通報主管。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Telephone orders: identify client, date/time, read back, write 't.o.' with prescriber's name and sign; prescriber countersigns.
電話醫囑：確認病人、日期時間、覆誦、註明「t.o.」與醫師姓名並簽名；醫師事後簽署。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Documentation: objective, factual, timely, black ink, sign each entry, no erasing, no blank spaces, no judgmental terms, no unacceptable abbreviations, correct errors per policy.
文件記錄：客觀、事實、即時、黑筆、每筆簽名、不擦拭、不留空白、不用評斷性字眼與禁用縮寫、依政策更正錯誤。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Document teaching: what was taught, understanding, who was present.
記錄衛教：教了什麼、理解程度、在場者。
法律保障、醫囑與文件記錄
Patient Self-Determination Act: ask about advance directives on admission and document them.
病人自主權法：入院時詢問預立醫囑並記錄。
Two types: instructional directive (living will) and durable power of attorney for health care (proxy).
兩類：指示型預立醫囑（生前遺囑）與醫療持續委任書（代理人）。
DNR requires informed consent and clear definition; without a DNR order, make every effort to resuscitate; review regularly.
DNR 需知情同意且定義清楚；無 DNR 醫囑時須盡力急救；定期檢討。
Some agencies bar nurses from witnessing legal documents; if allowed, document who was present and the client's conduct.
部分機構禁止護理師見證法律文件；若允許，須記錄在場者與病人表現。
Mandatory reports: certain communicable diseases, animal bites, suicides, child/elder abuse, domestic violence, gunshot or stab wounds, assaults, homicides.
強制通報：特定傳染病、動物咬傷、自殺、兒童/老人虐待、家暴、槍傷或刀傷、攻擊、殺人。
Suspected impaired coworker: report confidentially to the supervisor; client safety first. OSHA protects workers who report unsafe conditions; sexual harassment is prohibited.
懷疑同事受物質影響：向主管保密通報，病人安全優先。OSHA 保護通報不安全條件者；性騷擾受法律禁止。
Occurrence reports record facts only; do not mention the report in the chart.
事件報告只記錄事實；病歷中不提及該報告。
After a fall, reassess the client first.
病人跌倒後首先再評估病人。
Emergency without a legal representative: treat; consent is not required if delay causes harm.
緊急且無法定代理人：直接治療；延誤會造成傷害時不需同意。
The provider explains the procedure for informed consent; the nurse witnesses the signature.
由醫師說明並取得知情同意；護理師見證簽名。
A sedated, intoxicated, or unconscious client cannot give informed consent.
受鎮靜、醉酒或昏迷者不能給予知情同意。
If a client refuses surgery, hold preparation, explore concerns and notify the surgeon.
病人拒絕手術時暫停準備、探究顧慮並通知外科醫師。
Do not give an unclear or abnormal medication order; contact the prescriber, then the supervisor.
不執行不清楚或異常的醫囑；聯絡醫師，再通報主管。
Suspected impaired nurse: report to the nursing supervisor.
懷疑護理師受物質影響：通報護理主管。
Floating: clarify the assignment for safety; do not refuse unless union protection or proven incompetence.
調派支援：確認指派是否安全；除非有工會保障或能證明不具能力，否則不可拒絕。
Nurses are mandated reporters of child and elder abuse and domestic violence.
護理師為兒童、老人虐待與家暴的強制通報者。
HIPAA: share PHI only with those involved in care or with client authorization.
HIPAA：僅與參與照護者或經病人授權才分享 PHI。
Documentation: factual, objective, no judgmental words such as 'uncooperative', black ink, no erasing.
文件記錄：客觀事實、不用『不合作』等評斷字、黑筆、不擦拭。
Malpractice elements: duty, breach, proximate cause, damage.
醫療疏失要件：義務、違反、因果關係、損害。
Battery is touching without consent; assault is the threat of contact.
傷害行為是未經同意的觸碰；傷害威脅是接觸的威脅。
Ethical principles A-N-B-J-V-F: Autonomy, Nonmaleficence, Beneficence, Justice, Veracity, Fidelity.
倫理原則 A-N-B-J-V-F：自主、不傷害、行善、公正、誠實、忠誠。
Liability elements D-B-P-D: Duty, Breach, Proximate cause, Damage.
責任要件 D-B-P-D：義務、違反、因果關係、損害。

病人被發現躺在床邊地板。事件報告應寫下哪項？

身分不明、昏迷的外傷病人需緊急開顱手術。關於同意，最佳作法為何？

病人跌倒未受傷且事件報告已完成。護理師下一步該做什麼？
A nurse is told to float to an ICU she has never worked in. Best action?
護理師被指派支援從未去過的加護病房。最佳作法？
A nurse finds a coworker about to inject a clear liquid after tying a tourniquet in the medication room. Most appropriate action?
護理師在藥房發現同事綁止血帶、準備注射不明透明液體。最恰當的處置？
A nurse entered 2 mg hydromorphone instead of the 1 mg given in the MAR. Which actions are correct? Select all that apply.
護理師在 MAR 誤輸入給予 2 mg 氫嗎啡酮，實際為 1 mg。哪些處置正確？（複選）
Which documentation entries are accurate? Select all that apply.
下列哪些護理記錄是正確的？（複選）

老年病人透露被家人毆打。最恰當回應為何？

Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑
Managed care controls costs through outcome-driven care, health promotion, early detection and efficient resource use; case management supports it with an interprofessional approach.
管理式照護以成果導向、健康促進、早期發現與有效利用資源控制成本；個案管理以跨專業方式支持之。
Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑
Case manager (RN): assesses, plans, coordinates referrals and services, facilitates discharge, advocates for cost-effective care and knows insurance options.
個案管理師（RN）：評估、計畫、協調轉介與服務、促進出院、倡導具成本效益的照護並熟悉保險。
Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑

Insurance types: HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, HSA. Medicare: age 65+, some disabled, ESRD (Part A hospital/SNF/hospice, Part B outpatient 80%, Part C private plan, Part D drugs). Medicaid: joint federal-state for low income.
保險類型：HMO、PPO、EPO、POS、HDHP、HSA。Medicare：65 歲以上、部分身障者、末期腎病（A 部分住院/SNF/安寧、B 部分門診 80%、C 部分私人計畫、D 部分藥物）。Medicaid：聯邦與州合辦的低收入保險。
Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑
Critical pathway: evidence-based, time-framed care plan; variation analysis compares actual to expected outcomes to spot negative variance early.
臨床路徑：循證、設定時間的照護計畫；變異分析比較實際與預期結果，及早發現負向變異。
Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑
Care planning tools: nursing care plan, ADPIE, nursing process, SBAR, SOAP, NCJMM.
照護規劃工具：護理計畫、ADPIE、護理過程、SBAR、SOAP、NCJMM。
Care delivery systems, insurance and critical pathways
照護提供系統、保險與臨床路徑
Functional nursing: task-oriented, efficient for many clients but fragmented with low accountability.
功能制護理：以工作為導向，可照顧較多病人但照護片段且責任分散。
Team nursing: an RN team leader assesses, plans and evaluates; staff work within their scope (e.g., RN leading 2 LPNs and 3 APs for 12 clients).
小組護理：RN 組長負責評估、計畫與評值；成員在各自範圍內工作（例：RN 帶 2 位 LPN 與 3 位 AP 照顧 12 位病人）。
Relationship-based (primary) nursing: one primary nurse manages care from admission to discharge, with an associate when off duty.
關係導向（責任制）護理：由一位責任護理師從入院到出院負責，輪休時由輔助護理師接手。
Client-focused (total care/case method): the RN gives all needed care to assigned clients for the shift.
以病人為中心（全責/個案制）：RN 在該班次提供指派病人所有所需照護。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Accountability: answerable for choices and actions; assume only responsibilities within competence; admit mistakes.
責任：對選擇與行動負責；只承擔能力範圍內的職責；承認錯誤。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Leadership influences others to achieve goals; management accomplishes tasks through oneself or others.
領導是影響他人達成目標；管理是自己或透過他人完成任務。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Styles: authoritarian (leader decides), democratic (participative), laissez-faire (passive), situational, bureaucratic (policies), transformational (shared vision), servant.
風格：權威式（領導者決定）、民主式（參與）、放任式（被動）、情境式、官僚式（依規定）、轉型式（共同願景）、服務式。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Management functions: planning, organizing, directing, controlling. Problem-solving steps parallel the nursing process and NCJMM.
管理功能：計畫、組織、指導、控制。問題解決步驟與護理過程及 NCJMM 平行。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Managers: front-line (charge nurse, team leader), middle (unit manager, supervisor), nurse executive.
管理者：第一線（組長、領導護理師）、中階（單位主任、督導）、護理主管。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Power types: reward, coercive, referent, expert, legitimate, personal, informational; empowerment enables others through open communication and shared decisions.
權力類型：獎賞、強制、參照、專家、法定、個人、資訊；賦權透過開放溝通與共同決策使他人有能力。
責任、領導風格與管理者
Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement
組織、實證護理與品質改善
Mission, goals, organizational chart; policies guide, procedures describe methods, protocols prescribe care for a specific problem. Centralized vs decentralized decision-making.
使命、目標、組織圖；政策提供方向、程序說明方法、準則規範特定問題的照護。集權與分權決策。
Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement
組織、實證護理與品質改善

Evidence-based practice integrates best research, clinical expertise and client preferences; nurses question practice and formulate researchable questions. Level I evidence (reviews of RCTs) is strongest.
實證護理整合最佳研究、臨床專業與病人偏好；護理師質疑現行作法並提出可研究的問題。第 I 級證據（多個 RCT 回顧）最強。
Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement
組織、實證護理與品質改善
Quality improvement monitors outcomes against standards; retrospective audits review charts after discharge, concurrent audits evaluate during care; peer review evaluates colleagues' care.
品質改善依標準監測成果；回溯稽核在出院後查閱病歷，同步稽核於照護期間評估；同儕審查評估同事的護理品質。
Organizations, evidence-based practice and quality improvement
組織、實證護理與品質改善
Lewin's change model: unfreezing (identify problem, gather evidence), moving/changing (plan and implement), refreezing (stabilize).
勒溫變革模式：解凍（辨識問題、蒐集證據）、移動/改變（規劃與執行）、再凍結（穩定）。

Resistance reasons: conformity, habit, fear, secondary gains, threats to basic needs, differing values. Overcome by involving everyone, stressing benefits, evaluating progress and giving feedback; confront resistant staff to elicit feelings.
抗拒原因：從眾、習慣、恐懼、次級獲益、基本需求受威脅、價值差異。克服方法：全員參與、強調益處、持續評值與回饋；面質抗拒者以引導說出感受。
Conflict types: intrapersonal, interpersonal, organizational. Modes: avoidance, accommodation, competition, compromise (assertive and cooperative).
衝突類型：個人內在、人際、組織。處理方式：迴避、順應、競爭、妥協（堅定且合作）。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Team roles: PHCP, PA, NP/APRN, PT, OT, respiratory therapist, speech therapist (swallowing), dietitian, continuing care nurse, pharmacist, social worker, chaplain, AP.
團隊角色：醫師、PA、NP/APRN、物理治療師、職能治療師、呼吸治療師、語言治療師（吞嚥）、營養師、延續照護護理師、藥師、社工、牧靈人員、助理。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Reports: factual, accurate, complete, organized; change-of-shift reports may be at the bedside; transfer reports include name, diagnosis, status, needs, allergies, resuscitation status.
報告：事實、準確、完整、有條理；交班可在床邊；轉送報告含姓名、診斷、狀況、需求、過敏與急救狀態。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
SBAR: Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation. Telephone reports should be documented (when, who, what).
SBAR：情況、背景、評估、建議。電話報告須記錄（時間、對象、內容）。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Consultation is sought when the problem exceeds nursing resources; rapid-response teams respond to early deterioration on non-ICU units to prevent arrest.
問題超出護理資源時尋求會診；快速反應小組處理非加護單位早期惡化以預防心肺停止。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Medication reconciliation: compare current and new medication lists at transitions, resolve discrepancies, communicate the final list.
藥物整合：在轉換照護時比對現用與新藥單、解決差異並傳達最終清單。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Discharge planning begins at admission; teach with teach-back about medications, diet, activity, complications, equipment, resources and follow-up.
出院準備自入院即開始；以回述教導藥物、飲食、活動、併發症、設備、資源與追蹤。
Health care team and interprofessional collaboration
醫療團隊與跨專業合作
Delegation transfers a task to a competent person; the nurse keeps accountability. Five rights: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.
委派是將任務交給有能力者；護理師仍負責任。五項正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。
Cannot delegate nursing judgment or critical decision making (assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation).
不可委派護理判斷或關鍵決策（評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值）。
AP: noninvasive tasks for stable clients. LPN/VN: stable clients, dressings, suctioning, catheterization, oral/SC/IM meds. RN: stable and unstable clients, IV meds, initial assessment and teaching.
AP：穩定病人的非侵入性工作。LPN/VN：穩定病人、換藥、抽吸、導尿、口服/皮下/肌肉藥。RN：穩定與不穩定病人、靜脈給藥、初始評估與衛教。
Give clear directions, validate understanding, give feedback; match task to the nurse practice act and job description.
指示清楚、確認理解、給予回饋；依護理執業法與職務說明配對任務。
Time management: list tasks, prioritize, begin rounds early, delegate, document concurrently, evaluate the day.
時間管理：列出任務、排序、早班巡視、委派、同步記錄、評估當日。
Priorities are high (life-threatening), intermediate (nonemergency) or low (unrelated to illness); the client's own priorities count.
優先順序分高（危及生命）、中（非緊急）、低（與疾病無直接關係）；病人自己的優先事項也要考量。
Use ABCs, Maslow and nursing process (assessment first); CPR uses CAB; actual problems before potential ones; act on critically abnormal values.
使用 ABC、馬斯洛、護理過程（評估優先）；CPR 用 CAB；現存問題先於潛在問題；對嚴重異常值立即處理。
Group of clients: heart failure with 4-lb gain and dyspnea first, then fresh chest tube post-op, then absent bowel sounds, then pre-op teaching.
多位病人：心衰竭體重增加 4 磅且呼吸喘者優先，其次術後胸管，其次腸音消失，最後術前衛教。
Teaching priorities: immediate needs, client's perceived needs, anxiety level, time available.
衛教優先：立即需求、病人認為重要的事、焦慮程度、可用時間。
Internal disasters occur within the facility; external outside it; a mass casualty event exceeds hospital resources. Activate the emergency response plan immediately.
內部災難發生於機構內；外部災難發生於機構外；大規模傷亡超出醫院資源。立即啟動緊急應變計畫。
FEMA phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery; three disaster levels (I massive to III minor). ARC provides free relief, shelters and crisis counseling; HAZMAT teams handle exposures.
FEMA 階段：減災、整備、應變、復原；災難三級（I 級重大至 III 級輕微）。紅十字會提供免費救援、庇護與危機諮商；HAZMAT 處理暴露事件。
Triage: START tags in 30-60 seconds; ED triage emergent (red, priority 1), urgent (yellow, priority 2), nonurgent (green, priority 3); black for expected deaths. Think survivability.
檢傷：START 於 30-60 秒內分類；急診緊急（紅、第 1 優先）、次緊急（黃、第 2 優先）、非緊急（綠、第 3 優先）；黑色為預期死亡。思考可存活性。
Primary assessment (ABCs, check central pulse 5-10 seconds, agonal breathing needs ventilation) precedes secondary assessment (history, vital signs, neuro, pain, head-to-toe).
初級評估（ABC、中心脈搏檢查 5-10 秒、瀕死喘息需通氣）先於次級評估（病史、生命徵象、神經、疼痛、頭到腳）。
Personal preparedness: 3-day supply of water (1 gallon per person per day) and food, medications, radio, flashlight, documents; replace water every 3 months and food every 6 months.
個人整備：三天份飲水（每人每日 1 加侖）與食物、藥物、收音機、手電筒、證件；水每 3 個月、食物每 6 個月更換。
Delegate only tasks within the delegatee's scope; the delegating nurse stays accountable.
只委派在被委派者範圍內的任務；委派的護理師仍負責任。
Five rights of delegation: task, circumstances, person, direction/communication, supervision/evaluation.
委派五正確：任務、情境、人員、指示/溝通、督導/評值。
Do not delegate assessment, teaching initiation, planning, evaluation or unstable clients.
不可委派評估、起始衛教、計畫、評值或不穩定病人。
AP tasks: ADLs, ambulation, skin care, collecting urine specimens, vitals on stable clients.
AP 工作：日常生活照護、行走、皮膚照護、收集尿液檢體、穩定病人量生命徵象。
ED triage: chest pain, respiratory distress, trauma, acute neuro deficit, chemical eye splash = emergent (red).
急診檢傷：胸痛、呼吸窘迫、外傷、急性神經缺損、眼睛化學物噴濺 = 緊急（紅）。
Think survivability when triaging disaster victims; treat those who can be saved first.
災難檢傷時考量可存活性；先救治有存活機會者。
Closed chest-tube clients and unstable clients need assessment before stable teaching or discharge.
胸管或不穩定病人須先於穩定病人的衛教或出院處理。
Team nursing: RN leader directs a team (LPNs and APs); functional is task-based; primary is one nurse per client.
小組護理：RN 組長領導 LPN 與 AP；功能制按工作分配；責任制由一位護理師負責一位病人。
Lewin: unfreezing, moving, refreezing; confront resisting staff to explore feelings.
勒溫：解凍、移動、再凍結；面質抗拒者以探索感受。
Medicare Part B covers 80%; client pays 20% unless supplemental insurance.
Medicare B 部分給付 80%，其餘 20% 自付，除非有補充保險。
Rapid-response team: call early for signs of deterioration to prevent arrest.
快速反應小組：出現惡化徵象時及早呼叫以預防心肺停止。
Disaster plan phases: mitigation, preparedness, response, recovery.
災難計畫階段：減災、整備、應變、復原。
Medication reconciliation at admission, transfer and discharge.
在入院、轉床與出院時進行藥物整合。
Report impaired staff or short staffing to administration; never abandon an assignment.
通報受物質影響的同事或人力不足；不可擅離工作。
Management functions P-O-D-C: Planning, Organizing, Directing, Controlling.
管理功能 P-O-D-C：計畫、組織、指導、控制。

急診檢傷顏色：紅=緊急、黃=次緊急、綠=非緊急、黑=預期死亡。

Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念
Electrolytes ionize in solution; cations are positive and anions negative, and they must balance. Activity is measured in milliequivalents (mEq).
電解質在溶液中會解離成離子;陽離子帶正電、陰離子帶負電,兩者必須平衡,以毫當量(mEq)表示活性。
Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念
Fluid compartments: intracellular (about 70% of body water) and extracellular (about 30%), the latter split into interstitial (22%), intravascular (6%) and transcellular (2%).
體液分區:細胞內液約佔 70%,細胞外液約佔 30%,其中組織間液 22%、血管內液 6%、跨細胞液 2%。
Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念
Third-spacing traps extracellular fluid in a body space (pleural, peritoneal, bowel, burned tissue); it is a real intravascular loss that may not show in weight or intake/output.
第三間隙積液是指細胞外液被困在體腔(胸腔、腹腔、腸道、燒傷組織)中,實際造成血管內容積流失,但體重與輸出入量不一定反映。
Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念

Edema is excess interstitial fluid from altered oncotic or hydrostatic pressure, capillary permeability or lymphatic obstruction; generalized edema (anasarca) suggests cardiac, renal or liver disease.
水腫是組織間液過多,源於膠體滲透壓、靜水壓、微血管通透性或淋巴阻塞改變;全身性水腫(anasarca)常見於心、腎或肝臟疾病。
Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念
Total body water is about 60% of weight in adults, 55% in older adults and 80% in infants, so infants and older adults are at greater risk for fluid imbalance.
成人體水約佔體重 60%,老年人 55%,嬰兒 80%,因此嬰兒與老年人較易發生體液失衡。
Concepts of fluid and electrolyte balance
體液與電解質平衡的基本概念
Diffusion moves solute from high to low concentration; osmosis moves water toward the side with more solute; filtration moves fluid from higher to lower hydrostatic pressure.
擴散是溶質由高濃度往低濃度移動;滲透是水往溶質較多的一側移動;過濾則是液體由高靜水壓往低靜水壓移動。
At the arterial end of a capillary hydrostatic pressure pushes fluid out; at the venous end osmotic pull draws fluid back; lymph returns the remainder.
微血管動脈端靜水壓使液體流出,靜脈端滲透壓將液體拉回,剩餘部分由淋巴回收。
血漿滲透壓正常值為 275-295 mOsm/kg。
Isotonic solutions match body fluid osmolality (little osmosis); hypotonic solutions have lower and hypertonic solutions higher osmolality than body fluids.
等張溶液與體液滲透壓相同(幾乎不產生滲透);低張溶液滲透壓較低,高張溶液較高。
Active transport moves ions (Na+, K+, Ca2+, H+) against a gradient and needs cellular energy.
主動運輸需消耗細胞能量,使離子(Na+、K+、Ca2+、H+)逆濃度梯度移動。
Intake is about 2300-2900 mL/day (drinks, food, metabolic water); output is about 2600-3000 mL/day, mostly kidney (about 1500 mL).
每日攝入約 2300-2900 mL(飲水、食物、代謝水),排出約 2600-3000 mL,以腎臟最多(約 1500 mL)。
Insensible loss occurs through skin (600-800 mL) and lungs (400-600 mL) and cannot be measured exactly.
不感性流失來自皮膚(600-800 mL)與肺部(400-600 mL),無法精確測量。
Kidneys are the major regulators; aldosterone retains sodium (and water), and ADH controls water reabsorption.
腎臟是主要調節器官;醛固酮促進鈉(及水)再吸收,抗利尿激素(ADH)調節水分再吸收。
Severe diarrhea causes large fluid and electrolyte losses. With any imbalance, monitor cardiovascular, respiratory, neurological, musculoskeletal, renal, skin and GI status.
嚴重腹瀉會造成大量體液與電解質流失。發生任何失衡時,須監測心血管、呼吸、神經、肌肉骨骼、腎臟、皮膚與腸胃狀態。

Isotonic dehydration (hypovolemia) is the most common deficit: water and electrolytes are lost equally. Hypertonic: water loss exceeds electrolytes (cells shrink). Hypotonic: electrolyte loss exceeds water (cells swell).
等張性脫水(低血容)最常見,水與電解質等比例流失;高張性脫水為水分流失多於電解質(細胞萎縮);低張性脫水為電解質流失多於水分(細胞腫脹)。
Deficit findings: tachycardia with thready pulse, hypotension, flat neck veins, low CVP, dry mucosa, poor turgor, weight loss, low urine output, high hematocrit/BUN/osmolality/urine specific gravity.
容積不足表現:脈搏快而細弱、低血壓、頸靜脈扁塌、CVP 低、黏膜乾燥、皮膚彈性差、體重下降、尿量少,血比容、BUN、滲透壓與尿比重上升。
Excess findings: bounding pulse, high BP, distended neck veins, high CVP, crackles, dyspnea, edema, weight gain, ascites; low hematocrit/BUN/osmolality/urine specific gravity.
容積過多表現:脈搏洪大、高血壓、頸靜脈怒張、CVP 高、囉音、呼吸困難、水腫、體重增加、腹水;血比容、BUN、滲透壓與尿比重下降。
Treat deficit with oral or IV fluids and treat the cause (isotonic loss with isotonic fluid, hypertonic with hypotonic, hypotonic with hypertonic fluid); monitor I&O.
不足時給予口服或靜脈輸液並處理原因(等張流失用等張液、高張性用低張液、低張性用高張液),並監測輸出入量。
Treat excess with diuretics, fluid and sodium restriction, daily weight and I&O. Highest risk: AKI, CKD, heart failure, long-term corticosteroids.
過多時給予利尿劑、限制水分與鈉攝取,監測每日體重與輸出入量。高風險族群:急性腎損傷、慢性腎病、心衰竭、長期使用類固醇者。
Hypotonic overhydration (water intoxication) occurs with SIADH, heart failure, early kidney disease, or hypotonic IV/irrigation fluids.
低張性水過多(水中毒)見於 SIADH、心衰竭、早期腎病,或使用低張靜脈輸液/沖洗液。
Normal K+ is 3.5-5.0 mEq/L. Hypokalemia causes: diuretics, corticosteroids, albuterol, vomiting, diarrhea, NG suction, Cushing's, alkalosis, hyperinsulinism, NPO status.
鉀正常值 3.5-5.0 mEq/L。低血鉀原因:利尿劑、類固醇、albuterol、嘔吐、腹瀉、鼻胃管抽吸、庫欣氏症、鹼中毒、高胰島素、禁食。
Hypokalemia findings: weak thready irregular pulse, shallow respirations, weakness and cramps, hypoactive bowel/paralytic ileus; ECG shows ST depression, flat/inverted T waves, prominent U waves.
低血鉀表現:脈搏細弱不規則、呼吸淺、肌無力與抽筋、腸蠕動減弱/麻痺性腸阻塞;心電圖 ST 段下降、T 波平坦或倒置、U 波明顯。
Oral potassium: give with food/juice; liquid KCl tastes bad. IV potassium: always diluted, via infusion pump, never IV push, IM or subcutaneous.
口服鉀劑須隨餐或加果汁服用;靜脈鉀劑一定要稀釋並使用輸液幫浦,絕不可靜脈推注、肌肉或皮下注射。
Hyperkalemia causes: K+ supplements or salt substitutes, K+-sparing diuretics, kidney disease, Addison's, tissue damage/burns, acidosis, stored blood.
高血鉀原因:鉀補充劑或代鹽、保鉀利尿劑、腎病、愛迪生氏症、組織損傷/燒傷、酸中毒、庫存血。
Hyperkalemia findings: slow weak irregular pulse, hypotension, muscle weakness to ascending flaccid paralysis, hyperactive bowel/diarrhea; ECG shows tall peaked T, flat P, wide QRS, prolonged PR.
高血鉀表現:心跳慢而弱且不規則、低血壓、肌無力甚至上行性弛緩性麻痺、腸蠕動亢進/腹瀉;心電圖 T 波高尖、P 波平坦、QRS 變寬、PR 間期延長。
Treat hyperkalemia: stop K+ intake, IV calcium (protect heart), insulin with glucose, sodium polystyrene sulfonate, K+-excreting diuretics, dialysis if critical.
高血鉀處置:停止鉀攝入、靜脈鈣劑(保護心臟)、胰島素加葡萄糖、sodium polystyrene sulfonate、排鉀利尿劑,嚴重時透析。
Normal Na+ is 135-145 mEq/L; sodium problems usually travel with fluid volume problems.
鈉正常值 135-145 mEq/L;鈉失衡通常伴隨體液容積問題。
Hyponatremia causes: diaphoresis, diuretics, vomiting, diarrhea, SIADH, hypotonic fluids, heart failure, hyperglycemia, freshwater drowning.
低血鈉原因:大量流汗、利尿劑、嘔吐、腹瀉、SIADH、低張液體、心衰竭、高血糖、淡水溺水。
Hyponatremia findings: headache, confusion, seizures, weakness, hyperactive bowel sounds, abdominal cramping, increased urine output, low urine specific gravity.
低血鈉表現:頭痛、意識混亂、癲癇、無力、腸蠕動亢進、腹絞痛、尿量增加、尿比重降低。
Correct hyponatremia slowly; rapid correction risks osmotic demyelination. Hyponatremia can raise lithium levels toward toxicity.
低血鈉須緩慢矯正,過快有滲透性去髓鞘病變風險;低血鈉亦可導致鋰中毒。
Hypernatremia causes: corticosteroids, Cushing's, hyperaldosteronism, excess sodium intake, low water intake, fever, watery diarrhea, diabetes insipidus.
高血鈉原因:類固醇、庫欣氏症、高醛固酮症、鈉攝取過多、水分攝取不足、發燒、水瀉、尿崩症。
Hypernatremia findings: extreme thirst, dry sticky mucosa, flushed skin, agitation, confusion, seizures; high urine specific gravity. Altered cerebral function is the most common sign.
高血鈉表現:極度口渴、黏膜乾而黏、皮膚潮紅、躁動、意識混亂、癲癇;尿比重上升。腦功能改變為最常見症狀。
Normal calcium is 9-10.5 mg/dL. Corrected Ca = serum Ca + 0.8 x (4 - albumin). Ionized calcium normal is 4.64-5.28.
鈣正常值 9-10.5 mg/dL。校正鈣 = 血清鈣 + 0.8 x (4 - 白蛋白)。離子鈣正常值 4.64-5.28。
Hypocalcemia causes: low intake or vitamin D, lactose intolerance, malabsorption (Crohn's, celiac), diarrhea, alkalosis, acute pancreatitis, hyperphosphatemia, hypoparathyroidism.
低血鈣原因:攝取或維生素 D 不足、乳糖不耐、吸收不良(克隆氏症、乳糜瀉)、腹瀉、鹼中毒、急性胰臟炎、高血磷、副甲狀腺功能低下。
Hypocalcemia findings: tingling/numbness, twitching, cramps, tetany, seizures, hyperactive reflexes, positive Chvostek's and Trousseau's signs, increased GI motility; ECG prolonged ST and QT.
低血鈣表現:麻刺感、抽搐、痙攣、手足僵直、癲癇、反射亢進、Chvostek 與 Trousseau 徵象陽性、腸蠕動增加;心電圖 ST 與 QT 延長。
Treat with oral calcium and vitamin D or slow warmed IV calcium (keep 10% calcium gluconate available), seizure precautions, quiet environment, careful handling (fracture risk).
治療:口服鈣劑與維生素 D,或緩慢給予已加溫的靜脈鈣劑(備妥 10% 葡萄糖酸鈣)、癲癇防護、安靜環境、謹慎搬動(骨折風險)。
Hypercalcemia causes: hyperparathyroidism, hyperthyroidism, malignancy, immobility, thiazides, lithium, dehydration, excess calcium/vitamin D.
高血鈣原因:副甲狀腺或甲狀腺功能亢進、惡性腫瘤、制動、thiazide 利尿劑、鋰、脫水、鈣/維生素 D 過量。

Hypercalcemia findings: muscle weakness, absent reflexes, constipation, anorexia, bradycardia/heart block; ECG shortened ST, widened T. Give isotonic saline, calcitonin, bisphosphonates; strain urine for stones.
高血鈣表現:肌無力、反射消失、便秘、食慾差、心搏過緩/心臟傳導阻滯;心電圖 ST 縮短、T 波變寬。治療:等張生理食鹽水、calcitonin、雙磷酸鹽,並過濾尿液檢查結石。
Normal magnesium is 1.8-2.6 mEq/L. Hypomagnesemia causes: malnutrition, alcoholism, diuretics, malabsorption, vomiting/diarrhea, insulin, sepsis.
鎂正常值 1.8-2.6 mEq/L。低血鎂原因:營養不良、酒精中毒、利尿劑、吸收不良、嘔吐/腹瀉、胰島素、敗血症。
Hypomagnesemia findings: tachycardia, hypertension, hyperreflexia, tremors/twitching, tetany, seizures, positive Chvostek's/Trousseau's; often coexists with hypocalcemia.
低血鎂表現:心跳快、高血壓、反射亢進、顫抖/抽搐、手足僵直、癲癇、Chvostek/Trousseau 陽性;常合併低血鈣。
IV magnesium sulfate is preferred in ill clients (IM is painful); monitor reflexes for loss, which signals toxicity.
重症者以靜脈硫酸鎂補充(肌肉注射疼痛且傷組織);須監測深部肌腱反射,反射消失表示鎂過量。

Hypermagnesemia causes: Mg-containing antacids/laxatives, excess IV magnesium, renal insufficiency. Findings: bradycardia, hypotension, drowsiness, absent reflexes, respiratory depression; ECG prolonged PR, wide QRS.
高血鎂原因:含鎂制酸劑/瀉劑、靜脈鎂過量、腎功能不全。表現:心跳慢、低血壓、嗜睡、反射消失、呼吸抑制;心電圖 PR 延長、QRS 變寬。
Antidote for magnesium overdose is IV calcium gluconate (or calcium chloride); diuretics increase excretion; avoid Mg-containing laxatives/antacids.
鎂中毒的解毒劑為靜脈葡萄糖酸鈣(或氯化鈣);利尿劑促進排出;避免使用含鎂瀉劑與制酸劑。
Normal phosphorus is 3.0-4.5 mg/dL. Phosphorus and calcium have a reciprocal relationship: when one rises, the other falls.
磷正常值 3.0-4.5 mg/dL。磷與鈣呈相反關係:一方上升,另一方下降。
Hypophosphatemia causes: malnutrition/starvation, hyperparathyroidism, malignancy, Mg- or aluminum-based antacids, hyperglycemia, respiratory alkalosis. Mild cases may be symptom-free.
低血磷原因:營養不良/飢餓、副甲狀腺亢進、惡性腫瘤、含鎂或鋁的制酸劑、高血糖、呼吸性鹼中毒。輕度可能無症狀。
Treat hypophosphatemia with oral phosphorus plus vitamin D; IV phosphorus only when below 1 mg/dL with critical signs, given slowly after assessing renal function.
低血磷以口服磷加維生素 D 治療;僅在低於 1 mg/dL 並有嚴重症狀時才靜脈給磷,須先評估腎功能並緩慢輸注。
Hyperphosphatemia causes: renal insufficiency, tumor lysis syndrome, hypoparathyroidism, phosphate laxatives/enemas. Its problems come from the resulting hypocalcemia.
高血磷原因:腎功能不全、腫瘤溶解症候群、副甲狀腺功能低下、含磷瀉劑/灌腸劑。其問題主要來自隨之發生的低血鈣。
Give phosphate binders with or right after meals; limit high-phosphorus foods; avoid phosphate laxatives and enemas.
磷結合劑須隨餐或餐後立即服用;減少高磷食物;避免含磷瀉劑與灌腸劑。
Normal values: K+ 3.5-5.0; Na+ 135-145; Ca 9-10.5 mg/dL; Mg 1.8-2.6 mEq/L; phosphorus 3.0-4.5 mg/dL; osmolality 275-295 mOsm/kg.
IV potassium is never given by IV push, IM or subcutaneously; always dilute (max 1 mEq/10 mL), use a pump, 5-10 mEq/hr usual and never above 20 mEq/hr.
靜脈鉀絕不可推注、肌肉或皮下注射;須稀釋(最多 1 mEq/10 mL)並用幫浦,常規 5-10 mEq/hr,絕不超過 20 mEq/hr。
Over 10 mEq/hr of IV potassium requires cardiac monitoring; assess renal function and urine output (report under 30 mL/hr) and check IV site for phlebitis/infiltration.
靜脈鉀超過 10 mEq/hr 需心電圖監測;須評估腎功能與尿量(低於 30 mL/hr 通報),並觀察注射部位有無靜脈炎/滲漏。
Hyperkalemia ECG: tall peaked T, flat P, widened QRS, prolonged PR. Hypokalemia ECG: ST depression, flat/inverted T, prominent U.
高血鉀心電圖:T 波高尖、P 波平坦、QRS 變寬、PR 延長。低血鉀:ST 下降、T 波平坦/倒置、U 波明顯。
Severe hyperkalemia: stop K+, give IV calcium to protect the heart, insulin plus glucose to shift K+ into cells, then remove K+ (diuretics, sodium polystyrene sulfonate, dialysis).
嚴重高血鉀:停鉀、靜脈鈣保護心臟、胰島素加葡萄糖使鉀移入細胞,再排除鉀(利尿劑、sodium polystyrene sulfonate、透析)。
Stored (older) blood releases potassium; give fresh blood when possible to a client with hyperkalemia.
庫存較久的血液會釋出鉀;高血鉀患者輸血時盡量使用新鮮血。
Correct hyponatremia slowly to avoid osmotic demyelination; hyponatremia can precipitate lithium toxicity.
低血鈉須緩慢矯正以避免滲透性去髓鞘;低血鈉會誘發鋰中毒。
Hypocalcemia signs: Chvostek's (facial twitch on tapping cheek) and Trousseau's (carpal spasm with BP cuff) signs, tetany, seizures, prolonged QT; keep 10% calcium gluconate available.
低血鈣徵象:Chvostek(輕敲臉頰抽動)與 Trousseau(壓脈帶造成腕痙攣)、手足僵直、癲癇、QT 延長;備妥 10% 葡萄糖酸鈣。
Correct calcium for low albumin: Ca + 0.8 x (4 - albumin), or check ionized calcium.
低白蛋白時需校正鈣:鈣 + 0.8 x (4 - 白蛋白),或檢測離子鈣。
Calcium gluconate is the antidote for magnesium overdose; loss of deep tendon reflexes is an early sign of hypermagnesemia.
葡萄糖酸鈣是鎂過量的解毒劑;深部肌腱反射消失是高血鎂的早期徵象。
Calcium and phosphorus are reciprocal: high phosphorus lowers calcium, low phosphorus raises calcium.
鈣與磷呈相反關係:磷高則鈣低,磷低則鈣高。
Fluid deficit: tachycardia, low BP, flat neck veins, weight loss, high hematocrit/BUN/specific gravity. Excess: bounding pulse, high BP, crackles, edema, weight gain, low hematocrit.
容積不足:心跳快、低血壓、頸靜脈扁塌、體重下降、血比容/BUN/尿比重高。過多:脈搏洪大、高血壓、囉音、水腫、體重增加、血比容低。

Clients with AKI, CKD or heart failure are at high risk for fluid volume excess and hyperkalemia/hyperphosphatemia; vomiting, diarrhea, NG suction, ileostomy and diuretics cause deficits and hypokalemia.
急性腎損傷、慢性腎病或心衰竭患者易有容積過多、高血鉀與高血磷;嘔吐、腹瀉、鼻胃管抽吸、迴腸造口與利尿劑易致不足與低血鉀。
Infants and older adults have a higher fluid-imbalance risk (total body water 80% and 55%).
嬰兒與老年人體液失衡風險較高(體水量分別為 80% 與 55%)。
Moving clients with calcium or phosphorus imbalance carefully because of pathological fracture risk.
鈣或磷失衡的患者須小心移動,以免病理性骨折。
Hyperkalemia ECG: 'Tall T, flat P, wide QRS' (peaked T waves, flat P waves, widened QRS). Hypokalemia is the opposite pattern: flat T, U wave appears ('U need K+').
高血鉀心電圖口訣:「高 T、平 P、寬 QRS」。低血鉀相反:T 波平、出現 U 波(「U 需要 K+」)。
Hypocalcemia = 'CATS go numb': Convulsions, Arrhythmias, Tetany, Spasms (and numbness/tingling).
低血鈣口訣「CATS」:Convulsions(癲癇)、Arrhythmias(心律不整)、Tetany(手足僵直)、Spasms(痙攣),並伴麻刺感。
Calcium-phosphorus seesaw: one goes up, the other goes down.

Blood pH must stay between 7.35 and 7.45; below is acidosis, above is alkalosis.
血液 pH 須維持在 7.35-7.45;低於此為酸中毒,高於此為鹼中毒。
Acids donate hydrogen ions and are end products of metabolism; bases accept hydrogen ions.
酸是氫離子的提供者,為代謝終產物;鹼是氫離子的接受者。
血清碳酸氫根(HCO3-)正常值 21-28 mEq/L。
Buffers act fastest, giving immediate protection against pH change; once used up the body has less reserve.
緩衝系統反應最快,能立即防止 pH 改變;用盡後身體的儲備就減少。
Extracellular buffers: hemoglobin (chloride shift), plasma proteins, carbonic acid-bicarbonate (the main buffer) and phosphate.
細胞外緩衝系統包括血紅素(氯離子轉移)、血漿蛋白、碳酸-碳酸氫鹽(主要緩衝系統)與磷酸鹽。
Normal pH of 7.4 reflects a bicarbonate : carbonic acid ratio of 20:1; lungs control carbonic acid (CO2) and kidneys control bicarbonate.
pH 7.4 代表碳酸氫根與碳酸比為 20:1;肺控制碳酸(CO2),腎控制碳酸氫根。
The underlying cause of any imbalance must be identified and treated.
必須找出並治療酸鹼失衡的根本原因。
Lungs are the second defense and respond in 10-30 seconds: in acidosis rate and depth rise to blow off CO2; in alkalosis they fall to retain CO2.
肺是第二道防線,10-30 秒內反應:酸中毒時呼吸加快加深以排出 CO2;鹼中毒時呼吸變慢變淺以留住 CO2。
Kidneys are slower (hours to days) but more thorough: they excrete H+ and retain HCO3- in acidosis, and excrete HCO3- in alkalosis.
腎臟反應較慢(數小時至數天)但更完整:酸中毒時排 H+、留 HCO3-;鹼中毒時排 HCO3-。
Potassium shifts: in acidosis H+ enters cells and K+ leaves, causing hyperkalemia; in alkalosis K+ enters cells, causing hypokalemia.
鉀離子移動:酸中毒時 H+ 進入細胞、K+ 移出,造成高血鉀;鹼中毒時 K+ 進入細胞,造成低血鉀。
Monitor potassium closely in any acid-base imbalance because of dysrhythmia risk.
任何酸鹼失衡都須密切監測血鉀,因有心律不整風險。
Caused by hypoventilation with CO2 retention: COPD/emphysema, asthma, pneumonia, atelectasis, pulmonary edema or emboli, brain trauma, and CNS depressants (opioids, sedatives, anesthetics).
因換氣不足導致 CO2 滯留:COPD/肺氣腫、氣喘、肺炎、肺不張、肺水腫或肺栓塞、腦外傷、中樞神經抑制劑(鴉片類、鎮靜劑、麻醉劑)。
Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, dizziness, coma, hypotension, dysrhythmias (from hyperkalemia), warm flushed skin, seizures.
表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、頭暈、昏迷、低血壓、心律不整(高血鉀所致)、皮膚溫熱潮紅、癲癇。

Care: O2 as prescribed, semi-Fowler's position, turn/cough/deep-breathe, suction, respiratory treatments; avoid sedatives; prepare for intubation and ventilation if CO2 is above 50 mm Hg with acute distress.
處置:依醫囑給氧、半坐臥、翻身咳嗽深呼吸、抽吸、呼吸治療;避免鎮靜劑;若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 且急性呼吸窘迫,準備插管與機械通氣。
Caused by overstimulated breathing: hyperventilation, anxiety, pain, fever, hypoxia, and over-ventilation by a mechanical ventilator.
因呼吸過度刺激:換氣過度、焦慮、疼痛、發燒、缺氧,以及呼吸器過度換氣。
Findings: light-headedness, dizziness, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, numbness and tingling of extremities, tetany, hyperreflexia, seizures.
表現:輕飄感、頭暈、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、四肢麻刺、手足僵直、反射亢進、癲癇。
Care: reassure, coach slow breathing, breath holding or rebreathing (paper bag/rebreather mask), adjust ventilator, calcium gluconate for tetany as prescribed.
處置:安撫、指導緩慢呼吸、閉氣或再吸入(紙袋/再呼吸面罩)、調整呼吸器,依醫囑給葡萄糖酸鈣治療手足僵直。
Causes: diabetic ketoacidosis, aspirin overdose, lactic acidosis, malnutrition, high-fat diet, renal failure, severe diarrhea (loss of alkaline fluid).
原因:糖尿病酮酸中毒、阿斯匹靈過量、乳酸中毒、營養不良、高脂飲食、腎衰竭、嚴重腹瀉(流失鹼性液體)。
Findings: lethargy, confusion, headache, hypotension, dysrhythmias, cold clammy skin, nausea/vomiting/diarrhea, and Kussmaul's respirations (deep, rapid).
表現:嗜睡、意識混亂、頭痛、低血壓、心律不整、皮膚冰冷濕黏、噁心嘔吐腹瀉,以及 Kussmaul 呼吸(深快)。
Care: IV fluids and buffer base, monitor I&O and electrolytes; in DKA give insulin and fluid resuscitation; in kidney disease dialysis and a low-protein, high-calorie diet.
處置:靜脈輸液與補充緩衝鹼、監測輸出入量與電解質;DKA 給予胰島素與輸液復甦;腎病則透析並採低蛋白高熱量飲食。
Causes: excessive vomiting or NG suction (loss of HCl), diuretics, hyperaldosteronism, excess sodium bicarbonate, massive whole-blood transfusion (citrate becomes bicarbonate).
原因:大量嘔吐或鼻胃管抽吸(流失鹽酸)、利尿劑、高醛固酮症、碳酸氫鈉過量、大量輸入全血(檸檬酸轉為碳酸氫鹽)。
Findings: dizziness, irritability, confusion, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, nausea/vomiting, tetany, tremors, tingling, muscle cramps, seizures; breathing becomes slow and shallow.
表現:頭暈、易怒、意識混亂、心跳快、心律不整、噁心嘔吐、手足僵直、顫抖、麻刺、肌肉痙攣、癲癇;呼吸變慢變淺。
Care: IV fluids and medications to promote bicarbonate excretion, replace potassium as prescribed, monitor respiratory status.
處置:依醫囑給予靜脈輸液與藥物促進碳酸氫根排出、補充鉀,並監測呼吸狀態。
Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45; PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg; HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L; PaO2 80-100 mm Hg (venous pH 7.31-7.41, PvO2 40-50).
ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45;PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg;HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L;PaO2 80-100 mm Hg(靜脈 pH 7.31-7.41、PvO2 40-50)。
Perform the Allen's test before radial puncture to confirm ulnar collateral flow; positive means immediate flushing after releasing the ulnar artery.
橈動脈穿刺前先做 Allen 測試確認尺動脈側支循環;放開尺動脈後手掌立即變紅即為陽性。
Use a heparinized syringe, remove any air, press the site 5 minutes (10 if on anticoagulants), recheck the radial pulse, send on ice.
使用含肝素針筒、排除空氣,穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑者 10 分鐘),再確認橈動脈搏動,冰浴送檢。
Record temperature and O2 delivery on the lab form; note recent suctioning (within 20 minutes) or O2 changes.
檢驗單上註明體溫與給氧方式;留意 20 分鐘內是否抽痰或調整氧氣。
Step 1: pH low = acidosis, high = alkalosis. Step 2: if PaCO2 moves in the OPPOSITE direction to pH, it is respiratory. Step 3: if HCO3- moves in the SAME direction as pH, it is metabolic.
步驟 1:pH 低為酸中毒、高為鹼中毒。步驟 2:PaCO2 與 pH 方向「相反」則為呼吸性。步驟 3:HCO3- 與 pH 方向「相同」則為代謝性。
Step 4: a normal pH (7.35-7.45) means full compensation; if pH is abnormal, check the other indicator: abnormal value = partial compensation, normal value = uncompensated.
步驟 4:pH 回到 7.35-7.45 表示完全代償;pH 仍異常時,看另一指標:已異常為部分代償,仍正常為未代償。
Mixed disorders combine two problems (e.g., hyperventilation from pain plus gastric suction gives mixed alkalosis).
混合性失衡為同時存在兩種問題(如疼痛致換氣過度加胃管抽吸造成混合性鹼中毒)。
Potassium is usually increased in acidosis and decreased in alkalosis.
酸中毒時鉀通常上升,鹼中毒時鉀通常下降。
Normal ABG: pH 7.35-7.45, PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg, HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L, PaO2 80-100 mm Hg.
ABG 正常值:pH 7.35-7.45、PaCO2 35-45 mm Hg、HCO3- 21-28 mEq/L、PaO2 80-100 mm Hg。
Respiratory indicator is PaCO2; metabolic indicator is HCO3-.
呼吸指標是 PaCO2;代謝指標是 HCO3-。
Respiratory imbalance: pH and PaCO2 move in opposite directions. Metabolic imbalance: pH and HCO3- move together.
呼吸性失衡:pH 與 PaCO2 方向相反。代謝性失衡:pH 與 HCO3- 方向一致。
完全代償 = pH 回到 7.35-7.45。
Respiratory acidosis: pH low, PaCO2 high. Respiratory alkalosis: pH high, PaCO2 low.
呼吸性酸中毒:pH 低、PaCO2 高。呼吸性鹼中毒:pH 高、PaCO2 低。
Metabolic acidosis: pH low, HCO3- low. Metabolic alkalosis: pH high, HCO3- high.
代謝性酸中毒:pH 低、HCO3- 低。代謝性鹼中毒:pH 高、HCO3- 高。
Vomiting and NG suction cause metabolic alkalosis (HCl loss); severe diarrhea and DKA cause metabolic acidosis.
嘔吐與鼻胃管抽吸造成代謝性鹼中毒(流失鹽酸);嚴重腹瀉與 DKA 造成代謝性酸中毒。
COPD, hypoventilation and opioid/sedative overdose cause respiratory acidosis; avoid sedatives and opioids in these clients.
COPD、換氣不足與鴉片類/鎮靜劑過量造成呼吸性酸中毒;此類患者應避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類。
Kussmaul's respirations (deep and rapid) are the lungs' compensation for metabolic acidosis such as DKA.
Kussmaul 呼吸(深而快)是肺對代謝性酸中毒(如 DKA)的代償。
Acidosis raises serum K+ (hyperkalemia); alkalosis lowers it (hypokalemia). Watch for dysrhythmias.
酸中毒使血鉀上升(高血鉀);鹼中毒使血鉀下降(低血鉀)。須留意心律不整。
Lungs compensate in 10-30 seconds; kidneys take hours to days but are more complete.
肺代償需 10-30 秒;腎臟需數小時至數天,但更完整。
Intubation/ventilation needed in respiratory acidosis when CO2 exceeds 50 mm Hg with acute respiratory distress.
呼吸性酸中毒若 CO2 超過 50 mm Hg 並有急性呼吸窘迫,需準備插管與通氣。
Do an Allen's test before radial ABG puncture; after puncture hold pressure 5 min (10 min if anticoagulated).
橈動脈採 ABG 前先做 Allen 測試;穿刺後壓迫 5 分鐘(使用抗凝劑 10 分鐘)。
Treat the underlying cause of every acid-base disorder and monitor level of consciousness, electrolytes and repeat ABGs.
每種酸鹼失衡都要治療根本原因,並監測意識程度、電解質與追蹤 ABG。
Hyperventilation from anxiety, pain or fever causes respiratory alkalosis; rebreathing (paper bag) and calm coaching help.
焦慮、疼痛或發燒造成的換氣過度導致呼吸性鹼中毒;可用再吸入(紙袋)與安撫指導呼吸。
ROME: Respiratory Opposite, Metabolic Equal (pH vs PaCO2 opposite = respiratory; pH vs HCO3- same direction = metabolic).
ROME 口訣:呼吸性相反(Respiratory Opposite)、代謝性相同(Metabolic Equal)。pH 與 PaCO2 相反為呼吸性;pH 與 HCO3- 同向為代謝性。
Tic-Tac-Toe ABG: place pH, PaCO2, HCO3- in a row and check which one matches the pH direction.
ABG 判讀三格法:把 pH、PaCO2、HCO3- 排成一列,看哪一個與 pH 的方向吻合(酸中毒:pH 低,PaCO2 高 = 呼吸;HCO3- 低 = 代謝)。
Vomiting = alkalosis (lose acid); diarrhea = acidosis (lose base).
嘔吐=鹼中毒(失酸);腹瀉=酸中毒(失鹼)。

Measure on admission, during assessment, before/after invasive or surgical procedures, with drugs affecting heart/lungs/temperature, before/during/after transfusion, with any change in condition, and every 2-4 hours with fever or infection.

Postoperative rising heart rate with falling BP and SpO2 suggests bleeding.
術後心跳上升、血壓與血氧下降提示出血。
生命徵象:原則與測量時機
Normal range about 97.0-99.0 F (36.1-37.2 C); many settings define fever as 100.4 F (38 C) or higher.
正常範圍約 97.0-99.0 F(36.1-37.2 C);許多機構以 100.4 F(38 C)以上定義為發燒。
Rectal readings run about 1 F higher; tympanic and axillary about 1 F lower than oral. Temperature is lowest on waking and peaks late afternoon/evening.
肛溫約高 1 F;耳溫與腋溫約低 1 F。體溫起床時最低,傍晚到晚上最高。
Oral: wait 15-30 min after hot/cold food, smoking or gum; avoid with nasal congestion. Rectal: left side-lying, insert about 1.5 in (3.8 cm), 0.5 in in infants.
口溫:進食冷熱食物、吸菸或嚼口香糖後等 15-30 分鐘;鼻塞者避免。肛溫:左側臥,插入約 1.5 吋(3.8 公分),嬰兒 0.5 吋。
No rectal temperatures in cardiac clients, rectal surgery, diarrhea, fecal impaction or bleeding risk. Axillary is least accurate. Temporal probe may go behind the earlobe if diaphoretic.
心臟病患者、肛門手術後、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或有出血風險者不量肛溫。腋溫最不準確。出汗時顳動脈探頭可置於耳垂後。
Conversion: F to C = (F - 32) x 5/9; C to F = C x 9/5 + 32.
Inability to obtain a temperature should not be ignored; it may be hypothermia in infants or older adults.
量不到體溫不可忽視,在嬰兒或老年人可能是低體溫。
Adult heart rate 60-100 bpm; assess rate, rhythm, strength and equality. Pulse grade: 4+ bounding, 3+ full, 2+ normal, 1+ weak, 0 absent.
成人心率 60-100 次/分;評估速率、節律、強度與對稱性。脈搏分級:4+ 洪大、3+ 飽滿、2+ 正常、1+ 微弱、0 無。
Heart rate rises with exercise, pain, fever, emotions, stimulants, hypovolemia and hemorrhage; it slows with age and with depressant/cardiac drugs.
運動、疼痛、發燒、情緒、興奮劑、血容不足與出血會使心率上升;年齡增加及抑制劑/心臟藥物使心率減慢。
Apical pulse (left midclavicular 5th intercostal space) is counted for 1 full minute for irregular pulse, cardiac disease, before digoxin or beta blockers, and in children under 2.
心尖脈(左鎖骨中線第五肋間)須測滿 1 分鐘,適用於不規則脈搏、心臟疾病、給予 digoxin 或乙型阻斷劑前,及 2 歲以下兒童。
Pulse deficit = radial rate lower than apical rate; indicates poor perfusion/dysrhythmia; notify the provider.
脈搏短絀 = 橈動脈脈率低於心尖脈率,表示周邊灌流不良或心律不整,須通報醫師。
Adult respiratory rate 12-20/min; count for 30 sec x 2 unless ill or irregular (then 1 full minute); assess rate, depth, pattern and sounds.
成人呼吸 12-20 次/分;測 30 秒乘 2,若病重或不規則則測滿 1 分鐘;評估速率、深度、型態與呼吸音。
High CO2/low O2 raise the rate; head injury/raised ICP and opioids depress breathing.
CO2 升高或 O2 降低使呼吸加快;頭部外傷/顱內壓上升及鴉片類藥物抑制呼吸。
Adult categories: normal below 120/80; elevated 120-129 and under 80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 at least 140 or 90; crisis over 180 and/or over 120.
成人分類:正常低於 120/80;偏高 120-129 且舒張壓小於 80;第 1 期 130-139 或 80-89;第 2 期 140 以上或 90 以上;高血壓危象收縮壓大於 180 和/或舒張壓大於 120。
Orthostatic vitals: BP and pulse supine, sitting, standing, 1-3 minutes after each change.
姿位性生命徵象:分別於平躺、坐、站姿測血壓與脈搏,每次改變姿勢後 1-3 分鐘測量。
Avoid cuffs on arms with IV, AV fistula/shunt, breast/axillary surgery or trauma. No smoking or exercise 30 min before; rest 5 min seated with feet flat.
避免在有靜脈輸液、動靜脈瘻管/分流、乳房/腋下手術或外傷的手臂上量血壓。測前 30 分鐘勿吸菸或運動;坐姿雙腳平放休息 5 分鐘。
Too-small cuff gives a falsely high reading; too-large gives a falsely low reading. Systolic is Korotkoff phase 1; diastolic is phase 5.
壓脈帶太小使讀數偏高,太大使讀數偏低。收縮壓為 Korotkoff 第 1 期,舒張壓為第 5 期。

SpO2 normal 95-100%; below 90% requires notifying the provider (except some chronic conditions). Nail polish, motion, hypotension, anemia and poor perfusion distort readings; do not use a cold extremity.
SpO2 正常 95-100%;低於 90% 須通知醫師(部分慢性病患除外)。指甲油、移動、低血壓、貧血與灌流不良會影響讀數;勿選用冰冷的肢體。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
Pain types: acute, chronic noncancer, chronic episodic (migraine, sickle cell crisis), cancer, idiopathic.
疼痛類型:急性、慢性非癌症、慢性間歇性(偏頭痛、鐮刀型紅血球危象)、癌症、特發性。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
Pain is subjective; assess timing, location, severity, quality, aggravating and relieving factors. Use a 0-10 scale, or FACES/FLACC for children and nonverbal clients.
疼痛為主觀感受;評估時間、位置、強度、性質、加重與緩解因素。使用 0-10 量表,兒童與無法言語者用 FACES/FLACC。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
Older adults may show pain as sleep disturbance, gait change, withdrawal or depression; consider culture and beliefs.
老年人疼痛可能表現為睡眠障礙、步態改變、社交減少或憂鬱;須考量文化與信仰。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
Nonpharmacological: heat/cold (15-30 min with a barrier), massage, TENS, binders/elevation, distraction, relaxation, guided imagery, music, acupuncture, biofeedback.
非藥物措施:冷熱敷(隔層布、15-30 分鐘)、按摩、TENS、束帶/抬高、分散注意力、放鬆、引導想像、音樂、針灸、生理回饋。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
Ask about herbal remedies because of drug interactions.
須詢問是否使用草藥,以免與藥物交互作用。
疼痛評估與非藥物處置
NSAIDs/aspirin: gastric irritation, bleeding, sodium and water retention, tinnitus; take with food; avoid in ulcer disease; potentiate anticoagulants.
NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈:胃刺激、出血、鈉水滯留、耳鳴;隨餐服用;潰瘍者避免;會加強抗凝劑作用。
Ibuprofen can cause hypoglycemia with oral antidiabetics and toxicity with calcium channel blockers.
ibuprofen 與口服降血糖藥併用可能低血糖,與鈣離子阻斷劑併用有中毒風險。
Acetaminophen: main risk is hepatotoxicity; self-treatment no more than 10 days in adults (5 in children); antidote acetylcysteine.
acetaminophen:主要風險為肝毒性;成人自行用藥不超過 10 天(兒童 5 天);解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。

Opioids: give 30-60 min before painful activity; hold and call if RR below 12 or bradycardia; check BP, sedation, bowel/bladder; keep naloxone, O2 and resuscitation equipment; use an infusion pump for continuous or PCA IV.
鴉片類:於疼痛活動前 30-60 分鐘給予;呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;監測血壓、鎮靜程度、排便與排尿;備妥 naloxone、氧氣與急救設備;持續或 PCA 靜脈輸注須用輸液幫浦。
Adjuvants (amitriptyline, venlafaxine, gabapentin) help neuropathic pain.
輔助藥物(amitriptyline、venlafaxine、gabapentin)有助於神經病變性疼痛。

檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
Sodium 135-145 mEq/L; potassium 3.5-5.0 mEq/L. Prolonged tourniquet or hemolysis can falsely raise potassium; do not draw from an arm with an infusion.
鈉 135-145 mEq/L;鉀 3.5-5.0 mEq/L。止血帶綁太久或溶血會使鉀假性升高;勿由有輸液的手臂抽血。
Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
aPTT normal 30-40 sec; therapeutic heparin is 1.5-2.5 times normal (about 45-100 sec). Start bleeding precautions if over 100 sec; draw 1 hr before the next intermittent dose.
aPTT 正常 30-40 秒;使用肝素治療目標為正常的 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒)。超過 100 秒啟動出血防範;間歇給藥者於下次劑量前 1 小時抽血。
Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
PT 11-12.5 sec; INR 0.81-1.20; warfarin keeps PT at 1.5-2 times control. PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 on warfarin means bleeding precautions.
PT 11-12.5 秒;INR 0.81-1.20;warfarin 使 PT 維持在對照值 1.5-2 倍。服用 warfarin 者 PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範。
Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
High vitamin K intake (green leafy vegetables) shortens PT and lowers warfarin effect.
攝取大量維生素 K(深綠色葉菜)會縮短 PT、降低 warfarin 效果。
Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
Platelets 150,000-400,000/mm3; low with chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia, hemorrhage; apply pressure to puncture sites 3-5 min.
血小板 150,000-400,000/mm3;化療、DIC、白血病、出血時降低;穿刺處加壓 3-5 分鐘。
Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
Hemoglobin: male 14-18, female 12-16 g/dL. Hematocrit: male 42-52%, female 37-47%. Low in anemia and hemorrhage; hematocrit rises with dehydration and falls with overhydration.
血紅素:男 14-18、女 12-16 g/dL。血比容:男 42-52%、女 37-47%。貧血與出血時降低;脫水使血比容上升,水過多則下降。
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
Lipids (fast 12-14 hr): total cholesterol under 200, LDL under 100, HDL over 60 mg/dL; triglycerides male 40-160, female 35-135 mg/dL.
血脂(空腹 12-14 小時):總膽固醇低於 200、LDL 低於 100、HDL 高於 60 mg/dL;三酸甘油酯男 40-160、女 35-135 mg/dL。
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
Fasting glucose 70-99 mg/dL (fast 8-12 hr; hold morning insulin/oral agents until drawn). HbA1c reflects 3-4 months: normal under 5.7%, prediabetes 5.7-6.4%, diabetes 6.5% or more.
空腹血糖 70-99 mg/dL(禁食 8-12 小時;抽血前暫停早晨胰島素/口服藥)。HbA1c 反映 3-4 個月血糖控制:正常低於 5.7%,糖尿病前期 5.7-6.4%,糖尿病 6.5% 以上。
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
Creatinine: male 0.6-1.2, female 0.5-1.1 mg/dL (specific for renal function). BUN 10-20 mg/dL; raised by dehydration, GI bleeding, renal disease.
肌酸酐:男 0.6-1.2、女 0.5-1.1 mg/dL(腎功能的專一指標)。BUN 10-20 mg/dL;脫水、消化道出血、腎病時升高。
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
WBC 5,000-10,000/mm3; left shift (more immature neutrophils) suggests bacterial infection. Monitor WBC/differential in chemotherapy clients for neutropenia and infection.
白血球 5,000-10,000/mm3;左移(未成熟嗜中性球增加)提示細菌感染。化療患者須監測白血球及分類以防嗜中性球低下與感染。
Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能
Adult norms: HR 60-100, RR 12-20, BP below 120/80, SpO2 95-100%; report SpO2 below 90%.
成人正常值:心率 60-100、呼吸 12-20、血壓低於 120/80、SpO2 95-100%;SpO2 低於 90% 須通報。
Apical pulse for 1 full minute before digoxin and beta blockers, with irregular pulse or heart disease, and in children under 2.
給予 digoxin 與乙型阻斷劑前、脈搏不規則或心臟病、及 2 歲以下兒童,須測心尖脈滿 1 分鐘。
Pulse deficit (radial lower than apical) indicates ineffective contractions; notify provider.
脈搏短絀(橈動脈低於心尖)表示心臟收縮無效,須通報醫師。
Cuff too small = falsely high BP; too large = falsely low. Avoid arm with IV, fistula, mastectomy side or trauma.
壓脈帶太小血壓偏高;太大偏低。避開有輸液、瘻管、乳房切除側或外傷的手臂。
No rectal temperatures with cardiac disease, rectal surgery, diarrhea, impaction or bleeding risk; no oral temperature with nasal congestion.
心臟病、肛門手術、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或出血風險者不量肛溫;鼻塞者不量口溫。
Opioids: hold and notify if RR under 12 or bradycardia; keep naloxone available; assess 30 min after dose.
鴉片類:呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;備妥 naloxone;給藥後 30 分鐘評估效果。
Acetaminophen's major risk is hepatotoxicity; antidote acetylcysteine.
acetaminophen 主要風險為肝毒性;解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。
NSAIDs increase bleeding, especially with warfarin; avoid with ulcer disease; ibuprofen with antidiabetics (hypoglycemia) or calcium channel blockers (toxicity).
NSAIDs 增加出血風險,尤其合併 warfarin;潰瘍者避免;ibuprofen 與降血糖藥(低血糖)或鈣離子阻斷劑(中毒)併用須通報。
Heparin: aPTT target 1.5-2.5 x normal (about 45-100 sec); over 100 sec = bleeding precautions and notify provider.
肝素:aPTT 目標為正常 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒);超過 100 秒須啟動出血防範並通報。
Warfarin: PT 1.5-2 x control, INR therapeutic about 2-3; PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 = bleeding precautions and hold dose per provider.
Warfarin:PT 為對照值 1.5-2 倍、INR 治療範圍約 2-3;PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範並依醫囑暫停劑量。
Potassium 3.5-5.0: report low values before giving furosemide to a cardiac client (ventricular dysrhythmia risk).
鉀 3.5-5.0:心臟病患給 furosemide 前若血鉀偏低須通報(有心室心律不整風險)。
Platelets 150,000-400,000; low counts in chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia; institute bleeding precautions per agency threshold.
血小板 150,000-400,000;化療、DIC、白血病時偏低;依機構閾值啟動出血防範。
HbA1c: 6.5% or higher is diabetes; 8% means chronic hyperglycemia, so teach prevention and recognition of hyperglycemia.
HbA1c 6.5% 以上為糖尿病;8% 表示長期高血糖,須教導預防與辨識高血糖。
BUN 10-20 and creatinine 0.6-1.2 (male); BUN falls with adequate rehydration; creatinine is the more specific renal marker.
BUN 10-20、肌酸酐(男)0.6-1.2;補液充足時 BUN 下降;肌酸酐為較專一的腎功能指標。
Neutropenic precautions for low WBC (e.g., 2000/mm3); monitor WBC with chemotherapy.
白血球偏低(如 2000/mm3)須採嗜中性球低下防護;化療期間監測白血球。
Lipid profile requires fasting 12-14 hr (water only) and no alcohol for 24 hr; fasting glucose requires 8-12 hr.
血脂檢驗需空腹 12-14 小時(僅可喝水)且 24 小時內不飲酒;空腹血糖需禁食 8-12 小時。
Pulse grading 0-4+: 0 absent, 1+ weak, 2+ normal, 3+ full/increased, 4+ bounding.
脈搏分級 0-4+:0 無、1+ 微弱、2+ 正常、3+ 飽滿、4+ 洪大。
Heparin multiplies aPTT (30-40 sec) by 1.5-2.5; warfarin multiplies PT by 1.5-2 ('Heparin = aPTT, Warfarin = PT/INR').
肝素看 aPTT(30-40 秒)乘 1.5-2.5 倍;warfarin 看 PT/INR 乘 1.5-2 倍(「肝素 aPTT、華法林 PT/INR」)。
Opioid safety check: RR below 12/min = hold (under-12 rule); also sedation, pulse, BP.
鴉片類安全檢核:呼吸低於 12 次/分即暫停(低於 12 規則),並檢查鎮靜程度、脈搏與血壓。

服用 warfarin 的心房顫動患者 PT 為 35 秒。護理師預期醫囑為何?
A client on a continuous heparin infusion for DVT has an aPTT of 65 seconds (control 30-40 sec). What action is needed?
深部靜脈栓塞患者持續輸注肝素,aPTT 65 秒(對照 30-40 秒)。應採取何種行動?
A PCA hydromorphone client is drowsy with RR 11, pulse 52, BP 101/58, SpO2 93% on 3 L. What does the nurse do first?
使用 PCA hydromorphone 的患者嗜睡,呼吸 11、脈搏 52、血壓 101/58、3 L 氧氣下 SpO2 93%。護理師首先做什麼?

輔助人員選擇下列哪種測量方式,表示需要再教導?

糖尿病患者 HbA1c 為 8%。護理師應教導何者?

腸胃炎合併脫水患者已補液。下列哪個 BUN 值表示補液足夠?

Carbohydrates (4 kcal/g) are the preferred fuel for brain and muscle; sources include milk, grains, fruits and vegetables.
醣類(4 kcal/g)是腦與肌肉偏好的能量來源;來源包括奶類、穀類、水果與蔬菜。

Fats (9 kcal/g) store energy, protect organs, keep body warm and carry fat-soluble vitamins; deficiency of essential fatty acids causes cold intolerance, skin lesions, infection risk and amenorrhea.
脂肪(9 kcal/g)儲存能量、保護器官、維持體溫並協助吸收脂溶性維生素;必需脂肪酸缺乏會導致怕冷、皮膚病變、易感染與閉經。

蛋白質(4 kcal/g)建構與修復組織、調節體液與酸鹼、製造抗體、酵素與荷爾蒙。
營養素:醣類、脂肪、蛋白質
Complete proteins contain all essential amino acids; inadequate protein causes protein-energy malnutrition and wasting.
完全蛋白質含所有必需胺基酸;蛋白質不足會造成蛋白質熱量營養不良與肌肉脂肪消耗。
營養素:醣類、脂肪、蛋白質
Pregnancy, lactation, infancy, childhood and adolescence have special needs; aging also changes needs.
懷孕、哺乳、嬰兒期、兒童期與青春期有特殊需求;老化也會改變營養需求。
營養素:醣類、脂肪、蛋白質
Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) are stored and can reach toxic levels; water-soluble (B vitamins, C) are excreted in urine.
脂溶性維生素(A、D、E、K)會儲存,過量可中毒;水溶性維生素(B 群、C)隨尿液排出。
Vitamin sources: B12 in meat/liver; folic acid in leafy greens and liver; C in citrus, tomatoes, broccoli; K in green leafy and cruciferous vegetables; thiamine in pork, legumes, nuts, whole grains.
維生素來源:B12 在肉類/肝臟;葉酸在綠葉蔬菜與肝臟;C 在柑橘、番茄、花椰菜;K 在綠葉與十字花科蔬菜;硫胺素(B1)在豬肉、豆類、堅果、全穀。

Mineral sources: calcium (dairy, tofu, greens); iron (red meat, liver, dried beans/fruits, fortified cereals); potassium (bananas, citrus, potatoes, melon, meats); magnesium (greens, nuts, legumes); sodium (table salt, processed foods).
礦物質來源:鈣(乳製品、豆腐、綠葉蔬菜);鐵(紅肉、肝臟、乾豆/乾果、強化穀片);鉀(香蕉、柑橘、馬鈴薯、哈密瓜、肉類);鎂(綠葉蔬菜、堅果、豆類);鈉(食鹽、加工食品)。
Water is 60-70% of body weight; survival without it is limited to a few days.
水佔體重 60-70%;缺水僅能存活數天。
營養不良指標與健康飲食
Short-term protein status: retinol-binding protein, prealbumin, transferrin, creatinine, BUN. Long-term protein status: serum albumin. Nitrogen balance uses urinary urea.
短期蛋白質狀態:視黃醇結合蛋白、前白蛋白、運鐵蛋白、肌酸酐、BUN。長期蛋白質狀態:血清白蛋白。氮平衡以尿中尿素評估。
營養不良指標與健康飲食
CBC with indices helps separate anemias from nutritional deficiencies.
全血球計數與紅血球指數有助區分貧血與營養缺乏。
營養不良指標與健康飲食
Always assess ability to eat and swallow and support independence in eating.
務必評估進食與吞嚥能力,並盡量促進自行進食。
營養不良指標與健康飲食

MyPlate/Dietary Guidelines teaching: half the plate fruits and vegetables, at least half of grains whole, low-fat milk, varied proteins, less sodium/saturated fat/added sugar, water instead of sugary drinks.
MyPlate/飲食指南教導:半盤水果與蔬菜、至少一半穀類為全穀、低脂奶、多樣蛋白質、減少鈉/飽和脂肪/添加糖、以水取代含糖飲料。
營養不良指標與健康飲食
Consider culture, spiritual beliefs and personal choices when planning diets.
規劃飲食時須考量文化、宗教與個人選擇。
營養不良指標與健康飲食
Infants: breast/chest-feeding exclusively about 6 months; add new foods one at a time, 4-7 days apart; no cow's milk before 1 year; no honey or corn syrup before 1 year (botulism).
嬰兒:約 6 個月純母乳;新食物一次一種、間隔 4-7 天;1 歲前不喝牛奶;1 歲前不吃蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌風險)。
Toddlers: more than 24 oz milk/day risks milk anemia; avoid choking hazards (hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, candy, raw vegetables); finger foods build independence.
幼兒:每日牛奶超過 24 盎司有「牛奶貧血」風險;避免噎塞食物(熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、糖果、生菜);手抓食物可培養獨立。
School-age: watch high fat/sugar/salt snacks and childhood obesity; adolescents need more protein, calcium and iron and are at risk for eating disorders.
學齡兒童:留意高脂/糖/鹽零食與肥胖;青少年需要更多蛋白質、鈣與鐵,且是飲食障礙好發期。
Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, more calcium, iron and folic acid. Lactation: about 500 extra kcal/day, plenty of fluids, avoid alcohol and caffeine.
懷孕:蛋白質每日 60 公克,增加鈣、鐵與葉酸。哺乳:每日約多 500 大卡、足量水分,避免酒精與咖啡因。
Older adults: lower energy needs, reduced taste, smell and thirst, dental changes; ensure calcium and vitamin D; discourage grapefruit with many medications.
老年人:能量需求下降、味覺嗅覺與口渴感減退、牙齒變化;確保鈣與維生素 D;許多藥物不宜與葡萄柚併用。

Clear liquid: water, broth, clear juice, gelatin, ice pops, carbonated drinks, tea/coffee; short-term only; deficient in calories and nutrients. Dairy and opaque juices are not clear; avoid red/purple dye before colon exams.
清流質:水、清湯、澄清果汁、果凍、冰棒、碳酸飲料、茶/咖啡;僅短期使用,熱量與營養不足。乳製品與不透明果汁不算清流質;腸道檢查前避免紅/紫色染料。
Weight change of 1 kg equals about 1 L of fluid gained or lost; monitor I&O and weight on liquid diets.
體重變化 1 公斤約等於 1 公升水分增減;流質飲食期間須監測輸出入量與體重。
Full liquid adds milk, ice cream, pudding, custard, strained soups and cereals; use supplements if used more than 3 days.
全流質加入牛奶、冰淇淋、布丁、卡士達、過濾湯品與精製穀粥;使用超過 3 天需營養補充品。
Mechanical soft: pureed, ground or chopped foods for chewing difficulty or dysphagia; avoid nuts, dried and raw fruits/vegetables, fried and tough meats.
機械軟質:將食物打泥、絞碎或切碎,適用咀嚼困難或吞嚥困難;避免堅果、乾果、生蔬果、油炸與粗硬肉類。
Soft diet: for mouth sores, oral surgery, jaw fracture, stroke; serve cooler foods for mouth sores; avoid nuts/seeds, raw produce, fried foods and whole grains; no straw for dysphagia.
軟質飲食:適用口腔潰瘍、口腔手術、下顎骨折、中風;口腔潰瘍給較涼的食物;避免堅果/種子、生蔬果、油炸與全穀類;吞嚥困難者不可使用吸管。

Low-fiber (low-residue) for IBD, partial obstruction, gastroenteritis, diarrhea: white bread, refined cereals, white rice, peeled potatoes; avoid raw fruits (except bananas), nuts, seeds, whole grains.
低纖維(低渣)飲食適用發炎性腸道疾病、部分腸阻塞、腸胃炎、腹瀉:白麵包、精製穀片、白飯、去皮馬鈴薯;避免生水果(香蕉除外)、堅果、種子、全穀。
High-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, IBS and asymptomatic diverticular disease; increase gradually with plenty of fluids; limit gas-forming foods.
高纖維每日 20-35 公克,適用便秘、大腸激躁症與無症狀憩室疾病;須漸進增加並大量喝水;限制易產氣食物。
Cardiac/DASH diet: restrict sodium, cholesterol and fats; fruits, vegetables, whole grains, low-fat dairy, fish, poultry, nuts.
心臟/DASH 飲食:限制鈉、膽固醇與脂肪;多吃蔬果、全穀、低脂乳品、魚、禽肉、堅果。
Fat-restricted diet for malabsorption, pancreatitis, gallbladder disease, GERD; fecal fat above 6-8 g/day indicates malabsorption.
限脂飲食適用吸收不良、胰臟炎、膽囊疾病、胃食道逆流;糞便脂肪每日超過 6-8 公克表示脂肪吸收不良。
High-calorie, high-protein diet for burns, cancer, HIV, COPD, wound healing; use calorie counts.
高熱量高蛋白飲食適用燒傷、癌症、HIV、COPD、傷口癒合;可做熱量計算。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食
Carbohydrate-consistent diet (carb counting) for diabetes; Diabetes Plate: half nonstarchy vegetables, quarter lean protein, quarter complex carbohydrate, water.
固定醣類飲食(醣類計算)適用糖尿病;糖尿病餐盤法:一半非澱粉蔬菜、四分之一瘦蛋白質、四分之一複合醣類,飲水。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食

Sodium restriction for hypertension, heart failure, renal, liver disease: under 2,300 mg/day, ideally 1,500. Avoid processed, canned, smoked, pickled foods and effervescent medicines; salt substitutes contain potassium and are not for renal disease.
限鈉適用高血壓、心衰竭、腎臟與肝臟疾病:每日低於 2,300 mg,理想 1,500 mg。避免加工、罐頭、燻製、醃漬食品與發泡錠藥物;代鹽含鉀,腎病患者不可用。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食
Protein restriction (40-60 g/day) for renal disease and end-stage liver disease: use high-biological-value protein and enough calories so protein is not burned for energy.
限制蛋白質(每日 40-60 公克)適用腎病與末期肝病:選擇高生物價蛋白質並確保足夠熱量,避免蛋白質被當作能量。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食
Renal diet controls protein, sodium, phosphorus, calcium, potassium and fluids; peritoneal dialysis is less restrictive than hemodialysis. Weigh daily as the priority indicator of fluid status.
腎臟飲食控制蛋白質、鈉、磷、鈣、鉀與水分;腹膜透析比血液透析寬鬆。每日量體重是評估水分狀態的優先指標。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食
Thirst relief with fluid restriction: sugar-free gum or hard candy, frozen fluids, lemon in water, cold mouth rinse.
限水時緩解口渴:無糖口香糖或硬糖、冰凍液體、水中加檸檬、冷漱口水。
Diabetic, sodium, protein and renal diets
糖尿病、鈉、蛋白質與腎臟飲食
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
Low-potassium diet for hyperkalemia (renal failure, Addison's, ACE inhibitors, K+-sparing diuretics): applesauce, green beans, cabbage, lettuce, grapes, blueberries.
低鉀飲食適用高血鉀(腎衰竭、愛迪生氏症、ACE 抑制劑、保鉀利尿劑):蘋果泥、四季豆、高麗菜、萵苣、葡萄、藍莓。
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
High-potassium diet for hypokalemia (diarrhea, vomiting, K+-depleting diuretics, Cushing's, steroids).
高鉀飲食適用低血鉀(腹瀉、嘔吐、排鉀利尿劑、庫欣氏症、類固醇)。
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
High-calcium diet for bone growth and osteoporosis prevention; lactose-intolerant clients need nondairy calcium sources.
高鈣飲食用於骨骼生長與預防骨質疏鬆;乳糖不耐者需攝取非乳製品鈣來源。
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
Low-purine diet for gout, kidney stones, high uric acid: avoid anchovies, herring, mackerel, sardines, scallops, organ meats, gravies, game.
低普林飲食適用痛風、腎結石、高尿酸:避免鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、沙丁魚、干貝、內臟、肉汁、野味。
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
High-iron diet for anemia (organ meats, meat, egg yolk, whole wheat, dark leafy greens, dried fruit, legumes); take vitamin C with iron to improve absorption.
高鐵飲食適用貧血(內臟、肉類、蛋黃、全麥、深綠葉菜、乾果、豆類);鐵與維生素 C 併用可增加吸收。
Potassium, calcium, purine and iron diets
Vegan: no animal products; lacto-vegetarian adds dairy; lacto-ovo adds dairy and eggs; ovo-vegetarian adds eggs only.
純素:不含任何動物性產品;乳素加乳製品;蛋奶素加乳製品與蛋;蛋素僅加蛋。
Possible deficiencies: energy, protein, vitamin B12, zinc, iron, calcium, omega-3, vitamin D; B12 is most likely lacking in vegans.
可能缺乏:熱量、蛋白質、維生素 B12、鋅、鐵、鈣、omega-3、維生素 D;純素者最容易缺乏 B12。
Teach complementary proteins across the day; eat iron plus vitamin C together; soy protein is comparable to animal protein.
教導一天內搭配互補蛋白質;鐵與維生素 C 同餐;大豆蛋白品質與動物性蛋白相當。
BMI = 體重(公斤)/ 身高(公尺)平方。
Enteral nutrition: for a working GI tract when oral intake is inadequate (dysphagia, burns, trauma, organ failure, severe malnutrition); use lactose-free formula for lactose intolerance.
管灌營養:適用腸胃道功能正常但口服攝取不足(吞嚥困難、燒傷、創傷、器官衰竭、嚴重營養不良);乳糖不耐者用無乳糖配方。
Calories per gram: carbohydrate 4, protein 4, fat 9.
每公克熱量:醣類 4、蛋白質 4、脂肪 9 大卡。
Short-term protein status = prealbumin/transferrin; long-term = albumin.
短期蛋白質狀態看前白蛋白/運鐵蛋白;長期看白蛋白。
Vegans most often lack vitamin B12 (naturally found almost exclusively in animal products).
純素者最常缺乏維生素 B12(天然來源幾乎僅存在於動物性食品)。
Iron-deficiency anemia: iron foods plus vitamin C (oranges, leafy greens); avoid coffee and tea with iron foods.
缺鐵性貧血:鐵質食物搭配維生素 C(柳橙、綠葉蔬菜);避免與咖啡、茶同時攝取。
Clear liquids are transparent; dairy, pudding, custard and pureed foods are not.
清流質為透明液體;乳製品、布丁、卡士達與泥狀食物不屬於清流質。
Sodium limit under 2,300 mg/day (ideal 1,500); smoked, cured, canned and processed foods are high in sodium.
鈉攝取每日低於 2,300 mg(理想 1,500);燻製、醃製、罐頭與加工食品含鈉高。
Salt substitutes contain potassium; avoid in renal disease.
代鹽含鉀;腎病患者避免使用。
Renal/hemodialysis diet: limit sodium, potassium, phosphorus, fluid and (controlled) protein; weigh daily.
腎臟/血液透析飲食:限制鈉、鉀、磷、水分並控制蛋白質;每日量體重。
Protein restriction 40-60 g/day, but keep calories adequate and protein high biological value.
限制蛋白質每日 40-60 公克,但須維持足夠熱量並選用高生物價蛋白。
Infants: no honey or corn syrup under 1 year (botulism); no cow's milk before 1 year; introduce one new food every 4-7 days.
嬰兒:1 歲前不給蜂蜜或玉米糖漿(肉毒桿菌);1 歲前不喝牛奶;每 4-7 天新增一種食物。
Toddler choking hazards: hot dogs, grapes, nuts, popcorn, hard candy, raw vegetables.
幼兒噎塞危險食物:熱狗、葡萄、堅果、爆米花、硬糖、生蔬菜。
Pregnancy: protein 60 g/day, folic acid, iron, calcium. Lactation: +500 kcal/day, avoid alcohol/caffeine.
懷孕:蛋白質 60 公克/日、葉酸、鐵、鈣。哺乳:每日多 500 大卡,避免酒精/咖啡因。
Low-purine diet for gout/stones: avoid sardines, anchovies, herring, mackerel, organ meats, gravies.
痛風/結石低普林飲食:避免沙丁魚、鯷魚、鯡魚、鯖魚、內臟、肉汁。
Fiber diets: low-fiber for diarrhea/IBD/partial obstruction; high-fiber 20-35 g/day for constipation, introduced gradually with fluids.
纖維飲食:腹瀉/發炎性腸病/部分阻塞用低纖維;便秘用高纖維每日 20-35 公克,須漸進並搭配水分。
Dysphagia: assess swallowing, thicken liquids as prescribed, no straws; all clients: assess ability to eat and swallow.
吞嚥困難:評估吞嚥、依醫囑增稠液體、不用吸管;所有患者皆須評估進食與吞嚥能力。
Grapefruit and grapefruit juice alter absorption of many medications; discourage in older adults on prescriptions.
葡萄柚與葡萄柚汁會改變多種藥物吸收;服藥的老年人應避免。
Fat-soluble vitamins: 'ADEK' (stored, toxic in excess); B and C are water-soluble (excreted).
脂溶性維生素「ADEK」(可儲存、過量中毒);B 群與 C 為水溶性(排出體外)。
Diabetes Plate: 1/2 nonstarchy vegetables, 1/4 lean protein, 1/4 complex carbs.
糖尿病餐盤:1/2 非澱粉蔬菜、1/4 瘦蛋白質、1/4 複合醣類。
