會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄
Ensure privacy, comfort, good lighting and no interruptions; sit at eye level without barriers such as a desk; use open-ended questions and therapeutic communication.
確保隱私與舒適、光線充足、避免打擾;坐在與患者視線同高處、避免桌子等阻隔;使用開放式問句與治療性溝通。
會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄
Consider culture, language (use a professional interpreter, not family), values, eye contact and touch.
考量文化、語言(使用專業口譯人員,不要由家屬代譯)、價值觀、眼神接觸與觸碰。
會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄
Assessment types: complete (baseline), focused (a limited problem), episodic/follow-up (progress), emergency (rapid, during lifesaving care).
評估類型:完整(基準資料)、聚焦(特定問題)、階段性/追蹤(評估進展)、緊急(搶救中快速收集資料)。
會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄
SOAP = Subjective, Objective, Assessment, Plan. History of present illness uses OLDCARTS (onset, location, duration, character, aggravating, relieving, timing, severity).
SOAP = 主觀、客觀、評估、計畫。現病史以 OLDCARTS 分析(開始、位置、持續、性質、加重、緩解、時間、嚴重度)。
會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄
Health history: general state of health, chief complaint (client's own words), family and social history, and domestic violence screening done privately.
健康史:整體健康狀態、主訴(記錄患者原話)、家族史與社會史,以及在私下進行的家庭暴力篩檢。
會談、環境與 SOAP 記錄

Mental status: appearance, behavior and level of consciousness, facial expression, speech, and cognitive function (orientation, attention, recent and remote memory, new learning, judgment, thought processes).
心智狀態:外觀、行為與意識程度、表情、言語,以及認知功能(定向感、注意力、近期與遠期記憶、新學習、判斷力、思考過程)。
Order of techniques: inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation; for the abdomen use inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.
技術順序:視診、觸診、扣診、聽診;腹部則為視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。
Palpation: warm hands, light then deep, tender areas last. Percussion notes: resonance, hyperresonance, tympany, dullness, flatness.
觸診:手保持溫暖、先輕後深、疼痛處最後。扣診音:清音、過度清音、鼓音、濁音、平音。
Vital signs, height, weight and nutritional status are part of the physical exam.
生命徵象、身高、體重與營養狀態屬於身體評估的一部分。
Assess color, temperature, moisture, turgor, texture, lesions, edema, hair and nails; use a Wood's light for some lesions.
評估顏色、溫度、濕度、彈性、質地、病灶、水腫、毛髮與指甲;部分病灶可用伍氏燈。
In dark skin: check lips/tongue (gray = cyanosis), nail beds/palms/soles (blue), conjunctivae for pallor, oral mucosa and sclera near the iris for jaundice.
深色皮膚:看嘴唇/舌頭(灰色=發紺)、甲床/手掌/腳底(藍色)、結膜是否蒼白、口腔黏膜與靠近虹膜的鞏膜是否黃疸。
Capillary refill returns within 3 seconds when perfusion is normal. Poor turgor suggests severe dehydration or weight loss.
灌流正常時微血管再充填在 3 秒內。皮膚彈性差提示嚴重脫水或體重過度減輕。
Pitting edema scale: 1+ slight, 2+ about 4 mm (10-15 s), 3+ deep (over a minute), 4+ very deep (2-5 min) with gross distortion.
凹陷性水腫分級:1+ 輕微、2+ 約 4 mm(10-15 秒)、3+ 深(超過 1 分鐘)、4+ 非常深(2-5 分鐘)且肢體明顯變形。
Teach monthly skin self-exam with ABCDE: asymmetry, border, color, diameter over 6 mm, evolving; avoid sun exposure.
教導每月皮膚自我檢查 ABCDE:不對稱、邊緣不規則、顏色不均、直徑大於 6 mm、變化中;避免曝曬。
Inspect/palpate skull and face, temporal arteries, frontal and maxillary sinuses; TMJ movement tests cranial nerve V.
視診/觸診頭骨與臉部、顳動脈、額竇與上頜竇;顳顎關節活動測試第 V 對腦神經。
Test cranial nerve XI by chin and shoulder-shrug against resistance. The trachea should be midline.
以抵抗阻力轉頭與聳肩測試第 XI 對腦神經。氣管應位於中線。
Thyroid: inspect while the client swallows, palpate anterior-posterior; a normal thyroid is usually not palpable; auscultate for a bruit if enlarged.
甲狀腺:吞嚥時視診、由前後方觸診;正常甲狀腺通常摸不到;若腫大需聽診是否有血管雜音。
Palpate lymph nodes gently with circular finger pads, both sides, from preauricular down to supraclavicular; note size, shape, mobility, consistency, tenderness.
以指腹輕柔畫圈觸診淋巴結,雙側比較,由耳前往下到鎖骨上;記錄大小、形狀、活動度、硬度與壓痛。
Never move the neck if a neck injury is suspected.
懷疑頸部受傷時,絕不可活動頸部。
Inspect eyebrows, lashes, lids (ptosis), globes (exophthalmos/enophthalmos), conjunctiva (clear), sclera (white), cornea, iris.
檢查眉毛、睫毛、眼瞼(下垂)、眼球(突眼/眼球內陷)、結膜(清澈)、鞏膜(白色)、角膜、虹膜。
Snellen chart: 20 feet, one eye at a time, keep distance glasses on; normal 20/20; tests cranial nerve II. Near vision normal 14/14. Confrontation tests peripheral vision.
Snellen 視力表:距離 20 呎、單眼測試、保留遠視眼鏡;正常 20/20;測試第 II 對腦神經。近視力正常 14/14。對面法測周邊視野。
Corneal light reflex checks eye alignment; cover/uncover detects slight deviation; six cardinal positions test cranial nerves III, IV, VI and look for nystagmus.
角膜光反射檢查眼軸平行;遮蓋/去遮蓋測微小斜視;六個基本注視方向測試第 III、IV、VI 對腦神經並觀察眼震。
Ishihara chart tests red-green color vision. PERRLA: pupils equal, round, reactive to light (direct and consensual) and accommodation.
Ishihara 圖測紅綠色覺。PERRLA:瞳孔等大、圓形、對光(直接與間接)及調節有反應。
Ophthalmoscopy in a darkened room: red reflex; absent reflex may mean lens opacity; optic disc creamy yellow-orange to pink with distinct margins. Teach regular eye exams.
眼底鏡檢查在暗室進行:觀察紅反射,缺失可能表示水晶體混濁;視神經盤為乳黃橘至粉紅色且邊緣清晰。教導定期眼科檢查。
Conductive hearing loss: obstruction to sound transmission. Sensorineural: cochlea, cranial nerve VIII or brain defect. Mixed: both.
傳導性聽損:聲波傳導受阻。感覺神經性聽損:耳蝸、第 VIII 對腦神經或腦部缺損。混合性:兩者並存。
Whisper test (1-2 ft, one ear at a time) and ticking-watch test screen hearing; Weber/Rinne tuning-fork tests are less sensitive.
耳語測試(1-2 呎、一次一耳)與滴答錶測試用於篩檢聽力;Weber/Rinne 音叉測試敏感度較低。

Otoscope: check canal for foreign body, never insert blindly; in adults pull the pinna up and back; normal drum is pearly gray with cone of light at 5 o'clock (right) and 7 o'clock (left). Clean ears with a washcloth, never cotton swabs.
耳鏡:先檢查耳道有無異物,絕不盲目插入;成人將耳廓向上向後拉;正常鼓膜為珍珠灰,光錐在右耳 5 點、左耳 7 點。以濕毛巾清潔,勿用棉花棒。
Vestibular tests: Romberg (positive = marked sway), past pointing, gaze nystagmus, Dix-Hallpike.
前庭檢查:Romberg(明顯搖晃為陽性)、指向偏差、凝視眼震、Dix-Hallpike。

Nose/sinuses: check patency, septum, sinus tenderness. Mouth/throat: lips, teeth, gums, tongue, buccal mucosa, palates, uvula (rises midline with 'ahh', CN X), tonsil grade 0-4+, tongue protrusion midline (CN XII), gag reflex (CN IX).
鼻/竇:檢查通暢度、鼻中隔、竇壓痛。口/喉:嘴唇、牙齒、牙齦、舌、頰黏膜、顎、懸雍垂(發「啊」時居中上抬,第 X 對)、扁桃腺分級 0-4+、伸舌居中(第 XII 對)、作嘔反射(第 IX 對)。
Record smoking in pack-years (packs per day x years). Screen for infectious respiratory illness (fever, cough, dyspnea, loss of taste/smell, exposure).
吸菸史以包年記錄(每日包數 x 年數)。篩檢感染性呼吸道疾病(發燒、咳嗽、呼吸困難、味覺/嗅覺喪失、接觸史)。
Palpate chest excursion (symmetrical, thumbs separate about 2 inches/5 cm) and tactile fremitus ('ninety-nine').
觸診胸廓擴張(對稱,雙拇指分開約 2 吋/5 公分)與觸覺震顫(說「九十九」)。
Percussion: resonance is normal; hyperresonance means excess air; dullness means density. Auscultate with the diaphragm, side to side, apices down; avoid breast tissue.
扣診:清音為正常;過度清音表示空氣過多;濁音表示組織密度增加。以膜面聽診、左右對比、由肺尖往下;避開乳房組織。

Normal breath sounds: vesicular, bronchovesicular, bronchial (over trachea). Adventitious: fine crackles (end inspiration), coarse crackles, wheeze (high-pitched, asthma), rhonchi (low snoring), pleural friction rub.
正常呼吸音:肺泡音、支氣管肺泡音、支氣管音(氣管上方)。異常音:細囉音(吸氣末)、粗囉音、哮鳴音(高音調、氣喘)、鼾音(低音調)、胸膜摩擦音。
Voice sounds (bronchophony, egophony, whispered pectoriloquy) are tested when pathology is suspected; teach smoking cessation and pneumonia/influenza vaccines.
懷疑病變時測聲音傳導(支氣管語音、羊音、耳語胸音);教導戒菸與肺炎/流感疫苗。
Apical impulse at the 4th-5th intercostal space, medial to the midclavicular line. Heart areas: aortic 2nd RICS, pulmonic 2nd LICS, Erb's point 3rd LICS, tricuspid 4th LICS, mitral 5th LMCL.
心尖搏動位於第 4-5 肋間、鎖骨中線內側。聽診區:主動脈瓣右第 2 肋間、肺動脈瓣左第 2 肋間、Erb 點左第 3 肋間、三尖瓣左第 4 肋間、二尖瓣左鎖骨中線第 5 肋間。
S1 'lub' and S2 'dub' are normal; a murmur is a blowing or swooshing sound. Grades I-VI: grade IV and above have a palpable thrill.
S1「lub」與 S2「dub」為正常;心雜音是吹風或嘶嘶聲。分級 I-VI:IV 級以上可摸到震顫。
Palpate only one carotid at a time. A carotid bruit signals turbulence or blockage: notify the provider and monitor neurological status.
一次只觸診一側頸動脈。頸動脈雜音表示血流擾動或阻塞:通報醫師並監測神經功能。
Assess pulses for equality and force (0-4+), calf circumference and pretibial edema; use Doppler if pulse not palpable.
評估脈搏對稱性與強度(0-4+)、小腿圍與脛前水腫;摸不到脈搏時用都卜勒。

Breast inspection with arms raised, hands on hips, and leaning forward; palpate supine with arm behind head and small pillow under shoulder, using pads of three fingers; one breast is often larger; axillary nodes are normally not palpable.
乳房視診採舉手過頭、雙手叉腰、前傾姿勢;觸診平躺、同側手置頭後、肩下墊小枕,以三指指腹檢查;兩側常不一樣大;腋下淋巴結正常摸不到。
Teach breast self-exam and report lumps immediately.
教導乳房自我檢查,發現腫塊須立即通報。
Abdomen: empty bladder, warm hands, painful areas last; order is inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.
腹部:先排尿、手保持溫暖、疼痛處最後;順序為視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。

Bowel sounds: high-pitched gurgles 5-30 per minute, start in RLQ; listen 5 minutes before calling them absent. Tympany predominates; dullness over liver/spleen; costovertebral tenderness suggests kidney problem.
腸蠕動音:高音調咕嚕聲每分鐘 5-30 次,從右下腹開始;判定消失前須聽 5 分鐘。以鼓音為主;肝脾上方為濁音;肋脊角壓痛提示腎臟問題。
Light palpation about 1 cm then deep 5-8 cm; the aortic pulsation expands laterally with an aneurysm.
淺觸診約 1 公分、深觸診 5-8 公分;若有動脈瘤,主動脈搏動會向兩側擴張。
Inspect gait, posture and spinal curves (lordosis, kyphosis, scoliosis); active and passive ROM; muscle strength 0-5 (5 = full range against gravity and full resistance).
檢查步態、姿勢與脊椎彎曲(脊柱前凸、後凸、側彎);主動與被動關節活動度;肌力 0-5 級(5 級=可抗重力與完全阻力)。

Neuro exam: level of consciousness (Glasgow Coma Scale), pupils, motor, cerebellar (tandem gait, Romberg), coordination (rapid alternating movements, finger-to-nose, heel-to-shin), sensory (pain, light touch, position, stereognosis, graphesthesia).
神經檢查:意識程度(格拉斯哥昏迷指數)、瞳孔、運動、小腦功能(直線行走、Romberg)、協調(快速輪替動作、指鼻、跟脛測試)、感覺(痛覺、輕觸、位置覺、實體覺、書寫覺)。

Cranial nerves: I smell, II vision, III/IV/VI eye movement, V face sensation and chewing, VII face movement and taste, VIII hearing and balance, IX/X swallowing and gag, XI shoulder shrug, XII tongue.
腦神經:I 嗅覺、II 視覺、III/IV/VI 眼球運動、V 臉部感覺與咀嚼、VII 臉部運動與味覺、VIII 聽覺與平衡、IX/X 吞嚥與作嘔、XI 聳肩、XII 舌頭。
Deep tendon reflexes 0-4+ (2+ normal). Babinski's sign (great toe dorsiflexion with toe fanning) is abnormal over age 2 and indicates CNS disease.
深部肌腱反射 0-4+(2+ 正常)。Babinski 徵象(大拇趾背屈、其餘腳趾散開)在 2 歲以上為異常,提示中樞神經疾病。
Meningeal irritation: Brudzinski (neck flexion makes hips and knees flex) and Kernig (pain when the flexed leg is extended).
腦膜刺激徵象:Brudzinski(屈頸時髖膝不自主彎曲)與 Kernig(彎曲的腿伸直時疼痛)。
Teaching: calcium and vitamin D foods, avoid joint strain, keep normal weight; wear helmets and seat belts.
衛教:攝取含鈣與維生素 D 食物、避免關節勞損、維持正常體重;戴安全帽與繫安全帶。

Female exam: calm approach, empty bladder, lithotomy position; the nurse prepares and assists. Speculum exam permits Pap/HPV screening; bimanual exam checks uterus and adnexa. Check for cystocele and rectocele.
女性檢查:態度平穩、先排尿、截石位;護理師負責準備與協助。窺陰器檢查可做 Pap/HPV 篩檢;雙合診檢查子宮與附屬器。注意膀胱膨出與直腸膨出。
Male exam: inspect penis and scrotum (left testicle normally hangs lower), check inguinal canal for hernia with cough. Teach testicular self-exam on the same day monthly, after a warm bath or shower.
男性檢查:檢查陰莖與陰囊(左側睪丸通常較低)、咳嗽時檢查腹股溝管有無疝氣。教導每月固定日期在溫水沐浴後做睪丸自我檢查。

Rectal exam: lithotomy or bent-forward (or left lateral) position; assess sphincter tone, masses and prostate (firm without nodules; hard nodules suggest cancer, boggy or tender suggests infection). Teach high-fiber, low-fat diet and screening.
直腸檢查:截石位或前彎(或左側臥)姿勢;評估括約肌張力、腫塊與前列腺(堅實無結節;硬結提示癌症,鬆軟或壓痛提示感染)。教導高纖低脂飲食與篩檢。
Teach STI prevention and that partners need evaluation.
教導預防性傳染病,並告知伴侶須接受檢查。
Documentation is a legal record: accurate, concise, complete, legible, objective; chart as soon as possible after assessment and protect confidentiality.
記錄為法律文件:須準確、簡潔、完整、清晰、客觀;評估後儘快記錄並保護隱私。
Use a professional interpreter, not family or staff, for clients who need language services.
需要語言協助的患者,應使用專業口譯人員,而非家屬或一般職員。
Order of assessment: inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation; abdomen: inspection, auscultation, percussion, palpation.
評估順序:視診、觸診、扣診、聽診;腹部:視診、聽診、扣診、觸診。
Focused assessment targets the presenting problem (e.g., cough: lungs, temperature, respirations); complete assessment is the baseline.
聚焦評估針對主訴(如咳嗽:肺部、體溫、呼吸);完整評估為基準資料。
Capillary refill within 3 seconds is normal; pitting edema graded 1+ to 4+.
微血管再充填 3 秒內為正常;凹陷性水腫分 1+ 至 4+。
Never perform neck movement if a neck injury is suspected.
懷疑頸部受傷時,絕不可活動頸部。
Snellen 20/20 tests cranial nerve II; six cardinal positions test III, IV, VI (extraocular muscle weakness); PERRLA documents normal pupils.
Snellen 20/20 測第 II 對腦神經;六個基本注視方向測第 III、IV、VI 對(眼外肌無力);PERRLA 記錄正常瞳孔。
Never insert an otoscope blindly; in adults pull the pinna up and back; never use cotton-tipped applicators in the ear.
絕不盲目插入耳鏡;成人將耳廓向上向後拉;耳道勿使用棉花棒。
Conductive hearing loss = physical obstruction to sound transmission; sensorineural = cochlea/CN VIII/brain.
傳導性聽損=聲波傳導受阻;感覺神經性=耳蝸/第 VIII 對腦神經/大腦。
Positive Romberg = significant sway with feet together and eyes closed (balance/vestibular/cerebellar problem).
Romberg 陽性=雙腳併攏閉眼時明顯搖晃(平衡/前庭/小腦問題)。
Wheezes (asthma, narrowed airways); fine crackles at end of inspiration (HF, pneumonia); rhonchi clear with coughing; pleural friction rub is not cleared by cough.
哮鳴音(氣喘、氣道狹窄);吸氣末細囉音(心衰竭、肺炎);鼾音咳嗽後可能消失;胸膜摩擦音咳嗽無法消除。
Carotid bruit: notify the provider and monitor neurological status; palpate carotids one at a time.
頸動脈雜音:通報醫師並監測神經狀態;頸動脈一次只觸診一側。
Absent bowel sounds can only be declared after listening 5 minutes; normal is 5-30/min.
須聽診 5 分鐘才能判定腸蠕動音消失;正常為每分鐘 5-30 次。
Babinski's sign is abnormal after age 2 (CNS disease); positive Brudzinski/Kernig indicates meningeal irritation (meningitis).
Babinski 徵象在 2 歲後為異常(中樞神經疾病);Brudzinski/Kernig 陽性表示腦膜刺激(腦膜炎)。
Cheyne-Stokes respirations: rhythmic breathing with periods of apnea.
Cheyne-Stokes 呼吸:有規律的呼吸伴隨呼吸暫停期。
Testicular self-exam: same day each month, after a warm shower or bath; breast self-exam and report lumps immediately.
睪丸自我檢查:每月同一天、溫水沐浴後;乳房自我檢查,發現腫塊立即通報。
Pack-years = packs per day x years smoked (e.g., 0.5 pack x 20 years = 10 pack-years).
包年 = 每日包數 x 吸菸年數(例如 0.5 包 x 20 年 = 10 包年)。
OLDCARTS for symptom analysis: Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating, Relieving, Timing, Severity.
OLDCARTS 症狀分析:Onset 開始、Location 位置、Duration 持續、Character 性質、Aggravating 加重、Relieving 緩解、Timing 時間、Severity 嚴重度。
PERRLA: Pupils Equal, Round, Reactive to Light and Accommodation.
PERRLA:瞳孔等大、圓形、對光與調節有反應。
ABCDE of melanoma: Asymmetry, Border, Color, Diameter over 6 mm, Evolving.
黑色素瘤 ABCDE:不對稱、邊緣、顏色、直徑大於 6 mm、變化。
Abdominal assessment order: 'I Auscultate Pain Properly' = Inspect, Auscultate, Percuss, Palpate.
腹部評估順序:視診、聽診、扣診、觸診(先聽診以免觸診改變腸蠕動)。
A client who does not speak English requests an interpreter at triage. What is the best action?
不會說英語的患者在急診檢傷時要求口譯。最佳作法為何?
The nurse documents a positive Romberg test. Which observation supports this?
護理師記錄 Romberg 測試陽性。下列哪項觀察支持此判斷?
A client with suspected meningitis flexes the hips and knees when the nurse flexes the client's neck and reports spinal pain. This is which finding?
疑似腦膜炎患者在護理師屈曲其頸部時,髖與膝不自主彎曲並訴脊椎疼痛。這是什麼徵象?
A client with asthma in respiratory distress is auscultated. Which adventitious sound is expected?
氣喘發作呼吸窘迫的患者聽診,預期有哪種異常呼吸音?
A clinic client complains of cold symptoms, cough and chest congestion. What does the focused assessment include? Select all that apply.
門診患者主訴感冒症狀、咳嗽與胸悶。聚焦評估應包括哪些?(複選)
During cardiovascular assessment the nurse hears a blowing, swishing sound over the right carotid artery. What is the priority action?
心血管評估時,護理師在右頸動脈聽到吹風樣嘶嘶聲。優先措施為何?
The nurse teaches testicular self-examination. When is the best time?
護理師教導睪丸自我檢查。何時最適合?

Know exits, alarms, extinguisher locations and the agency evacuation plan; never use elevators in a fire; turn off oxygen and nearby appliances.
熟悉出口、警報器、滅火器位置及機構疏散計畫；火災時不可搭電梯；關閉附近氧氣與電器。
Clients on life support are bagged manually with an Ambu bag until moved away from the danger.
使用維生設備的個案，在移離危險區前以甦醒球（Ambu bag）人工維持呼吸。
Evacuation order: ambulatory clients walk out first, then wheelchair, then bedridden clients by bed/stretcher.
疏散順序：可自行行走者先走，其次輪椅，臥床者以床或擔架移送。
Extinguisher classes: A ordinary combustibles, B flammable liquids, C electrical, D metals, K cooking oils/fats.
滅火器類別：A 一般可燃物、B 易燃液體、C 電器、D 可燃金屬、K 烹飪油脂。

Electrical: use grounded three-prong plugs (third longer prong is ground), pull the plug not the cord, avoid water, remove frayed or faulty equipment, and turn off power before touching a shocked client.
用電：使用有接地的三孔插頭（較長的第三腳為接地），拔插頭時握插頭不可拉電線，遠離水源，移除破損設備，觸電個案須先關閉電源再接觸。
Client-owned electrical equipment must be inspected before use in the facility.
個案自備的電器必須經檢查後才能在院內使用。
輻射安全與感染性廢棄物處理
Reduce exposure with time (limit), distance (maximize) and shielding (lead apron); wear a dosimeter badge.
降低輻射暴露：縮短時間、拉大距離、使用鉛衣屏蔽，並配戴劑量計。
輻射安全與感染性廢棄物處理
Client with a radiation implant: private room; never touch a dislodged implant with bare hands; keep linens in the room until the implant is removed.
放射性植入物個案：住單人房；脫落的植入物不可徒手碰觸；植入物取出前，床單衣物留在房內。
輻射安全與感染性廢棄物處理
Treat all infectious material as hazardous; use labeled, closed, puncture-resistant containers; never recap, bend or break needles.
所有感染性物質視為危害物；使用有標示、密閉、防刺穿容器；針頭不可回套、折彎或折斷。
輻射安全與感染性廢棄物處理
Older adults have slower reflexes, reduced vision/hearing, weaker muscles and nocturia, all raising accident risk.
老年人反射變慢、視聽力下降、肌力減弱、夜尿增加，都會提高意外風險。
Fall risk assessment is client-centered: validated scale, gait, balance, vision, medications, home hazards, prior falls, upcoming procedures.
跌倒風險評估以個案為中心：使用量表，評估步態、平衡、視力、藥物、居家環境危險、過去跌倒史及即將進行的檢查處置。
Prevention: bed low and locked, call light and belongings within reach, bed/chair alarms, room near nurses' station, toileting schedule, clutter-free room, good lighting, sturdy non-skid footwear.
預防措施：床降至最低並鎖定、呼叫鈴與物品放在可及處、使用床/椅警報器、安排靠近護理站、定時如廁、環境整潔、燈光充足、穿穩固防滑鞋。
Gait belt: apply before ambulating, snug enough for two fingers, hold both sides/back; return client to bed or chair if dizzy.
使用步態帶（gait belt）：行走前繫上，鬆緊以可伸入兩指為度，握住兩側或後方；個案頭暈時立即回床或坐椅。
Nurse body mechanics: keep load close, bend knees, tighten abdominal muscles, keep trunk erect, use equipment.
護理人員身體力學：負重靠近身體、彎曲膝蓋、收緊腹肌、保持軀幹直立、善用輔助設備。
Physical restraints limit movement by a device; chemical restraints are drugs used to control behavior. Use alternatives first.
身體約束以裝置限制活動；化學約束則以藥物抑制行為。須優先使用替代方式。
Requires a PHCP prescription naming type, behaviors and a limited time; never PRN; PHCP evaluates within 1 hour if not present; renew per policy; explain to and get permission from client/family.
需醫囑，註明約束類型、適用行為及有限時間；不得開 PRN；醫師若不在場須於1小時內評估；依規定更新；向個案與家屬說明並取得同意。
Secure straps to the bed frame (not side rails or movable parts) with a quick-release knot/half-bow or buckle; leave slack, two fingers fit under strap.
約束帶固定於床架（不可綁在床欄或可移動部位），使用快速解開結或快扣；保留鬆度，可伸入兩指。
Assess skin, circulation and neurovascular status frequently; release at least every 2 hours for ROM, toileting, fluids and ADLs.
頻繁評估皮膚、循環及神經血管狀態；至少每2小時解除一次，進行關節活動、如廁、補水與日常照護。
Only the top two side rails are used and bed stays lowest; side rails to prevent a sedated client from falling are generally not a restraint per policy.
床欄僅使用上方兩側，且床維持最低位置；依規定，為防鎮靜個案跌落的床欄通常不算約束。

Alternatives for confusion: reorientation, sitters/family, room near station, clocks/night-light, familiar objects, toileting routine, remove unneeded tubes, review medications, look for causes (hypoxia, electrolytes).
意識混亂的替代措施：重新定向、陪伴者或家屬、靠近護理站、時鐘與夜燈、熟悉物品、定時如廁、盡早移除不必要管路、檢視藥物、尋找原因（缺氧、電解質異常）。
Document reason, method, time applied, duration, response, release/assessments and ongoing need.
記錄使用原因、方法、開始時間、持續時間、反應、解除與評估情形及持續需要性。
Children (infants to young school-age) and older adults with poor vision or memory are most at risk of accidental poisoning.
嬰幼兒至低年級學童，以及視力或記憶力差的老年人，是意外中毒的高風險族群。
Call Poison Control FIRST, before intervening; keep the number near the phone.
先撥打毒物諮詢中心，再採取處置；電話號碼應放在電話旁。
Remove visible material from mouth/eyes/skin, identify substance and amount, save vomitus if asked, call an ambulance if directed to the ED.
移除口、眼、皮膚上可見毒物，確認物質種類與量，依要求保留嘔吐物，若被指示送急診則叫救護車。
Never induce vomiting for lye, household cleaners, grease or petroleum products, or in an unconscious victim.
吞食強鹼、家用清潔劑、油脂或石油產品，或個案昏迷時，絕不可催吐。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
HAIs are acquired in a facility and not incubating on admission; common resistant organisms: MRSA, VRE, CRE, multidrug-resistant TB, plus C. difficile.
醫療照護相關感染為入院時未存在或潛伏、在醫療機構內獲得；常見抗藥菌：MRSA、VRE、CRE、多重抗藥結核，另有困難梭狀芽孢桿菌（C. difficile）。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
C. difficile spreads by hand contact, mostly after prolonged multiple antibiotics; alcohol rubs do not kill spores, so wash with soap and water.
C. difficile 經手接觸傳播，多見於長期使用多種抗生素者；酒精乾洗手無法殺死孢子，須以肥皂與水洗手。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
Standard precautions apply to every client: blood, all body fluids, secretions, excretions, nonintact skin, mucous membranes.
標準防護措施適用於所有個案：血液、所有體液、分泌物、排泄物、不完整皮膚及黏膜。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
Hand hygiene between clients and after glove removal; alcohol rub if hands not visibly soiled; gloves, mask/eye protection, gown as splash/soiling risk dictates.
個案間及脫手套後須手部衛生；手無明顯髒污可用酒精乾洗手；依噴濺或弄髒風險使用手套、口罩與護目、隔離衣。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
Donning order: gown, mask/respirator, goggles/face shield, gloves. Removal: gloves first (outside is contaminated), then goggles, gown, mask; wash hands.
穿戴順序：隔離衣、口罩/呼吸器、護目鏡/面罩、手套。脫除：先脫手套（外側受污染），再脫護目、隔離衣、口罩，最後洗手。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
Clean blood spills with 1:10 bleach solution or approved disinfectant; contaminated linen in leak-proof bags; use safety needle devices.
血液噴濺以 1:10 漂白水或核可消毒劑清潔；受污染被單置於防漏袋；使用安全針具。
Health Care-Associated Infections and Standard Precautions
醫療照護相關感染與標準防護措施
Airborne: measles, varicella/disseminated zoster, pulmonary or laryngeal TB, COVID-19. Negative-pressure private room, door closed, 6-12 air exchanges/hr, N95 or higher; mask client for transport.
空氣傳染：麻疹、水痘／散播性帶狀疱疹、肺或喉結核、COVID-19。負壓單人房、門關閉、每小時6-12次換氣、戴 N95 或更高等級；個案外出時戴外科口罩。

Droplet: influenza, pertussis, meningitis, mumps, rubella, epiglottitis, pharyngeal diphtheria, scarlet fever, strep pharyngitis, mycoplasma/meningococcal pneumonia, parvovirus B19, sepsis. Private room or cohort; mask within about 3 feet; mask on client for transport.
飛沫傳染：流感、百日咳、腦膜炎、腮腺炎、德國麻疹、會厭炎、咽喉白喉、猩紅熱、鏈球菌咽炎、黴漿菌／腦膜炎雙球菌肺炎、細小病毒B19、敗血症。單人房或同病原體集中安置；約3英尺內戴口罩；外出時個案戴口罩。

Contact: multidrug-resistant organisms, C. difficile and enteric infections, RSV, wound and skin infections (impetigo, scabies, lice, herpes simplex, zoster), conjunctivitis. Private room/cohort; gloves and gown on entry; dedicated equipment.
接觸傳染：多重抗藥菌、C. difficile 及腸道感染、RSV、傷口與皮膚感染（膿痂疹、疥瘡、頭蝨、單純疱疹、帶狀疱疹）、結膜炎。單人房或集中安置；進入時穿戴手套與隔離衣；專用器材。
For C. difficile: gloves and gown, soap and water on exit, no shared equipment, room cleaned with chlorine (bleach).
C. difficile：穿手套與隔離衣，離開時用肥皂水洗手，不共用器材，以含氯（漂白水）清潔病室。
COVID-19 may need airborne plus droplet plus contact precautions with eye protection, per agency protocol.
COVID-19 可能需同時採空氣、飛沫與接觸防護並加護目，依機構規定。
When notified of a disaster, activate the facility emergency response plan first; internal disasters occur in the facility, external ones (tornado, COVID surge) send victims to it.
接獲災難通報時，首先啟動院內緊急應變計畫；內部災難發生在院內，外部災難（龍捲風、COVID 疫情高峰）則使傷病患湧入。

Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis): skin (painless black-centered ulcer), GI (undercooked meat), inhalation (flu-like then severe respiratory distress/shock); no person-to-person spread; ciprofloxacin, doxycycline or penicillin.
炭疽（Bacillus anthracis）：皮膚型（無痛黑色焦痂潰瘍）、腸胃型（食用未煮熟肉類）、吸入型（先似流感，後出現嚴重呼吸窘迫與休克）；不會人傳人；用環丙沙星、多西環素或青黴素治療。
Smallpox: highly contagious by droplets/contaminated material; fever, back pain, then papules to pustules on face and limbs; vaccine available.
天花：傳染力強，經飛沫或污染物傳播；發燒、背痛，之後出現丘疹進展為膿疱，先見於臉與四肢；有疫苗。
Botulism: toxin from Clostridium botulinum; descending paralysis, diplopia, ptosis, dysphagia; not person-to-person; antitoxin; may need ventilation; no vaccine.
肉毒桿菌中毒：肉毒桿菌毒素；下行性麻痺、複視、眼瞼下垂、吞嚥困難；不會人傳人；用抗毒素；可能需呼吸器；無疫苗。
Plague (Yersinia pestis): bubonic most common, septicemic most deadly; pneumonic spreads person to person; streptomycin or gentamicin. Tularemia: ticks/deer flies, ulcer with lymphadenopathy.
鼠疫（Yersinia pestis）：腺鼠疫最常見、敗血性最致命；肺鼠疫可人傳人；用鏈黴素或慶大黴素。兔熱病：蜱或鹿蠅傳播，皮膚潰瘍伴淋巴結腫大。
Viral hemorrhagic fevers (Ebola, Marburg, Lassa): fluids transmit; fever, headache, vomiting, unexplained bleeding; symptoms 2-21 days after exposure; supportive treatment only.
病毒性出血熱（伊波拉、馬堡、拉薩）：經體液傳播；發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、不明出血；暴露後2-21天出現症狀；僅支持性治療。

Suspected Ebola (travel to endemic area within 21 days plus symptoms or temp 38 C / 100.4 F): isolate in private room with private bathroom, full PPE, limit entrants with a log, notify infection control and public health.
疑似伊波拉（21天內曾至疫區並有症狀或體溫 38°C／100.4°F）：安置單人房與專用衛浴、完整 PPE、限制進入人員並記錄、通報感控與公共衛生單位。
Chemical agents: sarin (nerve gas, respiratory paralysis), phosgene (pulmonary edema), mustard gas (garlic odor, blisters). Ionizing radiation causes nausea, vomiting, leukopenia, hemorrhage.
化學戰劑：沙林（神經毒氣，呼吸肌麻痺）、光氣（肺水腫）、芥子氣（蒜味、皮膚水疱）。游離輻射引起噁心、嘔吐、白血球減少與出血。
Fire priorities RACE: Rescue, Alarm, Confine, Extinguish. Extinguisher use PASS: Pull, Aim at base, Squeeze, Sweep.
火災優先順序 RACE：救援、警報、侷限、滅火。滅火器 PASS：拔插銷、瞄準火源底部、握壓把手、左右掃射。
Never use side rails or movable bed parts to tie restraints; use a quick-release knot on the bed frame.
約束帶不可綁在床欄或活動部位；應以快速解開結綁在床架。
Restraints need a time-limited PHCP prescription (not PRN), alternatives first, and release at least every 2 hours.
約束需有限時醫囑（不可 PRN）、先用替代方案，且至少每2小時解除一次。
Poisoning: call Poison Control first; never induce vomiting with corrosives, petroleum products or in unconscious clients.
中毒：先打毒物諮詢中心；腐蝕劑、石油產品或昏迷者不可催吐。
Standard precautions apply to all clients regardless of diagnosis.
標準防護措施適用於所有個案，不論診斷為何。
Alcohol hand rub does not kill C. difficile spores: use soap and water, gloves, gown and bleach cleaning.
酒精乾洗手無法殺死 C. difficile 孢子：須用肥皂水洗手、戴手套穿隔離衣並以漂白水清潔。
Airborne = measles, varicella, TB (also COVID): negative-pressure room, N95, door closed.
空氣傳染＝麻疹、水痘、結核（及 COVID）：負壓病室、N95、關門。
Droplet = meningitis, influenza, pertussis, mumps, rubella, epiglottitis: private room/cohort and surgical mask.
飛沫＝腦膜炎、流感、百日咳、腮腺炎、德國麻疹、會厭炎：單人房／集中安置並戴外科口罩。
Contact = MRSA, VRE, C. difficile, scabies, impetigo, RSV, conjunctivitis: gloves and gown on entry.
接觸＝MRSA、VRE、C. difficile、疥瘡、膿痂疹、RSV、結膜炎：進入時戴手套穿隔離衣。
Wear goggles/face shield plus mask when splashes are possible (e.g., ostomy care, irrigation) even under contact precautions.
可能噴濺時（如造口護理、沖洗）即使在接觸隔離下，也要戴護目鏡/面罩及口罩。
Remove PPE with gloves first; outside of all PPE is contaminated.
脫 PPE 先脫手套；所有 PPE 外側都視為受污染。
Radiation implant client: private room, time-distance-shielding, never touch a dislodged implant by hand, dosimeter badge.
放射性植入個案：單人房、時間-距離-屏蔽原則、脫落植入物不可徒手碰、配戴劑量計。
Disaster notification: first activate the facility emergency response plan (umbrella action).
接獲災難通知：首先啟動院內緊急應變計畫（涵蓋其他步驟的上位選項）。
Anthrax, botulism are not spread person to person; smallpox, pneumonic plague and Ebola are.
炭疽、肉毒桿菌中毒不會人傳人；天花、肺鼠疫與伊波拉會。
Suspected Ebola (recent travel plus fever/symptoms): isolate FIRST, then collect more data and notify authorities.
疑似伊波拉（近期旅遊加發燒／症狀）：先隔離，再收集資料並通報主管機關。
Do not recap needles; discard sharps immediately into puncture-resistant containers.
針頭不回套；尖銳物使用後立刻丟入防刺穿容器。
RACE: Rescue, Activate alarm, Confine, Extinguish.
RACE：救援、啟動警報、侷限火勢、滅火。
PASS: Pull the pin, Aim at the base, Squeeze the handle, Sweep side to side.
PASS：拔插銷、瞄準底部、握壓把手、左右掃射。
Gown-Mask-Goggles-Gloves to put on; gloves first off.
穿：隔離衣→口罩→護目→手套；脫：手套最先。
Airborne: MTV (Measles, TB, Varicella) plus COVID.
空氣傳染：MTV（麻疹、結核、水痘）加 COVID。

Assess the order, reconcile with current medications, ask about allergies and herbal use, and review vital signs, labs and interactions before giving a drug.
給藥前評估醫囑、與現用藥物核對（藥物整合）、詢問過敏與草藥使用，並檢視生命徵象、檢驗值與交互作用。
Rights include right prescription, medication, dose, client, route, time, reason, education, assessment, refusal, approach, evaluation and documentation.

Teach the client the drug name, purpose, action and adverse effects; address cultural, religious or other concerns.

Document administration and the client's response. If an order is unclear or inconsistent, contact the prescriber immediately.

A nurse who gives a wrong dose is legally responsible regardless of the source of the error.
不論錯誤來源為何，護理師給錯劑量須負法律責任。
Metric basics: meter (length), liter (volume), gram (mass). It is the most used system in practice.
公制基本單位：公尺（長度）、公升（容積）、公克（質量），是臨床最常用系統。
Larger to smaller unit: multiply by 1000 (move decimal 3 places right). Smaller to larger: divide by 1000 (3 places left).
大單位換小單位：乘以1000（小數點右移3位）；小單位換大單位：除以1000（左移3位）。

Household measures (drop, teaspoon, tablespoon, ounce, cup) and apothecary units (grain, dram, minim) are older; NCLEX will not ask apothecary-to-metric conversion, though 1 gr = 60 mg appears in an example.
家用單位（滴、茶匙、湯匙、盎司、杯）與藥衡制（grain、dram、minim）較舊；NCLEX 不考藥衡制換算公制，但書中範例用 1 gr = 60 mg。
mEq expresses electrolyte amounts; units (insulin, heparin, penicillin) measure drug activity rather than weight.
mEq 表示電解質量；單位（胰島素、肝素、青黴素）以藥效而非重量計量。
Conversion is the first step in dosage calculation; labels show the generic name, so learn generic names.
換算是劑量計算的第一步；藥標一定有學名，考試以學名為主。
A complete prescription has client name, date/time, drug, dose, route, frequency/time and prescriber signature; use only Joint Commission-approved abbreviations.
完整處方包括個案姓名、日期時間、藥名、劑量、途徑、頻率/時間及開立者簽名；僅用聯合委員會核可的縮寫。
Scored tablets may be split; enteric-coated and sustained-release products delay absorption and must not be crushed.
有刻痕的錠劑可依規定分割；腸溶錠與緩釋劑延遲吸收，不可壓碎。
Medicine cup holds 30 mL (1 oz); pour at eye level on a flat surface. Volumes under 5 mL are measured in a syringe (no needle).
藥杯容量30 mL（1盎司）；置於平面並平視刻度倒藥。小於5 mL以去針頭的針筒抽取。
Use a calibrated oral syringe for children.
兒童使用有刻度的口服針筒。
Parenteral routes: IV, IM, subcutaneous, intradermal. Angles: intradermal 5-15 degrees, subcutaneous 45 or 90 degrees, IM 90 degrees.
注射途徑：靜脈、肌肉、皮下、皮內。角度：皮內5-15度、皮下45或90度、肌肉90度。
Draw to the top ring of the plunger (closest to the needle). Standard 3-mL syringe is calibrated in 0.1 mL; 5-mL in 0.2 mL; tuberculin 1-mL in 0.01 mL.
抽藥時以活塞最靠針頭端的環對齊刻度。標準3 mL針筒刻度0.1 mL；5 mL為0.2 mL；結核菌素1 mL為0.01 mL。
Maximum volumes: IM 3 mL per site (2 mL deltoid); subcutaneous 0.5-1.5 mL for adults. Question larger volumes.
最大注射量：肌肉每處3 mL（三角肌2 mL）；成人皮下0.5-1.5 mL。超量須再確認。

Subcutaneous: 25-gauge 5/8-inch needle at 45 degrees or 1/2-inch at 90 degrees. IM needle length depends on weight and fat; larger gauge for viscous drugs. Z-track uses a deep muscle such as ventrogluteal.
皮下：25號、5/8吋針以45度，或1/2吋針以90度。肌肉針長依體重與脂肪厚度而定，黏稠藥物用較粗針；Z字法選深層肌肉如腹臀肌。
Insulin only in insulin syringes (100 units = 1 mL). Mixing: draw clear regular first, then NPH (RN). Pens and pumps are alternatives.
胰島素僅用胰島素針筒（100單位 = 1 mL）。混合時先抽透明的 Regular，再抽 NPH（RN）。另有胰島素筆與幫浦。
Prefilled cartridges are single use; discard extra before injecting a partial dose. Engage safety needle device right after injection.
預充式卡匣單次使用；給部分劑量時先丟棄多餘藥量。注射後立即啟動安全針具。
Powdered drugs are reconstituted with sterile diluent per label; the final volume exceeds the diluent volume; label multidose vials with date, time, initials and expiration.
粉劑依標示以無菌稀釋液調製；最終體積大於稀釋液體積；多劑量瓶須標註日期時間、簽名縮寫及有效期。
Ratio and proportion: H : V :: D : X. Standard formula: (Desired / Available) x Quantity.
比例法：H : V :: D : X。標準公式：（所需量／現有量）× 單位量。
Dimensional analysis: start with the desired unit, set conversion fractions so unwanted units cancel.
單位分析法：先確定所求單位，排列換算分數使不需要的單位相消。
Check that everything is in the same unit first; more than 3 tablets or an oddly large injection volume should prompt verification.
先確認單位一致；超過3錠或注射量異常過大時，須再確認。
Round at the end; adult injections to the nearest 0.1 mL; small or pediatric doses may be rounded down to 0.01 mL per policy; follow the rounding instruction in the question.
計算完最後再四捨五入；成人注射至0.1 mL；微量或兒童劑量依規定可捨至0.01 mL；依題目指示進位。
Percent solution = g per 100 mL (10% calcium gluconate = 10 g/100 mL); ratio solution = g per total mL (epinephrine 1:1000 = 1 g/1000 mL).
百分比溶液＝每100 mL的公克數（10%葡萄糖酸鈣＝10 g/100 mL）；比例溶液＝每總毫升的公克數（腎上腺素1:1000＝1 g/1000 mL）。

Drops/min = (total volume x drop factor) / time in minutes. mL/hr = total mL / hours. Infusion time = total volume / mL per hr.
每分鐘滴數＝（總量 × 滴系數）／分鐘數；mL/hr＝總毫升／小時數；輸注時間＝總量／每小時毫升。

Macrodrip sets give 10-20 gtt/mL; microdrip about 60 gtt/mL (ICU, pediatrics). The calibration is printed on the tubing package.
大滴管每 mL 10-20滴；微滴管約60滴/mL（加護與兒科）。滴系數印在輸液管包裝上。

Monitor flow rate often even with a pump. Never speed up a late infusion without PHCP approval; watch for crackles and increased respirations (fluid overload), especially in older, cardiac, renal, pulmonary or neurologic clients.
即使使用幫浦也須經常檢查速率。輸液落後時未經醫師同意不可加快；觀察呼吸變快與肺部囉音（容積過量），尤其是老年及心、肺、腎、神經疾病個案。

IV Flow Rates and Infusion Safety
Unit-per-hour infusions (heparin, regular insulin): step 1 units per mL = units in bag / mL in bag; step 2 mL/hr = dose per hr / units per mL.
每小時單位數輸注（肝素、Regular 胰島素）：步驟1 每 mL 單位數＝袋內單位／袋內毫升；步驟2 mL/hr＝每小時劑量／每 mL 單位數。

Conversion comes first: g to mg multiply by 1000; mcg to mg divide by 1000 (150 mcg = 0.15 mg).
先換算：g 轉 mg 乘1000；mcg 轉 mg 除以1000（150 mcg = 0.15 mg）。
Drops/min = volume x drop factor / minutes; round to a whole number (drops cannot be fractional).
滴/分＝總量 × 滴系數／分鐘；四捨五入至整數。
Heparin/insulin drip: units per mL = units / mL in bag; mL/hr = ordered units per hr / units per mL.
肝素／胰島素點滴：每 mL 單位＝單位／袋容量；mL/hr＝醫囑單位數／每 mL 單位。
Never speed up a behind-schedule IV without PHCP approval; assess for fluid overload when rate increases.
IV 落後時未經醫師同意不可加速；速率增加時評估容積過量。
Question any oral dose needing more than 3 tablets, or excessive injection volume (IM over 3 mL, 2 mL deltoid; subcutaneous over 1.5 mL).
口服需超過3錠或注射量過大（肌肉超過3 mL、三角肌超過2 mL、皮下超過1.5 mL）須質疑。
Do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release medications.
腸溶或緩釋劑不可壓碎。
Insulin is measured only in an insulin syringe; mix regular before NPH (RN).
胰島素只用胰島素針筒；先抽 Regular 再抽 NPH（RN）。
Intradermal angle 5-15 degrees with a tuberculin syringe; IM 90 degrees; subcutaneous 45 or 90 degrees.
皮內5-15度用結核菌素針筒；肌肉90度；皮下45或90度。
Verify unclear or inconsistent orders with the prescriber immediately.
醫囑不清或不一致時，立即向開立者確認。
Reconstituted volume exceeds diluent volume; label multidose vials with date, time, initials, expiration.
調製後體積大於稀釋液體積；多劑量瓶標註日期、時間、簽名、效期。
Draw the syringe to the top ring of the plunger closest to the needle.
抽取針筒時以最靠針頭端的活塞環對齊刻度。
Medicine cup is 30 mL; use syringe for volumes under 5 mL, and for children.
藥杯30 mL；小於5 mL及兒童劑量用針筒。
Percent solution is g/100 mL; 1:1000 epinephrine is 1 g/1000 mL (1 mg/mL).
百分比溶液為 g/100 mL；1:1000 腎上腺素為 1 g/1000 mL（1 mg/mL）。
NCLEX uses generic drug names; learn generics.
NCLEX 使用藥物學名，須熟記。
RN: draw Regular insulin first, then NPH.
RN：先抽 Regular 再抽 NPH。

H : V :: D : X（現有量、載體、所需量、未知數）。

Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin
術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
The surgeon explains the procedure; the nurse may witness the signature after confirming the client understands. If the client is confused about the surgery, notify the surgeon before proceeding.
由外科醫師說明手術；護理師確認個案理解後可見證簽名。若個案仍不了解，須通知外科醫師釐清後再繼續。
Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin
術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
Minors, or clients not alert/oriented, need a parent, guardian or health care power of attorney; no sedation before signing. Telephone consent is acceptable with a second nurse as witness.
未成年人或意識不清者需由父母、監護人或醫療委任代理人簽署；簽署前不可給鎮靜劑。電話同意可行，須有第二位護理師見證。
Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin
術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
NPO about 6-8 hours before general anesthesia (about 3 hours for local, as prescribed) to prevent aspiration; start IV with a catheter large enough for blood products.
全身麻醉前約禁食6-8小時（局部麻醉約3小時，依醫囑）以防吸入；建立足夠大口徑的靜脈管路以便輸血。
Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin
術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
Client voids just before surgery; bowel prep and urinary catheter as prescribed; document urine output from catheter bags.
術前立即排尿；依醫囑做腸道準備及放置導尿管；記錄導尿袋尿量。

術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
Skin cleansing with antiseptic soap the night before; hair removal only as prescribed (head/face/eyebrows only if ordered).
手術前晚以抗菌皂清潔；除毛依醫囑（頭、臉、眉毛須有醫囑才剃）。
Preoperative Consent, Nutrition, Elimination and Skin
術前同意書、飲食、排泄與皮膚準備
Ask about allergies (including latex), vitamins, herbals and OTC drugs; explain what to expect and any tubes, drains, catheters.
詢問過敏（含乳膠）、維他命、草藥與成藥；說明術後預期情形及各種管路、引流。
Pain: expect some; use pain scales; PCA is pushed only by the client; teach relaxation, distraction, guided imagery.
疼痛：預期會有一些疼痛；使用疼痛量表；PCA 僅限個案本人按壓；教導放鬆、分散注意力、引導想像。
No smoking for at least 24 hours before surgery.
Deep breathing/coughing sitting upright: 3 deep breaths, hold the third 3 seconds, then cough 3 times, every 1-2 hours.
深呼吸與咳嗽採坐姿：深呼吸3次，第3次屏息3秒後咳嗽3次，每1-2小時一次。
Incentive spirometer: sit upright, inhale slowly, hold 5 seconds, 10 times per hour.
誘發性肺量計：坐直、緩慢吸氣、屏息5秒，每小時10次。
Leg exercises (calf pumping, quadriceps setting, foot circles), sequential compression devices, splinting the incision with pillow, turning schedule.
腿部運動（踝泵、股四頭肌收縮、足部畫圈）、間歇性氣動加壓裝置、以枕頭護住傷口、翻身計畫。
術前核對表與術前藥物
Verify ID band, allergies, signed consents (surgery, transfusion, limb disposal, sterilization), H&P, labs, ECG/chest x-ray, type and crossmatch.
核對手圈、過敏、各項同意書（手術、輸血、肢體處置、結紮）、病歷與理學檢查、檢驗、心電圖／胸部X光、血型與交叉配對。
術前核對表與術前藥物
Remove jewelry, dentures, glasses, prostheses, makeup, hairpins; secure valuables; document last intake, voiding, vital signs and preop meds.
取下飾品、假牙、眼鏡、義肢、化妝品、髮夾；貴重物品妥善保管；記錄最後飲食時間、排尿、生命徵象與術前給藥。
術前核對表與術前藥物
Risk factors: older age, obesity, bleeding disorders, diabetes, heart/lung disease, OSA, infection, liver disease, immunosuppression, smoking, substance abuse.
風險因子：高齡、肥胖、出血疾患、糖尿病、心肺疾病、睡眠呼吸中止、感染、肝病、免疫抑制、吸菸、藥物濫用。
術前核對表與術前藥物
Aspirin, NSAIDs stop at least 48 hours before; clopidogrel about 5 days. Corticosteroids cause adrenal suppression; insulin needs vary; herbals can interact with anesthesia.
阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs 至少術前48小時停用；氯吡格雷約5天。類固醇導致腎上腺抑制；胰島素需求會變動；草藥可能與麻醉交互作用。
術前核對表與術前藥物
After preoperative sedatives keep the client in bed with rails up, bed low, call bell in reach.
給予術前鎮靜藥後，個案臥床、床欄拉起、床降低、呼叫鈴置於手邊。

Respiratory: airway first; stridor or crowing suggests obstruction/laryngospasm; crackles suggest atelectasis or edema; RR should be above 10 and below 30; SpO2 under 95% (or baseline) needs prompt notification.
呼吸：先確保呼吸道；喘鳴或雞鳴聲提示阻塞／喉痙攣；囉音提示肺塌陷或水腫；呼吸速率應大於10、小於30；血氧低於95%（或基準值）須立即通報。
Cardiovascular: perfusion, bleeding, pulses, dysrhythmias, VTE prophylaxis with stockings, SCDs, early mobility.
心血管：評估灌流、出血、脈搏、心律不整，以彈性襪、間歇性加壓裝置、早期活動預防靜脈血栓。
Position low-Fowler's for lung expansion; side-lying if semiconscious; turn every 1-2 hours; sit at bed edge before standing.
採低半坐臥利於肺擴張；半昏迷者側臥；每1-2小時翻身；下床前先坐床緣。
Neuro: orient client, check motor/sensation; older adults take longer to reorient. Prevent hypothermia with warm blankets.
神經：協助定向、檢查運動與感覺；老年人定向恢復較慢。以保暖毯預防體溫過低。
Wound: mark drainage on dressings, check drains, REEDA signs, abdominal binder for obese/debilitated.
傷口：於敷料標記滲液、檢查引流、REEDA 評估，肥胖或虛弱者可用腹帶。
GI: NPO until gag reflex and peristalsis return, then ice chips and clear liquids; oral care every 2 hours; after gastric surgery do not irrigate or move NG tube unless ordered.
腸胃：禁食至嘔吐反射與腸蠕動恢復，再給冰塊與清流質；每2小時口腔護理；胃手術後除非醫囑，不可沖洗或移動鼻胃管。
Renal: urine at least 30 mL/hr; void within 6-8 hours (at least 200 mL).
腎臟：尿量至少30 mL/hr；術後6-8小時內排尿（至少200 mL）。
Pain: assess before giving analgesics, check respirations, BP, LOC; after opioid reassess RR and relief every 30 minutes; use nonpharmacologic measures too.
疼痛：給止痛藥前先評估；檢查呼吸、血壓與意識；給予鴉片類後每30分鐘評估呼吸速率與止痛效果；併用非藥物方法。
Atelectasis typically 1-2 days postop; pneumonia 3-5 days. Signs: dyspnea, crackles, fever, productive cough. Treat with turning, deep breathing, incentive spirometry, fluids, ambulation.
肺塌陷多在術後1-2天；肺炎3-5天。徵象：呼吸困難、囉音、發燒、有痰咳嗽。處置：翻身、深呼吸、誘發性肺量計、補水、下床活動。
Hypoxemia: restlessness (early), dyspnea, tachycardia, cyanosis, low SpO2; give oxygen and notify surgeon.
低血氧：躁動（早期）、呼吸困難、心搏過速、發紺、血氧低；給氧並通知外科醫師。
Pulmonary embolism: sudden dyspnea, sharp chest pain, tachycardia, hypotension, cyanosis; notify surgeon immediately.
肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、尖銳胸痛、心搏過速、低血壓、發紺；立即通知外科醫師。

Hemorrhage/shock: restlessness, rapid weak pulse, hypotension, tachypnea, cool clammy skin, low urine output; apply pressure, oxygen, IV fluids/blood, elevate legs (spinal anesthesia: only on a pillow).
出血／休克：躁動、脈快而弱、低血壓、呼吸快、皮膚濕冷、尿少；加壓止血、給氧、輸液／血品、抬高下肢（脊髓麻醉者僅墊枕頭高度）。
Thrombophlebitis: hard, cordlike, tender vein, aching leg, warmth, low fever; elevate leg 30 degrees without popliteal pressure, stockings, SCD, anticoagulants; do not let the client dangle legs.
血栓性靜脈炎：靜脈硬如條索、壓痛、腿部痠痛、發熱、輕微發燒；抬腿30度且膕窩不受壓、彈性襪、間歇性加壓、抗凝血劑；不可讓個案垂腿。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症

Urinary retention appears 6-8 hours postop: unable to void, lower abdominal pain, distended bladder; use ambulation, privacy, running water or warm water over perineum before catheterizing as prescribed.
尿滯留於術後6-8小時出現：無法排尿、下腹痛、膀胱脹；導尿前先嘗試下床、隱私、流水聲或溫水沖會陰。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Constipation: no stool within 48 hours of solid diet; fluids up to 3000 mL/day, fiber, ambulation, stool softeners.
便祕：恢復固體飲食後48小時未排便；每日補水至3000 mL、纖維、活動、軟便劑。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Paralytic ileus: vomiting, distention, absent bowel sounds or flatus; NPO, NG decompression with suction, IV fluids.
麻痺性腸阻塞：嘔吐、腹脹、無腸音或排氣；禁食、鼻胃管減壓抽吸、靜脈輸液。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Wound infection 3-6 days postop: fever, chills, warm tender incision, drainage, high WBC; REEDA; cultures and antibiotics.
傷口感染於術後3-6天：發燒、寒顫、傷口熱痛、滲液、白血球升高；REEDA 評估；培養與抗生素。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Dehiscence and evisceration occur 5-10 days postop, most often in obese, abdominal-surgery, poor-healing clients. Evisceration is an emergency.
傷口裂開與內臟脫出多發生於術後5-10天，常見於肥胖、腹部手術、癒合不良者。內臟脫出為緊急狀況。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Evisceration care: stay with client, call for help, low-Fowler's with knees bent, cover with sterile saline-moistened dressing, monitor for shock, prepare for surgery.
內臟脫出處置：陪伴個案、呼叫協助、低半坐臥並屈膝、以無菌生理食鹽水濕敷料覆蓋、監測休克、準備手術。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症
Sterile dressing change: verify order, check allergies, assess pain, clean from least to most contaminated with single strokes, date/time/initial dressing.
無菌換藥：確認醫囑、確認過敏、評估疼痛，由最乾淨至最髒以單向擦拭，敷料標註日期時間簽名。
腸胃、泌尿與傷口併發症

Criteria: alert and oriented, baseline vital signs, voided, no respiratory distress, able to ambulate/swallow/cough, minimal pain, no vomiting, minimal bleeding, responsible adult driver, surgeon release.
出院條件：意識清楚、生命徵象回到基準、已排尿、無呼吸窘迫、可行走吞嚥咳嗽、疼痛輕微、無嘔吐、出血極少、有成人陪同載送、外科醫師同意。
Teach before the procedure day; provide written instructions; use teach-back.
於手術日前即進行衛教；提供書面說明；使用回覆示教。
No driving, major decisions or legal signing for 24 hours after general anesthesia.
全身麻醉後24小時內不可開車、做重大決定或簽署法律文件。
Sutures or staples out in 7-14 days; Steri-Strips may follow; cover incision with plastic when showering if allowed; 48-hour dressing supply.
縫線或釘書針於7-14天拆除；之後可貼無菌膠帶；若可淋浴則以塑膠覆蓋傷口；提供48小時份敷料。

After major surgery no lifting for 6 weeks; abdominal incision no lifting 10 pounds or more, no pushing or pulling; return to work usually 6-8 weeks; drink 6-8 glasses fluid; high protein, calorie, vitamin diet.
大手術後6週不提重物；腹部傷口不可提10磅以上、不可推拉；通常6-8週返回工作；每日飲水6-8杯；高蛋白、高熱量、高維生素飲食。
Teach signs of complications and when to call the surgeon.
教導併發症徵象及何時聯絡外科醫師。
If a client is unclear about the surgery after signing, notify the surgeon before proceeding; consent comes before sedation.
個案簽署後仍不清楚手術內容，須通知外科醫師後再進行；簽同意書前不可給鎮靜。
Telephone consent from guardian/POA is acceptable with a second nurse witness; do not send to surgery unsigned.
監護人／委任代理人電話同意可行，須第二位護理師見證；不可無同意書送刀。
NPO 6-8 hours before general anesthesia; no smoking 24 hours; aspirin/NSAIDs stop at least 48 hours, clopidogrel about 5 days.
全身麻醉前禁食6-8小時；24小時不吸菸；阿斯匹靈／NSAIDs 至少停48小時、氯吡格雷約5天。
Verify client and site: marking, then time-out with the whole team.
核對個案與部位：標記，然後全體團隊暫停核對。
Postoperative priority is airway and breathing; SpO2 below 95% or baseline requires prompt notification; RR 10-30.
術後優先為呼吸道與呼吸；血氧低於95%或基準值須即時通報；呼吸速率10-30。
Postop urine output should be at least 30 mL/hr; falling urine with tachycardia and hypotension suggests hemorrhage/shock.
術後尿量至少30 mL/hr；尿量減少合併心搏過速與低血壓提示出血／休克。
Restlessness is an early sign of hypoxemia and hemorrhage.
躁動是低血氧與出血的早期徵象。
Sudden dyspnea and chest pain postoperatively: suspect pulmonary embolism; notify surgeon immediately.
術後突發呼吸困難與胸痛：懷疑肺栓塞，立即通知外科醫師。
Spinal anesthesia plus shock: legs raised only to a pillow level so the diaphragm is not impaired.
脊髓麻醉合併休克：下肢僅墊枕頭高度，以免影響橫膈膜呼吸。
Evisceration: cover with saline-moistened sterile dressing, low-Fowler's with knees bent, stay with client, call surgeon.
內臟脫出：以無菌生理食鹽水濕敷料覆蓋、低半坐臥屈膝、陪伴個案、通知外科醫師。
Postoperative vomiting, distention and absent bowel sounds indicate paralytic ileus: NPO, NG suction.
術後嘔吐、腹脹、腸音消失表示麻痺性腸阻塞：禁食、鼻胃管抽吸。
Atelectasis occurs 1-2 days postop; pneumonia 3-5; wound infection 3-6; dehiscence/evisceration 5-10 days.
肺塌陷術後1-2天；肺炎3-5天；傷口感染3-6天；裂開／內臟脫出5-10天。
After gastric surgery do not irrigate or reposition the NG tube unless prescribed.
胃手術後除非醫囑，不可沖洗或調整鼻胃管位置。
Do not allow thrombophlebitis clients to dangle legs or rub/massage the leg; elevate and anticoagulate as ordered.
血栓性靜脈炎個案不可垂腿；依醫囑抬高並給予抗凝血劑。
Opioid given: reassess respiratory rate and pain relief every 30 minutes.
給予鴉片類藥物後每30分鐘重新評估呼吸速率與止痛效果。
Same-day discharge requires a responsible adult driver and no driving or legal decisions for 24 hours after general anesthesia.
當日出院需有負責任的成人載送，全身麻醉後24小時不可開車或做法律決定。
REEDA for wound assessment: Redness, Edema/Erythema, Ecchymosis, Drainage, Approximation.
REEDA 傷口評估：紅、腫、瘀斑、滲液、傷口對合。
Postop complication timing: atelectasis 1-2 d, pneumonia 3-5 d, wound infection 3-6 d, dehiscence 5-10 d.
術後併發症時間：肺塌陷1-2天、肺炎3-5天、傷口感染3-6天、裂開5-10天。
A postoperative client admitted 1 hour ago has urine output of 20 mL/hr, BP 100/70, temperature 37.6 C, and serous drainage on the dressing. Which finding is the priority to monitor?
術後1小時的個案尿量20 mL/hr、血壓100/70、體溫37.6°C、敷料有漿液性滲液。最需優先監測的是哪項？
A client who sedated with opioids cannot sign consent for an urgent gastric surgery. What is the nurse's best action?
因使用鴉片類藥物而鎮靜的個案無法簽署緊急胃手術同意書。護理師最適當的行動為何？
Which instructions are correct for preoperative deep breathing and incentive spirometry? Select all that apply.
下列哪些是術前深呼吸與誘發性肺量計的正確指導？（複選）
On day 7 after a colectomy a client reports a popping sensation and the nurse sees bowel protruding from the incision. What is the first action?
結腸切除術後第7天，個案表示有破裂感，護理師見到腸管由傷口突出。首要處置為何？
A client who had spinal anesthesia is hypotensive with signs of shock. How should the nurse position the legs?
脊髓麻醉後的個案低血壓並有休克徵象。護理師應如何擺放下肢？
Which findings indicate a postoperative pulmonary embolism? Select all that apply.
哪些發現提示術後肺栓塞？（複選）
Which discharge teaching is appropriate after ambulatory surgery under general anesthesia?
全身麻醉門診手術後，哪項出院衛教適當？
Box 15.1: coughing, incentive spirometry, leg exercises and incision splinting teaching.
方框15.1：咳嗽、誘發性肺量計、腿部運動與傷口護持衛教。

圖15.1-15.3腿部運動、傷口護持與間歇性加壓裝置；方框15.2文化考量。

方框15.3手術風險疾病與方框15.4影響手術的藥物。

方框15.6：無菌換藥與傷口沖洗步驟。

圖15.5傷口裂開與內臟脫出、處置步驟、方框15.7出院衛教。
Consider culture, preferences, developmental stage and body image; assess strength, balance, vision, sensation and signs of activity intolerance (changes in respirations, pulse, color, dizziness).
考量文化、個人偏好、發展階段與身體意象；評估肌力、平衡、視力、感覺及活動耐受不良徵象（呼吸、脈搏、膚色改變、頭暈）。
Complete bed baths, tub baths and showers increase oxygen demand and can exhaust clients; partial baths suit partly dependent clients.
全身床上擦浴、盆浴、淋浴會增加耗氧量而使個案疲憊；部分擦浴適合部分依賴者。
Basins can harbor bacteria; chlorhexidine (CHG) baths reduce bacterial growth; dry basins after use and do not store supplies in them.
水盆易滋生細菌；氯己定（CHG）擦浴可減少細菌；用後須擦乾，且不可用來存放物品。
Check for allergies to soaps or products first; provide privacy, warmth, safety and promote independence.
先確認對肥皂或產品是否過敏；提供隱私、保暖、安全並促進獨立。
Perineal care at least daily and as needed; higher risk for uncircumcised males, indwelling catheters, postpartum, rectal/genital surgery, incontinence and obesity.
會陰護理至少每日一次及必要時；未割包皮男性、留置導尿管、產後、直腸或生殖器手術、失禁與肥胖者風險較高。
Skin assessment during hygiene: color, texture, turgor, temperature, lesions, device contact points, skinfolds, perineum, and extra care in darker skin.
沐浴時評估皮膚：顏色、質地、彈性、溫度、病灶、器材接觸處、皮膚皺摺、會陰；深膚色者須更仔細。
Skin risk factors: immobility, obesity, reduced sensation, dementia, poor nutrition/hydration, moisture, devices, vascular insufficiency.
皮膚風險因子：活動受限、肥胖、感覺減退、失智、營養與水分不足、潮濕、醫療器材、血管不足。

Diabetes or peripheral vascular disease: do NOT soak feet, do NOT trim nails (refer to podiatrist/PHCP), wash daily in lukewarm water, dry between toes, lotion but not between toes, seamless clean cotton socks, well-fitting shoes.
糖尿病或周邊血管疾病：不可泡腳、不可自行剪指甲（轉介足科或醫師）、每日以溫水洗淨、趾縫擦乾、擦乳液但趾縫不擦、穿無接縫乾淨棉襪、鞋子合腳。
Others trim nails straight across and file edges; avoid long soaks and harsh chemicals (maceration). Assess pedal pulses, sensation and gait.
其他個案指甲剪直並磨平邊緣；避免長時間浸泡與刺激性化學品（浸軟）。評估足背脈搏、感覺與步態。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Brush with fluoride toothpaste twice daily, floss (unwaxed), alcohol-free rinse; avoid vigorous flossing with chemotherapy, radiation or anticoagulants.
每日兩次以含氟牙膏刷牙、使用無蠟牙線、酒精含量為零的漱口水；化療、放療或使用抗凝血劑者避免用力使用牙線。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Special oral needs: unconscious (pneumonia risk), diabetes, chemotherapy, immunosuppression, artificial airway; CHG oral care reduces ventilator-associated pneumonia.
特殊口腔需求：意識不清（肺炎風險）、糖尿病、化療、免疫抑制、人工氣道；CHG 口腔護理可降低呼吸器相關肺炎。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Dentures: handle carefully, rinse after meals, remove at night, store in a labeled cup covered with water (not in tissue), clean with lukewarm water.
假牙：小心處理、餐後清潔、夜間取下、放在標示個案姓名的杯中並以水覆蓋（不可包衛生紙）、以微溫水清洗。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Hair/scalp: assess for alopecia, lice and lesions; electric razor for clients on anticoagulants/antiplatelets or with low platelets or bleeding disorders; each client uses own razor.
頭髮與頭皮：評估禿髮、頭蝨與病灶；使用抗凝血劑／抗血小板藥、血小板低或出血疾患者用電動刮鬍刀；每位個案專用刮鬍刀。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Clean eyes inner to outer canthus with a different part of washcloth each time; lubricate eyes of unconscious clients; no Q-tips in ears; irrigate impacted cerumen.
擦拭眼睛由內眥至外眥，每次用毛巾不同處；昏迷者需潤滑眼睛；耳朵不可用棉花棒；耳垢栓塞可沖洗。
Oral, Hair, Eye, Ear and Nose Care
口腔、頭髮與眼耳鼻護理
Assess mobility from lying, to sitting, to transfer, to walking with or without devices.
活動力評估順序：臥床、坐起、轉位到椅子、行走（有無輔具）。
Metabolic: lowered metabolic rate, negative nitrogen balance, muscle loss, calcium resorption (hypercalcemia, kidney stones, fractures), constipation.
代謝：代謝率降低、負氮平衡、肌肉流失、鈣質流失（高血鈣、腎結石、骨折）、便祕。
Respiratory: atelectasis and hypostatic pneumonia. Cardiovascular: orthostatic hypotension, increased workload, thrombus formation.
呼吸：肺塌陷與沉積性肺炎。心血管：姿位性低血壓、心臟負荷增加、血栓形成。
Musculoskeletal: weakness, disuse osteoporosis, contractures such as footdrop. Urinary: stasis, infection, calculi. Skin: pressure injury over bony prominences. Psychosocial: depression, withdrawal.
肌肉骨骼：無力、廢用性骨質疏鬆、攣縮如垂足。泌尿：尿液滯留、感染、結石。皮膚：骨突處壓力性損傷。心理社會：憂鬱、退縮。

Crutch fit: 2-3 finger widths between axilla and pad; elbows flexed 20-30 degrees; never bear weight on axillae (brachial plexus damage); crutches 6-10 inches diagonally ahead; stop if hands tingle or go numb. Stand on the affected side.
拐杖合適度：腋下與腋墊相距2-3指寬；手肘彎曲20-30度；腋下不可承重（會傷臂神經叢）；拐杖置於腳斜前方6-10吋；手麻或刺痛須停止。護理師站在患側。

Gaits: four-point (both legs bear weight, three points always on floor), two-point (faster), three-point (one leg bears weight; move both crutches and weak leg, then the strong leg), swing-through (paraplegia with braces).
步態：四點（雙腿可承重，隨時三點著地）、兩點（較快）、三點（僅一腿承重；兩拐杖與患肢同時向前，再跨健肢）、擺盪式（下肢支架的截癱者）。
Stairs: up with the good leg first (up with the good); down with crutches and the weak leg first (down with the bad). Sitting: strong leg against the chair.
上下樓：上樓先出健腳（好的先上）；下樓先出拐杖與患腳（壞的先下）。坐下：健側腿貼近椅子。

Cane: held on the STRONGER side, 4-6 inches lateral to the foot, handle at greater trochanter, elbow 15-30 degrees; move cane with the weaker leg; two points of support at all times; check rubber tips.
手杖：持於較強側，距腳外側4-6吋，握把與大轉子同高，手肘彎曲15-30度；手杖與患腿一起向前；隨時保持兩點支撐；定期檢查橡膠頭。
Walker: all four legs flat on floor before weight bearing; move walker, then weaker foot, then stronger foot. Keep tips dry and unworn.
助行器：四腳平放地面後才承重；先移助行器，再移弱腳，再移強腳。橡膠頭保持乾燥未磨損。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Healing needs protein, calories, vitamins, trace minerals, oxygen/perfusion; infection, diabetes, older age, immobility and incontinence delay healing. Albumin indicates nutrition.
癒合需要蛋白質、熱量、維生素、微量礦物質及氧氣灌流；感染、糖尿病、高齡、活動受限與失禁會延遲癒合。白蛋白可反映營養。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Braden scale predicts pressure injury risk.
Braden 量表預測壓力性損傷風險。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Phases: inflammatory 3-5 days (edema, pain, redness, warmth); fibroblastic from day 4 for 2-4 weeks (granulation); maturation from about 3 weeks up to a year.
癒合期：發炎期3-5天（水腫、疼痛、紅、熱）；纖維母細胞期第4天起2-4週（肉芽組織）；成熟期約3週起可達1年。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Intention: primary (edges approximated), secondary (tissue loss, fills in), tertiary (delayed primary closure).
癒合方式：一期（傷口對合）、二期（組織缺損，由內填補）、三期（延遲一期縫合）。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Exudate: serous (clear), serosanguineous (pale pink), sanguineous (red, bleeding), purulent (yellow/green/brown, infection).
滲液：漿液性（清澈）、漿血性（淡粉紅）、血性（紅色，出血）、膿性（黃綠褐，感染）。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
Device-related pressure injury sources include tubes, cannulas, BiPAP masks, catheters, compression stockings, orthopedic devices and restraints.
與器材相關的壓力性損傷來源：管路、鼻導管、BiPAP 面罩、導尿管、彈性襪、骨科器材與約束。
皮膚完整性與傷口癒合
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料
Caused by pressure, shear and friction over bony prominences; risk rises with immobility, malnutrition, incontinence, reduced sensation.
由壓力、剪力與摩擦於骨突處造成；活動受限、營養不良、失禁、感覺減退使風險增加。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料
Prevention: turn every 2 hours, pressure-relief surfaces, keep skin dry and linen wrinkle-free, barrier cream for incontinence, ROM at least every 8 hours, nutrition. NEVER massage reddened areas.
預防：每2小時翻身、使用減壓裝置、保持皮膚乾燥與床單平整、失禁者用隔離霜、至少每8小時關節活動、補充營養。絕不按摩發紅處。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料

Stage 1: intact skin, nonblanchable redness. Stage 2: partial-thickness loss, exposed dermis, pink moist bed or blister. Stage 3: full-thickness, fat visible, no muscle/bone. Stage 4: exposed fascia, muscle, tendon, cartilage or bone.
第1期：皮膚完整、不變白的發紅。第2期：部分皮層缺損、真皮外露、粉紅濕潤或水疱。第3期：全層皮膚缺損、可見脂肪，無肌肉骨骼外露。第4期：筋膜、肌肉、肌腱、軟骨或骨頭外露。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料
Unstageable: base covered by slough/eschar. Suspected deep-tissue injury: persistent deep red/maroon/purple area or blood-filled blister.
無法分期：傷口底被腐肉或焦痂覆蓋。疑似深層組織損傷：持續暗紅、栗色或紫色，或血水疱。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料

Dressings: stage 1 transparent/hydrocolloid or none; stage 2 composite film, hydrocolloid, hydrogel with cover; stage 3-4 hydrocolloid/hydrogel/alginate/foam/gauze. Alginate is absorbent for deep/exudating wounds; antimicrobial for infected ones.
敷料：第1期透明膜／水膠體或不用；第2期複合膜、水膠體、水凝膠加覆蓋；第3-4期水膠體／水凝膠／藻酸鹽／泡棉／紗布。藻酸鹽吸收力強用於深、滲液多傷口；感染傷口用抗菌敷料。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料

Document size (length, width, depth), exudate, undermining, tunneling; consider wound/nutrition referral. Other therapies: negative-pressure wound therapy, hyperbaric oxygen, electrical stimulation, growth factors.
記錄大小（長寬深）、滲液、潛行與隧道；考慮轉介傷口與營養專家。其他治療：負壓傷口治療、高壓氧、電刺激、生長因子。
壓力性損傷：預防、分期與敷料
Diabetes/PVD foot care: no soaking, no self nail trimming (podiatrist), dry between toes, no lotion between toes.
糖尿病／周邊血管疾病足部護理：不泡腳、不自行剪甲（轉介足科）、趾縫擦乾、趾縫不擦乳液。
Ask about soap/product allergies before a bed bath.
床上擦浴前先詢問對肥皂／產品過敏。
Never massage a reddened area: it damages capillaries and tissue.
絕不按摩發紅處：會損傷微血管與組織。
Turn immobile clients at least every 2 hours; ROM at least every 8 hours.
活動受限者至少每2小時翻身；至少每8小時做關節活動。
Stage 1 intact nonblanchable red; stage 2 partial thickness; stage 3 full thickness with fat; stage 4 muscle/tendon/bone.
第1期完整不變白紅；第2期部分皮層；第3期全層伴脂肪；第4期肌肉／肌腱／骨頭。
Eschar or slough hiding the base means unstageable; deep purple/maroon means suspected deep-tissue injury.
焦痂或腐肉覆蓋底部為無法分期；深紫／栗色為疑似深層組織損傷。
Crutches resting on the axillae can injure the brachial plexus; keep 2-3 finger widths.
拐杖壓在腋下會傷臂神經叢；保留2-3指寬空隙。
Cane goes on the stronger side; with right-sided weakness use the left hand.
手杖持於較強側；右側無力用左手。
Stairs with crutches: up with the good leg, down with the bad leg (crutches go with the affected leg).
拐杖上下樓：好腳先上，壞腳（連同拐杖）先下。
Use an electric razor for clients on anticoagulants/antiplatelets, thrombocytopenia or bleeding disorders.
使用抗凝血劑／抗血小板藥、血小板低或出血疾患者，須用電動刮鬍刀。
Immobility complications: atelectasis, orthostatic hypotension, DVT, hypercalcemia/kidney stones, constipation, contractures, pressure injury.
制動併發症：肺塌陷、姿位性低血壓、深部靜脈血栓、高血鈣／腎結石、便祕、攣縮、壓力性損傷。
Purulent exudate (yellow/green/brown) signals infection; sanguineous means active bleeding.
膿性滲液（黃／綠／褐）提示感染；血性代表活動性出血。
Wound healing phases: inflammatory 3-5 days, fibroblastic day 4 to 4 weeks, maturation up to 1 year.
癒合期：發炎期3-5天、纖維母細胞期第4天至4週、成熟期可達1年。
Dentures stored overnight in a labeled cup covered with water; clean with lukewarm water.
假牙夜間放在有標示的杯中並以水覆蓋；用微溫水清洗。
Unconscious clients need eye lubrication and frequent oral care.
昏迷個案需眼部潤滑與頻繁口腔護理。
Crutch stairs: 'Up with the good, down with the bad.'
拐杖上下樓：「好的先上，壞的先下」。
Cane: hold it on the strong side; cane and weak leg move together.
手杖：持於強側；手杖與弱腿一起前進。
Pressure injury stage memory: 1 intact red, 2 dermis, 3 fat, 4 bone/muscle.
壓力性損傷分期記憶：1 完整紅、2 真皮、3 脂肪、4 骨與肌肉。

為何拐杖不可頂在腋下？

Tables 16.2-16.3: dressing choices by stage and dressing materials.
表16.2-16.3：各分期敷料選擇與敷料材質。
Assess voiding pattern: fluid intake, frequency, nocturia, urgency, dysuria, hesitancy, dribbling, hematuria, caffeine, and drugs such as diuretics.
評估排尿型態：水分攝取、頻率、夜尿、急尿、排尿疼痛、遲滯、滴尿、血尿、咖啡因及利尿劑等藥物。
Urine output should be at least 30 mL/hr; below that, or two consecutive low voids, needs prompt follow-up for renal impairment or hypovolemia.
尿量應至少30 mL/hr；低於此值或連續兩次排尿量偏少需立即追蹤，可能為腎功能受損或血容量不足。
Normal urine is clear, pale straw to amber, mild ammonia odor. Foul odor may mean UTI; cloudy from bacteria/WBC; blood is abnormal. Phenazopyridine and beets change color; asparagus changes odor.
正常尿液清澈、淡稻草色至琥珀色、有輕微氨味。惡臭可能為泌尿道感染；混濁可因細菌或白血球；血尿為異常。Phenazopyridine 與甜菜根會改變顏色；蘆筍改變氣味。
Physical findings: flank pain and CVA tenderness (kidney), distended bladder, meatal drainage, perineal skin problems.
身體檢查：腰痛與肋脊角壓痛（腎）、膀胱脹、尿道口分泌物、會陰皮膚問題。

Retention: bladder cannot fully empty; straining, small frequent voids or dribbling, suprapubic discomfort. Postvoid residual by bladder scan or straight cath confirms it. Causes: enlarged prostate, stones.
尿滯留：膀胱無法完全排空；用力排尿、少量頻尿或滴尿、恥骨上不適。以膀胱掃描或單次導尿測餘尿確認。原因：攝護腺肥大、結石。
UTI symptoms: dysuria, urgency, frequency, suprapubic tenderness, cloudy foul urine, hematuria. Older adults may show confusion, falls, incontinence and no fever.
泌尿道感染症狀：排尿疼痛、急尿、頻尿、恥骨上壓痛、混濁惡臭尿、血尿。老年人可能只表現意識混亂、跌倒、失禁，且不發燒。
Most common organism is E. coli. Lower UTI = cystitis; upper = pyelonephritis; ascending infection can cause urosepsis.
最常見致病菌為大腸桿菌。下泌尿道感染＝膀胱炎；上泌尿道＝腎盂腎炎；上行感染可致泌尿道敗血症。
Asymptomatic bacteriuria is not treated; symptomatic UTI gets antibiotics. CAUTI is a preventable health care-associated infection.
無症狀性菌尿不治療；有症狀的泌尿道感染使用抗生素。導尿管相關感染（CAUTI）是可預防的醫療照護相關感染。
Risks: indwelling catheter, stasis, poor perineal hygiene, incontinence, constipation, stones, pregnancy, menopause, delayed voiding.
風險：留置導尿管、尿液滯留、會陰衛生不良、失禁、便祕、結石、懷孕、停經、習慣憋尿。
Urge (overactive bladder): sudden strong urge then leakage before reaching toilet; nocturia.
急迫性（膀胱過動）：突然強烈尿意，來不及到廁所即漏尿；夜尿。
Stress: small leaks with cough, laugh or exertion from weak sphincter or pelvic floor.
壓力性：咳嗽、大笑或用力時少量漏尿，因括約肌或骨盆底肌無力。
Mixed: urge plus stress. Overflow: bladder distended by obstruction or underactive muscle, constant dribbling.
混合性：急迫加壓力性。滿溢性：因阻塞或膀胱肌無力造成膀胱脹滿，持續滴尿。
Functional: normal urinary tract but cannot reach or use toilet in time (arthritis, mobility, cognition); reflex: nerve damage (MS, spinal cord injury) with leakage without warning.
功能性：泌尿道正常，但因關節炎、行動或認知問題無法及時如廁；反射性：神經受損（多發性硬化、脊髓損傷），無預警漏尿。
Treat with pelvic floor exercises, bladder training, scheduled toileting, safety measures, and medication for overactive bladder.
處理：骨盆底運動、膀胱訓練、定時如廁、安全措施，過動膀胱可用藥物。
Straight (single lumen) for one-time drainage, specimens, residuals; indwelling with balloon (double lumen); three-way (triple lumen) for continuous bladder irrigation.
單次導尿管（單腔）用於一次性排空、採檢、測餘尿；留置氣球導尿管（雙腔）；三腔導尿管用於持續膀胱灌洗。
Strict aseptic technique for insertion; sterile field above waist, 1-inch border contaminated. Female: advance about 3 inches then 1-2 inches more after urine; male: 7-9 inches then 1-2 inches more.
插入須嚴格無菌；無菌區保持在腰部以上，邊緣1吋視為污染。女性：進約3吋，見尿後再進1-2吋；男性：進7-9吋，見尿後再進1-2吋。
Inflate balloon fully only after urine returns. If the client has pain on inflation, stop and deflate; do not continue.
見尿後才完全充氣氣球。若充氣時個案疼痛，須停止並放氣，不可繼續。

Care: clean meatus and catheter with soap and water daily, keep bag below bladder level, secure catheter to thigh, no disconnecting the closed system, no lotion or powder near the catheter, empty bag regularly, remove as soon as possible.
護理：每日以肥皂水清潔尿道口與導管、集尿袋低於膀胱、導管固定於大腿、不隨意中斷密閉系統、導管周圍不用乳液或粉、定時倒尿、盡早拔除。
Removal: deflate the balloon completely with a syringe, pull slowly, record first void and amounts for 24 hours.
拔除：以針筒完全抽空氣球，緩慢拔出，記錄第一次排尿及24小時尿量。
Ureteral/nephrostomy tubes: never clamp, irrigate only if prescribed with at most 5 mL sterile saline; output under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 minutes is reported at once.
輸尿管／腎造口管：絕不夾管，僅在醫囑下以最多5 mL無菌生理食鹽水緩慢沖洗；尿量低於30 mL/hr或15分鐘無尿須立即通報。

Types: ureterostomy (pouch needed), ileal conduit (stoma and pouch), continent internal ileal reservoir such as Kock pouch (self-catheterize every 4-6 hours), ureterosigmoidostomy (urine passes with stool, no stoma).
類型：輸尿管造口（需戴袋）、迴腸導管（造口與尿袋）、可控式迴腸貯尿囊如 Kock pouch（每4-6小時自行導尿）、輸尿管乙狀結腸造口（尿隨糞便排出，無造口）。
Postop: check stoma hourly for 24 hours (red and moist); dusky or dark stoma means necrosis; urine flow 30-60 mL/hr, report under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 min.
術後：前24小時每小時檢查造口（紅色濕潤）；暗黑或紫暗代表壞死；尿量30-60 mL/hr，低於30 mL/hr或15分鐘無尿須通報。
Watch for hematuria, peritonitis, return of peristalsis in 2-3 days, shock, hemorrhage, thrombophlebitis and lymphedema after radical cystectomy.
觀察血尿、腹膜炎、2-3天腸蠕動恢復，以及根除性膀胱切除後的休克、出血、血栓性靜脈炎與淋巴水腫。
Urine pH should be 4.0-6.0; do not put the dipstick into the stoma.
尿液 pH 應為4.0-6.0；試紙不可放入造口內。

Pouch care: change in the morning (least urine), cut barrier no more than 3 mm larger than stoma, empty when one-third full, change every 5-7 days, avoid karaya (urine erodes it), vinegar soak for odor, bath water below the stoma.
尿袋護理：早晨更換（尿量最少）、底板開口不超過造口大3 mm、三分之一滿時倒空、每5-7天更換、避免 karaya（尿會侵蝕）、以稀釋白醋浸泡除臭、泡澡水位低於造口。
Reservoir catheterization: start every 2-3 hours, lengthen by 1 hour per week to every 4-6 hours; use clean technique; never force.
貯尿囊導尿：起初每2-3小時，每週延長1小時至每4-6小時；使用清潔技術；不可強插。
Fluids about 2000-2300 mL/day (if no heart/renal restriction); avoid fluids 2 hours before sleep for nocturia.
每日水分約2000-2300 mL（無心腎限制時）；睡前2小時避免飲水以減少夜尿。
Privacy, normal position (women sitting, men standing), running water, double voiding, bladder scan for residual.
提供隱私、採正常姿勢（女性坐、男性站）、流水聲、二次排尿、膀胱掃描測餘尿。
Prevent infection: fluids, perineal hygiene, front-to-back wiping, cotton underwear, regular voiding.
預防感染：補水、會陰衛生、由前往後擦拭、棉質內褲、規律排尿。
Avoid bladder irritants (coffee, tea, soft drinks, chocolate, smoking). Kegel exercises, bladder training with urge suppression, scheduled toileting every 2-3 hours.
避免膀胱刺激物（咖啡、茶、汽水、巧克力、吸菸）。凱格爾運動、以放鬆呼吸抑制尿意的膀胱訓練、每2-3小時定時如廁。
Intermittent catheterization: about 400 mL per cath shows a good schedule.
間歇導尿：每次約400 mL表示排程適當。
Influences: age, fiber and fluids, activity, stress/depression, medications (opioids and iron constipate; antibiotics cause diarrhea), position, pregnancy, pain.
影響因素：年齡、纖維與水分、活動、壓力／憂鬱、藥物（鴉片類與鐵劑致便祕；抗生素致腹瀉）、姿勢、懷孕、疼痛。
Constipation: fewer than 3 stools per week, hard dry stools. Impaction: repeated urge without passage, seepage of liquid stool; confused and debilitated clients at greatest risk.
便祕：每週少於3次、糞便硬而乾。糞便嵌塞：反覆便意卻無法排出、滲出液態糞便；意識混亂與虛弱者風險最高。
Diarrhea: unformed liquid stool, risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; consider C. difficile after antibiotics.
腹瀉：排出液狀稀便，有脫水與電解質失衡風險；抗生素後須考慮 C. difficile。
Incontinence, flatulence, and hemorrhoids (engorged rectal veins from straining, pregnancy, heart/liver failure).
大便失禁、脹氣與痔瘡（因用力、懷孕、心肝衰竭致直腸靜脈腫脹）。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Healthy stoma is red or pink and moist; pale suggests low Hgb/Hct; dark, dusky, purple or black means ischemia and the surgeon must be notified immediately.
健康造口為紅或粉紅且濕潤；蒼白提示血紅素／血比容低；暗黑、紫暗或黑色代表缺血，須立即通知外科醫師。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Ascending colostomy gives liquid stool; transverse loose to semiformed; descending and sigmoid near-normal. Ileostomy output is liquid, green to yellow.
升結腸造口排液狀便；橫結腸為糊狀至半成形；降結腸與乙狀結腸接近正常。迴腸造口為液狀、由深綠轉黃。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Ileostomy carries high risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; monitor I&O.
迴腸造口脫水與電解質失衡風險高；監測輸出入量。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Postop: pouch fitted early, empty at one-third full, keep stool off skin, passing flatus and stool by about 72 hours is expected, teach to limit gas-forming foods.
術後：早期裝上造口袋、三分之一滿時倒空、避免糞便接觸皮膚、約72小時內排氣與排便屬預期，教導限制產氣食物。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Colostomy irrigation: 500-1000 mL lukewarm tap water, bag at shoulder level, insert without force, clamp for cramping, same time daily, about 1 hour after meals.
結腸造口灌洗：500-1000 mL 微溫自來水、灌洗袋與肩同高、不可強行插入、絞痛時夾管、每日同一時間、飯後約1小時。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Preop: enterostomal therapist marks site, diet and bowel prep as ordered, teach-back, and psychosocial support about body image and sexuality.
術前：造口治療師標記位置、依醫囑飲食與腸道準備、回覆示教、提供身體意象與性生活的心理支持。
腸道造口：結腸造口與迴腸造口
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸
Bowel training: same time daily, hot drink or prune juice, privacy, lean forward or footstool, exercise at least 150 minutes per week, high-fiber diet with fluids.
腸道訓練：每日固定時間、熱飲或西梅汁、隱私、前傾或腳凳、每週運動至少150分鐘、高纖飲食並補水。
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸
Diarrhea diet: clear liquids then low-residue (white rice, bread, bananas, potatoes); protect skin; fecal collection devices if skin intact.
腹瀉飲食：清流質後改低渣（白飯、麵包、香蕉、馬鈴薯）；保護皮膚；皮膚完整時可用糞便收集裝置。
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸
Laxatives should not be used long term (reduced motility and sensation). Antidiarrheals treat cause as well.
軟便劑不可長期使用（降低蠕動與感覺）。腹瀉也應針對病因處理並可用止瀉藥。
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸

Enema: left lateral position, tube toward umbilicus, container at shoulder height, stop and breathe for cramping, hold as long as possible; normal saline preferred (isotonic); hypertonic (Fleet) contraindicated in dehydration and young infants; tap water limited to 3 due to overload risk.
灌腸：左側臥、管子朝向肚臍、容器與肩同高、絞痛時停止並深呼吸、盡量忍住；首選生理食鹽水（等張）；高張（Fleet）禁用於脫水與幼嬰；自來水灌腸最多3次以免容積過量。
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸
Digital removal of stool: last resort, left lateral position, monitor pulse because vagal stimulation can slow heart rate.
手挖糞便：最後手段，左側臥，監測脈搏，因迷走神經刺激可使心跳減慢。
Restorative Bowel Care, Laxatives and Enemas
腸道復健、軟便劑與灌腸
Urine output below 30 mL/hr (or two consecutive low voids) requires prompt evaluation.
尿量低於30 mL/hr（或連續兩次排尿量少）須立即評估。
Older adults with UTI may show only confusion, falls or incontinence, without fever.
老年人泌尿道感染可能僅表現意識混亂、跌倒或失禁，且不發燒。
Asymptomatic bacteriuria is not treated with antibiotics.
無症狀性菌尿不用抗生素治療。
CAUTI prevention: aseptic insertion, closed system, bag below bladder, daily care, remove catheter early.
預防 CAUTI：無菌插入、密閉系統、集尿袋低於膀胱、每日護理、盡早拔管。
If a client has pain as the catheter balloon inflates, stop inflating and deflate; the balloon may be in the urethra.
氣球充氣時個案疼痛，須停止並放氣；氣球可能仍在尿道內。
Never clamp a ureteral or nephrostomy tube; irrigate only if prescribed with max 5 mL sterile saline.
輸尿管／腎造口管絕不夾管；僅在醫囑下以最多5 mL無菌生理食鹽水沖洗。
Urinary stoma pouch: empty at one-third full, change every 5-7 days, change in the morning.
尿路造口袋：三分之一滿倒空、每5-7天更換、早晨更換。
A dusky, purple, dark blue or black stoma indicates necrosis: notify the surgeon immediately.
造口暗紅、紫、深藍或黑色代表壞死：立即通知外科醫師。
Healthy stoma: red or pink and moist; passing flatus after colostomy is a normal sign of returning peristalsis.
健康造口：紅或粉紅、濕潤；結腸造口後排氣是腸蠕動恢復的正常徵象。
Ileostomy: most frequent complication is fluid and electrolyte imbalance.
迴腸造口：最常見併發症為體液與電解質失衡。
Stool consistency by colostomy site: ascending liquid, transverse loose/semiformed, descending/sigmoid near normal.
各結腸造口糞便性質：升結腸液狀、橫結腸糊狀／半成形、降結腸與乙狀結腸接近正常。
Opioids and iron cause constipation; antibiotics cause diarrhea (watch for C. difficile).
鴉片類與鐵劑引起便祕；抗生素引起腹瀉（注意 C. difficile）。
Digital stool removal can stimulate the vagus nerve and slow heart rate: monitor pulse.
手挖糞便可刺激迷走神經使心跳變慢：監測脈搏。
Hypertonic enemas are contraindicated in dehydration and young infants; tap water enemas limited to 3.
高張灌腸禁用於脫水與幼嬰；自來水灌腸最多3次。
Enema position: left lateral (Sims) with rectal tube aimed at the umbilicus.
灌腸姿勢：左側臥（Sims 臥位），肛管朝向肚臍。
Do not place a urine dipstick into the stoma; normal urine pH is 4.0-6.0.
試紙不可放入造口；正常尿液 pH 為4.0-6.0。
Stoma color: red = good, dusky/dark = dead (call the surgeon).
造口顏色：紅＝好，暗黑＝壞死（通知外科醫師）。
Further along the colon, firmer the stool: ascending liquid, descending formed.
愈往遠端結腸，糞便愈成形：升結腸液狀，降結腸成形。
Catheter bag stays below the bladder for downhill flow.
集尿袋永遠低於膀胱，讓尿液順勢流下。

艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Eight stages from birth to death; each presents a crisis that must be resolved for emotional progress, though outcomes can be revised by later experience.
從出生到死亡共八個階段；每階段有一個危機，須解決才能情緒成長，但結果可被日後經驗改變。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Infancy (birth-18 mo): trust vs mistrust; attachment to caregiver. Respond to infant cues, hold and comfort.
嬰兒期（出生-18個月）：信任對不信任；與主要照顧者依附。回應嬰兒的訊號、擁抱與安撫。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Early childhood (18 mo-3 yr): autonomy vs shame and doubt; allow self-feeding, dressing and safe choices; set limits for tantrums with simple explanations.
幼兒期（18個月-3歲）：自主對羞愧懷疑；讓孩子自行進食、穿衣與在安全下做選擇；對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Late childhood (3-6 yr): initiative vs guilt; purposeful play, medical-equipment play.
學齡前期（3-6歲）：主動對罪惡感；有目的的遊戲、使用醫療器材玩具。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
School age (6-12 yr): industry vs inferiority; learning and social skills; peers become important; continue schoolwork in hospital.
學齡期（6-12歲）：勤奮對自卑；學習與社交技能；同儕變重要；住院時持續課業。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Adolescence (12-20 yr): identity vs role confusion; allow choices and private interviews without parents.
青春期（12-20歲）：自我認同對角色混淆；讓其參與決定並可在無父母在場下會談。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Early adulthood (20-35): intimacy vs isolation. Middle adulthood (35-65): generativity vs stagnation. Later adulthood (65+): integrity vs despair; listen to reminiscence.
成年早期（20-35歲）：親密對孤立。成年中期（35-65歲）：生產對停滯。老年期（65歲以上）：完整對絕望；傾聽其回顧人生。
艾瑞克森：心理社會發展
Schema is a mental framework; assimilation fits new information into existing schemas; accommodation changes the schema to fit new information.
基模是思考架構；同化是將新資訊納入既有基模；調適是改變基模以容納新資訊。
Sensorimotor (birth-2 yr): learns through senses and movement; object permanence develops (does not know hidden objects exist at first).
感覺動作期（出生-2歲）：透過感覺與動作學習；發展物體恆存概念（起初不知被遮物體仍存在）。
Preoperational (2-7 yr): prelogical, egocentric, needs concrete examples, thinks in past/present/future.
前運思期（2-7歲）：前邏輯思考、自我中心、需要具體例子，開始有過去、現在、未來概念。
Concrete operational (7-11 yr): classifies, orders, sorts; logical about concrete problems; less egocentric.
具體運思期（7-11歲）：分類、排序、歸納；對具體問題有邏輯；較不自我中心。
Formal operational (11 yr to adulthood): abstract and logical thinking like an adult.
形式運思期（11歲至成年）：如成人般抽象與邏輯思考。
A 6-year-old who lacks object permanence is abnormal: report to the pediatrician.
6歲兒童缺乏物體恆存屬異常：應通報小兒科醫師。
Moral development is sequential; stages cannot be skipped; it follows cognitive development; not everyone reaches stages 5-6.
道德發展依序進行，不可跳階；隨認知發展而進展；並非人人達到第5-6階段。
Preconventional: stage 1 punishment-obedience (2-4 yr), stage 2 instrumental relativist, 'what is in it for me' (4-7 yr). Motivated by punishment and reward.
前習俗層次：第1階段懲罰與服從（2-4歲），第2階段工具相對（「我有什麼好處」）（4-7歲）。動機來自懲罰與獎賞。
Conventional: stage 3 good boy/nice girl (7-10 yr) to please others; stage 4 law and order (10-12 yr).
習俗層次：第3階段乖男孩／好女孩（7-10歲），為取悅他人；第4階段法律與秩序（10-12歲）。
Postconventional (about age 13+): stage 5 social contract; stage 6 universal ethical principles; internal conscience.
後習俗層次（約13歲後）：第5階段社會契約；第6階段普遍倫理原則；內在良知。
Toddler discipline: simple explanations, praise good behavior, distraction; avoid physical punishment or withdrawing love.
幼兒管教：簡單說明、稱讚良好行為、轉移注意；避免體罰或收回關愛。
Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality
佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構
Unconscious: illogical, pleasure principle, repressed material. Preconscious: recallable. Conscious: logical, reality principle.
潛意識：不合邏輯、享樂原則、壓抑的內容。前意識：可回憶。意識：合邏輯、現實原則。
Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality
佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構

Id: drives, pleasure principle, present at birth, impulsive. Ego: reality testing and problem solving, mediates between id and world, starts about 4-5 months. Superego: conscience and ego ideal, develops in phallic stage (3-6 yr).
本我：驅力、享樂原則、出生即有、衝動。自我：現實檢驗與解決問題、調節本我與外界，約4-5個月開始形成。超我：良知與自我理想，於性器期（3-6歲）發展。
Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality
佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構
Defense mechanisms are mostly unconscious (except suppression) and distort reality to reduce anxiety; needed for survival but extreme use hinders adjustment.
防衛機轉多為無意識（壓抑除外），扭曲現實以減少焦慮；為生存所必需，但過度使用妨礙適應。
Freud: Levels of Awareness and Personality
佛洛伊德：意識層次與人格結構
Oral (birth-1 yr): gratification through mouth; trust begins; ego emerges.
口腔期（出生-1歲）：以口腔獲得滿足；信任開始；自我萌芽。
Anal (1-3 yr): toilet training and control of body; learning to delay gratification.
肛門期（1-3歲）：如廁訓練與身體控制；學習延遲滿足。
Phallic (3-6 yr): genital focus, Oedipus complex, identification with same-sex parent; superego emerges.
性器期（3-6歲）：注意生殖器、戀母情結、認同同性父母；超我出現。
Latency (6-12 yr): sexual urges quiet; energy goes to school, friends and skills.
潛伏期（6-12歲）：性衝動沉寂；精力投入學業、友誼與技能。
Genital (12+): puberty, mature sexual and emotional relationships, life goals and identity.
兩性期／生殖期（12歲以上）：青春期、成熟的性與情感關係、人生目標與認同。
Each stage has a conflict to resolve; early experiences shape adult personality.
每階段有需解決的衝突；早期經驗形塑成人人格。
Infant: trust vs mistrust; respond promptly and consistently to the infant's signals.
嬰兒：信任對不信任；對嬰兒訊號迅速且一致地回應。
Toddler: autonomy vs shame/doubt; allow safe choices, set limits on tantrums with simple explanations.
幼兒：自主對羞愧懷疑；給予安全選擇，對發脾氣設限並簡單說明。
Preschooler: initiative vs guilt; encourage purposeful, imaginative play.
學齡前：主動對罪惡感；鼓勵有目的與想像的遊戲。
School-age: industry vs inferiority; peer focus is normal and healthy.
學齡兒童：勤奮對自卑；注重同儕是正常且健康的。
Adolescent: identity vs role confusion; interview privately and include in decisions.
青少年：認同對角色混淆；私下會談並納入決策。
Older adult: integrity vs despair; listen to life reminiscence.
老年人：完整對絕望；傾聽生命回顧。
皮亞傑：感覺動作期0-2、前運思期2-7、具體運思期7-11、形式運思期11歲以上。
A school-age child without object permanence is developmentally delayed: report to the provider.
學齡兒童缺乏物體恆存為發展遲緩：通報醫師。
Preconventional morality is driven by punishment and reward.
前習俗道德以懲罰與獎賞為動機。
Kohlberg stages are sequential and cannot be skipped; preschoolers are preconventional, school-age conventional, adolescents postconventional.
柯爾伯格階段依序、不可跳階；學齡前為前習俗、學齡期為習俗、青少年進入後習俗。
Freud: anal stage = toilet training (1-3 yr); phallic = identification with same-sex parent; latency = sexual repression; oral = mouth gratification.
佛洛伊德：肛門期＝如廁訓練（1-3歲）；性器期＝認同同性父母；潛伏期＝性衝動壓抑；口腔期＝口腔滿足。
Id = pleasure principle, ego = reality principle, superego = conscience.
本我＝享樂原則；自我＝現實原則；超我＝良知。
Defense mechanisms are unconscious except suppression.
防衛機轉為無意識，唯壓抑（suppression）為有意識。
Do not use physical punishment or withdraw love with toddlers; use explanation, praise and distraction.
對幼兒勿用體罰或收回關愛；用說明、稱讚與轉移注意力。
Erikson in order: Trust, Autonomy, Initiative, Industry, Identity, Intimacy, Generativity, Integrity (TAI-III-GI).
艾瑞克森順序：信任、自主、主動、勤奮、認同、親密、生產、完整。
皮亞傑：感覺動作、前運思、具體運思、形式運思（S-P-C-F）。
Freud: Oral, Anal, Phallic, Latency, Genital (OAPLG).
佛洛伊德：口腔、肛門、性器、潛伏、兩性（OAPLG）。
柯爾伯格：前習俗（懲罰／獎賞）、習俗（取悅他人／法律）、後習俗（原則）。

Toddler separation anxiety has three phases: protest (crying, searching, aggression), despair (withdrawn, loses new skills), detachment (seems adjusted but is resignation; the most serious phase).
幼兒分離焦慮三階段：抗議（哭鬧、尋找、攻擊）、絕望（退縮、喪失新技能）、疏離（看似適應，實為放棄；最嚴重）。

Toddlers fear pain and loss of control; they regress, show tantrums and ritual disruption. Offer choices, keep home routines, allow comfort objects, play therapy, accept regression.
幼兒害怕疼痛與失控；會退化、發脾氣。提供選擇、維持家中作息、容許安慰物、遊戲治療、接納退化。
住院的嬰兒、幼兒與學齡前兒童
Infants: therapeutic touch, soft voice, pacifier for sucking even if NPO, contrasting colors and textures for stimulation.
嬰兒：治療性碰觸、輕柔聲音、即使禁食也提供奶嘴吸吮、對比色與質感刺激。
住院的嬰兒、幼兒與學齡前兒童

Preschoolers: separation anxiety is less obvious; fear mutilation and invasive procedures and think illness is punishment for their thoughts. Encourage rooming-in or a favorite toy, simple explanations, play, independence, same-age peers.
學齡前：分離焦慮較不明顯；害怕身體受損與侵入性處置，認為生病是自己想法或行為造成的。鼓勵陪住或帶心愛玩具、簡單說明、遊戲、獨立、同齡玩伴。

住院的學齡兒童與青少年
School-age: worry about missing school and being forgotten by friends; fear injury, disability, death and genital exams; protest-despair-detachment seldom occur.
學齡兒童：擔心缺課與被朋友遺忘；害怕受傷、失能、死亡與生殖器檢查；少出現抗議-絕望-疏離。
住院的學齡兒童與青少年
Interventions: choices, involvement in care, body diagrams for explanations, privacy, schoolwork, contact with friends, accept regression but encourage independence.
措施：提供選擇、參與照護、用人體圖說明、保護隱私、學業安排、與朋友聯繫、接納退化並鼓勵獨立。
住院的學齡兒童與青少年
Adolescents: ambivalent about parents, upset at being excluded by friends, fear being different, guard sexual-development exams; may seem unafraid.
青少年：對父母態度矛盾、被朋友排除會難過、害怕與眾不同、對性發展檢查防衛；外表可能裝作不怕。
住院的學齡兒童與青少年
Support: privacy, own clothes and grooming, peer contact, schooling, future planning, positive coping.
支持：隱私、穿自己的衣服與整理儀容、同儕聯繫、教育、未來規劃、正向因應。

Infant: slow, calm approach, soft voice, respond to cries. Toddler: short concrete words, take words literally, prepare immediately before procedures, use play and let them handle equipment.
嬰兒：緩慢溫和接近、輕柔聲音、回應哭聲。幼兒：簡短具體用詞、字面理解、操作前才準備、用遊戲並讓其摸器材。

Preschooler: simple sentences, offer choices, play and equipment handling. School-age: clear explanation, photos/dolls/medical play. Adolescent: privacy, avoid judgmental, too abstract or prying talk.
學齡前：簡單句子、給選擇、遊戲與接觸器材。學齡兒童：清楚說明、照片/娃娃/醫療遊戲。青少年：保護隱私，避免批判、過度抽象或追問。

Back seat is safest for all children; follow manufacturer seat guidance; an 8-year-old 4 ft tall still needs a booster seat.
所有兒童坐後座最安全；依製造商指引使用安全座椅；8 歲、身高 4 英尺（約 122 公分）仍需增高墊。
Communication, Car Safety and Preventive Care
溝通、汽車安全與預防保健
Well-child visits follow AAP/Bright Futures (screenings include development, autism, vision, hearing, lead, anemia, depression).
依 AAP/Bright Futures 進行兒童健康檢查（篩檢包括發展、自閉症、視力、聽力、鉛、貧血、憂鬱）。

Missed doses are given without restarting the series; vaccines can be given simultaneously; preterm infants get full doses at chronological age.
漏打只需補打不需重來；可同時接種；早產兒依實足年齡給足量。
Contraindications: anaphylaxis to prior dose or component; live vaccines not for severe immunodeficiency, pregnancy or gelatin sensitivity; caution with moderate/severe acute illness.
禁忌：先前劑量或成分過敏性休克；活性疫苗不用於嚴重免疫缺損、孕婦或明膠過敏者；中重度急性病需小心。
Administration: separate syringes and sites; IM in vastus lateralis (deltoid from 36 months); IM needle 1 inch 23-25 g, subcutaneous 5/8 inch 25 g; observe 15-30 minutes; report adverse events.
給藥：分開針筒與部位；肌肉注射於股外側肌（36 個月起可用三角肌）；IM 針 1 英寸 23-25 號、皮下針 5/8 英寸 25 號；觀察 15-30 分鐘；通報不良反應。
Schedule: birth HepB; 2, 4, 6 mo DTaP, Hib, IPV, PCV, RV; 12-15 mo MMR, varicella, HepA, PCV, Hib; 4-6 yr DTaP, IPV, MMR, varicella; 11-12 yr Tdap, MCV4, HPV. Flu yearly from 6 months.
時程：出生 HepB；2、4、6 個月 DTaP、Hib、IPV、PCV、RV；12-15 個月 MMR、水痘、A 肝、PCV、Hib；4-6 歲 DTaP、IPV、MMR、水痘；11-12 歲 Tdap、MCV4、HPV。6 個月起每年流感。
Mother HBsAg positive: infant gets HepB vaccine and HBIG within 12 hours of birth.
母親 HBsAg 陽性：嬰兒 12 小時內接種 HepB 疫苗並給 HBIG。
Rotavirus is oral; MMR, varicella, IPV given subcutaneously; delay MMR 3-6 months after immunoglobulin; avoid aspirin after varicella vaccine (Reye syndrome).
輪狀病毒為口服；MMR、水痘、IPV 皮下注射；注射免疫球蛋白後 MMR 延後 3-6 個月；水痘疫苗後避免阿斯匹靈（Reye 症候群）。
Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions
其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
MCV4 at 11-12 yr with booster at 16; contraindicated with history of Guillain-Barre syndrome. HPV 3 doses over 6 months if started at 11-12 yr; avoid in pregnancy.
MCV4 於 11-12 歲接種、16 歲追加；有格林巴利症候群病史者禁用。HPV 若 11-12 歲開始需 3 劑（6 個月內）；孕期避免。
Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions
其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
Adults: yearly flu, Tdap then Td every 10 years, Tdap each pregnancy, zoster recombinant 2 doses at 50+, pneumococcal at 65+.
成人：每年流感、Tdap 後每 10 年 Td、每次懷孕打 Tdap、50 歲以上帶狀疱疹重組疫苗 2 劑、65 歲以上肺炎鏈球菌。
Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions
其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
Local reactions: tenderness, redness, low fever; cool compresses first 24 hours; acetaminophen or ibuprofen every 4-6 hr.
局部反應：觸痛、紅腫、低燒；前 24 小時冷敷；每 4-6 小時給乙醯胺酚或布洛芬。
Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions
其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
Anaphylaxis: secure airway, epinephrine, fluids, vasopressors, CPR if needed.
過敏性休克：確保呼吸道、給 epinephrine、輸液、升壓劑，必要時 CPR。
Other Vaccines, Adult Immunizations and Reactions
其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
COVID-19 vaccine: rare myocarditis/pericarditis; report chest pain, dyspnea, palpitations.
COVID-19 疫苗：罕見心肌炎/心包炎；胸痛、呼吸困難、心悸須通報。
