其他疫苗、成人疫苗與反應
Birth weight doubles at 5-6 months and triples at 12 months; length rises 50% by 1 year; head circumference 33-35 cm at birth.
體重 5-6 個月加倍、12 個月三倍；1 歲身長增加 50%；出生頭圍 33-35 公分。
Posterior fontanel closes by 4 months; anterior by 18 months; soft and flat is normal; first teeth (lower central incisors) at 6-10 months.
後囟門 4 個月前閉合；前囟門 18 個月前閉合；軟而平為正常；6-10 個月長出下中門牙。
Vital signs: newborn HR 120-160, RR 30-60; 1-year-old HR 90-130, RR 20-40, BP 90/56.

Nutrition: breast milk preferred for 6 months; vitamin D 400 IU for breastfed infants; iron stores depleted by 4 months; solids at 5-6 months one at a time every 4-5 days (iron-fortified rice cereal first); no cow's milk before 12 months, no honey under 12 months, no microwaving bottles, avoid choking foods.
營養：6 個月內以母乳為佳；純母乳嬰兒補充維生素 D 400 IU；4 個月鐵質儲存耗盡；5-6 個月起一次一種副食品、間隔 4-5 天（先吃強化鐵米糊）；12 個月前不喝牛奶、不吃蜂蜜、不微波奶瓶、避免易噎食物。
Milestones: social smile 2-3 mo, rolls over 4-5 mo, sits with support and stranger fear 6-7 mo, sits unsupported and crawls 8-9 mo, walks alone 14-15 mo.
里程碑：2-3 個月社交性微笑、4-5 個月翻身、6-7 個月扶坐與怕生、8-9 個月獨坐與爬行、14-15 個月獨自走路。
Safety: baby-proof, never leave on bed or in bath, no small toys, cords away, poison control number, never shake an infant.
安全：居家防護、不讓嬰兒獨自在床上或浴缸、避免小零件玩具、繩索遠離、備毒物中心電話、絕不搖晃嬰兒。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
Toddler: gains about 3 in/yr, 22-27 lb at 2 yr, lordosis (potbelly) normal, anterior fontanel closes 12-18 months, one nap, vital signs HR 80-120, RR 20-30.
幼兒：每年長高約 7.5 公分、2 歲體重 10-12 公斤、腹部凸出（腰椎前凸）正常、前囟門 12-18 個月閉合、一次午睡、心跳 80-120、呼吸 20-30。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
Toddler diet: 2-3 servings milk daily (24-30 oz), small meals, physiological anorexia normal, no bottle to bed, avoid choking foods, no food as reward.
幼兒飲食：每天 2-3 份奶（700-800 mL）、少量多餐、生理性厭食正常、不含奶瓶入睡、避免易噎食物、不以食物當獎懲。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
Toddler skills: runs by 2, hops on one foot by 3; about 300 words at 2; parallel play; toilet readiness signs (dry 2 hr, sits 5-10 min); bowel control precedes bladder.
幼兒技能：2 歲會跑、3 歲單腳跳；2 歲約 300 字；平行遊戲；如廁準備徵象（乾燥 2 小時、可坐 5-10 分鐘）；先控制排便再控制排尿。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
Toddler safety: back stove burners, pot handles inward, gates, window locks, never alone near water, lock poisons.
幼兒安全：用後排爐頭、鍋柄朝內、安全門、窗鎖、水邊不離人、毒物上鎖。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展

Preschooler: 5 lb and 2.5-3 in per year, 12 hr sleep, alternates feet on stairs, cooperative and imaginative play, imaginary friends, magical thinking; teach fire, gun, stranger and 911 safety; guns locked unloaded.
學齡前：每年增加 2.25 公斤與 6.5-7.5 公分、睡 12 小時、可雙腳交替上樓、合作性與想像遊戲、假想玩伴、魔幻思考；教導火、槍、陌生人與 119/911 安全；槍械退彈上鎖。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
Preschooler vital signs HR 70-110, RR 16-22; vocabulary 900 words at 3 yr, 2100 at 5 yr.
學齡前生命徵象心跳 70-110、呼吸 16-22；3 歲詞彙約 900 字、5 歲約 2100 字。
幼兒與學齡前兒童發展
學齡、青少年與成人發展
School-age: 2 in/yr, 4.5-6.5 lb/yr, permanent teeth from age 6, 10-12 hr sleep, competitive rule-based play, vital signs HR 60-100, RR 18-20; helmets, traffic and water safety.
學齡：每年 5 公分、2-3 公斤、6 歲起恆齒、睡 10-12 小時、有規則的競爭遊戲、心跳 60-100、呼吸 18-20；戴安全帽、交通與水上安全。
學齡、青少年與成人發展
Adolescent: puberty, menses about 2.5 years after puberty onset, risk-taking; teach about substances, seat belts, diving feet-first, STIs, internet safety; vitals HR 55-90, RR 12-20.
青少年：青春期、初經約在青春期開始後 2.5 年、冒險行為；教導物質濫用、安全帶、腳先入水、性傳染病、網路安全；心跳 55-90、呼吸 12-20。
學齡、青少年與成人發展
Early adulthood: separation from family, career/marriage decisions, ignores symptoms, STI risk. Middle adulthood: menopause/climacteric, generativity, empty nest, body image concerns.
成年早期：脫離原生家庭、職涯婚姻決定、忽略症狀、性傳染病風險。成年中期：更年期、生產力（generativity）、空巢、身體形象。
學齡、青少年與成人發展

Gender identity is personal sense of gender; gender expression is outward expression; sexual orientation is attraction. Support children with unconditional acceptance, watch for depression, prepare for bullying.
性別認同為個人對自身性別的感受；性別表達為對外表現；性傾向為吸引對象。以無條件接納支持孩子、留意憂鬱、預備霸凌因應。
學齡、青少年與成人發展
Care follows client wishes: advance directives, organ donation, withholding or withdrawing treatment, CPR. Palliative/hospice care focuses on comfort not cure.
依個案意願：預立醫囑、器官捐贈、不給予或撤除治療、CPR。安寧緩和照護著重舒適而非治癒。

Near-death signs: slowed metabolism, blurred vision, hearing lost last, noisy respirations (death rattle), Cheyne-Stokes, slow HR and falling BP, cool mottled extremities, less urine, constipation, Kennedy terminal ulcer on sacrum.
臨終徵象：代謝減慢、視力模糊、聽力最後消失、痰鳴（死前嘎嘎聲）、陳施氏呼吸、心跳慢血壓降、四肢冰冷斑駁、尿量減少、便秘、薦骨肯尼迪終末潰瘍。
Comfort care: never delay pain medication; elevate head of bed and oxygen for dyspnea; oral care, ice chips, do not force food; do not restrain restless client.
舒適照護：不延誤止痛；呼吸困難時抬高床頭並給氧；口腔照護、冰塊、不強迫進食；躁動者不約束。
Address fears: pain, loneliness, being meaningless; allow family presence, touch if culturally acceptable, life review.
處理恐懼：疼痛、孤獨、無意義感；容許家屬陪伴、文化允許時碰觸、生命回顧。

Respect culture and religion; ask the family about preferences. Postmortem care: dignity, check organ donor status, close eyes, replace dentures, wash, remove tubes, allow viewing; preserve evidence for medical examiner cases.
尊重文化與宗教，詢問家屬偏好。遺體護理：維護尊嚴、確認器官捐贈、闔眼、裝回假牙、清潔、拔除管路、讓家屬瞻仰；需法醫案件須保留證據。
Detachment is the most serious phase of separation; the toddler looks adjusted but is resigned.
疏離是分離反應中最嚴重階段；幼兒看似適應其實是放棄。
Preschoolers think illness is punishment and fear mutilation; use simple explanations and rooming-in.
學齡前兒童認為生病是懲罰並害怕身體受損；用簡單說明並鼓勵陪住。
Hospitalized adolescents most fear separation from peers; school-age children fear missing school.
住院青少年最怕與同儕分離；學齡兒童擔心缺課。
Vital sign norms: newborn HR 120-160, RR 30-60; 1-yr RR 20-40; toddler HR 80-120; preschool HR 70-110; school-age HR 60-100; adolescent HR 55-90.
Anterior fontanel soft and flat is normal; closes by 18 months. Posterior closes by 4 months.
前囟門軟而平為正常，18 個月前閉合；後囟門 4 個月前閉合。
No honey or cow's milk under 12 months; no solids before 4-6 months; no microwaving bottles.
12 個月前不可蜂蜜與牛奶；4-6 個月前不加副食品；不微波奶瓶。
Vitamin D 400 IU for breastfed infants; iron supplement when iron stores deplete at 4 months.
母乳嬰兒補充維生素 D 400 IU；4 個月鐵質耗盡時補鐵。
Never let a toddler sleep with a bottle of milk or juice (bottle-mouth caries).
幼兒不可含奶瓶（奶或果汁）入睡（奶瓶性齲齒）。
Choking foods for infants and toddlers: nuts, grapes, popcorn, raisins, hot dog pieces, seeds.
嬰幼兒易噎食物：堅果、葡萄、爆米花、葡萄乾、熱狗片、帶籽食物。
Never shake an infant (shaken baby syndrome).
絕不搖晃嬰兒（嬰兒搖晃症候群）。
Vaccines: anaphylaxis is a contraindication; live vaccines avoided in pregnancy and severe immunodeficiency; mild illness is not a contraindication.
疫苗：過敏性休克為禁忌；活性疫苗孕期與嚴重免疫缺損避免；輕微疾病不是禁忌。
Infant of HBsAg-positive mother gets HepB vaccine plus HBIG within 12 hours.
HBsAg 陽性母親之嬰兒 12 小時內給 HepB 疫苗加 HBIG。
Avoid aspirin after varicella vaccine; delay MMR 3-6 months after immunoglobulin.
水痘疫苗後避免阿斯匹靈；免疫球蛋白後 MMR 延後 3-6 個月。
Infant IM vaccines go in vastus lateralis; observe 15-30 minutes after any vaccine for anaphylaxis.
嬰兒肌肉注射選股外側肌；接種後觀察 15-30 分鐘以防過敏性休克。
Car safety: back seat for all children; booster for 8-year-old under 4 ft 9 in.
汽車安全：兒童坐後座；8 歲、未滿 4 英尺 9 英寸者用增高墊。
Never delay pain medication for the dying client; do not restrain restlessness; hearing is last sense lost.
臨終個案不延誤止痛；躁動不約束；聽覺最後消失。
Kennedy terminal ulcer on the sacrum signals the dying process.
薦骨肯尼迪終末潰瘍預示瀕死過程。
Separation response: P-D-D = Protest, Despair, Detachment.
分離反應 P-D-D：抗議、絕望、疏離。
Weight rule: birth weight doubles at 5-6 months, triples at 12 months.
體重規則：5-6 個月兩倍、12 個月三倍。
Posterior fontanel closes at 2-4 months-ish ('4 months'); anterior by 18 months ('12-18').
後囟門約 4 個月前；前囟門約 12-18 個月。

Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Aging is a lifelong biopsychosocial process; gerontology is the study of aging.
老化是從出生到死亡的生物、心理、社會變化歷程；老年學是研究老化的學科。
Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Skin: thinner epidermis, less elasticity, turgor, subcutaneous fat and sweating; bruises and tears easily, tolerates temperature extremes poorly.
皮膚：表皮變薄、彈性與膚質張力下降、皮下脂肪與出汗減少；容易瘀青撕裂，對冷熱耐受差。
Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Skin care: inspect nails, cut toenails straight across, moisturize, ensure protein and fluids, dress for the weather.
皮膚照護：檢查指甲、趾甲剪平、擦保濕劑、補充蛋白質與水分、依氣溫穿衣。
Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Neuro: slowed reflexes, tremor, poor balance, more night awakenings, short-term memory may decline while long-term memory is kept; do not rush the client.
神經：反射變慢、輕微顫抖、平衡差、夜間易醒；短期記憶可能下降，長期記憶多半保留；不要催促個案。
Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Musculoskeletal: muscle atrophy, bone demineralization, kyphosis and height loss, wider-based shortened gait; combined with neuro changes this raises fall risk.
肌肉骨骼：肌肉萎縮、骨質流失、駝背與身高變矮、步態變短且底寬；與神經變化合併使跌倒風險增加。
Aging and Gerontology; Skin, Neuro and Musculoskeletal Changes
老化與老年學；皮膚、神經與肌肉骨骼變化
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
Cardiovascular: stiffer, thicker valves, lower cardiac output and exercise tolerance, weaker pulses, higher BP yet prone to orthostatic hypotension.
心血管：瓣膜變厚變硬、心輸出量與運動耐受下降、脈搏較弱、血壓偏高但易姿勢性低血壓。
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
Respiratory: lower chest wall compliance, fewer alveoli, shallow breaths, weaker cough; respiratory rate itself is unchanged; infections are worse.
呼吸：胸壁順應性下降、肺泡減少、呼吸變淺、咳痰能力差；呼吸速率本身不變；感染更嚴重。
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
Blood: Hgb/Hct at low end of normal, more clotting tendency, less albumin available to bind drugs.
血液：Hgb/Hct 偏低正常範圍、較易凝血、可結合藥物的蛋白質減少。
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
Immune: reduced resistance; recommend influenza, pneumococcal and shingles vaccines.
免疫：抵抗力下降；建議接種流感、肺炎鏈球菌與帶狀疱疹疫苗。
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
GI: lower caloric need, appetite and thirst, slowed motility, constipation, dehydration risk, dental problems, reduced taste/smell/saliva.
消化：熱量需求、食慾與口渴感下降、腸蠕動變慢、便秘、易脫水、牙齒問題、味覺嗅覺與唾液減少。
Cardiovascular, Respiratory, Blood, Immune and GI Changes
心血管、呼吸、血液、免疫與消化變化
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
Endocrine: lower metabolic rate, decreased glucose tolerance with peripheral insulin resistance; dress warmly.
內分泌：代謝率下降、葡萄糖耐受降低且周邊胰島素阻抗；需保暖。
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
Renal: smaller kidneys, lower GFR, reduced concentrating ability, smaller bladder capacity, more residual urine and infection; impaired drug excretion.
腎臟：腎臟縮小、GFR 下降、濃縮能力差、膀胱容量小、殘尿與感染增加；藥物排除受損。
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
Bladder tips: limit fluids 2-4 hr before bed and void at least every 2 hr to prevent overflow incontinence.
膀胱照護：睡前 2-4 小時減少飲水，至少每 2 小時排尿以預防滿溢性尿失禁。
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
Reproductive: lower testosterone, prostate changes (hesitancy, retention), vaginal dryness and reduced tone after menopause; teach Kegel exercises; sexual function varies.
生殖：睪固酮下降、攝護腺改變（遲滯、滯留）、停經後陰道乾澀與肌張力下降；教導凱格爾運動；性功能因人而異。
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
Senses: reduced acuity, glare sensitivity, presbyopia and cataracts; hearing loss of high-frequency sounds so low-pitched tones are heard better; reduced pain awareness.
感覺：視力下降、怕眩光、老花與白內障；高頻聽力喪失，低音調較易聽見；痛覺遲鈍。
Endocrine, Renal, Reproductive and Sensory Changes
內分泌、腎臟、生殖與感覺變化
心理社會與心理健康議題
Concerns include loss of independence, retirement and income, role change, loss of loved ones, health-care costs, and body image.
常見困擾：失去獨立性、退休與收入減少、角色改變、親友逝去、醫療費用、身體形象。
心理社會與心理健康議題
Depression is common and may present as helplessness and low self-worth; always take suicide threats seriously.
憂鬱常見，可表現為無助感與低自尊；任何自殺言語都須重視。
心理社會與心理健康議題
Grief and isolation are also frequent; effective coping after a death includes social activities and reminiscing, not neglect of grooming.
哀傷與孤立也常見；喪親後有效的因應包括參與社交與回憶，而非忽略儀容。
心理社會與心理健康議題
Differentiate delirium (sudden, fluctuating, worse at night, impaired attention), depression (recent onset, flat affect, 'I don't know'), and dementia (insidious, years, stable).
鑑別譫妄（突發、波動、夜間加重、注意力受損）、憂鬱（近期發作、情感平淡、常答不知道）與失智（隱匿、歷時數年、穩定）。
心理社會與心理健康議題
Promote autonomy by letting the client make choices.
提供選擇讓個案自己決定，以促進自主。
心理社會與心理健康議題
Pain is often musculoskeletal and under-reported because older adults think it is normal aging or fear tests.
疼痛多來自肌肉骨骼退化，且老人常因以為是老化或害怕檢查而少報。
Cues: restlessness, agitation, moaning, crying, verbal report.
線索：躁動不安、激動、呻吟、哭泣、口述疼痛。
Set functional goals; use nonpharmacologic measures (distraction, relaxation, massage, heat/ice, stretching).
設定功能性目標；採用非藥物措施（分散注意、放鬆、按摩、冷熱敷、伸展）。
Avoid opioids when possible; acetaminophen, topical lidocaine and others may be prescribed; evaluate effect.
盡量避免使用鴉片類；可處方乙醯胺酚、利多卡因貼片等；並評估成效。
Altered mental status, especially with a urinary tract infection, is a common sign of infection in the older adult.
意識狀態改變是老人感染（尤其泌尿道感染）的常見徵象。
Nonspecific signs: anorexia, apathy, functional decline, falls, incontinence, tachypnea, hyperglycemia, BP below baseline.
非特異性徵象：厭食、冷漠、功能下降、跌倒、尿失禁、呼吸急促、高血糖、血壓低於基準。
Risks: poor hygiene, poor nutrition or weight loss, inactivity, poor support, low albumin.
風險因子：衛生不佳、營養不良或體重減輕、缺乏活動、社會支持差、低白蛋白。
Problems: adverse effects, interactions, errors, nonadherence, polypharmacy, cost. Doses are often one-third to one-half of adult dose.
問題：副作用、交互作用、用藥錯誤、不遵從、多重用藥、費用。劑量常為成人的三分之一至二分之一。
A sudden mental status change is a common sign of adverse drug reaction.
突然的意識狀態改變是藥物不良反應的常見徵象。

Beers Criteria drugs to avoid: NSAIDs/ketorolac/indomethacin/meperidine, first-generation tricyclics and antihistamines, alpha-1 blockers, oxybutynin/tolterodine, muscle relaxants, benzodiazepines and barbiturates.
Beers 準則應避免：NSAIDs/ketorolac/indomethacin/meperidine、第一代三環抗憂鬱劑與抗組織胺、alpha-1 阻斷劑、oxybutynin/tolterodine、肌肉鬆弛劑、苯二氮平類與巴比妥類。
Aspiration-safe oral meds: sit upright, one pill at a time, stay upright 30 min; do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release tablets; thicken liquids, avoid straws.
預防吸入的口服給藥：坐直、一次一顆、服後維持直立 30 分鐘；腸溶或長效錠不可磨碎；液體增稠、避免用吸管。
Polypharmacy first step: identify duplications; use one pharmacy, pill organizer, up-to-date list, and teach-back.
多重用藥首要步驟：找出重複用藥；固定一家藥局、使用藥盒、隨身攜帶最新藥單、使用回覆示教。
Domestic mistreatment occurs at home (physical, psychological, financial, sexual, neglect, abandonment); institutional mistreatment occurs in facilities.
家庭內虐待發生於家中（身體、心理、財務、性、疏忽、遺棄）；機構內虐待發生於照護機構。
Self-neglect is a competent person's choice; the person may refuse care unless declared incompetent.
自我忽視是有行為能力者的選擇，除非被判無行為能力，否則有權拒絕照護。
Highest risk: dependent, immobile or cognitively impaired clients living with the abuser.
高風險：依賴、行動不便或認知受損且與施虐者同住者。
Nurse actions: thorough injury assessment, private nonjudgmental interview, report to authorities, safety plan and resources.
護理行動：完整傷勢評估、隱私且不批判的會談、通報主管機關、擬定安全計畫並提供資源。
Teach about scams: verify callers and never give bank, card, password or SSN information.
教導防詐騙：查證來電者，絕不透露銀行、信用卡、密碼或社會安全號碼。
Falls risk comes from combined neurologic and musculoskeletal changes; do not rush the client and assess need for a cane or walker.
跌倒風險來自神經與肌肉骨骼變化的合併；不要催促個案並評估是否需拐杖或助行器。
Decreased lean mass and GFR cause drug accumulation, so older clients are at risk for medication toxicity (e.g., digoxin).
瘦體重與 GFR 下降使藥物蓄積，老人易發生藥物毒性（如 digoxin）。
Respiratory rate is usually unchanged with aging; heart rate tends to decrease.
老化時呼吸速率通常不變；心跳速率傾向下降。
Short-term memory may decline but long-term memory is usually preserved; marked loss is not normal.
短期記憶可能下降但長期記憶通常保留。
Sudden confusion in an older adult suggests infection (often UTI) or drug reaction: assess first.
老人突發意識混亂應考慮感染（常為 UTI）或藥物反應，先行評估。
Delirium is sudden, fluctuating and worse at night; dementia is slow and progressive; depression has flat affect.
譫妄突發、波動、夜間惡化；失智緩慢進行；憂鬱情感平淡。
Any suicide threat by an older client must be taken seriously.
老人任何自殺言語都必須嚴肅處理。
High-frequency hearing is lost first; speak in a low pitch, face the client.
高頻聽力先喪失；說話用低音調並面對個案。
Avoid Beers Criteria drugs (benzodiazepines, first-generation antihistamines, meperidine, NSAIDs, etc.).
避免 Beers 準則所列藥物（苯二氮平類、第一代抗組織胺、meperidine、NSAIDs 等）。
Do not crush enteric-coated or sustained-release tablets; keep upright 30 minutes after oral meds if aspiration risk.
腸溶與長效錠不可磨碎；有吸入風險者服藥後維持直立 30 分鐘。
With polypharmacy, first identify duplicate medications, then interactions, then involve the provider.
多重用藥時先找重複用藥，再查交互作用，最後聯絡醫療提供者。
Suspected elder abuse: assess, protect confidentiality, report, safety plan; most at risk are dependent, impaired clients.
疑似老人虐待：評估、保密、通報、安全計畫；最高風險為依賴、功能受損者。
Older adults need flu, pneumococcal and shingles vaccines.
老人應接種流感、肺炎鏈球菌與帶狀疱疹疫苗。
Three D's: Delirium = acute and fluctuating; Depression = affect flat; Dementia = decades slow.
三個 D：譫妄＝急性波動；憂鬱＝情感平淡；失智＝多年緩慢。
Beers drug groups: 'Pain, Mood, Allergy, BP, Bladder, Muscle, Sleep' (analgesics, TCAs, antihistamines, alpha blockers, antimuscarinics, relaxants, sedatives).
Beers 藥物類別記憶：痛、情緒、過敏、血壓、膀胱、肌肉、睡眠。

圖 20.1：40、60、70 歲脊椎變化，顯示骨質疏鬆造成駝背與身高減少最多約 15 公分。
Table 20.1 compares delirium, depression and dementia; Box 20.1 lists nonspecific signs of infection.
表 20.1 比較譫妄、憂鬱與失智；框 20.1 列出感染的非特異性徵象。

框 20.2（應避免的 Beers 藥物）與框 20.3（吸入風險者口服給藥步驟）。
Clinical Judgment box: actions for suspected elder abuse.
臨床判斷框：疑似老人虐待的處置。
Ovaries form and release ova and secrete estrogen and progesterone.
卵巢產生並排出卵子，分泌雌激素與黃體素。
Fallopian tubes carry the ovum to the uterus; the uterus is the pear-shaped organ where the fetus grows and menstruation occurs.
輸卵管將卵子送往子宮；子宮為梨形肌肉器官，胎兒在此生長，月經亦由此而來。
Cervix links uterus and vagina; vagina is the 7.6-10 cm birth canal and menstrual outflow tract.
子宮頸連接子宮與陰道；陰道長約 7.6-10 公分，是產道與經血出口。
Scrotum keeps the testes slightly cooler than body temperature; prostate secretes alkaline fluid that aids sperm and neutralizes vaginal acidity.
陰囊使睪丸溫度略低於體溫；攝護腺分泌鹼性液，助精子活動並中和陰道酸性。
Average cycle about 28 days; FSH and LH from the anterior pituitary drive ovarian and endometrial changes.
平均週期約 28 天；腦下垂體前葉的 FSH 與 LH 驅動卵巢與子宮內膜變化。
Follicular phase: FSH grows follicles; estrogen rises and triggers the LH surge; ovulation occurs around days 12-16.
濾泡期：FSH 促進濾泡生長；雌激素上升引發 LH 高峰；約第 12-16 天排卵。
Luteal phase: corpus luteum secretes estrogen and progesterone for 12-14 days, then degenerates if no pregnancy; body temperature rises 0.5-1 F after ovulation.
黃體期：黃體分泌雌激素與黃體素 12-14 天，若未懷孕即退化；排卵後基礎體溫升高 0.5-1 華氏度。
Uterine phases: menstrual (4-6 days), proliferative (about 9 days, estrogen high), secretory (about 12 days, progesterone prepares endometrium).
子宮週期：月經期（4-6 天）、增生期（約 9 天，雌激素高）、分泌期（約 12 天，黃體素準備內膜）。
True pelvis (inlet, midpelvis, outlet) is below the brim; false pelvis supports abdominal organs.
真骨盆（入口、中骨盆、出口）在骨盆緣下方；假骨盆支撐腹部臟器。
Gynecoid is normal and most favorable for labor; android (heart-shaped) and platypelloid (flat) make vaginal birth difficult; anthropoid is oval with adequate outlet.
女性型為正常骨盆，最利於生產；男性型（心形）與扁平型使陰道生產困難；類人猿型呈橢圓、出口足夠。
Obstetric conjugate is the smallest front-to-back inlet distance the fetal head must pass; the outlet is the smallest plane of the canal.
產科結合徑為胎頭須通過的入口最小前後徑；骨盆出口為產道最小平面。
Cephalopelvic disproportion usually leads to cesarean birth.
頭骨盆不對稱通常需剖腹產。
Fertilization occurs in the ampulla (outer third) of the tube; ovum is viable up to about 72 hours.
受精發生於輸卵管壺腹（外三分之一）；卵子約可存活至 72 小時。
Each gamete carries 23 chromosomes; sperm carry X or Y, so sperm determines sex (XY male, XX female).
每個生殖細胞有 23 條染色體；精子帶 X 或 Y，決定性別（XY 男、XX 女）。
Zygote implants 6-10 days after ovulation; the blastocyst makes hCG to keep the corpus luteum going for the first 2-3 months.
受精卵於排卵後 6-10 天著床；囊胚分泌 hCG 維持黃體約前 2-3 個月。
The tubal isthmus stays contracted about 3 days so the ovum can develop and implant normally in the fundus.
輸卵管峽部約 3 天維持收縮，使受精卵發育並正常著床於子宮底。
Preembryonic: first 2 weeks; embryonic: day 15 to week 8; fetal: week 9 to birth.
前胚胎期：前 2 週；胚胎期：第 15 天至第 8 週；胎兒期：第 9 週至出生。
Week 8: all organ systems present; week 12: kidneys make urine, Doppler heartbeat 10-12 weeks; week 16-20: sex visible on ultrasound, fetoscope heartbeat at 20 weeks.
第 8 週：所有器官系統成形；第 12 週：腎臟開始產尿，10-12 週可用都卜勒聽胎心；16-20 週：超音波可辨性別，20 週可用胎心聽診器。
Week 24: surfactant begins; week 28: lungs can exchange gas; week 36: L/S ratio over 2:1, lungs mature.
第 24 週：開始產生表面張力素；第 28 週：肺可交換氣體；第 36 週：L/S 比值大於 2:1，肺成熟。
Week 40: length about 40 cm, over 3200 g; sole creases cover two-thirds of foot, entire sole after 41 weeks.
第 40 週：身長約 40 公分、體重超過 3200 公克；足底紋路覆蓋三分之二，超過 41 週則滿布足底。
Amnion is the inner membrane, chorion the outer and forms the fetal placenta.
羊膜為內層膜；絨毛膜為外層，形成胎盤的胎兒部分。
Amniotic fluid (800-1200 mL at term) cushions, allows movement, maintains temperature, and reflects fetal kidney function.
羊水（足月 800-1200 mL）緩衝、利於胎動、維持體溫並反映胎兒腎功能。
Placenta exchanges nutrients and wastes, forms by week 12 and takes over hormone production; maternal IgG gives passive immunity.
胎盤進行養分與廢物交換，12 週完成並接手荷爾蒙生產；母體 IgG 提供被動免疫。
Alcohol, drugs, antibiotics, viruses, antibodies and bacteria can cross the placenta.
酒精、藥物、抗生素、病毒、抗體與細菌皆可通過胎盤。
CVS can be done at 10-12 weeks for genetic testing.
絨毛膜取樣（CVS）可於 10-12 週進行基因檢查。
Umbilical cord: two arteries carry deoxygenated blood away from the fetus; one vein carries oxygenated blood to it.
臍帶：兩條動脈將缺氧血帶離胎兒；一條靜脈將含氧血送往胎兒。
Three shunts: ductus venosus (umbilical vein to IVC, bypasses liver), foramen ovale (right to left atrium), ductus arteriosus (pulmonary artery to aorta); the latter two bypass the lungs.
三個分流：靜脈導管（臍靜脈至下腔靜脈，繞過肝）、卵圓孔（右心房至左心房）、動脈導管（肺動脈至主動脈）；後兩者繞過肺。
Normal FHR 110-160 bpm (160-170 in first trimester), about twice the maternal rate.
正常胎心率 110-160 次/分（第一孕期 160-170），約為母親心率兩倍。
Contraceptive choice depends on effectiveness, safety, preference, beliefs, age, intercourse frequency, and ability to adhere; the client's preference matters most.
避孕方式依有效性、安全性、偏好、信念、年齡、性交頻率與遵從能力而定；以個案偏好最重要。
Sterilization is for couples who have completed their families; reversal may fail, so ask about future childbearing plans.
結紮適用已完成生育的夫妻；復通可能失敗，故應詢問未來生育計畫。
Infertility is inability to conceive when desired; causes in men (sperm, erection, seminal fluid) and women (ovulation, tubes, cervix, scarring).
不孕為想懷孕卻無法受孕；男性（精子、勃起、精液）與女性（排卵、輸卵管、子宮頸、沾黏）皆可能。
Options: medications, surgery, artificial insemination, IVF, surrogate, adoption; support the couple's decision-making.
選項：藥物、手術、人工授精、試管嬰兒、代理孕母、領養；支持夫妻決策。
Normal FHR is 110-160 bpm; 174 at 38 weeks is abnormal, notify the provider.
正常胎心率 110-160 次/分；38 週時 174 為異常，應通報醫師。
臍帶：2 動脈（缺氧血）、1 靜脈（含氧血）。
Ductus venosus: umbilical vein to IVC; foramen ovale: right to left atria; ductus arteriosus: pulmonary artery to aorta.
靜脈導管：臍靜脈到下腔靜脈；卵圓孔：右到左心房；動脈導管：肺動脈到主動脈。
Gynecoid pelvis is most favorable for vaginal birth.
女性型骨盆最利於陰道生產。
Fertilization occurs in the outer third of the fallopian tube; implantation 6-10 days after ovulation.
受精於輸卵管外三分之一；排卵後 6-10 天著床。
hCG from the blastocyst maintains the corpus luteum until the placenta takes over by week 12.
囊胚的 hCG 維持黃體直到 12 週胎盤接手。
Lung maturity: L/S ratio 2:1 or greater at 36 weeks; surfactant begins at 24 weeks.
肺成熟：36 週 L/S 比值 2:1 以上；24 週開始產生表面張力素。
Substances including alcohol, drugs and viruses cross the placenta; counsel pregnant adolescents on avoiding alcohol.
酒精、藥物、病毒可通過胎盤；須輔導懷孕青少年避免飲酒。
Sperm determines fetal sex; sex visible on ultrasound at 16-20 weeks.
精子決定胎兒性別；16-20 週超音波可見。
Sterilization counseling: ask whether the couple wants more children.
結紮諮詢：詢問是否還想生育。
Amniotic fluid reflects fetal kidney function; abnormal volume prompts further evaluation.
For sexual concerns use open-ended questions first to build trust.
談性問題時先用開放式問句建立信任。
Fetal shunts: 'Venosus = Vein to Vena cava'; 'Ovale = Over (between atria)'; 'Arteriosus = Artery to Aorta'.
胎兒分流：靜脈導管＝臍靜脈到下腔靜脈；卵圓孔＝心房之間；動脈導管＝肺動脈到主動脈。
Cord: 'AVA' = 2 Arteries, 1 Vein; arteries away carry blood low in oxygen.
臍帶：2 動脈 1 靜脈；動脈帶離胎兒、缺氧。
Which statements about fetal circulation are correct? Select all that apply.
關於胎兒循環，何者正確？（複選）
At 38 weeks' gestation the FHR is 174 bpm. What is the priority action?
懷孕 38 週，胎心率 174 次/分。優先處置為何？
Which are functions of amniotic fluid? Select all that apply.
羊水的功能有哪些？（複選）
Which pelvis type is most favorable for vaginal birth?
哪一種骨盆最利於陰道生產？
A couple asks about sterilization. Which question best determines suitability?
一對夫妻詢問結紮，哪個問題最能判斷是否適合？
Box 21.1: menstrual cycle ovarian and uterine phases and hormones.
框 21.1：月經週期的卵巢與子宮各期與荷爾蒙。
框 21.2：逐週胎兒發育里程碑。

圖 21.1：胎兒循環與三個分流。
Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)
妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）
Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)
妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）
Naegele's rule (regular 28-day cycle): first day of LMP minus 3 months plus 7 days (plus 1 year if needed). LMP Oct 19, 2023 gives July 26, 2024.
Naegele 法則（月經週期規則 28 天）：末次月經第一天減 3 個月加 7 天（必要時加 1 年）。LMP 2023/10/19 → 2024/7/26。
Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)
妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）
Gravidity counts all pregnancies including the current one; parity counts births after 20 weeks, not fetuses.
Gravidity 為包含本次的懷孕次數；parity 為 20 週後的生產次數，不論胎數。
Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)
妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）
GTPAL: Gravida, Term (over 37 wk), Preterm, Abortions (before 20 wk), Living children. Twins count once for G, T or P but twice for L.
GTPAL：懷孕次數、足月產（超過 37 週）、早產、流產（20 週前）、現存子女數。雙胞胎在 G、T、P 算 1，在 L 算 2。
Gestation, Naegele's Rule, Gravidity and Parity (GTPAL)
妊娠、Naegele 法則、懷孕與生產史（GTPAL）
Presumptive: amenorrhea, nausea/vomiting, breast changes, urinary frequency, quickening (16-20 wk), fatigue, linea nigra, melasma.
推定徵象：停經、噁心嘔吐、乳房變化、頻尿、胎動感（16-20 週）、疲倦、黑線、黃褐斑。
Probable: uterine enlargement, Hegar's, Goodell's and Chadwick's signs, ballottement, Braxton Hicks contractions, positive hCG test.
可能徵象：子宮變大、Hegar、Goodell、Chadwick 徵象、浮球感、Braxton Hicks 收縮、hCG 陽性。
Positive (diagnostic): FHR by Doppler at 10-12 wk or fetoscope at 20 wk, palpable active fetal movement, fetal outline on ultrasound or radiograph.
確定徵象：10-12 週都卜勒或 20 週胎心聽診器聽到胎心、檢查者觸及胎動、超音波或 X 光見胎兒輪廓。
子宮底高度與生理變化

Weeks 18-30: fundal height in cm approximately equals weeks of gestation, plus or minus 2 cm. 16 wk halfway between symphysis and umbilicus; 20-22 wk at umbilicus; 36 wk at xiphoid. Have client void first.
18-30 週：子宮底高度（公分）約等於週數 ±2。16 週在恥骨聯合與肚臍中間；20-22 週在肚臍；36 週在劍突。測量前先排尿。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Cardiovascular: blood volume up 40-50%, physiological anemia, higher iron need, pulse up 10-15 bpm, BP dips in second trimester.
心血管：血容積增加 40-50%、生理性貧血、鐵需求增加、脈搏增加 10-15 次/分、第二孕期血壓略降。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Respiratory: oxygen consumption up 15-20%, diaphragm elevated, dyspnea possible.
呼吸：耗氧量增加 15-20%、橫膈上升、可能呼吸困難。
子宮底高度與生理變化
GI: nausea from hCG, constipation, heartburn from progesterone slowing motility, hemorrhoids, gum swelling and ptyalism from estrogen.
消化：hCG 造成噁心；黃體素使蠕動變慢造成便秘、火燒心；痔瘡；雌激素造成牙齦腫脹與流涎。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Renal: urinary frequency in 1st and 3rd trimesters; reduced renal glucose threshold so glycosuria may appear.
腎臟：第一與第三孕期頻尿；腎糖閾下降故可能出現糖尿。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Endocrine: higher BMR, prolactin and oxytocin, more insulin production. Uterus grows from about 60 g to 1000 g.
內分泌：基礎代謝率上升、泌乳素與催產素、胰島素分泌增加。子宮由約 60 公克增至 1000 公克。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Cervix softens (Chadwick sign, violet) and forms a mucous plug; breasts enlarge, colostrum may leak; skin shows linea nigra, chloasma, striae.
子宮頸變軟（Chadwick 徵象、紫藍色）並形成黏液栓；乳房變大、可能漏初乳；皮膚出現黑線、黃褐斑、妊娠紋。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Musculoskeletal: relaxin and progesterone loosen joints, lordosis, waddling gait, fall risk; eyes may have corneal edema.
肌肉骨骼：relaxin 與黃體素使關節鬆弛、腰椎前凸、鴨步、易跌倒；眼睛可能角膜水腫。
子宮底高度與生理變化
Early ambivalence is normal even in planned pregnancy; partner may be ambivalent too.
即使是計畫中的懷孕，早期矛盾感也屬正常；伴侶亦可能如此。
Tasks: accept pregnancy, identify with parent role, solidify partner relationship, bond with the fetus, prepare for birth.
任務：接受懷孕、認同父母角色、鞏固伴侶關係、與胎兒建立連結、為生產做準備。
Emotional lability and body image changes are common; bonding progresses from accepting pregnancy, to accepting the fetus as separate, to preparing for birth.
情緒不穩與身體形象改變很常見；連結歷程為接受懷孕、接受胎兒為獨立個體、實際準備生產。
Nausea: dry crackers before rising, small frequent low-fat meals, fluids between meals, avoid fried/spicy food, protein bedtime snack.
噁心：起床前吃蘇打餅乾、少量多餐低脂、兩餐間喝水、避免油炸辛辣、睡前吃蛋白質點心。
Supine hypotension: avoid lying flat in 2nd/3rd trimester (uterus compresses inferior vena cava); side-lying, change positions slowly.
仰臥低血壓：第二、三孕期避免平躺（子宮壓迫下腔靜脈）；採側臥並緩慢變換姿勢。
Urinary frequency: at least 2000 mL fluid by day, limit evening fluids and diuretic foods, Kegels.
頻尿：白天至少飲水 2000 mL，傍晚減少並避免利尿食物，做凱格爾運動。
Heartburn: small meals, upright 30 min after eating, avoid fatty/spicy food; ask provider about antacids.
火燒心：少量多餐、飯後坐直 30 分鐘、避免油膩辛辣；詢問醫師可否用制酸劑。
Ankle edema and varicose veins: elevate legs, side-lying, support hose, avoid prolonged standing or crossing legs.
腳踝水腫與靜脈曲張：抬高腿、側臥、穿彈性襪、避免久站久坐或蹺腳。
Constipation and hemorrhoids: high fiber, 2000 mL fluids, walking, sitz bath; consult provider for stool softeners.
便秘與痔瘡：高纖、2000 mL 水分、散步、溫水坐浴；用軟便劑前諮詢醫師。
Backache: pelvic tilt, good posture, squat to lift, low-heeled shoes. Leg cramps: dorsiflex the foot, increase calcium, walk.
背痛：骨盆傾斜運動、良好姿勢、蹲下拿物、穿低跟鞋。腿抽筋：足背屈、增加鈣質、散步。
Increased thin vaginal discharge (leukorrhea) is normal; use cotton underwear, no douching or tampons. Nasal stuffiness: humidifier, avoid decongestant sprays unless approved.
陰道分泌物增加（白帶）正常；穿棉質內褲，不灌洗、不用衛生棉條。鼻塞：用加濕器，未經許可避免鼻噴劑。
Headaches are usually benign in first trimester but need evaluation later; acetaminophen only if prescribed.
頭痛在第一孕期多屬良性，後期需進一步評估；僅在處方下使用乙醯胺酚。
Age under 20 or over 35 raises perinatal risk; adolescent risks include poor nutrition, hypertension, anemia, CPD, preterm and low-birth-weight infants, and lack of support.
年齡小於 20 或大於 35 歲增加風險；青少年懷孕風險包括營養不良、高血壓、貧血、頭骨盆不對稱、早產與低出生體重、缺乏支持。
Folic acid for all people of childbearing age prevents neural tube defects and orofacial clefts.
所有育齡者應補充葉酸，預防神經管缺陷與唇顎裂。
Rubella in the first 8 weeks has highest fetal infection and anomaly rate.
前 8 週感染德國麻疹胎兒感染與畸形率最高。
Abuse raises risk of abruptio placentae and preterm birth; interview the client alone and examine breasts, abdomen, genitals.
暴力增加胎盤早期剝離與早產風險；應單獨訪談個案，並檢查乳房、腹部與生殖器。
HIV: perinatal zidovudine lowers transmission. Substance use: growth restriction, abruptio, fetal bradycardia; smoking causes low birth weight and stillbirth; alcohol causes fetal alcohol syndrome.
HIV：周產期給予 zidovudine 可降低傳染。物質濫用：胎兒生長受限、胎盤早剝、胎心過慢；吸菸造成低出生體重與死產；酒精造成胎兒酒精症候群。
Visit schedule: every 4 weeks to 28-32 wk, every 2 weeks 32-36 wk, weekly 36-40 wk.
產檢頻率：28-32 週前每 4 週、32-36 週每 2 週、36-40 週每週。
Rh-negative with negative antibody screen: RhoGAM at 28 weeks and within 72 hr after birth of an Rh-positive infant; also after miscarriage/termination and CVS.
Rh 陰性且抗體篩檢陰性：28 週給 RhoGAM，Rh 陽性新生兒出生後 72 小時內再給；流產、人工流產及 CVS 後亦給。
Rubella titer under 1:8: give live vaccine subcutaneously postpartum; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months and contact with immunocompromised people; ask about egg allergy; never give during pregnancy.
德國麻疹抗體價低於 1:8：產後皮下注射活性疫苗；1-3 個月內避免懷孕並避免接觸免疫低下者；詢問蛋過敏；孕期不可施打。
Anemia in pregnancy: Hgb under 10 g/dL or Hct under 30%. WBC mildly elevated is normal.
孕期貧血：Hgb 低於 10 g/dL 或 Hct 低於 30%。白血球輕度上升屬正常。
GCT at 24-28 weeks: 50 g glucose, 1-hour level over 140 mg/dL is positive and needs the 3-hour test.
GCT 於 24-28 週：口服 50 g 葡萄糖，1 小時血糖超過 140 mg/dL 為陽性，需做 3 小時試驗。
Urine at each visit for glucose and protein; 2+ to 4+ protein suggests infection or preeclampsia.
每次產檢驗尿糖與尿蛋白；蛋白 2+ 至 4+ 提示感染或子癇前症。
Hepatitis B antigen testing for all; hepatitis B vaccine is not contraindicated in pregnancy. TB: positive skin test needs chest X-ray with shield only after 20 weeks.
所有孕婦篩檢 B 肝表面抗原；B 肝疫苗孕期不禁忌。結核菌素陽性者需於 20 週後以鉛屏護腹拍胸部 X 光。
GBS vaginal/rectal swab at about 36 weeks (20-25% colonized).
約 36 週採陰道/直腸 GBS 培養（20-25% 帶菌）。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Ultrasound: no known risk; abdominal scan needs a full bladder; transvaginal in first trimester checks cervix length.
超音波：無已知風險；腹部超音波需憋尿；第一孕期經陰道超音波可測子宮頸長度。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Biophysical profile: breathing, movement, tone, amniotic fluid index, NST. Doppler studies placental and fetal blood flow.
生物物理評估：呼吸、動作、張力、羊水指數、NST。都卜勒評估胎盤與胎兒血流。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Quad screen (AFP at 16-18 wk) screens for Down syndrome and neural tube defects; cell-free DNA blood test from 7 weeks screens trisomy 21, 18, 13.
四指標篩檢（16-18 週 AFP）篩檢唐氏症與神經管缺陷；7 週起可做游離 DNA 抽血篩檢 21、18、13 三染色體。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
CVS at 10-13 wk (genetic diagnosis, give RhoGAM if Rh-negative, rest 24 hr). Amniocentesis at 15-20 wk (full bladder before 20 wk, empty after; consent; FHR monitoring; left side after).
CVS 於 10-13 週（基因診斷，Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM，休息 24 小時）。羊膜穿刺於 15-20 週（20 週前憋尿、之後排空；需同意書；監測胎心；術後左側臥）。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
After CVS or amniocentesis report fever over 100.4 F (38 C), chills, bleeding, fluid leak, decreased fetal movement, contractions or cramping.
CVS 或羊膜穿刺後，若發燒超過 38 度（100.4 F）、寒顫、出血、漏液、胎動減少、宮縮或痙攣應通報。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Kick counts from 28 weeks: sitting or side-lying, at least 10 movements in 2 hours.
28 週起數胎動：坐或側臥，2 小時至少 10 次。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Ruptured membranes: fern test shows ferning; nitrazine paper turns blue (pH 7.0-7.5) versus vaginal pH 4.5-5.5. Fetal fibronectin at 22-34 wk predicts preterm labor (negative is reassuring).
胎膜破裂：羊齒葉試驗呈羊齒狀；硝氮試紙變藍（pH 7.0-7.5，陰道 pH 4.5-5.5）。22-34 週胎兒纖維連接蛋白預測早產（陰性較安心）。
產前胎兒評估與侵入性檢查
Reactive NST (normal): 2 or more accelerations of at least 15 bpm lasting at least 15 sec within 20 min with movement. Nonreactive: none in 40 min.
反應型 NST（正常）：20 分鐘內有 2 次以上、至少上升 15 bpm 且持續 15 秒以上的加速。無反應型：40 分鐘內無。
Position side-lying for NST/CST to avoid vena cava compression.
NST/CST 採側臥避免壓迫下腔靜脈。
CST: negative (normal) = no late decelerations; positive (abnormal) = late decelerations with 50% or more of contractions; 3 contractions of 40 sec in 10 min required.
CST：陰性（正常）＝無晚期減速；陽性（異常）＝50% 以上宮縮出現晚期減速；需 10 分鐘內 3 次、每次 40 秒以上宮縮。
Weight gain 25-35 lb (11-16 kg) for normal prepregnancy weight; +300 kcal/day in pregnancy, +500 during lactation; fluids 8-10 glasses; sodium not restricted.
體重增加：孕前體重正常者 11-16 公斤（25-35 磅）；孕期每日加 300 大卡、哺乳加 500 大卡；水分 8-10 杯；不限鈉。
Vegetarian risks: B12, iron, zinc, calcium, vitamin D, omega-3; pair iron with vitamin C. Lactose intolerance: nondairy calcium, lactase.
素食風險：B12、鐵、鋅、鈣、維生素 D、omega-3；鐵搭配維生素 C。乳糖不耐：非乳製鈣來源、乳糖酶。
Pica (eating dirt, clay, starch) can cause iron-deficiency anemia.
異食癖（吃泥土、黏土、澱粉）可造成缺鐵性貧血。
Naegele's rule: LMP minus 3 months plus 7 days (plus 1 year).
Naegele 法則：末次月經減 3 個月加 7 天（再加 1 年）。
GTPAL: abortions before 20 wk count in gravida but not parity; twins count as one birth but two living children.
GTPAL：20 週前流產算入 G 不算 P；雙胞胎算一次生產、兩個現存子女。
Fundal height (cm) equals weeks plus or minus 2 between 18-30 weeks; 36 weeks at xiphoid.
18-30 週子宮底高度（公分）≈週數 ±2；36 週在劍突。
Positive (diagnostic) signs: fetal heart tones, fetal movement felt by examiner, ultrasound outline. Others are presumptive or probable.
確定徵象：胎心音、檢查者觸及胎動、超音波輪廓；其餘為推定或可能徵象。
Avoid supine position after 20 weeks (supine hypotension from IVC compression).
20 週後避免仰臥（壓迫下腔靜脈造成仰臥低血壓）。
RhoGAM at 28 weeks and within 72 hours of delivery of an Rh-positive baby for Rh-negative clients.
Rh 陰性者 28 週與生下 Rh 陽性寶寶後 72 小時內施打 RhoGAM。
Rubella vaccine is live: never in pregnancy; postpartum, avoid pregnancy 1-3 months; compatible with breastfeeding.
德國麻疹疫苗為活性疫苗：孕期禁用；產後 1-3 個月避免懷孕；可哺乳。
Folic acid supplementation prevents neural tube defects.
補充葉酸預防神經管缺陷。
Hgb under 10 g/dL or Hct under 30% means anemia in pregnancy.
Hgb 低於 10 或 Hct 低於 30% 為孕期貧血。
GCT 24-28 weeks; 1-hr glucose over 140 mg/dL is positive.
GCT 於 24-28 週；1 小時血糖超過 140 mg/dL 為陽性。
Reactive NST is normal; negative CST is normal; positive CST (late decelerations) is abnormal.
NST 反應型為正常；CST 陰性為正常；CST 陽性（晚期減速）為異常。
Amniocentesis: consent, report fever, bleeding, leaking, reduced movement; Rh-negative needs RhoGAM.
羊膜穿刺：需同意書，通報發燒、出血、漏液、胎動減少；Rh 陰性需 RhoGAM。
Nitrazine turns blue (pH 7.0-7.5) for amniotic fluid; ferning confirms.
羊水使硝氮試紙變藍（pH 7.0-7.5）；羊齒狀結晶可確認。
Kick counts: 10 movements in 2 hours, sit or side-lying, not flat on back.
數胎動：2 小時 10 次，坐或側臥，不可平躺。
Braxton Hicks (irregular, painless) and leukorrhea are normal; no need for emergency visit.
Braxton Hicks（不規則無痛）與白帶屬正常，無需急診。
Screen for abuse privately; ask partner to leave the room.
私下篩檢家暴；請伴侶離開房間。
GTPAL: Gravida, Term, Preterm, Abortion, Living.
GTPAL：懷孕、足月、早產、流產、存活。
Pregnancy signs: Presumptive = what she feels; Probable = what the examiner finds; Positive = the fetus itself.
懷孕徵象：推定＝孕婦自覺；可能＝檢查者發現；確定＝胎兒本身。
A client's last menstrual period began October 19, 2023 (regular 28-day cycle). Using Naegele's rule, what is the EDD?
個案末次月經始於 2023 年 10 月 19 日（週期 28 天規則）。依 Naegele 法則預產期為何？
A client is pregnant with twins, has one healthy 5-year-old born at 38 weeks, and no abortions. What is the GTPAL?
個案懷雙胞胎，有一名 38 週出生的 5 歲健康孩子，無流產。GTPAL 為何？
Which are PROBABLE signs of pregnancy? Select all that apply.
下列何者為懷孕的「可能徵象」？（複選）
A client at 28 weeks has a fundal height of 30 cm. How should the nurse interpret this?
28 週個案子宮底高度 30 公分，護理師應如何解讀？
A postpartum client is rubella non-immune (titer under 1:8) and will receive the vaccine. Which teaching is appropriate? Select all that apply.
產後個案德國麻疹無免疫（抗體價低於 1:8）將接種疫苗。哪些衛教適當？（複選）
Which statement by a client learning kick counts indicates a need for more teaching?
學習數胎動的個案哪一句話顯示需再衛教？
A nonstress test is nonreactive. A contraction stress test follows and is negative. How is this documented?
NST 為無反應型，接著做 CST 結果為陰性。如何記錄？
A first-trimester client reports thin, colorless vaginal drainage without odor or itching. What is the best response?
第一孕期個案表示有稀薄無色陰道分泌物，無異味無搔癢。最佳回應為何？
An Rh-negative client with a negative antibody screen is at 28 weeks. What should the nurse anticipate?
Rh 陰性、抗體篩檢陰性的個案目前 28 週。護理師預期什麼？
Box 22.1 Naegele's rule worked example, Box 22.2 GTPAL example and Box 22.3 fundal height technique.
框 22.1 Naegele 法則範例、框 22.2 GTPAL 範例、框 22.3 子宮底測量法。
Figs. 22.1 and 22.2: fundal height by week and heart/lung position shifts in pregnancy.
圖 22.1、22.2：各週子宮底高度與孕期心肺位置變化。
Box 22.4 Nonstress test: reactive vs nonreactive criteria.
框 22.4 無壓力試驗：反應型與無反應型標準。
Box 22.5 Contraction stress test: negative, positive, equivocal.
框 22.5 宮縮壓力試驗：陰性、陽性、可疑。
Implantation bleeding occurs 10-14 days after conception, is light, lasts 1-2 days, and needs no treatment.
著床出血發生於受孕後 10-14 天，量少、持續 1-2 天，無需治療。

Abortion is loss before 20 weeks. Types: threatened (bleeding and cramping, cervix closed), inevitable (cervix dilating), incomplete (some tissue retained), complete, missed (fetal death retained), habitual (3 or more).
流產為 20 週前終止妊娠。類型：先兆流產（出血痙攣、子宮頸未開）、不可避免流產（子宮頸開始擴張）、不完全流產（部分組織殘留）、完全流產、過期流產（胎死留於子宮）、習慣性流產（連續 3 次以上）。
Care: monitor vital signs, count and weigh pads (1 g = 1 mL), save tissue, IV fluids, D&C for incomplete abortion, RhoGAM if Rh-negative, emotional support.
照護：監測生命徵象、計算並秤重護墊（1 g＝1 mL）、保留排出組織、靜脈輸液、不完全流產做刮除術、Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM、情緒支持。
Ectopic pregnancy: usually ampulla of tube; missed period, abdominal pain, dark red/brown spotting; rupture brings severe pain, shoulder pain and shock.
子宮外孕：多在輸卵管壺腹；停經、腹痛、暗紅或棕色出血；破裂時劇痛、肩痛與休克。
Ectopic management: methotrexate (folic acid antagonist) for early cases, or laparotomy/tube removal or repair; RhoGAM if Rh-negative.
子宮外孕處置：早期用 methotrexate（葉酸拮抗劑），或剖腹手術切除/修補輸卵管；Rh 陰性給 RhoGAM。
Incompetent cervix: painless dilation at 4th-5th month, treated with cerclage at 10-14 weeks; remove at 37 weeks.
子宮頸閉鎖不全：第 4-5 個月無痛性擴張，10-14 週行子宮頸環紮，37 週拆除。

Mole: abnormal trophoblast, grape-like cluster; no fetal heart tones, hyperemesis, bleeding, early preeclampsia signs before 20 weeks, uterus larger than dates, hCG over 100,000 mIU/mL, snowstorm ultrasound.
葡萄胎：滋養層異常、葡萄串狀；無胎心、嚴重孕吐、出血、20 週前出現子癇前症徵象、子宮大於週數、hCG 超過 100,000 mIU/mL、超音波呈暴風雪樣。
Treat with suction evacuation; follow hCG every 1-2 weeks until normal, then monthly for 1 year; avoid pregnancy during follow-up (risk of choriocarcinoma).
以抽吸術清除；每 1-2 週追蹤 hCG 至正常，之後每 1-2 個月追蹤一年；追蹤期避孕（可能轉為絨毛膜癌）。

Hyperemesis: intractable vomiting in first trimester with weight loss, dehydration, electrolyte imbalance and ketonuria; give IV fluids, antiemetics, small low-fat carbohydrate meals, fluids between meals.
妊娠劇吐：第一孕期持續嘔吐，伴體重減輕、脫水、電解質失衡與酮尿；給靜脈輸液、止吐藥、低脂碳水少量餐、兩餐間喝水。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Blood volume peaks at 32-34 weeks; watch for cardiac decompensation: cough, dyspnea, fatigue, palpitations, edema, chest pain. Limit activity, low-sodium diet, avoid excess weight gain.
血容積於 32-34 週達高峰；注意心臟代償不全：咳嗽、呼吸困難、疲倦、心悸、水腫、胸痛。限制活動、低鈉飲食、避免體重過度增加。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Cardiac labor care: side-lying with head and shoulders raised, oxygen, early pain control, controlled pushing, cardiac and fetal monitoring.
心臟病產婦產程：側臥並抬高頭肩、給氧、早期止痛、控制用力、心臟與胎兒監測。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Chorioamnionitis: infection of amniotic cavity after prolonged rupture; uterine tenderness, fever, maternal/fetal tachycardia, foul fluid, leukocytosis; give antibiotics after cultures.
絨毛膜羊膜炎：破水過久後羊膜腔感染；子宮壓痛、發燒、母胎心搏過速、羊水惡臭、白血球增加；培養後給抗生素。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Diabetes: glucose crosses the placenta, insulin does not; insulin needs fall in first trimester, rise in 2nd/3rd, and drop sharply after placenta delivery.
糖尿病：葡萄糖可通過胎盤，胰島素不行；第一孕期胰島素需求下降，二、三孕期上升，胎盤娩出後驟降。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Infant of diabetic mother: macrosomia, hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, RDS, hypocalcemia, anomalies.
糖尿病母親的新生兒：巨嬰、低血糖、高膽紅素、呼吸窘迫、低血鈣、先天異常。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
GDM: screen 24-28 weeks (1-hr GCT 140 or more, then 3-hr OGTT); diet, exercise, glucose checks 4x daily; targets fasting under 95, 1-hr under 130-140, 2-hr under 120 mg/dL.
妊娠糖尿病：24-28 週篩檢（1 小時 GCT ≥140 再做 3 小時 OGTT）；飲食、運動、每日 4 次血糖監測；目標空腹小於 95、餐後 1 小時小於 130-140、2 小時小於 120 mg/dL。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
Labor: continuous fetal monitoring, regulate insulin and IV glucose. Postpartum: watch for hypoglycemia as insulin need falls.
產程：持續胎心監測，調整胰島素與靜脈葡萄糖。產後：胰島素需求下降，注意低血糖。
心臟病、絨毛膜羊膜炎與糖尿病
DIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎

DIC: clotting cascade activated, consuming platelets and factors; bleeding, petechiae, purpura, shock; low fibrinogen/platelets, high PT/PTT and fibrin degradation products; keep urine at least 30 mL/hr.
DIC：凝血串聯被活化，耗盡血小板與凝血因子；出血、瘀點、紫斑、休克；纖維蛋白原與血小板降低、PT/PTT 與纖維蛋白降解物升高；尿量至少 30 mL/hr。
DIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎
Predisposing: abruptio placentae, amniotic fluid embolism, gestational hypertension, HELLP, fetal demise, sepsis, severe hemorrhage.
誘發因素：胎盤早剝、羊水栓塞、妊娠高血壓、HELLP、胎死腹中、敗血症、嚴重出血。
DIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎
Vulvar hematoma: severe perineal pain, pressure, swelling, inability to void, falling Hgb/Hct; apply ice, analgesics, catheterize if needed, antibiotics.
外陰血腫：劇烈會陰疼痛、壓迫感、腫脹、無法排尿、Hgb/Hct 下降；冰敷、止痛、必要時導尿、抗生素。
DIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎
Hepatitis B: after birth wash blood off the newborn first, then give HBIG and hepatitis B vaccine (doses at birth, 1 and 6 months); breastfeeding allowed after newborn treated.
B 肝：新生兒出生後先清除血液，再給 HBIG 與 B 肝疫苗（出生、1 個月、6 個月）；治療後可哺乳。
DIC、血腫與 B 型肝炎

HAART (3 drugs) lowers viral load; zidovudine orally after 12 weeks, IV in labor (1 hr before vaginal birth, 3 hr before cesarean if RNA 400 or more or unknown), and syrup to newborn at 2 hr then q12h for 6 weeks.
HAART（三合一）降低病毒量；12 週後口服 zidovudine，產程靜脈注射（陰道生產前 1 小時、剖腹前 3 小時，若 RNA ≥400 或不明），新生兒出生 2 小時後起每 12 小時口服糖漿共 6 週。
Vaginal birth acceptable if viral load under 1000 copies/mL; otherwise cesarean.
病毒量小於 1000 copies/mL 可陰道生產；否則剖腹。
Single reactive ELISA is not diagnostic; confirm with Western blot or IFA.
單次 ELISA 反應不能確診；需 Western blot 或 IFA 確認。
Avoid amniocentesis, scalp electrodes, episiotomy, oxytocin; remove newborn blood promptly; breastfeeding generally restricted.
避免羊膜穿刺、胎兒頭皮電極、會陰切開、催產素；盡快清除新生兒身上血液；通常限制哺乳。
Categories: chronic hypertension (before 20 wk), gestational hypertension (after 20 wk), preeclampsia, chronic hypertension with superimposed preeclampsia; eclampsia means seizures.
分類：慢性高血壓（20 週前）、妊娠高血壓（20 週後）、子癇前症、慢性高血壓合併子癇前症；子癇指抽搐。

Preeclampsia BP 140/90 or higher twice 4 hr apart after 20 weeks; severe features: 160/110 or higher, platelets under 100,000, doubled liver enzymes, creatinine over 1.0, pulmonary edema, headache, visual changes, RUQ pain, oliguria under 500 mL/day.
子癇前症：20 週後相隔 4 小時兩次血壓 ≥140/90；嚴重特徵：≥160/110、血小板小於 100,000、肝酵素加倍、肌酐酸大於 1.0、肺水腫、頭痛、視覺障礙、右上腹痛、尿量小於 500 mL/天。
Proteinuria is no longer a reliable diagnostic criterion. HELLP: hemolysis, elevated liver enzymes, low platelets; an emergency.
蛋白尿不再是可靠診斷標準。HELLP：溶血、肝酵素升高、血小板低下；屬急症。
Care: side-lying rest, BP and weight monitoring, kick counts, urine output at least 30 mL/hr, check reflexes and clonus, lower BP gradually, corticosteroids for fetal lungs, delivery planning.
照護：側臥休息、監測血壓與體重、數胎動、尿量至少 30 mL/hr、檢查反射與陣攣、血壓緩慢下降、給予類固醇促進胎肺成熟、準備分娩。

Magnesium sulfate via controlled pump to prevent seizures (continue 24-48 hr postpartum). Toxicity: flushing, sweating, hypotension, absent reflexes, low urine output, respiratory depression; antidote calcium gluconate.
硫酸鎂以控制輸液幫浦給予預防抽搐（產後持續 24-48 小時）。中毒徵象：潮紅、出汗、低血壓、反射消失、尿量減少、呼吸抑制；解毒劑為葡萄糖酸鈣。
Eclampsia seizure: stay, call for help, side-lying, airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min, monitor FHR, give seizure medication, suction after.
子癇抽搐：留在床邊並求援、側臥、維持呼吸道、給氧 8-10 L/min、監測胎心、給予抗痙攣藥、抽搐後抽吸。
Toxoplasmosis: raw meat and cat litter; teach avoidance. Rubella: teratogenic in first trimester (eyes, heart, ears, brain); vaccinate postpartum if titer under 1:8.
弓形蟲：生肉與貓砂；教導避免。德國麻疹：第一孕期致畸（眼、心、耳、腦）；抗體價小於 1:8 者產後接種。

CMV: low birth weight, hepatosplenomegaly, jaundice, hearing loss, seizures; contact precautions. HSV: no vaginal exams with active lesions; cesarean if vaginal lesions; acyclovir/valacyclovir suppression late pregnancy.
CMV：低出生體重、肝脾腫大、黃疸、聽力喪失、抽搐；接觸隔離。HSV：有活動性病灶不做陰道檢查；陰道有病灶時剖腹；孕晚期用 acyclovir/valacyclovir 抑制。
GBS: vaginal/rectal culture at 35-37 weeks; IV antibiotics in labor to prevent early-onset newborn sepsis.
GBS：35-37 週陰道/直腸培養；產程給靜脈抗生素預防新生兒早發型敗血症。
COVID-19: pregnant people have higher risk of severe illness and preterm birth. Zika: microcephaly risk; supportive care, avoid aspirin/NSAIDs.
COVID-19：孕婦重症與早產風險較高。Zika：小頭症風險；支持性療法，避免阿斯匹靈與 NSAIDs。

Multiples: large-for-dates uterus, more than one FHR, excessive weight gain; risks include anemia, preterm labor, IUGR, hypertension, polyhydramnios, postpartum hemorrhage; give oxytocics after birth.
多胞胎：子宮大於週數、聽到多個胎心、體重增加過多；風險包括貧血、早產、胎兒生長受限、高血壓、羊水過多、產後出血；產後給子宮收縮劑。
Placenta accreta, increta, percreta: abnormal adherence; hemorrhage after birth, possible hysterectomy.
植入性胎盤（accreta、increta、percreta）：胎盤異常附著；產後出血，可能需子宮切除。
Previa: painless bright red bleeding, soft relaxed nontender uterus; NO vaginal exams; types total, partial, marginal; total needs cesarean.
前置胎盤：無痛性鮮紅色出血、子宮柔軟放鬆無壓痛；禁做陰道檢查；分完全、部分、邊緣型；完全型需剖腹。
Abruptio: dark red bleeding (may be concealed), painful rigid tender uterus, fetal distress, shock, DIC risk; rapid delivery.
胎盤早期剝離：暗紅色出血（可為隱性）、子宮疼痛僵硬壓痛、胎兒窘迫、休克、DIC 風險；儘速分娩。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
Chlamydia: often asymptomatic, neonatal conjunctivitis/pneumonia; gonorrhea: ophthalmia neonatorum; treat partner; rescreen near term.
披衣菌：常無症狀，新生兒結膜炎/肺炎；淋病：新生兒眼炎；伴侶需治療；近足月再篩檢。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
Syphilis: VDRL/RPR at first visit and again at 36 weeks; crosses placenta after month 4; test for HIV too.
梅毒：首次產檢與 36 週做 VDRL/RPR；4 個月後通過胎盤；亦需驗 HIV。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
HPV warts: treatment usually delayed until after birth; cesarean only if obstructing. Trichomoniasis and bacterial vaginosis: metronidazole. Candidiasis: topical antifungal; avoid oral fluconazole.
HPV 生殖器疣：通常延至產後治療；僅阻塞產道才剖腹。滴蟲與細菌性陰道炎：metronidazole。念珠菌：局部抗黴菌劑；避免口服 fluconazole。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
TB: chest X-ray only after 20 weeks with shield; isoniazid, pyrazinamide, rifampin (add ethambutol if resistance) with pyridoxine; breastfeed only if noninfectious.
結核：20 週後才拍胸部 X 光並護腹；isoniazid、pyrazinamide、rifampin（可能抗藥加 ethambutol）並併用維生素 B6；僅無傳染性時可哺乳。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
UTI: screen at first visit or 12-16 weeks; pyelonephritis needs hospitalization, risks preterm labor.
泌尿道感染：首次產檢或 12-16 週篩檢；腎盂腎炎需住院，有早產風險。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
Obesity: GDM, hypertension, preeclampsia, VTE, cesarean, postpartum hemorrhage, endometritis; use SCDs/stockings, early ambulation, incision care.
肥胖：妊娠糖尿病、高血壓、子癇前症、靜脈栓塞、剖腹、產後出血、子宮內膜炎；使用 SCD/彈性襪、早期下床、傷口照護。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
Iron-deficiency anemia: CBC at first visit, 24-28 and 36 weeks; iron between meals. Asthma meds are generally safe; maintain action plan.
缺鐵性貧血：首次產檢、24-28 週、36 週做 CBC；鐵劑於兩餐間服用。氣喘藥物一般安全；維持氣喘行動計畫。
STIs, TB, UTI, Obesity and Other Complications
性傳染病、結核、泌尿道感染、肥胖與其他
Placenta previa: painless bright red bleeding, soft nontender uterus, NO vaginal exam. Abruptio: dark red bleeding, painful rigid uterus.
前置胎盤：無痛鮮紅出血、子宮柔軟無壓痛、禁陰道檢查。胎盤早剝：暗紅出血、子宮疼痛僵硬。
Magnesium sulfate toxicity: absent DTRs, low urine output, respiratory depression; antidote calcium gluconate; use a pump and check reflexes, RR, urine output.
硫酸鎂中毒：反射消失、尿量減少、呼吸抑制；解毒劑葡萄糖酸鈣；使用幫浦並監測反射、呼吸、尿量。
Preeclampsia worsening signs: headache, blurred vision, RUQ/epigastric pain, hyperreflexia, oliguria, BP 160/110 or higher.
子癇前症惡化徵象：頭痛、視力模糊、右上腹/上腹痛、反射亢進、少尿、血壓 ≥160/110。
Eclamptic seizure: side-lying, airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min, monitor FHR, seizure meds, stay with client.
子癇抽搐：側臥、維持呼吸道、給氧 8-10 L/min、監測胎心、給藥、留在床邊。
Lower BP gradually in preeclampsia to preserve placental perfusion.
子癇前症血壓應緩慢下降以維持胎盤灌流。
DIC: bleeding with low platelets and fibrinogen, high PT/PTT and FDP; remove cause, replace blood, keep urine at least 30 mL/hr.
DIC：出血、血小板與纖維蛋白原低、PT/PTT 與 FDP 高；除去病因、輸血、尿量至少 30 mL/hr。
Ectopic pregnancy rupture: sudden severe pain, shoulder pain, shock; methotrexate for early unruptured cases.
子宮外孕破裂：突發劇痛、肩痛、休克；未破裂早期用 methotrexate。
Hydatidiform mole: no FHT, hCG over 100,000, snowstorm ultrasound; follow hCG for 1 year and avoid pregnancy.
葡萄胎：無胎心、hCG 超過 100,000、暴風雪超音波；追蹤 hCG 一年並避孕。
Insulin needs: decrease in first trimester, increase in second/third, drop sharply after delivery of the placenta.
胰島素需求：第一孕期下降、二三孕期上升、胎盤娩出後驟降。
GDM screening 24-28 weeks; 1-hour GCT 140 mg/dL or higher then 3-hour OGTT; exercise is safe.
妊娠糖尿病 24-28 週篩檢；1 小時 GCT ≥140 mg/dL 再做 3 小時 OGTT；運動安全。
Infant of diabetic mother: watch hypoglycemia, hyperbilirubinemia, RDS, hypocalcemia.
糖尿病母親之新生兒：注意低血糖、高膽紅素、呼吸窘迫、低血鈣。
HIV: zidovudine antepartum, intrapartum and to newborn for 6 weeks; avoid scalp electrodes, episiotomy, oxytocin; formula feeding generally advised.
HIV：產前、產中與新生兒 6 週給 zidovudine；避免頭皮電極、會陰切開、催產素；一般建議配方奶。
HSV with active vaginal lesions: cesarean; no vaginal exams. GBS cultures at 35-37 weeks, IV antibiotics in labor.
HSV 陰道有活動性病灶：剖腹；不做陰道檢查。GBS 35-37 週培養，產程給靜脈抗生素。
Rubella, toxoplasmosis, CMV: teratogenic infections; avoid raw meat and cat litter.
德國麻疹、弓形蟲、CMV：致畸感染；避免生肉與貓砂。
Syphilis: screen at first visit and 36 weeks; crosses placenta; treat partner.
梅毒：首次產檢與 36 週篩檢；可通過胎盤；伴侶需治療。
Hepatitis B: remove maternal blood from newborn, then HBIG plus vaccine; breastfeeding allowed after vaccination.
B 肝：先清除新生兒母血，再給 HBIG 加疫苗；接種後可哺乳。
Cardiac disease in pregnancy: watch decompensation; blood volume peaks 32-34 weeks; low sodium, side-lying in labor.
孕期心臟病：注意代償不全；血容積 32-34 週最高；低鈉飲食、產程側臥。
TORCH: Toxoplasmosis, Other (syphilis, HIV, hepatitis B, parvovirus), Rubella, Cytomegalovirus, Herpes.
TORCH：弓形蟲、其他（梅毒、HIV、B 肝、細小病毒）、德國麻疹、巨細胞病毒、疱疹。
HELLP: Hemolysis, Elevated Liver enzymes, Low Platelets.
HELLP：溶血、肝酵素升高、血小板低。
Magnesium toxicity: 'Reflexes gone, Respirations slow, Urine low' - give calcium gluconate.
硫酸鎂中毒：反射消失、呼吸變慢、尿量少，給葡萄糖酸鈣。
Previa = Painless, Pretty red; Abruptio = Agonizing, Dark, rigid.
前置胎盤＝無痛、鮮紅；早剝＝劇痛、暗紅、僵硬。

Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
The 4 Ps are Powers (contractions, effacement, dilation, pushing), Passageway (bony pelvis and soft tissue), Passenger (fetus, membranes, placenta) and Psyche (emotional state).
4P為產力（宮縮、子宮頸變薄與擴張、用力）、產道（骨盆與軟組織）、胎兒及附屬物（胎兒、胎膜、胎盤）與心理狀態。
Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
Normal attitude is flexion (chin to chest, limbs folded); extension presents larger diameters.
正常胎勢為屈曲（下巴貼胸、四肢蜷曲）；伸展會使胎頭通過的徑線變大。
Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
Lie: longitudinal (spines parallel; cephalic or breech) vs transverse (right angle, shoulder presenting, cesarean needed).
胎向：縱向（脊柱平行，頭位或臀位）；橫向（垂直，肩先露，需剖腹產）。
Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
Presentation: cephalic (most common: vertex, military, brow, face), breech (frank, full, footling), shoulder.
先露：頭位（最常見：頂位、軍姿位、額位、顏面位）、臀位（單臀、完全、足先露）、肩位。
Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
Station measures descent relative to the ischial spines: 0 = at spines (engaged), minus = above, plus = below.
站位以坐骨棘為基準測量下降：0為在坐骨棘（已入盆）、負值在上方、正值在下方。
Process of Labor: the 4 Ps and fetal terms
分娩過程：4P與胎兒相關名詞
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
Pre-labor signs: lightening (about 2 weeks before in first pregnancies), more Braxton Hicks, bloody show, cervical ripening, nesting burst of energy, 1-3 lb weight loss, rupture of membranes.
產前徵兆：胎兒下降（初產婦約提前2週）、假性宮縮增加、見紅、子宮頸成熟、築巢本能、體重減輕1至3磅、破水。
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
True labor: contractions regular, stronger, longer, closer; progressive dilation/effacement and descent. False labor: irregular, no cervical change, often relieved by walking.
真陣痛：規律、越來越強、越長、間隔越短，子宮頸持續變化與下降；假陣痛：不規則、無頸部變化，走動常可緩解。
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
Cardinal movements in order: engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, restitution, external rotation, expulsion.
分娩機轉順序：入盆、下降、屈曲、內旋轉、伸展、復位、外旋轉、娩出。
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
Leopold maneuvers locate the fetal back (smooth, hard) and small parts (knobs) and help place the Doppler.
李氏四步觸診可判斷胎背（光滑堅硬）與小肢體（不規則突起），並協助放置胎心探頭。
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
Breathing: slow-paced, modified (shallow fast), pattern-paced (pant-blow); blow in short puffs to avoid pushing early; limit breath-holding to under 6-8 seconds when pushing.
呼吸技巧：慢式、改良式（淺快）、模式式（喘吹）；不想用力時短促吹氣；用力時憋氣少於6至8秒。
Signs of labor and mechanisms of labor
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形
Normal baseline FHR at term is 110-160 bpm, measured between contractions. Bradycardia <110, tachycardia >160 for 10 minutes or more.
足月正常基準胎心率為110至160次/分，於宮縮間測量；持續10分鐘以上低於110為心搏過緩，高於160為過速。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形

External monitoring: ultrasound transducer over the fetal back, tocotransducer over the fundus; side-lying to avoid vena cava compression. Internal monitoring (scalp electrode, IUPC) needs ruptured membranes and 2-3 cm dilation.
外部監測：超音波探頭置於胎背處、宮縮壓力計置於子宮底；採側臥避免壓迫下腔靜脈。內部監測（胎頭電極、子宮內壓導管）需破水且擴張2至3公分。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形
Variability: absent (undetected), minimal (<=5), moderate (6-25), marked (>25 bpm). Absent/minimal can mean hypoxemia, acidosis, drugs, or fetal sleep (up to 30 min).
變異性：無（測不到）、輕微（5以下）、中度（6至25）、顯著（大於25次/分）。缺乏或輕微可能代表缺氧、酸中毒、藥物或胎兒睡眠（最長約30分鐘）。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形
Accelerations (>=15 bpm for >=15 sec) are reassuring.
加速（上升至少15次/分且持續至少15秒）為安心圖形。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形

Early decelerations: mirror the contraction, head compression, benign. Late: start after contraction onset, uteroplacental insufficiency, nonreassuring. Variable: abrupt, variable shape, cord compression.
早期減速：與宮縮呈鏡像、胎頭受壓、良性；晚期減速：宮縮開始後才出現、子宮胎盤功能不全、不安心；變異減速：突然、形狀不一、臍帶受壓。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形
Significant variables fall below 70 bpm and last 60 seconds or longer. Uterine resting tone averages 5-15 mm Hg; contractions 50-75 mm Hg; uterus should relax 60 seconds or more between contractions.
重要的變異減速為降至70次/分以下且持續60秒以上。子宮靜止張力平均5至15 mmHg，宮縮強度50至75 mmHg，宮縮間子宮應放鬆至少60秒。
胎兒監測與胎心率圖形
Stage 1 latent: 1-4 cm, contractions q15-30 min, 15-30 sec, mild; ambulate, fluids, void every 1-2 hr.
第一產程潛伏期：1至4公分，每15至30分鐘一次、持續15至30秒、輕度；鼓勵走動、補充水分、每1至2小時排尿。
Stage 1 active: 4-7 cm, q3-5 min, 30-60 sec, moderate; breathing support, back rubs, sacral pressure.
活躍期：4至7公分，每3至5分鐘、持續30至60秒、中度；協助呼吸、背部按摩、薦骨加壓。
Transition: 8-10 cm, q2-3 min, 45-90 sec, strong; rest between contractions, privacy, wake client to start breathing.
過渡期：8至10公分，每2至3分鐘、持續45至90秒、強烈；宮縮間休息、維護隱私、宮縮開始時喚醒產婦開始呼吸。
Stage 2: complete dilation to birth; Ferguson reflex urge to push, bloody show increases; assess every 5 minutes.
第二產程：全開至胎兒娩出；出現Ferguson反射的用力衝動、血性分泌物增加；每5分鐘評估一次。
Stage 3: placenta expelled 5-30 min after birth. Schultze: shiny fetal side first; Duncan: dull maternal side first. Inspect placenta for completeness; fundus firm, 2 fingerbreadths below umbilicus.
第三產程：胎兒娩出後5至30分鐘胎盤娩出。Schultze為光亮胎兒面先出；Duncan為粗糙母體面先出。檢查胎盤是否完整；子宮底堅硬、位於肚臍下兩指幅。
Stage 4: 1-4 hours after birth; assess every 15 min x1 hr, 30 min x1 hr, then hourly x2; warm blankets, perineal ice, fundal massage, lochia moderate and red.
第四產程：產後1至4小時；每15分鐘評估1小時、每30分鐘1小時，之後每小時2小時；保暖、會陰冰敷、子宮按摩、惡露中量紅色。
局部麻醉（會陰切開）：對胎兒無影響。

Epidural (L3-L4): hypotension, bladder distention, longer second stage; keep side-lying or wedge under right hip, give IV fluids, check bladder; watch opioid effects (nausea, itching, respiratory depression).
硬膜外麻醉（L3至L4）：可能低血壓、膀胱脹、第二產程延長；側臥或右臀下墊枕、給予靜脈輸液、檢查膀胱；注意鴉片類副作用（噁心、搔癢、呼吸抑制）。
Spinal (L3-L5): hypotension and postdural headache; lie flat 8-12 hours.
脊髓麻醉（L3至L5）：低血壓與脊髓穿刺後頭痛；需平躺8至12小時。
General: risk of respiratory depression, vomiting, aspiration.
全身麻醉：有呼吸抑制、嘔吐與吸入性肺炎風險。
Bishop score (dilation, effacement, consistency, position, station) of 8 or more means a favorable cervix for induction.
Bishop評分（擴張、變薄、質地、位置、站位）達8分以上代表子宮頸有利於引產。
Oxytocin induction: baseline tracing first; do not increase once contractions reach every 2-3 min lasting 60 sec; stop if contractions closer than 2 min, longer than 90 sec, or fetal distress.
催產素引產：先取得基準圖形；宮縮達每2至3分鐘、持續60秒即不再加量；宮縮間隔小於2分鐘、持續超過90秒或胎兒窘迫時停藥。
Amniotomy at 0 or plus station: risks cord prolapse and infection; check FHR before and after, note fluid color (meconium = distress, bloody = abruption, foul = infection).
人工破水於站位0或正值時進行：有臍帶脫垂與感染風險；破水前後檢查胎心，記錄羊水顏色（胎便＝窘迫、血性＝胎盤早剝、臭味＝感染）。
External version after 34 weeks: give RhoGAM if Rh-negative, nonstress test afterward, Kleihauer-Betke test.
外轉胎位術於34週後進行：Rh陰性者確認已給予RhoGAM，術後做無壓力試驗與Kleihauer-Betke試驗。
Episiotomy: ice 24 hours then sitz baths; front-to-back, blot dry. Forceps/vacuum: check infant for injury; vacuum no longer than 25 minutes; watch for cephalhematoma (caput resolves in 24 hr).
會陰切開：24小時冰敷後改坐浴；由前往後、輕拍擦乾。產鉗與真空吸引：檢查新生兒有無傷害；真空吸引不超過25分鐘；注意頭血腫（產瘤24小時內消退）。
Cesarean: consent, IV, Foley, Rh status; postop watch for UTI, endometritis (tender uterus, foul lochia), pneumonia, thrombophlebitis.
剖腹產：同意書、靜脈留置、導尿、確認Rh；術後注意泌尿道感染、子宮內膜炎（子宮壓痛、惡露惡臭）、肺炎、血栓靜脈炎。
Normal FHR 110-160 bpm; a baseline of 100 between contractions or 180 needs provider notification.
正常胎心率110至160次/分；宮縮間為100或達180需通知醫師。
Late decelerations = uteroplacental insufficiency: turn side-lying, oxygen 8-10 L/min by face mask, IV fluids, stop oxytocin, notify provider.
晚期減速＝子宮胎盤功能不全：側臥、面罩給氧8至10 L/分、靜脈輸液、停催產素、通知醫師。
Variable decelerations = cord compression: stop oxytocin, reposition, oxygen, assist with amnioinfusion if prescribed.
變異減速＝臍帶受壓：停催產素、變換姿勢、給氧、依醫囑協助羊水灌注。
Early decelerations and accelerations are reassuring; early decelerations need no intervention.
早期減速與加速為安心圖形；早期減速不需處置。
Nonreassuring patterns: bradycardia, tachycardia, late or prolonged decelerations, hypertonic uterus, absent variability, severe variables (<70 bpm for >60 sec).
不安心圖形：心搏過緩、過速、晚期或延長減速、子宮張力過高、變異性消失、嚴重變異減速（低於70次/分超過60秒）。
If oxytocin is running and fetal distress or hyperstimulation appears, the priority is to stop the oxytocin infusion.
使用催產素時若出現胎兒窘迫或過度刺激，首要處置為停止催產素。
After rupture of membranes (spontaneous or amniotomy) check FHR first because of cord prolapse risk.
破水後（自然或人工）首先確認胎心率，以排除臍帶脫垂。
Avoid supine position: use side-lying or a wedge under the right hip to prevent vena cava compression, including on the cesarean table.
避免仰臥：採側臥或右臀下墊楔形枕，以防下腔靜脈受壓，剖腹產手術台亦然。
Spinal anesthesia: lie flat 8-12 hours, risk of hypotension and headache. Epidural: hypotension, check bladder.
脊髓麻醉：平躺8至12小時，有低血壓與頭痛風險；硬膜外：低血壓、檢查膀胱。
True labor shows progressive cervical change; contractions that last longer and stronger. Walking relieves false labor.
真陣痛使子宮頸持續變化、宮縮增強延長；假陣痛走動可緩解。
Bishop score 8 or higher = favorable for induction. Amniotomy requires fetus at 0 or plus station.
Bishop評分8分以上有利引產；人工破水需胎頭在站位0或正值。
Meconium-stained fluid suggests fetal distress; bloody fluid suggests abruption; foul-smelling fluid suggests infection.
胎便污染羊水提示胎兒窘迫；血性提示胎盤早剝；惡臭提示感染。
Never leave a laboring client in transition alone; in second stage prioritize rest between contractions and effective pushing.
過渡期產婦不可獨留；第二產程重點為宮縮間休息與有效用力。
Postpartum complications after cesarean: pain/burning urination (UTI), tender uterus plus foul lochia (endometritis), productive cough/chills (pneumonia), calf pain/redness (thrombophlebitis).
剖腹產術後併發症：排尿灼痛（泌尿道感染）、子宮壓痛合併惡露惡臭（子宮內膜炎）、有痰咳嗽或畏寒（肺炎）、小腿疼痛紅腫（血栓靜脈炎）。
VEAL CHOP: Variable decels - Cord compression; Early - Head compression; Accelerations - OK; Late - Placental insufficiency.
VEAL CHOP：變異減速－臍帶受壓；早期－胎頭受壓；加速－正常；晚期－胎盤功能不全。
Cardinal movements: "EDFIREE" - Engagement, Descent, Flexion, Internal rotation, Extension, Restitution/External rotation, Expulsion.
分娩機轉口訣：入盆、下降、屈曲、內旋轉、伸展、復位與外旋轉、娩出。
4 Ps of labor: Powers, Passageway, Passenger, Psyche.
分娩4P：產力、產道、胎兒、心理。

剖腹產接受脊髓麻醉後，下列哪項指導最重要？

Spontaneous rupture before labor onset; gestational age guides management; preterm rupture with delayed birth raises infection risk.
於陣痛開始前自然破水；週數決定處置；早產且延遲分娩時感染風險增加。
Assess pooled vaginal fluid, positive nitrazine test, fluid amount/color/odor, temperature, and FHR (fetal tachycardia can signal maternal infection).
評估陰道積液、石蕊試紙（nitrazine）陽性、羊水量／顏色／氣味、體溫與胎心率（胎兒心搏過速可能代表母體感染）。
Avoid vaginal examinations; give antibiotics as prescribed; monitor for infection or fetal compromise.
避免陰道檢查；依醫囑給予抗生素；監測感染與胎兒狀況。

Cord slips ahead of or beside the presenting part, compressing and cutting off fetal circulation. Suspect it with a sensation of something in the vagina, visible or palpable cord, bradycardia or variable decelerations after rupture.
臍帶滑到先露部前方或旁邊而受壓，阻斷胎兒血流。若產婦感覺陰道有東西、見到或摸到臍帶、破水後胎心過慢或變異減速，應懷疑。
Immediately relieve pressure: sterile gloved hand lifts the presenting part off the cord and stays there.
立即解除壓力：以無菌手套的手將先露部上推離開臍帶並維持不動。

Position: extreme Trendelenburg, modified left lateral or knee-chest. Call for help, oxygen 8-10 L/min, wrap exposed cord in warm sterile saline-soaked towel, IV fluids, prepare for emergency cesarean.
姿勢：極度頭低腳高、改良左側臥或膝胸臥位。呼叫協助、給氧8至10 L/分、以溫無菌生理食鹽水濕巾包覆外露臍帶、靜脈輸液、準備緊急剖腹產。
Never push the cord back into the uterus.
絕不可將臍帶推回子宮。
Supine hypotension: uterus compresses vena cava and aorta; pallor, dizziness, tachycardia, hypotension, clammy skin, fetal distress. Turn to the side or place a wedge under the hip.
仰臥低血壓：子宮壓迫下腔靜脈與主動脈；蒼白、頭暈、心跳快、低血壓、冒冷汗、胎兒窘迫。處置為側臥或臀下墊楔形枕。
Preterm labor: after 20 weeks and before 37 weeks. Risks include multiples, infection, anemia, substance abuse, age under 18, or a first pregnancy after age 40.
早產：20週後至未滿37週。危險因子包括多胞胎、感染、貧血、物質濫用、年齡小於18歲，或大於40歲的初產婦。
Signs: contractions, cramping or diarrhea, low back pain, pelvic pressure, change in discharge, ruptured membranes, positive fetal fibronectin, shortened cervix.
徵象：宮縮、腹部絞痛或腹瀉、下背痛、骨盆壓迫感、分泌物改變、破水、胎兒纖維連接蛋白陽性、子宮頸縮短。
Care: treat infection, restrict activity, hydrate, lateral bed rest, monitor fetus, tocolytics as prescribed, 17P injections to lower risk of preterm birth.
處置：治療感染、限制活動、補充水分、側臥休息、監測胎兒、依醫囑給予安胎藥、使用17P注射以降低早產風險。
Precipitous labor lasts under 3 hours: stay with client, keep her calm, pant between contractions, do not try to stop delivery.
急產指產程少於3小時：陪伴產婦、使其鎮定、宮縮間喘息呼吸，不可阻止胎兒娩出。

Emergency birth: support perineum and apply gentle pressure on head (Ritgen), check for cord around neck, suction mouth then nose, dry and warm the infant, allow placenta to separate naturally, skin-to-skin to promote contractions.
緊急接生：支托會陰並輕壓胎頭（Ritgen手法）、檢查臍帶繞頸、先吸口再吸鼻、擦乾保暖新生兒、讓胎盤自然剝離、肌膚接觸促進子宮收縮。

Dystocia: prolonged or painful labor from contractions, fetus (large, malpositioned) or pelvis. Hypotonic contractions are weak and irregular (oxytocin or amniotomy may help); hypertonic are painful, frequent, uncoordinated (pain relief and rest; no oxytocin).
難產：因宮縮、胎兒（過大、胎位不正）或骨盆問題導致產程延長或疼痛。低張性宮縮微弱不規則（可用催產素或人工破水）；高張性宮縮疼痛、頻繁、不協調（止痛與休息；不用催產素）。
Dystocia care: monitor FHR first, contractions, maternal temperature/pulse, hydration, I&O, position changes, watch for cord prolapse after rupture.
難產處置：首要監測胎心率，並監測宮縮、母體體溫與脈搏、水分、輸出入量、變換姿勢，破水後留意臍帶脫垂。
Amniotic fluid embolism and fetal distress/demise
羊水栓塞與胎兒窘迫／胎死腹中

Anaphylactoid syndrome of pregnancy (amniotic fluid embolism): sudden respiratory distress, chest pain, cyanosis, coagulation failure; often fatal. Give 100% oxygen/ventilation, side position, fluids, blood products, prepare for emergency delivery.
妊娠類過敏症候群（羊水栓塞）：突發呼吸窘迫、胸痛、發紺、凝血功能障礙，常致命。給予高濃度氧與通氣、側臥、輸液、血液製品，準備緊急分娩。
Amniotic fluid embolism and fetal distress/demise
羊水栓塞與胎兒窘迫／胎死腹中

Fetal distress: FHR <110 or >160, meconium, late or severe variable decelerations, decreasing variability, abnormal activity. Stop oxytocin, lateral position, oxygen 8-10 L/min, IV fluid bolus, prepare for cesarean.
胎兒窘迫：胎心<110或>160、胎便、晚期或嚴重變異減速、變異性下降、胎動異常。停催產素、側臥、給氧8至10 L/分、靜脈輸液快速注入、準備剖腹產。
Amniotic fluid embolism and fetal distress/demise
羊水栓塞與胎兒窘迫／胎死腹中

Fetal demise (after 20 weeks): no fetal movement or heart tones; retained 3-4 weeks risks DIC (low platelets, bleeding from puncture sites). Support grieving, respect culture and religion, accept sadness/anger, refer to support groups.
胎死腹中（20週後）：無胎動與胎心音；滯留3至4週有DIC風險（血小板低、穿刺處出血）。支持哀傷、尊重文化與宗教、接納悲傷與憤怒、轉介支持團體。
Amniotic fluid embolism and fetal distress/demise
羊水栓塞與胎兒窘迫／胎死腹中
Rupture risks: labor after prior cesarean, overdistended uterus, trauma. Signs: abdominal pain/tenderness, chest pain, contractions stop, rigid abdomen, absent FHR, shock.
破裂危險因子：剖腹產後試產、子宮過度膨脹、外傷。徵象：腹痛壓痛、胸痛、宮縮停止、腹部僵硬、胎心消失、休克。
Rupture care: treat shock (oxygen, fluids, blood), prepare for cesarean, possible hysterectomy.
破裂處置：治療休克（氧氣、輸液、輸血）、準備剖腹產，可能需子宮切除。
Inversion: uterus turns inside out, often with fundal placenta, cord traction, or atony. Signs: fundal depression, visible uterine tissue, severe pain, hemorrhage, shock.
內翻：子宮翻出，常見於底部著床、強拉臍帶或子宮收縮不良。徵象：子宮底凹陷、可見子宮組織、劇痛、大出血、休克。
Inversion care: treat shock, prepare for vaginal replacement or laparotomy.
內翻處置：治療休克、準備經陰道復位，失敗則剖腹復位。
Cord prolapse: relieve pressure with a gloved hand holding the presenting part up; Trendelenburg or knee-chest; oxygen; never push the cord back.
臍帶脫垂：戴手套的手上推先露部以解除壓迫；頭低腳高或膝胸臥位；給氧；絕不將臍帶推回。
After membranes rupture, check FHR immediately (cord prolapse risk) and note fluid color.
破水後立即檢查胎心率（臍帶脫垂風險）並記錄羊水顏色。
PROM: no routine vaginal exams (infection); watch for fever and fetal tachycardia.
胎膜早破：不做常規陰道檢查（避免感染）；注意發燒與胎兒心搏過速。
Fetal distress: stop oxytocin, lateral position, oxygen 8-10 L/min by face mask, IV fluids, notify provider, prepare for cesarean.
胎兒窘迫：停催產素、側臥、面罩給氧8至10 L/分、輸液、通知醫師、準備剖腹產。
Hypertonic contractions: pain relief and rest, not oxytocin or amniotomy. Hypotonic contractions may get oxytocin with fetal monitoring.
高張性宮縮：止痛與休息，不用催產素或人工破水；低張性宮縮可在胎兒監測下使用催產素。
Supine hypotension: turn to the side or wedge under the hip.
仰臥低血壓：側臥或臀下墊楔形枕。
Preterm labor: 20 to <37 weeks; fetal fibronectin positive and short cervix; hydration, lateral rest, tocolytics, 17P.
早產：20週至未滿37週；胎兒纖維連接蛋白陽性與子宮頸短；補水、側臥、安胎藥、17P。
Precipitous birth: never hold the baby back; support head and perineum, check cord around neck, suction mouth then nose.
急產：不可阻止胎兒娩出；支托胎頭與會陰、檢查臍帶繞頸、先吸口再吸鼻。
Amniotic fluid embolism: abrupt dyspnea, chest pain, cyanosis, then DIC; 100% oxygen, intubation readiness, correct coagulopathy.
羊水栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、發紺，隨後DIC；給100%氧、準備插管、矯正凝血異常。
Fetal demise retained 3-4 weeks leads to DIC; monitor coagulation labs and bleeding.
胎死腹中滯留3至4週可導致DIC；監測凝血檢驗與出血。
Uterine rupture: sudden pain, contractions stop, absent FHR, shock. Uterine inversion: fundal dimple, hemorrhage, shock; do not massage or push.
子宮破裂：突發疼痛、宮縮停止、胎心消失、休克。子宮內翻：底部凹陷、出血、休克；不可按摩或推壓。
In dystocia the priority is fetal heart rate monitoring.
難產時首要為監測胎心率。
Cord prolapse: "Up, Out of the way, Oxygen" - lift the presenting part, elevate the hips, give oxygen, call for help.
臍帶脫垂：「上推、抬高、給氧」－上推先露部、抬高臀部、給氧、呼叫協助。
Preterm labor window: after week 20, before week 37.

A client suddenly develops dyspnea, chest pain and cyanosis during labor, followed by bleeding from IV sites. Which condition does the nurse suspect and which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
產婦於待產中突發呼吸困難、胸痛、發紺，隨後靜脈注射處出血。護理師懷疑何種情況？哪些處置適當？（複選）

使用催產素的產婦反覆出現晚期減速。準備剖腹產時，最重要的護理行動為何？
Take Action box: step-by-step nursing response to a prolapsed umbilical cord.
臍帶脫垂的逐步護理處置。
Figure 25.1: types of cord prolapse (occult, complete, presenting, frank breech).
圖25.1：臍帶脫垂類型（隱性、完全、先露、單臀位）。
The postpartum period runs from birth to about 6 weeks.
產後期從分娩後至約6週。
Uterus shrinks from about 2 lb (900 g) to 2 oz (57 g) in 6 weeks; fundus descends about 1 cm/day and is not palpable abdominally by day 10. Breast-/chest-feeding speeds involution through oxytocin.
子宮於6週內由約2磅（900 g）縮至2盎司（57 g）；子宮底每日下降約1公分，第10天腹部已摸不到。哺乳透過催產素加速復舊。
Boggy (flaccid) fundus = atony, massage until firm; tender fundus suggests infection; a full bladder displaces the uterus upward and prevents contraction, so have client void before assessment.
子宮軟而鬆弛＝子宮收縮不良，需按摩至變硬；子宮壓痛提示感染；膀胱脹滿會將子宮推高並妨礙收縮，評估前先請產婦排尿。
Afterpains are more common in multiparas, nursing parents, oxytocin use, and overdistended uterus.
後陣痛較常見於經產婦、哺乳者、使用催產素及子宮過度膨脹者。
Rubra: bright red, days 0-3. Serosa: brownish pink, days 4-10. Alba: white, days 11-14.
紅惡露：鮮紅，第0至3天；漿液惡露：粉褐色，第4至10天；白惡露：白色，第11至14天。
Normal odor resembles menstrual flow; foul odor suggests infection. Large clots (>1 cm) or saturating a pad in 15 minutes (excessive) need provider notification.
正常氣味似月經；惡臭提示感染。血塊大於1公分或15分鐘浸濕一片護墊（過量）需通知醫師。
Amount: scant <2.5 cm/hr, light <10 cm, moderate <15 cm, heavy saturated in 1 hr, excessive saturated in 15 min. Weigh pads for accuracy.
量：極少（每小時<2.5 cm）、少（<10 cm）、中（<15 cm）、多（1小時浸濕）、過多（15分鐘浸濕）。可秤護墊重量以求準確。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象
Menses return in 1-2 months if not nursing, 3-6 months if nursing; ovulation can precede menses, so lactation is not reliable contraception.
未哺乳者1至2個月月經恢復，哺乳者約3至6個月；可能先排卵再來月經，因此哺乳不是可靠的避孕。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象
Colostrum 48-72 hr; milk comes in day 3; engorgement about day 4. Non-nursing: snug bra/binder, ice, avoid nipple stimulation; resolves in 24-36 hr.
初乳持續48至72小時；第3天泌乳；約第4天脹奶。未哺乳者：穿緊身胸罩或束帶、冰敷、避免刺激乳頭；24至36小時緩解。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象
Diuresis begins within 12 hr; urinary retention is possible; bowel movement by day 2-3; hemorrhoids common.
12小時內開始利尿；可能尿滯留；第2至3天排便；痔瘡常見。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象

Temp may reach 100.4 F (38 C) in first 24 hr from dehydration, higher suggests infection. Pulse may fall to 50 (normal); >100 suggests hemorrhage or infection. Falling BP suggests hypovolemia; rising respirations suggest PE, atony or hemorrhage.
前24小時因脫水體溫可達100.4°F（38°C），更高提示感染。脈搏可降至50次/分（正常）；大於100提示出血或感染。血壓下降提示低血容量；呼吸明顯加快提示肺栓塞、子宮收縮不良或出血。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象
Orthostatic hypotension may occur in the first 8 hours: assist when getting up.
產後前8小時可能有姿勢性低血壓：下床需有人協助。
Other physiologic changes and vital signs
其他生理變化與生命徵象

Assess vital signs, pain, fundus (height, consistency, location after voiding), lochia, breasts, perineum (REEDA-type swelling/discoloration), incisions, bowel, I&O, calf for thrombophlebitis, bonding, emotions.
評估生命徵象、疼痛、子宮底（排尿後測高度、硬度、位置）、惡露、乳房、會陰（腫脹或瘀青）、傷口、腸道、輸出入量、小腿血栓靜脈炎、親子依附與情緒。
Give Rho(D) immune globulin within 72 hours to Rh-negative clients with Rh-positive newborn; check rubella immunity and vaccinate if nonimmune, avoid conception 1-3 months.
Rh陰性且新生兒為Rh陽性者，72小時內給予Rho(D)免疫球蛋白；確認德國麻疹免疫，無免疫者接種疫苗，之後1至3個月避免受孕。
Teach: no heavy lifting for 3 weeks, daily rest, delay intercourse until lochia stops, follow-up at 4-6 weeks, report chills, fever, increased lochia, or depressed mood.
衛教：3週內避免提重物、每日休息、惡露停止後再行房、4至6週回診、有畏寒、發燒、惡露增多或情緒低落立即通報。
Perineum/episiotomy: ice first 24 hours then sitz baths; perineal care after voiding; analgesic spray; avoid suppositories/enemas with lacerations.
會陰／會陰切開：前24小時冰敷，之後坐浴；排尿後做會陰護理；使用止痛噴劑；有撕裂傷時避免塞劑與灌腸。
Constipation: 2000 mL fluid/day, fiber, ambulation, stool softener if prescribed.
便秘：每日2000 mL水分、高纖飲食、走動、依醫囑用軟便劑。

Postpartum blues: tearfulness, mood swings, anxiety, fatigue, usually self-limited. Depression: guilt, loss of pleasure, less responsive to infant, suicidal thoughts. Psychosis: delusions, hallucinations, confusion, break with reality (emergency).
產後憂鬱情緒：愛哭、情緒起伏、焦慮、疲倦，通常自行緩解。產後憂鬱症：罪惡感、失去興趣、對嬰兒反應少、自殺意念。產後精神病：妄想、幻覺、混亂、脫離現實（急症）。
All clients should be screened for depression in pregnancy and postpartum.
所有孕產婦於孕期與產後均應篩檢憂鬱。
Nursing parents need 200-500 extra kcal/day, more fluids, and continued prenatal vitamins; avoid alcohol, unprescribed medications, gas-forming foods and caffeine.
哺乳者每日增加200至500大卡、多喝水、持續服用孕期維生素；避免酒精、未經處方藥物、產氣食物與咖啡因。
Start feeding early; use LATCH (Latch, Audible swallowing, Type of nipple, Comfort, Hold).
儘早開始哺乳；以LATCH評估（含乳、吞嚥聲、乳頭型態、舒適度、抱姿）。
Wash breasts with water only (no soap); supportive non-underwire bra day and night; air-dry cracked nipples 10-20 min, ensure areolar latch, rotate positions.
乳房只用清水清潔（不用肥皂）；日夜穿支撐型無鋼圈胸罩；乳頭皸裂時風乾10至20分鐘、確保含住乳暈、輪換姿勢。
Engorgement: feed frequently, warm before, cold between feeds, massage. Estrogen-containing pills not recommended; progestin-only less likely to reduce milk.
脹奶：頻繁哺乳、餵前熱敷、餵後冷敷、按摩。不建議含雌激素避孕藥；單純黃體素較不影響奶量。
Newborn stools are light yellow, seedy, watery, frequent.
母乳寶寶糞便為淺黃色、顆粒狀、水樣、次數多。
Boggy uterus: massage the fundus until firm (first check bladder); never push on an uncontracted uterus (inversion risk).

Hematoma (vulvar most common): linked to forceps and vessel injury. Signs: severe unrelieved pain, perineal pressure, bulging discolored mass, inability to void, falling Hgb/Hct, tachycardia/hypotension.

Atony: boggy uterus; massage until firm, empty the bladder, notify provider if not resolved.
收縮不良：子宮鬆軟；按摩至變硬、排空膀胱，無改善則通知醫師。
子宮收縮不良與產後出血
Hemorrhage: >500 mL vaginal birth, >1000 mL cesarean, or 10% Hgb/Hct drop with symptoms. Highest risk in first 4 hours, then first 24 hours; late is beyond 24 hours.
出血定義：陰道生產大於500 mL、剖腹產大於1000 mL，或血紅素／血容比下降10%並有症狀。風險最高為產後4小時內，其次24小時內；24小時後為晚期出血。

Causes: atony, lacerations, hematoma, retained placenta fragments. Risk factors: prior PPH, coagulopathy, chorioamnionitis, previa/abruption, overdistention, multiparity, prolonged labor, operative delivery.
原因：收縮不良、裂傷、血腫、胎盤殘留。危險因子：曾有產後出血、凝血異常、絨毛膜羊膜炎、前置胎盤／胎盤早剝、子宮過度膨脹、多產、產程延長、手術生產。

Assess: pad soaked in 15 min; weigh pads (1 g = 1 mL). Early signs restlessness and rising pulse; later low BP, cool clammy ashen skin, low urine output, altered consciousness.
評估：15分鐘浸濕護墊；秤護墊重量（1 g = 1 mL）。早期徵象為躁動與脈搏上升；晚期為低血壓、皮膚冰冷濕黏灰白、尿量減少、意識改變。

Take-action sequence: airway, oxygen 8-10 L/min nonrebreather, call OB, legs up about 30 degrees, massage if atonic, IV (two lines, 16-18 gauge), uterotonics (oxytocin, prostaglandins), fluids (LR/NS), Foley, blood products, prepare for surgery.
處置順序：確保呼吸道、非再吸入面罩給氧8至10 L/分、呼叫產科醫師、抬腿約30度、鬆軟則按摩、建立兩條16至18號靜脈、子宮收縮劑（催產素、前列腺素）、輸液（LR／NS）、導尿、輸血、準備手術。

感染、乳腺炎與子宮內膜炎
Postpartum infection occurs within 28 days; fever at or above 100.4 F after the first 24 hours is infection until proven otherwise. Malodorous discharge, chills, malaise, pelvic pain, high WBC.
產後感染發生於28天內；24小時後體溫達100.4°F以上視為感染。惡臭分泌物、畏寒、倦怠、骨盆痛、白血球升高。
感染、乳腺炎與子宮內膜炎
Care: VS q2-4h, position for drainage, fluids 3000-4000 mL/day, high-calorie high-protein diet, hand hygiene, antibiotics per culture, antipyretics.
處置：每2至4小時測生命徵象、引流姿勢、每日水分3000至4000 mL、高熱量高蛋白飲食、洗手、依培養結果用抗生素、退燒藥。
感染、乳腺炎與子宮內膜炎

Mastitis: usually 2-3 weeks postpartum in nursing parents; localized heat, swelling, pain, axillary nodes, fever, flu-like symptoms. Continue emptying the breast (nurse or pump every 3-4 h), fluids 2500-3000 mL, supportive non-underwire bra, antibiotics.
乳腺炎：多見於產後2至3週的哺乳者；局部紅熱腫痛、腋下淋巴結痛、發燒、類流感症狀。持續排空乳房（哺乳或每3至4小時擠奶）、水分2500至3000 mL、穿無鋼圈支撐胸罩、抗生素。

Endometritis: fever, chills, tachycardia, headache, backache, severe prolonged afterpains, large tender uterus, foul or reddish-brown lochia, ileus. Fowler's position, private room, IV antibiotics, no need to isolate newborn.
子宮內膜炎：發燒、畏寒、心跳快、頭痛、背痛、嚴重持續後陣痛、子宮大而壓痛、惡露惡臭或紅褐色、腸阻塞。採半坐臥、單人房、靜脈抗生素，不需隔離新生兒。
感染、乳腺炎與子宮內膜炎
肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全與血栓靜脈炎
PE: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, tachypnea, tachycardia, cough, crackles, hemoptysis, impending doom. Oxygen first, elevate head, monitor, IV fluids, anticoagulants, possible thrombolytics.
肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、呼吸心跳快、咳嗽、囉音、咳血、瀕死感。先給氧、抬高床頭、監測、輸液、抗凝血劑，必要時溶栓。
肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全與血栓靜脈炎
Subinvolution: painful, larger than expected uterus, heavy bleeding, prolonged lochia rubra; treat with methylergonovine as prescribed, frequent voiding, monitor Hgb/Hct.
子宮復舊不全：子宮疼痛、比預期大、出血多、紅惡露延長；依醫囑給予methylergonovine、常排尿、監測血紅素／血容比。
肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全與血栓靜脈炎

Thrombophlebitis: hard bumpy tender vessel, warm red area, fever, diminished pulses, swelling. Bed rest, elevate leg, warm moist heat, stockings, anticoagulation; NEVER massage the leg; avoid aspirin-containing drugs with anticoagulants; early ambulation after cesarean prevents it.
血栓靜脈炎：血管硬、凹凸、壓痛，局部紅熱、發燒、脈搏減弱、腫脹。臥床休息、抬高患肢、溫濕敷、彈性襪、抗凝血；絕不可按摩小腿；使用抗凝血劑時避免含阿斯匹靈藥物；剖腹產後早期下床可預防。
肺栓塞、子宮復舊不全與血栓靜脈炎
Teach: avoid leg crossing and prolonged sitting, avoid constrictive clothing, stop smoking, adhere to anticoagulants.
衛教：避免蹺腳與久坐、避免緊身衣物、戒菸、確實服用抗凝血劑。

Respect cultural, spiritual and religious practices; not every intervention fits every family.

Firm fundus but excessive bleeding suggests laceration: notify the OB; do not keep massaging.

Boggy uterus: massage until firm; never push on a boggy uterus (inversion).

疑似肺栓塞：先給氧，再建立靜脈、監測生命徵象、抗凝血劑。
Never massage a leg with thrombophlebitis; avoid aspirin with anticoagulants; monitor for PE.

周產期喪失：依文化與宗教個別化照護；提供紀念與與嬰兒相處的時間。

葡萄酒斑不會消退；草莓狀血管瘤7至9歲消退；鸛咬痕2歲前消退；蒙古斑1至2年內消退。

Check clavicle fractures, hip dysplasia (Ortolani/Barlow), spinal dimples or hair tufts, symmetric movements. Jittery tremors may signal hypoglycemia, hypocalcemia, or drug withdrawal.
檢查鎖骨骨折、髖關節發育不良（Ortolani／Barlow）、脊柱凹陷或毛髮叢、動作對稱性。顫抖可能代表低血糖、低血鈣或藥物戒斷。

IgG crosses placenta, IgA via colostrum; raised IgM suggests intrauterine infection. Eye prophylaxis (erythromycin 0.5%) within 1 hr to prevent ophthalmia neonatorum (gonorrhea).

Cord care: keep dry and clean, fold diaper below cord, sponge baths until it falls off (10-14 days); moist, oozing, reddened base means infection. Circumcision: petroleum gauze, loose diaper, must void within 24 hr, yellow exudate normal; some blood tinge normal.
臍帶照護：保持乾燥清潔、尿布折在臍帶下方、掉落前（10至14天）以擦澡；潮濕、滲液、基部發紅提示感染。包皮環切：凡士林紗布、尿布寬鬆、24小時內須排尿；黃色滲出物屬正常；少許血跡正常。

Stomach <10 mL at birth, about 90 mL by day 10. Breastfeed every 2-3 hr, formula every 3-4 hr; burp; position right side after feeding but supine for sleep (SIDS prevention). Meconium first 24 hr, transitional stool, then seedy yellow (breast) or pale yellow-brown (formula).
出生時胃容量少於10 mL，約第10天達90 mL。母乳每2至3小時、配方奶每3至4小時；拍嗝；餵後右側臥，但睡覺一律仰臥（預防SIDS）。依序為胎便（24小時內）、過渡便、黃色顆粒便（母乳）或淺黃至淺褐便（配方奶）。

PKU screening after 24 hr of formula/human milk.
PKU篩檢於攝入配方奶或母乳24小時後進行。

腸胃、神經與體溫調節；反射

Newborns do not shiver; use brown fat. Heat loss: evaporation (dry), radiation (away from cold walls), convection (no drafts), conduction (warm surfaces). Cold stress leads to hypoxia, hypoglycemia and acidosis. Axillary temp q30 min for 2 hr, q4h to 24 hr.
新生兒不會顫抖，靠棕色脂肪產熱。散熱方式：蒸發（擦乾）、輻射（遠離冰冷牆面）、對流（避免風）、傳導（暖墊）。受寒會導致缺氧、低血糖與酸中毒。腋溫前2小時每30分鐘一次，至24小時每4小時。

Reflexes: rooting/sucking (3-4 mo), tonic neck (3-4 mo), palmar grasp (3-4 mo), plantar grasp (8 mo), Moro (gone by 6 mo; persistence abnormal), startle (4 mo), Babinski (1 yr), stepping (3-4 mo), crawling (6 wk). Absence of normal reflexes needs neurologic evaluation.
反射：尋乳／吸吮（3至4個月）、頸張力（3至4個月）、手掌抓握（3至4個月）、足底抓握（8個月）、擁抱反射Moro（6個月消失；持續為異常）、驚嚇（4個月）、巴賓斯基（1歲）、踏步（3至4個月）、爬行（6週）。正常反射缺失需神經評估。

Match ID bands, transport infant in bassinet (never carry), verify staff badges, crib away from door, never leave infant unattended or alone on elevated surface.
核對手環、以嬰兒車運送（不可抱著走）、確認工作人員識別證、嬰兒床遠離門口、不可獨留嬰兒或放在高處。
新生兒安全與父母衛教
Formula or human milk is sufficient for 4-6 months; do not microwave bottles. Bathe in warm room, clean to dirty, eyes inner to outer canthus. Dress newborn in one more layer than parents.
配方奶或母乳足以供應4至6個月；勿用微波爐加熱奶瓶。在溫暖房間沐浴，由乾淨到髒、眼睛由內眥往外。穿著比父母多一層。
新生兒安全與父母衛教
Uncircumcised: never forcibly retract foreskin; separation completes by 3-6 years.
未割包皮：切勿強行翻開包皮；3至6歲自然分離。
