Gestational age variations and respiratory problems
Preterm (<37 wk): apnea, hypothermia, poor suck, thin skin, lanugo; keep in warmer, monitor VS q2-4h, girth, weight. Postterm (>42 wk): hypoglycemia, dry cracked skin, long nails, meconium staining.
早產（<37週）：呼吸中止、低體溫、吸吮差、皮膚薄、胎毛多；置於保暖設備、每2至4小時測生命徵象、腹圍、體重。過期產（>42週）：低血糖、皮膚乾裂、指甲長、胎便染色。
Gestational age variations and respiratory problems
SGA (<=10th percentile) and LGA (>=90th): both at risk for hypoglycemia; SGA also polycythemia, LGA birth trauma.
SGA（小於等於第10百分位）與LGA（大於等於第90百分位）：皆有低血糖風險；SGA另有紅血球增多症，LGA有產傷風險。
Gestational age variations and respiratory problems
RDS: surfactant deficiency; grunting, flaring, seesaw breathing; surfactant therapy, lowest effective oxygen, eye exam for ROP; side/back position, neck slightly extended.
呼吸窘迫症候群：缺乏表面張力素；呻吟、鼻翼搧動、蹺蹺板式呼吸；給予表面張力素、使用最低有效氧濃度、檢查視網膜病變；側臥或仰臥、頸部微伸。
Gestational age variations and respiratory problems
Meconium aspiration: term/postterm, yellow-green staining; suction if depressed. BPD: oxygen-dependent >28 days. TTN: retained lung fluid, resolves in 24-48 hr.
胎便吸入：足月／過期產、黃綠染色；若活力差需氣管內抽吸。支氣管肺發育不良：依賴氧氣超過28天。暫時性呼吸急促：肺液吸收不全，24至48小時消退。

腦室內出血、早產兒視網膜病變、壞死性腸炎
IVH: prematurity, RDS; absent Moro, lethargy, apnea, shrill cry, seizures; midline head, elevate 30 degrees.
腦室內出血：早產、RDS；莫羅反射減弱或消失、嗜睡、呼吸中止、尖叫、抽搐；頭保持中線、抬高30度。
腦室內出血、早產兒視網膜病變、壞死性腸炎
ROP: prematurity and prolonged oxygen; leukocoria; laser treatment.
早產兒視網膜病變：早產與長期用氧；白瞳症；雷射治療。
腦室內出血、早產兒視網膜病變、壞死性腸炎
NEC: day 4-10, preterm; girth increase, absent bowel sounds, bile-stained vomit, bloody stool. No rectal temps; hold feeds, OG decompression, IV antibiotics and fluids.
壞死性腸炎：第4至10天、早產兒；腹圍增加、腸音減弱或消失、膽汁性嘔吐、血便。不測肛溫；禁食、胃管減壓、靜脈抗生素與輸液。

Evaluate bilirubin >12 mg/dL in term infant; kernicterus is the danger. Jaundice spreads head to toe; check in natural light with blanching. Early frequent feeding (every 2-4 hr; continue breastfeeding).
足月兒膽紅素大於12 mg/dL需評估；怕核黃疸。黃疸由頭向腳擴散；於自然光下按壓皮膚檢查。早期頻繁餵食（每2至4小時；持續哺乳）。
高膽紅素血症、Rh疾病、敗血症與感染

Phototherapy: expose skin, cover genitals, eye shields (remove each shift), photometer, extra fluids, skin temp, loose green stools, bronze baby syndrome, reposition q2h, turn lights off before drawing bilirubin, watch for rebound.
光照療法：暴露皮膚、遮蓋生殖器、戴眼罩（每班移除檢查）、光度計、增加水分、監測皮膚溫度、綠色稀便、青銅寶寶症候群、每2小時翻身、抽血前關燈、注意反彈性升高。
高膽紅素血症、Rh疾病、敗血症與感染
Erythroblastosis fetalis: Rh-negative mother, Rh-positive fetus; jaundice before 24 hr, anemia, edema; RhoGAM within 72 hr; exchange transfusion.
胎兒母細胞增多症：Rh陰性母親、Rh陽性胎兒；24小時內黃疸、貧血、水腫；72小時內給RhoGAM；換血治療。

Sepsis (e.g., group B strep): pallor, temperature instability, poor feeding, apnea, distention; cultures, antibiotics, warmth.
敗血症（如B群鏈球菌）：蒼白、體溫不穩、吸吮差、呼吸中止、腹脹；做培養、給抗生素、保暖。
高膽紅素血症、Rh疾病、敗血症與感染
Congenital syphilis: hepatosplenomegaly, palmar rash, snuffles; penicillin; contact precautions; gloves until 24 hr of antibiotics.
先天性梅毒：肝脾腫大、手掌皮疹、鼻塞（snuffles）；青黴素；接觸隔離；抗生素24小時內戴手套。

藥物成癮新生兒：易怒、顫抖、肌張力高、高頻哭聲、打噴嚏、吸吮差、吸拳頭、抽搐。包裹、昏暗安靜環境、少量多餐、癲癇防護。

FASD: short palpebral fissures, thin upper lip, flat philtrum and midface, abnormal palmar creases, heart defects; priority is feeding and weight gain monitoring, low stimulation.
胎兒酒精譜系障礙：眼裂短、上唇薄、人中平坦、中臉扁平、手掌紋異常、心臟缺損；優先監測餵食與體重，減少刺激。

HIV-exposed newborn: standard precautions, no breastfeeding/chest-feeding, clean skin before injections, no circumcision until status known, PJP prophylaxis, antiretrovirals 6 weeks, delay live vaccines.
HIV暴露新生兒：標準防護、不哺乳、注射前清潔皮膚、確定感染狀態前不做包皮環切、預防肺囊蟲肺炎、抗反轉錄病毒藥物6週、延後活性疫苗。

Hypoglycemia <45 mg/dL (normal 45-60 day 1; 50-90 after): jitteriness, high-pitched cry, apnea, seizures; early feeds or IV glucose.
低血糖小於45 mg/dL（第1天正常45至60；之後50至90）：顫抖、高頻哭聲、呼吸中止、抽搐；儘早餵食或靜脈給葡萄糖。

Hypothyroidism: thick protruding tongue, hoarse cry, low tone, abdominal distention; thyroid replacement.
甲狀腺低下：舌大突出、哭聲沙啞、肌張力低、腹脹；甲狀腺素補充。

Mild obstruction: good air exchange, forceful cough; do not interfere. Severe: weak/no cough, high-pitched or no sound, cyanosis, cannot cry.
輕度阻塞：氣體交換良好、有力咳嗽；不要干預。重度：咳嗽無力或無聲、高頻或無聲音、發紺、無法哭。
Severe: 5 back slaps (head lower than chest, supported on forearm), then 5 chest thrusts (lower half of sternum); repeat; no blind finger sweeps; if unresponsive call for help and start CPR.
重度：5次背部拍擊（頭低於胸，以前臂支撐），再5次胸部推擠（胸骨下半）；重複進行；不可盲目手指清除；若無反應則求救並開始CPR。
Infant pulse check: brachial artery; infant = 1 year or younger.
嬰兒脈搏檢查：肱動脈；嬰兒指1歲或以下。
Apgar 8-10 no intervention; 4-7 stimulate and oxygen; 0-3 full resuscitation.
Apgar 8至10分不需處置；4至7分刺激與給氧；0至3分完整復甦。
Newborn norms: HR 110-160, RR 30-60, axillary temp 97.7 to <99.5 F, weight 2500-4000 g, head 33-35 cm.
Caput crosses sutures; cephalhematoma does not.
產瘤跨越縫合線；頭血腫不跨縫合線。
Jaundice in the first 24 hours is pathologic: report it.
出生24小時內出現黃疸為病理性：需通報。
Prevent heat loss: dry the infant (evaporation), warm surfaces (conduction), avoid drafts (convection), keep away from cold walls (radiation). Cold stress causes hypoglycemia and acidosis.
預防散熱：擦乾（蒸發）、暖墊（傳導）、避風（對流）、遠離冷牆（輻射）。受寒導致低血糖與酸中毒。
Vitamin K IM in the vastus lateralis prevents bleeding because newborn gut lacks bacteria to make it.
維生素K肌肉注射於股外側肌，因新生兒腸道無菌叢可合成而預防出血。
Erythromycin eye ointment within 1 hour prevents ophthalmia neonatorum from gonorrhea.
1小時內塗紅黴素眼藥膏以預防淋病引起的新生兒眼炎。
Put the baby to sleep on the back; avoid prone and side positions (SIDS).
嬰兒睡眠採仰臥；避免俯臥與側臥（SIDS）。
Signs of cord infection: moist, oozing, discharge, red base: call provider.
臍帶感染徵象：潮濕、滲液、分泌物、基部發紅：通知醫師。
RDS signs: tachypnea, grunting, retractions, flaring, cyanosis; give surfactant; barrel chest is not RDS.
RDS徵象：呼吸急促、呻吟、凹陷、鼻翼搧動、發紺；給予表面張力素；桶狀胸非RDS表現。
Phototherapy: eye shields, cover genitals, extra fluids, loose green stools expected, bronze baby syndrome, turn lights off for bilirubin draws.
光照療法：戴眼罩、遮蓋生殖器、多補水、預期綠色稀便、青銅寶寶症候群、抽膽紅素前關燈。
Continue breastfeeding with hyperbilirubinemia; feed every 2-4 hours.
高膽紅素血症仍持續哺乳；每2至4小時一次。
Rh-negative mother with Rh-positive baby: RhoGAM within 72 hours.
Rh陰性母親生下Rh陽性嬰兒：72小時內給RhoGAM。
NEC: no rectal temperatures; abdominal girth, bile-stained emesis, bloody stool.
壞死性腸炎：不量肛溫；腹圍、膽汁性嘔吐、血便。
Infant of diabetic mother: priority is hypoglycemia. Hypoglycemia <45 mg/dL.
糖尿病母親的新生兒：首要為低血糖；低血糖小於45 mg/dL。
HIV-positive parent: no breastfeeding; standard precautions; delay live vaccines.
HIV陽性父母：不哺乳；標準防護；延後活性疫苗。
Infant choking: 5 back blows then 5 chest thrusts; no blind finger sweeps.
嬰兒哽塞：5次背拍、5次胸推；不盲目手指清除。
Newborn abduction prevention: carry in bassinet only, badge check, never unattended.
防止新生兒被抱走：只用嬰兒車運送、檢查識別證、不可無人看護。
APGAR: Appearance (color), Pulse, Grimace (reflex), Activity (tone), Respiration.
APGAR：外觀（膚色）、脈搏、反射（做鬼臉）、活動（肌張力）、呼吸。

散熱四途徑：蒸發、傳導、輻射、對流。
Choking in infants: 5 and 5 - five back slaps, five chest thrusts.
嬰兒哽塞「5加5」：5次背拍、5次胸推。

FDA's PLLR replaced pregnancy letter categories (A, B, C, D, X) with narrative risk-benefit information.
FDA的PLLR取代了孕期字母分級（A、B、C、D、X），改以文字敘述風險與效益。

Tocolytics relax the uterus to delay preterm birth. Maternal contraindications: severe preeclampsia/eclampsia, active bleeding, intrauterine infection, cardiac disease, abruption, uncontrolled diabetes.
安胎藥使子宮放鬆以延遲早產。母體禁忌：重度子癇前症／子癇、活動性出血、子宮內感染、心臟病、胎盤早剝、血糖控制不良。
Fetal contraindications: >37 weeks, dilation >4 cm, fetal demise, lethal anomaly, chorioamnionitis, acute distress, chronic IUGR.
胎兒禁忌：大於37週、擴張大於4公分、胎死腹中、致死性異常、絨毛膜羊膜炎、急性窘迫、慢性生長遲滯。
Care: side-lying, frequent maternal/fetal/labor monitoring, adverse effects, daily weight, I&O, psychosocial support.
護理：側臥、頻繁監測母體／胎兒／產程、副作用、每日體重、輸出入量、心理支持。

Indomethacin (NSAID): not >2-3 days, avoid >32 weeks (ductus arteriosus closure), oligohydramnios, NEC/IVH risk. Nifedipine (calcium channel blocker): tachycardia, hypotension, headache, flushing; avoid with magnesium sulfate.
Indomethacin（NSAID）：不超過2至3天，32週後避免（動脈導管早閉）、羊水過少、增加NEC／腦室內出血風險。Nifedipine（鈣離子阻斷劑）：心搏過速、低血壓、頭痛、臉潮紅；避免與硫酸鎂併用。
CNS depressant and smooth muscle relaxant; used to prevent/control seizures in preeclampsia/eclampsia and sometimes for preterm labor. Antidote: calcium gluconate.
中樞神經抑制劑與平滑肌鬆弛劑；用於預防及控制子癇前症／子癇抽搐，有時用於早產。解毒劑：葡萄糖酸鈣。
Toxicity: respiratory depression (RR <12), loss of DTRs, hypotension, flushing, extreme weakness, urine output <25-30 mL/hr (<100 mL/4 hr), pulmonary edema, heart block, cardiac arrest.
中毒徵象：呼吸抑制（呼吸小於12次/分）、深肌腱反射消失、低血壓、臉潮紅、極度無力、尿量小於25至30 mL/小時（4小時小於100 mL）、肺水腫、心臟傳導阻滯、心跳停止。

Therapeutic level as tocolytic 4-7.5 mEq/L (2-3.75 mmol/L); check levels every 6 hr; give by IV pump only; check patellar reflex and RR before each parenteral dose; keep calcium gluconate and suction/oxygen at bedside.
作為安胎藥的治療濃度4至7.5 mEq/L（2至3.75 mmol/L）；每6小時檢測；僅用靜脈輸液幫浦給藥；每次注射前檢查膝反射與呼吸；床邊備葡萄糖酸鈣、抽吸與氧氣。
Contraindicated in heart block, myocardial damage, kidney failure; newborn may show hypotonia and sleepiness; if used for preeclampsia it continues 12-24 hr postpartum.
禁用於心臟傳導阻滯、心肌損傷、腎衰竭；新生兒可能肌張力低、嗜睡；用於子癇前症時產後持續12至24小時。
DTR grading 0-4: 2 is expected; 0 none, 1 diminished, 3 brisk, 4 clonus.
深肌腱反射分級0至4：2為預期正常；0無反應、1減弱、3較活躍、4陣攣。

Betamethasone/dexamethasone speed fetal lung maturity (surfactant) for preterm labor at 28-32 weeks if labor can be delayed 48 hr; deep IM; monitor infection, WBC, glucose (hyperglycemia in diabetics), pulmonary edema.
Betamethasone／dexamethasone促進胎兒肺成熟（表面張力素）；用於28至32週早產且可延遲48小時者；深部肌肉注射；監測感染、白血球、血糖（糖尿病者血糖升高）、肺水腫。

Opioid analgesics in labor: withhold and call provider if RR <=12; monitor FHR and contractions, hypotension (keep recumbent with hip wedge), bladder; keep naloxone ready (may precipitate withdrawal in dependent clients). Newborn withdrawal: irritability, tremors, seizures.
產程鴉片類止痛藥：呼吸小於等於12次/分暫停給藥並通知醫師；監測胎心與宮縮、低血壓（採側臥並以楔形枕墊髖）、膀胱；備妥naloxone（對依賴者可誘發戒斷）。新生兒戒斷：易怒、顫抖、抽搐。

Prostaglandins ripen cervix when Bishop score <=4 (dinoprostone PGE2 gel/insert; misoprostol PGE1). Effects: GI upset, fever, tachysystole (>=12 contractions in 20 min), hyperstimulation, meconium. Client voids first, lies supine with lateral tilt or side-lying 30-60 min (gel) to 2 hr (insert). Stop when Bishop >=8 or 3+ contractions in 10 min; oxytocin can start 6-12 hr later.
前列腺素用於Bishop評分小於等於4時軟化子宮頸（dinoprostone PGE2凝膠／栓劑；misoprostol PGE1）。副作用：腸胃不適、發燒、過度收縮（20分鐘內大於等於12次）、過度刺激、胎便。先排尿，採仰臥並側傾或側臥：凝膠30至60分鐘、栓劑至2小時。Bishop達8以上或10分鐘內達3次以上宮縮即停；催產素可於6至12小時後開始。
Prostaglandin contraindications include prior cesarean or uterine surgery, fetal malpresentation, nonreassuring FHR, previa, significant CPD, regular contractions.
前列腺素禁忌：曾剖腹產或子宮手術、胎位不正、胎心不安心、前置胎盤、明顯頭骨盆不對稱、已有規律宮縮。

Oxytocin: increases force, frequency, duration of contractions; milk let-down; induces or augments labor, controls postpartum bleeding. Give IV by pump, piggyback at port nearest the insertion, never leave client unattended. Monitor vitals, contractions, FHR every 15 min. Risks: hypertonic contractions, uterine rupture, water intoxication, postpartum atony. Contraindicated with inability to deliver vaginally, hypertonic contractions, active genital herpes.
催產素：增強宮縮強度、頻率與持續時間；促進泌乳排出；引產或加強宮縮、控制產後出血。以靜脈幫浦給藥，接在最靠近穿刺處的接口，不可離開產婦。每15分鐘監測生命徵象、宮縮與胎心。風險：高張性宮縮、子宮破裂、水中毒、產後子宮收縮不良。禁忌：無法經陰道生產、高張性宮縮、活動性生殖器疱疹。
If hyperstimulation or nonreassuring FHR: stop oxytocin, side-lying, increase plain IV fluid, oxygen by face mask; have magnesium sulfate available to relax uterus.
若過度刺激或胎心不安心：停催產素、側臥、增加無藥輸液速度、面罩給氧；備妥硫酸鎂以放鬆子宮。
Dose example: oxytocin 2 mU/min from 20 U in 1000 mL = 0.1 mL/min = 6 mL/hr (convert mU to U first).
劑量範例：催產素2 mU/分，配置為20 U加於1000 mL，等於0.1 mL/分＝6 mL/小時（先將mU換算為U）。

Methylergonovine (ergot alkaloid): firm tetanic uterine contraction, vasoconstriction. Give only after placenta delivered. Check BP first; withhold and notify if BP raised. Contraindicated in hypertension, preeclampsia, cardiovascular and peripheral vascular disease. Adverse: nausea, cramping, bradycardia, severe hypertension, MI.
Methylergonovine（麥角生物鹼）：使子宮強直收縮、血管收縮。僅於胎盤娩出後使用。給藥前先量血壓；血壓高則暫停並通知醫師。禁用於高血壓、子癇前症、心血管與周邊血管疾病。副作用：噁心、絞痛、心搏過緩、嚴重高血壓、心肌梗塞。
Carboprost (PGF2 alpha): contracts uterus; adverse headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, fever, tachycardia, hypertension; contraindicated in asthma.
Carboprost（PGF2α）：使子宮收縮；副作用頭痛、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉、發燒、心搏過速、高血壓；氣喘者禁用。
催產素為首選子宮收縮劑。
Rho(D) immune globulin and rubella vaccine
Rho(D)免疫球蛋白與德國麻疹疫苗

Rho(D) IG: Rh-negative, antibody-negative client; IM at 28 weeks and within 72 hr after delivery of an Rh-positive baby; also after amniocentesis, CVS, abortion, trauma, bleeding. Never IV, not for the newborn, no benefit if already sensitized (positive titer).
Rho(D)免疫球蛋白：用於Rh陰性且抗體陰性者；28週肌肉注射，分娩Rh陽性嬰兒後72小時內再注射；羊膜穿刺、絨毛取樣、流產、外傷、出血後亦需給予。不可靜脈注射、不給新生兒、已致敏（抗體滴度陽性）者無效。
Rho(D) immune globulin and rubella vaccine
Rho(D)免疫球蛋白與德國麻疹疫苗
Rubella vaccine: subcutaneous before discharge if titer <1:8; check egg allergy and immunocompromised household members; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months.
德國麻疹疫苗：滴度小於1:8者出院前皮下注射；評估蛋過敏與家人免疫功能低下；1至3個月內避免懷孕。
Rho(D) immune globulin and rubella vaccine
Rho(D)免疫球蛋白與德國麻疹疫苗
Surfactant: intratracheal for RDS; watch bradycardia and desaturation; no suctioning for 2 hours after.
表面張力素：氣管內給藥治療RDS；注意心搏過緩與血氧下降；給藥後2小時內避免抽吸。
Erythromycin eye ointment: legally required; prevents gonorrhea and chlamydia ophthalmia; clean eyes first, do not flush; may delay up to 1 hr for bonding.
紅黴素眼藥膏：法律規定；預防淋病與披衣菌所致眼炎；先清潔眼睛、給藥後不沖洗；為親子依附可延後最多1小時。
Phytonadione (vitamin K): protect from light; IM into the vastus lateralis; newborns deficient for first 5-8 days; rare hyperbilirubinemia; monitor bruising and cord bleeding.
維生素K（phytonadione）：避光；肌肉注射於股外側肌；新生兒前5至8天缺乏；少見高膽紅素血症；監測瘀青與臍帶出血。
Hepatitis B vaccine IM in vastus lateralis before discharge with parental consent; if mother HBsAg-positive, add hepatitis B immune globulin within 12 hr of birth.
B型肝炎疫苗於出院前取得同意後肌肉注射股外側肌；母親HBsAg陽性者，出生12小時內加打B型肝炎免疫球蛋白。
Combined estrogen-progestin suppress ovulation and thicken cervical mucus; usually 21 days on, 7 off; full effect up to 1 week.
雌激素合併黃體素複方抑制排卵並使子宮頸黏液變稠；通常服21天、停7天；可能需1週才完全有效。

Risk: smoking, obesity, hypertension. Contraindicated: hypertension, thromboembolism, CVA/CAD, estrogen-dependent cancer, pregnancy. Antibiotics may reduce effectiveness; report thromboembolic signs; diabetics monitor glucose.
風險：吸菸、肥胖、高血壓。禁忌：高血壓、血栓栓塞、腦中風／冠心病、雌激素依賴性癌症、懷孕。抗生素可能降低效果；回報血栓徵象；糖尿病者監測血糖。

Patch: 3 weeks on, 1 week off, new site weekly; off <24 hr reapply/replace, >24 hr start new cycle. Ring: 3 weeks in, 1 out; discard in foil, not toilet. Use backup 2 months after stopping before conceiving.
貼片：貼3週、停1週，每週換新位置；脫落小於24小時可重貼或換新，超過24小時需開始新週期。陰道環：置入3週、取出1週；以鋁箔包好丟棄，不可丟馬桶。停藥後為排出荷爾蒙，需再避孕2個月才受孕。

Fertility drugs (clomiphene, menotropins, FSH analogs, hCG): risks multiple births, ovarian hyperstimulation (abdominal pain, distention, ascites, pleural effusion); teach timing of intercourse and follow-up.
助孕藥（clomiphene、menotropins、FSH類似物、hCG）：風險為多胞胎、卵巢過度刺激（腹痛、腹脹、腹水、肋膜積水）；衛教行房時機與追蹤。
Magnesium sulfate toxicity: RR <12, absent DTRs, urine output <25-30 mL/hr; stop infusion, give calcium gluconate, notify provider.
硫酸鎂中毒：呼吸小於12、DTR消失、尿量小於25至30 mL/小時；停藥、給葡萄糖酸鈣、通知醫師。
Therapeutic magnesium 4-7.5 mEq/L; give with IV pump; keep calcium gluconate at bedside.
鎂的治療濃度4至7.5 mEq/L；以靜脈幫浦給藥；床邊備葡萄糖酸鈣。
Oxytocin: stop for hyperstimulation, late decelerations or nonreassuring FHR; turn side-lying, increase plain IV fluid, oxygen.
催產素：過度刺激、晚期減速或胎心不安心時停藥；側臥、增加無藥輸液、給氧。
Oxytocin calculation: 2 mU/min from 20 U/1000 mL = 6 mL/hr.
催產素計算：2 mU/分，20 U/1000 mL＝6 mL/小時。
Methylergonovine: check BP first; contraindicated in hypertension, preeclampsia, vascular disease; given only after placenta delivery.
Methylergonovine：先量血壓；高血壓、子癇前症、血管疾病禁用；胎盤娩出後才給。
Betamethasone at 28-32 weeks accelerates fetal lung maturity if labor can be delayed 48 hours.
28至32週給betamethasone，若可延遲48小時則加速胎兒肺成熟。
Naloxone reverses opioid respiratory depression; withhold opioid if RR <=12.
Naloxone可逆轉鴉片類呼吸抑制；呼吸小於等於12次/分暫停鴉片類。
Rho(D) IG: IM only, 28 weeks and within 72 hr of birth; not for Rh-positive mothers or the newborn; no help once sensitized.
Rho(D)免疫球蛋白：僅肌肉注射，28週與產後72小時內；Rh陽性母親與新生兒不用；已致敏無效。
Rubella vaccine: give if titer <1:8; avoid pregnancy 1-3 months.
德國麻疹疫苗：滴度小於1:8給予；1至3個月避免懷孕。
Surfactant is given intratracheal; no suctioning for 2 hours.
表面張力素經氣管內給予；2小時內不抽吸。
Newborn eye ointment: don't flush; within 1 hour; prevents gonorrhea/chlamydia ophthalmia.
新生兒眼藥膏：不沖洗；1小時內；預防淋病與披衣菌眼炎。
Vitamin K IM in vastus lateralis; hepatitis B vaccine plus HBIG within 12 hr if mother HBsAg-positive.
維生素K肌肉注射於股外側肌；母親HBsAg陽性者12小時內加打HBIG與B肝疫苗。
Indomethacin tocolysis: no more than 2-3 days and not after 32 weeks (ductus closure).
Indomethacin安胎：不超過2至3天，32週後不用（動脈導管閉合）。
Nifedipine plus magnesium sulfate can cause severe hypotension; avoid combination.
Nifedipine合併硫酸鎂可造成嚴重低血壓；避免併用。
Antibiotics may reduce oral contraceptive effectiveness: use backup method.
抗生素可能降低口服避孕藥效果：需使用備用避孕方式。
Magnesium toxicity: check the 3 Rs-- Respirations (>=12), Reflexes (present), Renal output (>=25-30 mL/hr).
鎂中毒檢查三R：呼吸（至少12）、反射（存在）、腎臟尿量（至少25至30 mL/小時）。
Oxytocin trouble: stop, side, fluids, oxygen (stop drip, turn to side, increase plain IV, O2 8-10 L/min).
催產素出問題：停藥、側臥、輸液、給氧（停滴、側臥、增加無藥輸液、氧氣8至10 L/分）。
Antidotes: magnesium - calcium gluconate; opioids - naloxone.
解毒劑：鎂－葡萄糖酸鈣；鴉片類－naloxone。

Superficial inflammation of the epidermis; linked to family history, allergies, asthma, allergic rhinitis.
表皮淺層發炎；與家族史、過敏、氣喘、過敏性鼻炎有關。
Signs: itching, redness, scaling, tiny papules and vesicles, weeping/oozing and crusting; typical on scalp, face, elbow/knee creases, neck, wrists, ankles; axilla, buttocks, groin uncommon.
症狀：搔癢、紅斑、脫屑、小丘疹與水泡、滲液結痂；好發頭皮、臉、肘膝彎處、頸、腕、踝；腋下、臀、鼠蹊少見。
Infantile form starts at 2-6 months and may remit by 3 years; childhood form 2-3 years; adolescent form from about 12 years onward.
嬰兒型 2–6 個月開始，3 歲前可能緩解；兒童型 2–3 歲；青少年型約 12 歲起。
Goals: relieve itch, hydrate skin, reduce inflammation, prevent/control secondary infection.
目標：止癢、保濕、消炎、預防或控制續發感染。
Short (5-10 min) lukewarm baths, oatmeal soothing; moisturize immediately with thick cream/ointment.
短時間（5–10 分鐘）微溫水浴，可用燕麥浴；浴後立即塗厚層乳霜或軟膏。
Topical medication goes on within 3 minutes after the bath, before the moisturizer; corticosteroids in a thin layer rubbed in well.
外用藥於浴後 3 分鐘內先塗，再塗保濕劑；類固醇薄塗並充分推開。
Avoid irritants: harsh soaps, detergents, fabric softeners, wipes, powder, wool, latex, heat, wet diapers.
避免刺激物：刺激性肥皂、洗衣精、柔軟精、濕紙巾、爽身粉、羊毛、乳膠、高溫、濕尿布。
Keep nails short, cover hands with gloves/cotton socks; cool wet compresses for itch.
指甲剪短，手戴手套或棉襪；冷濕敷止癢。
Honey-colored crusts with surrounding redness means secondary infection: seek care promptly.
蜜黃色痂皮伴周圍紅斑代表續發感染，應立即就醫。
Contagious skin infection by group A strep and Staphylococcus aureus; more common in hot, humid months, often at insect bites or damaged skin.
由 A 群鏈球菌與金黃色葡萄球菌引起的傳染性皮膚感染；炎熱潮濕季節多見，常發生於蚊蟲叮咬或受損皮膚。
Most common on face around mouth/nose, then hands, neck, extremities; vesicles/pustules rupture leaving honey-colored crusts.

Infection: protective isolation, private room (HEPA), strict asepsis, masks, no raw fruits/vegetables, no fresh flowers or standing water, daily antimicrobial bath, frequent oral care.
感染防護：保護性隔離、單人房（HEPA）、嚴格無菌技術、戴口罩、不吃生鮮蔬果、禁鮮花與積水、每日抗菌洗澡、常口腔護理。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護
Avoid injections, rectal temperatures, catheterization; give G-CSF; no live-virus vaccines or varicella vaccine; inactivated polio ok.
避免注射、肛溫、導尿；給予 G-CSF；不可打活性病毒疫苗與水痘疫苗；可打不活化小兒麻痺疫苗。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護
Neutropenic fever: obtain cultures and CBC with differential, then start antibiotics.
嗜中性球低下發燒：先採檢體培養與 CBC 分類，再給抗生素。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護

Bleeding: platelet transfusion for active bleeding unresponsive to local care; soft toothbrush, no floss, no NSAIDs/aspirin, no rectal meds, firm pressure 10 minutes after needlestick, measure abdominal girth.
出血防護：活動性出血且局部處理無效才輸血小板；軟毛牙刷、不用牙線、禁 NSAID/阿斯匹靈、禁肛門給藥、針刺後加壓至少 10 分鐘、量腹圍。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護
Chemo: watch nadir, nausea/vomiting (antiemetics before, during, after), constipation (stool softeners), mucositis, hemorrhagic cystitis, peripheral neuropathy; hair regrows in 3-6 months.
化療：留意最低點（nadir）、噁心嘔吐（化療前中後給止吐藥）、便祕（軟便劑）、黏膜炎、出血性膀胱炎、周邊神經病變；毛髮 3–6 個月再生。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護
Small, soft, non-irritating meals; cluster care to conserve energy.
少量、軟、無刺激飲食；集中護理節省體力。
Protecting from infection, bleeding; chemotherapy care
防感染、防出血與化療照護
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
Infant ICP signs: bulging fontanel, split sutures, Macewen sign, high-pitched cry, setting-sun eyes; older child: headache, forceful vomiting, diplopia, seizures.
嬰兒顱內壓徵象：囪門膨出、縫線分離、Macewen 徵象、高頻哭聲、落日眼；較大兒童：頭痛、噴射嘔吐、複視、癲癇。
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
Late ICP signs: bradycardia, pupil changes, posturing, Cheyne-Stokes, papilledema, coma.
顱內壓晚期徵象：心搏過緩、瞳孔改變、去大腦/去皮質姿勢、Cheyne-Stokes 呼吸、視乳突水腫、昏迷。
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
Hodgkin: lymph node malignancy with Reed-Sternberg cells; peak mid-adolescence; excellent prognosis.
何杰金氏病：淋巴結惡性腫瘤，可見 Reed-Sternberg 細胞；高峰在青春中期；預後佳。
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
Painless firm movable cervical/supraclavicular nodes, nonproductive cough, fever, night sweats, weight loss, pruritus; biopsy confirms.
無痛、硬、可移動的頸部/鎖骨上淋巴結、乾咳、發燒、盜汗、體重減輕、搔癢；切片確診。
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
Treat with chemo +/- radiation; Table 32.1 lists radiation effects (anorexia, mucositis, alopecia, skin desquamation, cystitis, myelosuppression).
以化療加/不加放療；表 32.1 列放療副作用（厭食、黏膜炎、掉髮、皮膚脫屑、膀胱炎、骨髓抑制）。
顱內壓上升與何杰金氏病
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Wilms: most common childhood kidney/intra-abdominal tumor, peak age 3; firm, nontender, one-sided flank mass, hematuria, hypertension (renin), anemia, fever.
威爾姆氏瘤：兒童最常見腎臟/腹內腫瘤，高峰 3 歲；單側側腹硬、無痛腫塊、血尿、高血壓（腎素）、貧血、發燒。
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Do NOT palpate the abdomen (risk of tumor rupture and spread); post sign; measure girth daily; handle gently. Treatment: nephrectomy plus chemo +/- radiation.
勿觸診腹部（腫瘤破裂擴散風險）；床邊放警示牌；每日量腹圍；輕柔搬動。治療：腎切除加化療 ± 放療。
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Post-op Wilms: monitor BP, temperature, hemorrhage, infection, I&O, bowel sounds/obstruction.
威爾姆氏瘤術後：監測血壓、體溫、出血、感染、輸出入量、腸音/腸阻塞。
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Neuroblastoma: neural crest tumor of adrenal medulla/sympathetic chain; diagnosed late with metastasis; urine VMA, HVA, dopamine, norepinephrine elevated.
神經母細胞瘤：源自腎上腺髓質/交感神經鏈的神經嵴腫瘤；多診斷時已轉移；尿 VMA、HVA、多巴胺、正腎上腺素升高。
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Firm irregular abdominal mass crossing midline, bone pain, periorbital ecchymosis/exophthalmos, cord compression paralysis; younger age gives better survival.
堅硬不規則腹部腫塊且越過中線、骨痛、眼眶周圍瘀斑/突眼、脊髓壓迫麻痺；診斷年齡越小存活越好。
威爾姆氏瘤與神經母細胞瘤
Most common bone cancer in children, peak age 13-16, metaphysis of long bones, often femur.
兒童最常見骨癌，高峰 13–16 歲，長骨幹骺端，多在股骨。
Localized pain (often relieved by flexion), mass, limp, limited ROM, pathological fracture; early mistaken for growing pains.
局部疼痛（屈曲時緩解）、腫塊、跛行、活動受限、病理性骨折；早期常誤為生長痛。
Treatment: chemo plus limb-salvage surgery or amputation; prosthesis fitting; teach phantom limb pain (tingling, itching, pain).
治療：化療加保肢手術或截肢；義肢配置；教導幻肢痛（刺麻、癢、痛）。
支持身體心像；誠實溝通。
Infratentorial (posterior, cerebellum/brainstem) tumors are most common in children; supratentorial in cerebrum; MRI is the main diagnostic.
幕下（後方，小腦/腦幹）腫瘤在兒童最常見；幕上位於大腦；MRI 為主要診斷。
Signs: morning headache improving through the day, vomiting unrelated to feeding, ataxia, seizures, behavior change, diplopia, facial weakness.
徵象：晨起頭痛白天緩解、與進食無關的嘔吐、共濟失調、癲癇、行為改變、複視、顏面無力。
Preop: neuro checks at least every 4 hours, seizure precautions, nutrition assessment, prepare child for large head dressing.
術前：至少每 4 小時神經評估、癲癇防護、營養評估、告知術後會有大頭部敷料。
Postop: neuro and pupil checks, temperature (cooling blanket), meningitis signs, ICP signs, hemorrhage (check back of dressing), prevent vomiting, quiet environment.
術後：神經與瞳孔檢查、體溫（備降溫毯）、腦膜炎徵象、顱內壓徵象、出血（檢查敷料後方）、預防嘔吐、安靜環境。
Clear/colorless drainage = CSF (glucose positive on dipstick): report immediately.
無色引流液＝腦脊髓液（試紙測葡萄糖陽性）：立即通報。
Positioning: never Trendelenburg; supratentorial: head elevated; infratentorial: flat or on side; after large tumor removal avoid operative side.
擺位：絕不採頭低腳高；幕上手術抬高頭部；幕下手術平躺或側臥；大型腫瘤切除後避免壓術側。
Colorless drainage on a craniotomy dressing is CSF: notify the surgeon immediately.
開顱術後敷料無色滲液＝腦脊髓液：立即通知外科醫師。
Do not palpate the abdomen in suspected Wilms tumor.
疑似威爾姆氏瘤不可觸診腹部。
Never place a post-craniotomy child in Trendelenburg or supine; it raises ICP.
開顱術後絕不採頭低腳高或平躺；會增加顱內壓。
Bone marrow biopsy with blasts confirms leukemia; Reed-Sternberg cells confirm Hodgkin.
骨髓見 blast 確診白血病；Reed-Sternberg 細胞確診何杰金氏病。
Platelets below 50,000 call for bleeding precautions (example 19,500 mm3).
血小板低於 50,000 需出血防護（例：19,500 mm3）。
No fresh flowers, plants or standing water for neutropenic children (Aspergillus, Pseudomonas).
嗜中性球低下兒童禁鮮花、植物與積水（麴菌、綠膿桿菌）。
Neutropenic fever: cultures and CBC with differential first, then antibiotics.
嗜中性球低下發燒：先採培養與 CBC 分類，再給抗生素。
No live virus vaccines for immunosuppressed child; inactivated polio acceptable.
免疫抑制兒童禁打活性病毒疫苗；不活化小兒麻痺可。
Vomiting is an early ICP sign in a child whose fontanels are closed; infants show bulging fontanel.
囪門已閉的兒童嘔吐是顱內壓上升早期徵象；嬰兒則見囪門膨出。
尿 VMA 升高提示神經母細胞瘤。
Avoid aspirin/NSAIDs, rectal temperatures, enemas, suppositories, injections in thrombocytopenic child.
血小板低下兒童避免阿斯匹靈/NSAID、肛溫、灌腸、塞劑、注射。
Osteosarcoma pain often dismissed as growing pains; femur most common.
骨肉瘤疼痛常被誤認為生長痛；股骨最常見。
ICP early vs late: vomiting, headache early; bradycardia, posturing late (Cushing-type).
顱內壓早期：嘔吐、頭痛；晚期：心搏過緩、姿勢異常。
After a craniotomy the nurse notes colorless drainage on the back of the head dressing. What is the first action?
開顱術後護理師發現頭部敷料後側有無色滲液，首要行動為何？
A 4-year-old has a swollen abdomen, eats well, normal activity. Wilms tumor is suspected. What does the nurse avoid?
4 歲孩童腹脹、食慾與活動正常，疑威爾姆氏瘤，護理師應避免什麼？
A child with leukemia has a platelet count of 19,500/mm3. Which intervention is included?
白血病孩童血小板 19,500/mm3，應納入何項措施？
Which finding confirms the diagnosis of Hodgkin disease?
何項檢查結果可確診何杰金氏病？
A grandparent brings fresh garden flowers for a neutropenic child. Best response?
祖父母帶了花園鮮花給嗜中性球低下的孩童，最佳回應為何？
Which interventions reduce infection risk in a child with leukemia? Select all that apply.
哪些措施可降低白血病孩童感染風險？（多選）
A 3-year-old post-craniotomy: which is an early sign of increased ICP?
3 歲孩童開顱術後，何為顱內壓上升的早期徵象？
Which statement about osteosarcoma shows a need for more teaching?
關於骨肉瘤，何項陳述顯示需再教導？

框 32.1 各年齡顱內壓徵象；框 32.2 防感染措施。
Fig 32.1 Hodgkin lymph node areas; Clinical Judgment cues.
圖 32.1 何杰金氏病淋巴結部位；臨床判斷線索。
Table 32.1 radiation adverse effects and nursing care.
表 32.1 放射治療副作用與護理。
Fever is 38.0 C (100.4 F) or higher; normal about 36.4-37.0 C. Fever in an infant under 1 month is an emergency: call the provider immediately.
發燒定義為 ≥38.0°C（100.4°F）；正常約 36.4–37.0°C。未滿 1 個月嬰兒發燒屬緊急，須立即聯絡醫師。
Signs: flushed warm skin, diaphoresis, chills, restlessness or lethargy.
徵象：皮膚潮紅溫熱、出汗、寒顫、躁動或嗜睡。
Remove excess clothing/blankets, cool room, circulate air; acetaminophen, or ibuprofen if older than 6 months; no aspirin (Reye syndrome).
脫去多餘衣被、降低室溫、增加通風；給予乙醯胺酚，或 6 個月以上給 ibuprofen；禁用阿斯匹靈（雷氏症候群）。
Recheck temperature 30-60 minutes after antipyretic; encourage fluids; avoid cold sponge baths (shivering).
退燒藥後 30–60 分鐘再測體溫；鼓勵飲水；避免冷水擦浴（引發顫抖）。
Infants/children are vulnerable: immature kidneys and more body water in extracellular fluid.
嬰幼兒易脫水：腎臟未成熟且細胞外液比例較高。

Table 33.1: mild 3-5% (infant) weight loss; moderate 6-9%; severe 10% or more. Severe: very fast pulse, hyperpnea, lethargy, absent tears, sunken fontanel, capillary refill over 4 sec, oliguria/anuria.
表 33.1：輕度體重減少 3–5%（嬰兒）；中度 6–9%；重度 ≥10%。重度：脈搏很快、深快呼吸、嗜睡、無淚、囪門凹陷、微血管再充填 >4 秒、少尿/無尿。
Monitor weight, I&O, urine specific gravity, LOC, skin turgor, mucous membranes.
監測體重、輸出入量、尿比重、意識、皮膚彈性、黏膜。
Mild-moderate: oral rehydration (Pedialyte); avoid carbonated drinks and apple juice. Severe: NPO and IV fluids.
輕中度：口服電解質液（如 Pedialyte）；避免碳酸飲料與蘋果汁。重度：禁食並靜脈輸液。
Before IV potassium confirm the child has voided and has adequate renal function.
給靜脈鉀前確認已排尿且腎功能足夠。
Autosomal recessive; phenylalanine toxic to CNS. PKU: phenylalanine above 20 mg/dL; normal 0-2 mg/dL.
體染色體隱性；苯丙胺酸對中樞神經有毒性。PKU：苯丙胺酸 >20 mg/dL；正常 0–2 mg/dL。
Signs: vomiting, seizures, musty urine odor, intellectual disability; older: eczema, hypertonia, hypopigmentation, hyperactivity.
徵象：嘔吐、癲癇、尿液霉味、智能障礙；較大：濕疹、肌張力高、毛髮皮膚虹膜色素減退、過動。
Newborn screening after feeding begun; rescreen by 14 days if first test before 24 hours old.
新生兒篩檢須已開始餵奶；若 24 小時內採檢，14 天內再篩。
Restrict phenylalanine: meats, dairy, aspartame; use special formula; allowed cereals, pasta, rice, fruits, vegetables; follow-up and social support.
限制苯丙胺酸：肉類、乳製品、阿斯巴甜；使用特殊配方奶；可吃穀類、麵、飯、蔬果；定期追蹤與社會資源。
Use BMI percentile for ages 2-20: overweight 85th to under 95th; obese above 95th; severe obesity 120% of 95th percentile or BMI 35 or more.
2–20 歲使用 BMI 百分位：過重 85th 至 <95th；肥胖 >95th；重度肥胖為 95th 的 120% 或 BMI ≥35。
Consequences: asthma, sleep apnea, joint problems, type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia, heart disease, adult obesity.
後果：氣喘、睡眠呼吸中止、關節問題、第二型糖尿病、高血脂、心臟病、成年肥胖。
Box 33.1: water instead of sugary drinks, more fruits/vegetables, 60 minutes activity daily, screen time limited to 60 minutes.
框 33.1：以水取代含糖飲料、多吃蔬果、每日活動 60 分鐘、螢幕時間限 60 分鐘。
Type 1: beta-cell destruction and absolute insulin deficiency. Type 2: insulin resistance; overweight is the top childhood risk.
第一型：胰島 beta 細胞破壞，絕對缺乏胰島素。第二型：胰島素阻抗；過重為最大危險因子。
Signs: polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, weight loss, fatigue, enuresis in toilet-trained child, vaginal candidiasis, fruity breath, blurred vision, slow healing. DKA can be first presentation.
徵象：多尿、多渴、多食、體重減輕、疲倦、已訓練如廁者遺尿、陰道念珠菌感染、水果味呼吸、視力模糊、傷口難癒。DKA 可能是首次表現。
Diet: three meals plus midafternoon and bedtime snacks, consistent carbohydrate; fat 30% or less; carry glucose tablets.
飲食：三餐加下午與睡前點心，碳水穩定；脂肪 ≤30%；隨身攜帶葡萄糖錠。
Exercise: 10-15 g extra carbohydrate per 30-45 minutes of activity; check glucose before and after.
運動：每 30–45 分鐘活動加 10–15 g 碳水；運動前後測血糖。
Long-term: growth failure, neuropathy, retinal and renal microvascular disease, cardiovascular disease.
長期併發症：生長遲緩、神經病變、視網膜與腎微血管病變、心血管疾病。
HbA1c every 3 months (reference under 6%). Never withhold insulin during illness; stress and infection raise insulin need.
每 3 個月測 HbA1c（參考值 <6%）。生病時不可停胰島素；感染與壓力使需求增加。
Teach hypo/hyperglycemia recognition, glucagon IM/SC for unconscious child, spare insulin, MedicAlert.
教導辨識低/高血糖、無法進食者施打 glucagon（IM/SC）、備用胰島素、醫療警示手環。
Blood glucose monitoring more accurate than urine; second-voided urine for ketones; test ketones when ill or glucose persistently over 200 mg/dL.
血糖監測比尿糖準確；尿酮用第二次排尿；生病或血糖持續 >200 mg/dL 時驗尿酮。
Less painful finger sticks: warm finger, side of the pad, ring finger or thumb, light lancet pressure.
減輕採血疼痛：先溫手、取指腹側邊、用無名指或拇指、輕壓採血筆。
Hypoglycemia: under 70 mg/dL; sweating, tremors, hunger, headache, confusion, slurred speech, perioral tingling.
低血糖：<70 mg/dL；出汗、顫抖、飢餓、頭痛、意識混亂、口齒不清、口周麻刺。
Treat at once with fast sugar (1/2 cup juice, 2-3 glucose tablets, 1 tsp honey), then complex carbohydrate plus protein; if unconscious, glucose paste on gums, glucagon, IV dextrose in hospital.
立即給快速糖（1/2 杯果汁、2–3 顆葡萄糖錠、1 茶匙蜂蜜），再給複合碳水加蛋白質；昏迷則牙齦塗糖膏、glucagon、院內靜脈葡萄糖。

Hyperglycemia: over 200 mg/dL; polyuria, polydipsia, blurred vision. Sick-day rules: always give insulin, test glucose every 4 hours, ketones each void, fluids, rest, call provider if vomiting, fruity breath, deep fast breathing, decreased LOC.
高血糖：>200 mg/dL；多尿、多渴、視力模糊。生病日原則：照打胰島素、至少每 4 小時測血糖、每次排尿驗酮、多喝水、休息；嘔吐、水果味呼吸、深快呼吸、意識下降須通知醫師。
Severe insulin deficiency: glucose over 300 mg/dL, positive serum and urine ketones, metabolic acidosis; Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, lethargy.
嚴重胰島素缺乏：血糖 >300 mg/dL、血尿酮陽性、代謝性酸中毒；Kussmaul 呼吸、水果味呼吸、嗜睡。
First: restore volume with IV 0.9% or 0.45% saline; then IV regular insulin; dextrose added when glucose falls.
首要：以靜脈 0.9% 或 0.45% 生理食鹽水補充血容量；再給靜脈常規胰島素；血糖降低後加葡萄糖。
Monitor potassium closely (falls with insulin); give potassium only if child is voiding; watch for fluid overload and cerebral edema; give oxygen as prescribed.
密切監測鉀（胰島素使鉀下降）；有排尿才補鉀；留意體液過多與腦水腫；依醫囑給氧。
Fever 38.0 C (100.4 F) in an infant under 1 month: emergency.
未滿 1 個月嬰兒體溫 38.0°C：緊急。
Never give aspirin to a febrile child (Reye syndrome).
發燒孩童勿給阿斯匹靈（雷氏症候群）。
PKU: phenylalanine over 20 mg/dL; normal 0-2; avoid aspartame and high-protein foods.
PKU：苯丙胺酸 >20 mg/dL；正常 0–2；避免阿斯巴甜與高蛋白食物。
Hypoglycemia is under 70 mg/dL: give fast carbohydrate immediately, do not delay to recheck.
低血糖 <70 mg/dL：立即給快速碳水，勿延遲。
Do not withhold insulin during illness; test ketones; push fluids.
生病時不可停胰島素；驗尿酮；多補水。
DKA: glucose over 300, ketones, Kussmaul breathing; initial treatment is IV normal saline, not dextrose or potassium.
DKA：血糖 >300、酮體、Kussmaul 呼吸；初始治療為靜脈生理食鹽水，非葡萄糖或鉀。

Viral, bacterial (group A strep) or fungal; enlarged tonsils/adenoids cause snoring, mouth breathing, nasal speech, obstructive sleep apnea.
病毒、細菌（A 群鏈球菌）或黴菌；扁桃腺/腺樣體腫大造成打鼾、口呼吸、鼻音、阻塞性睡眠呼吸中止。
Signs: sore throat, bright red tonsils with exudate, dysphagia, fever, bad breath, cough.
徵象：喉嚨痛、扁桃腺鮮紅有滲出物、吞嚥困難、發燒、口臭、咳嗽。
Preop: check for active infection, bleeding/clotting studies (PT), loose teeth, prepare for sore throat.

Surgery depends on infections per year and obstructive disturbance.

Position prone or side-lying; suction equipment ready but do not suction unless obstruction.
採俯臥或側臥；備抽吸設備但除非阻塞勿抽吸。
Bleeding signs: frequent swallowing or throat clearing; bright red vomit; turn child to side and notify provider.

Avoid coughing, throat clearing, nose blowing; ice collar and analgesics; antiemetics.
避免咳嗽、清喉嚨、擤鼻；冰領與止痛；止吐藥。
Clear, cool, noncitrus, noncarbonated fluids; avoid red/purple/brown liquids and milk products initially; no straws or sharp objects.
給清澈、冰涼、非柑橘、非碳酸飲料；避免紅/紫/棕色液體與初期乳製品；不用吸管或尖銳物。
Mild fever, bad breath, ear pain for a few days; report bleeding, persistent earache or fever; normal activity in 1-2 weeks.
數日內可有輕微發燒、口臭、耳痛；出血、持續耳痛或發燒須通報；1–2 週恢復活動。
Epistaxis from trauma, foreign body, nose picking; recurrent/severe bleeding suggests underlying disease.
鼻出血來自外傷、異物、挖鼻；反覆或嚴重出血提示潛在疾病。
First aid: sit up, lean forward, continuous pressure with thumb and finger at least 10 minutes, ice to bridge, ED if uncontrolled.
急救：坐起前傾、拇指食指持續加壓至少 10 分鐘、鼻梁冰敷、無法止血送急診。
Allergic rhinitis: itchy watery eyes, clear drainage, dark circles, pale nasal mucosa, cobblestoning; test for allergies, eczema, asthma.
過敏性鼻炎：眼癢流淚、清水鼻涕、黑眼圈、鼻黏膜蒼白、鵝卵石樣咽部；評估過敏、濕疹、氣喘。
Treat with trigger avoidance, antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids.
治療：避開誘發物、抗組織胺、鼻用類固醇。

Prone or side-lying after tonsillectomy; avoid suctioning unless obstructed.
扁桃腺術後俯臥或側臥；除非阻塞勿抽吸。
扁桃腺手術前確認 PT/凝血檢查。
Avoid red, purple, brown fluids, milk products, straws after tonsillectomy.
術後避免紅紫棕色液體、乳製品、吸管。

Complete the full antibiotic course for otitis media.

Ear drops: under 3 years pull lobe down/back; over 3 years pull up/back.
滴耳：3 歲以下向下向後；3 歲以上向上向後。
Strabismus not corrected early leads to amblyopia; treat with patching the good eye.
斜視未早期矯正致弱視；遮蓋好眼治療。
Tympanostomy tubes: keep ears dry, no nose blowing 7-10 days.
通氣管：耳朵保持乾燥、7–10 天不擤鼻。
Epistaxis: sit up, lean forward, pinch 10 minutes; do not lie back.
鼻出血：坐起前傾、捏鼻 10 分鐘；勿仰躺。
Toddlers with strabismus tilt the head or close an eye.

Ear drops direction: Under 3 = Down; Over 3 = Up.
滴耳方向：3 歲以下往下；3 歲以上往上。

Bacterial (usually H. influenzae type b), age 2-8, abrupt onset, winter; emergency that can obstruct the airway completely. Hib vaccine lowers risk.
細菌性（多為 Hib），2–8 歲，突發、冬季；可迅速完全阻塞呼吸道的急症。Hib 疫苗可降低風險。
Classic signs: tripod position, drooling, stridor, muffled voice, high fever, dysphagia, agitation, no spontaneous cough, cherry-red swollen epiglottis.
典型徵象：三腳架姿勢、流口水、喘鳴、聲音悶啞、高燒、吞嚥困難、躁動、無自發性咳嗽、櫻桃紅腫脹會厭。
Do NOT examine the throat, culture, take oral temperature, or agitate the child until the airway is secured (risk of spasm and total occlusion).
在呼吸道確保前，不可檢視咽喉、採喉頭培養、量口溫或使孩童躁動（可能痙攣致完全阻塞）。
Keep child with parent, never leave unattended; humidified oxygen, pulse oximetry, lateral neck film, ready intubation/tracheostomy equipment.
與家長在一起，不可獨留；給濕化氧氣、監測血氧、頸部側位 X 光、備妥插管/氣切設備。
Viral (parainfluenza 2 and 3, RSV, influenza), under 5 years, gradual onset after URI.
病毒性（副流感 2、3 型、RSV、流感），5 歲以下，上呼吸道感染後逐漸發生。
Stages (Box 36.1): I low fever, hoarseness, seal-bark cough, inspiratory stridor; II continuous stridor, retractions; III restlessness, pallor, tachypnea, hypoxia; IV cyanosis, apnea.
分期（框 36.1）：I 低燒、聲音沙啞、犬吠樣咳嗽、吸氣性喘鳴；II 持續喘鳴、凹陷；III 躁動、蒼白、呼吸急促、缺氧；IV 發紺、呼吸暫停。
Cool mist/humidified air, HOB elevated, fluids, corticosteroids, nebulized racemic epinephrine, heliox; antibiotics only if bacterial; no cough/cold medicines.
涼霧/濕化空氣、抬高床頭、補水、類固醇、racemic epinephrine 噴霧、氦氧混合氣；細菌感染才用抗生素；避免咳嗽與感冒藥。
Home: cool vaporizer, cool night air, or open freezer air.
居家：冷霧機、夜間冷空氣或冷凍庫開門冷空氣。
Bronchitis: usually viral; dry hacking cough worse at night becoming productive in 2-3 days; supportive care, cool humidified air, fluids.
支氣管炎：多為病毒性；夜間加劇的乾咳，2–3 天後轉為有痰；支持療法、涼濕空氣、補水。
RSV is the common cause of bronchiolitis; spread by droplet and contact; fall to spring; worst under 6 months; high-risk: chronic disease, immunocompromised.
RSV 為常見病因；經飛沫與接觸傳播；秋至春季；6 個月以下最嚴重；高危險：慢性病、免疫低下。
Signs: rhinorrhea, cough, wheezing, fever; progression to air hunger, retractions, cyanosis; severe: rate over 70/min, apnea, decreased breath sounds, listlessness.
徵象：流鼻水、咳嗽、喘鳴、發燒；進展至空氣飢餓、凹陷、發紺；嚴重：呼吸 >70/分、呼吸暫停、呼吸音減弱、嗜睡。
Single room, contact + droplet + standard precautions; don't assign nurse to other high-risk children.
單人房、接觸+飛沫+標準防護；照護者勿同時照顧其他高危兒。
Position 30-40 degrees with neck slightly extended; humidified O2, pulse oximetry, fluids, suction before feeding; palivizumab for high-risk infants.
擺位抬高 30–40 度、頸稍伸展；濕化氧氣、血氧監測、補水、餵食前抽吸；高危嬰兒給 palivizumab。
No honey cough remedies under 1 year (botulism); cough suppressants used cautiously.
1 歲以下不可用含蜂蜜止咳品（肉毒桿菌）；止咳藥謹慎使用。
Table 36.1: cannula 22-40% (can eat/talk), mask higher, tent 30-50% (access poor), hood/face tent up to 100%.
表 36.1：鼻導管 22–40%（可進食說話）、面罩較高、氧氣帳 30–50%（接近困難）、氧罩/面罩最高 100%。
Viral most common; mycoplasma/chlamydia (atypical) ages 5-12 fall-winter; bacterial often needs hospitalization; aspiration pneumonia from food/secretions; pneumococcal vaccine prevents.
病毒性最常見；黴漿菌/披衣菌（非典型）5–12 歲、秋冬；細菌性常需住院；吸入性肺炎由食物/分泌物引起；肺炎鏈球菌疫苗可預防。
Bacterial: abrupt fever, infant irritability/poor feeding/cyanosis; older child chest pain, headache; diminished breath sounds, crackles.
細菌性：突發發燒；嬰兒易怒、餵食差、發紺；較大兒童胸痛、頭痛；呼吸音減弱、囉音。
Blood cultures then antibiotics (IV in hospital), O2 and pulse oximetry, cool humidified air, suction, CPT every 4 hours, bed rest, lie on affected side, fluids carefully.
先抽血培養再給抗生素（住院多靜脈）、給氧與血氧監測、涼濕空氣、抽吸、每 4 小時胸腔物理治療、臥床休息、患側臥、小心補水。
Monitor temperature (febrile seizures); isolation for pneumococcal/staph; chest tube for empyema; thoracentesis.
監測體溫（熱性痙攣）；肺炎鏈球菌/葡萄球菌需隔離；膿胸放胸管；胸腔穿刺。
Viral/atypical pneumonia: symptomatic care, recovery 7-10 days for atypical.
病毒性/非典型肺炎：症狀治療，非典型約 7–10 天恢復。

Chronic airway inflammation with bronchospasm, mucus, edema; early and late reactions; triggers in Box 36.4 (allergens, smoke, cold air, exercise, infection, emotions, aspirin/NSAIDs, beta blockers, sulfites).
氣道慢性發炎，支氣管痙攣、黏液、水腫；有立即與延遲反應；誘發因子見框 36.4（過敏原、菸、冷空氣、運動、感染、情緒、阿斯匹靈/NSAID、乙型阻斷劑、亞硫酸鹽）。

Attack: wheeze, cough, dyspnea, retractions, prolonged expiration, short phrases, tripod posture; SILENT CHEST and ineffective cough mean severe obstruction; status asthmaticus unresponsive to beta-agonists is an emergency.
發作：喘鳴、咳嗽、呼吸困難、凹陷、呼氣延長、短句說話、三腳架姿勢；「無聲胸」與無效咳嗽代表嚴重阻塞；對乙型作用劑無反應的重積性氣喘為急症。
Severity (Table 36.2): mild intermittent, mild persistent, moderate persistent, severe persistent by symptom frequency and FEV1 (over 80%, over 80%, 60-80%, 60% or less).
嚴重度（表 36.2）：輕度間歇、輕度持續、中度持續、重度持續；依症狀頻率與 FEV1（>80%、>80%、60–80%、≤60%）。
Quick-relief: SABA, anticholinergics, systemic steroids. Controllers: inhaled steroids, LABA (never alone), leukotriene modifiers, cromolyn, monoclonal antibody.
速效藥：SABA、抗膽鹼、全身性類固醇。控制藥：吸入類固醇、LABA（不可單用）、白三烯調節劑、cromolyn、單株抗體。
Use a spacer with inhaled steroids, rinse mouth (thrush); monitor growth; peak flow personal best; decreased PEF warns of exacerbation; CPT not during acute attack.
吸入類固醇使用吸藥輔助器並漱口（預防鵝口瘡）；監測生長；峰值流速個人最佳值；PEF 下降警示惡化；急性發作時不做胸腔物理治療。
Acute ED care: humidified O2, rescue meds, IV access, corticosteroids, chest x-ray, ABG as needed.
急診處置：濕化氧氣、速效藥、建立靜脈、類固醇、胸部 X 光、必要時動脈血氣。
Home: remove allergens, avoid cold air and infections, annual flu vaccine from 6 months, inform school.
居家：移除過敏原、避免冷空氣與感染、6 個月起每年流感疫苗、通知學校。
Autosomal recessive exocrine gland disorder: thick mucus obstructs lungs, pancreas, intestines, reproductive tract; high sweat sodium and chloride; CFTR modulators exist.
體染色體隱性外分泌腺疾病：濃稠黏液阻塞肺、胰、腸、生殖道；汗液鈉氯升高；有 CFTR 調節藥。
Sweat chloride: under 40 mEq/L normal; over 60 positive; 40-60 repeat (over 40 diagnostic under 3 months). Also newborn screening (IRT), 72-hour stool fat.
汗液氯：<40 mEq/L 正常；>60 陽性；40–60 需重測（3 個月以下 >40 即診斷）。另有新生兒篩檢（IRT）、72 小時糞便脂肪。

Lungs: chronic infection, wheeze, clubbing, barrel chest, pneumonia, pulmonary hypertension/cor pulmonale, pneumothorax, hemoptysis. GI: meconium ileus (earliest), frothy foul stools, DIOS, FTT, low vitamins A D E K, rectal prolapse, diabetes risk.
肺部：慢性感染、喘鳴、杵狀指、桶狀胸、肺炎、肺高壓/肺心症、氣胸、咳血。腸胃：胎便性腸阻塞（最早）、泡沫惡臭便、遠端腸阻塞症候群、生長遲滯、維生素 A D E K 缺乏、直腸脫垂、糖尿病風險。
Skin tastes salty; risk of dehydration in heat; delayed puberty, infertility.
皮膚嚐起來鹹；高溫易脫水；青春期延遲、不孕。
Respiratory care: CPT on waking and evening (not right after meals), bronchodilator before CPT, huffing, Flutter, vest, exercise, antibiotics; careful with oxygen (CO2 retention).
呼吸照護：起床與晚間胸腔物理治療（餐後不做）、治療前給支氣管擴張劑、哈氣技巧、Flutter、背心、運動、抗生素；給氧小心（CO2 滯留）。
GI care: high calorie/protein diet, extra vitamins, pancreatic enzymes within 30 minutes of meals and snacks (not NPO), do not crush enteric-coated capsules; extra salt in heat.
腸胃照護：高熱量高蛋白飲食、補充維生素、餐點與點心 30 分鐘內給胰臟酵素（禁食不給）、腸溶膠囊不可壓碎；高溫時多補鹽。
Unexplained death of infant under 1 year, peak 2-4 months, winter, higher in males; lower with breastfeeding and pacifier use.
1 歲以下嬰兒不明原因死亡，高峰 2–4 個月、冬季、男嬰較多；哺乳與使用奶嘴者較低。
Risks: prone sleep, soft bedding, sofa sleeping, overheating, co-sleeping, maternal smoking/substance use, tobacco smoke exposure.
危險因子：趴睡、柔軟寢具、睡沙發、過熱、同床、母親吸菸/物質濫用、二手菸。
Prevention: supine for sleep, firm mattress, no toys or loose items in crib; tummy time while awake and varied head position to prevent plagiocephaly.
預防：仰睡、硬床墊、嬰兒床不放玩具或鬆軟物；清醒時趴玩並變換頭位以預防斜頭畸形。
Round foods (hot dogs, grapes, peanuts, popcorn, candy) are common; signs choking, cough, stridor, wheeze, cyanosis; abdominal thrusts per AHA guidelines; endoscopic removal then humidified air.
圓形食物（熱狗、葡萄、花生、爆米花、糖果）常見；徵象嗆咳、喘鳴、發紺；依 AHA 指引腹部推擠；內視鏡取出後給濕化空氣。
Prevention: keep small objects/balloons away, avoid small round foods; teach caregivers emergency measures.
預防：小物件/氣球放遠、避免小而圓的食物；教導照顧者緊急處理。

TB: droplet transmission, mainly from household contact; Mantoux positive 2-12 weeks after infection, does not confirm active disease; sputum or gastric washings culture is definitive; don't test with measles vaccine.
結核：飛沫傳染，多來自家人接觸；感染後 2–12 週 Mantoux 陽性，不代表活動性；痰或胃洗液培養為確診；不與麻疹疫苗同時測試。
Latent TB: isoniazid 9 months (12 if HIV). Active: isoniazid + rifampin + pyrazinamide 2 months then isoniazid + rifampin 4 months; DOT; orange-red body fluids; N95 and respiratory isolation.
潛伏結核：isoniazid 9 個月（HIV 為 12 個月）。活動性：isoniazid + rifampin + pyrazinamide 2 個月，再 isoniazid + rifampin 4 個月；直接觀察治療；體液橘紅色；N95 與呼吸道隔離。
Epiglottitis: tripod, drooling, stridor, muffled voice. Never visualize throat or agitate; secure airway first.
會厭炎：三腳架、流口水、喘鳴、聲音悶啞。不可檢視咽喉或使其躁動；先確保呼吸道。
Silent chest in asthma = severe obstruction/impending respiratory failure.
氣喘「無聲胸」＝嚴重阻塞/即將呼吸衰竭。
Quick-relief asthma drug: short-acting beta agonist; LABA never without inhaled steroid.
氣喘速效藥：短效乙型作用劑；LABA 不可無吸入類固醇單用。
Spacer and mouth rinse with inhaled corticosteroids to prevent thrush.
吸入類固醇用輔助器並漱口以預防鵝口瘡。
CF: sweat chloride over 60 mEq/L is positive; meconium ileus earliest GI sign.
CF：汗液氯 >60 mEq/L 為陽性；胎便性腸阻塞為最早腸胃表現。
CF enzymes: give with meals/snacks within 30 minutes, never crush enteric-coated capsules; extra salt in heat.
CF 酵素：餐點30 分鐘內給予、腸溶膠囊不可壓碎；高溫多補鹽。
CF vitamins A, D, E, K deficiency; high-calorie high-protein diet.
CF 缺乏維生素 A D E K；高熱量高蛋白飲食。
RSV: contact/droplet precautions, single room, position 30-40 degrees, palivizumab for high risk.
RSV：接觸/飛沫防護、單人房、抬高 30–40 度、高危給 palivizumab。
No honey for infants under 1 year (botulism).
1 歲以下嬰兒不可給蜂蜜（肉毒桿菌）。
SIDS: supine sleep, no soft bedding, no co-sleeping, no smoke exposure.
SIDS：仰睡、無柔軟寢具、不同床、避免菸害。
Positive Mantoux does not mean active TB; sputum/gastric culture confirms; delay TST around measles vaccine.
Mantoux 陽性不等於活動性 TB；痰/胃液培養確診；麻疹疫苗時避免同時測。
TB meds turn body fluids orange-red; isoniazid 9 months for latent infection.
結核藥使體液呈橘紅色；潛伏感染 isoniazid 9 個月。
Bacterial pneumonia: blood cultures before antibiotics; lie on affected side; monitor for febrile seizures.
細菌性肺炎：先抽血培養再給抗生素；患側臥；留意熱性痙攣。
Foreign body: round foods; abdominal thrusts; post-endoscopy watch airway edema.
異物：圓形食物；腹部推擠；內視鏡後留意氣道水腫。
Epiglottitis 4 Ds: Drooling, Dysphagia, Dysphonia, Distress (plus tripod).
會厭炎 4D：流口水、吞嚥困難、聲音改變、呼吸窘迫（加三腳架）。
Croup = barking seal cough with inspiratory stridor; epiglottitis = no cough, muffled, toxic.
哮吼＝犬吠樣咳嗽加吸氣喘鳴；會厭炎＝無咳嗽、聲音悶、中毒外觀。
A 4-year-old sits leaning forward with chin thrust, drooling, muffled voice and high fever. What is the priority nursing action?
4 歲孩童身體前傾、下巴前突、流口水、聲音悶啞、高燒。護理師的優先行動為何？
Which finding in a child with asthma signals impending respiratory failure?
氣喘孩童何項表現提示即將呼吸衰竭？
Teaching about inhaled corticosteroid via MDI for a child. Which is correct?
兒童使用 MDI 吸入類固醇的指導，何者正確？
A child with cystic fibrosis is prescribed pancreatic enzymes. How should they be given?
囊性纖維化孩童使用胰臟酵素，應如何給予？
Which sweat chloride result is a positive test for cystic fibrosis?
何項汗液氯結果為囊性纖維化陽性？
Select all that apply: the nurse caring for an infant hospitalized with RSV should
照護 RSV 住院嬰兒，護理師應（多選）
Parents ask how to reduce SIDS risk. Which advice is correct?
家長詢問如何降低 SIDS 風險，何項建議正確？

孩童 Mantoux 陽性，護理師了解此結果代表
Which are triggers for asthma exacerbation? Select all that apply.
哪些為氣喘誘發因子？（多選）
Epiglottitis assessment, tripod position and the do-not-visualize warning.
會厭炎評估、三腳架姿勢與「勿檢視咽喉」警示。
Fig 36.1 normal larynx versus croup edema, Fig 36.2 retraction locations, Box 36.1 croup stages.
圖 36.1 正常喉與哮吼水腫、圖 36.2 凹陷位置、框 36.1 哮吼分期。
表 36.1 氧氣給予系統比較。

表 36.2 氣喘嚴重度分類；框 36.4 誘發因子；急性氣喘臨床判斷。

框 36.7 汗液氯測試與圖 36.3 CF 影響。
圖 36.4 異物氣道阻塞機轉。
Ages 2-19: total cholesterol <170 mg/dL acceptable, 170-199 borderline, >=200 high.
2-19歲：總膽固醇 <170 mg/dL 為可接受，170-199 為臨界，≥200 為偏高。
LDL <110 acceptable, 110-129 borderline, >=130 high; HDL >45 acceptable, <40 low.
LDL <110 可接受，110-129 臨界，≥130 偏高；HDL >45 可接受，<40 偏低。
Triglycerides: <100 mg/dL (age <=9) or <130 mg/dL (age >=10) is acceptable.
三酸甘油酯：9歲以下 <100 mg/dL，10歲以上 <130 mg/dL 為可接受。
Childhood hyperlipidemia tends to persist and raises later cardiac event risk; any elevation warrants cardiology referral.
兒童期高血脂常持續至成年並增加心臟事件風險；任何異常升高皆應轉介心臟科。
Treatment centers on diet, physical activity and behavior change.
治療以飲食、身體活動與行為改變為主。
HF = heart cannot meet the body's metabolic/oxygen needs; in children usually from congenital defects causing volume or pressure overload; both sides typically fail together.
HF指心臟無法供應身體代謝與氧需求；兒童多因先天缺損造成容積或壓力負荷過重，通常左右心同時衰竭。
Early signs: tachycardia (even at rest), tachypnea, profuse scalp sweating in infants, fatigue, irritability, sudden weight gain, respiratory distress.
早期徵象：休息時心跳過速、呼吸過速、嬰兒頭皮大量出汗、疲倦易怒、體重突然增加、呼吸窘迫。
Left-sided: crackles, cough, dyspnea, grunting, nasal flaring, retractions, orthopnea. Right-sided: hepatosplenomegaly, JVD, peripheral/periorbital edema, ascites, oliguria, weight gain.
左心衰：囉音、咳嗽、呼吸困難、呻吟、鼻翼搧動、肋間凹陷。右心衰：肝脾腫大、頸靜脈怒張、周邊/眼周水腫、腹水、少尿、體重增加。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Count apical pulse and respirations for a full minute; strict I&O (weigh diapers); daily weight, same scale/time; 0.5 kg (1 lb) gain in a day suggests fluid retention.
心尖脈與呼吸需測滿1分鐘；嚴格I&O（秤尿布）；每日同一體重計、同一時間量體重，一天增加0.5 kg代表液體滯留。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Semi-Fowler position, cool humidified oxygen, neutral thermal environment, cluster care for rest, small frequent feedings.
半坐臥、冷濕化氧氣、維持中性溫度、集中護理讓其休息、少量多餐。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Digoxin: hold if apical rate <90-110 (infants/young children) or <70 (older children); therapeutic level 0.8-2 ng/mL; toxicity signs are anorexia, poor feeding, N/V, bradycardia, dysrhythmias.
毛地黃：心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停給藥；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL；中毒徵象為厭食、拒食、噁心嘔吐、心搏過緩、心律不整。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Furosemide causes hypokalemia (K+ <3.5), which potentiates digoxin toxicity; give potassium only if indicated and renal function is adequate.
furosemide可致低血鉀（K+ <3.5），會加重毛地黃中毒；需有適應症且腎功能良好才補鉀。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
ACE inhibitors: watch for hypotension, renal dysfunction, cough.
ACE抑制劑：注意低血壓、腎功能異常、咳嗽。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Parents learn digoxin home care and CPR.
需教導家長在家給予毛地黃及CPR。
Heart failure: nursing care and medications
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
Left-to-right shunts (ASD, VSD, PDA, AV canal): blood moves from high-pressure left side to right; signs of HF.
左向右分流（ASD、VSD、PDA、房室管缺損）：血液由高壓左側流向右側，出現HF徵象。
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
ASD: opening between atria; may be asymptomatic; closed by catheter or open repair, usually before school age.
ASD：心房間開口；可無症狀；可經心導管或開心手術修補，多在學齡前完成。
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
AV canal defect: incomplete endocardial cushion fusion; most common defect in Down syndrome.
房室管缺損：心內膜墊融合不全；唐氏症最常見之心臟缺損。
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
PDA: machinery-like murmur, widened pulse pressure, bounding pulses; indomethacin closes it in premature infants; prostaglandin E keeps it open in ductal-dependent lesions.
PDA：機械樣雜音、脈壓增寬、脈搏洪大；indomethacin可使早產兒導管關閉；導管依賴型缺損用前列腺素E維持導管開放。
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
VSD: many small/moderate defects close spontaneously in the first year; HF common.
VSD：許多小至中型缺損在第一年自行閉合；常見HF。
Defects with increased pulmonary blood flow
Aortic stenosis: narrowed aortic valve; LV hypertrophy; children have activity intolerance, chest pain, dizziness; treated with balloon dilation or valvotomy.
主動脈瓣狹窄：瓣膜狹窄、左心室肥大；兒童活動耐受不良、胸痛、頭暈；以氣球擴張或瓣膜切開術治療。
Coarctation of the aorta: BP higher in arms than legs, bounding arm pulses, weak/absent femoral pulses, cool legs; headache, epistaxis, dizziness.
主動脈縮窄：上肢血壓高於下肢、上肢脈搏洪大、股動脈脈搏弱或消失、下肢冰冷；頭痛、流鼻血、頭暈。
Coarctation repair is outside the heart: thoracotomy, no cardiopulmonary bypass.
縮窄修補位於心臟外：開胸，不需體外循環。
Pulmonary stenosis: right ventricular hypertrophy, decreased pulmonary flow; severe cases cyanotic in newborns; treated by dilation or valvotomy.
肺動脈瓣狹窄：右心室肥大、肺血流減少；嚴重者新生兒發紺；以擴張或瓣膜切開治療。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Right-to-left shunts cause hypoxemia and cyanosis.
右向左分流造成低血氧與發紺。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Tetralogy of Fallot: VSD, pulmonary stenosis, overriding aorta, RV hypertrophy.
法洛氏四重症：VSD、肺動脈狹窄、主動脈騎跨、右心室肥大。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Tet spells occur with crying, feeding, defecating; older children squat and develop clubbing and poor growth.
哭泣、餵食、排便時可出現缺氧發作（tet spell）；較大兒童會蹲踞、杵狀指、生長遲緩。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Management: palliative shunt in infants who cannot have primary repair; complete repair in the first year via sternotomy and bypass.
處置：無法一次修補的嬰兒先做姑息性分流；第一年內以胸骨切開與體外循環完全修補。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Tricuspid atresia: no RA-to-RV connection; blood passes through ASD/PFO and VSD; cyanosis, clubbing.
三尖瓣閉鎖：右心房與右心室無相通；血液經ASD/PFO與VSD；發紺、杵狀指。
Defects with decreased pulmonary blood flow
Hypoplastic left heart: hypoplastic LV and aortic atresia; deteriorates as the ductus closes; needs prostaglandin E1 and ventilation before surgery.
左心發育不全：左心室發育不良與主動脈閉鎖；導管關閉後急速惡化；術前需前列腺素E1與呼吸器。
Transposition of great arteries: aorta from RV, pulmonary artery from LV; severe cyanosis if little mixing; PGE1 and balloon atrial septostomy; arterial switch repair.
大動脈轉位：主動脈出自右心室、肺動脈出自左心室；混合少則重度發紺；使用PGE1與氣球心房中膈造口；動脈調換術修補。
Total anomalous pulmonary venous connection: pulmonary veins fail to reach LA; rapid decline with obstruction; repaired in early infancy.
全肺靜脈異位連接：肺靜脈未接左心房；阻塞時快速惡化；嬰兒早期修補。
Truncus arteriosus: single vessel overrides both ventricles; HF and variable cyanosis; repair in first months.
永存動脈幹：單一血管跨接兩心室；HF與不等程度發紺；數月內修補。
General defect care: monitor respiratory status, reverse Trendelenburg for work of breathing, watch for hypercyanotic spells, daily weight, high-calorie nutrition.
缺損一般照護：監測呼吸、以反Trendelenburg減少呼吸功、注意缺氧發作、每日體重、高熱量營養。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
Pre-procedure: accurate height/weight, iodine allergy, signs of infection, mark and record distal pulses, baseline O2 saturation.
術前：測準確身高體重、碘過敏史、感染徵象、標記並記錄遠端脈搏、基礎血氧。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
Post-procedure: monitor 4 hours; check pulses, color and warmth below site (coolness = arterial obstruction); keep leg flat 4-6 h (venous) or 6-8 h (arterial).
術後：監測4小時；檢查穿刺處以下脈搏、顏色與溫度（變冷＝動脈阻塞）；靜脈入路平躺4-6小時、動脈入路6-8小時。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
If bleeding: apply continuous direct pressure at or just above the site and report.
若出血：於穿刺處或其上方持續直接加壓並通報。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
Cardiac surgery postop: watch temperature and sepsis, aseptic technique, pain control, rest, early parent contact.
心臟手術後：監測體溫與敗血症、無菌技術、止痛、休息、盡早親子接觸。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
Home care after surgery: avoid crowds 2 weeks, no falls risk activities 2-4 weeks, no lotions/powders on incision, no new foods for infants, no PE for 2 months, dental visits with antibiotic notice.
術後居家：2週避免人群、2-4週避免易跌倒活動、傷口勿擦乳液或粉、嬰兒不加新食物、2個月不上體育課、看牙需告知心臟病史。
心導管檢查與心臟手術
Autoimmune inflammation appearing 2-6 weeks after untreated/partly treated group A beta-hemolytic strep pharyngitis; mitral valve most affected.
未治療或不完全治療之A群乙型溶血性鏈球菌咽炎後2-6週發生的自體免疫發炎；最常侵犯二尖瓣。

Jones: major = carditis, polyarthritis, chorea, erythema marginatum, subcutaneous nodules; minor = fever, arthralgia, raised ESR/CRP, prolonged PR. Need 2 major or 1 major + 2 minor plus evidence of strep (ASO titer).
Jones準則：主要＝心臟炎、多發性關節炎、舞蹈症、環形紅斑、皮下結節；次要＝發燒、關節痛、ESR/CRP升高、PR間期延長。需2主要或1主要+2次要，加上鏈球菌感染證據（ASO）。
Care: bed rest in acute phase, antibiotics, anti-inflammatories after diagnosis confirmed, seizure precautions for chorea, long-term antibiotic prophylaxis.
照護：急性期臥床、抗生素、確診後才給抗發炎藥、舞蹈症時癲癇防護、長期抗生素預防。
Acute systemic vasculitis of unknown cause; coronary aneurysm is the major complication.
原因不明的急性全身性血管炎；主要併發症為冠狀動脈瘤。
Acute: fever, conjunctival hyperemia, cracked red lips/strawberry tongue, swollen hands/feet with red palms/soles, rash, cervical lymphadenopathy, irritability.
急性期：發燒、結膜充血、嘴唇乾裂紅腫/草莓舌、手足腫脹與掌蹠紅斑、皮疹、頸部淋巴結腫大、易怒。
Subacute: peeling fingertips/toes, joint pain, thrombocytosis. Convalescent: looks normal, labs still abnormal.
亞急性期：指趾脫皮、關節痛、血小板增多。恢復期：外觀正常，檢驗仍異常。
Treatment: high-dose IVIG (blood product) plus aspirin; delay MMR/varicella vaccines 11 months after IVIG; no aspirin if exposed to chickenpox or flu.
治療：高劑量IVIG（血液製品）加阿斯匹靈；IVIG後11個月內延後MMR/水痘疫苗；接觸水痘或流感時避免阿斯匹靈。
Early HF signs in infants: tachycardia, tachypnea, scalp sweating, fatigue, sudden weight gain.
嬰兒HF早期徵象：心跳過速、呼吸過速、頭皮出汗、疲倦、體重突增。
Hold digoxin if apical pulse <90-110 (infant/young child) or <70 (older child); therapeutic 0.8-2 ng/mL.
心尖脈嬰幼兒 <90-110、較大兒童 <70 時暫停毛地黃；治療濃度0.8-2 ng/mL。
Hypokalemia from furosemide increases digoxin toxicity risk.
furosemide造成的低血鉀增加毛地黃中毒風險。

典型四聯：大量蛋白尿、低白蛋白血症、高血脂、水腫。
Findings: weight gain, periorbital edema worse in morning, leg/labial/scrotal edema, ascites, dark frothy urine, normal or low BP, lethargy, pallor.

Goals: reduce urinary protein loss, reduce edema, prevent infection.
目標：減少尿蛋白流失、減輕水腫、預防感染。
Treatment: corticosteroids started at diagnosis, immunosuppressants for relapse/non-response, diuretics, salt-poor albumin for severe edema; sodium restriction during massive edema.
治療：確診即開始類固醇；復發/無反應加免疫抑制劑；利尿劑；嚴重水腫用低鹽白蛋白；大量水腫時限鈉。
Monitor urine specific gravity and protein; teach home urine protein testing, infection signs, avoiding infectious contacts.
監測尿比重與蛋白；教導居家尿蛋白檢測、感染徵象、避免接觸感染者。

檢驗：BUN/肌酸酐高、Hgb/Hct低、網狀紅血球高、蛋白尿、血尿、尿圓柱。
Care: strict fluid balance, fluid restriction if anuric, dialysis if worsening, infection prevention, nutrition, blood transfusion cautiously to avoid fluid overload.
照護：嚴格體液平衡、無尿時限水、惡化時透析、預防感染、營養、謹慎輸血避免液體過量。
Urine flows backward from bladder to ureters/kidneys; primary type from faulty ureter-bladder valve, secondary from bladder outlet blockage.
尿液由膀胱逆流至輸尿管/腎臟；原發性為輸尿管膀胱瓣膜缺陷，續發性為膀胱出口阻塞。
Risk: bladder exstrophy, family history, neurogenic bladder (e.g., spina bifida).
危險因子：膀胱外翻、家族史、神經性膀胱（如脊柱裂）。
Diagnosis: ultrasound, voiding cystourethrogram; recurrent UTI is the common presentation.
診斷：超音波、排尿性膀胱尿道攝影；常見表現為反覆UTI。
Treatment: prophylactic antibiotics, Deflux injection, or surgical repair; teach fluids, avoid juice/soda, warm towel for discomfort.

Diagnosed in children older than 5 who wet at least twice weekly for 3 months; the child cannot control it.
5歲以上、每週至少2次且持續3個月的尿濕；孩子無法控制。
Primary: never dry; nocturnal enuresis is common and usually outgrown. Secondary: wetting after established continence; check for UTI, diabetes.

Care: urinalysis/culture, limit fluids at night, void before bed, reward systems, conditioning (alarms), desmopressin or anticholinergics.
照護：尿液分析/培養、夜間限水、睡前排尿、獎勵制度、行為制約（警報器）、desmopressin或抗膽鹼藥。
One or both testes not descended into the scrotum; not palpable or easily guided down.

Epispadias: urethral opening on dorsal penis (often with bladder exstrophy). Hypospadias: opening on ventral side below glans.

Monitor urine output, infection, renal labs; give antibiotics; support parents.

CSF absorption/production imbalance; communicating (absorption problem) vs noncommunicating (obstructive).
腦脊髓液吸收/產生失衡；交通性（吸收問題）與非交通性（阻塞性）。

Infants: enlarging head, tense bulging non-pulsating fontanel, separated sutures, setting-sun eyes, frontal bossing, dilated scalp veins, irritability, poor feeding. Children: headache on waking, vomiting, ataxia, papilledema. Late: high shrill cry, seizures.
嬰兒：頭圍增大、囟門緊繃膨出無搏動、縫合分離、日落眼、前額突出、頭皮靜脈擴張、易怒、拒食。兒童：晨起頭痛、嘔吐、運動失調、視乳突水腫。晚期：高尖哭聲、癲癇。
VP shunt drains CSF to peritoneum; VA shunt to right atrium; endoscopic third ventriculostomy is an alternative; revisions needed with growth.
腦室腹腔分流（VP）將腦脊髓液引流至腹腔；腦室心房分流（VA）至右心房；內視鏡第三腦室造瘻為替代方式；成長後需修正。
Preop: I&O, small frequent feeds, reposition head often with egg-crate to prevent pressure sores.
術前：I&O、少量多餐、經常變換頭部位置並用蛋盒型墊防壓瘡。

Postop: position on unoperated side, flat if prescribed to avoid rapid CSF drop, monitor head circumference, infection, ICP; teach shunt malfunction signs (infant: irritable, lethargic, poor feeding, shrill cry; toddler: headache, poor appetite; older: LOC change).
術後：側臥於未手術側、依醫囑平躺以免腦脊髓液驟降、測頭圍、監測感染與ICP；教導分流管故障徵象（嬰兒：易怒、嗜睡、拒食、尖哭；幼兒：頭痛、食慾差；較大兒童：意識改變）。
CNS infection (bacterial or viral); bacterial causes: H. influenzae b, S. pneumoniae, N. meningitidis (droplet spread, epidemic).
中樞神經感染（細菌或病毒）；細菌性病原：b型流感嗜血桿菌、肺炎鏈球菌、腦膜炎雙球菌（飛沫傳播、可流行）。
Bacterial CSF: cloudy, high pressure, high WBC, high protein, low glucose (via lumbar puncture).
細菌性腦脊髓液：混濁、壓力高、WBC高、蛋白高、葡萄糖低（腰椎穿刺）。
Signs: fever, headache, vomiting, nuchal rigidity, high shrill cry, bulging fontanel, positive Kernig and Brudzinski, petechial/purpuric rash (meningococcal).
徵象：發燒、頭痛、嘔吐、頸部僵硬、高尖哭聲、囟門膨出、Kernig與Brudzinski陽性、瘀點/紫斑（腦膜炎雙球菌）。
Respiratory (droplet) isolation until 24 hours after antibiotics started; give antibiotics promptly after cultures/LP; watch for SIADH, seizures, hearing loss; prophylaxis for close contacts.

Pneumococcal conjugate vaccine from age 2 months helps prevent meningitis.

Hypoxia is the main problem; cerebral cells suffer irreversible damage after 4-6 minutes; aspiration and hypothermia add risk.
缺氧為主要問題；腦細胞缺氧4-6分鐘後造成不可逆損傷；另有吸入與低體溫風險。
Prognosis good if submerged <5 min with responsiveness, reactive pupils, normal rhythm; poor if >10 min and no response to CPR within 25 min.
浸水<5分鐘且有反應、瞳孔有反應、心律正常則預後佳；>10分鐘且CPR 25分鐘無反應預後極差。
Support ventilation/circulation; respiratory compromise and cerebral edema can appear 24 hours later; watch for aspiration pneumonia; teach water supervision.
維持通氣與循環；24小時後仍可能出現呼吸惡化與腦水腫；注意吸入性肺炎；教導水域看護。
Acute encephalopathy with cerebral edema and fatty liver after a viral illness (influenza, varicella) 4-7 days earlier.
病毒感染（流感、水痘）後4-7天出現的急性腦病變，伴腦水腫與脂肪肝。
Avoid aspirin/salicylates in febrile or viral illness; use acetaminophen or ibuprofen.
發燒或病毒感染時避免阿斯匹靈/水楊酸類；改用acetaminophen或ibuprofen。
Signs: fever, vomiting, lethargy, progressive neurological decline, elevated ammonia, coagulopathy.
徵象：發燒、嘔吐、嗜睡、神經狀態進行性惡化、血氨升高、凝血異常。
Care: quiet dim environment, neuro checks, ICP monitoring, liver function, I&O, bleeding precautions.
照護：安靜昏暗環境、神經評估、ICP監測、肝功能、I&O、出血監測。
Excessive disorganized neuronal discharge; generalized (tonic-clonic, absence, myoclonic, atonic) or partial (simple, complex).
神經元過度且無序放電；全身性（強直陣攣、失神、肌躍型、失張力）或局部性（單純、複雜）。
During seizure: protect airway, time it, ease to floor and side-lying, cushion head, loosen clothing, clear hazards, never restrain or put anything in the mouth, stay with child.
發作時：保護呼吸道、計時、協助躺地並側臥、墊頭、鬆開衣物、清除危險物、勿約束、勿放任何物入口、陪伴在旁。
Bedside: suction and oxygen. Postictal: disoriented and sleepy.
床邊備吸引與氧氣。發作後：定向力障礙、嗜睡。
Home: medical ID, swim with a companion, helmet for biking/skating, take medications on schedule.
居家：配戴醫療識別、游泳需有同伴、騎車/溜冰戴安全帽、規律服藥。
Failure of neural tube closure; folic acid in childbearing years/pregnancy lowers risk; associated clubfoot, hip dislocation, hydrocephalus.
神經管閉合不全；育齡期與孕期補充葉酸可降低風險；常合併內翻足、髖關節脫位、水腦。

隱性脊柱裂：椎弓未閉合，通常無神經缺損。脊髓膜膨出：腦膜與腦脊髓液囊，脊髓未受累。脊髓脊膜膨出：脊髓/神經根在囊內，有神經缺損。
Myelomeningocele findings: visible defect, flaccid leg paralysis, bladder/bowel dysfunction, hip deformity, hydrocephalus.
脊髓脊膜膨出表現：可見缺損、下肢弛緩性麻痺、膀胱/腸道功能異常、髖關節變形、水腦。
Care: sterile moist nonadherent saline dressing on sac, aseptic technique, prone positioning (head turned for feeds), measure head circumference, antibiotics, watch for infection.
照護：囊上覆蓋無菌濕潤不沾黏生理食鹽水敷料、無菌技術、俯臥（餵食時頭轉向一側）、測頭圍、抗生素、監測感染。
Long-term: bladder program/clean intermittent catheterization, antispasmodics, bowel program with fiber and fluids, latex allergy precautions.
長期：膀胱計畫/間歇導尿、抗痙攣藥、高纖多水排便計畫、乳膠過敏防護。
Developmentally inappropriate inattention, overactivity and impulsivity; diagnosed from parent/teacher reports and tools.
發展上不適當的注意力不足、過動與衝動；依家長/老師報告與評估工具診斷。
Signs: fidgeting, distractibility, not following instructions, shifting tasks, excessive talking, interrupting, risk taking.
徵象：坐立不安、易分心、不遵從指示、常轉換任務、多話、打斷他人、冒險行為。
Care: behavioral therapy, consistent routine at home/school, safety, self-esteem; stimulants may cause appetite loss, weight loss, nervousness, tics, insomnia, raised BP.
照護：行為治療、家庭/學校一致作息、安全、提升自尊；興奮劑可能造成食慾下降、體重減輕、緊張、抽動、失眠、血壓升高。

Skin anatomy, risks and psychosocial impact
皮膚解剖、危險因子與心理社會影響
Skin is the largest organ: barrier against infection, sensation, thermoregulation, excretion, prevents water loss, vitamin D synthesis, nutrient storage.
皮膚是最大器官：感染屏障、感覺、體溫調節、排泄、防止水分流失、合成維生素D、儲存養分。

Layers: epidermis, dermis, hypodermis; appendages: nails, hair, sebaceous and sweat glands; acidic pH 4.2-5.6 limits bacterial growth.
層次：表皮、真皮、皮下組織；附屬物：指甲、毛髮、皮脂腺與汗腺；pH 4.2-5.6的酸性環境抑制細菌。

危險因子：日曬/日光浴、輻射、污染物、衛生不良、強效肥皂、長期糖皮質激素、營養不良、壓力、感染、反覆損傷、遺傳、全身性疾病。

Inflammatory phase 3-5 days (edema, pain, redness, warmth); fibroblastic from day 4 for 2-4 weeks (granulation tissue, scar); maturation from ~3 weeks up to 1 year.
發炎期3-5天（水腫、疼痛、紅、熱）；纖維母細胞期自第4天起2-4週（肉芽組織、疤痕）；成熟期約3週起可達1年。
First intention: edges approximated (sutures). Second: tissue loss fills in gradually. Third: delayed primary closure after being left open for cleaning.
第一癒合：傷口緣對合（縫合）。第二癒合：組織缺損逐漸填補。第三癒合：先敞開清創後延遲縫合。
Drainage: serous (clear) and serosanguineous (pink) normal; sanguineous and hemorrhagic abnormal; purulent (yellow/gray/green) means infection.
引流液：漿液性（清澈）與漿液血性（粉紅）屬正常；血性與出血為異常；膿性（黃/灰/綠）表示感染。
Skin biopsy (punch, excisional, shave): confirm consent, send specimen to pathology; keep dressing on at least 8 h; sutures out in 7-10 days; report drainage, redness.
皮膚切片（打孔、切除、削切）：確認同意書、送病理；敷料至少保留8小時；7-10天拆線；通報滲液、紅腫。
Skin/wound culture: obtain before antibiotics; viral cultures go on ice; nasal swab screens exposure.
皮膚/傷口培養：於抗生素前採檢；病毒培養置冰上；鼻腔拭子篩檢帶菌。
Wood's light (UV) identifies superficial infections: darken room, reassure that light is harmless, help adjust afterward.
伍氏燈（紫外線）辨識表淺感染：暗室、說明無害、事後協助適應光線。
Diascopy: press glass slide on lesion to blanch erythema.
玻片壓診：以玻片壓迫病灶使紅斑褪色以便觀察。
Candida: superficial yeast infection (skinfolds, perineum, axilla, mouth thrush); risk: immunosuppression, long antibiotics, diabetes, obesity; keep folds clean/dry, mouth care, antifungals.
念珠菌：表淺酵母感染（皮膚皺褶、會陰、腋下、口腔鵝口瘡）；危險因子：免疫抑制、長期抗生素、糖尿病、肥胖；保持皺褶乾燥、口腔護理、抗黴菌藥。
Shingles: reactivated varicella-zoster in dorsal root ganglia; unilateral segmental vesicles with burning pain; Tzanck smear/viral culture; postherpetic neuralgia possible.
帶狀疱疹：水痘帶狀疱疹病毒於背根神經節再活化；單側節段性水泡伴灼痛；Tzanck抹片/病毒培養；可能有疱疹後神經痛。
Shingles care: contact precautions while vesicles present; cool environment, air mattress/bed cradle, loose cotton clothes, astringent compresses; antivirals within 3 days; vaccine at age 50+.
帶狀疱疹照護：水泡期接觸防護；環境涼爽、氣墊床/床架；寬鬆棉質衣物；收斂濕敷；3天內抗病毒藥；50歲以上接種疫苗。
Staff who never had chickenpox or varicella vaccine should not care for shingles clients; watch for Bell's palsy.
未得過水痘或未接種水痘疫苗的工作人員不應照護帶狀疱疹病人；注意貝爾氏麻痺。
MRSA: folliculitis, furuncles; confirm with culture and sensitivity; standard + contact precautions, antibiotics, monitor for sepsis.

Erysipelas: acute superficial infection of upper skin layers (group A Strep). Cellulitis: dermis and hypodermis (Strep or S. aureus).
丹毒：表層皮膚急性感染（A群鏈球菌）。蜂窩性組織炎：真皮與皮下組織（鏈球菌或金黃色葡萄球菌）。

Signs: pain, erythema, warmth, edema, fever; rest affected area, warm compresses, culture before antibiotics.
徵象：疼痛、紅、熱、水腫、發燒；患部休息、溫敷、抗生素前先採培養。

Brown recluse: necrotic wound; ice early and intermittently up to 4 days. Black widow: neurotoxin; ice immediately. Tarantula: remove barbed hairs with sticky tape, irrigate eyes, elevate. Keep tetanus current; call Poison Control.
棕色隱士蛛：壞死性傷口；早期間歇冰敷可達4天。黑寡婦蛛：神經毒；立即冰敷。狼蛛：用膠帶黏除倒刺毛、沖洗眼睛、抬高。維持破傷風疫苗；聯絡毒物中心。

Spironolactone與口服避孕藥降低雄性素活性；spironolactone致畸，可能高血鉀、乳房脹痛、月經不規則。
Silver sulfadiazine: broad antimicrobial (including yeast) to prevent sepsis; does not speed healing; apply 1/16-inch film and keep covered; does not cause acidosis.
Silver sulfadiazine：廣效抗菌（含酵母）預防敗血症；不促進癒合；塗1/16吋薄層並保持覆蓋；不會造成酸中毒。
Silver sulfadiazine adverse effects: rash, itching, blue-green/gray discoloration, leukopenia, interstitial nephritis; monitor CBC/WBC and report leukopenia.
Silver sulfadiazine副作用：皮疹、癢、藍綠/灰色變色、白血球減少、間質性腎炎；監測CBC/WBC並通報白血球低下。
Mafenide acetate: penetrates avascular tissue; carbonic anhydrase inhibition causes metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; painful, so premedicate; bone marrow depression, hemolytic anemia.
Mafenide acetate：可穿透無血管組織；抑制碳酸酐酶造成代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；疼痛故需先給止痛；骨髓抑制、溶血性貧血。
If hyperventilation occurs, notify provider, check ABG/electrolytes; if acidosis, wash off and hold 1-2 days.
出現過度換氣須通知醫師、檢查血液氣體/電解質；若酸中毒，洗去並停用1-2天。
Other products: bacitracin (first-degree burns only), povidone-iodine, chlorhexidine skin cleanser.
Topical steroid absorption is highest on scalp, axilla, face, neck, eyelids, perineum; safe on back, palms, soles.
外用類固醇吸收最高部位：頭皮、腋下、臉、頸、眼瞼、會陰；背、手掌、腳底較安全。
Topical steroids: thin film, gloves, no dry occlusive dressing, not on open skin; watch for atrophy, striae and systemic absorption.
外用類固醇：薄塗、戴手套、不用乾性密封敷料、不塗開放傷口；注意萎縮、妊娠紋與全身吸收。
Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus: protect from sun; risk of skin cancer/lymphoma.
Tacrolimus/pimecrolimus：避免日曬；皮膚癌/淋巴瘤風險。
Sunscreen: SPF 15 or higher, broad-spectrum, apply 30 minutes before exposure, reapply every 2-3 hours and after swimming/sweating.
防曬乳：SPF 15以上、廣譜、曝曬前30分鐘塗抹、每2-3小時及游泳/流汗後補擦。
Salicylic acid toxicity (salicylism): tinnitus, dizziness, hyperpnea.
Salicylic acid中毒（水楊酸中毒）：耳鳴、頭暈、過度換氣。
Methotrexate and acitretin are teratogenic; acitretin needs 2 contraceptives (1 month before, 3 years after).
Methotrexate與acitretin致畸；acitretin需兩種避孕（前1個月、後3年）。
Biologics: TB screening before starting; no live vaccines; watch for serious infection.
生物製劑：開始前篩檢結核；不可接種活性疫苗；注意嚴重感染。
Isotretinoin: highly teratogenic (iPLEDGE), measure triglycerides before/during, avoid vitamin A and alcohol, stop if depression.
Isotretinoin：高度致畸（iPLEDGE）、治療前後測三酸甘油酯、避免維生素A與酒精、憂鬱時停藥。
Tretinoin and other retinoids: use sunscreen SPF 15+, stop vitamin A supplements.
Tretinoin等類視黃酮：使用SPF 15以上防曬、停用維生素A補充。
Silver sulfadiazine: monitor WBC; leukopenia (e.g., 3000/mm3) must be reported; it does not promote healing and does not cause acidosis.
Silver sulfadiazine：監測WBC；白血球低下（如3000/mm3）須通報；不促進癒合且不會造成酸中毒。
Mafenide: metabolic acidosis with hyperventilation; premedicate for pain; monitor ABGs and electrolytes.
Mafenide：代謝性酸中毒伴過度換氣；先給止痛；監測血液氣體與電解質。
Oral antibiotics for acne take 3-6 months to show benefit.
痤瘡口服抗生素需3-6個月見效。
Retinoid rule 'No A, No Sun, No Baby': stop vitamin A, use sunscreen, avoid pregnancy (isotretinoin, acitretin).
類視黃酮三不口訣：不補維生素A、不曬太陽（要防曬）、不懷孕（isotretinoin、acitretin）。
Mafenide = 'Mafenide Makes acidosis' (carbonic anhydrase inhibitor); silver sulfadiazine = 'Silver Shrinks WBCs' (leukopenia).
Mafenide＝造成酸中毒（碳酸酐酶抑制）；silver sulfadiazine＝白血球減少。

Cancer basics, diagnosis and pain control
癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Cancer is uncontrolled growth of cells that lost normal growth control; it can impair immunity, blood production, GI, motor/sensory and respiratory function.
癌症是失去生長控制的細胞不受控增生，可損害免疫、造血、胃腸、運動感覺與呼吸功能。
Cancer basics, diagnosis and pain control
癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Metastasis: local seeding, bloodborne (most common), lymphatic spread.
轉移途徑：局部播種、血行性（最常見）、淋巴性。
Cancer basics, diagnosis and pain control
癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Solid tumors arise in organs; hematological cancers (leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma) arise from blood-forming tissue.
實體腫瘤源自器官；血液癌（白血病、淋巴瘤、多發性骨髓瘤）源自造血組織。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Grading (I-IV) describes cell differentiation under the microscope; staging (0-IV) describes size, spread and metastasis. Stage 0 = in situ, stage IV = distant metastasis.
分級（I-IV）描述顯微鏡下細胞分化程度；分期（0-IV）描述大小、擴散與轉移。0期=原位癌，IV期=遠處轉移。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Risks: chemical, physical (radiation, UV), viral (EBV, HBV, HPV), H. pylori, tobacco, obesity, diet, genetics, age, immunosuppression.
危險因子：化學物質、物理因素（輻射、紫外線）、病毒（EBV、HBV、HPV）、幽門螺旋桿菌、菸草、肥胖、飲食、遺傳、年齡、免疫抑制。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Early detection: mammography, Pap test, stool occult blood, colonoscopy, breast and testicular self-exam, skin checks, and the nine CAUTION-US warning signs.
早期偵測：乳房攝影、子宮頸抹片、糞便潛血、大腸鏡、乳房與睪丸自我檢查、皮膚檢查及CAUTION警訊。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Biopsy is the definitive diagnosis; types are needle, incisional, excisional and staging. Frozen section gives results in minutes; permanent paraffin section takes about 24 hours but is clearer.
切片為確診方法；類型有針吸、切開、全切除與分期切片。冷凍切片數分鐘出結果；石蠟永久切片約24小時但較清晰。

Other tests: CBC, CT/PET, MRI, tumor markers (CEA, alpha-fetoprotein), bone marrow exam, endoscopy; invasive procedures need informed consent.
其他檢查：全血球計數、CT/PET、MRI、腫瘤標記（CEA、AFP）、骨髓檢查、內視鏡；侵入性檢查需知情同意。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Cancer pain arises from bone destruction, organ obstruction, nerve compression, infiltration, inflammation and anxiety.
癌痛源於骨破壞、器官阻塞、神經壓迫、組織浸潤、發炎與焦慮。
Cancer basics, diagnosis and pain control
癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制

Pain is what the client says it is. Most cancer pain is controlled with around-the-clock oral opioids; mild pain uses acetaminophen/NSAIDs; severe pain uses morphine, hydromorphone, methadone; neuropathic pain may need anticonvulsants or antidepressants.
疼痛以病人主訴為準。多數癌痛可用口服鴉片類藥物定時給予控制；輕度用acetaminophen/NSAIDs；重度用morphine、hydromorphone、methadone；神經痛可用抗癲癇藥或抗憂鬱藥。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Use equianalgesic charts when changing routes; add relaxation, imagery, biofeedback, massage, heat/cold.
更換給藥途徑時使用等效鎮痛換算表；加入放鬆、意象、生理回饋、按摩與冷熱敷。

癌症基礎、診斷與疼痛控制
Surgery types: prophylactic, curative, control (debulking), palliative, reconstructive. Risks include pain, infection, bleeding, thromboembolism and body image grief.
手術類型：預防性、根治性、控制性（減積）、緩和性、重建性。風險包括疼痛、感染、出血、血栓與身體意象失落。
Chemotherapy is systemic and harms rapidly dividing normal cells (skin, hair, GI lining, sperm, bone marrow); combinations are timed around the nadir. See Chapter 46.
化療為全身性，傷害快速分裂的正常細胞（皮膚、毛髮、胃腸黏膜、精子、骨髓）；組合療程依最低點（nadir）安排。詳見第46章。

External beam radiation: client is not radioactive; teach skin care (no lotions or powders unless prescribed, mild soap, pat dry, avoid sun, do not wash off markings). Fatigue is the most common side effect.
外部放射治療：病人不具放射性；皮膚護理：未經處方不塗乳液粉劑、溫和肥皂、輕拍擦乾、避免日曬、勿洗掉標記。疲倦為最常見副作用。
Brachytherapy: sealed source implants make the client radioactive but excreta are not; unsealed source (oral/IV) makes body fluids radioactive for about 48 hours.
近接治療：密封式植入使病人具放射性，但排泄物不具放射性；非密封式（口服/靜脈）使體液具放射性約48小時。

Sealed implant precautions: private room, sign on door, 30 minutes per caregiver per shift, dosimeter badge, lead shielding, rotate staff, no pregnant staff, no children under 16 or pregnant visitors, visitors 6 feet away and 30 minutes/day, never touch a dislodged source (use long forceps into a lead container).
密封植入防護：單人房、門上警示、每位照護者每班30分鐘、佩戴劑量計、鉛屏蔽、輪替人員、懷孕者不可照護、16歲以下兒童與孕婦不可探視、訪客距離6呎且每日30分鐘、掉落放射源不可徒手碰觸（以長夾放入鉛容器）。
After implant removal the client is not radioactive; cancer is not contagious.
移除植入物後病人不再具放射性；癌症不會傳染。
BMT or PBSCT replaces marrow destroyed by high-dose chemotherapy or radiation; used for leukemia, lymphoma, myeloma and neuroblastoma.
骨髓或周邊血幹細胞移植用以取代被高劑量化放療破壞的骨髓；用於白血病、淋巴瘤、骨髓瘤與神經母細胞瘤。
Donor types: autologous (own cells, most common, harvested in remission and frozen), allogeneic (sibling/unrelated), syngeneic (identical twin).
捐贈類型：自體（最常見，緩解期採集冷凍）、異體（手足或非親屬）、同基因（同卵雙胞胎）。

Steps: harvest (apheresis 4-6 hours, or iliac crest aspiration), conditioning regimen, infusion through central line like a transfusion, then engraftment when WBC, RBC and platelets begin to rise (2-5 weeks).
步驟：採集（血球分離4-6小時或髂骨抽取）、前處置（conditioning）、經中央靜脈如輸血般輸注、植入成功時白血球、紅血球、血小板開始回升（2-5週）。
Until engraftment the client has no natural immunity: infection, bleeding, neutropenia and thrombocytopenia are the main risks.
植入前病人無自然免疫力：主要風險為感染、出血、嗜中性球與血小板低下。
Complications: failure to engraft, graft-versus-host disease (allogeneic: donor cells attack recipient), hepatic veno-occlusive disease (RUQ pain, jaundice, ascites, weight gain, hepatomegaly).
併發症：植入失敗、移植物抗宿主病（異體：捐贈細胞攻擊受贈者）、肝靜脈阻塞症（右上腹痛、黃疸、腹水、體重增加、肝腫大）。

白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Leukemia is abnormal, immature leukocyte overproduction in marrow; ALL (children under 15), AML (15-39), CML (fourth decade), CLL (over 50).
白血病為骨髓中不成熟白血球異常增生；ALL（15歲以下）、AML（15-39歲）、CML（30多歲，人生第四個十年）、CLL（50歲以上）。
Leukemia, Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma
白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Findings: anemia (pallor, fatigue, tachycardia), thrombocytopenia (petechiae, bleeding), fever, enlarged nodes/spleen/liver, bone pain; bone marrow biopsy shows blasts.
表現：貧血（蒼白、疲倦、心搏過速）、血小板低下（瘀點、出血）、發燒、淋巴結脾肝腫大、骨痛；骨髓切片可見芽細胞。

白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤

Infection is a leading cause of death: protective isolation, private room (HEPA if possible), strict hand hygiene, no fresh flowers or plants, neutropenic diet without raw fruits and vegetables, no rectal temperatures or invasive procedures, no live vaccines.
感染為主要死因：保護性隔離、單人房（可行時HEPA）、嚴格洗手、不放鮮花植物、嗜中性球低下飲食（不吃生鮮蔬果）、不測肛溫與避免侵入性處置、不打活性疫苗。

Bleeding: risk under 50,000/mm3, spontaneous under 20,000/mm3 (may need platelet transfusion); soft toothbrush, electric razor, stool softeners, avoid NSAIDs, no suppositories or enemas, pad side rails.
出血：低於50,000/mm3有風險，低於20,000/mm3可能自發性出血（可能需輸血小板）；軟毛牙刷、電動刮鬍刀、軟便劑、避免NSAIDs、不用栓劑灌腸、床欄加墊。

白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Mucositis care (Box 45.8): soft brush, rinse, avoid alcohol or glycerin mouthwash, soft bland warm foods. Fatigue: small frequent high-calorie meals and rest.
口腔黏膜炎照護（Box 45.8）：軟毛牙刷、漱口、避免含酒精或甘油漱口水、溫和軟質食物。疲倦：少量多餐高熱量並充分休息。

Chemotherapy phases: induction (remission), consolidation (cure), maintenance (stay in remission).
化療階段：誘導（緩解）、鞏固（治癒）、維持（保持緩解）。
Leukemia, Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma
白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤

Hodgkin's: Reed-Sternberg cells in nodes; cervical nodes first, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, painless nodes; PET/CT stage; early stage treated with external radiation, advanced with multiagent chemotherapy; discuss sperm banking.
何杰金氏：淋巴結出現Reed-Sternberg細胞；頸部淋巴結先受侵、發燒、盜汗、體重減輕、疲倦；以PET/CT分期；早期以外部放療，晚期多藥化療；討論精子保存。
Leukemia, Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma
白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Multiple myeloma: malignant plasma cells destroy bone; bone pain (ribs, spine, pelvis), pathological fractures, hypercalcemia, high uric acid, renal failure, recurrent infection, anemia.
多發性骨髓瘤：惡性漿細胞破壞骨骼；肋骨脊椎骨盆疼痛、病理性骨折、高血鈣、高尿酸、腎衰竭、反覆感染、貧血。

白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Urine Bence Jones protein and bone marrow aspirate with immature plasma cells support diagnosis.
尿液Bence Jones蛋白與骨髓抽吸出現不成熟漿細胞可輔助診斷。
Leukemia, Hodgkin's lymphoma and multiple myeloma
白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
Care: at least 2 L fluid per day, ambulation, handle gently to avoid fractures, IV fluids and diuretics for calcium, bisphosphonates, analgesics, monitor kidney function.
照護：每日至少2 L水分、鼓勵活動、輕柔搬動防骨折、靜脈輸液與利尿劑降鈣、雙磷酸鹽、止痛、監測腎功能。
