白血病、何杰金氏淋巴瘤與多發性骨髓瘤
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌

Testicular cancer (ages 15-40; cryptorchidism risk): painless swelling, heavy 'dragging' feeling; do monthly testicular self-exam after a warm shower; unilateral orchiectomy and possibly retroperitoneal node dissection; offer sperm banking; ice pack first 48 hours.
睪丸癌（15-40歲；隱睪症為危險因子）：無痛腫大、下墜感；溫水淋浴後每月自我檢查；單側睪丸切除與可能的腹膜後淋巴結清除；提供精子保存；術後前48小時冰敷。
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌

Cervical cancer: HPV, smoking, early intercourse, multiple partners; painless postcoital bleeding and foul discharge; Pap test and HPV vaccine prevent; treatments include laser, cryosurgery (watery discharge several weeks, no tampons or intercourse), conization, hysterectomy and pelvic exenteration.
子宮頸癌：HPV、吸菸、初次性行為早、多重性伴侶；無痛性性交後出血與惡臭分泌物；抹片與HPV疫苗可預防；治療包括雷射、冷凍（數週水樣分泌物，避免棉條與性行為）、錐狀切除、子宮切除與骨盆腔臟器切除。
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌

After hysterectomy: monitor bleeding (more than one saturated pad per hour is excessive), SCDs, coughing and deep breathing, avoid lifting over 20 lb, no intercourse for 3-6 weeks. Pelvic exenteration: ileal conduit, colostomy, sexual counseling.
子宮切除術後：監測出血（每小時浸濕超過一片護墊為過量）、使用間歇壓迫裝置、咳嗽深呼吸、避免提超過20磅、3-6週內不性行為。骨盆臟器切除：迴腸導管、結腸造口、性諮詢。
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌
Ovarian cancer: often silent until advanced, bloating, urinary frequency, CA-125; surgery with debulking plus chemotherapy, intraperitoneal chemotherapy.
卵巢癌：晚期前常無症狀，腹脹、頻尿、CA-125上升；手術減積加化療、腹腔內化療。
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌

Endometrial cancer: postmenopausal abnormal bleeding; risk from estrogen, obesity, nulliparity, diabetes, hypertension; total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy; progesterone for estrogen-dependent tumors.
子宮內膜癌：停經後異常出血；危險因子為雌激素、肥胖、未生育、糖尿病、高血壓；全子宮與雙側輸卵管卵巢切除；雌激素依賴型可用黃體素。
睪丸癌、子宮頸癌、卵巢癌與子宮內膜癌
乳癌與乳房切除術照護

Risks: age over 65, family history, early menarche and late menopause, nulliparity, HRT, obesity. Findings: fixed, irregular, painless mass (upper outer quadrant), dimpling, peau d'orange, nipple retraction, axillary nodes.
危險因子：年齡大於65歲、家族史、初經早停經晚、未生育、荷爾蒙治療、肥胖。表現：固定、不規則、無痛腫塊（外上象限）、凹陷、橘皮樣皮膚、乳頭內縮、腋下淋巴結腫。
乳癌與乳房切除術照護
Breast self-exam 7-10 days after menses (postmenopausal on a set day monthly); trastuzumab for HER-2 positive tumors.
乳房自我檢查於月經後7-10天；停經者每月固定日期；HER-2陽性可用trastuzumab。
乳癌與乳房切除術照護
Procedures: lumpectomy, simple mastectomy, modified radical mastectomy (nodes removed).
手術：腫瘤切除術、單純乳房切除術、改良式根治性乳房切除術（含淋巴結）。
乳癌與乳房切除術照護
Postoperative: semi-Fowler's, affected arm elevated above heart, manage Jackson-Pratt drain, deep breathing, monitor for lymphedema and fluid collection.
術後：半坐臥、患側手臂高於心臟、管理Jackson-Pratt引流、深呼吸、監測淋巴水腫與積液。
乳癌與乳房切除術照護
No IVs, injections, BP or venipuncture in the affected arm; protect the arm, gloves for gardening, no tight jewelry, no heavy bag, medical alert bracelet.
患側手臂不可靜脈注射、注射、量血壓或抽血；保護手臂、園藝戴手套、避免緊束飾物、不提重物、佩戴醫療警示手環。
乳癌與乳房切除術照護
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸
Esophageal: dysphagia, odynophagia; smoking, alcohol, reflux, Barrett's; watch aspiration and nutrition.
食道癌：吞嚥困難、吞嚥痛；吸菸、酒精、逆流、Barrett食道；注意吸入與營養。
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸

Gastric: H. pylori, smoked/salted foods; early indigestion, late weight loss, iron-deficiency anemia, epigastric mass; Billroth I and II or total gastrectomy; postoperative NG drainage bloody then brown then yellow; do not irrigate or remove NG tube; watch dumping, B12 deficiency.
胃癌：幽門螺旋桿菌、燻製鹽漬食物；早期消化不良，晚期體重減輕、缺鐵性貧血、上腹腫塊；Billroth I與II或全胃切除；術後鼻胃管引流液先血性再褐色後黃色；勿自行沖洗或拔除；注意傾倒症候群與B12缺乏。
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸
Pancreatic: jaundice, clay stools, dark urine, weight loss, glucose intolerance, poor prognosis; Whipple procedure; monitor blood glucose.
胰臟癌：黃疸、陶土色便、深色尿、體重減輕、葡萄糖耐受不良、預後差；Whipple手術；監測血糖。
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸
Colorectal: blood in stool most common; ascending tumor = diarrhea, descending = constipation or ribbon stool, rectal = alternating; complications: perforation, obstruction, abscess, hemorrhage.
大腸直腸癌：糞便帶血最常見；升結腸=腹瀉，降結腸=便祕或細扁糞便，直腸=便祕腹瀉交替；併發症：穿孔、阻塞、膿瘍、出血。
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸

Colostomy: stoma should be red or pink, pale means low Hgb/Hct, dark blue/purple/black means ischemia - call surgeon; ascending colostomy liquid stool, descending near-formed; empty pouch at one-third full. Ileostomy: dark green then yellow liquid stool, risk dehydration.
結腸造口：造口應紅或粉紅，蒼白表示血紅素/血容比低，暗藍紫黑表示缺血須通知外科；升結腸造口為液狀便，降結腸接近成形；袋子1/3滿時倒空。迴腸造口：深綠後轉黃的液狀便，有脫水風險。
GI cancers: esophageal, gastric, pancreatic, colorectal
消化道癌：食道、胃、胰臟、大腸
Lung: smoking and pollutants; SCLC vs NSCLC; cough, hemoptysis, wheezing, hoarseness, weight loss, clubbing; diagnosed with imaging, bronchoscopy and sputum cytology.
肺癌：吸菸與污染；小細胞肺癌與非小細胞肺癌；咳嗽、咳血、喘鳴、聲音沙啞、體重減輕、杵狀指；以影像、支氣管鏡與痰液細胞學診斷。
Airway is the priority; Fowler's position, oxygen, humidification, high-calorie diet; thoracentesis or pleurodesis for malignant effusion.
氣道為優先；採Fowler's臥位、給氧、加濕、高熱量飲食；惡性肋膜積液可行胸腔穿刺或肋膜沾黏術。

Surgery: pneumonectomy, lobectomy, segmental resection. After pneumonectomy no chest tube drainage is usually used; fluid fills the space and consolidates, stabilizing the mediastinum. Avoid complete lateral turning per surgeon.
手術：全肺、肺葉、肺節切除。全肺切除通常不放胸管引流，積液會填滿並固化，穩定縱膈；依醫囑避免完全側臥。
Laryngeal: smoking plus alcohol, persistent hoarseness, painless neck mass, dysphagia; total laryngectomy leaves a permanent stoma.
喉癌：吸菸加飲酒、持續聲音沙啞、無痛頸部腫塊、吞嚥困難；全喉切除留下永久性氣切造口。
Post-laryngectomy: high Fowler's, suction, airway patency, neck hemorrhage and edema, tube feedings, stoma guard and shower shield, humidity, fluids 3000 mL, medical alert bracelet.
喉切除術後：高坐臥、抽吸、維持氣道通暢、監測頸部出血與水腫、管灌飲食、造口護罩與淋浴護罩、增加環境濕度、每日液體3000 mL、佩戴醫療警示手環。
Speech options: esophageal speech, electrolarynx, tracheoesophageal fistula prosthesis.
語言復健：食道發聲、電子喉、氣管食道瘻管發聲閥。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術

Slow-growing adenocarcinoma, risk rises after 50; early silent, later hard nodule on DRE, hematuria, obstruction, bone pain. PSA alone is not a screening test; used to monitor therapy; biopsy diagnoses.
生長緩慢的腺癌，50歲後風險上升；早期無症狀，後期直腸指診可摸到硬結節、血尿、阻塞、骨痛。PSA不可單獨作篩檢，用於追蹤治療；切片確診。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術
Treatment: androgen suppression (hot flashes, low libido, osteoporosis), radiation, brachytherapy, orchiectomy, prostatectomy (retropubic, perineal, suprapubic), TURP for palliation.
治療：雄激素抑制（熱潮紅、性慾降低、骨質疏鬆）、放療、近接治療、睪丸切除、攝護腺切除（恥骨後、會陰、恥骨上）、TURP用於症狀緩解。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術
Post-TURP: watch for hemorrhage and TUR syndrome (hyponatremia/water intoxication: confusion, bradycardia, hypertension). Use sterile irrigation solution only.
TURP後：監測出血與TUR症候群（低血鈉/水中毒：意識混亂、心搏過緩、高血壓）。僅使用無菌沖洗液。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術

CBI with three-way catheter: keep urine pink; bright red with clots = arterial bleeding, increase CBI and call; burgundy = venous, traction may be applied; if obstruction, stop CBI and irrigate 30-50 mL saline if prescribed; do not release traction without order.
三腔導尿管膀胱持續灌洗：維持粉紅尿；鮮紅且有血塊=動脈出血，加快灌洗並通知醫師；暗紅=靜脈出血，可能施以導管牽引；阻塞時停止灌洗並依醫囑以30-50 mL生理食鹽水沖洗；未經醫囑不可放鬆牽引。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術

Teach: fluids 2400-3000 mL/day, avoid straining, heavy lifting, Valsalva, intercourse for 2-6 weeks, perineal exercises; urge to void is normal, do not void around catheter (spasm). Avoid rectal tubes, enemas and thermometers after perineal surgery.
衛教：每日2400-3000 mL液體、避免用力解便、提重物、Valsalva動作及2-6週內性行為、會陰運動；持續尿意屬正常，不可繞著導管解尿（引起痙攣）。會陰手術後避免肛管、灌腸與肛溫。
攝護腺癌與攝護腺切除術
Painless hematuria is the most common sign; smoking and industrial chemicals are risks; diagnosis by bladder wash and biopsy.
無痛性血尿為最常見徵象；吸菸與工業化學物為危險因子；以膀胱沖洗細胞學與切片診斷。
Intravesical chemotherapy: retain 2 hours, rotate position every 15-30 minutes, then void sitting and drink fluids; urine is biohazard; disinfect toilet with bleach for 6 hours.
膀胱內化療：留置2小時，每15-30分鐘變換姿勢，之後坐著排尿並多喝水；尿液視為生物危害；6小時內以漂白水消毒馬桶。
Surgery: TURBT with fulguration, partial cystectomy (capacity about 60 mL then 200-400 mL), cystectomy with urinary diversion.
手術：經尿道膀胱腫瘤切除與電灼、部分膀胱切除（容量約60 mL後增至200-400 mL）、膀胱切除加尿路改道。

Diversions: ileal conduit (Bricker, incontinent stoma, needs pouch), Kock and Indiana pouches (continent, self-catheterize every 4-6 hours after building up from 2-3 hours), neobladder, ureterostomy, nephrostomy.
改道方式：迴腸導管（Bricker，非節制性造口需戴袋）、Kock與Indiana貯尿囊（節制性，從每2-3小時逐週增加至每4-6小時自我導尿）、新膀胱、輸尿管造口、腎造口。

Postop stoma: red and moist, check hourly for 24 hours; dark/dusky = necrosis, call surgeon. Urine output 30-60 mL/hr; report under 30 mL/hr or none for 15 minutes. Peristalsis returns in 3-4 days; NPO until bowel sounds.
術後造口：紅且濕潤，前24小時每小時評估；暗沉=壞死須通知外科。尿量30-60 mL/小時；低於30 mL/小時或15分鐘無尿須通報。腸蠕動於3-4天恢復；腸音恢復前禁食。

Urinary stoma care: change appliance in the morning, cut barrier no more than 3 mm larger than stoma, empty at one-third full, change every 5-7 days, non-karaya products, vinegar rinse to reduce odor.
尿路造口護理：早晨更換裝置、皮膚護板開口不超過造口3 mm、1/3滿時倒空、每5-7天更換、使用非karaya產品、白醋浸泡減少異味。
Sepsis and DIC: gram-negative sepsis in immunocompromised clients; IV antibiotics, anticoagulants early in DIC, cryoprecipitated clotting factors if hemorrhage dominates.
敗血症與DIC：免疫低下病人易發生格蘭氏陰性菌敗血症；靜脈抗生素、DIC早期給抗凝劑、出血為主時給冷凍沉澱凝血因子。
SIADH: tumor-produced ADH causes water intoxication and hyponatremia (115-120 mEq/L mild; near 110 seizures, coma); restrict fluids, give sodium, ADH antagonist, treat tumor.
SIADH：腫瘤產生ADH造成水中毒與低血鈉（115-120 mEq/L輕度；近110時抽搐昏迷）；限水、補鈉、ADH拮抗劑、治療腫瘤。
Spinal cord compression: back pain first, then weakness, numbness, loss of bowel/bladder sensation; give high-dose corticosteroids, immediate radiation or surgery.
脊髓壓迫：先背痛，再無力、麻木、大小便感覺喪失；給予高劑量類固醇、立即放療或手術。
Hypercalcemia (bone metastasis): fatigue, nausea, constipation, polyuria, weakness, ECG changes; fluids, calcium-lowering drugs, encourage walking, dialysis if severe.
高血鈣（骨轉移）：疲倦、噁心、便祕、多尿、無力、心電圖改變；輸液、降鈣藥物、鼓勵走動、嚴重時透析。

Superior vena cava syndrome (lung cancer, lymphoma): facial and periorbital edema in the morning, tight collar (Stokes' sign), dyspnea, neck vein distention; semi-Fowler's, steroids, diuretics, mediastinal radiation or stent.
上腔靜脈症候群（肺癌、淋巴瘤）：晨起臉部眼周水腫、衣領變緊（Stokes徵象）、呼吸困難、頸靜脈怒張；半坐臥、類固醇、利尿劑、縱膈放療或支架。

Tumor lysis syndrome: hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia with hypocalcemia, hyperuricemia leading to AKI; hydrate, diuretics, allopurinol, glucose-insulin for potassium, dialysis if needed, low K and phosphorus diet.
腫瘤溶解症候群：高血鉀、高血磷伴低血鈣、高尿酸導致急性腎損傷；補水、利尿劑、allopurinol、葡萄糖加胰島素降鉀、必要時透析、低鉀低磷飲食。
Anemia: too few healthy red cells or hemoglobin; fatigue, pallor, dyspnea, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, chest pain, cool extremities.
貧血：健康紅血球或血紅素不足；疲倦、蒼白、呼吸困難、心搏過速、心律不整、胸痛、四肢冰冷。
Iron deficiency: microcytic, hypochromic, low Hgb/Hct/MCV. Iron between meals with vitamin C; not with milk or antacids; black stools, constipation; liquid iron through straw; Z-track if IM.
缺鐵性貧血：小球性低色素、血紅素/血容比/MCV低。鐵劑餐間服用並配維生素C；不與牛奶或制酸劑併服；黑便、便祕；液態鐵用吸管；肌注採Z字形。
Vitamin B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia, lack of intrinsic factor): macrocytic, beefy red tongue, paresthesias, gait disturbance; lifelong B12 injections.
維生素B12缺乏（惡性貧血，缺乏內在因子）：大球性、牛肉紅舌、感覺異常、步態不穩；需終身注射B12。
Folate deficiency: macrocytic, from poor diet, alcoholism, malabsorption, anticonvulsants, pregnancy; give folic acid and folate-rich foods.
葉酸缺乏：大球性，因飲食不良、酗酒、吸收不良、抗癲癇藥、懷孕；補充葉酸與富含葉酸食物。
Aplastic anemia: pancytopenia from marrow failure; marrow biopsy shows fatty marrow; treat with immunosuppression (ATG), transplant if donor available, bleeding and infection precautions.
再生不良性貧血：骨髓衰竭造成全血球低下；骨髓切片呈脂肪化；以免疫抑制（ATG）治療，有合適捐贈者則移植；預防出血與感染。
Pain is what the client says; do not undermedicate; around-the-clock oral opioids control most cancer pain.
疼痛以病人主訴為準；不可給藥不足；定時口服鴉片類可控制多數癌痛。

Sealed radiation implant: client emits radiation, excreta do not. Limit caregiver time to 30 min/shift, no pregnant staff, visitors 6 ft away; lost source: long forceps into lead container, never touch.
密封放射植入：病人具放射性，排泄物不具。照護者每班30分鐘、孕婦不可照護、訪客距離6呎；放射源掉落以長夾放入鉛容器，絕不徒手碰觸。
External beam radiation does not make the client radioactive; protect skin, avoid lotions, sun, friction, and do not wash off markings.
外部放療不使病人具放射性；保護皮膚，避免乳液、日曬、摩擦，勿洗掉標記。
Until stem cell engraftment (2-5 weeks) the client has no immunity; main risks are infection, bleeding, GVHD in allogeneic transplants, hepatic veno-occlusive disease.
幹細胞植入前（2-5週）病人無免疫力；主要風險為感染、出血、異體移植的GVHD、肝靜脈阻塞症。
Leukemia: infection is the major cause of death. Protective isolation, no fresh flowers or raw produce, no rectal temps or injections, no live vaccines.
白血病：感染為主要死因。保護性隔離、不放鮮花與生食、不測肛溫與注射、不打活性疫苗。
Platelets under 50,000/mm3 bleeding risk; under 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding and platelet transfusion.
血小板低於50,000/mm3有出血風險；低於20,000/mm3自發性出血並可能輸血小板。
Multiple myeloma: protect from pathological fractures, 2 L fluid per day, watch calcium, uric acid and kidney failure; Bence Jones proteinuria.
多發性骨髓瘤：防病理性骨折、每日2 L水分、監測血鈣尿酸與腎衰竭；Bence Jones蛋白尿。
Testicular self-exam monthly after a warm shower; painless swelling is the key sign.
睪丸自我檢查每月一次，溫水淋浴後；無痛性腫大為關鍵徵象。
After mastectomy: no BP, IV or venipuncture in the affected arm; elevate arm, watch lymphedema.
乳房切除術後：患側手臂不可量血壓、靜脈注射或抽血；抬高手臂、注意淋巴水腫。
Colostomy/urostomy stoma: red/pink healthy; dark blue, purple, black or dusky means ischemia, notify surgeon.
結腸/泌尿造口：紅或粉紅為健康；暗藍、紫、黑或暗沉代表缺血，須通知外科。
Lung or laryngeal cancer: airway is the priority; after laryngectomy keep high Fowler's, suction, tracheostomy stoma permanent.
肺癌或喉癌：氣道為優先；喉切除術後高坐臥、抽吸、氣切造口為永久性。
Post-TURP/prostatectomy CBI: pink urine goal; bright red with clots = arterial bleeding; obstruction: stop CBI, notify surgeon; watch TUR syndrome (hyponatremia).
TURP/攝護腺切除術後持續膀胱灌洗：目標粉紅尿；鮮紅含血塊=動脈出血；阻塞時停止灌洗並通知醫師；注意TUR症候群（低血鈉）。
Urinary diversion: report urine output under 30 mL/hr; stoma should be red and moist.
尿路改道：尿量低於30 mL/小時須通報；造口應紅潤濕潤。
Spinal cord compression: back pain precedes neuro deficits; give high-dose steroids and prepare for radiation. It is an emergency.
脊髓壓迫：背痛先於神經缺損；給高劑量類固醇並準備放療；屬急症。
SIADH: sodium 115-120 mild, near 110 seizures; fluid restriction, sodium, monitor sodium.
SIADH：鈉115-120輕度，近110抽搐；限水、補鈉、監測血鈉。
Tumor lysis syndrome: high K, high phosphorus, low Ca, high uric acid; hydrate, allopurinol, glucose-insulin, dialysis if refractory.
腫瘤溶解症候群：高鉀、高磷、低鈣、高尿酸；補水、allopurinol、葡萄糖加胰島素、無效則透析。
SVC syndrome: facial edema in the morning and tight collar; semi-Fowler's, steroids, radiation.
上腔靜脈症候群：晨間臉腫、衣領緊；半坐臥、類固醇、放療。
Hypercalcemia of malignancy: weakness, constipation, polyuria, ECG changes; fluids and encourage walking.
惡性腫瘤高血鈣：無力、便祕、多尿、心電圖改變；輸液並鼓勵走動。
Iron: between meals with vitamin C, black stools expected. B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia) needs lifelong injections.
鐵劑：餐間併維生素C，黑便屬預期。B12缺乏（惡性貧血）需終身注射。

Chemotherapy kills or inhibits neoplastic cells for cure, longer survival, or fewer life-threatening complications; normal rapidly dividing cells are also hurt, which causes most side effects.
化療殺死或抑制腫瘤細胞，目的為治癒、延長存活或減少危及生命的併發症；正常的快速分裂細胞也會受損，造成多數副作用。
Cell cycle phase-specific drugs act only in one phase; phase-nonspecific drugs act in any phase (Fig. 46.1).
週期特異性藥物只在特定細胞週期作用；非特異性藥物在任何階段都有效（圖46.1）。
Drugs are usually combined, and may be paired with surgery or radiation; IV is the most common route, with oral, intra-arterial, isolated limb perfusion or intracavitary also used.
通常合併多種藥物，並可與手術或放療並用；最常見為靜脈給藥，也可口服、動脈內、肢體隔離灌注或體腔內給藥。
Dosing is based on body surface area (BSA), so measure current height and weight before each dose.
劑量依體表面積(BSA)計算，每次給藥前須測量當前身高與體重。
Chemotherapy causes rapid cell death with uric acid release; allopurinol may be given, especially in leukemia and lymphoma.
化療造成細胞快速死亡並釋出尿酸；尤其白血病與淋巴瘤可給予allopurinol。
Side effects and general nursing care
Common effects: anorexia, nausea/vomiting, mucositis, alopecia, diarrhea, anemia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, infertility and neuropathy.
常見副作用：厭食、噁心嘔吐、黏膜炎、落髮、腹瀉、貧血、嗜中性球低下、血小板低下、不孕與神經病變。
Side effects and general nursing care
Monitor CBC, WBC, platelets, uric acid and electrolytes; give antiemetics hours before and 12-48 hours after chemotherapy; encourage at least 2000 mL fluid per day.
監測全血球計數、白血球、血小板、尿酸與電解質；化療前數小時及後12-48小時給予止吐劑；每日至少攝取2000 mL液體。
Side effects and general nursing care
Platelets below 50,000/mm3 raise bleeding risk; below 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding may occur. Start bleeding precautions and avoid IM injections and venipunctures where possible.
血小板低於50,000/mm3出血風險增加；低於20,000/mm3可能自發性出血。應啟動出血預防措施，盡量避免肌肉注射與靜脈穿刺。
Side effects and general nursing care
ANC = WBC x % neutrophils; ANC below 1000 means neutropenia: hold the drug, notify the oncologist, and start neutropenic precautions (example: ANC 900).
ANC=白血球數x嗜中性球百分比；ANC低於1000為嗜中性球低下：暫停給藥、通知腫瘤科醫師並啟動嗜中性球低下防護（例如ANC 900）。
Side effects and general nursing care
Teach: avoid crowds and sick contacts, soft toothbrush, electric razor, no aspirin, no live vaccines, consult the provider before any vaccination, oral hygiene and mouth rinses.
衛教：避免人群與感染者、使用軟毛牙刷與電動刮鬍刀、避免阿斯匹靈、不可施打活性疫苗、接種前先詢問醫師、加強口腔衛生。
Side effects and general nursing care

Psychosocial: discuss hair loss and wigs before treatment, hair regrows months after the last dose; teratogenic so contraception is needed; infertility may be permanent, so offer sperm banking or egg preservation.
心理社會：治療前討論落髮與假髮，髮量於末次治療後數月長回；具致畸性需避孕；不孕可能不可逆，可提供精子或卵子保存。
Side effects and general nursing care
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應
Prepare IV chemotherapy in a biological safety cabinet; wear gloves, gown, eye protection and mask; pregnant nurses should avoid preparing or giving chemotherapy; discard in biohazard containers.
在生物安全櫃中調配靜脈化療藥；穿戴手套、隔離衣、護目與口罩；懷孕護理師應避免調配或給藥；廢棄物丟入生物危害容器。
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應
Vesicants go through a central line when possible; with a peripheral line, check blood return first.
起疱劑盡可能經中央靜脈導管給予；若用周邊靜脈須先確認有回血。
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應

Extravasation (pain, redness, swelling, slowed infusion): stop infusion, notify the provider, expect heat or ice depending on the drug and possibly an antidote injected into the site. Never restart in the same vein or speed the flow.
藥物外滲（疼痛、紅腫、滴速變慢）：停止輸注、通知醫師，依藥物使用冷敷或熱敷，可能需於局部注射解毒劑；不可在同一條靜脈重新建立或加快滴速。
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應

Anaphylaxis signs: dyspnea, chest tightness, urticaria, tachycardia, hypotension, anxiety, cyanosis. Stop the drug, call rapid response, give oxygen, keep IV open with saline, prepare epinephrine and intubation.
過敏性休克徵象：呼吸困難、胸悶、蕁麻疹、心搏過速、低血壓、焦慮、發紺。立即停藥、呼叫快速反應小組、給氧、以生理食鹽水維持靜脈通路、備epinephrine與插管。
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應
Prevent anaphylaxis: allergy history, test dose if prescribed, stay with the client, have emergency equipment ready.
預防：詢問過敏史、依醫囑做測試劑量、全程陪伴病人、備妥急救設備。
安全處理、藥物外滲與過敏性反應
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素
Alkylating agents (nitrogen mustards, nitrosoureas, platinum compounds) break the DNA helix; they are cell cycle nonspecific.
烷化劑（氮芥類、亞硝基脲類、鉑類）破壞DNA雙股螺旋，屬非週期特異性。
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素
Busulfan, chlorambucil and mechlorethamine raise uric acid; cisplatin causes ototoxicity, tinnitus, nephrotoxicity, hypokalemia, hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia.
Busulfan、chlorambucil、mechlorethamine使尿酸升高；cisplatin造成耳毒性、耳鳴、腎毒性、低鉀、低鈣與低鎂。
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素
Cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide cause hemorrhagic cystitis: drink 2-3 L/day; mesna protects against ifosfamide cystitis; oral cyclophosphamide is taken without food.
Cyclophosphamide與ifosfamide造成出血性膀胱炎：每日飲水2-3 L；mesna可預防ifosfamide膀胱炎；口服cyclophosphamide宜空腹。
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素
Antitumor antibiotics (bleomycin, daunorubicin, doxorubicin, idarubicin) interfere with DNA/RNA synthesis and are nonspecific.
抗腫瘤抗生素（bleomycin、daunorubicin、doxorubicin、idarubicin）干擾DNA/RNA合成，屬非特異性。
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素

Daunorubicin/doxorubicin/idarubicin: cardiotoxicity, heart failure (crackles, edema, weight gain), ECG changes; dexrazoxane is cardioprotective. Bleomycin: pulmonary toxicity and fibrosis, so follow PFTs and lung sounds.
Daunorubicin/doxorubicin/idarubicin：心毒性、心衰竭（囉音、水腫、體重增加）、心電圖變化；dexrazoxane具心臟保護作用。Bleomycin：肺毒性與肺纖維化，需追蹤肺功能與呼吸音。
烷化劑與抗腫瘤抗生素
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑
Antimetabolites act in the S phase: cytarabine, fluorouracil, mercaptopurine and methotrexate; bone marrow depression, stomatitis, diarrhea, alopecia.
抗代謝藥作用於S期：cytarabine、fluorouracil、mercaptopurine、methotrexate；骨髓抑制、口腔炎、腹瀉、落髮。
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑
Fluorouracil: cerebellar dysfunction (dizziness, weakness, ataxia) and photosensitivity; methotrexate: photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity; give leucovorin rescue with high-dose methotrexate.
Fluorouracil：小腦功能異常（頭暈、無力、共濟失調）與光敏感；methotrexate：光敏感、肝毒性；高劑量methotrexate須給leucovorin解救。
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑
Vinca alkaloids (vincristine, vinblastine, vinorelbine) act in the M phase: peripheral neuropathy, ptosis, hoarseness, constipation and paralytic ileus; give by minibag, not IV push.
長春花生物鹼（vincristine、vinblastine、vinorelbine）作用於M期：周邊神經病變、眼瞼下垂、聲音沙啞、便祕與麻痺性腸阻塞；以小袋稀釋輸注，不可靜脈推注。
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑
Taxanes (paclitaxel, docetaxel) are also mitotic inhibitors and can trigger hypersensitivity reactions.
紫杉醇類（paclitaxel、docetaxel）亦為有絲分裂抑制劑，可能引發過敏反應。
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑
Topoisomerase inhibitors (etoposide, irinotecan, topotecan) act in G2 and S phases: myelosuppression, diarrhea, orthostatic hypotension, hypersensitivity; infuse etoposide slowly over 30-60 minutes.
拓樸異構酶抑制劑（etoposide、irinotecan、topotecan）作用於G2與S期：骨髓抑制、腹瀉、姿勢性低血壓、過敏；etoposide須緩慢輸注30-60分鐘。
抗代謝藥、有絲分裂抑制劑、拓樸異構酶抑制劑

Hormonal agents block or change hormones in hormone-sensitive tumors: estrogens, antiestrogens (tamoxifen, anastrozole, letrozole), antiandrogens, progestins (megestrol), leuprolide, mitotane, asparaginase.
荷爾蒙藥物阻斷或改變荷爾蒙敏感腫瘤的激素環境：雌激素、抗雌激素（tamoxifen、anastrozole、letrozole）、抗雄激素、黃體素（megestrol）、leuprolide、mitotane、asparaginase。
Effects: nausea, leukopenia, hot flashes, weight gain, edema, hypertension, thromboembolism, sex-characteristic changes (gynecomastia, masculinizing effects).
影響：噁心、白血球低下、熱潮紅、體重增加、水腫、高血壓、血栓栓塞、性徵改變（男性女乳症、女性男性化）。
Tamoxifen: hypercalcemia, high cholesterol and triglycerides, venous thromboembolism risk; used to treat and prevent breast cancer. Monitor calcium.
Tamoxifen：高血鈣、膽固醇與三酸甘油酯升高、靜脈血栓風險；用於治療及預防乳癌。需監測血鈣。
Asparaginase impairs pancreatic function: contraindicated with pancreatitis history; watch nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain. Megestrol: caution with venous thromboembolism history.
Asparaginase損害胰臟功能：有胰臟炎病史者禁用；注意噁心、嘔吐、腹痛。Megestrol：有靜脈血栓病史者需謹慎。
免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物
Immunomodulators (interleukins, interferons) stimulate the immune system to destroy cancer cells.
免疫調節劑（介白素、干擾素）刺激免疫系統辨識並消滅癌細胞。
免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物
Colony-stimulating factors speed marrow recovery: filgrastim and pegfilgrastim (G-CSF), sargramostim (GM-CSF), epoetin and darbepoetin (erythropoietin).
群落刺激因子加速骨髓恢復：filgrastim、pegfilgrastim（G-CSF）、sargramostim（GM-CSF）、epoetin與darbepoetin（紅血球生成素）。
免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物
Targeted therapy uses monoclonal antibodies (rituximab, trastuzumab, bevacizumab, cetuximab) and small molecule inhibitors (imatinib, erlotinib); monoclonal antibodies can cause allergic reactions.
標靶治療包括單株抗體（rituximab、trastuzumab、bevacizumab、cetuximab）與小分子抑制劑（imatinib、erlotinib）；單株抗體可能引起過敏反應。
免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物
Other agents: altretamine (ovarian cancer), denileukin diftitox and bexarotene (cutaneous T-cell lymphoma), pegaspargase (ALL when asparaginase cannot be used).
其他藥物：altretamine（卵巢癌）、denileukin diftitox與bexarotene（皮膚T細胞淋巴瘤）、pegaspargase（無法使用asparaginase的急性淋巴性白血病）。
免疫療法、標靶治療與其他藥物
Iron-deficiency anemia: iron. Vitamin B12 deficiency: B12. Folate deficiency: folate.
缺鐵性貧血：補鐵；維生素B12缺乏：補B12；葉酸缺乏：補葉酸。
Acute blood-loss anemia: transfusion of packed red cells, platelets or fresh frozen plasma depending on cause.
急性失血性貧血：依原因輸注濃縮紅血球、血小板或新鮮冷凍血漿。
Anemia of chronic disease: iron and erythropoietic, leukopoietic and thrombopoietic growth factors.
慢性病貧血：鐵劑與紅血球、白血球、血小板生成因子。
Dose by BSA: obtain actual current height and weight before every dose, never client-reported values.
依BSA給藥：每次給藥前測量實際身高與體重，不可只憑病人自述。
ANC = WBC x neutrophil %. ANC below 1000: hold chemotherapy, notify oncologist, start neutropenic precautions.
ANC=白血球x嗜中性球百分比。ANC低於1000：暫停化療、通知腫瘤科醫師、啟動嗜中性球低下防護。
Platelets under 50,000/mm3 start bleeding precautions; under 20,000/mm3 spontaneous bleeding risk. Avoid IM injections, aspirin and NSAIDs.
血小板低於50,000/mm3啟動出血預防；低於20,000/mm3有自發性出血風險。避免肌肉注射、阿斯匹靈與NSAIDs。
Extravasation: stop infusion, notify PHCP, heat or ice per drug, antidote into site. Do not flush faster or restart in the same vein.
藥物外滲：停止輸注、通知醫師、依藥物冷熱敷、局部注射解毒劑；不可加快沖洗或在同一條靜脈重打。
Anaphylaxis to chemotherapy: stop infusion first, call rapid response, oxygen, keep IV with saline, epinephrine.
化療過敏性休克：先停藥、呼叫快速反應、給氧、生理食鹽水維持靜脈通路、給epinephrine。
Antiemetics are given several hours before chemotherapy and for 12-48 hours afterward; keep fluids at 2000 mL/day or more.
止吐劑於化療前數小時及後12-48小時給予；每日液體至少2000 mL。
Hyperuricemia from massive cell kill (leukemia, lymphoma): monitor uric acid, give allopurinol; busulfan also raises uric acid.
大量細胞死亡造成高尿酸（白血病、淋巴瘤）：監測尿酸、給allopurinol；busulfan亦使尿酸升高。
Cyclophosphamide/ifosfamide: hemorrhagic cystitis; 2-3 L fluid daily, report hematuria, mesna with ifosfamide.
Cyclophosphamide/ifosfamide：出血性膀胱炎；每日飲水2-3 L、通報血尿、ifosfamide併用mesna。
Cisplatin: ototoxicity, tinnitus, nephrotoxicity, low K, Ca, Mg.
Cisplatin：耳毒性、耳鳴、腎毒性、低鉀鈣鎂。
Doxorubicin/daunorubicin: cardiotoxicity and heart failure (lung crackles, edema, weight gain, ECG changes). Bleomycin: pulmonary fibrosis, follow PFTs.
Doxorubicin/daunorubicin：心毒性與心衰竭（肺囉音、水腫、體重增加、心電圖變化）。Bleomycin：肺纖維化，追蹤肺功能。
Methotrexate high dose: leucovorin rescue. Fluorouracil/methotrexate: sunscreen and protective clothing; fluorouracil: watch ataxia and stomatitis.
高劑量methotrexate：leucovorin解救。Fluorouracil/methotrexate：防曬與保護衣物；fluorouracil注意共濟失調與口腔炎。
Vincristine: peripheral neuropathy (numbness, tingling, lost Achilles reflex), constipation and paralytic ileus, ptosis; never IV push.
Vincristine：周邊神經病變（麻木刺痛、跟腱反射減弱）、便祕與麻痺性腸阻塞、眼瞼下垂；不可靜脈推注。
Etoposide: orthostatic hypotension; infuse over 30-60 minutes and monitor blood pressure.
Etoposide：姿勢性低血壓；輸注30-60分鐘並監測血壓。
Tamoxifen: monitor calcium (hypercalcemia), lipids, thromboembolism; treats and prevents breast cancer.
Tamoxifen：監測血鈣（高血鈣）、血脂、血栓；可治療與預防乳癌。
Asparaginase contraindicated in pancreatitis; megestrol caution with venous thromboembolism.
Asparaginase禁用於胰臟炎；megestrol對靜脈血栓病史者需謹慎。
No live vaccines for the client or household contacts; check with PHCP before any immunization. Pregnant nurses avoid handling chemotherapy.
病人與同住者不可接種活性疫苗；任何接種前先問醫師。懷孕護理師避免接觸化療藥。
Phase-specific drugs: S = antimetabolites; M = mitotic inhibitors (vinca, taxanes); G2/S = topoisomerase inhibitors. Nonspecific = Alkylating, Antitumor antibiotics, Hormonal (AAH).
週期特異性：S期=抗代謝藥；M期=有絲分裂抑制劑（長春花、紫杉類）；G2/S期=拓樸異構酶抑制劑。非特異性=烷化劑、抗腫瘤抗生素、荷爾蒙（AAH）。
Organ toxicities: Bleomycin = Breath (lungs); Doxorubicin = Dead heart; Cisplatin = Can't hear/kidney; Vincristine = Vincristine nerves; Cyclophosphamide = Cystitis.
器官毒性：Bleomycin=肺；Doxorubicin=心；Cisplatin=耳與腎；Vincristine=神經；Cyclophosphamide=膀胱炎。
A client is scheduled for chemotherapy. The morning CBC shows WBC 3000/mm3 with 25% neutrophils. What should the nurse do?
病人預定化療，晨間血液檢查白血球3000/mm3，嗜中性球25%。護理師應如何處理？
A client receiving ifosfamide is at risk for which complication, and which measures are appropriate? Select all that apply.
接受ifosfamide的病人有哪些風險，哪些措施適當？（複選）
A client receiving doxorubicin reports shortness of breath, and the nurse hears bilateral crackles and notes weight gain. Which adverse effect is suspected?
接受doxorubicin的病人呼吸喘，護理師聽到雙側囉音且體重增加。懷疑何種不良反應？
During a vincristine infusion the nurse should teach the client to report which finding first?
vincristine治療期間，護理師應教導病人優先通報何種症狀？
During an IV chemotherapy infusion the client reports burning at the site, and the site is red and swollen with a slowed infusion. Select all appropriate actions.
化療靜脈輸注期間病人訴注射部位灼痛，局部紅腫且滴速變慢。請選出所有適當措施。（複選）

病人服用tamoxifen，護理師特別監測哪項檢驗值？

給予asparaginase前，何種病史需通知醫師？

Endocrine glands: hypothalamus, pituitary, thyroid, parathyroids, adrenals, pancreas, ovaries, testes; they regulate metabolism, stress response, growth, reproduction, fluid and electrolyte balance.
內分泌腺體：下視丘、腦下垂體、甲狀腺、副甲狀腺、腎上腺、胰臟、卵巢、睪丸；調控代謝、壓力反應、生長、生殖與水電解質平衡。
Pituitary is the master gland: anterior lobe makes ACTH, TSH, FSH, LH, GH, prolactin, MSH; posterior lobe stores oxytocin and ADH (vasopressin) made by the hypothalamus.
腦下垂體為主控腺體：前葉分泌ACTH、TSH、FSH、LH、GH、泌乳素、MSH；後葉儲存下視丘製造的oxytocin與ADH（vasopressin）。
Adrenal cortex: glucocorticoids (cortisol) and mineralocorticoids (aldosterone: sodium retention, potassium excretion); medulla: epinephrine and norepinephrine.
腎上腺皮質：糖皮質素（cortisol）與礦物皮質素（aldosterone：留鈉排鉀）；髓質：epinephrine與norepinephrine。
Thyroid makes T3, T4 and calcitonin; parathyroid makes PTH (calcium and phosphorus); pancreas makes insulin and glucagon.
甲狀腺分泌T3、T4與降鈣素；副甲狀腺分泌PTH（鈣磷代謝）；胰臟分泌胰島素與升糖素。
Negative feedback: rising target-gland hormone suppresses releasing hormones.
負回饋：標的腺體荷爾蒙上升會抑制其釋放荷爾蒙。
Stimulation tests check for hypofunction (hormone fails to rise); suppression tests check for hyperfunction (hormone fails to fall). Overnight dexamethasone suppression helps identify Cushing's.
刺激試驗檢查功能低下（荷爾蒙未上升）；抑制試驗檢查功能亢進（荷爾蒙未下降）。夜間dexamethasone抑制試驗用於辨別庫欣氏症。
Radioactive iodine uptake: about 3-19% at 2-4 hours, 11-30% at 24 hours; high in hyperthyroidism; contraindicated in pregnancy.
放射性碘攝取：2-4小時約3-19%、24小時約11-30%；甲亢時升高；懷孕禁用。
Total T4 5-12 mcg/dL; free T4 0.8-2.8 ng/dL; TSH 0.5-5.0 mIU/L: high TSH = primary hypothyroidism; low TSH = hyperthyroidism or secondary hypothyroidism.
總T4 5-12 mcg/dL；游離T4 0.8-2.8 ng/dL；TSH 0.5-5.0 mIU/L：TSH高=原發性甲低；TSH低=甲亢或次發性甲低。
Thyroid scan: avoid iodine-containing meds and contrast; NPO after midnight; contraindicated in pregnancy; fine needle aspiration for cytology.
甲狀腺掃描：避免含碘藥物與顯影劑；午夜後禁食；懷孕禁用；細針抽吸做細胞學檢查。
HbA1c reflects glucose control over about 90 days, no fasting needed, normal under 6% in adults without diabetes.
HbA1c反映約90天血糖控制，無需空腹，無糖尿病成人正常小於6%。
24-hour urine VMA, metanephrines and catecholamines for pheochromocytoma.
24小時尿液VMA、甲氧基腎上腺素與兒茶酚胺用於診斷嗜鉻細胞瘤。
Hypopituitarism: low GH, gonadotropins, TSH, ACTH or ADH from tumor, trauma, stroke; fatigue, low BP, infertility, headache and visual defects with tumors; replace deficient hormones.
腦下垂體功能低下：腫瘤、外傷、中風造成GH、性腺激素、TSH、ACTH或ADH不足；疲倦、低血壓、不孕，腫瘤可致頭痛與視野缺損；補充缺乏荷爾蒙。
Acromegaly (excess GH in adults): large hands/feet, jaw protrusion, joint pain, oily skin, sweating, hypertension, heart disease, sleep apnea, hyperglycemia, colon polyps.
肢端肥大症（成人GH過多）：手腳增大、下顎突出、關節痛、油性皮膚、多汗、高血壓、心臟病、睡眠呼吸中止、高血糖、大腸息肉。
Hypophysectomy: transsphenoidal approach preferred; complications CSF leak, infection, diabetes insipidus, hypopituitarism.
腦下垂體切除：偏好經蝶竇途徑；併發症為腦脊髓液漏、感染、尿崩症、腦下垂體功能低下。

Postop: HOB elevated, avoid sneezing, coughing, blowing nose, straining; no toothbrush early; report clear nasal drainage (test for glucose), monitor urine output; lifelong ADH, cortisol, thyroid replacement if entire gland removed.
術後：抬高床頭，避免打噴嚏、咳嗽、擤鼻、用力；早期不刷牙；通報清澈鼻液（檢測葡萄糖）、監測尿量；全切除需終身補充ADH、cortisol、甲狀腺素。
Diabetes insipidus: too little ADH (central) or kidney non-response (nephrogenic); large volumes of dilute urine, polydipsia, dehydration, low specific gravity, hypotension, tachycardia.
尿崩症：ADH不足（中樞性）或腎臟無反應（腎因性）；大量稀釋尿、多渴、脫水、尿比重低、低血壓、心搏過速。
DI care: replace fluids (hypotonic IV), strict I&O, weight, serum osmolality, desmopressin or vasopressin (watch for water intoxication), medical alert bracelet.
尿崩症照護：補充水分（低張靜脈輸液）、嚴格記錄出入量、體重、血清滲透壓、desmopressin或vasopressin（注意水中毒）、佩戴醫療警示手環。
SIADH: excess ADH causes water retention, dilutional hyponatremia, concentrated scant urine, weight gain without edema, confusion, seizures.
SIADH：ADH過多造成水滯留、稀釋性低血鈉、尿少濃縮、無水腫體重增加、意識混亂、抽搐。

SIADH care: fluid restriction (800-1000 mL/day if chronic), seizure precautions, HOB no more than 10 degrees, daily weight, hypertonic or normal saline, loop diuretic only if sodium at least 125 mEq/L, vasopressin antagonists.
SIADH照護：限水（慢性800-1000 mL/日）、抽搐防護、床頭最高抬高10度、每日體重、高張或生理食鹽水、鈉至少125 mEq/L才用袢利尿劑、vasopressin拮抗劑。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群

Addison's disease: cortical hypofunction (autoimmune): weakness, weight loss, hypotension, hypoglycemia, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, bronze hyperpigmentation; lifelong glucocorticoid (and often mineralocorticoid) replacement.
艾迪森氏病：腎上腺皮質功能低下（自體免疫）：無力、體重減輕、低血壓、低血糖、低血鈉、高血鉀、皮膚古銅色；需終身糖皮質素（常加礦物皮質素）補充。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群

Addisonian crisis: triggered by stress, infection, trauma, surgery, abrupt steroid stop; severe headache, abdominal/back pain, confusion, severe hypotension, shock; give IV hydrocortisone and fluids, bed rest, monitor Na, K, glucose.
艾迪森氏危象：由壓力、感染、外傷、手術、驟停類固醇誘發；劇烈頭痛、腹痛背痛、意識混亂、嚴重低血壓、休克；給予靜脈hydrocortisone與輸液、臥床休息、監測鈉鉀血糖。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群

Cushing's: excess cortisol; moon face, buffalo hump, truncal obesity with thin limbs, striae, bruising, hypertension, hyperglycemia, hypernatremia, hypokalemia, infection risk. Cushing's disease = pituitary ACTH source; syndrome includes exogenous steroids.
庫欣氏：皮質醇過多；月亮臉、水牛肩、軀幹肥胖四肢細、紫紋、易瘀青、高血壓、高血糖、高血鈉、低血鉀、易感染。庫欣氏病=腦下垂體ACTH來源；症候群含外源性類固醇。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群
Cushing's care: monitor BP, glucose, I&O, weight; protect from infection and thrombi; hypophysectomy or adrenalectomy; stress-dose steroids after surgery.
庫欣氏照護：監測血壓、血糖、出入量、體重；預防感染與血栓；腦下垂體或腎上腺切除；術後壓力情況增加類固醇。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群

Conn's (primary hyperaldosteronism): sodium and water retention, potassium loss: hypertension, hypokalemia, alkalosis, weakness, dysrhythmias, tetany; give potassium-sparing diuretics/aldosterone antagonists; adrenalectomy.
康氏症（原發性醛固酮過多）：留鈉水、失鉀：高血壓、低血鉀、鹼中毒、無力、心律不整、手足抽搐；給保鉀利尿劑/醛固酮拮抗劑；腎上腺切除。
腎上腺疾病：艾迪森氏、庫欣氏、康氏症候群
嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除
Catecholamine-secreting adrenal medulla tumor: paroxysmal hypertension, severe headache, palpitations, diaphoresis, flushing, tremor, hyperglycemia.
分泌兒茶酚胺的腎上腺髓質腫瘤：陣發性高血壓、劇烈頭痛、心悸、盜汗、臉潮紅、顫抖、高血糖。
嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除
Avoid triggers: abdominal palpation or pressure, smoking, caffeine, sudden position changes; quiet environment; alpha-blockers started 7-10 days before beta-blockers.
避免誘因：腹部觸診或壓迫、吸菸、咖啡因、突然變換姿勢；安靜環境；alpha阻斷劑須比beta阻斷劑早7-10天開始。
嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除
Hypertensive crisis: semi-Fowler's, notify PHCP, oxygen, IV access with slow saline, IV antihypertensives.
高血壓危象：半坐臥、通知醫師、給氧、緩慢輸注生理食鹽水保持靜脈通路、靜脈降壓藥。
嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除

Adrenalectomy: bilateral = lifelong glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid; unilateral = temporary replacement; watch hemorrhage, shock, hypotension, urine output under 30 mL/hr, paralytic ileus, adrenal insufficiency.
腎上腺切除：雙側=終身糖皮質素與礦物皮質素補充；單側=暫時補充；注意出血、休克、低血壓、尿量低於30 mL/小時、麻痺性腸阻塞、腎上腺功能不足。
嗜鉻細胞瘤與腎上腺切除

Hypothyroidism: low T4, high TSH (primary): fatigue, cold intolerance, weight gain, bradycardia, constipation, dry skin, myxedema; levothyroxine; avoid sedatives and opioids; warmth; watch overdose (tachycardia, chest pain, nervousness).
甲狀腺功能低下：T4低、TSH高（原發性）：疲倦、怕冷、體重增加、心搏過緩、便祕、皮膚乾燥、黏液水腫；levothyroxine；避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類；保暖；注意過量（心搏過速、胸痛、緊張）。
Myxedema coma: hypotension, bradycardia, hypothermia, hyponatremia, hypoglycemia, respiratory failure; secure airway, IV levothyroxine, IV fluids and glucose, corticosteroids, warm gently.
黏液水腫昏迷：低血壓、心搏過緩、體溫過低、低血鈉、低血糖、呼吸衰竭；確保氣道、靜脈levothyroxine、輸液與葡萄糖、皮質類固醇、緩慢保暖。
Hyperthyroidism (Graves' disease): T3/T4 high, TSH low; nervousness, tremor, heat intolerance, weight loss, diarrhea, tachycardia, exophthalmos, goiter.
甲狀腺功能亢進（葛瑞夫茲氏病）：T3/T4高、TSH低；緊張、顫抖、怕熱、體重減輕、腹瀉、心搏過速、突眼、甲狀腺腫。

Treatment: methimazole or propylthiouracil, iodides, propranolol, radioactive iodine, subtotal thyroidectomy; cool quiet environment, high-calorie diet; exophthalmos: HOB up, artificial tears, dark glasses, tape lids at night.
治療：methimazole或propylthiouracil、碘劑、propranolol、放射性碘、甲狀腺次全切除；涼爽安靜環境、高熱量飲食；突眼：抬高床頭、人工淚液、深色眼鏡、夜間貼合眼瞼。
Thyroid storm: fever, tachycardia, systolic hypertension, agitation, delirium; give antithyroid drugs, iodides, propranolol, glucocorticoids, cooling blanket, acetaminophen (not aspirin).
甲狀腺風暴：發燒、心搏過速、收縮壓高、躁動、譫妄；給抗甲狀腺藥、碘劑、propranolol、糖皮質素、降溫毯、acetaminophen（避免阿斯匹靈）。

Thyroidectomy postop: semi-Fowler's, support neck, tracheostomy set and suction at bedside, monitor hoarseness, laryngeal nerve damage, bleeding behind the neck, hypocalcemia with tetany (Chvostek, Trousseau), calcium gluconate ready.
甲狀腺切除術後：半坐臥、支托頸部、床邊備氣切包與抽吸、監測聲音沙啞、喉返神經損傷、頸後出血、低血鈣手足抽搐（Chvostek、Trousseau徵象）、備calcium gluconate。
Hypoparathyroidism (often after thyroidectomy): hypocalcemia, hyperphosphatemia, tingling, cramps, positive Chvostek/Trousseau, laryngospasm, seizures.
副甲狀腺功能低下（常見於甲狀腺切除後）：低血鈣、高血磷、麻刺感、抽筋、Chvostek/Trousseau陽性、喉痙攣、抽搐。
Care: IV calcium gluconate, seizure precautions, tracheostomy set, high-calcium low-phosphorus diet, calcium and vitamin D, phosphate binders.
照護：靜脈calcium gluconate、抽搐防護、備氣切包、高鈣低磷飲食、鈣與維生素D、磷結合劑。
Hyperparathyroidism: hypercalcemia, low phosphorus, bone pain and fractures, renal stones, constipation, weakness, dysrhythmias.
副甲狀腺功能亢進：高血鈣、低血磷、骨痛與骨折、腎結石、便祕、無力、心律不整。
Care: fluids, furosemide, IV saline, calcitonin, bisphosphonates, move gently, parathyroidectomy; postop watch hypocalcemic crisis, hoarseness.
照護：補水、furosemide、靜脈生理食鹽水、降鈣素、雙磷酸鹽、輕柔移動、副甲狀腺切除；術後注意低血鈣危象與聲音沙啞。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動

Type 1: nearly absolute insulin deficiency from beta cell destruction (ketosis-prone); type 2: insulin resistance or relative deficiency. Metabolic syndrome: abdominal obesity, hyperglycemia, hypertension, high triglycerides, low HDL.
第1型：胰島β細胞破壞造成幾近絕對胰島素缺乏（易酮症）；第2型：胰島素阻抗或相對不足。代謝症候群：腹部肥胖、高血糖、高血壓、高三酸甘油酯、低HDL。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動
Classic signs: polyuria, polydipsia, polyphagia, blurred vision, slow healing, infections; weight loss common in type 1.
典型症狀：多尿、多渴、多食、視力模糊、傷口癒合慢、感染；體重減輕多見於第1型。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動
Diet: consistent timing and amounts, carbohydrate counting for intensive insulin therapy.
飲食：進食時間與份量一致，強化胰島素治療可用碳水化合物計算。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動
Exercise lowers glucose; check glucose before, during, after; do not exercise if glucose above 250 mg/dL with ketones (type 1); avoid injecting insulin into the limb about to be exercised.
運動降血糖；運動前中後監測血糖；血糖大於250 mg/dL且有酮體（第1型）時不運動；避免將胰島素注射於即將運動的肢體。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動
Urine glucose is not reliable for monitoring; test urine ketones during illness or glucose over 250 mg/dL on two checks in type 1.
尿糖不可靠，不用於監測；生病或第1型連續兩次血糖大於250 mg/dL時檢測尿酮。
糖尿病概論、飲食與運動
Insulin treats type 1 and some type 2; never withhold during illness or stress. Know peak times for hypoglycemia risk. Only regular insulin (and rapid-acting) may be given IV.
胰島素用於第1型及部分第2型；生病或壓力時不可停用。需了解高峰時間以預防低血糖。僅短效（regular）及速效胰島素可靜脈給予。
Local allergy at the site; lipodystrophy from repeated site use: rotate within one anatomical area, sites 1.5 inches apart, not the same site for 2-3 weeks.
局部過敏；重複注射同一處造成脂肪營養不良：在同一解剖區輪替，間隔1.5吋，2-3週內不重複同一處。
Dawn phenomenon: morning hyperglycemia from GH and cortisol; adjust insulin dose or timing.
黎明現象：因生長激素與皮質醇造成晨間高血糖；調整胰島素劑量或時間。
Somogyi effect: nighttime hypoglycemia (2-3 a.m.) triggers counterregulatory hormones and morning hyperglycemia; night sweats, headaches, nightmares; decrease insulin or add bedtime snack.
蘇木吉效應：夜間2-3點低血糖引發反調節荷爾蒙造成晨間高血糖；盜汗、頭痛、惡夢；減少胰島素或睡前加點心。

Insulin pump: continuous basal rate plus meal bolus; rapid or regular insulin; change needle/catheter every 2-3 days; skin sensor monitors glucose. Pancreas transplant is done in limited clients, often with kidney.
胰島素幫浦：持續基礎量加餐前大量；速效或短效胰島素；每2-3天更換針頭/導管；皮膚感測器監測血糖。胰臟移植用於少數病人，常與腎臟移植同時。
低血糖、酮酸中毒與高滲透壓高血糖狀態

Hypoglycemia: glucose under 70 mg/dL; mild (sweating, tremor, tachycardia, hunger), moderate (confusion, slurred speech, irritability), severe (unarousable, seizures). Beta-blockers, older age and frequent episodes cause hypoglycemia unawareness.
低血糖：血糖低於70 mg/dL；輕度（出汗、顫抖、心搏過速、飢餓）、中度（混亂、口齒不清、易怒）、重度（無法喚醒、抽搐）。Beta阻斷劑、高齡與頻繁發作可造成低血糖無感。
低血糖、酮酸中毒與高滲透壓高血糖狀態

15/15 rule: give 15 g fast carbohydrate (1/2 cup juice, glucose gel), recheck in 15 minutes, repeat; if altered consciousness give glucagon IM/SC or 25-50 mL of 50% dextrose IV; follow with a complex carbohydrate and protein snack. Never give oral food to a semiconscious client.
15/15原則：給15 g速效碳水化合物（1/2杯果汁、葡萄糖膠），15分鐘後複測並重複；意識改變時給glucagon肌注/皮下或靜脈50%葡萄糖25-50 mL；之後給複合碳水加蛋白質點心。意識不清者不可口服進食。
低血糖、酮酸中毒與高滲透壓高血糖狀態
DKA (type 1): hyperglycemia, ketosis, acidosis, dehydration; Kussmaul respirations, fruity breath, abdominal pain; glucose over 300, pH under 7.35, HCO3 under 15, ketones positive; sudden onset.
DKA（第1型）：高血糖、酮症、酸中毒、脫水；Kussmaul呼吸、水果味呼氣、腹痛；血糖大於300、pH低於7.35、HCO3低於15、酮體陽性；起病急。

DKA treatment: fluids first (0.9% or 0.45% saline), then IV regular insulin by pump, replace potassium once urine output adequate (K falls quickly), add dextrose when glucose 250-300 mg/dL, cardiac monitoring, watch for cerebral edema if glucose drops too fast.
DKA治療：先補液（0.9%或0.45%食鹽水），再以幫浦靜脈給regular insulin，尿量足夠後補鉀（鉀快速下降），血糖降至250-300 mg/dL時加葡萄糖，心電圖監測，血糖降太快注意腦水腫。

HHS (type 2, older): glucose over 800 mg/dL, osmolarity over 350, no ketosis or acidosis, gradual onset, severe dehydration and neurological changes; treat with careful fluids (heart failure risk), electrolytes, insulin.
HHS（第2型、老年）：血糖大於800 mg/dL、滲透壓大於350、無酮症或酸中毒、逐漸發作、嚴重脫水與神經症狀；謹慎補液（心衰風險）、電解質、胰島素。
低血糖、酮酸中毒與高滲透壓高血糖狀態

Sick-day rules: continue insulin, check glucose and ketones every 3-4 hours, sip fluids every 30-60 minutes, call PHCP if glucose above 250-300, ketonuria over 24 hours, unable to eat or drink for 4 hours.
生病期間守則：持續使用胰島素、每3-4小時測血糖與尿酮、每30-60分鐘小口喝水、血糖大於250-300、酮尿超過24小時、4小時無法進食飲水須通知醫師。

Retinopathy: microaneurysms, macular edema, retinal detachment, cataracts; laser photocoagulation, vitrectomy; control BP and glucose.

Nephropathy: microalbuminuria first; restrict protein, sodium, potassium; avoid nephrotoxic drugs; dialysis or transplant.
腎病變：先出現微量白蛋白尿；限制蛋白質、鈉、鉀；避免腎毒性藥物；透析或移植。

Neuropathy: peripheral (distal feet), autonomic (orthostatic hypotension, gastroparesis, neurogenic bladder, impotence, hypoglycemia unawareness), focal (cranial nerves III, VI diplopia).
神經病變：周邊型（遠端足部）、自主神經型（姿勢性低血壓、胃輕癱、神經性膀胱、陽痿、低血糖無感）、局部型（第III、VI腦神經造成複視）。

Foot care: inspect daily, wash with warm water and dry well, no soaks, moisturize but not between toes, cotton socks, well-fitting shoes never barefoot, cut nails straight, no corn treatment or heating pads.
足部照護：每日檢查、溫水清洗徹底擦乾、不泡腳、保濕但趾縫不塗、棉襪、合腳鞋且不赤腳、指甲剪平、不自行處理雞眼、不用熱敷墊。

Surgery: check with PHCP about withholding oral agents or insulin; metformin may be stopped 48 hours before and restarted after renal function is normal; IV glucose and insulin postoperatively; frequent glucose checks; higher risk for cardiovascular, renal problems and poor healing.
手術：向醫師確認口服藥或胰島素是否停用；metformin可能術前48小時停藥，待腎功能正常再恢復；術後給靜脈葡萄糖與胰島素；頻繁監測血糖；心血管、腎臟併發症與傷口癒合不良風險較高。

Hypoglycemia (under 70 mg/dL): conscious = 15 g fast carbohydrate, recheck in 15 minutes; unconscious = glucagon IM/SC or IV 50% dextrose; never oral food.
低血糖（低於70 mg/dL）：清醒=15 g速效碳水、15分鐘複測；意識不清=glucagon肌注/皮下或靜脈50%葡萄糖；不可口服。
DKA: fluids first, then insulin infusion; monitor potassium closely (falls with treatment); cerebral edema if glucose drops too fast.
DKA：先補液再給胰島素輸注；密切監測血鉀（治療後下降）；血糖降太快會腦水腫。
DKA vs HHS: DKA glucose over 300, ketones, pH under 7.35, type 1, sudden; HHS glucose over 800, osmolarity over 350, no ketones, type 2, gradual.
DKA對HHS：DKA血糖大於300、有酮體、pH低於7.35、第1型、急發；HHS血糖大於800、滲透壓大於350、無酮體、第2型、漸進。
Never withhold insulin during illness; test ketones when glucose is over 250 mg/dL twice in type 1.
生病時不可停胰島素；第1型連續兩次血糖大於250 mg/dL需測尿酮。
Somogyi: nocturnal hypoglycemia then morning hyperglycemia (reduce insulin); dawn phenomenon: morning hyperglycemia without hypoglycemia (increase insulin or change timing).
蘇木吉：夜間低血糖後晨間高血糖（減少胰島素）；黎明現象：無低血糖的晨間高血糖（增加或調整胰島素時間）。
Only regular and rapid-acting insulin may be given IV; infusions via controller; rotate sites 1.5 inches apart.
僅短效與速效胰島素可靜脈給予；以輸液控制器輸注；注射部位輪替相隔1.5吋。
Addisonian crisis: hypotension, shock, hyponatremia, hyperkalemia, hypoglycemia; IV hydrocortisone and fluids. Steroid doses increase during stress; never stop abruptly.
艾迪森氏危象：低血壓、休克、低血鈉、高血鉀、低血糖；靜脈hydrocortisone與輸液。壓力時增加類固醇劑量，不可驟停。
Cushing's: moon face, buffalo hump, hypertension, hyperglycemia, hypokalemia, infection and thrombus risk. Addison's is the opposite: hypotension, hypoglycemia, hyperkalemia, bronze skin.
庫欣氏：月亮臉、水牛肩、高血壓、高血糖、低血鉀、感染與血栓風險。艾迪森氏相反：低血壓、低血糖、高血鉀、古銅膚色。
Pheochromocytoma: no abdominal palpation, avoid smoking and caffeine; alpha-blockers before beta-blockers (7-10 days); crisis = BP can exceed 220/140.
嗜鉻細胞瘤：不可觸壓腹部、避免吸菸與咖啡因；alpha阻斷劑先於beta阻斷劑7-10天；危象時血壓可超過220/140。
Diabetes insipidus: large dilute urine, low specific gravity, dehydration; desmopressin. SIADH: water retention, hyponatremia, fluid restriction, seizure precautions.
尿崩症：大量稀釋尿、尿比重低、脫水；desmopressin。SIADH：水滯留、低血鈉、限水、抽搐防護。
After transsphenoidal hypophysectomy: clear nasal drainage may be CSF leak (check glucose); avoid coughing, sneezing, straining; watch for diabetes insipidus.
經蝶竇腦下垂體切除術後：清澈鼻液可能為腦脊液漏（檢測葡萄糖）；避免咳嗽、打噴嚏、用力；注意尿崩症。
Thyroidectomy: airway first: trachea set and suction at bedside; watch bleeding, hoarseness, hypocalcemia (Chvostek, Trousseau), calcium gluconate.
甲狀腺切除術：氣道優先：床邊備氣切包與抽吸；注意出血、聲音沙啞、低血鈣（Chvostek、Trousseau）、備calcium gluconate。
Thyroid storm: fever, tachycardia, delirium; use acetaminophen, not aspirin; propranolol, iodides, antithyroid drugs.
甲狀腺風暴：發燒、心搏過速、譫妄；用acetaminophen而非阿斯匹靈；propranolol、碘劑、抗甲狀腺藥。
Myxedema coma: hypothermia, bradycardia, hypoglycemia, respiratory failure; avoid sedatives and opioids in hypothyroidism; IV levothyroxine.
黏液水腫昏迷：體溫過低、心搏過緩、低血糖、呼吸衰竭；甲低者避免鎮靜劑與鴉片類；靜脈levothyroxine。
TSH high + T4 low = primary hypothyroidism; TSH low + T4 high = hyperthyroidism.
TSH高加T4低=原發性甲低；TSH低加T4高=甲亢。
Hypoparathyroidism: low calcium, high phosphorus, tetany; hyperparathyroidism: high calcium, low phosphorus, stones, fractures.
副甲狀腺低下：低鈣高磷、手足抽搐；亢進：高鈣低磷、結石、骨折。
HbA1c reflects about 90 days of control; normal under 6% without diabetes; no fasting needed.
HbA1c反映約90天控制；無糖尿病正常小於6%；無需空腹。
Diabetic foot care: never barefoot, no heating pads, inspect daily, cut nails straight across.
糖尿病足部照護：不赤腳、不用熱敷墊、每日檢查、指甲剪平。
Addison's vs Cushing's: Addison = 'Low everything' (BP, Na, glucose) but K high, skin bronze; Cushing = 'High everything' (BP, glucose, Na) but K low.
艾迪森氏=血壓、鈉、血糖低但鉀高、膚色古銅；庫欣氏=血壓、血糖、鈉高但鉀低。
Hypoglycemia 'cold and clammy, need some candy'; hyperglycemia 'hot and dry, sugar high'.
低血糖：冷汗濕黏需補糖；高血糖：皮膚熱而乾。
Thyroid: hyper = everything up and 'hot' (tachycardia, weight loss, diarrhea); hypo = everything slow and 'cold' (bradycardia, weight gain, constipation).
甲亢=全部加快、怕熱（心搏過速、體重減輕、腹瀉）；甲低=全部變慢、怕冷（心搏過緩、體重增加、便祕）。

Take at the same time every morning on an empty stomach; separate by at least 4 hours from calcium, iron, antacids, multivitamins, bile acid sequestrants, sucralfate.

Enhances warfarin, sympathomimetics and antidepressants; decreases effect of insulin, oral hypoglycemics and digoxin; phenytoin/carbamazepine reduce thyroid effect.

Hypoparathyroidism (low Ca, tetany) is treated with calcium and vitamin D; hyperparathyroidism/hypercalcemia uses agents such as cinacalcet, calcitonin, bisphosphonates.

Calcium with digoxin raises digoxin toxicity risk; oral calcium lowers tetracycline absorption.

Calcitonin nasal spray: alternate nostrils. Calcium supplements: adequate vitamin D, fluids and fiber (constipation); give other drugs 1 hour apart.

Fludrocortisone（礦物皮質素）留鈉留水、排鉀：用於 Addison 氏病替代治療；不良反應水腫、高血壓、低血鉀、心衰竭。建議高鉀飲食。

肝臟切片：禁食 8-12 小時、檢查 PT/PTT/血小板、穿刺時吐氣後閉氣；術後右側臥並於肋緣下墊枕 2 小時、臥床 12-14 小時；呼吸困難/發紺提示氣胸。

Urea breath test detects H. pylori (hold antibiotics/bismuth 1 month, PPIs/sucralfate 1 week, H2RAs 24 h).
尿素呼氣試驗偵測幽門螺旋桿菌（抗生素/鉍劑停 1 個月、PPI/sucralfate 停 1 週、H2 阻斷劑停 24 小時）。

腹腔穿刺、肝臟切片、糞便與實驗室檢查
Liver tests: ALP 38-126 U/L, AST 0-35, ALT 4-36, PT 11-12.5 s, PTT 30-40 s, INR 0.8-1.2, ammonia 10-80 mcg/dL, total bilirubin 0.3-1.0 mg/dL, amylase 60-120 Somogyi units/dL, lipase 0-160 U/L.
肝功能：ALP 38-126 U/L、AST 0-35、ALT 4-36、PT 11-12.5 秒、PTT 30-40 秒、INR 0.8-1.2、氨 10-80 mcg/dL、總膽紅素 0.3-1.0 mg/dL、澱粉酶 60-120 Somogyi 單位/dL、脂肪酶 0-160 U/L。

Prolonged PT with low platelets before biopsy: notify PHCP and start bleeding precautions.
切片前 PT 延長且血小板低：通知醫師並採取出血防護。

Signs of perforation/peritonitis: guarding, rigid distended abdomen, rebound tenderness, absent bowel sounds, fever, tachycardia, hypotension.
穿孔/腹膜炎徵象：腹部防衛、僵硬脹大、反彈痛、腸音消失、發燒、心搏過速、低血壓。

胃食道逆流、胃炎、食道裂孔疝氣
GERD: incompetent LES; heartburn, regurgitation, chronic night cough, hoarseness, dysphagia. Avoid peppermint, chocolate, caffeine, fatty food, alcohol, citrus, tomato, smoking.
胃食道逆流：下食道括約肌鬆弛；燒心、逆流、夜間慢性咳嗽、聲音沙啞、吞嚥困難。避免薄荷、巧克力、咖啡因、油膩、酒精、柑橘、番茄與抽菸。
胃食道逆流、胃炎、食道裂孔疝氣

GERD teaching: small meals, no food 2 h before bed, stay upright 2-3 h after eating, raise head of bed 6-8 inches; avoid anticholinergics, NSAIDs, calcium channel blockers. Fundoplication if refractory.
衛教：少量多餐、睡前 2 小時不進食、餐後直立 2-3 小時、床頭抬高 6-8 吋；避免抗膽鹼藥、NSAIDs、鈣離子阻斷劑。難治時做胃底折疊術。
胃食道逆流、胃炎、食道裂孔疝氣
Acute gastritis: NSAIDs, alcohol, H. pylori; watch for hemorrhagic gastritis (hematemesis, tachycardia, hypotension). Chronic gastritis can cause B12 deficiency.
急性胃炎：NSAIDs、酒精、H. pylori；注意出血性胃炎（吐血、心搏過速、低血壓）。慢性胃炎可致 B12 缺乏。
胃食道逆流、胃炎、食道裂孔疝氣
Hiatal hernia: stomach herniates through diaphragm; symptoms worse lying down; small frequent meals, do not recline for 1 hour after eating; complications include strangulation.
食道裂孔疝氣：胃經橫膈膜突入胸腔；平躺時症狀加重；少量多餐、餐後 1 小時內勿平躺；併發症含絞扼。

Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群
Gastric ulcer: pain 1-2 h after meals, worsened by food, hematemesis more common. Duodenal ulcer: pain 2-5 h after meals/night, relieved by food, melena more common.
胃潰瘍：餐後 1-2 小時痛、進食加重、較常吐血。十二指腸潰瘍：餐後 2-5 小時或夜間痛、進食緩解、較常黑便。
Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群
Risks: H. pylori, NSAIDs, smoking, alcohol, steroids, stress. Avoid caffeinated and decaffeinated coffee, alcohol, aspirin/NSAIDs. Complications: hemorrhage, perforation, obstruction.
危險因子：H. pylori、NSAIDs、抽菸、酒精、類固醇、壓力。避免含咖啡因與去咖啡因咖啡、酒精、阿斯匹靈/NSAIDs。併發症：出血、穿孔、阻塞。
Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群
Active bleeding: stabilize airway/circulation, two large-bore IVs, NPO, monitor Hgb/Hct and coagulation, type and cross, transfusion, vasoconstrictive drugs.
活動性出血：穩定呼吸道與循環、兩條大管徑靜脈管路、禁食、監測 Hgb/Hct 與凝血、血型交叉、輸血、血管收縮藥。
Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群

Surgeries: vagotomy, antrectomy, Billroth I (gastroduodenostomy), Billroth II (gastrojejunostomy), pyloroplasty. Post-op: Fowler's, NG suction, NPO 1-3 days; do not irrigate or reposition the NG tube without order.
手術：迷走神經切斷、胃竇切除、Billroth I（胃十二指腸吻合）、Billroth II（胃空腸吻合）、幽門成形。術後：半坐臥、鼻胃管抽吸、禁食 1-3 天；無醫囑不可沖洗或移動鼻胃管。
Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群
Post-op complications: hemorrhage, dumping syndrome, hypoglycemia, bile reflux gastritis, B12 deficiency.
術後併發症：出血、傾倒症候群、低血糖、膽汁逆流性胃炎、B12 缺乏。
Peptic ulcer disease, gastric surgery and dumping syndrome
消化性潰瘍、胃部手術與傾倒症候群

Dumping syndrome (about 30 min after eating): nausea, fullness, cramping, diarrhea, palpitations, sweating, dizziness. Prevent: 5-6 small meals, high-protein/complex carbs, limit sugar, no fluids with meals, lie down 20-30 min after.
傾倒症候群（進食後約 30 分鐘）：噁心、飽脹、絞痛、腹瀉、心悸、冒汗、頭暈。預防：一天 5-6 小餐、高蛋白與複合碳水、限制糖、餐中不喝水、餐後平躺 20-30 分鐘。

Bariatric surgery: psychological screening, lifelong lifestyle change; anastomotic leak (abdominal pain, restlessness, unexplained tachycardia, oliguria) is the most serious complication.
減重手術：心理評估、需終身改變生活型態；吻合口漏（腹痛、躁動、不明原因心搏過速、少尿）為最嚴重併發症。
Post-bariatric diet: 1-ounce clear liquids, then puree, liquids/puree for about 6 weeks; eat slowly; supplements calcium, iron, multivitamin, B12; avoid high sugar/fat.
術後飲食：先 30 mL 清流質，再進展至泥狀食物，流質/泥狀約 6 週；細嚼慢嚥；補充鈣、鐵、綜合維他命、B12；避免高糖高脂。
Cholecystitis: RUQ pain radiating to right shoulder after fatty meal, Murphy's sign, fever, nausea; biliary obstruction causes jaundice, dark foamy urine, clay stools, pruritus.
膽囊炎：高脂餐後右上腹痛並放射至右肩、Murphy 氏徵象、發燒、噁心；膽道阻塞出現黃疸、深色泡沫尿、陶土色便、搔癢。
Treatment: NPO, NG decompression, antiemetics, analgesics, antispasmodics; cholecystectomy usually laparoscopic. Post-op: cough/deep breathe, splint, early ambulation.
治療：禁食、鼻胃管減壓、止吐、止痛、解痙；膽囊切除常為腹腔鏡。術後：咳嗽深呼吸、按壓傷口、早期下床。
T-tube: drainage bag below gallbladder level, semi-Fowler's, report sudden increase in bile or foul purulent drainage; no irrigation/clamping without order.
T 型管：引流袋低於膽囊高度、半坐臥、膽汁突然增加或惡臭膿性引流須通報；無醫囑不可沖洗/夾閉。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張

Cirrhosis: chronic hepatocyte destruction and scarring (hepatitis C, alcohol, NAFLD/NASH). Complications: portal hypertension, ascites, varices, coagulopathy, jaundice, encephalopathy, hepatorenal syndrome.
肝硬化：肝細胞慢性破壞與纖維化（C 肝、酒精、非酒精性脂肪肝）。併發症：門脈高壓、腹水、靜脈曲張、凝血障礙、黃疸、肝腦病變、肝腎症候群。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張

Encephalopathy: ammonia not detoxified; asterixis, altered LOC, fetor hepaticus. Give lactulose (lowers bowel pH, ammonia excretion) and antibiotics; avoid opioids, sedatives, barbiturates, hepatotoxins; alcohol abstinence.
肝腦病變：氨無法代謝；撲翼樣顫抖、意識改變、肝臭。給予 lactulose（降低腸道 pH、排出氨）與抗生素；避免鴉片類、鎮靜劑、巴比妥與肝毒性物質；戒酒。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張
Care: HOB elevated, Na and fluid restriction, diuretics, daily weight and abdominal girth, vitamin K/B complex, monitor coagulation and electrolytes, paracentesis if needed.
照護：抬高床頭、限鈉限水、利尿劑、每日體重與腹圍、維生素 K/B 群、監測凝血與電解質、必要時腹腔穿刺。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張

Varices: dilated esophageal veins from portal hypertension; rupture = life-threatening hematemesis/melena/shock. NPO, oxygen, IV fluids, blood, monitor Hgb/Hct, vasoconstrictors, endoscopic sclerotherapy or band ligation.
靜脈曲張：門脈高壓使食道靜脈擴張；破裂會危及生命（吐血、黑便、休克）。禁食、氧氣、靜脈輸液、輸血、監測 Hgb/Hct、血管收縮藥、內視鏡硬化或套扎。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張
Balloon tamponade is uncomfortable and rarely used; shunts include portacaval, distal splenorenal, mesocaval, and TIPS.
氣囊填塞不舒適且少用；分流手術包含門腔、遠端脾腎、腸繫膜腔靜脈分流與 TIPS。
肝硬化與食道靜脈曲張
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E
Stages: preicteric (flu-like, anorexia, most transmissible), icteric (jaundice, dark urine, clay stools, pruritus), posticteric (recovery, 6-8 weeks).
分期：黃疸前期（類流感、厭食、傳染力最強）、黃疸期（黃疸、深色尿、陶土便、搔癢）、黃疸後期（恢復，約 6-8 週）。
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E
Hepatitis A: fecal-oral, incubation 15-50 days, anti-HAV IgM = acute; vaccine 2 doses 6 months apart; immune globulin within 2 weeks of exposure.
A 肝：糞口傳染，潛伏期 15-50 天，anti-HAV IgM 代表急性感染；疫苗兩劑間隔 6 個月；暴露後 2 週內給免疫球蛋白。
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E
Hepatitis B: blood/body fluids, incubation 60-180 days; HBsAg diagnostic, persisting beyond 6 months = chronic/carrier; anti-HBs = recovery/immunity; vaccine and HBIG.
B 肝：血液/體液傳染，潛伏期 60-180 天；HBsAg 為診斷指標，6 個月後仍存在=慢性/帶原；anti-HBs=康復/免疫；疫苗與 HBIG。
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E

Hepatitis C: blood, IV drug use, transfusions, born 1945-1965; anti-HCV; leads to chronic liver disease and carcinoma. Hepatitis D needs HBV to replicate. Hepatitis E: waterborne, high mortality in third-trimester pregnancy.
C 肝：血液、靜脈藥癮、輸血、1945-1965 年出生者；anti-HCV；可致慢性肝病與肝癌。D 肝需有 B 肝才可複製。E 肝：水源傳染，孕晚期死亡率高。
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E

Home care: strict handwashing, personal items not shared, no food preparation for others, avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic OTC drugs (acetaminophen, sedatives), small high-carbohydrate low-fat meals, no blood donation.
居家：嚴格洗手、個人用品不共用、不為他人備餐、避免酒精與肝毒性成藥（acetaminophen、鎮靜劑）、少量多餐高碳水低脂、不可捐血。
病毒性肝炎 A 至 E
Causes: alcohol, gallstones, trauma, hyperlipidemia, hypercalcemia. Acute: sudden epigastric/LUQ pain radiating to back, worse after fatty meal/lying flat, N/V, low-grade fever.
病因：酒精、膽結石、外傷、高血脂、高血鈣。急性：突發上腹/左上腹痛放射至背部，油膩餐後或平躺加重、噁心嘔吐、低燒。
Labs: elevated serum lipase and amylase, WBC, glucose, bilirubin. Cullen's sign (periumbilical) and Turner's sign (flank bruising).
檢驗：血清脂肪酶與澱粉酶、WBC、血糖、膽紅素升高。Cullen 徵象（臍周瘀斑）與 Turner 徵象（側腹瘀斑）。
Acute care: NPO, IV fluids, NG for vomiting/ileus, opioids for pain, H2RA/PPI, parenteral or nasojejunal feeding, watch for shock, avoid alcohol.
急性期：禁食、靜脈輸液、嘔吐/腸阻塞時鼻胃管、止痛用鴉片類、H2 阻斷劑/PPI、腸外或鼻空腸餵食、注意休克、戒酒。
Chronic: steatorrhea, weight loss, diabetes; pancreatic enzymes with meals, small high-calorie low-fat meals, no alcohol/caffeine, insulin if needed.
慢性：脂肪瀉、體重減輕、糖尿病；餐時給胰酵素、少量高熱量低脂餐、不喝酒/咖啡因、必要時用胰島素。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症
IBS: functional; increase fiber, 8-10 cups fluid, probiotics; lubiprostone/linaclotide for constipation-predominant, alosetron for diarrhea-predominant.
腸躁症：功能性；增加纖維、每日 8-10 杯水、益生菌；便秘型用 lubiprostone/linaclotide，腹瀉型用 alosetron。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症

Ulcerative colitis: starts in rectum and moves proximally; severe bloody mucus diarrhea, anemia, dehydration; acute phase NPO/IV or TPN, then low-fiber high-protein diet; avoid dairy, raw produce, nuts, caffeine, alcohol; salicylates, steroids, immunosuppressants.
潰瘍性結腸炎：由直腸向上蔓延；嚴重血便黏液便、貧血、脫水；急性期禁食/靜脈或全靜脈營養，之後低纖高蛋白飲食；避免乳製品、生鮮蔬果、堅果、咖啡因、酒精；水楊酸製劑、類固醇、免疫抑制劑。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症
Surgery: restorative proctocolectomy with ileal pouch-anal anastomosis (two-stage, temporary ileostomy) or total proctocolectomy with permanent ileostomy.
手術：迴腸袋肛門吻合重建性大腸直腸切除（兩階段、暫時性迴腸造口）或全大腸直腸切除合併永久性迴腸造口。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症
Stoma: pink to bright red and shiny is normal; pale pink = low Hgb/Hct; purple-black = compromised circulation, notify PHCP immediately. Empty pouch when one-third full.
造口：粉紅至鮮紅濕潤為正常；蒼白代表 Hgb/Hct 低；紫黑代表血流受損，須立即通知醫師。袋子三分之一滿即排空。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症
Crohn's: any GI segment, usually terminal ileum, fistulas, strictures, cramping after meals, worse malnutrition; surgery avoided because recurrence is common.
克隆氏症：可發生於任何消化道、多在末端迴腸，有瘻管、狹窄、餐後絞痛、營養不良更嚴重；因復發率高盡量避免手術。
腸躁症、潰瘍性結腸炎、克隆氏症
Appendicitis: periumbilical pain moving to RLQ, maximal at McBurney's point, rebound tenderness, low-grade fever, high WBC. No heat, laxatives or enemas; pain that suddenly stops may mean rupture.
闌尾炎：臍周痛轉移至右下腹、McBurney 點最痛、反彈痛、低燒、WBC 升高。不可熱敷、不給瀉劑或灌腸。
Pre-op: NPO, IV fluids, antibiotics, right side-lying or semi-Fowler's, ice pack if prescribed. Post-op: if ruptured, drain/open wound, semi-Fowler's with legs flexed, antibiotics, early ambulation.
術前：禁食、靜脈輸液、抗生素、右側臥或半坐臥、必要時冰敷。術後：若破裂有引流/開放傷口、半坐臥雙腿屈曲、抗生素、早期下床。

Diverticulitis: LLQ pain, fever, N/V, blood in stool; bed rest, NPO or clear liquids, low-fiber during flare then high-fiber; fluids 2500-3000 mL; avoid straining, seeds/nuts/popcorn; watch for perforation, abscess, fistula.
憩室炎：左下腹痛、發燒、噁心嘔吐、血便；臥床休息、禁食或清流質、發炎期低纖維，緩解後高纖維；水分 2500-3000 mL；避免用力、種子/堅果/爆米花；注意穿孔、膿瘍、瘻管。
Hemorrhoids: bright red bleeding with defecation; high fiber, fluids, stool softeners, sitz baths, witch hazel.
痔瘡：排便時鮮紅色出血；高纖維、多喝水、軟便劑、坐浴、金縷梅。
Post-hemorrhoidectomy: prone/side-lying, ice packs, watch urinary retention, first bowel movement painful (vasovagal risk, stay nearby), short sitting periods, sitz baths 3-4 times daily.
痔瘡切除術後：俯臥/側臥、冰敷、注意尿滯留、第一次排便會痛（可能迷走神經反應，需有人在旁）、縮短久坐、每日坐浴 3-4 次。
Paracentesis: rapid fluid removal can drop abdominal pressure and cause vasodilation and shock; monitor BP and pulse closely.
腹腔穿刺：快速引流使腹壓下降、血管擴張而致休克；密切監測血壓與脈搏。
After any endoscopy do not give food or fluids until the gag reflex returns (aspiration risk).
任何內視鏡檢查後，嘔吐反射恢復前不可給予飲食（吸入風險）。
Liver biopsy: lie on RIGHT side with pillow under costal margin; dyspnea, cyanosis, restlessness = pneumothorax; check PT/PTT/platelets first.
肝臟切片：右側臥並墊枕；呼吸困難、發紺、躁動=氣胸；事先檢查 PT/PTT/血小板。
Do not irrigate or remove the NG tube after gastric surgery without an order (anastomosis disruption).
胃部手術後無醫囑不可沖洗或拔除鼻胃管（可能破壞吻合口）。
Upper GI bleed: ABCs, oxygen, two large-bore IVs, NPO, monitor Hgb/Hct, coagulation; ruptured varices are life-threatening.
上消化道出血：ABC、氧氣、兩條大管徑靜脈管路、禁食、監測 Hgb/Hct 與凝血；食道靜脈曲張破裂可致命。
Gastric ulcer pain occurs soon after eating; duodenal ulcer pain occurs hours later and is relieved by food.
胃潰瘍餐後不久疼痛；十二指腸潰瘍數小時後疼痛、進食緩解。
Dumping syndrome ~30 minutes after eating: small meals, limit sugar, no fluids with meals, lie down after.
傾倒症候群約於餐後 30 分鐘：少量餐、限糖、餐中不喝水、餐後躺下。
Anastomotic leak (pain, restlessness, unexplained tachycardia, oliguria) is the deadliest complication of gastric bypass.
吻合口漏（疼痛、躁動、不明原因心搏過速、少尿）是胃繞道術最致命的併發症。
Cirrhosis with encephalopathy: lactulose, avoid sedatives/opioids, watch asterixis and ammonia (normal 10-80 mcg/dL).

Appendicitis: never apply heat or give laxatives/enemas; heat may cause rupture and peritonitis.

憩室炎：發作期低纖維、緩解後高纖維；避免用力與種子/堅果；注意穿孔。

Chew tablets thoroughly then drink water or milk; shake liquids; take regularly (e.g., 1 and 3 hours after meals and at bedtime); separate from other drugs by 1 hour.

Magnesium: diarrhea; avoid in intestinal obstruction, appendicitis, undiagnosed abdominal pain; accumulates in renal impairment. Often combined with aluminum.
鎂製劑：腹瀉；腸阻塞、闌尾炎、不明腹痛禁用；腎功能不全會蓄積。常與鋁製劑併用。
Calcium carbonate: acid rebound, belching, constipation, milk-alkali syndrome. Sodium bicarbonate: gas, systemic alkalosis in renal impairment, caution in HTN/HF.
碳酸鈣：酸反彈、打嗝、便秘、乳鹼症候群。碳酸氫鈉：脹氣、腎功能不全時全身性鹼中毒、高血壓/心衰竭慎用。
Misoprostol: prostaglandin that reduces acid and maintains mucosal blood flow; prevents NSAID/aspirin ulcers; take with meals; diarrhea and abdominal pain; contraindicated in pregnancy.
Misoprostol：前列腺素類，降低胃酸並維持黏膜血流；預防 NSAID/阿斯匹靈潰瘍；隨餐服用；腹瀉與腹痛；懷孕禁用。

Sucralfate: forms a protective barrier on the ulcer; give on an empty stomach (1 hour before meals); constipation; separate at least 2 hours from warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, digoxin and some antibiotics.
Sucralfate：在潰瘍面形成保護屏障；空腹（餐前 1 小時）服用；便秘；與 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、digoxin 及部分抗生素至少間隔 2 小時。
Cimetidine, famotidine, nizatidine suppress acid secretion; heal GERD, prevent stress ulcers and ulcer recurrence; use caution in renal/hepatic impairment and reduce dose in renal impairment.
Cimetidine、famotidine、nizatidine 抑制胃酸分泌；治療胃食道逆流、預防壓力性潰瘍與潰瘍復發；腎/肝功能不全慎用，腎功能不全需減量。
Cimetidine: crosses blood-brain barrier (confusion, agitation, psychosis, especially elderly); inhibits liver enzymes, raising warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, lidocaine levels (reduce doses).
Cimetidine：可通過血腦障壁（意識混亂、躁動、精神症狀，尤其老年人）；抑制肝酵素使 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、lidocaine 濃度上升（需減量）。
IV cimetidine can cause hypotension and dysrhythmias. Antacids lower oral absorption: separate by at least 1 hour. Famotidine and nizatidine need not be taken with food.
靜脈注射 cimetidine 可引起低血壓與心律不整。制酸劑降低口服吸收，間隔至少 1 小時。Famotidine 與 nizatidine 不需與食物併服。

Cholestyramine, colestipol, colesevelam bind bile salts in the gut for hypercholesterolemia and itching from biliary obstruction; constipation, bloating, impaction; use caution in bowel obstruction; mix powders with juice, add fiber/stool softener.

Bulk-forming (psyllium, methylcellulose, polycarbophil): water into stool; need adequate fluids; contraindicated in obstruction. Stimulants (bisacodyl, senna). All laxatives: risk of dehydration and electrolyte imbalance; long-term use can cause dependency; increase fluids as directed.
各類瀉劑：有脫水與電解質失衡風險；長期使用可能依賴；依醫囑增加水分。

Antidiarrheals: treat cause, replace fluids/electrolytes. Opioids (diphenoxylate with atropine, loperamide) slow motility but worsen diarrhea from poisons, infections or bacterial toxins. Also bismuth subsalicylate and anticholinergic antispasmodics (dicyclomine, glycopyrrolate).
止瀉藥：治療原因並補充水分/電解質。鴉片類（diphenoxylate/atropine、loperamide）降低蠕動，但中毒、感染、細菌毒素引起的腹瀉會因此惡化。另有次水楊酸鉍與抗膽鹼解痙藥（dicyclomine、glycopyrrolate）。

制酸劑與其他藥物間隔 1 小時以避免交互作用。

Cimetidine: CNS confusion, inhibits liver metabolism (reduce warfarin, phenytoin, theophylline, lidocaine doses).
Cimetidine：中樞神經混亂、抑制肝代謝（需減少 warfarin、phenytoin、theophylline、lidocaine 劑量）。
Aluminum antacid: constipation and hypophosphatemia; magnesium antacid: diarrhea; magnesium accumulates in renal impairment.
鋁制酸劑：便秘與低血磷；鎂制酸劑：腹瀉；腎功能不全時鎂會蓄積。

H. pylori 需合併療法（PPI 加兩種抗生素，或含鉍的四合一）。

Metoclopramide：出現類巴金森/錐體外徑反應需停藥；阻塞、穿孔、消化道出血禁用。
Bile acid sequestrants worsen constipation or obstruction; use cautiously.
膽酸結合劑會加重便秘或阻塞；需謹慎使用。
Lactulose: diarrhea means it is working; monitor ammonia (10-80 mcg/dL), I&O, dehydration.
Lactulose：腹瀉代表有效；監測氨值（10-80 mcg/dL）、輸出入與脫水。

Pancrelipase 必須與所有餐點與點心一起服用。

Alosetron：嚴重便秘、阻塞、穿孔、缺血性結腸炎；須立即停藥。
Opioid antidiarrheals are harmful when diarrhea is caused by infection, poisons or toxins.
腹瀉由感染、毒物或毒素引起時，鴉片類止瀉藥有害。
Antiemetics cause drowsiness: protect the client from injury.
止吐藥會致嗜睡：保護病人避免受傷。
Bulk-forming laxatives contraindicated in bowel obstruction; clients need adequate fluids.
膨脹性瀉劑在腸阻塞時禁用；需有足夠水分。

制酸劑金屬：鋁與鈣便秘；鎂拉肚子。

功能：供氧、排出二氧化碳，另維持酸鹼平衡、發聲、嗅覺、水分與熱平衡。
Right mainstem bronchus is wider, shorter, more vertical; right lung has 3 lobes, left lung 2. Trachea branches at the carina.
右主支氣管較寬、短且垂直；右肺 3 葉、左肺 2 葉。氣管於隆凸分叉。
Alveoli are the gas exchange units; type 2 alveolar cells make surfactant, which lowers surface tension and prevents collapse. Terminal bronchioles lack cartilage and cilia.
肺泡為氣體交換單位；第二型肺泡細胞分泌表面張力素，降低表面張力防止塌陷。終末細支氣管無軟骨與纖毛。
Diaphragm descends on inspiration creating negative pressure; expiration is passive recoil. Gas exchange needs matched ventilation and perfusion.
吸氣時橫膈下降形成負壓；呼氣為被動回彈。氣體交換需要通氣與灌流相配。
Parietal pleura lines the chest wall; visceral pleura covers the lung; pleural fluid lubricates.
壁層胸膜覆蓋胸壁；臟層胸膜覆蓋肺；胸膜液具潤滑作用。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
Chest x-ray: remove metal objects, ask about pregnancy. Sputum: early morning, rinse mouth, deep cough, collect before antibiotics (about 15 mL); saliva is not sputum.
胸部 X 光：移除金屬物，詢問懷孕。痰液：清晨、先漱口、深咳、於使用抗生素前採集（約 15 mL）；唾液不是痰。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡

Bronchoscopy: consent, NPO, check coagulation, local spray; afterward semi-Fowler's, NPO until gag reflex returns, watch for bloody sputum, bronchospasm, perforation (facial/neck crepitus), hypoxemia, pneumothorax.
支氣管鏡：同意書、禁食、檢查凝血、局部噴劑；術後半坐臥、嘔吐反射恢復前禁食、監測血痰、支氣管痙攣、穿孔（臉頸皮下氣腫）、低血氧、氣胸。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
Pulmonary angiography: assess iodine/seafood allergy; afterward no BP in injection arm for 24 h, check neurovascular status and site bleeding.
肺動脈攝影：評估碘/海鮮過敏；術後該側肢體 24 小時不量血壓、檢查神經血管狀態與穿刺處出血。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
Spiral CT and CT pulmonary angiography are preferred for PE (contrast, renal function); V/Q scan used with renal impairment or contrast allergy; encourage fluids.
螺旋 CT 與 CT 肺動脈攝影為肺栓塞首選（顯影劑、腎功能）；腎功能不全或顯影劑過敏者做 V/Q 掃描；鼓勵多喝水。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
D-dimer: high sensitivity, low specificity; normal < 50 ng/mL. Pulmonary function tests: hold bronchodilators if prescribed, no heavy meal or smoking 4-6 h.
D-dimer：高敏感性、低特異性；正常 < 50 ng/mL。肺功能檢查：依醫囑停用支氣管擴張劑，檢查前 4-6 小時不吃大餐或抽菸。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
Do not suction before drawing an ABG (it depletes oxygen and distorts results).
抽動脈血氣前不可抽吸（會消耗氧氣、影響結果）。
診斷檢查：影像、痰液、內視鏡
Thoracentesis removes fluid or air from the pleural space: check coagulation, sit upright leaning on a bedside table (or lie toward the unaffected side), do not cough or move.
胸腔穿刺移除胸腔積液或空氣：檢查凝血、坐直倚靠床邊桌（或向健側臥），不可咳嗽或移動。
After: monitor respiratory status, pressure dressing, bleeding/crepitus; watch for pneumothorax, air embolism, pulmonary edema; review chest x-ray.
術後：監測呼吸、壓迫敷料、出血/皮下氣腫；觀察氣胸、空氣栓塞、肺水腫；檢視胸部 X 光。
Lung biopsy: NPO, sedation, remain still; afterward dressing, watch for respiratory distress, pneumothorax, air emboli.
肺活檢：禁食、鎮靜、保持不動；術後敷料、觀察呼吸窘迫、氣胸、空氣栓塞。
Rib fracture: pain, shallow breathing, high pneumonia risk; Fowler's, analgesia, self-splint with pillow (no external binders), nerve block if severe.
肋骨骨折：疼痛、淺呼吸、肺炎風險高；半坐臥、止痛、以枕頭自行按壓（不用外部束縛）、嚴重時神經阻斷。
Flail chest: paradoxical movement of a chest segment, severe pain, dyspnea, cyanosis, tachycardia, hypotension; oxygen, analgesia, Fowler's, intubation with PEEP if respiratory failure.
連枷胸：胸壁一段反常運動、劇痛、呼吸困難、發紺、心搏過速、低血壓；給氧、止痛、半坐臥、呼吸衰竭時插管並用 PEEP。
Pulmonary contusion: interstitial/alveolar hemorrhage, hypoxemia, hemoptysis; ARDS is the major complication.
肺挫傷：間質/肺泡出血、低血氧、咳血；主要併發症為急性呼吸窘迫症候群。

Pneumothorax: absent/diminished breath sounds on affected side, unilateral decreased chest expansion, sharp pain, crepitus; open pneumothorax has sucking sound; tension pneumothorax shows tracheal deviation to the unaffected side, distended neck veins, hypotension.
氣胸：患側呼吸音消失/減弱、單側胸廓擴張減少、尖銳疼痛、皮下氣腫；開放性氣胸有吸吮聲；張力性氣胸氣管偏向健側、頸靜脈怒張、低血壓。
Interventions: nonporous dressing for open wound, oxygen, Fowler's, chest tube until lung re-expands, monitor drainage and subcutaneous emphysema.
處置：開放傷口用不透氣敷料、給氧、半坐臥、置放胸管至肺完全擴張、監測引流與皮下氣腫。

Chronic airway inflammation with hyperresponsiveness and reversible obstruction; triggers include allergens, exercise, infection, irritants, cold air, aspirin, NSAIDs, beta blockers, sulfites, GERD, stress.
慢性氣道發炎伴隨高反應性與可逆性阻塞；誘因包含過敏原、運動、感染、刺激物、冷空氣、阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs、β 阻斷劑、亞硫酸鹽、胃食道逆流、壓力。
Findings: wheeze, prolonged expiration, accessory muscle use, tachypnea, tachycardia, pulsus paradoxus, diaphoresis, decreased SpO2; silent chest means impending respiratory failure.
表現：喘鳴、呼氣延長、使用輔助肌、呼吸急促、心搏過速、奇脈、盜汗、血氧下降；呼吸音消失（靜默胸）代表即將呼吸衰竭。
Acute episode: high-Fowler's/sitting, oxygen, stay with client, bronchodilators, corticosteroids, magnesium sulfate, IV fluids, auscultate before/during/after.
急性發作：高坐臥/坐姿、給氧、陪伴病人、支氣管擴張劑、類固醇、硫酸鎂、靜脈輸液、治療前中後聽診。
Status asthmaticus is life-threatening and refractory to treatment. Teach peak flow use, spacer, trigger avoidance, action plan, MedicAlert.
氣喘重積狀態危及生命且對治療反應不佳。衛教尖峰流速計、吸入輔助器、避開誘因、行動計畫、醫療警示手環。
慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）

Progressive, not fully reversible airflow limitation; complications include pulmonary hypertension and cor pulmonale. Findings: cough, sputum, exertional dyspnea, barrel chest, prolonged expiration, clubbing, orthopnea, weight loss.
進行性、不完全可逆的氣流受限；併發症含肺高壓與肺心症。表現：咳嗽、痰、運動時呼吸困難、桶狀胸、呼氣延長、杵狀指、端坐呼吸、體重下降。
慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）
ABGs show chronic respiratory acidosis with hypoxemia; uncompensated respiratory acidosis suggests acute exacerbation.
動脈血氣顯示慢性呼吸性酸中毒伴低血氧；未代償的呼吸性酸中毒提示急性惡化。
慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）
Give oxygen at the lowest concentration per ABG/SpO2; pursed-lip and diaphragmatic breathing, tripod position, chest physiotherapy, fluids up to 3000 mL/day, high-calorie high-protein small meals.
依血氣與血氧給最低有效濃度氧氣；噘嘴與橫膈式呼吸、三腳架姿勢、胸部物理治療、每日水分可達 3000 mL、高熱量高蛋白少量多餐。
慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）
Meds: bronchodilators, corticosteroids for exacerbations, mucolytics, antibiotics for infection. Teach stopping smoking, avoiding infection/crowds, immunizations, wet dusting.
藥物：支氣管擴張劑、惡化時用類固醇、黏液溶解劑、感染時抗生素。衛教戒菸、避免感染/人群、疫苗、濕布擦拭灰塵。
慢性阻塞性肺病（慢性支氣管炎與肺氣腫）
Pneumonia: fever, chills, pleuritic pain, productive cough, crackles/rhonchi, hypoxia, mental status change in older adults; sputum culture, high WBC; CXR consolidation.
肺炎：發燒、畏寒、胸膜性疼痛、有痰咳嗽、囉音/鼾音、低血氧、老年人意識改變；痰培養、WBC 升高；胸片實變。
Care: oxygen, semi-Fowler's, cough/deep breathing/incentive spirometer, chest physiotherapy, fluids up to 3 L/day, high-calorie diet, antibiotics, hand hygiene; pneumococcal vaccine teaching.
照護：給氧、半坐臥、咳嗽/深呼吸/誘發性肺量計、胸部物理治療、每日水分可達 3 L、高熱量飲食、抗生素、手部衛生；肺炎鏈球菌疫苗衛教。
Influenza: abrupt fever, chills, myalgia, headache, cough; annual vaccine (contraindicated with egg allergy per book), rest, fluids, antivirals, droplet hygiene.
流感：突發發燒、畏寒、肌痛、頭痛、咳嗽；每年接種疫苗（書中指出蛋過敏者禁用）、休息、補水、抗病毒藥、飛沫衛生。

COVID-19: spread by droplets even without symptoms; symptoms 2-14 days after exposure incl. new loss of taste/smell; droplet (+/- contact) precautions; emergency signs: trouble breathing, persistent chest pain, confusion, cyanosis.
COVID-19：即使無症狀也可經飛沫傳染；暴露後 2-14 天出現症狀，含新發味嗅覺喪失；飛沫（必要時接觸）隔離；急症徵象：呼吸困難、持續胸痛、意識混亂、發紺。
SARS: coronavirus, fever, aches, then dry cough/dyspnea after 2-7 days. Legionnaire's: Legionella from contaminated water sources, flu-like with high fever, dry cough, diarrhea; not person-to-person.
SARS：冠狀病毒，發燒、痠痛，2-7 天後出現乾咳與呼吸困難。退伍軍人症：Legionella 來自受汙染水源，類流感高燒、乾咳、腹瀉；不會人傳人。

Pleural effusion: pleuritic pain, dyspnea, decreased chest wall movement, dry cough, decreased breath sounds/friction rub, mediastinal shift away from fluid if > 250 mL; Fowler's, thoracentesis; pleurodesis/pleurectomy if recurrent.
胸腔積液：胸膜性疼痛、呼吸困難、胸壁活動減少、乾咳、呼吸音減弱/摩擦音、積液 >250 mL 時縱膈偏離積液側；半坐臥、胸腔穿刺；反覆發生則做胸膜沾黏術/胸膜切除術。
Empyema: pus in pleural space; fever, night sweats, chest pain, weight loss; antibiotics, thoracentesis/chest tube drainage, decortication if thickened.
膿胸：胸腔內膿液；發燒、盜汗、胸痛、體重下降；抗生素、胸腔穿刺/胸管引流、胸膜增厚時行剝離術。
Pleurisy: knife-like pain worse on deep breath, friction rub; analgesics, hot/cold applications, lie on the affected side to splint.
胸膜炎：深呼吸時刀割樣痛、胸膜摩擦音；止痛藥、冷熱敷、患側臥以支撐固定。
Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases
肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病
PE: thrombus (usually deep vein) travels to a pulmonary artery. Risks: immobility, surgery, obesity, pregnancy, HF, estrogen, long-bone fracture (fat emboli).
肺栓塞：血栓（多來自深部靜脈）流至肺動脈。危險因子：不動、手術、肥胖、懷孕、心衰竭、雌激素、長骨骨折（脂肪栓塞）。
Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases
肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病
Signs: sudden dyspnea, pleuritic/chest pain, tachypnea, tachycardia, hypotension, cyanosis, anxiety/impending doom, hemoptysis, distended neck veins, petechiae over chest/axilla.
徵象：突發呼吸困難、胸膜性/胸痛、呼吸急促、心搏過速、低血壓、發紺、焦慮/瀕死感、咳血、頸靜脈怒張、胸腋瘀點。
Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases
肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病
Action: elevate HOB, oxygen, call rapid response and PHCP, prepare ABG, labs, scan, heparin; monitor vitals and lung sounds; support client.
處置：抬高床頭、給氧、呼叫快速反應小組與醫師、準備血氣、檢驗、影像、heparin；監測生命徵象與呼吸音；提供支持。
Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases
肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病

Histoplasmosis: inhaled spores from soil/bird droppings; mask and wet floor before sweeping barns; watch nephrotoxicity of antifungals. Sarcoidosis: granulomas, steroids. Occupational lung disease: prevention with respiratory protection.
組織漿菌症：吸入土壤/鳥糞孢子；清掃穀倉前戴口罩並先噴濕地面；注意抗黴菌藥腎毒性。類肉瘤病：肉芽腫、使用類固醇。職業性肺病：以呼吸防護預防。
Pulmonary embolism and other lung diseases
肺栓塞與其他肺部疾病
Mycobacterium tuberculosis, acid-fast, airborne droplet nuclei; mainly upper lobes; noncompliance leads to MDR-TB; risk after 2-3 weeks of treatment falls greatly.
結核分枝桿菌，抗酸性、經空氣飛沫核傳染；多侵犯上肺葉；不遵從治療導致多重抗藥結核；治療 2-3 週後傳染力大幅下降。
Signs: fatigue, anorexia, weight loss, low-grade fever, night sweats, persistent cough with mucoid/bloody sputum; upper-lobe infiltrates and calcification on x-ray.
徵象：疲倦、厭食、體重減輕、低燒、盜汗、持續咳嗽伴黏液/血痰；X 光上肺葉浸潤與鈣化。

Tests: TST (read at 48-72 h, induration in mm; positive means exposure, not active disease; BCG gives positive; confirm with chest x-ray), QuantiFERON-TB Gold, sputum acid-fast smear and culture (up to 6 weeks).
檢查：結核菌素試驗（48-72 小時判讀硬結 mm；陽性代表曾暴露，非活動性疾病；BCG 可呈陽性；需胸部 X 光確認）、QuantiFERON-TB Gold、痰液抗酸染色與培養（最多 6 週）。
Hospital: airborne isolation, negative-pressure room with door closed, at least 6 air exchanges per hour, N95/particulate respirator for staff, surgical mask on client when transported.
住院：空氣隔離、負壓病室門須關閉、每小時至少 6 次換氣、工作人員戴 N95/呼吸防護具、病人外出需戴外科口罩。

Teaching: take medication exactly as prescribed, up to 12 months; sputum cultures every 2-4 weeks, three negative cultures = not infectious; cover cough, handwashing, nutrition (iron, protein, vitamin C), notify public health department.
衛教：嚴格按時服藥，最長達 12 個月；每 2-4 週痰培養，三次陰性即無傳染力；掩口咳嗽、洗手、營養（鐵、蛋白質、維生素 C）、通報公共衛生單位。
Silent chest in acute asthma means impending respiratory failure.
急性氣喘發作時呼吸音消失（靜默胸）代表即將呼吸衰竭。
Tension pneumothorax: tracheal deviation to the unaffected side, distended neck veins, hypotension, absent breath sounds; chest tube.
張力性氣胸：氣管偏向健側、頸靜脈怒張、低血壓、呼吸音消失；需胸管。
Open chest wound: apply a nonporous dressing.
開放性胸部傷口：覆蓋不透氣敷料。
Flail chest shows paradoxical chest movement; treat pain, oxygen, PEEP for respiratory failure.
連枷胸呈反常呼吸；需止痛、給氧，呼吸衰竭用 PEEP。
Uncompensated respiratory acidosis in COPD suggests acute exacerbation; use lowest oxygen concentration guided by ABG/SpO2.
COPD 出現未代償呼吸性酸中毒提示急性惡化；依血氣/血氧使用最低有效氧濃度。
Pulmonary embolism: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, anxiety, tachycardia; HOB up, oxygen, rapid response, heparin; CT angiography is preferred test.
肺栓塞：突發呼吸困難、胸痛、焦慮、心搏過速；抬高床頭、給氧、快速反應、heparin；CT 肺動脈攝影為首選檢查。
D-dimer: sensitive but not specific; normal < 50 ng/mL.
D-dimer：敏感但非特異；正常 < 50 ng/mL。
After bronchoscopy keep NPO until gag reflex returns; watch for bronchospasm, hemorrhage, pneumothorax, crepitus.
支氣管鏡後嘔吐反射恢復前禁食；監測支氣管痙攣、出血、氣胸、皮下氣腫。
Thoracentesis: monitor for pneumothorax, air embolism, pulmonary edema; check coagulation first.
胸腔穿刺：監測氣胸、空氣栓塞、肺水腫；事先檢查凝血。
Do not suction before an ABG draw.
抽動脈血氣前不可抽吸。
TB skin test: read 48-72 hours; positive result means exposure; BCG causes positive; needs chest x-ray.
結核菌素試驗：48-72 小時判讀；陽性代表曾暴露；BCG 可致陽性；需做胸部 X 光。
Active TB: airborne precautions, negative-pressure room, N95 for staff, mask on client in transit.
活動性結核：空氣隔離、負壓病室、工作人員戴 N95、病人外出戴口罩。
TB medication continues up to 12 months; noncompliance causes MDR-TB; three negative sputum cultures end infectiousness.
結核藥物最長持續 12 個月；不遵從導致多重抗藥；三次痰培養陰性代表無傳染力。
Legionnaire's disease is not spread person-to-person; COVID-19 and influenza use droplet precautions.
退伍軍人症不會人傳人；COVID-19 與流感採飛沫隔離。
Pleural effusion > 250 mL causes mediastinal shift away from the fluid.
胸腔積液 > 250 mL 使縱膈偏離積液側。
Rib fractures: self-splint with a pillow, avoid external binders; pneumonia risk is high.
肋骨骨折：以枕頭自行按壓，避免外部束縛；肺炎風險高。
Asthma triggers 'ASA, NSAIDs, beta-blockers' (the three drug classes to avoid).
氣喘誘發藥物：阿斯匹靈、NSAIDs、β 阻斷劑（三類須避免）。
Tension pneumothorax: tracheal deviation AWAY from the injured (affected) side; effusion pushes mediastinum away from fluid.
張力性氣胸氣管偏向健側（遠離患側）；積液使縱膈偏離積液側。
TB: 'N95 + negative pressure + 6 air changes per hour'.
結核：N95 + 負壓 + 每小時 6 次換氣。
PE triad to remember: sudden dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain, tachycardia in a client at risk for DVT.
肺栓塞三要點：DVT 高風險者出現突發呼吸困難、胸膜性胸痛、心搏過速。
A client with blunt chest trauma is assessed. Which finding most strongly suggests pneumothorax?
胸部鈍傷病人評估後，哪項最支持氣胸？
A client with COPD in an acute exacerbation has ABGs showing uncompensated respiratory acidosis. Which interventions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
COPD 急性惡化病人血氣呈未代償呼吸性酸中毒。下列哪些處置適當？（複選）
A postoperative client with obesity and a history of DVT suddenly develops chest pain, cough, SpO2 89%, HR 120, BP 90/66 and anxiety. What is the nurse's first action?
術後肥胖且有 DVT 病史的病人突發胸痛、咳嗽、SpO2 89%、心跳 120、血壓 90/66 並焦慮。護理師首要行動？
A client with active pulmonary tuberculosis is admitted. Which actions are correct? Select all that apply.
活動性肺結核病人入院。哪些處置正確？（複選）
A client received BCG vaccine years ago and now has a positive tuberculin skin test. What should the nurse expect?
病人多年前接種過 BCG，現在結核菌素試驗為陽性。護理師預期？
Which finding in a client with an acute asthma exacerbation is most ominous?

白三烯調節劑為預防用藥,不治療急性氣喘;監測肝功能與情緒/自殺意念。
Cromolyn can cause bronchospasm; do not stop abruptly (rebound attack).
Cromolyn可能引起支氣管痙攣;不可突然停藥(反彈性發作)。
Omalizumab: anaphylaxis risk (lip/tongue swelling, dyspnea) - have emergency meds ready at first dose; no live vaccines.
Omalizumab:有過敏性休克風險(嘴唇/舌頭腫脹、呼吸困難),首次給藥備妥急救藥;避免活性疫苗。
Decongestants max 48 hours because of rebound congestion; caution in hypertension, cardiac disease, diabetes, hyperthyroidism.
解鼻充血劑最長使用48小時(反彈性鼻塞);高血壓、心臟病、糖尿病、甲狀腺亢進者慎用。
Acetylcysteine: avoid in asthma; also antidote for acetaminophen overdose.
Acetylcysteine:氣喘者避免;亦為acetaminophen過量的解毒劑。
Naloxone: have resuscitation equipment ready; effect may wear off before the opioid, so respiratory depression can return.
Naloxone:備妥急救設備;藥效可能比鴉片類先消退,呼吸抑制可能復發。
Isoniazid: hepatitis and peripheral neuritis; give pyridoxine (B6); report jaundice, dark urine, anorexia, fatigue; no alcohol; avoid tyramine foods.
Isoniazid:肝炎與周邊神經炎;給予B6;通報黃疸、尿液變深、厭食、疲倦;禁酒;避免含酪胺食物。
Rifampin turns urine, sweat, tears, feces red-orange (harmless, stains soft contacts); reduces oral contraceptive effectiveness.
Rifampin使尿液、汗液、淚液、糞便呈橘紅色(無害,會染色軟式隱形眼鏡);降低口服避孕藥效果。
Ethambutol: report any visual change (red-green discrimination, decreased acuity) immediately - optic neuritis.
Ethambutol:任何視覺改變(紅綠辨色困難、視力下降)須立即通報(視神經炎)。
Streptomycin/aminoglycosides/capreomycin: ototoxicity, nephrotoxicity; baseline and repeated audiometry; report tinnitus, hearing loss, vertigo.
Streptomycin/胺基糖苷類/capreomycin:耳毒性、腎毒性;基線及定期聽力檢查;通報耳鳴、聽力下降、眩暈。
Never skip TB doses: nonadherence creates multidrug-resistant TB; DOT improves adherence.
結核藥物不可漏服:不遵從會產生多重抗藥性結核;DOT可提升遵從性。
Influenza antivirals work best within 2 days of symptom onset and do not replace the vaccine.
流感抗病毒藥在症狀出現2天內使用效果最佳,且不能取代疫苗。
Live attenuated nasal flu vaccine is not for pregnancy or people with chronic lung/heart disease or asthma.
活性減毒鼻噴流感疫苗不適用於孕婦或患有慢性肺/心臟病、氣喘者。
RIPE for first-line TB drugs: Rifampin, Isoniazid, Pyrazinamide, Ethambutol.
Ethambutol = Eyes (optic neuritis); Isoniazid = Impairs nerves and liver (B6); Rifampin = Red-orange fluids; Streptomycin = Sound (ears).
Ethambutol=眼睛(視神經炎);Isoniazid=神經與肝(補B6);Rifampin=橘紅體液;Streptomycin=聽力(耳)。
Theophylline toxicity: nervous, shaky, racing heart (above 20 mcg/mL).
Theophylline中毒:緊張、顫抖、心跳加快(>20 mcg/mL)。
Bronchodilator first (open the door), steroid second (deliver inside).
先擴張劑(先開門),再類固醇(再送進去)。

服用isoniazid的個案主訴尿液變深、疲倦、厭食與鞏膜發黃。護理師應如何處理?
