Heart wall: epicardium (outer), myocardium (muscle), endocardium (inner lining). Pericardial space holds 5-20 mL fluid.
心壁分三層:心外膜、心肌層、心內膜。心包腔內含5-20 mL液體。
Valves: tricuspid and mitral (AV valves) close at start of ventricular contraction; pulmonic and aortic (semilunar) open during contraction.
瓣膜:三尖瓣與二尖瓣(房室瓣)於心室收縮開始時關閉;肺動脈瓣與主動脈瓣(半月瓣)於收縮時開啟。
Conduction: SA node 60-100/min, AV node 40-60/min as backup, Purkinje fibers 20-40/min.
傳導:竇房結60-100次/分;房室結備援40-60次/分;浦金氏纖維20-40次/分。
Coronary arteries: RCA supplies SA/AV nodes and inferior wall; LAD supplies anterior wall, septum and apex; circumflex supplies lateral and posterior wall.
冠狀動脈:右冠狀動脈供應竇房結/房室結與下壁;左前降支供應前壁、中隔與心尖;迴旋支供應側壁與後壁。
S1 = AV valves closing (loudest at apex); S2 = semilunar valves closing; S3 suggests heart failure/regurgitation (normal under 30); S4 suggests stiff ventricle.
S1為房室瓣關閉(心尖最清楚);S2為半月瓣關閉;S3提示心衰竭/逆流(30歲以下可正常);S4提示心室僵硬。
Sympathetic (norepinephrine) raises HR, contractility and vasoconstriction; parasympathetic (acetylcholine) lowers HR. Baroreceptors in aortic arch and carotid sinuses regulate BP.
交感神經(norepinephrine)使心率、收縮力與血管收縮增加;副交感(acetylcholine)使心率下降。壓力感受器位於主動脈弓與頸動脈竇,調節血壓。
Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone: renin makes angiotensin I, converted to II in lungs; AII causes vasoconstriction and aldosterone-driven Na/water retention.
腎素-血管收縮素-醛固酮系統:腎素產生血管收縮素I,於肺轉成II;AII引起血管收縮與醛固酮造成鈉水滯留。
Troponin I rises within 3 hours and stays elevated 7-10 days (normal <0.35 ng/mL; troponin T <0.1). High-sensitivity troponin detects injury in 60-90 minutes.
Troponin I於3小時內上升,持續7-10天(正常<0.35 ng/mL;troponin T<0.1)。高敏感度troponin可在60-90分鐘偵測損傷。
CK-MB (2-6 ng/mL) rises within hours, peaks at 18 hours; myoglobin rises in 2 hours, declines by 7 hours but is not cardiac specific.
CK-MB(2-6 ng/mL)數小時內上升,18小時達高峰;肌紅素2小時上升、7小時後下降,但非心臟特異。
BNP normally <100 ng/mL; higher means more severe heart failure. hsCRP <1 mg/L low risk, >3 mg/L high risk.
BNP正常<100 ng/mL;越高代表心衰竭越嚴重。hsCRP<1 mg/L低風險,>3 mg/L高風險。
Hypokalemia: flat/inverted T, U wave, ST depression, ventricular dysrhythmias, digoxin toxicity risk. Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T, wide QRS, flat P, asystole.
低血鉀:T波平坦/倒置、U波、ST下降、心室心律不整、增加digoxin中毒風險。高血鉀:高尖T波、QRS變寬、P波消失、心搏停止。
Hypocalcemia prolongs ST/QT; hypercalcemia shortens ST, AV block; low magnesium causes VT/VF; high Mg gives weakness, hypotension, bradycardia.
低血鈣使ST/QT延長;高血鈣使ST縮短、房室傳導阻滯;低血鎂可致VT/VF;高血鎂致無力、低血壓、心搏過緩。
WBC rises after MI; BUN rises in HF/cardiogenic shock; coagulation factors rise after MI; elevated Lp(a) and homocysteine raise CVD risk.
MI後白血球上升;心衰竭/心因性休克時BUN上升;MI後凝血因子上升;Lp(a)與同半胱胺酸升高增加心血管風險。

Stress test: avoid smoking, alcohol, caffeine; beta/calcium blockers usually held that day, theophylline 12 hours before; dipyridamole/dobutamine if cannot exercise.
運動負荷測試:避免吸菸、酒精、咖啡因;當天通常停用β阻斷劑/鈣通道阻斷劑,theophylline於前12小時停用;無法運動者用dipyridamole/dobutamine。

MRI:檢查有無節律器/金屬。經食道超音波(TEE)為侵入性,準備類似內視鏡。

Cardiac cath pre-procedure: consent, check iodine/seafood allergy, NPO (solids 6-8 h, liquids 4 h), baseline pulses and weight; hold metformin 24 hours before and until renal function reviewed (about 48 hours after).
心導管術前:同意書、確認碘/海鮮過敏、禁食(固體6-8小時、液體4小時)、記錄基線脈搏與體重;metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)恢復。

Post-cath: vitals and rhythm q30 min x 2 hours; check distal pulses, color, warmth; cool/pale limb or lost pulse = emergency (clot). Bleeding: manual pressure. Extremity straight 4-6 h, bed rest 6-12 h, HOB no more than 15 degrees if no closure device; push fluids to flush dye.
心導管術後:前2小時每30分鐘監測生命徵象與心律;檢查遠端脈搏、顏色、溫度;肢體冰冷蒼白或脈搏消失為急症(血栓)。出血時手動加壓。無縫合裝置時肢體伸直4-6小時、臥床6-12小時,床頭≤15度;鼓勵補充水分以排除顯影劑。

PTCA balloon dilates artery; complications: dissection, rupture, embolization, spasm, MI, reocclusion. Stents need antiplatelets (clopidogrel + aspirin) for months; IV nitroglycerin may prevent spasm.
PTCA以球囊擴張血管;併發症:剝離、破裂、栓塞、痙攣、心肌梗塞、再阻塞。支架術後需抗血小板藥(clopidogrel+aspirin)數月;IV nitroglycerin可預防痙攣。

CABG uses saphenous vein or internal mammary artery; MIDCAB for LAD lesions needs no sternotomy or bypass pump.
冠狀動脈繞道術使用隱靜脈或內乳動脈;MIDCAB用於左前降支病灶,不需胸骨切開或體外循環。
冠狀動脈繞道手術與心臟移植
Pre-op: teach splinting, coughing, incentive spirometer, tubes/ventilator; diuretics stopped 2-3 days, digoxin 12 hours, aspirin/anticoagulants 1 week before.
術前:教導按壓傷口、咳嗽、誘發性肺量計、管路/呼吸器;利尿劑術前2-3天、digoxin術前12小時、aspirin/抗凝血劑術前1週停用。

Post-op: chest tube drainage over 100-150 mL/hr reported; keep K+ 4-5 mEq/L; fluids 1500-2000 mL; rewarm no faster than 1.8 degrees per hour; ground equipment for epicardial wires (microshock).
術後:胸管引流量>100-150 mL/小時需通報;維持鉀4-5 mEq/L;液體限制1500-2000 mL;回溫速度每小時不超過1.8度;心外膜導線設備須接地(防微電擊)。

Tamponade signs: sudden stop of heavy mediastinal drainage, JVD with clear lungs, equalized pressures, pulsus paradoxus. Anginal pain suggests graft failure.
心包填塞徵象:大量縱隔引流突然停止、頸靜脈怒張但肺部清晰、壓力趨於相等、奇脈。心絞痛樣疼痛提示移植血管失敗。

Recovery: stop activity if BP drops 10-20 mm Hg or pulse rises over 10; sternum heals 6-8 weeks; avoid pushing/pulling 6 weeks; infection if WBC/fever persists after 3-4 days.
恢復:血壓下降10-20 mm Hg或脈搏增加>10次應停止活動;胸骨約6-8週癒合;6週內避免推拉;3-4天後仍發燒/白血球高提示感染。

Heart transplant: lifelong immunosuppression, infection risk, denervated heart (no angina, resting rate about 100, slow response to exercise), two P waves on ECG, rejection signs: hypotension, dysrhythmias, fatigue; biopsies for surveillance.
心臟移植:終身免疫抑制、感染風險、心臟去神經(無心絞痛、靜止心率約100、運動反應慢)、心電圖有兩種P波、排斥徵象:低血壓、心律不整、疲倦;定期心內膜切片。

Estimate rate with 6-second strip x 10. Normal sinus rhythm: regular, 60-100, normal PR and QRS.
以6秒心電圖條帶QRS數x10估算心率。正常竇性心律:規則、60-100次/分、PR與QRS正常。
Sinus bradycardia (<60): treat if symptomatic with oxygen, atropine (avoid extra doses), then transcutaneous pacing; hold causative drugs.
竇性心搏過緩(<60):有症狀時給氧、atropine(避免多餘劑量),再用經皮節律器;暫停可疑藥物。
Sinus tachycardia (100-180): find and treat the cause.
竇性心搏過速(100-180):找出並治療原因。

Atrial fibrillation: 350-600 chaotic atrial impulses, no P waves, fibrillatory waves, thrombus/stroke risk; give anticoagulants, rate control, cardioversion (anticoagulate 4-6 weeks and TEE first, hold digoxin 48 h).
心房顫動:每分鐘350-600次紊亂心房衝動、無P波、有顫動波、有血栓/中風風險;給予抗凝血劑、控制心室率、電擊(術前抗凝4-6週並做TEE,停digoxin 48小時)。
PVCs: check O2 sat and K+; notify provider for chest pain, increased frequency, multifocal, R-on-T, or runs of VT. Bigeminy, trigeminy, couplets described.
PVC:檢查血氧與鉀;若胸痛、頻率增加、多源性、R-on-T或連續VT需通知醫師。依序有二聯、三聯、成對等型態。
VT (140-250/min): stable = oxygen plus antidysrhythmics; unstable with pulse = synchronized cardioversion; pulseless = defibrillation and CPR.
VT(140-250次/分):穩定時給氧與抗心律不整藥;不穩定但有脈搏=同步電擊;無脈搏=去顫與CPR。
VF: no cardiac output, unconscious, no pulse; fatal in 3-5 minutes; CPR then immediate defibrillation, 2 minutes CPR between shocks.
VF:無心輸出量、意識喪失、無脈搏;3-5分鐘內致命;CPR並立即去顫,每次電擊間CPR 2分鐘。
Sudden loss of complexes: assess the client first (asystole vs lead displacement) before touching equipment.
心電圖波形突然消失:先評估個案(心搏停止或電極脫落),再處理儀器。

Vagal maneuvers (carotid massage, Valsalva) for supraventricular tachycardia; need monitor, defibrillator ready, record strips.
迷走神經刺激(頸動脈按摩、Valsalva)用於上心室心搏過速;需心電監測、備妥去顫器並記錄心電圖。

心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
Cardioversion is synchronized (to R wave) with lower energy; sedate, consent if elective; turn off oxygen; clear everyone; after: airway first, then vitals, rhythm, chest burns.
電擊(同步於R波)使用較低能量;給予鎮靜、擇期需同意書;關閉氧氣;確認無人接觸;術後先確保呼吸道,再評估生命徵象、心律與胸部灼傷。

心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
Defibrillation is asynchronous for pulseless VT/VF: 120-200 J biphasic or 360 J monophasic; resume CPR immediately; confirm rhythm after placing pads; do not delay for drugs.
去顫為非同步,用於無脈搏VT/VF:雙相120-200 J或單相360 J;立即恢復CPR;貼電擊板後先確認心律;不因給藥而延遲。

心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
Pad placement: right of sternum 3rd ICS and left midaxillary 5th ICS; avoid breast tissue, medication patches, implanted devices; AED: stop CPR during analysis, shocks only for pulseless VT/VF.
電擊板位置:胸骨右側第3肋間與左腋中線第5肋間;避開乳房組織、藥物貼片與植入裝置;AED:分析時停止CPR,僅對無脈搏VT/VF放電。

AICD delivers 25-30 J up to 4 times; client sits or lies down after a shock, keeps a log, avoids strong magnetic fields, contact sports, MRI/diathermy; carry ID card.
AICD放電25-30 J、最多4次;被電擊後應坐下或躺下、記錄日誌、避免強磁場、接觸性運動、MRI/透熱療法;隨身攜帶識別卡。

Pacemakers: demand (senses, paces if rate too low) vs fixed rate; spike before P = atrial pacing, before QRS = ventricular; capture = spike followed by depolarization.
節律器:需求型(感知後才起搏)與固定頻率型;P波前尖峰=心房起搏、QRS前尖峰=心室起搏;有後續去極化即為起搏成功(capture)。
Dysrhythmia management: cardioversion, defibrillation, AICD, pacemakers
心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
Transcutaneous pacing: do not take pulse/BP on left side; lack of capture = check skin contact then raise current. Temporary wires: insulate, ground equipment to prevent microshock.
經皮起搏:勿測左側脈搏/血壓;失去capture時先檢查皮膚接觸,再提高電流。暫時性導線:絕緣、設備接地以防微電擊。
Dysrhythmia management: cardioversion, defibrillation, AICD, pacemakers
心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
Permanent pacemaker: limit operative arm movement, report fever/swelling, dizziness, edema; battery 10 years (lithium); use cell phone on opposite side; avoid strong electromagnetic fields.
永久性節律器:限制術側手臂活動、通報發燒/腫脹、頭暈、水腫;鋰電池約10年;手機用對側耳朵;避免強電磁場。
Dysrhythmia management: cardioversion, defibrillation, AICD, pacemakers
心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
CAD = atherosclerosis narrowing coronaries; significant when left main lumen reduced 50% or a major branch 75%.
CAD為粥狀硬化使冠狀動脈狹窄;左主幹管徑減少50%或主要分支減少75%即有意義。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
Ischemia: ST depression/T inversion; infarction: ST elevation, then T inversion and Q wave. Manage risk factors, diet low in calories, sodium, cholesterol and fat.
缺血:ST下降/T波倒置;梗塞:ST上升,繼而T波倒置與Q波。控制危險因子,低熱量、低鈉、低膽固醇、低脂飲食。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛

Angina is O2 supply-demand imbalance. Stable: exertion, relieved by rest/NTG. Unstable: unpredictable, >15 min, escalating, may not respond to NTG. Variant (Prinzmetal): coronary spasm at rest, ST elevation.
心絞痛為氧供需失衡。穩定型:運動誘發、休息/NTG可緩解。不穩定型:不可預測、>15分鐘、逐漸加重、NTG可能無效。變異型(Prinzmetal):冠狀動脈痙攣、休息時發作、ST上升。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
Angina pain: substernal, squeezing, radiates to arm/jaw/back, usually <5 min (up to 15-20), relieved by rest or NTG; troponin normal.
心絞痛疼痛:胸骨下壓榨感、放射至手臂/下顎/背部,通常<5分鐘(最長15-20分鐘),休息或NTG緩解;troponin正常。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
Acute angina: stop activity, oxygen, monitor, NTG, semi-Fowler, 12-lead ECG, IV access; at home call EMS if NTG fails (aspirin may be chewed).
急性心絞痛:停止活動、給氧、監測、NTG、半坐臥、12導程心電圖、建立靜脈管路;居家NTG無效應叫救護車(可嚼服aspirin)。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
Medications: nitrates, calcium channel blockers (variant angina; avoid grapefruit juice), beta blockers, statins, antiplatelets.
藥物:硝酸鹽、鈣通道阻斷劑(變異型心絞痛;避免葡萄柚汁)、β阻斷劑、statin、抗血小板藥。
冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛
Evolves over hours; blue swollen area by 6 hours, gray with yellow streaks at 48 hours, granulation 8-10 days, scar 2-3 months. LAD = anterior/septal; circumflex = lateral/posterior; RCA = inferior.
梗塞數小時內進展;6小時呈藍色腫脹、48小時灰色帶黃紋、8-10天形成肉芽組織、2-3個月形成疤痕。LAD=前壁/中隔;迴旋支=側壁/後壁;RCA=下壁。

Pain: crushing substernal, radiates to jaw/back/left arm, lasts 30+ minutes, not relieved by rest or NTG (opioids needed); nausea, diaphoresis, dyspnea, doom; women/older adults may present atypically (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion).
疼痛:胸骨下壓榨痛、放射至下顎/背/左臂、持續30分鐘以上、休息或NTG無法緩解(需鴉片類);噁心、冒汗、呼吸困難、瀕死感;女性/老年人可能症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂)。
Labs: troponin 3 h-7-10 days; CK-MB peaks 18 h, normal in 48-72 h; myoglobin 2 h; WBC up day 2. ECG: STEMI, T inversion, Q waves persist.
檢驗:troponin 3小時起、持續7-10天;CK-MB 18小時達高峰、48-72小時恢復;肌紅素2小時;白血球第2天上升。心電圖:STEMI、T波倒置、Q波持續存在。
Acute care: morphine is priority for pain (reduces O2 demand), oxygen, NTG, monitor, semi-Fowler, IV, 12-lead ECG, beta blockers, thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath/PTCA.
急性期:疼痛處置首選morphine(降低耗氧)、給氧、NTG、監測、半坐臥、靜脈管路、12導程心電圖、β阻斷劑,若無緊急心導管/PTCA則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。
If SBP <100 or 25 mm Hg below prior, lower HOB and notify provider. Watch for poor output (cool, clammy, weak pulses), HF, dysrhythmias (PVCs, tachycardia in first hours).
若收縮壓<100或比先前低25 mm Hg,降低床頭並通知醫師。注意輸出不足(冰冷濕黏、脈搏弱)、心衰竭、心律不整(最初數小時PVC、心搏過速)。
Complications: dysrhythmias, HF, pulmonary edema, cardiogenic shock, pericarditis, mitral insufficiency, ventricular rupture, Dressler syndrome.
併發症:心律不整、心衰竭、肺水腫、心因性休克、心包炎、二尖瓣閉鎖不全、心室破裂、Dressler症候群。
Recovery: progressive activity (dangle, chair 30 min x3, ambulation), ACE inhibitor/ARB, aspirin, clopidogrel, lipid-lowering drugs; cardiac rehabilitation.
恢復期:漸進活動(床邊垂腿、下床坐椅30分鐘x3、步行)、ACE抑制劑/ARB、aspirin、clopidogrel、降血脂藥;心臟復健。

HF = inability to maintain output for metabolic needs. Systolic (HFrEF) = poor ejection; diastolic (HFpEF) = poor filling. Left failure often first; compensation (tachycardia, vasoconstriction, Na/water retention, hypertrophy) eventually harms.
心衰竭為心輸出量無法滿足代謝需求。收縮性(HFrEF)=射血差;舒張性(HFpEF)=充填差。多始於左心衰竭;代償機制(心搏過速、血管收縮、鈉水滯留、肥厚)終致傷害。
Left HF: pulmonary congestion - dyspnea, crackles, cough, PND, nocturia. Right HF: systemic - dependent edema, JVD, hepatomegaly, abdominal distention, weight gain.
左心衰竭:肺部鬱血-呼吸困難、囉音、咳嗽、夜間陣發性呼吸困難、夜尿。右心衰竭:全身性-下垂性水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大、腹脹、體重增加。
Acute pulmonary edema: severe dyspnea, crackles/wheezing, pink frothy sputum, anxiety, cold clammy skin, cyanosis, SpO2 low.
急性肺水腫:嚴重呼吸困難、囉音/喘鳴、粉紅泡沫痰、焦慮、皮膚冰冷濕黏、發紺、血氧低。
Emergency: high-Fowler, stay with client, get help, oxygen, IV access, furosemide, morphine IV, Foley, prepare for intubation.
急救:高坐臥、陪伴個案、呼叫協助、給氧、靜脈管路、furosemide、IV morphine、導尿、準備插管。

Home teaching: daily weights, report edema/weight gain, low sodium/fat/cholesterol diet, potassium foods (except with K-sparing diuretics), spread fluids and hard candy for thirst, avoid isometrics, caffeine and OTC drugs, balance rest and activity.
居家衛教:每日量體重、通報水腫/體重增加、低鈉低脂低膽固醇飲食、攝取高鉀食物(使用保鉀利尿劑除外)、液體分散攝取並含硬糖止渴、避免等長運動、咖啡因與成藥、活動與休息平衡。
Typical medications: digoxin, diuretics, ACE inhibitors, low-dose beta blockers, vasodilators.
常用藥物:digoxin、利尿劑、ACE抑制劑、低劑量β阻斷劑、血管擴張劑。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

Pericarditis: sharp pleuritic chest pain worse supine/inspiration, relieved leaning forward, friction rub, fever, ST elevation, AF; give NSAIDs/steroids, oxygen, sit upright leaning forward; watch for tamponade.
心包炎:尖銳的胸膜性胸痛、平躺/吸氣時加重、前傾可緩解、心包摩擦音、發燒、ST上升、心房顫動;給NSAIDs/類固醇、氧氣、前傾坐姿;注意心包填塞。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞
Myocarditis: fever, dyspnea, tachycardia, friction rub, gallop, murmur, HF signs; treat with analgesics, antibiotics, digoxin, antidysrhythmics.
心肌炎:發燒、呼吸困難、心搏過速、摩擦音、奔馬律、雜音、心衰竭徵象;予止痛劑、抗生素、digoxin、抗心律不整藥。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

Endocarditis: risk with IV drug use, prosthetic valves, dental/invasive procedures; signs: fever, murmur, petechiae, splinter hemorrhages, Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), clubbing, embolic events.
心內膜炎:風險包括靜脈藥物濫用、人工瓣膜、牙科/侵入性處置;徵象:發燒、雜音、瘀點、甲下線狀出血、Osler結節(有壓痛)、Janeway病灶(無壓痛)、杵狀指、栓塞事件。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

Endocarditis care: IV antibiotics, blood cultures, watch for splenic (left shoulder pain), renal (flank pain, hematuria), CNS (confusion, aphasia), pulmonary emboli; teach oral hygiene with soft brush, prophylactic antibiotics before dental work, temperature daily for 6 weeks.
心內膜炎處置:IV抗生素、血液培養、監測脾栓塞(左肩痛)、腎栓塞(側腹痛、血尿)、中樞栓塞(意識混亂、失語)、肺栓塞;教導軟毛牙刷口腔衛生、牙科前預防性抗生素、6週內每日量體溫。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

Tamponade: fluid in pericardium restricts filling (20-50 mL rapid can be acute). Signs: pulsus paradoxus, JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, narrowing pulse pressure, hypotension, rising CVP.
心包填塞:心包液體限制心室充填(快速累積20-50 mL即可急性發作)。徵象:奇脈、頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、脈壓變窄、低血壓、中心靜脈壓上升。
Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞
Tamponade care: ICU hemodynamic monitoring, IV fluids, pericardiocentesis; success = clear lungs, normal JVD, lower CVP, higher BP.
填塞處置:加護病房血行動力監測、靜脈輸液、心包穿刺;成功指標:肺清晰、頸靜脈正常、CVP下降、血壓上升。

Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

Stenosis = valve will not open fully; insufficiency/regurgitation = will not close. Aortic stenosis: exertional dyspnea, angina, syncope, harsh systolic murmur; aortic insufficiency: blowing diastolic murmur.
狹窄=瓣膜無法完全開啟;閉鎖不全/逆流=無法完全關閉。主動脈狹窄:運動時呼吸困難、心絞痛、昏厥、粗糙收縮期雜音;主動脈閉鎖不全:吹風樣舒張期雜音。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

Mechanical valve: durable, lifelong anticoagulation; bioprosthetic (pig/cow/human): less durable, often no long-term anticoagulant. Teach oral hygiene, prophylactic antibiotics, MedicAlert; stop anticoagulants about 72 hours before surgery.
機械瓣膜:耐久,需終身抗凝;生物瓣膜(豬/牛/人):較不耐用,多不需長期抗凝。教導口腔衛生、預防性抗生素、MedicAlert手環;手術前約72小時停抗凝劑。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病
Cardiomyopathy: dilated (dilated chambers, HF, emboli), hypertrophic (thick septum, sudden death; avoid digoxin/nitrates if obstructed), restrictive (stiff walls, right HF).
心肌病變:擴張型(腔室擴大、心衰竭、栓塞)、肥厚型(中隔肥厚、猝死;阻塞型避免digoxin/硝酸鹽)、限制型(心壁僵硬、右心衰竭)。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

Thrombophlebitis/DVT: calf pain, warmth, swelling; Homans sign unreliable; bed rest, elevate leg, no massage, no knee gatch/pillow under knees, antiembolism stockings, heparin (aPTT) then warfarin (INR); watch for PE (dyspnea, chest pain).
血栓性靜脈炎/DVT:小腿疼痛、發熱、腫脹;Homans徵象不可靠;臥床、抬高肢體、不按摩、勿用膝下枕/膝部支架、抗栓襪、heparin(aPTT)後接warfarin(INR);注意肺栓塞(呼吸困難、胸痛)。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

Superficial phlebitis: warm moist soaks. Venous insufficiency: edema, brown stasis dermatitis, ulcers at lateral malleolus; leg elevation, compression stockings (put on before rising), Unna boot (saline only, no povidone-iodine/peroxide, check for arterial occlusion).
表淺靜脈炎:溫濕敷。靜脈功能不全:水腫、棕色鬱積性皮膚炎、外踝潰瘍;抬腿、壓力襪(起床前穿上)、Unna boot(僅用生理食鹽水,不用優碘/雙氧水,注意動脈阻塞)。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病
Varicose veins: aching legs, Trendelenburg test (veins fill from proximal end); stockings, leg elevation, sclerotherapy, laser, stripping.
靜脈曲張:腿部酸痛、Trendelenburg測試(靜脈由近端充盈);穿彈性襪、抬腿、硬化療法、雷射、靜脈剝除。
Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

PAD: intermittent claudication, rest pain relieved by dependency, cool gray-blue skin, hair loss, thick nails, elevational pallor/dependent rubor, absent pulses, ulcers on toes. Keep legs level or slightly dependent (not above heart), walk to claudication then rest, no heat, no smoking/caffeine, no crossing legs.
周邊動脈疾病:間歇性跛行、下垂可緩解的休息痛、皮膚冰冷灰藍、掉毛、趾甲增厚、抬高蒼白/下垂潮紅、脈搏消失、趾部潰瘍。腿部保持水平或略下垂(不高於心臟)、走到跛行再休息、不可直接加熱、戒菸與咖啡因、勿翹腳。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

After arterial bypass: warmth, redness, edema expected (increased flow); sharp pain increase or lost pulse = graft occlusion (call immediately); keep leg straight, avoid hip/knee flexion; watch BP (hypotension and hypertension both harmful).
動脈繞道術後:溫熱、發紅、水腫為預期(血流增加);疼痛突然加劇或脈搏消失=移植血管阻塞(立即通報);肢體伸直、避免髖/膝彎曲;注意血壓(過低或過高皆有害)。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Raynaud: vasospasm with cold/stress, white-blue-red color change; avoid cold, smoking, injury; vasodilators. Buerger: smokers, claudication, rest pain, ulcers; same care.
雷諾氏症:受冷/壓力引發血管痙攣、白-藍-紅變色;避免寒冷、吸菸、受傷;血管擴張劑。Buerger病:吸菸者、跛行、休息痛、潰瘍;照護同上。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

Aortic aneurysm: fusiform, saccular, dissecting, false. AAA: pulsating abdominal mass, bruit; do NOT palpate deeply. Rupture: severe abdominal/back pain, flank hematoma, hypotension, shock. Thoracic: hoarseness, dysphagia, back pain.
主動脈瘤:梭狀、囊狀、剝離、假性。腹主動脈瘤:搏動性腹部腫塊、血管雜音;不可深壓觸診。破裂:劇烈腹/背痛、側腹血腫、低血壓、休克。胸主動脈瘤:聲音沙啞、吞嚥困難、背痛。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

AAA repair post-op: check pulses distal to graft, HOB max 45 degrees, NG suction, urine output hourly (report <30-50 mL/hr, rising BUN/creatinine = acute kidney injury), no lifting >15-20 lb for 6-12 weeks.
腹主動脈瘤術後:檢查移植血管遠端脈搏、床頭最高45度、鼻胃管抽吸、每小時尿量(<30-50 mL/hr、BUN/肌酐上升=急性腎損傷需通報)、6-12週內不提超過15-20磅重物。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Embolectomy: baseline pulses, bed cradle, extremity slightly dependent; watch reperfusion compartment swelling (pain on passive movement, tense muscle, numbness).
取栓術:基線脈搏、床架、肢體略下垂;注意再灌流造成肌肉腫脹(被動活動疼痛、肌肉緊繃、麻木)。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Vena cava filter traps emboli to prevent PE; held anticoagulants pre-op per provider.
下腔靜脈濾器可攔截栓子以預防肺栓塞;術前依醫囑停用抗凝劑。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
BP categories: normal <120/<80; elevated 120-129/<80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 >=140 or >=90. Higher value classifies.
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Lifestyle: sodium about 2 g/day, weight loss, exercise (no isometrics/heavy lifting), limit alcohol/caffeine, stop smoking; drugs lifelong, never stop for side effects without calling.
生活型態:鈉約2 g/天、減重、運動(避免等長/重量訓練)、限制酒精/咖啡因、戒菸;藥物需終身服用,有副作用先聯絡醫療人員,勿自行停藥。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120 with headache, confusion, blurred vision; IV antihypertensives, BP q5 min, HOB 45 degrees, airway, Foley, I&O, watch for hypotension.
高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120伴頭痛、意識混亂、視力模糊;IV降壓藥、每5分鐘量血壓、床頭45度、維持呼吸道、導尿、記錄輸出入、注意低血壓。
動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓
Cardiac cath: withhold metformin 24 h before and until renal function is confirmed (about 48 h after); check allergy to iodine/seafood; post-procedure check distal pulse and bleeding.
心導管:metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)再用;確認碘/海鮮過敏;術後檢查遠端脈搏與出血。
Cool, pale, pulseless or numb extremity after cath or arterial surgery = possible clot, emergency.
心導管或動脈手術後肢體冰冷、蒼白、無脈或麻木=可能血栓,屬急症。
Symptomatic sinus bradycardia: oxygen, atropine, then transcutaneous pacing; avoid repeated atropine.
有症狀的竇性心搏過緩:給氧、atropine,再用經皮節律器;避免重複給atropine。
VF/pulseless VT: CPR, immediate defibrillation (120-200 J biphasic, 360 J monophasic), unsynchronized, confirm rhythm; fatal in 3-5 minutes.
VF/無脈搏VT:CPR、立即去顫(雙相120-200 J、單相360 J)、非同步、確認心律;3-5分鐘內致命。
Cardioversion is synchronized to the R wave to avoid the T wave; before: anticoagulation 4-6 weeks plus TEE for AF, hold digoxin 48 h; after: airway first.
電擊與R波同步以避開T波;術前:心房顫動需抗凝4-6週加TEE、停digoxin 48小時;術後先確保呼吸道。
Before shocking: turn off oxygen, clear everyone (check 3 times).
放電前:關閉氧氣、確認無人接觸(檢查三次)。
R-on-T PVC, multifocal PVCs, runs of VT, or PVCs with chest pain: notify provider; first check BP and SpO2.
R-on-T PVC、多源性PVC、連續VT或PVC合併胸痛:通知醫師;先檢查血壓與血氧。
Atrial fibrillation: no P waves, fibrillatory waves, anticoagulate for stroke risk; rapid rate drops cardiac output (syncope, dizziness, palpitations).
心房顫動:無P波、有顫動波、需抗凝預防中風;速率快使心輸出量下降(昏厥、頭暈、心悸)。
MI: crushing pain over 30 minutes unrelieved by rest or NTG; morphine is priority analgesic; troponin rises in 3 hours; thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath.
MI:壓榨痛超過30分鐘、休息或NTG無效;morphine為優先止痛;troponin 3小時上升;若無緊急心導管則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。
Troponin and enzymes are normal in stable angina; elevated in MI.
穩定型心絞痛troponin與酵素正常;MI時升高。
Women and older adults often have atypical MI symptoms (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion, NSTEMI).
女性與老年人MI常症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂、NSTEMI)。
Acute pulmonary edema: high-Fowler, oxygen, furosemide, morphine, Foley; crackles and pink frothy sputum; do not delay for transport.
急性肺水腫:高坐臥、給氧、furosemide、morphine、導尿;囉音與粉紅泡沫痰;勿因轉送而延遲處置。
Left HF signs are pulmonary; right HF signs are systemic (edema, JVD, hepatomegaly).
左心衰竭徵象在肺部;右心衰竭徵象在全身(水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大)。
Tamponade: JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, pulsus paradoxus, narrow pulse pressure; pericardiocentesis. Sudden stop of mediastinal drainage after cardiac surgery is a warning.
心包填塞:頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、奇脈、脈壓變窄;心包穿刺。心臟手術後縱隔引流突然停止為警訊。
Endocarditis: Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), splinter hemorrhages; prophylactic antibiotics before dental work for prosthetic valves.
心內膜炎:Osler結節(痛)、Janeway病灶(不痛)、甲下線狀出血;人工瓣膜者牙科前預防性抗生素。
DVT: no massage, no knee gatch or pillow under knees; heparin with aPTT, warfarin with INR; watch for PE.
DVT:不按摩、勿用膝部支架或膝下枕;heparin監測aPTT、warfarin監測INR;注意肺栓塞。
PAD: do not elevate legs above heart; no heat; walk until claudication then rest. Venous insufficiency: elevate legs.
周邊動脈疾病:腿不可高於心臟;不可加熱;走到跛行後休息。靜脈功能不全:需抬腿。
AAA: do not palpate deeply; rupture = severe back/abdominal pain, shock; post-op urine output under 30 mL/hr and rising creatinine = acute kidney injury, call provider.
腹主動脈瘤:不可深壓觸診;破裂=劇烈背/腹痛、休克;術後尿量<30 mL/hr與肌酐上升=急性腎損傷,通知醫師。
Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120; IV antihypertensives; BP every 5 minutes; HOB 45 degrees.
高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120;IV降壓藥;每5分鐘量血壓;床頭45度。
Coronary territories: LAD = anterior (Left Anterior); RCA = inferior, SA and AV nodes; circumflex = lateral/posterior.
冠狀動脈供血區:LAD=前壁;RCA=下壁、竇房結與房室結;迴旋支=側/後壁。
Rate by 6-second strip: count QRS in 6 seconds x 10.
Angina = relieved by rest/NTG, short, normal troponin; MI = unrelieved, 30+ min, troponin up.
心絞痛=休息/NTG緩解、短暫、troponin正常;MI=無法緩解、30分鐘以上、troponin升高。
Left HF = Lungs; Right HF = Rest of the body (edema, JVD, liver).
左心衰竭=肺(Lung);右心衰竭=全身其餘(水腫、頸靜脈、肝)。
Osler nodes are Ouch (painful); Janeway lesions are not.
Beck triad of tamponade: hypotension, JVD, muffled heart sounds.
心包填塞Beck三聯徵:低血壓、頸靜脈怒張、心音遙遠。
A client with type 2 diabetes is scheduled for cardiac catheterization. Which medication should be withheld 24 hours before the procedure?
第2型糖尿病個案預定接受心導管檢查。哪一種藥物應於術前24小時停用?
A client has sinus bradycardia at 45/min, BP 82/60 and dizziness. Which intervention does the nurse anticipate?
個案竇性心搏過緩45次/分,血壓82/60並頭暈。護理師預期何種處置?
A client with heart failure suddenly has extreme dyspnea, tachycardia and crackles. Which actions are priorities? Select all that apply.
心衰竭個案突然極度呼吸困難、心搏過速、有囉音。哪些為優先處置?(多選)
The monitor shows no P waves, wide QRS complexes, and a regular ventricular rate of 160/min in an unresponsive client with no pulse. What is the first action?
監視器顯示無P波、QRS變寬、心室律規則160次/分,個案無意識且無脈搏。首要處置為何?
Which energy setting is used for defibrillation with a monophasic defibrillator?
單相去顫器去顫時使用哪個能量?
Four hours after aortoiliac bypass grafting, a client's leg is warm, red and slightly edematous with a palpable pedal pulse. How does the nurse interpret this?
主動脈髂動脈繞道術後4小時,個案腿部溫熱、發紅、輕微水腫,足背脈搏可摸到。護理師如何判讀?
A client is 1 day post abdominal aortic aneurysm resection with urine output 90, 50 then 28 mL over 3 hours, BUN 35 and creatinine 1.8. What is the priority?
腹主動脈瘤切除術後1天,3小時尿量依序90、50、28 mL,BUN 35、肌酐1.8。優先處置為何?
Which findings support infective endocarditis? Select all that apply.
下列哪些發現支持感染性心內膜炎?(多選)
A client with peripheral arterial disease asks how to relieve rest pain in the foot at night. Which teaching is correct?
周邊動脈疾病個案詢問如何緩解夜間足部休息痛。哪項衛教正確?
A client has BP 188/124 with severe headache, blurred vision and confusion. Which actions apply? Select all that apply.
個案血壓188/124,伴嚴重頭痛、視力模糊與意識混亂。哪些處置適用?(多選)

Prevent clot formation/extension; used in MI, unstable angina, AF, DVT, PE, mechanical valves. Contraindicated with active bleeding (except DIC), bleeding disorders, ulcers, severe liver/kidney disease, hemorrhagic brain injury.
預防血栓形成與延伸;用於心肌梗塞、不穩定型心絞痛、心房顫動、DVT、肺栓塞、機械瓣膜。活動性出血(DIC除外)、出血性疾病、潰瘍、嚴重肝腎疾病、出血性腦傷為禁忌。

Heparin blocks thrombin conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin; does not dissolve existing clots. Normal aPTT 30-40 s; therapeutic 1.5-2.5 x normal; check every 4-6 hours initially. Antidote: protamine sulfate.
Heparin阻止凝血酶將纖維蛋白原轉為纖維蛋白;不會溶解已有血栓。aPTT正常30-40秒,治療目標為正常值1.5-2.5倍;起始時每4-6小時監測。解毒劑:protamine sulfate。
Subcutaneous heparin: abdomen, 5/8-inch needle, 90 degrees, do not aspirate or rub. Continuous IV via infusion pump. Monitor platelets (thrombocytopenia).
皮下注射heparin:腹部、5/8吋針頭、90度角,不回抽、不按揉。持續靜脈滴注須用輸液幫浦。監測血小板(血小板低下)。

Enoxaparin (low-molecular-weight heparin): give to recumbent client in abdominal wall, do not expel air bubble or aspirate; anti-Xa therapeutic 0.5-1.2 IU/mL; antidote protamine. Rivaroxaban is oral once daily.
Enoxaparin(低分子量肝素):個案平躺、注射於腹壁,不排除預充針筒氣泡、不回抽;抗Xa治療範圍0.5-1.2 IU/mL;解毒劑protamine。Rivaroxaban為口服每日一次。

Warfarin antagonizes vitamin K (factors II, VII, IX, X); monitored by PT (normal 11-12.5 s) and INR (normal 0.81-1.2). Goal INR 2-3 standard, 3-4.5 high-dose. Antidote: phytonadione (vitamin K). Heparin bridge until INR therapeutic.
Warfarin拮抗維生素K(因子II、VII、IX、X);以PT(正常11-12.5秒)與INR(正常0.81-1.2)監測。標準目標INR 2-3,高強度3-4.5。解毒劑:phytonadione(維生素K)。INR達標前以heparin銜接。
Dabigatran: direct thrombin inhibitor for nonvalvular AF, fixed twice-daily dose, no routine blood monitoring.
Dabigatran:直接凝血酶抑制劑,用於非瓣膜性心房顫動,固定每日兩次,無需常規抽血監測。

Avoid with anticoagulants: NSAIDs, salicylates, ginkgo/ginseng, corticosteroids, macrolides, fluoroquinolones, phenytoin, sulfonamides, cimetidine, allopurinol, oral hypoglycemics; keep vitamin K intake consistent (green leafy vegetables).
與抗凝血劑併用應避免:NSAIDs、水楊酸類、銀杏/人蔘、類固醇、巨環類、氟喹諾酮、phenytoin、磺胺類、cimetidine、allopurinol、口服降血糖藥;維生素K攝取量需穩定(深綠色蔬菜)。
血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥
Thrombolytics (alteplase, reteplase, tenecteplase) activate plasminogen to plasmin; used early in MI (within 4-6 hours of onset), arterial/venous thrombosis, PE, ischemic stroke, occluded catheters.
血栓溶解劑(alteplase、reteplase、tenecteplase)活化纖溶酶原成纖溶酶;用於MI早期(發作4-6小時內)、動靜脈血栓、肺栓塞、缺血性中風、導管阻塞。
血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥
Contraindications: active bleeding, prior hemorrhagic stroke, intracranial problems/surgery within 2 months, major surgery within 10 days, uncontrolled hypertension, prolonged CPR.
禁忌:活動性出血、曾有出血性中風、顱內問題/2個月內顱內或脊椎手術、10天內大手術、血壓失控、近期長時間CPR。
血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥

Main risk is bleeding; also dysrhythmias and allergy. Monitor aPTT, PT, fibrinogen, Hct, platelets, neuro status; avoid injections/venipuncture; direct pressure 20-30 min; handle gently. Antidote: aminocaproic acid.
主要風險為出血,另有心律不整與過敏。監測aPTT、PT、纖維蛋白原、血比容、血小板與神經狀態;避免注射/抽血;穿刺處直接加壓20-30分鐘;輕柔搬動。解毒劑:aminocaproic acid。
血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥

Antiplatelets (aspirin, clopidogrel, ticagrelor, cilostazol, dipyridamole, abciximab, eptifibatide, tirofiban) inhibit aggregation; used after MI, stents, revascularization, stroke. Adverse: bruising, GI bleeding, tarry stools, hematuria.
抗血小板藥(aspirin、clopidogrel、ticagrelor、cilostazol、dipyridamole、abciximab、eptifibatide、tirofiban)抑制血小板聚集;用於MI後、支架、血管重建、中風。不良反應:瘀斑、消化道出血、黑便、血尿。
血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥

IV inotropes (dobutamine, dopamine, milrinone) for short-term advanced heart failure; use infusion pump and continuous ECG; stop if BP drops or dysrhythmias occur; watch potassium, liver enzymes, platelets.
靜脈強心劑(dobutamine、dopamine、milrinone)用於晚期心衰竭短期處置;使用輸液幫浦與持續心電圖;血壓下降或出現心律不整時停止;注意鉀、肝酵素、血小板。

Digoxin: positive inotrope, negative chronotrope and dromotrope (slows AV conduction); second-line for HF, used for AF/flutter rate control; contraindicated in ventricular dysrhythmias and 2nd/3rd-degree block.
Digoxin:正性肌力、負性變時與負性傳導作用(減慢房室傳導);為心衰竭第二線用藥,用於心房顫動/撲動心室率控制;心室心律不整與二、三度房室傳導阻滯禁用。

Therapeutic level 0.5-2.0 ng/mL (0.63-2.56 nmol/L); low end preferred. Toxicity: anorexia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea first, then bradycardia/dysrhythmias and visual changes (blurred, yellow-green vision, halos).
治療濃度0.5-2.0 ng/mL(0.63-2.56 nmol/L),偏低端較佳。中毒:先出現食慾不振、噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉,後出現心搏過緩/心律不整與視覺異常(模糊、黃綠視、光暈)。
Risk factors: hypokalemia (K below 3.5), hypomagnesemia, hypercalcemia, hypothyroidism, renal disease, older age, K-wasting diuretics, corticosteroids. Antidote: digoxin immune Fab.
風險因素:低血鉀(<3.5)、低血鎂、高血鈣、甲狀腺機能低下、腎病、高齡、排鉀利尿劑、類固醇。解毒劑:digoxin immune Fab。
Check apical pulse for a full minute; hold and call if below 60/min. Teach pulse taking (report <60 or >100), eat potassium-rich foods, avoid OTC drugs.
測心尖脈搏滿一分鐘;低於60次/分應暫停並通知醫師。教導自測脈搏(<60或>100通報)、攝取高鉀食物、避免自行服用成藥。

Thiazides (hydrochlorothiazide, chlorthalidone, metolazone): act on distal tubule; for hypertension and edema; need normal renal function. Adverse: hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hypercalcemia, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia, photosensitivity; sulfa-based.
Thiazide類(hydrochlorothiazide、chlorthalidone、metolazone):作用於遠曲小管;用於高血壓與水腫;腎功能須正常。不良反應:低血鉀、低血鈉、高血鈣、高血糖、高尿酸、光敏感;含磺胺結構。
Thiazide teaching: take in morning, rise slowly, sunscreen, potassium-rich foods, watch digoxin/lithium toxicity.
Thiazide衛教:早晨服用、緩慢起身、防曬、攝取高鉀食物、注意digoxin/lithium毒性。

Loop diuretics (furosemide, bumetanide, torsemide): potent, act on loop of Henle; for pulmonary edema, HF, hypertension. Adverse: hypokalemia, hyponatremia, hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, ototoxicity, hyperuricemia. Give IV furosemide slowly over 1-2 minutes.
袢利尿劑(furosemide、bumetanide、torsemide):作用強,作用於亨利氏環;用於肺水腫、心衰竭、高血壓。不良反應:低血鉀、低血鈉、低血鈣、低血鎂、耳毒性、高尿酸。IV furosemide須於1-2分鐘緩慢推注。

Potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride, triamterene): primary concern is hyperkalemia (K above 5.0; peaked T waves). Avoid salt substitutes, K supplements; caution with ACE inhibitors.
保鉀利尿劑(spironolactone、eplerenone、amiloride、triamterene):主要顧慮為高血鉀(K>5.0;T波高尖)。避免鹽代用品與鉀補充劑;與ACE抑制劑併用需謹慎。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
Peripheral alpha blockers (doxazosin, prazosin, terazosin): vasodilation; adverse orthostatic hypotension, reflex tachycardia, fluid retention. Rise slowly, limit salt.
周邊α阻斷劑(doxazosin、prazosin、terazosin):血管擴張;不良反應為姿勢性低血壓、反射性心搏過速、水分滯留。緩慢起身、限鹽。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
Central agents (clonidine, methyldopa, guanfacine): adverse dry mouth, drowsiness, bradycardia, depression, edema; never stop abruptly (rebound hypertension); monitor liver function.
中樞作用劑(clonidine、methyldopa、guanfacine):不良反應為口乾、嗜睡、心搏過緩、憂鬱、水腫;不可突然停藥(反彈性高血壓);監測肝功能。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
ACE inhibitors (-pril) block angiotensin I to II; ARBs (-sartan) block AII receptors. Used for hypertension, HF, post-MI protection.
ACE抑制劑(-pril)阻斷血管收縮素I轉換為II;ARB(-sartan)阻斷血管收縮素II受體。用於高血壓、心衰竭、MI後心臟保護。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
Adverse: persistent dry cough (ACE inhibitors), hyperkalemia, hypotension, taste change; captopril may cause bruising/neutropenia and is taken 20-60 minutes before meals.
不良反應:持續乾咳(ACE抑制劑)、高血鉀、低血壓、味覺改變;captopril可能引起瘀斑/嗜中性球低下,須餐前20-60分鐘服用。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
Avoid potassium supplements and K-sparing diuretics; monitor BUN, creatinine, K+; do not stop abruptly; report cough that persists.
避免鉀補充劑與保鉀利尿劑;監測BUN、肌酐、鉀;不可突然停藥;持續咳嗽應通報。
Alpha blockers, central sympatholytics, ACE inhibitors, ARBs
α阻斷劑、中樞交感神經抑制劑、ACE抑制劑與ARB
Vasodilate, lowering preload and afterload and myocardial oxygen demand. Contraindicated with significant hypotension, increased ICP, severe anemia, and erectile dysfunction drugs (PDE5 inhibitors).
血管擴張,降低前負荷、後負荷與心肌耗氧。顯著低血壓、顱內壓升高、嚴重貧血及使用勃起功能障礙藥物(PDE5抑制劑)者禁用。
Adverse: headache (use acetaminophen), orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, flushing, reflex tachycardia.
不良反應:頭痛(可用acetaminophen)、姿勢性低血壓、頭暈、臉潮紅、反射性心搏過速。

Sublingual: sit down, dissolve under tongue, do not swallow; at home 1 tablet and call EMS if pain not relieved; in hospital 1 tablet every 5 minutes up to 3 doses, check BP before each, notify provider if pain persists.
舌下含片:坐下、含於舌下溶解、不吞服;居家1錠,疼痛未緩解立即叫救護車;住院每5分鐘1錠,最多3錠,每次給藥前測血壓,仍疼痛通知醫師。
Store in dark tightly closed bottle; tablets can expire within 6 months of opening; a burning/stinging sensation suggests potency.
存放於深色緊閉瓶中;開瓶後約6個月內可能失效;刺痛或灼熱感表示藥效仍在。

Patch: hairless site, rotate daily, remove after 12-14 hours for a 10-12 hour nitrate-free period (prevents tolerance); not on chest where defibrillator pads go; wear gloves for ointment/patch. Do not crush sustained-release forms; avoid abrupt withdrawal.
貼片:無毛部位、每日輪換,12-14小時後移除,保留10-12小時無藥期(防止耐受);不貼於除顫電擊板位置的胸部;塗抹藥膏/貼片時戴手套。緩釋劑型不可磨碎;避免突然停藥。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑

Beta blockers (-olol): lower HR, BP, contractility; nonselective (propranolol, carvedilol, labetalol, nadolol) vs cardioselective (metoprolol, atenolol, bisoprolol, esmolol). Contraindicated in asthma, bradycardia, decompensated HF; caution in diabetes (mask hypoglycemia).
β阻斷劑(-olol):降低心率、血壓與收縮力;非選擇性(propranolol、carvedilol、labetalol、nadolol)與心臟選擇性(metoprolol、atenolol、bisoprolol、esmolol)。氣喘、心搏過緩、失代償心衰竭禁用;糖尿病慎用(掩蓋低血糖)。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑
Beta blocker care: hold if pulse/BP outside parameters; report wheezing, dizziness; do not stop abruptly (rebound tachycardia, angina); avoid cold/decongestant OTCs.
β阻斷劑護理:脈搏/血壓超出參數時暫停給藥;通報喘鳴、頭暈;不可突然停藥(反彈性心搏過速、心絞痛);避免感冒藥/解鼻充血劑。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑

Calcium channel blockers (amlodipine, nifedipine, diltiazem, verapamil): vasodilate and reduce contractility; adverse bradycardia, hypotension, peripheral edema, constipation, headache, flushing. Caution in HF, AV block; do not crush sustained-release.
鈣離子通道阻斷劑(amlodipine、nifedipine、diltiazem、verapamil):血管擴張並降低收縮力;不良反應:心搏過緩、低血壓、周邊水腫、便祕、頭痛、臉潮紅。心衰竭、房室傳導阻滯慎用;緩釋劑不可磨碎。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑
Peripheral vasodilators (pentoxifylline, CCBs, alpha blockers) for vasospasm like Raynaud's; response may take up to 3 months; no smoking, avoid alcohol and aspirin unless approved.
周邊血管擴張劑(pentoxifylline、鈣通道阻斷劑、α阻斷劑)用於血管痙攣如雷諾氏症;療效可能需3個月;不可吸菸,避免酒精,未經許可不用aspirin。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑
Direct arteriolar vasodilators (hydralazine, nitroprusside, diazoxide, fenoldopam): for severe hypertension/emergencies; hypotension, reflex tachycardia, edema.
直接作用小動脈血管擴張劑(hydralazine、nitroprusside、diazoxide、fenoldopam):用於嚴重高血壓/高血壓急症;低血壓、反射性心搏過速、水腫。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑

Nitroprusside: risk of cyanide/thiocyanate toxicity; protect from light with dark bag; discard if red, green or blue. Nesiritide (BNP) for decompensated HF: hypotension; monitor BP, rhythm, urine output, weight.
Nitroprusside:有氰化物/硫氰酸鹽中毒風險;以深色袋避光;若呈紅、綠、藍色須丟棄。Nesiritide(BNP)用於失代償心衰竭:低血壓;監測血壓、心律、尿量、體重。
Beta blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators
β阻斷劑、鈣離子通道阻斷劑與血管擴張劑
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑
Class I sodium channel blockers: IA (procainamide, quinidine, disopyramide), IB (lidocaine, mexiletine, phenytoin), IC (flecainide, propafenone); adverse hypotension, HF, proarrhythmia, GI upset.
第I類鈉離子通道阻斷劑:IA(procainamide、quinidine、disopyramide)、IB(lidocaine、mexiletine、phenytoin)、IC(flecainide、propafenone);不良反應:低血壓、心衰竭、致心律不整、胃腸不適。
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑

Class II beta blockers; Class III potassium channel blockers (amiodarone, dofetilide, ibutilide, sotalol) prolong QT, risk torsades de pointes; Class IV calcium channel blockers (verapamil, diltiazem). Others: adenosine, digoxin.
第II類為β阻斷劑;第III類鉀離子通道阻斷劑(amiodarone、dofetilide、ibutilide、sotalol)延長QT間期,有torsades de pointes風險;第IV類為鈣離子通道阻斷劑(verapamil、diltiazem)。其他:adenosine、digoxin。
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑
Amiodarone: pulmonary fibrosis, photosensitivity, blue-gray skin, corneal deposits, hypothyroidism, neuropathy; monitor ECG, lungs, thyroid; use sunscreen.
Amiodarone:肺纖維化、光敏感、皮膚藍灰色、角膜沉積、甲狀腺機能低下、神經病變;監測心電圖、肺部、甲狀腺;使用防曬。
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑

General care: continuous cardiac monitoring, IV via infusion pump, check lidocaine vial is not the local-anesthetic (epinephrine/preservative) form, give oral antidysrhythmics without food (mexiletine may be with food), rise slowly, limit fluid/salt, fiber for constipation.
一般護理:持續心臟監測、IV使用輸液幫浦、確認lidocaine非含epinephrine/防腐劑的局部麻醉劑型、口服抗心律不整藥不與食物併服(mexiletine可隨餐)、緩慢起身、限水限鹽、增加纖維預防便祕。
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑

Adrenergic agonists: dobutamine (beta; HF, cardiac output), dopamine (alpha/beta; BP and renal flow), epinephrine (cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, asthma), norepinephrine (vasoconstriction in shock/hypotension). Adverse dysrhythmias, tachycardia, angina; give via large vein; monitor ECG, urine output.
腎上腺素促效劑:dobutamine(β;心衰竭、增加心輸出量)、dopamine(α/β;升血壓與腎血流)、epinephrine(心跳停止、過敏性休克、氣喘)、norepinephrine(休克/低血壓時血管收縮)。不良反應:心律不整、心搏過速、心絞痛;經大靜脈給予;監測心電圖與尿量。
抗心律不整藥與腎上腺素促效劑
Bile sequestrants (cholestyramine, colestipol, colesevelam): bind bile acids; constipation, bloating; mix gritty powder in juice/water, take with plenty of fluid; may raise triglycerides.
膽酸結合劑(cholestyramine、colestipol、colesevelam):結合膽酸;便祕、腹脹;粉末需以果汁/水充分混合,並多喝水;可能升高三酸甘油酯。

Statins (atorvastatin, simvastatin, lovastatin, rosuvastatin, pravastatin): monitor liver enzymes; report unexplained muscle pain immediately (myopathy/rhabdomyolysis); annual eye exam; avoid with gemfibrozil.
Statin類(atorvastatin、simvastatin、lovastatin、rosuvastatin、pravastatin):監測肝酵素;不明原因肌肉痛須立即通報(肌病變/橫紋肌溶解);每年眼科檢查;避免與gemfibrozil併用。
Gemfibrozil competes for protein binding with anticoagulants (monitor INR, lower anticoagulant dose); with statins raises myositis/rhabdomyolysis risk.
Gemfibrozil與抗凝血劑競爭蛋白結合(監測INR、降低抗凝劑劑量);與statin併用增加肌炎/橫紋肌溶解風險。

Nicotinic acid (niacin): flushing, GI upset, elevated liver enzymes, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia; take with meals; aspirin or NSAID 30 minutes before reduces flushing; do not use OTC niacin without provider.
菸鹼酸:臉潮紅、胃腸不適、肝酵素升高、高血糖、高尿酸;隨餐服用;服藥前30分鐘服aspirin或NSAID可減輕潮紅;未經醫師同意不可自行服用成藥菸鹼酸。
Lifestyle: restrict fats, cholesterol, carbohydrates, alcohol; exercise; lipid levels take weeks to fall.
生活型態:限制脂肪、膽固醇、碳水化合物與酒精;規律運動;血脂需數週才會下降。
Bleeding is the primary concern with anticoagulants, thrombolytics, and antiplatelets.
抗凝血劑、血栓溶解劑與抗血小板藥的首要顧慮為出血。
Heparin: aPTT 1.5-2.5 x normal (normal 30-40 s, so about 60-80 s); antidote protamine sulfate; monitor platelets.
Heparin:aPTT為正常1.5-2.5倍(正常30-40秒,約60-80秒);解毒劑protamine sulfate;監測血小板。
Warfarin: INR 2-3 standard; antidote phytonadione (vitamin K); avoid aspirin/NSAIDs, alcohol; consistent vitamin K intake.
Warfarin:標準INR 2-3;解毒劑phytonadione(維生素K);避免aspirin/NSAID與酒精;維持穩定的維生素K攝取。
Enoxaparin: anti-Xa 0.5-1.2 IU/mL; do not expel air bubble; protamine reverses.
Enoxaparin:抗Xa 0.5-1.2 IU/mL;不排除針筒氣泡;可用protamine逆轉。
Thrombolytic antidote is aminocaproic acid; check for neurological change, occult blood in all excretions; stridor/urticaria/hypotension means anaphylaxis - stop infusion, call rapid response.
血栓溶解劑解毒劑為aminocaproic acid;監測神經變化與所有排泄物潛血;喘鳴/蕁麻疹/低血壓代表過敏性休克,應停止輸注並呼叫快速反應小組。

Digoxin level 0.5-2.0 ng/mL; hold if apical pulse below 60; toxicity: GI symptoms, bradycardia, yellow-green vision; hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, hypercalcemia increase risk; antidote digoxin immune Fab.
Digoxin濃度0.5-2.0 ng/mL;心尖脈<60暫停;中毒:胃腸症狀、心搏過緩、黃綠視;低鉀、低鎂、高鈣增加風險;解毒劑digoxin immune Fab。
Always assess the client (pulse, BP) before the monitor or additional tests when dizziness occurs after an IV antidysrhythmic.
靜脈抗心律不整藥後出現頭暈,應先評估個案(脈搏、血壓),再處理儀器或其他檢查。
Potassium-sparing diuretics: hyperkalemia (K above 5.0); avoid salt substitutes. Loop and thiazide diuretics: hypokalemia.
保鉀利尿劑:高血鉀(K>5.0);避免鹽代用品。袢利尿劑與thiazide:低血鉀。
Thiazides are sulfa-based: caution with sulfa allergy; cause hypokalemia, hypercalcemia, hyperglycemia, hyperuricemia.
Thiazide含磺胺結構:磺胺過敏者慎用;可致低血鉀、高血鈣、高血糖、高尿酸。
IV furosemide push slowly over 1-2 minutes to avoid ototoxicity.
IV furosemide須1-2分鐘緩慢推注,避免耳毒性。
ACE inhibitor: persistent dry cough, hyperkalemia; ARBs do not usually cause cough; never combine with K supplements or K-sparing diuretics.
ACE抑制劑:持續乾咳、高血鉀;ARB通常不引起咳嗽;不可併用鉀補充劑或保鉀利尿劑。
Do not abruptly stop clonidine, beta blockers, ACE inhibitors, CCBs: rebound hypertension/tachycardia/angina.
不可突然停用clonidine、β阻斷劑、ACE抑制劑、鈣通道阻斷劑:會造成反彈性高血壓/心搏過速/心絞痛。
Nitroglycerin: in hospital 1 SL tablet q5 min x 3 with BP check; call provider if pain persists; no PDE5 inhibitors; tablets expire; patch-free 10-12 hours daily.
Nitroglycerin:住院每5分鐘舌下1錠、共3錠並檢查血壓;疼痛持續通知醫師;不可併用PDE5抑制劑;藥片會過期;每日留10-12小時無貼片期。
Beta blockers: contraindicated in asthma (wheezing = bronchospasm), mask hypoglycemia signs, hold for low HR/BP.
β阻斷劑:氣喘禁用(喘鳴代表支氣管痙攣)、掩蓋低血糖徵象、心率/血壓偏低時暫停給藥。
Amiodarone and dofetilide prolong QT (torsades de pointes); amiodarone also pulmonary fibrosis, hypothyroidism, photosensitivity.
Amiodarone與dofetilide延長QT(torsades de pointes);amiodarone另有肺纖維化、甲狀腺機能低下、光敏感。
Sodium nitroprusside: cyanide/thiocyanate toxicity, protect from light, discard if red/green/blue.
Nitroprusside:氰化物/硫氰酸鹽中毒、需避光、呈紅綠藍色須丟棄。
Statins/lipid drugs: report unexplained muscle pain immediately; gemfibrozil + statin raises rhabdomyolysis risk; OTC niacin can harm the liver.
Statin/降血脂藥:不明原因肌肉痛立即通報;gemfibrozil併用statin增加橫紋肌溶解風險;成藥菸鹼酸可能傷肝。
Antidotes: Heparin = Protamine sulfate; Warfarin = phytonadione (vitamin K); Thrombolytics = aminocaproic acid; Digoxin = digoxin immune Fab.
解毒劑:Heparin=Protamine;Warfarin=phytonadione(維生素K);血栓溶解劑=aminocaproic acid;Digoxin=digoxin immune Fab。
Digoxin toxicity order: GI first (anorexia, N/V, diarrhea), then heart rate and vision changes; think low K, low Mg, high Ca.
Digoxin中毒順序:先胃腸症狀(厭食、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉),再出現心率與視覺變化;記住低鉀、低鎂、高鈣。

-pril = cough (ACE inhibitors); -sartan = no cough (ARBs); -olol = beta blocker (slow heart); -dipine = dihydropyridine CCB causing edema; verapamil (a non-dihydropyridine CCB, so it is not a '-dipine') is more linked to constipation.
-pril=咳嗽(ACE抑制劑);-sartan=不咳(ARB);-olol=β阻斷劑(心跳變慢);-dipine=雙氫吡啶類鈣通道阻斷劑,易致水腫;verapamil(屬非雙氫吡啶類鈣通道阻斷劑,藥名並非以-dipine結尾)則較易引起便祕。
Loops lose K, Ca, Mg; thiazides lose K but keep Ca (hypercalcemia); spironolactone spares K (hyperkalemia).
袢利尿劑流失鉀、鈣、鎂;thiazide流失鉀但留鈣(高血鈣);spironolactone保鉀(高血鉀)。
A client with atrial fibrillation is on a continuous heparin infusion; the laboratory control aPTT is 35 seconds. Which result shows a therapeutic effect?
心房顫動個案持續滴注heparin,實驗室對照aPTT為35秒。哪個結果代表達到治療效果?
A client taking warfarin has an INR of 5.2 and gum bleeding. Which medication does the nurse anticipate?
服用warfarin的個案INR為5.2且牙齦出血。護理師預期給予何種藥物?
A client taking digoxin and furosemide has K+ 3.0 mEq/L, anorexia and nausea. Which digoxin level would be outside the therapeutic range?
服用digoxin與furosemide的個案鉀3.0 mEq/L,有厭食與噁心。哪個digoxin濃度超出治療範圍?
Which findings indicate digoxin toxicity? Select all that apply.
下列哪些是digoxin中毒的徵象?(多選)
Before giving digoxin, the nurse finds apical pulse 54/min. What is the priority action?
給予digoxin前,護理師測得心尖脈54次/分。首要處置為何?
A client receiving alteplase for STEMI develops stridor, urticaria and hypotension. Select all appropriate actions.
接受alteplase治療STEMI的個案出現喘鳴、蕁麻疹與低血壓。請選出所有適當處置。(多選)
A client with hospital chest pain has taken one sublingual nitroglycerin tablet, pain persists, BP 118/72. What should the nurse do next?
住院個案胸痛,已含服一錠nitroglycerin,疼痛未緩解,血壓118/72。護理師下一步應如何?
A client taking spironolactone and lisinopril has K+ 5.9 mEq/L. Which teaching is appropriate? Select all that apply.
服用spironolactone與lisinopril的個案鉀5.9 mEq/L。下列哪些衛教適當?(多選)
A client taking propranolol develops expiratory wheezes. What does the nurse suspect?
服用propranolol的個案出現呼氣喘鳴。護理師懷疑為何?
Heparin monitoring details: aPTT targets and subcutaneous injection technique.
Heparin監測:aPTT目標與皮下注射技巧。
Warfarin PT/INR targets, enoxaparin anti-Xa range, Box 54.1 listing oral and parenteral anticoagulants, and Box 54.2 substances to avoid with anticoagulants.
Warfarin的PT/INR目標、enoxaparin抗Xa範圍、Box 54.1列出的口服與注射抗凝血劑,以及Box 54.2抗凝血劑應避免的物質。
Fig. 54.1: vicious cycle of maladaptive compensatory responses in a failing heart (why inotropes, ACE inhibitors, diuretics help); Box 54.5 inotropes.
圖54.1:衰竭心臟代償反應的惡性循環(說明強心劑、ACE抑制劑、利尿劑的作用);Box 54.5強心劑。
Clinical Judgment box: stepwise nitroglycerin response to chest pain; Box 54.14 beta blockers by selectivity.
臨床判斷方塊:胸痛時nitroglycerin的逐步處置;Box 54.14依選擇性分類的β阻斷劑。
Antidysrhythmic classes I-II listed with adverse effects (class III begins on the next page); Box 54.17 direct arteriolar vasodilators.
第I-II類抗心律不整藥及其不良反應(第III類始於次頁);Box 54.17直接作用小動脈血管擴張劑。
Nephron (glomerulus + tubules) is the functional unit; the glomerulus filters, the PCT reabsorbs most water/electrolytes, the loop of Henle concentrates urine, the DCT fine-tunes sodium/water.
腎元(腎絲球+腎小管)為功能單位；腎絲球過濾，近曲小管再吸收大部分水與電解質，亨利氏環濃縮尿液，遠曲小管調節鈉與水。
Kidney functions: acid-base balance, waste excretion, fluid/electrolyte control, drug excretion, renin (BP), erythropoietin (RBC), activation of vitamin D.
腎臟功能：酸鹼平衡、排除廢物、體液電解質調控、藥物排泄、分泌腎素(血壓)與紅血球生成素(RBC)、活化維生素D。
ADH from the posterior pituitary makes the distal tubule/collecting duct permeable to water; lack of ADH causes diabetes insipidus.
ADH由腦下垂體後葉釋放，使遠端小管與集尿管對水通透；缺乏ADH則造成尿崩症。
Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone: low BP/flow releases renin, then angiotensin II (vasoconstriction) and aldosterone (retain Na+/water, excrete K+).
腎素-血管張力素-醛固酮系統：低血壓或低流量釋放腎素，生成血管張力素II(血管收縮)與醛固酮(保鈉保水、排鉀)。
Kidneys control bicarbonate and lungs control carbonic acid; normal pH 7.35-7.45 with a 20:1 bicarbonate:carbonic acid ratio.
腎臟調控碳酸氫根，肺調控碳酸；正常pH 7.35-7.45，碳酸氫根與碳酸比為20:1。
Bladder capacity about 1 L; normal adult urine output about 1500 mL/day. The prostate surrounds the urethra.
膀胱容量約1公升；成人正常尿量約1500 mL/天。攝護腺環繞尿道。
Serum creatinine 0.6-1.2 mg/dL (M), 0.5-1.1 (F) reflects GFR; it rises only after about 50% of function is lost. BUN 10-20 mg/dL can rise with dehydration, high protein, GI bleeding, steroids.
血清肌酸酐0.6-1.2 mg/dL(男)、0.5-1.1(女)反映GFR，約喪失50%功能後才上升。BUN 10-20 mg/dL，脫水、高蛋白、消化道出血、類固醇亦可升高。
BUN/creatinine ratio: decreased with fluid volume deficit, obstructive uropathy, catabolic state and high-protein diet; increased with fluid volume excess (per book).
BUN/肌酸酐比值：體液不足、阻塞性泌尿道疾病、分解代謝狀態及高蛋白飲食時下降；體液過多時上升（依本書）。
Urinalysis: specific gravity 1.003-1.030, pH 4-8; glucose, ketones, protein, blood, casts normally negative. Use first morning void, 10-15 mL.
尿液分析：比重1.003-1.030、pH 4-8；糖、酮體、蛋白、血、圓柱體正常為陰性。留取晨間第一次尿10-15 mL。
24-hour urine: discard the first void at start, collect all urine for 24 h, include the final void, keep on ice/refrigerated.
24小時尿液：起始時排尿並丟棄，之後收集全部尿液，結束時最後一次排尿也加入，檢體需冰存。
Creatinine clearance best estimates GFR (about 125 mL/min young adult; falls about 10% per decade). Urine culture: clean-catch midstream sample.
肌酸酐清除率最能估算GFR(年輕成人約125 mL/分，每十年約降10%)。尿液培養：中段尿清潔收集。
IV urography/contrast: check iodine/shellfish allergy and pregnancy, encourage fluids, watch urine output because dye is nephrotoxic.
靜脈腎盂攝影/顯影劑：確認碘/海鮮過敏與懷孕，鼓勵飲水並監測尿量，顯影劑具腎毒性。

Cystoscopy with biopsy: expect pink-tinged urine and burning; report bright red urine, clots, fever. Renal biopsy: prone positioning, check coagulation, bed rest supine 2-6 h, watch for hypotension/tachycardia, hematuria.
膀胱鏡切片：術後可有粉紅尿與灼熱感；出現鮮紅尿、血塊、發燒需通報。腎臟切片：俯臥、檢查凝血、術後仰臥臥床2-6小時，監測低血壓/心搏過速與血尿。
AKI is abrupt, potentially reversible loss of kidney function. Causes: prerenal (hypoperfusion), intrarenal (ATN, nephrotoxins), postrenal (obstruction).
AKI為突發且可能可逆的腎功能喪失。病因：腎前性(灌流不足)、腎內性(急性腎小管壞死、腎毒物)、腎後性(阻塞)。
Phases: onset, oliguric (<400 mL/day, 8-15 days), diuretic (4-5 L/day), recovery (may take 1-2 years).
分期：起始期、少尿期(<400 mL/天，8-15天)、利尿期(4-5 L/天)、恢復期(可達1-2年)。
Oliguric phase: fluid overload, hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia, hypocalcemia, metabolic acidosis (Kussmaul), uremia, pericarditis; restrict fluids to measured output plus about 400-1000 mL.
少尿期：體液過多、高血鉀、高血磷、低血鈣、代謝性酸中毒(庫斯毛氏呼吸)、尿毒症、心包炎；液體限制為前日尿量加約400-1000 mL。
Diuretic phase: risk of hypovolemia, hypotension, hypokalemia, hyponatremia; replace fluids/electrolytes.
利尿期：易低血容量、低血壓、低血鉀、低血鈉；需補充液體與電解質。
Monitor hourly I&O, daily weight (gain 0.25-0.5 kg/day = retention), labs, lung sounds; low-moderate protein, high carbohydrate diet; avoid nephrotoxins (aminoglycosides, NSAIDs, contrast).
監測每小時輸出入量、每日體重(增加0.25-0.5公斤/天代表水分滯留)、檢驗值、肺音；低至中蛋白高醣飲食；避免腎毒性藥物(胺基糖苷類、NSAIDs、顯影劑)。
Dialysis or CRRT may be needed for fluid overload, azotemia, or severe acidosis.
體液過量、氮血症或嚴重酸中毒時可能需透析或連續性腎臟替代療法(CRRT)。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
CKD: progressive irreversible loss, GFR <=60 mL/min for 3 months or more. Stages: >90 at risk, 60-89 mild, 30-59 moderate, 15-29 severe, <15 ESRD.
CKD：漸進不可逆，GFR≦60 mL/分且持續3個月以上。分期：>90高風險、60-89輕度、30-59中度、15-29重度、<15末期(ESRD)。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Main causes: diabetes, hypertension, chronic obstruction, recurrent infection, autoimmune disease, following AKI.
主要原因：糖尿病、高血壓、慢性阻塞、反覆感染、自體免疫疾病、AKI後續。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Anemia (low erythropoietin): give epoetin/darbepoetin, folic acid, iron; transfuse only when necessary.
貧血(紅血球生成素不足)：給予epoetin/darbepoetin、葉酸、鐵劑；僅在必要時輸血。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Hyperkalemia: telemetry; low-K diet; sodium polystyrene sulfonate; IV calcium gluconate (protect heart), regular insulin + 50% dextrose, sodium bicarbonate; avoid spironolactone/triamterene.
高血鉀：連續心電圖監測；低鉀飲食；聚苯乙烯磺酸鈉；靜脈葡萄糖酸鈣(保護心肌)、常規胰島素+50%葡萄糖、碳酸氫鈉；避免spironolactone/triamterene。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Hyperphosphatemia/hypocalcemia: phosphate binders with meals, activated vitamin D, calcium; hypermagnesemia: avoid Mg antacids/laxatives.
高血磷/低血鈣：隨餐服用磷結合劑、活化維生素D、鈣；高血鎂：避免含鎂制酸劑與瀉劑。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Other problems: hypertension, hypervolemia (restrict Na/fluid), GI bleeding, pruritus (uremic frost late), neuropathy, bone disease/fractures, infection risk, psychosocial stress.
其他問題：高血壓、體液過多(限鈉限水)、消化道出血、搔癢(尿霜為晚期)、神經病變、骨病與骨折、感染風險、心理社會壓力。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Uremic syndrome: nitrogenous waste buildup; limit protein (high quality), sodium, potassium, phosphate; monitor for altered LOC, stomatitis, N/V.
尿毒症候群：含氮廢物蓄積；限制蛋白質(高品質)、鈉、鉀、磷；監測意識改變、口腔炎、噁心嘔吐。
Chronic kidney disease and uremic syndrome
慢性腎臟病與尿毒症候群
Hemodialysis uses diffusion, osmosis and ultrafiltration across a semipermeable membrane; removes urea, creatinine, excess fluid and corrects electrolytes.
血液透析利用擴散、滲透與超過濾，透過半透膜清除尿素、肌酸酐、多餘水分並矯正電解質。

Before dialysis: weigh, check vitals/labs; hold antihypertensives and dialyzable drugs (water-soluble vitamins, some antibiotics, digoxin) until after treatment. After: watch for hypotension, bleeding (heparin), hypovolemia.
透析前：量體重、生命徵象與檢驗值；降血壓藥及可被透析的藥物(水溶性維生素、部分抗生素、digoxin)延至透析後給予。透析後：留意低血壓、出血(肝素)與低血容量。
AV fistula is the access of choice (matures 4-6 weeks); AV graft usable after about 2 weeks; temporary subclavian/femoral catheters; external shunt usable immediately.
動靜脈瘻管為首選通路(成熟需4-6週)；人工血管約2週後可用；暫時性鎖骨下/股靜脈導管；外部分流管可立即使用。
Access arm: no BP, venipuncture, IV or injections; check thrill and bruit; teach hand exercises (fistula).
通路手臂：不量血壓、不抽血、不打點滴或注射；檢查震顫與血管雜音；教導手部運動(瘻管)。

Femoral catheter: client should not sit up more than 45 degrees. Arterial steal syndrome: hand ischemia distal to the access, with pain, pallor and a diminished pulse (coolness of the tubing/extremity instead points to access clotting, not steal syndrome).
股靜脈導管：病人坐起不超過45度。動脈竊血症候群：通路遠端手部缺血，表現為疼痛、蒼白與脈搏減弱(管路或肢體發冷則多提示通路栓塞，而非竊血症候群)。
Complications: air embolus, disequilibrium syndrome, hypotension, hemorrhage, sepsis, hepatitis, electrolyte shifts.
併發症：空氣栓塞、失衡症候群、低血壓、出血、敗血症、肝炎、電解質變化。
The peritoneum is the membrane; Tenckhoff catheter placed 3-5 cm below the umbilicus; one exchange = fill (10-20 min, 1-2 L), dwell, drain.
以腹膜為透析膜；Tenckhoff導管置於臍下3-5 cm；一次交換=灌入(10-20分鐘、1-2 L)、留置、引流。
Contraindications: peritonitis, recent abdominal surgery, adhesions, other GI problems such as diverticulosis.
禁忌：腹膜炎、近期腹部手術、腹腔沾黏、憩室症等腸胃問題。
Higher dextrose concentration pulls more fluid; do not extend dwell beyond order (hyperglycemia). Warm the dialysate to reduce cramping.
葡萄糖濃度越高脫水越多；留置時間不可超過醫囑(高血糖風險)。將透析液加溫以減少腹部絞痛。

Outflow less than inflow: retained fluid counts as intake. Cloudy outflow = peritonitis; bloody (after first exchanges) = vascular complication; brown = bowel perforation; urine-colored = bladder perforation.
引流量少於灌入量：滯留量算為攝入。混濁=腹膜炎；(初期後)血性=血管併發症；棕色=腸穿孔；尿色=膀胱穿孔。
Poor outflow: usually constipation, then catheter migration, kinks, fibrin; reposition, check tubing, keep bag below abdomen.
引流不良：最常因便秘，其次導管移位、管路扭折、纖維蛋白塊；調整姿勢、檢查管路、引流袋置於腹部下方。
Types: CAPD (manual, 4 exchanges/day), automated (CCPD, IPD, NPD) with a cycler. Peritonitis prevention: strict sterile technique, keep dressing dry.
種類：連續性可攜式(CAPD，手動、每日4次)、自動化(CCPD、IPD、NPD)使用循環機。預防腹膜炎：嚴守無菌技術、敷料保持乾燥。
Living related donor is the most desirable; recipient takes immunosuppressants for life. Dialysis completed within 24 h before surgery; strict asepsis.
活體親屬捐贈最理想；受贈者需終生服用免疫抑制劑。手術前24小時內完成透析；嚴格無菌。
Kidney placed in the iliac fossa; own kidneys usually left in place. Monitor hourly urine output; abrupt drop must be reported; IV replacement based on urine output for 12-24 h.
新腎置於髂窩；原腎通常保留。每小時監測尿量，突然減少須通報；前12-24小時依尿量補充輸液。
Urinary catheter 3-5 days; initial urine may be pink/bloody; report gross hematuria with clots.
導尿管留置3-5天；初期尿可呈粉紅或血尿；肉眼血尿合併血塊須通報。
Rejection signs: fever >100 F (37.8 C), pain/tenderness over graft, weight gain 2-3 lb (0.9-1.4 kg) in 24 h, edema, hypertension, rising BUN/creatinine.
排斥徵象：體溫>100°F(37.8°C)、移植腎處疼痛壓痛、24小時增重2-3磅(0.9-1.4公斤)、水腫、高血壓、BUN/肌酸酐上升。
Hyperacute rejection within 48 h (remove kidney); acute within first week or later (increase immunosuppression); chronic over months-years.
超急性排斥於48小時內(切除移植腎)；急性排斥多於一週內或其後(加強免疫抑制)；慢性排斥於數月至數年。
Teach: never miss immunosuppressants, avoid infection exposure and contact sports, avoid prolonged sitting.
衛教：不可漏服免疫抑制劑、避免接觸感染源與接觸性運動、避免久坐。
Cystitis: E. coli most common; frequency, urgency, dysuria, cloudy foul urine, hematuria. In older adults altered mentation may be the only sign.
膀胱炎：最常見為大腸桿菌；頻尿、急尿、解尿灼痛、混濁惡臭尿、血尿。老年人可能僅表現意識混亂。
Collect culture before antibiotics; fluids up to 3000 mL/day; complete full antibiotic course; keep urine acidic; avoid caffeine/alcohol.
使用抗生素前先送尿培養；每日飲水可達3000 mL；完成整個療程；維持酸性尿；避免咖啡因與酒精。
Prevention: wipe front to back, void every 2-3 h, void after intercourse, avoid bubble baths, cotton underwear.
預防：由前往後擦拭、每2-3小時排尿、性行為後排尿、避免泡泡浴、穿棉質內褲。
Urethritis: commonly STI (gonorrhea, chlamydia); treat partners, abstinence until treated; chlamydia can cause sterility.
尿道炎：常與性傳染病(淋病、披衣菌)相關；伴侶需治療，治療完成前禁止性行為；披衣菌可致不孕。
Acute pyelonephritis: fever, chills, flank pain, CVA tenderness, pyuria; fluids to 3000 mL/day, antibiotics, warm compresses. Chronic: scarring, can lead to CKD.
急性腎盂腎炎：發燒寒顫、腰痛、肋脊角叩痛、膿尿；每日飲水達3000 mL、抗生素、溫敷。慢性者造成腎臟疤痕，可進展為CKD。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Adult polycystic kidney disease: autosomal dominant, symptoms at 30-40 y; flank pain, hematuria, hypertension, recurrent UTI; avoid NSAIDs/aspirin; genetic counseling.
成人多囊腎：體染色體顯性，30-40歲發病；腰痛、血尿、高血壓、反覆泌尿道感染；避免NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈；遺傳諮詢。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Hydronephrosis: obstruction with distended renal pelvis; after relief watch for diuresis and dehydration.
水腎：阻塞造成腎盂擴張；阻塞解除後留意利尿與脫水。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Renal calculi: severe colicky flank pain radiating to groin, hematuria, N/V; strain all urine, send stones for analysis, fluids up to 3000 mL/day, scheduled analgesics, ambulation.
腎結石：劇烈絞痛由腰部放射至鼠蹊、血尿、噁心嘔吐；過濾所有尿液並送結石分析、每日飲水至3000 mL、定時給予止痛、鼓勵走動。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Diet by stone type: limit purines, calcium or oxalate as indicated.
依結石種類調整飲食：限制普林、鈣或草酸。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Treatment: ESWL (watch for obstruction, bleeding, hematoma), percutaneous lithotripsy, ureterolithotomy, nephrectomy. Do not irrigate nephrostomy tube unless prescribed.
治療：體外震波碎石(留意阻塞、出血、血腫)、經皮碎石、輸尿管切開取石、腎切除。除非醫囑否則不沖洗腎造口管。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Renal tumor: painless gross hematuria, flank pain, mass; radical nephrectomy care: monitor bleeding, adrenal insufficiency, urine 30-50 mL/h.
腎腫瘤：無痛性肉眼血尿、腰痛、腫塊；根治性腎切除術後：監測出血、腎上腺功能不足、尿量30-50 mL/小時。
多囊腎、水腎、結石與腫瘤
Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma
副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷
Epididymitis: scrotal pain/swelling, fever; bed rest with scrotal elevation, cold compresses, antibiotics (partner if STI).
副睪炎：陰囊疼痛腫脹、發燒；臥床並抬高陰囊、冷敷、抗生素(性傳染病時伴侶亦需治療)。
Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma
副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷
Bacterial prostatitis: acutely ill, fever, perineal/low back pain, tender warm prostate; antibiotics, sitz baths, stool softeners; avoid spicy food, caffeine, alcohol.
細菌性攝護腺炎：急性病容、發燒、會陰與下背痛、攝護腺壓痛發熱；抗生素、坐浴、軟便劑；避免辛辣、咖啡因、酒精。
Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma
副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷
BPH: weak stream (early), hesitancy, nocturia, retention, overflow dribbling; avoid anticholinergics, antihistamines, decongestants; fluids 2000-3000 mL/day.
BPH：尿流細弱(早期)、遲疑、夜尿、尿滯留、溢流性滴尿；避免抗膽鹼藥、抗組織胺、解充血劑；每日飲水2000-3000 mL。
Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma
副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷
Bladder trauma (often pelvic fracture): hematuria, suprapubic pain, anuria; if blood at meatus, do NOT catheterize until retrograde urethrogram/ureterogram.
膀胱外傷(常因骨盆骨折)：血尿、恥骨上疼痛、無尿；若尿道口有血，在逆行尿道/輸尿管攝影前勿導尿。
Epididymitis, prostatitis, BPH and bladder trauma
副睪炎、攝護腺炎、BPH與膀胱外傷
Serum creatinine rises only after about 50% of kidney function is lost; creatinine clearance is the best GFR estimate (normal ~125 mL/min, ~65 at age 65).
血清肌酸酐需喪失約50%腎功能才上升；肌酸酐清除率最能估算GFR(正常約125 mL/分，65歲約65)。
AKI oliguric phase: urine <400 mL/day, hyperkalemia, fluid overload, acidosis; diuretic phase: urine 4-5 L/day, risk of dehydration and hypokalemia.
AKI少尿期：尿量<400 mL/天、高血鉀、體液過多、酸中毒；利尿期：尿量4-5 L/天，注意脫水與低血鉀。
Hyperkalemia in kidney disease: place on telemetry; calcium gluconate protects the heart, insulin + dextrose shifts K+ into cells, sodium polystyrene sulfonate and dialysis remove it.
腎病高血鉀：給予心電圖監測；葡萄糖酸鈣保護心臟、胰島素+葡萄糖使鉀進入細胞、聚苯乙烯磺酸鈉與透析排除鉀。
Daily weight gain of 0.5-1 lb/day (0.25-0.5 kg) indicates fluid retention; weigh same scale, same clothes, same time.
每日增重0.5-1磅(0.25-0.5公斤)代表水分滯留；固定體重計、衣著與時間。
Contrast dye and aminoglycosides/NSAIDs are nephrotoxic; hydrate and monitor urine output and creatinine.
顯影劑、胺基糖苷類與NSAIDs具腎毒性；需補充水分並監測尿量與肌酸酐。
Never take BP, draw blood, start IVs or give injections in the arm with a fistula/graft; check for thrill and bruit; absent thrill/bruit = notify PHCP immediately.
有瘻管/人工血管的手臂不可量血壓、抽血、打點滴或注射；檢查震顫與雜音；無震顫/雜音需立即通報。
Air embolism during hemodialysis: stop dialysis (do not reinfuse), turn client left side with head down, give oxygen, call PHCP/rapid response.
血液透析中空氣栓塞：停止透析(不回輸血液)、左側臥頭低足高、給氧、通知醫師與快速反應小組。
Hold antihypertensives and dialyzable drugs (digoxin, water-soluble vitamins, some antibiotics) until after hemodialysis.
降血壓藥與可被透析的藥物(digoxin、水溶性維生素、部分抗生素)延至血液透析後給予。
Peritoneal dialysis outflow: cloudy = peritonitis (early sign); brown = bowel perforation; urine-colored = bladder perforation; constipation is the main cause of poor outflow.
腹膜透析引流液：混濁=腹膜炎(早期徵象)；棕色=腸穿孔；尿色=膀胱穿孔；便秘是引流不良主因。
Kidney transplant: report abrupt fall in urine output, fever, graft tenderness, 2-3 lb gain in 24 h (rejection); immunosuppressants for life.
腎移植：尿量突然減少、發燒、移植腎壓痛、24小時增重2-3磅(排斥)須通報；終生服用免疫抑制劑。
Strain all urine in renal calculi; fluids up to 3000 mL/day; severe sudden flank pain radiating to groin = renal colic.
腎結石須過濾所有尿液；每日飲水至3000 mL；突發劇烈腰痛放射至鼠蹊為腎絞痛。
Altered mental status may be the only sign of UTI in older adults; obtain culture before antibiotics.
老年人泌尿道感染可能僅表現意識改變；使用抗生素前先採尿培養。
Blood at the urethral meatus after trauma: do not insert a urinary catheter until urethral injury is ruled out.
外傷後尿道口見血：排除尿道損傷前不可導尿。
After renal biopsy: supine bed rest 2-6 h, watch for hypotension, tachycardia, falling Hgb/Hct, hematuria; avoid heavy lifting 1-2 weeks.
腎臟切片後：仰臥臥床2-6小時，監測低血壓、心搏過速、Hgb/Hct下降與血尿；1-2週避免提重物。
Avoid anticholinergics, antihistamines and decongestants in BPH because they cause urinary retention.
BPH避免使用抗膽鹼藥、抗組織胺與解充血劑，因可造成尿滯留。
Kidney stones: Strain urine, push Fluids, scheduled Analgesics, Ambulate.
腎結石口訣：過濾尿液、補充水分、定時止痛、鼓勵走動。
AKI phases: O-O-D-R = Onset, Oliguric (K+ high), Diuretic (K+ low, dehydration), Recovery.
AKI分期口訣O-O-D-R：起始、少尿(鉀高)、利尿(鉀低、脫水)、恢復。

Action: inhibit bacterial growth in urine only; no useful blood or tissue levels, so not for infections outside the urinary tract.
作用：僅在尿液中抑制細菌生長；血液與組織濃度不足，不適用泌尿道以外感染。
Fosfomycin (福斯黴素): granules dissolved in about 120 mL cold water, drink all; drugs that speed GI motility lower absorption.
Fosfomycin(福斯黴素)：顆粒溶於約120 mL冷水並全部喝完；促腸蠕動藥物會降低吸收。

Methenamine (烏洛托品): for chronic UTI prophylaxis; needs acidic urine (pH 5.5 or lower); avoid alkalinizing antacids and sulfonamides (crystalluria); avoid in renal impairment and liver dysfunction (ammonia); high fluid intake dilutes effect.
Methenamine(烏洛托品)：用於慢性泌尿道感染預防；需酸性尿(pH≦5.5)；避免鹼化制酸劑與磺胺類(結晶尿)；腎功能不全與肝功能異常者禁用(產生氨)；大量飲水會稀釋療效。

Nitrofurantoin (呋喃妥因): take with food/milk; may turn urine harmless brown; adverse effects include pulmonary reaction (dyspnea, cough, fever, chills; stop drug), peripheral neuropathy, blood dyscrasias (agranulocytosis, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, megaloblastic anemia), hypersensitivity; contraindicated in renal impairment; avoid antacids.
Nitrofurantoin(呋喃妥因)：隨餐或牛奶服用；尿液可變棕色(無害)；不良反應包括肺部反應(呼吸困難、咳嗽、發燒、寒顫，需停藥)、週邊神經病變、血球異常(顆粒球低下、白血球低下、血小板低下、巨母紅血球性貧血)、過敏；腎功能不全禁用；避免制酸劑。
Action: inhibit bacterial DNA synthesis enzymes; broad spectrum. Examples: ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin, ofloxacin.
作用：抑制細菌DNA合成酵素；廣效。例如ciprofloxacin、levofloxacin、ofloxacin。

Adverse effects: tendinitis/tendon rupture (Achilles; higher risk age >60, corticosteroids, transplant), CNS effects (dizziness, confusion, hallucinations, depression), photosensitivity, GI upset, crystalluria.

Use cautiously in hepatic, renal or CNS disorders.
肝、腎或中樞神經疾病者小心使用。
Action: block folic acid synthesis; TMP-SMX blocks two sequential steps so is more effective than either alone. Used mainly for acute UTI.

Adverse effects: rash (withhold and report), Stevens-Johnson syndrome, photosensitivity, hemolytic anemia, agranulocytosis, thrombocytopenia (report sore throat or fever).
不良反應：皮疹(需停藥並通報)、史蒂文斯-強生症候群、光敏感、溶血性貧血、顆粒球低下、血小板低下(出現喉嚨痛或發燒需通報)。
Contraindicated with sulfa/sulfonylurea/thiazide/loop diuretic hypersensitivity, infants <2 months, pregnancy and lactation.
對磺胺、磺醯脲、噻嗪或袢利尿劑過敏、2個月以下嬰兒、孕婦及哺乳者禁用。
Potentiates warfarin, phenytoin and oral hypoglycemics. Teach: empty stomach, 8-10 glasses of water, urine output at least 1200 mL/day, finish course, sunscreen.
增強warfarin、phenytoin及口服降血糖藥效果。衛教：空腹服用、每日飲水8-10杯、尿量至少1200 mL、完成療程、防曬。

Phenazopyridine (苯偶氮吡啶): relieves urinary pain only, given with an antibiotic; turns urine, tears and contact lenses red-orange; contraindicated in renal/hepatic disease; interferes with urine glucose/ketone tests.
Phenazopyridine(苯偶氮吡啶)：僅緩解泌尿道疼痛，需併用抗生素；使尿液、淚液及隱形眼鏡呈紅橙色；腎或肝疾病禁用；干擾尿糖與尿酮檢驗。

膀胱過動症抗膽鹼藥(oxybutynin、tolterodine、solifenacin、darifenacin、trospium、fesoterodine)：口乾、便秘、視力模糊、尿滯留、心搏過速、老年人混亂。

Contraindicated in glaucoma (angle-closure; book also warns open-angle), GI/GU obstruction, severe colitis, myasthenia gravis. Do not crush extended-release forms; sugarless gum/candy for dry mouth.
青光眼、胃腸/泌尿道阻塞、嚴重結腸炎、重症肌無力者禁用(本書亦提醒開角型青光眼)。長效劑型不可磨碎或咀嚼；口乾可用無糖口香糖/糖果。

Bethanechol (貝胆鹼): cholinergic that increases bladder tone for nonobstructive retention/neurogenic bladder; give on empty stomach; never IM or IV.
Bethanechol(貝胆鹼)：膽鹼劑，增加膀胱張力，用於非阻塞性尿滯留/神經性膀胱；空腹服用；不可肌肉或靜脈注射。

Bethanechol adverse effects: hypotension, bradycardia, bronchoconstriction, flushing, salivation, cramps. Antidote for cholinergic overdose: atropine sulfate. Contraindicated with urinary obstruction/stricture.
Bethanechol不良反應：低血壓、心搏過緩、支氣管收縮、潮紅、流涎、腹絞痛。膽鹼過量解毒劑：atropine sulfate。尿道阻塞/狹窄者禁用。

Cyclosporine (環孢素): calcineurin inhibitor blocking IL-2 production; nephrotoxicity, hypertension, tremor, hirsutism, gingival changes, infection, lymphoma, hyperkalemia, hyperglycemia. Monitor blood levels, BUN, creatinine, K+, glucose, LFTs.
Cyclosporine(環孢素)：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑，阻斷IL-2；腎毒性、高血壓、顫抖、多毛、感染、淋巴瘤、高血鉀、高血糖。監測血中濃度、BUN、肌酸酐、鉀、血糖、肝功能。
Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors
免疫抑制劑：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑與mTOR抑制劑

Cyclosporine interactions: grapefruit juice, ketoconazole, erythromycin, amphotericin B raise levels; phenytoin, phenobarbital, rifampin, TMP-SMX lower levels. Mix liquid with milk/chocolate milk/orange juice in a glass container, not plastic.
Cyclosporine交互作用：葡萄柚汁、ketoconazole、erythromycin、amphotericin B使濃度升高；phenytoin、phenobarbital、rifampin、TMP-SMX使濃度降低。液劑以牛奶/巧克力牛奶/柳橙汁混合並使用玻璃容器。
Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors
免疫抑制劑：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑與mTOR抑制劑
Contraindicated in pregnancy (embryotoxic), live vaccines, active infection such as varicella/zoster.
懷孕(胚胎毒性)、活病毒疫苗、活動性感染(如水痘/帶狀疱疹)時禁用。
Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors
免疫抑制劑：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑與mTOR抑制劑
Tacrolimus (他克莫司): more potent but more toxic than cyclosporine; nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, hyperglycemia (monitor glucose), hyperkalemia, infection.
Tacrolimus(他克莫司)：比cyclosporine強效但毒性較高；腎毒性、神經毒性、高血糖(需監測血糖)、高血鉀、感染。
Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors
免疫抑制劑：鈣調神經磷酸酶抑制劑與mTOR抑制劑

Sirolimus (西羅莫司) and everolimus (依維莫司): mTOR inhibitors; infection, renal injury, raised cholesterol/triglycerides, lymphocele, rash, acne, anemia, thrombocytopenia, hypokalemia, edema; no grapefruit juice; avoid crowds and live vaccines.
Sirolimus與everolimus：mTOR抑制劑；感染、腎損傷、膽固醇/三酸甘油酯升高、淋巴囊腫、皮疹、粉刺、貧血、血小板低下、低血鉀、水腫；勿喝葡萄柚汁；避免人群與活疫苗。
Immunosuppressants: calcineurin inhibitors and mTOR inhibitors

免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
Prednisone: glucocorticoid; hyperglycemia and hypokalemia (monitor glucose and K+).
Prednisone：糖皮質素；高血糖與低血鉀(監測血糖與鉀)。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
Azathioprine (硫唑嘌呤): bone marrow suppression (neutropenia, thrombocytopenia), neoplasm risk, contraindicated in pregnancy; monitor CBC, platelets, liver enzymes.
Azathioprine(硫唑嘌呤)：骨髓抑制(嗜中性白血球及血小板低下)、腫瘤風險、懷孕禁用；監測全血球、血小板、肝酵素。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體

Mycophenolate mofetil (黴酚酸酯): diarrhea, vomiting, severe neutropenia, sepsis, malignancy; absorption reduced by Mg/Al antacids and cholestyramine; empty stomach, do not open/crush capsules; contraindicated in pregnancy/lactation.
Mycophenolate mofetil(黴酚酸酯)：腹瀉、嘔吐、嚴重嗜中性白血球低下、敗血症、惡性腫瘤；鎂/鋁制酸劑與cholestyramine降低吸收；空腹服用、膠囊不可打開或磨碎；懷孕與哺乳禁用。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
Basiliximab (巴利昔單抗): IL-2 receptor antibody for induction, IV within 2 h before transplant; headache, tremor, GI distress, edema, slow wound healing.
Basiliximab(巴利昔單抗)：IL-2受體抗體，用於誘導，移植前2小時內靜脈給予；頭痛、顫抖、腸胃不適、水腫、傷口癒合慢。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
Antithymocyte globulin, equine: treats acute rejection; intradermal skin test before first dose; monitor platelets; risk of infectious agent transmission.
馬抗胸腺細胞球蛋白：用於治療急性排斥；首次使用前做皮內試驗；監測血小板；有傳播感染原風險。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
All immunosuppressants: take at the same time daily, never skip, report fever, sore throat, bleeding/bruising, mouth sores promptly.
所有免疫抑制劑：每天固定時間服用、不可漏服，出現發燒、喉嚨痛、出血/瘀青、口腔潰瘍須立即通報。
免疫抑制劑：類固醇、抗代謝藥與抗體
Erythropoietic agents (epoetin alfa 阿法依泊汀, darbepoetin alfa): treat anemia of CKD; effect in 1-2 weeks, Hct normal in 2-3 months.
紅血球生成素類(epoetin alfa、darbepoetin alfa)：治療CKD貧血；1-2週見效，2-3個月血比容恢復正常。
Major adverse effect hypertension; also thrombosis, stroke, MI, heart failure. Monitor BP, Hgb/Hct, iron stores.
主要不良反應為高血壓；另有血栓、中風、心肌梗塞、心衰竭。監測血壓、Hgb/Hct與鐵儲存。
Leukopoietic agents (filgrastim 非格司亭, pegfilgrastim, sargramostim): raise WBC in chemotherapy neutropenia; bone pain, leukocytosis, raised uric acid, splenomegaly.
白血球生成素類(filgrastim、pegfilgrastim、sargramostim)：用於化療引起的嗜中性白血球低下；骨痛、白血球增多、尿酸升高、脾腫大。
Thrombopoietic agent: raises platelets; fluid retention, dysrhythmias, visual blurring, papilledema.
血小板生成素類：提升血小板；水分滯留、心律不整、視力模糊、視乳頭水腫。
Alpha blockers (tamsulosin 坦索羅辛, alfuzosin, doxazosin, terazosin, silodosin): relax prostate and bladder neck smooth muscle; dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, retrograde ejaculation.
α阻斷劑(tamsulosin、alfuzosin、doxazosin、terazosin、silodosin)：放鬆攝護腺與膀胱頸平滑肌；頭暈、姿位性低血壓、逆行性射精。
5-alpha-reductase inhibitors (finasteride 非那雄胺, dutasteride): shrink the prostate; may take up to 6 months; retrograde ejaculation.
5-α還原酶抑制劑(finasteride、dutasteride)：縮小攝護腺；最久需6個月見效；逆行性射精。
Avoid decongestants, antihistamines, anticholinergics that cause urinary retention in BPH.
BPH應避免會造成尿滯留的解充血劑、抗組織胺與抗膽鹼藥。
Nitrofurantoin: cough, fever, chills, dyspnea = pulmonary reaction, stop drug and report; brown urine is harmless; contraindicated in renal impairment.
Nitrofurantoin：咳嗽、發燒、寒顫、呼吸困難=肺部反應，需停藥並通報；棕色尿無害；腎功能不全禁用。
Methenamine works only in acidic urine (pH 5.5 or lower): avoid sodium bicarbonate antacids, sulfonamides, and excess fluids.
Methenamine僅在酸性尿(pH≦5.5)有效：避免碳酸氫鈉制酸劑、磺胺類與過量飲水。
Fluoroquinolones: tendon rupture risk (age >60, steroids, transplant) and CNS toxicity; stop and report tendon pain, dizziness, blurred vision, depression.
氟喹諾酮：肌腱斷裂風險(>60歲、類固醇、移植)與中樞毒性；肌腱疼痛、頭暈、視力模糊、憂鬱需停藥並通報。
Sulfonamides: withhold and report rash (possible Stevens-Johnson), sore throat or fever; keep urine output >=1200 mL/day (8-10 glasses water).
磺胺類：出現皮疹(可能史蒂文斯-強生)、喉嚨痛或發燒須停藥並通報；尿量維持≧1200 mL/天(喝水8-10杯)。
Phenazopyridine turns urine, tears and contact lenses orange-red and treats pain only; give with an antibiotic.
Phenazopyridine使尿液、淚液與隱形眼鏡呈橙紅色，僅治療疼痛；需併用抗生素。
Anticholinergic bladder drugs are contraindicated or risky in glaucoma, obstruction, myasthenia gravis; expect dry mouth and constipation.
抗膽鹼膀胱藥在青光眼、阻塞、重症肌無力時禁用或高風險；預期有口乾與便秘。
Bethanechol: never IM/IV; contraindicated in urinary obstruction; antidote for cholinergic toxicity is atropine sulfate.
Bethanechol：不可肌肉/靜脈注射；尿路阻塞禁用；膽鹼中毒解毒劑為atropine sulfate。
Cyclosporine/tacrolimus: nephrotoxic; monitor drug levels, BUN, creatinine, K+, glucose; no grapefruit juice; take at same time daily.
Cyclosporine/tacrolimus具腎毒性；監測血中濃度、BUN、肌酸酐、鉀、血糖；禁喝葡萄柚汁；每日固定時間服用。
Immunosuppressed clients: report fever, sore throat, bruising; avoid live vaccines, crowds and sick contacts; lifelong therapy.
免疫抑制病人：發燒、喉嚨痛、瘀青需通報；避免活疫苗、人群與病人接觸；需終生服藥。
Azathioprine and mycophenolate: bone marrow suppression, contraindicated in pregnancy; monitor CBC.
Azathioprine與mycophenolate：骨髓抑制、懷孕禁用；監測全血球計數。
Antithymocyte globulin requires intradermal skin test first; basiliximab is given within 2 h before transplant.
抗胸腺細胞球蛋白需先做皮內試驗；basiliximab於移植前2小時內給予。
Epoetin/darbepoetin: monitor blood pressure (hypertension is the major adverse effect), thrombosis risk.
Epoetin/darbepoetin：監測血壓(高血壓為主要不良反應)與血栓風險。
Alpha blockers for BPH cause orthostatic hypotension and dizziness: rise slowly; finasteride can take up to 6 months.
BPH的α阻斷劑會造成姿位性低血壓與頭暈：緩慢起身；finasteride最久需6個月才見效。
Cholinergic overdose = SLUDGE/DUMBBELS (salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI cramps, emesis, bradycardia): antidote atropine.
膽鹼過量=SLUDGE(流涎、流淚、排尿、排便、腹絞痛、嘔吐、心搏過緩)：解毒劑atropine。
Anticholinergic effects: 'can't see, can't pee, can't spit, can't poop.'
抗膽鹼作用：視力模糊、尿滯留、口乾、便秘。

Layers: fibrous (cornea, sclera), uveal (choroid, ciliary body, iris), retina. Rods = peripheral/night vision; cones = color/central vision; fovea = sharpest vision; optic disc = blind spot.

Aqueous humor is made by the ciliary body and drains through the canal of Schlemm; poor drainage raises IOP (normal 10-21 mm Hg, higher in the morning).

Fluorescein angiography: allergy check, dilating drops, yellow skin and bright green/orange urine for up to 2 days, sunglasses.

Tonometry measures IOP (contact type needs topical anesthetic; do not rub eye after). Slit lamp, corneal staining (green = epithelial defect), ultrasound, CT, MRI.

Myopia: images fall in front of retina; hyperopia and presbyopia: behind retina; astigmatism: irregular cornea. Corrections: glasses, contacts, LASIK, PRK, corneal ring.
近視：成像於視網膜前；遠視與老花：成像於視網膜後；散光：角膜曲度不規則。矯正：眼鏡、隱形眼鏡、LASIK、PRK、角膜環。

協助視障者：正常音量說話、先表明身分、環境導向、以時鐘位置描述食物、讓病人扶護理師手肘(落後一步)、白底紅頭手杖。

Surgery one eye at a time (phacoemulsification/extracapsular, with lens implant). Post-op: HOB 30-45, lie on back or non-operative side, eye shield at night.

Primary open-angle (most common): painless, gradual. Angle-closure: sudden severe eye pain, halos around lights, blurred vision, red eye, nausea/vomiting = emergency.
原發性開角型(最常見)：無痛、漸進。閉角型：突發劇烈眼痛、燈光暈輪、視力模糊、紅眼、噁心嘔吐=急症。
Treatment: miotics, carbonic anhydrase inhibitors, beta blockers lower IOP; peripheral iridectomy for angle-closure; trabeculectomy when medical therapy fails.
治療：縮瞳劑、碳酸酐酶抑制劑、β阻斷劑降眼壓；閉角型行周邊虹膜切開術；藥物失敗時行小梁切除術。
Teach lifelong medication, MedicAlert bracelet, avoid anticholinergic/atropine-like drugs, check OTC drugs with provider, report eye pain, halos, vision change.
衛教：終生用藥、佩戴醫療警示手環、避免抗膽鹼/類阿托品藥物、OTC藥品先詢問醫師、眼痛、暈輪與視力改變需通報。

修補：雷射、冷凍、電燒、鞏膜扣壓、注入氣體或矽油。術後：監測出血、突發劇痛，預防嘔吐與用力，閱讀限制3-5週，戴墨鏡，避免彎腰。

Macular degeneration: loss of central vision, distortion; dry (atrophic, common) vs wet (exudative, faster). Maximize remaining vision; laser/photodynamic therapy.

Ocular melanoma: most common adult malignant eye tumor; enucleation or radioactive plaque. After enucleation: monitor dressing for bright red bleeding, emotional support, prosthesis in about 1 month.
眼黑色素瘤：成人最常見惡性眼腫瘤；眼球摘除或放射性敷貼。眼球摘除後：觀察敷料有無鮮紅出血、情緒支持，約1個月後裝義眼。

Hyphema: blood in anterior chamber; semi-Fowler's rest, avoid sudden eye movement, cycloplegic drops, eye shield.
前房出血：前房積血；半坐臥休息、避免突然眼動、睫狀肌麻痺劑、眼罩。
Contusion: apply ice immediately; full eye exam. Foreign body: look up, irrigate/remove with moist applicator.
挫傷：立即冰敷並做完整眼科檢查。異物：向上看，以濕棉棒或沖洗移除。
Penetrating object: never remove; cover with cup/shield, cover both eyes, no pressure, do not let client bend or lie flat; no MRI.
穿透性異物：不可拔除；以杯狀護罩覆蓋、雙眼遮蓋、不可加壓，避免彎腰或平躺；禁做MRI。
Chemical burn: flush with water at least 15-20 minutes immediately, check pH, continue irrigation until pH acceptable.
化學灼傷：立即以清水沖洗至少15-20分鐘，測pH，持續沖洗至pH正常。
Corneal transplant rejection signs RSVP: Redness, Swelling, decreased Vision, Pain; treat with topical corticosteroids. Wear shield at night for 1 month.

Blepharitis: chronic lid margin inflammation; lid hygiene, warm compresses, possible antibiotics or steroids.
眼瞼緣炎：慢性眼瞼緣發炎；眼瞼清潔、溫敷、可能使用抗生素或類固醇。
Hordeolum (stye): painful red lump from infected gland; warm wet compress, do not squeeze, no makeup or contacts.
麥粒腫：腺體感染的紅痛腫塊；溫濕敷、不可擠壓、避免化妝與隱形眼鏡。
Chalazion: painless firm lump from blocked gland; warm compresses, do not squeeze.
霰粒腫：腺體阻塞的無痛硬塊；溫敷、不可擠壓。

耳朵解剖、檢查與聽力損失
External ear (pinna to tympanic membrane), middle ear (malleus, incus, stapes; eustachian tube equalizes pressure), inner ear (cochlea = hearing, semicircular canals = balance, CN VIII).
外耳(耳廓至鼓膜)、中耳(錘骨、砧骨、鐙骨；耳咽管平衡壓力)、內耳(耳蝸=聽覺、半規管=平衡、第八對腦神經)。

耳朵解剖、檢查與聽力損失
Tests: audiometry (pure tone, speech), electronystagmography (NPO 3 h, avoid caffeine 24-48 h, ears irrigated with cool/warm water, nausea possible), tomography, MRI.
檢查：聽力檢查(純音、語音)、眼震電圖(禁食3小時、24-48小時避免咖啡因、以冷熱水沖洗耳朵可能噁心)、斷層攝影、MRI。

Conductive loss: blocked sound in outer/middle ear, often correctable. Sensorineural: inner ear/CN VIII damage, often permanent. Mixed: both. Central: brain interpretation.
傳導性：外耳/中耳阻礙聲音，常可矯正。感覺神經性：內耳/第八對腦神經受損，多為永久。混合型：兩者皆有。中樞性：腦部解讀障礙。

Hearing aids help conductive loss (amplify only); cochlear implant for sensorineural loss. Hearing aid care: turn off before removal, keep dry, remove battery when unused.
助聽器適用傳導性聽損(僅放大聲音)；人工電子耳用於感覺神經性聽損。助聽器護理：取下前先關閉、保持乾燥、不用時取出電池。

耳朵解剖、檢查與聽力損失
Communication: face the client, lower pitch, normal volume (do not shout), reduce noise, rephrase, get attention first.
溝通：面對病人、降低音調、正常音量(不要大叫)、減少噪音、換句話說、先引起注意。

Presbycusis: age-related bilateral sensorineural loss; hears sound but cannot understand words. No cotton-tipped applicators in the ear canal.
老年性聽損：老化造成的雙側感覺神經性聽損；聽得見聲音但聽不清字句。不可用棉花棒掏耳朵。

Chronic otitis media: debris removal, myringoplasty, mastoidectomy. Post-op: hearing reduced from packing, operative ear up, avoid forceful coughing.

Myringotomy teaching: avoid straining, straws, air travel, getting head wet; blow nose one side at a time with mouth open; cotton with petroleum jelly in ear.
鼓膜切開術衛教：避免用力、吸管、搭飛機、頭部進水；擤鼻一次一側且張口；耳內放塗凡士林棉球。

Mastoiditis: swelling and pain behind ear, low-grade fever, immobile dull tympanic membrane; complications meningitis, brain abscess, CN VI and VII damage. Monitor for stiff neck and vomiting.
乳突炎：耳後腫痛、低燒、鼓膜暗淡不動；併發腦膜炎、腦膿瘍、第VI與VII對腦神經受損。監測頸部僵硬與嘔吐。

Otosclerosis: stapes fixation, slowly progressive bilateral conductive loss, tinnitus, Schwartze's sign (pink tympanic membrane); stapedectomy.
耳硬化症：鐙骨固定，緩慢進行性雙側傳導性聽損、耳鳴、Schwartze徵象(鼓膜粉紅)；鐙骨切除術。

Stapedectomy post-op: hearing worse initially (up to 6 weeks), avoid sneezing, nose blowing, straining, pressure changes; assess facial nerve, vertigo; move head slowly.
鐙骨切除術後：初期聽力更差(可長達6週)，避免打噴嚏、擤鼻、用力、壓力變化；評估顏面神經與眩暈；緩慢轉頭。

Acute angle-closure glaucoma is an emergency: sudden severe eye pain, halos, blurred vision, nausea/vomiting; lower IOP promptly.
急性閉角型青光眼為急症：突發劇烈眼痛、暈輪、視力模糊、噁心嘔吐；需儘速降眼壓。

Penetrating eye injury: do NOT remove object, shield without pressure, cover both eyes, keep client upright/still, no MRI.
眼睛穿透傷：不可拔除異物，無壓力護罩、雙眼遮蓋、病人保持直立/靜止，禁做MRI。

眼睛化學濺傷：立即以清水沖洗至少15-20分鐘後送急診；測pH。
After cataract surgery: avoid bending, straining, coughing, rubbing; report severe pain, decreased vision, redness, discharge.
白內障術後：避免彎腰、用力、咳嗽、揉眼；劇痛、視力下降、紅腫、分泌物需通報。
Corneal graft rejection RSVP: Redness, Swelling, decreased Vision, Pain.
角膜移植排斥RSVP：紅、腫、視力下降、疼痛。
Hyphema: semi-Fowler's, restrict activity and reading, cycloplegics to rest the eye.

聽損：傳導性(外/中耳，助聽器有幫助)與感覺神經性(內耳/CN VIII，常永久)。

Mastoiditis/labyrinthitis: monitor for meningitis (stiff neck, headache, vomiting, lethargy).
乳突炎/迷路炎：監測腦膜炎(頸僵、頭痛、嘔吐、嗜睡)。
Meniere's disease: tinnitus + vertigo + sensorineural hearing loss; priority is safety; low sodium and fluid restriction.
梅尼爾氏症：耳鳴+眩暈+感覺神經性聽損；優先為安全；低鈉與限水。
Never use cotton-tipped applicators or ear candles in ear canal.
耳道內不可使用棉花棒或耳燭。
RSVP = corneal graft rejection signs: Redness, Swelling, Vision decrease, Pain.

Interventions: HOB 30-40 degrees, head midline, avoid hip/neck flexion, Trendelenburg and Valsalva; limit fluids (~1200 mL/day), quiet environment, prevent shivering and hypoxia; avoid morphine.
