Medications: antiseizure, antipyretics/muscle relaxants, BP control (notify if SBP <100 or >150), corticosteroids (taper slowly), IV fluids by pump, osmotic diuretics (monitor renal function).

Hyperthermia (>105 F / 40.6 C) raises cerebral metabolism; cool with fluids, baths, fans or cooling blanket and prevent shivering. VP shunt diverts CSF to the peritoneum; watch for shunt failure and infection.
高熱（>105°F/40.6°C）增加腦代謝；以輸液、冷水浴、風扇或降溫毯降溫並防寒顫。腦室腹腔分流將腦脊髓液導入腹腔；注意分流失效與感染。

Epidural hematoma: arterial, rapid, lucid interval then coma; surgical emergency. Subdural: venous, slower. Concussion, contusion and skull fractures are other injury types.
硬腦膜外血腫：動脈出血、進展快、有清醒期後昏迷，為外科急症。硬腦膜下血腫：靜脈出血、較慢。另有腦震盪、腦挫傷與顱骨骨折。
CSF leak from nose/ear: halo (ring) sign and glucose-positive; do not suction the nose, clean the ear or let the client blow the nose; apply loose dry sterile dressing and notify the PHCP.
鼻/耳漏出腦脊髓液：出現暈環徵並葡萄糖陽性；勿經鼻抽吸、清潔耳道或擤鼻；以鬆的乾燥無菌敷料覆蓋並通知醫師。

頭部外傷照護：維持呼吸道、抬高床頭、避免頸屈曲與咳嗽、癲癇預防、監測神經狀態與感染；鴉片類藥物須謹慎。

Positioning after surgery follows prescription: bone flap removal - turn to the nonoperative side; posterior fossa - side-lying; infratentorial - flat or HOB 30-45 per order; supratentorial - HOB 30 degrees.

開顱術後可預期眼周水腫與瘀青；依醫囑冰敷。

動脈瘤預防措施：臥床休息、半坐臥或側臥、昏暗安靜、限制訪客、避免Valsalva（給軟便劑）、勿測肛溫、預防高血壓、預防深部靜脈栓塞、抗癲癇藥。
Seizure types: tonic-clonic (tonic 10-20 s then clonic ~30 s), absence (brief staring, children), myoclonic, atonic, simple partial (conscious), complex partial (temporal lobe, altered awareness).
癲癇類型：強直-陣攣（強直10-20秒後陣攣約30秒）、失神（短暫凝視、常見於兒童）、肌躁、失張力、單純局部（意識清楚）、複雜局部（顳葉、意識改變）。

癲癇重積狀態：連續發作而意識未恢復；屬急症，可致腦損傷。
Teaching: lifelong medication with level monitoring, avoid alcohol, stress, fatigue and strobe lights, wear a medical ID bracelet.

Ischemic (thrombotic, embolic) vs hemorrhagic; type must be confirmed by CT because symptoms overlap and treatment differs. TIA is a warning sign.

Check fingerstick glucose to rule out hypoglycemia; airway is always the priority; deficits appear on the side opposite the lesion.
測指尖血糖排除低血糖；呼吸道永遠優先；缺損出現在病灶對側。
Left-brain stroke: right hemiplegia, aphasia, slow cautious, aware of deficits. Right-brain stroke: left hemiplegia, neglect, impulsive, poor judgment, denies problems.

Acute phase: keep BP around 150/100 for perfusion, HOB 15-30 degrees, side-lying, suction orally and not longer than 10 seconds, ICP risk highest in first 72 hours.

Homonymous hemianopsia and neglect: approach from the unaffected side, place items in the intact visual field, teach head turning to scan.
同側偏盲與忽略症：從健側接近、物品放在可視野、教導轉頭掃視。

MS: demyelination, remissions and exacerbations; fatigue, ataxia, spasticity, diplopia, bladder/bowel problems; avoid heat, fatigue, stress and infection; IV glucocorticoids for flare-ups.

Myasthenia gravis: weakness worse with activity, ptosis, diplopia, dysphagia; respiratory failure risk; plan activity at peak strength; anticholinesterase drugs on time.

Myasthenic crisis = too little medication (strength improves with edrophonium); cholinergic crisis = too much (cramps, diarrhea, miosis, bradycardia, secretions; edrophonium worsens weakness); antidote atropine.
肌無力危象＝藥量不足（給edrophonium會改善）；膽鹼性危象＝藥量過多（腹絞痛、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、心搏過緩、分泌物多；edrophonium使無力加重）；解毒劑為atropine。

Edrophonium test: keep atropine and emergency equipment available (risk of ventricular fibrillation/arrest).
Edrophonium試驗：備妥atropine與急救設備（有心室顫動/心跳停止風險）。

Parkinson's: dopamine depletion; bradykinesia, resting pill-rolling tremor, rigidity, masklike face, shuffling gait, drooling.
帕金森氏症：多巴胺缺乏；動作遲緩、靜止性搓丸樣顫抖、僵硬、面具臉、拖曳步態、流口水。

Parkinson's care: high-calorie, high-protein, high-fiber soft diet, 2000 mL fluids, low-heeled shoes, lift feet, avoid rushing; avoid vitamin B6-rich foods with levodopa and avoid MAO inhibitors.

Trigeminal neuralgia (CN V): severe sharp facial pain triggered by cold, washing, chewing; avoid temperature extremes, chew on unaffected side; surgical options include microvascular decompression and rhizotomy.
三叉神經痛（第五對）：因冷、洗臉、咀嚼誘發的劇烈刺痛；避免冷熱、用健側咀嚼；手術包括微血管減壓與神經根切斷術。
腦神經與神經肌肉疾病
Bell's palsy (CN VII): one-sided facial paralysis, loss of taste, cannot close eyelid; protect the eye from dryness, facial exercises, chew on the unaffected side; usually recovers in weeks.
貝爾氏麻痺（第七對）：單側顏面麻痺、味覺喪失、眼瞼無法閉合；保護眼睛防乾燥、臉部運動、用健側咀嚼；通常數週內恢復。
腦神經與神經肌肉疾病
Guillain-Barre: follows infection by days to weeks; ascending symmetric weakness, paresthesias, CSF protein elevated; main danger is respiratory failure and dysrhythmias; recovery is slow.
格林-巴利症候群：感染後數日至數週發生；上行性對稱無力、感覺異常、腦脊髓液蛋白升高；主要危險為呼吸衰竭與心律不整；恢復緩慢。
腦神經與神經肌肉疾病
ALS: progressive motor neuron disease, sensory, autonomic and mental status spared; weakness, atrophy, fasciculations, dysphagia, dysarthria; supportive care and advance directives.
ALS：進行性運動神經元疾病，感覺、自律神經與心智不受影響；無力、萎縮、肌束顫動、吞嚥與構音困難；支持性照護與預立醫囑。

Encephalitis: brain inflammation, usually viral (HSV-1, arboviruses); fever, altered LOC, signs of ICP; acyclovir for herpes encephalitis; HOB 30-45 degrees.
腦炎：腦實質發炎，多為病毒（HSV-1、蟲媒病毒）；發燒、意識改變、ICP徵象；疱疹性腦炎用acyclovir；床頭抬高30-45度。
West Nile virus: mosquito-borne, symptoms 3-14 days after bite, many asymptomatic; care is supportive; prevent with DEET, long sleeves, eliminating standing water.
西尼羅病毒：蚊媒傳播、被叮咬後3-14天發病、許多人無症狀；以支持性照護；以DEET、長袖與清除積水預防。
Meningitis: fever, nuchal rigidity, photophobia, positive Kernig and Brudzinski; CSF cloudy with high protein and WBC and low glucose; meningococcal rash is red macular.
腦膜炎：發燒、頸僵硬、畏光、Kernig與Brudzinski陽性；腦脊髓液混濁、蛋白與白血球升高、葡萄糖降低；腦膜炎雙球菌有紅色斑疹。
Meningitis care: droplet/isolation precautions for bacterial types, seizure precautions, quiet dim room, HOB 30 degrees, avoid neck/hip flexion, antibiotics and analgesics.
腦膜炎照護：細菌性採飛沫/隔離預防、癲癇預防、安靜昏暗環境、床頭30度、避免頸/髖過度屈曲、給予抗生素與止痛藥。
Change in level of consciousness is the earliest, most sensitive sign of increased ICP.
意識程度改變是ICP上升最早且最敏感的徵象。
Late ICP signs (Cushing's triad): rising systolic BP with widened pulse pressure, bradycardia, irregular respirations.
ICP晚期徵象（庫欣三徵）：收縮壓升高且脈搏壓增寬、心搏過緩、呼吸不規則。
Increased ICP: HOB 30-40 degrees, avoid Trendelenburg, neck/hip flexion, Valsalva, coughing; avoid morphine; PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg.
ICP上升：床頭30-40度，避免頭低位、頸/髖屈曲、Valsalva、咳嗽；避免嗎啡；PaCO2 30-35 mm Hg。
Lumbar puncture is contraindicated with increased ICP (herniation).
顱內壓上升者禁做腰椎穿刺（腦疝）。
Epidural hematoma: arterial bleed, lucid interval, then rapid deterioration; surgical emergency.
硬腦膜外血腫：動脈出血、清醒期後急速惡化；為外科急症。
CSF leak: halo sign and glucose-positive; no nasal suction, no nose blowing; loose sterile dry dressing.
腦脊髓液漏：暈環徵與葡萄糖陽性；勿經鼻抽吸、擤鼻；鬆敷乾燥無菌敷料。
Seizure: protect head, side-lying, never restrain or put objects in the mouth, record time and characteristics.
癲癇發作：保護頭部、側臥、絕不約束或放物入口、記錄時間與特徵。
Stroke: airway first, check glucose, confirm type by CT; BP about 150/100 in acute stroke; ICP risk highest in the first 72 hours.
中風：先顧呼吸道、測血糖、CT確認類型；急性期血壓約150/100；前72小時ICP風險最高。
Stroke feeding: sit upright, chin slightly flexed, food in the back of the mouth on the unaffected side, thickened fluids; never suction nasally or over 10 seconds.
中風進食：坐直、下巴微收、食物置口腔後方健側、增稠液體；勿經鼻抽吸且不超過10秒。
Myasthenic crisis (undermedicated) vs cholinergic crisis (overmedicated): withhold anticholinesterase and give atropine in cholinergic crisis; edrophonium differentiates.
肌無力危象（藥量不足）與膽鹼性危象（藥量過多）：膽鹼性危象停用抗膽鹼酯酶並給atropine；edrophonium可區分。
Guillain-Barre: respiratory failure is the major concern; keep intubation equipment and ECG monitoring available.
格林-巴利：主要顧慮為呼吸衰竭；備妥插管設備與心電圖監測。
Parkinson's: avoid vitamin B6-rich foods with levodopa and avoid MAO inhibitors (hypertensive crisis).
帕金森：使用levodopa時避免高維生素B6食物，避免MAO抑制劑（高血壓危象）。
Aneurysm precautions: quiet, dim room, no straining, no rectal temperatures, prevent hypertension.
動脈瘤預防措施：安靜昏暗、勿用力解便、勿測肛溫、預防高血壓。
Meningitis: CSF cloudy, high protein/WBC, low glucose; positive Kernig/Brudzinski; isolation for bacterial types.
腦膜炎：腦脊髓液混濁、蛋白/白血球高、葡萄糖低；Kernig/Brudzinski陽性；細菌性需隔離。
Pupils: unilateral dilated = CN III compression; bilateral fixed dilated = ominous; pinpoint = pons or opioids.
瞳孔：單側放大＝第三對受壓；雙側固定放大＝嚴重；針尖＝橋腦或鴉片類。
Right brain = Risky (impulsive, neglect, left-sided deficits); Left brain = Language (aphasia, slow and cautious, right-sided deficits).
右腦＝冒險（衝動、忽略症、左側缺損）；左腦＝語言（失語、緩慢謹慎、右側缺損）。
Cholinergic crisis = SLUDGE/DUMBELS signs (salivation, lacrimation, urination, defecation, GI cramps, emesis) - too much drug; myasthenic crisis = too little.
膽鹼性危象＝SLUDGE症狀（流涎、流淚、排尿、排便、腸胃絞痛、嘔吐）－藥過量；肌無力危象＝藥不足。
Cushing's triad: high BP (wide pulse pressure), low HR, irregular respirations.
庫欣三徵：高血壓（脈搏壓增寬）、心搏過慢、呼吸不規則。
A client with a head injury has a GCS that falls from 15 to 11, with new restlessness and slowed pupil response. What is the nurse's priority action?
頭部外傷病人GCS由15降至11，出現躁動且瞳孔反應變慢。護理師的首要行動為何？
Which vital sign trend indicates rising ICP?
下列何種生命徵象趨勢表示ICP上升？

基底顱骨骨折病人鼻腔流出清澈液體。下列哪些發現提示為腦脊髓液？（多選）
A client begins a tonic-clonic seizure in bed. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
病人在床上發生強直-陣攣癲癇。下列哪些行動適當？（多選）
A client with a stroke has dysphagia. Which action by the nurse is best when feeding?
中風且有吞嚥困難的病人，護理師餵食時何者最佳？

服用pyridostigmine的重症肌無力病人出現腹絞痛、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、心搏過緩與無力加重。護理師預期？

格林-巴利病人主訴麻刺感且雙腿無法移動。床邊最必要的設備為何？

三叉神經痛病人說出下列何者表示需再衛教？

表59.1 大腦皮質各葉功能（額、頂、顳、枕葉與邊緣系統）。

Meningeal irritation signs and the Glasgow Coma Scale scoring table.
腦膜刺激徵象與格拉斯哥昏迷指數評分表。
Care of the unconscious client checklist and clinical judgment case showing worsening ICP.
昏迷病人照護清單，及顱內壓惡化的臨床判斷案例。
Types of head injury and hematomas (epidural vs subdural).
頭部外傷與血腫類型（硬腦膜外與硬腦膜下）。
Craniotomy positioning and aneurysm precautions boxes.
開顱術後擺位與動脈瘤預防措施。
Seizure types and stroke manifestations by type.
癲癇類型與各型中風表現。
Right versus left brain stroke deficits and stroke assessment findings.
右腦與左腦中風缺損比較及中風評估發現。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）
Class/examples: neostigmine, pyridostigmine (treatment); edrophonium (diagnosis, distinguishes myasthenic from cholinergic crisis).
類別/例：neostigmine、pyridostigmine（治療）；edrophonium（診斷，區分肌無力與膽鹼性危象）。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）
Action: block acetylcholine breakdown at the neuromuscular junction, improving strength.
作用：阻斷神經肌肉接合處乙醯膽鹼分解，增進肌力。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）

Adverse effects (overdose = cholinergic crisis): abdominal cramps, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, miosis, blurred vision, bradycardia, bronchospasm, increased secretions, sweating, hypotension, facial twitching.
不良反應（過量＝膽鹼性危象）：腹絞痛、噁心嘔吐、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、視力模糊、心搏過緩、支氣管痙攣、分泌物增加、出汗、低血壓、臉部抽動。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）
Antidote: atropine sulfate; keep atropine and resuscitation equipment ready during edrophonium use.
解毒劑：atropine sulfate；使用edrophonium時備妥atropine與急救設備。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）
Nursing: give on time (lifelong), with a little food; meal 45-60 min after dose to reduce aspiration risk; assess strength, reflexes, gait; MedicAlert bracelet.
護理：準時服用（終生）、搭配少量食物；服藥後45-60分鐘再進餐以降低吸入風險；評估肌力、反射、步態；配戴醫療警示手環。
抗肌無力藥（抗膽鹼酯酶）
Disease-modifying immunomodulators: interferon beta, glatiramer, dimethyl fumarate, fingolimod, teriflunomide, cladribine; reduce relapses and lesions.
疾病修飾免疫調節劑：interferon beta、glatiramer、dimethyl fumarate、fingolimod、teriflunomide、cladribine；減少復發與病灶。
Immunomodulator adverse effects: flu-like reactions, hepatotoxicity, myelosuppression, injection-site reactions, depression.
免疫調節劑不良反應：類流感反應、肝毒性、骨髓抑制、注射部位反應、憂鬱。
Immunosuppressants (mitoxantrone) and monoclonal antibodies (alemtuzumab, natalizumab, ocrelizumab, ofatumumab): myelosuppression, cardiotoxicity, fetal harm, alopecia, GI injury.
免疫抑制劑（mitoxantrone）與單株抗體（alemtuzumab、natalizumab、ocrelizumab、ofatumumab）：骨髓抑制、心毒性、胎兒傷害、落髮、胃腸黏膜損傷。
Acute relapse: high-dose IV glucocorticoid (methylprednisolone) or IV immune globulin.
急性復發：高劑量靜脈類固醇（methylprednisolone）或靜脈免疫球蛋白。

Symptom drugs: psyllium/docusate (bowel), memantine (cognition), fluoxetine/sertraline (depression), amantadine/modafinil (fatigue), gabapentin/carbamazepine (neuropathic pain), dalfampridine (walking speed).
症狀用藥：psyllium/docusate（腸道）、memantine（認知）、fluoxetine/sertraline（憂鬱）、amantadine/modafinil（疲倦）、gabapentin/carbamazepine（神經痛）、dalfampridine（行走速度）。

Dopaminergics (carbidopa-levodopa, pramipexole, ropinirole, bromocriptine, amantadine, apomorphine, selegiline, rasagiline): increase dopamine activity; contraindicated in significant cardiac, renal or psychiatric disease.
多巴胺類（carbidopa-levodopa、pramipexole、ropinirole、bromocriptine、amantadine、apomorphine、selegiline、rasagiline）：增加多巴胺作用；重度心、腎或精神疾病者禁用。
Adverse effects: dyskinesia, orthostatic hypotension, nausea/vomiting, hallucinations, confusion, depression, urinary retention, constipation, insomnia.
不良反應：異動症、姿位性低血壓、噁心嘔吐、幻覺、意識混亂、憂鬱、尿滯留、便秘、失眠。
Carbidopa-levodopa with MAO inhibitor antidepressant can cause hypertensive crisis; avoid excess vitamin B6; spread protein across meals; urine and sweat may darken (harmless); do not stop abruptly.
carbidopa-levodopa與MAO抑制劑類抗憂鬱藥併用可致高血壓危象；避免過量維生素B6；蛋白質平均分配於各餐；尿與汗可能變色（無害）；勿突然停藥。
Diabetic clients should not rely on urine glucose testing with levodopa.
糖尿病病人使用levodopa時勿以尿糖檢測。
Anticholinergics (benztropine, trihexyphenidyl): reduce tremor and drooling; little effect on rigidity/bradykinesia; contraindicated in glaucoma.
抗膽鹼藥（benztropine、trihexyphenidyl）：減少顫抖與流口水；對僵硬與動作遲緩效果小；青光眼禁用。

Anticholinergic effects: dry mouth, blurred vision, tachycardia, constipation, urinary retention, confusion, photophobia; use ice chips/sugarless candy, sunglasses, fluids and fiber; abrupt stop worsens parkinsonism.
抗膽鹼副作用：口乾、視力模糊、心搏過速、便秘、尿滯留、意識混亂、畏光；以冰塊/無糖糖果、太陽眼鏡、水分與纖維緩解；突然停藥使症狀加重。
COMT inhibitors (entacapone, opicapone, tolcapone) block peripheral dopamine metabolism and extend levodopa effect.
COMT抑制劑（entacapone、opicapone、tolcapone）阻斷周邊多巴胺代謝，延長levodopa效果。

Action: depress abnormal neuronal discharge and prevent spread. Monitor serum levels, liver and renal function, signs of toxicity (CNS depression, ataxia, nystagmus, visual disturbance). Seizure precautions.
作用：抑制異常神經放電並防止擴散。監測血中濃度、肝腎功能與毒性徵象（中樞抑制、運動失調、眼震、視覺障礙）。癲癇預防措施。
Therapeutic ranges: phenytoin 10-20 mcg/mL, carbamazepine 3-14, divalproex 50-100, phenobarbital 15-40, ethosuximide 40-100 mcg/mL; clonazepam 20-80 and lorazepam 50-240 ng/mL.
治療濃度：phenytoin 10-20 mcg/mL、carbamazepine 3-14、divalproex 50-100、phenobarbital 15-40、ethosuximide 40-100 mcg/mL；clonazepam 20-80、lorazepam 50-240 ng/mL。

Hydantoins (phenytoin, fosphenytoin): gingival hyperplasia, nystagmus, ataxia, hirsutism, blood dyscrasias, hyperglycemia, teratogenic, may reduce birth control effectiveness. IV: normal saline only (dextrose precipitates), inline filter, no faster than 25-50 mg/min (hypotension, dysrhythmias); separate tube feedings.
乙內醯脲類（phenytoin、fosphenytoin）：牙齦增生、眼震、運動失調、多毛、血液惡病質、高血糖、致畸胎、可能降低避孕藥效果。靜脈：僅用生理食鹽水（葡萄糖會沈澱）、使用過濾器、速率不超過25-50 mg/分（低血壓、心律不整）；與管灌飲食分開給藥。
Barbiturates (phenobarbital): tonic-clonic and status epilepticus; sedation, respiratory depression, hypotension, tolerance.
巴比妥類（phenobarbital）：強直-陣攣與癲癇重積；鎮靜、呼吸抑制、低血壓、耐受性。

Benzodiazepines (diazepam, lorazepam, clonazepam, clorazepate): status epilepticus, absence; sedation, dependence, hepatotoxicity, blood dyscrasias; IV slowly; antidote flumazenil but avoid in increased ICP or status epilepticus treated with benzodiazepines.
苯二氮平類（diazepam、lorazepam、clonazepam、clorazepate）：癲癇重積、失神發作；鎮靜、依賴、肝毒性、血液惡病質；靜脈緩慢給予；解毒劑flumazenil，但顱內壓升高或以苯二氮平治療的癲癇重積者避免使用。
Succinimides (ethosuximide): absence seizures; GI upset, blood dyscrasias.
Succinimide類（ethosuximide）：失神發作；腸胃不適、血液惡病質。
Valproates (valproic acid, divalproex): pancreatitis, hepatotoxicity, thrombocytopenia, teratogenic (neural tube defects).
Valproate類（valproic acid、divalproex）：胰臟炎、肝毒性、血小板低下、致畸胎（神經管缺損）。
Carbamazepine (iminostilbene): also trigeminal neuralgia; drowsiness, rash, agranulocytosis/aplastic anemia - report sore throat, bruising, fever; check CBC.
Carbamazepine（亞胺芪類）：亦用於三叉神經痛；嗜睡、皮疹、顆粒球缺乏/再生不良性貧血－喉嚨痛、瘀青、發燒須通報；監測CBC。
Education: never stop abruptly, avoid alcohol, take with food but not milk/antacids, soft toothbrush and dental care, medical ID.
衛教：勿突然停藥、避免酒精、隨食物服用但避免牛奶/制酸劑、軟毛牙刷與牙科檢查、配戴醫療警示。
Examples: amphetamines, methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, lisdexamfetamine, atomoxetine, caffeine; anorexiants (phentermine). Used for narcolepsy, ADHD, adjunct for obesity.
例：安非他命類、methylphenidate、dexmethylphenidate、lisdexamfetamine、atomoxetine、咖啡因；食慾抑制劑（phentermine）。用於猝睡症、ADHD、肥胖輔助。
Adverse effects: irritability, insomnia, tachycardia, hypertension, dysrhythmias, anorexia/weight loss, psychosis, dependence.
不良反應：易怒、失眠、心搏過速、高血壓、心律不整、厭食/體重減輕、精神病症狀、依賴。

Nursing: monitor vital signs, CBC, growth in children; give before meals, last dose at least 6 h before bedtime; do not crush long-acting forms; avoid caffeine; do not stop abruptly; effect in ADHD in 3-4 weeks.
護理：監測生命徵象、CBC、兒童生長；餐前服用、最後一劑在睡前至少6小時；長效劑型勿壓碎；避免咖啡因；勿突然停藥；ADHD約3-4週見效。

NSAIDs/aspirin inhibit prostaglandin synthesis: analgesic, antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, antiplatelet. Examples: ibuprofen, naproxen, ketorolac, diclofenac, indomethacin, meloxicam; celecoxib (COX-2).
NSAID/aspirin抑制前列腺素合成：止痛、退燒、抗發炎、抗血小板。例：ibuprofen、naproxen、ketorolac、diclofenac、indomethacin、meloxicam；celecoxib（COX-2）。
Adverse effects: GI irritation/bleeding, renal impairment, fluid retention, tinnitus (salicylism), cardiovascular thrombotic events, blood dyscrasias. Monitor salicylate level with high doses.
不良反應：胃腸刺激/出血、腎功能下降、水腫、耳鳴（水楊酸中毒）、心血管血栓事件、血液惡病質。大劑量時監測水楊酸濃度。

Avoid in anticoagulant therapy and liver/renal disease; do not combine aspirin with another NSAID; children with flu/varicella: no aspirin (Reye's syndrome); stop aspirin 3-7 days before surgery as prescribed.
抗凝血治療與肝腎疾病者避免；aspirin不與其他NSAID併用；兒童流感/水痘勿用aspirin（雷氏症候群）；依醫囑術前3-7天停aspirin。
Teach: take with food/milk, sit upright 20-30 min after aspirin, do not crush enteric-coated tablets, avoid alcohol, watch for tarry stools and bruising.
衛教：隨食物/牛奶服用、服aspirin後坐直20-30分鐘、腸溶錠勿壓碎、避免酒精、注意黑便與瘀青。

Acetaminophen: analgesic and antipyretic; hepatotoxicity risk above 4000 mg/day; antidote acetylcysteine; avoid in liver disease and alcoholism; self-use no longer than 10 days (adult) / 5 days (child); monitor liver enzymes.
Acetaminophen：止痛退燒；每日超過4000 mg有肝毒性風險；解毒劑acetylcysteine；肝病與酗酒者避免；自行使用成人不超過10天、兒童5天；監測肝酵素。
Examples: morphine, hydromorphone, fentanyl, methadone, oxycodone, codeine, tapentadol. Act on opioid receptors; cause sedation, euphoria, dependence.
例：morphine、hydromorphone、fentanyl、methadone、oxycodone、codeine、tapentadol。作用於鴉片受體；造成鎮靜、欣快、依賴。
Adverse effects: respiratory depression, orthostatic hypotension, urinary retention, nausea/vomiting, constipation, sedation, confusion, cough suppression, miosis.
不良反應：呼吸抑制、姿位性低血壓、尿滯留、噁心嘔吐、便秘、鎮靜、意識混亂、咳嗽抑制、瞳孔縮小。
Hold dose if adult respiratory rate <12 (unless ventilated or terminal as prescribed) or bradycardia; give 30-60 min before painful activity; encourage turning, deep breathing; manage constipation.
成人呼吸<12次/分（除非有呼吸支持或依醫囑末期）或心搏過緩時暫停給藥；疼痛活動前30-60分鐘給藥；鼓勵翻身深呼吸；處理便秘。
Opioid antagonists (naloxone, naltrexone, methylnaltrexone, naloxegol, alvimopan): reverse opioid respiratory depression.
鴉片拮抗劑（naloxone、naltrexone、methylnaltrexone、naloxegol、alvimopan）：逆轉鴉片所致呼吸抑制。
After naloxone: check BP, pulse, respirations every 5 min then taper, cardiac monitor, stay with client; its short half-life means overdose signs can return.
給予naloxone後：每5分鐘測血壓、脈搏、呼吸後逐漸延長、心電監測、不離開病人；因半衰期短，過量症狀可能再發。
Action: raises osmotic pressure of filtrate; used to lower ICP and intraocular pressure and for oliguria.
作用：提高濾液滲透壓；用於降低顱內壓與眼壓、少尿。
Adverse effects: fluid and electrolyte imbalance, pulmonary edema, hyponatremia, dehydration, headache, tachycardia.
不良反應：體液電解質失衡、肺水腫、低血鈉、脫水、頭痛、心搏過速。
Monitor weight, urine output, electrolytes, lungs, neuro status; do not use mannitol vials with crystals; change position slowly.
監測體重、尿量、電解質、肺部、神經狀態；有結晶之mannitol瓶勿使用；緩慢改變姿勢。
Cholinergic crisis (anticholinesterase overdose): cramps, diarrhea, miosis, bradycardia, secretions; withhold drug and give atropine.
膽鹼性危象（抗膽鹼酯酶過量）：絞痛、腹瀉、瞳孔縮小、心搏過緩、分泌物多；停藥並給atropine。
Edrophonium: improvement = myasthenic crisis (needs more drug); worsening = cholinergic crisis. Have atropine and resuscitation equipment ready.
Edrophonium：改善＝肌無力危象（需加藥）；惡化＝膽鹼性危象。備妥atropine與急救設備。
Phenytoin therapeutic level 10-20 mcg/mL; nystagmus above 20, ataxia and slurred speech above 30.
Phenytoin治療濃度10-20 mcg/mL；超過20出現眼震、超過30出現運動失調與口齒不清。
IV phenytoin: normal saline only, inline filter, max 25-50 mg/min; fast infusion causes hypotension and dysrhythmias.
靜脈phenytoin：僅用生理食鹽水、過濾器、最快25-50 mg/分；過快造成低血壓與心律不整。
Phenytoin: gingival hyperplasia - good oral hygiene; may decrease birth control effectiveness; teratogenic.
Phenytoin：牙齦增生－保持口腔衛生；可能降低避孕藥效果；致畸胎。
Carbamazepine: agranulocytosis/aplastic anemia; low WBC is the adverse-effect lab finding.
Carbamazepine：顆粒球缺乏/再生不良性貧血；白血球過低為不良反應檢驗發現。
Valproate: hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis, thrombocytopenia, neural tube defects.
Valproate：肝毒性、胰臟炎、血小板低下、神經管缺損。
Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepines but avoid with increased ICP or seizure disorders treated with benzodiazepines.
Flumazenil可逆轉苯二氮平，但顱內壓升高或以苯二氮平控制癲癇者避免。
Carbidopa-levodopa: avoid MAOIs (hypertensive crisis), limit vitamin B6, spread protein; dyskinesia is a key adverse effect; never stop abruptly.
Carbidopa-levodopa：避免MAO抑制劑（高血壓危象）、限制維生素B6、蛋白質分散；異動症為重要副作用；勿突然停藥。
Anticholinergics are contraindicated in glaucoma; cause dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention.
抗膽鹼藥青光眼禁用；造成口乾、便秘、尿滯留。
Acetaminophen: max 4000 mg/day, liver toxicity (elevated bilirubin/enzymes), antidote acetylcysteine.
Acetaminophen：每日上限4000 mg、肝毒性（膽紅素/酵素上升）、解毒劑acetylcysteine。
Aspirin toxicity (salicylism): tinnitus is the classic early sign; no aspirin in children with viral illness (Reye's).
Aspirin中毒（水楊酸中毒）：耳鳴為典型早期徵象；病毒感染兒童勿用aspirin（雷氏症候群）。
Opioids: hold and notify if respirations <12; keep naloxone available; constipation is expected; naloxone half-life is short.
鴉片類：呼吸<12次/分暫停給藥並通報；備妥naloxone；便秘為預期副作用；naloxone半衰期短。
Mannitol: do not use if crystals in vial; monitor for pulmonary edema, electrolytes and urine output.
Mannitol：瓶內有結晶勿使用；監測肺水腫、電解質與尿量。
Stimulants: give last dose 6 h before bed, no caffeine, monitor growth in children.
興奮劑：最後一劑睡前至少6小時、避免咖啡因、監測兒童生長。
Phenytoin toxicity ladder: 10-20 therapeutic, >20 nystagmus, >30 ataxia/slurred speech.
Phenytoin中毒階梯：10-20治療範圍、>20眼震、>30運動失調/口齒不清。
Anticholinergic effects: dry as a bone (mouth), blind as a bat (blurred vision), red-flushed, constipated, can't pee.
抗膽鹼副作用：口乾、視力模糊、皮膚潮紅、便秘、尿滯留。

Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
Bones: spongy bone handles multidirectional force; compact bone resists longitudinal force; length growth stops at ages 18-25; bone resorption speeds with aging.
骨骼：海綿骨承受多方向力量；緻密骨抗縱向力；長度生長在18-25歲停止；老化後骨質吸收加速。
Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
Joints: synarthrosis (fixed), amphiarthrosis (slightly movable), diarthrosis (synovial, free movement); synovial fluid lubricates and cushions.
關節：不動關節、微動關節、滑動關節（可自由活動）；滑液潤滑與緩衝。
Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
Muscle contraction needs ATP and calcium; acetylcholine from the motor end plate starts it and acetylcholinesterase breaks it down.
肌肉收縮需要ATP與鈣；運動終板釋放乙醯膽鹼啟動，乙醯膽鹼酯酶分解之。
Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
Bone healing stages: hematoma, granulation tissue, callus formation, ossification/remodeling, healing complete.
骨癒合階段：血腫、肉芽組織、骨痂形成、骨化/重塑、癒合完成。
Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
Risk factors: falls, calcium deficiency, postmenopause, obesity, medications, hyperuricemia, infection, autoimmune and neoplastic disease.
危險因子：跌倒、缺鈣、停經後、肥胖、藥物、高尿酸、感染、自體免疫與腫瘤疾病。
Anatomy, bone healing and risk factors
解剖、骨癒合與危險因子
X-ray/MRI: support the injured limb above and below the joint, give analgesia first, remove metal, screen for pregnancy; no pacemaker or magnetic implants for MRI.
X光/MRI：支托受傷肢體上下關節、事先給止痛、移除金屬、詢問懷孕；MRI不可有心律調節器或磁性植入物。
Arthrocentesis: consent, compression bandage, ice, rest joint 8-24 h; report fever or swelling; steroid injection may raise glucose in diabetics.
關節穿刺：同意書、壓縮繃帶、冰敷、關節休息8-24小時；發燒或腫脹要通報；類固醇注射可能使糖尿病人血糖升高。
Arthroscopy: fast 8-12 h, consent, neurovascular checks, compression bandage 2-4 days, elevate and ice; report fever, redness, drainage >3 days.
關節鏡：禁食8-12小時、同意書、神經血管評估、壓縮繃帶2-4天、抬高與冰敷；發燒、紅腫、引流超過3天要通報。
DXA measures bone density (minimal radiation); bone scan uses IV radioisotope, drink 32 oz fluid, void before scanning; no special precautions afterward.
DXA測骨密度（輻射極少）；骨掃描靜脈注射放射性同位素，需喝32盎司水、掃描前排尿；之後無特殊防護。
Biopsy: monitor bleeding, hematoma, infection, elevate site 24 h. EMG: needle insertion is uncomfortable; no stimulants or sedatives 24 h before.
切片：監測出血、血腫、感染、抬高部位24小時。肌電圖：針刺不適；檢查前24小時避免興奮劑或鎮靜劑。
Strain = overstretched muscle/tendon; sprain = stretched or torn ligament (twisting). Manage with RICE: rest, ice, compression, elevation.
拉傷＝肌肉/肌腱過度拉扯；扭傷＝韌帶拉傷或撕裂（扭轉）。以RICE處置：休息、冰敷、加壓、抬高。
Moderate sprains may need casting; severe ligament damage needs surgery.
中度扭傷可能需石膏；嚴重韌帶損傷需手術。
Rotator cuff tear: shoulder pain and inability to hold arm abducted (drop-arm); NSAIDs, PT, sling, ice/heat; surgery if complete tear.
旋轉肌袖撕裂：肩痛且無法維持手臂外展（落臂試驗）；NSAID、物理治療、吊帶、冷熱敷；完全撕裂需手術。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏

Findings: pain, deformity, crepitus, swelling, loss of function, spasm, neurovascular compromise. Immobilize first and check neurovascular status; cover an open fracture with a sterile dressing and splint.
表現：疼痛、變形、骨擦音、腫脹、功能喪失、痙攣、神經血管受損。先固定並評估神經血管；開放性骨折以無菌敷料覆蓋並夾板固定。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Closed reduction is manual; open reduction (ORIF) is surgical with plates, screws, pins or rods. External fixators need pin care and stability checks.
閉鎖性復位為手法；開放性復位（ORIF）為手術並用鋼板、螺釘、鋼釘或髓內釘。外固定器需針孔護理與穩定性檢查。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Traction: weights hang freely, never touch the floor; do not remove weights without order; ropes move freely in pulleys; keep alignment.
牽引：重量自由懸吊、不碰地；未經醫囑勿移除重量；繩索在滑輪中順暢；維持對位。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Skeletal traction 25-40 lb with pin site care; skin traction (Buck's) not more than 8-10 lb, foot of bed raised; balanced suspension keeps ~20 degree thigh angle.
骨骼牽引25-40磅並做針孔護理；皮膚牽引（Buck氏）不超過8-10磅、抬高床尾；平衡懸吊維持大腿約20度。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Plaster cast dries 24-72 h (synthetic ~20 min); handle with palms; cool hair dryer only; keep dry; elevate; turn every 1-2 h; do not insert objects.
石膏：乾燥需24-72小時（合成約20分鐘）；以手掌托持；僅用冷風吹風機；保持乾燥；抬高；每1-2小時翻動；勿塞入物品。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Watch for circulation problems (pain, swelling, discoloration, tingling, coolness, weak pulse) and infection (fever, hot spots, odor).
注意循環障礙（疼痛、腫脹、變色、刺痛、冰冷、脈搏弱）與感染（發燒、熱點、異味）。
Fractures, reduction, fixation, traction and casts
骨折、復位、固定、牽引與石膏
Fat embolism: restlessness, sudden dyspnea, chest pain, cough, hypoxemia, crackles, confusion; give oxygen, notify PHCP, prepare for ventilation.
脂肪栓塞：躁動、突發呼吸困難、胸痛、咳嗽、低血氧、囉音、意識混亂；給氧、通知醫師、準備呼吸器。
Acute compartment syndrome: pain unrelieved or worse, pain on passive movement, paresthesia, pallor; pulselessness is late; irreversible damage after 4-6 h; loosen dressings/bivalve cast, fasciotomy.
急性腔室症候群：疼痛無法緩解或加劇、被動活動疼痛、感覺異常、蒼白；無脈為晚期；4-6小時後可能不可逆；鬆開敷料/剖開石膏、筋膜切開術。
Osteomyelitis: fever >101 F, local pain, leukocytosis, high ESR; long-term IV antibiotics, surgery if resistant.
骨髓炎：發燒>101°F、局部疼痛、白血球與ESR升高；長期靜脈抗生素、抗藥者需手術。
Avascular necrosis: blood supply interrupted causing bone death; report pain/numbness.
缺血性壞死：血供中斷導致骨壞死；疼痛/麻木需通報。

Crutches fit: 2-3 finger widths below axilla, elbows flexed 20-30 degrees; never bear weight on axillae (brachial plexus injury); crutches placed 6-10 in diagonally forward; stand on affected side when assisting.
拐杖合適度：腋下留2-3指寬、肘彎20-30度；腋下勿承重（臂神經叢損傷）；拐杖置於斜前6-10吋；協助時站在患側。
Gaits: 2-point (partial weight, bilateral prostheses), 3-point (no/partial weight on one leg), 4-point (weight bearing both), swing-to/swing-through (strong arms).
步態：兩點（部分承重）、三點（患肢不/部分承重）、四點（雙腳可承重）、擺至/擺過（手臂有力）。
Stairs: up with the good leg first (up with the good); down with crutches and the affected leg first (down with the bad).
樓梯：上樓先出健腿；下樓先出拐杖與患腿。
Cane in hand on the unaffected side, handle at greater trochanter, 4-6 in from the foot; walker - all four points flat before weight bearing.
手杖拿在健側手、握把與大轉子同高、距足側4-6吋；助行器－四腳著地後再承重。
髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位
Intracapsular hip fracture: poor blood supply, treated with replacement or ORIF; extracapsular: traction then ORIF/nail.
囊內髖骨折：血供差，以置換或ORIF處理；囊外：牽引後ORIF/髓內釘。
髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位
Post-hip surgery: avoid hip flexion >90 degrees, adduction/crossing legs, internal rotation; avoid low chairs; keep leg aligned; monitor delirium, DVT, infection and neurovascular status.
髖部術後：避免髖屈曲>90度、內收/翹腳、內旋；避免低椅；維持肢體排列；監測譫妄、深部靜脈栓塞、感染與神經血管。
髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位
Total knee replacement: CPM as prescribed, analgesia before CPM, weight bearing with device as tolerated, avoid dangling leg; tranexamic acid reduces blood loss.
全膝關節置換：依醫囑使用CPM、CPM前給止痛、使用輔具依耐受承重、避免下垂；tranexamic acid減少失血。
髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位
Dislocation: asymmetry, pain, swelling; risks neurovascular compromise and avascular necrosis; reduce promptly then immobilize.
脫位：不對稱、疼痛、腫脹；風險為神經血管受損與缺血性壞死；及早復位後固定。
髖骨折、膝關節置換與脫位
Cervical herniation (C5-C6, C6-C7): pain to shoulder/arm, paresthesia; collar, heat/ice, bed rest, avoid neck flexion/rotation.
頸椎突出（C5-C6、C6-C7）：疼痛放射至肩臂、感覺異常；頸圈、冷熱敷、臥床、避免頸屈曲/旋轉。

Lumbar herniation (L4-L5, L5-S1): back pain radiating down leg (sciatica), worse with bending, lifting, coughing; sleep on side with pillow between flexed knees; neurological deterioration or bowel/bladder dysfunction needs urgent care.
腰椎突出（L4-L5、L5-S1）：下背痛放射至腿（坐骨神經痛）、彎腰、提重物、咳嗽加劇；側臥並屈膝間夾枕；神經惡化或大小便功能異常需緊急處理。

After cervical surgery: watch breathing, hoarseness (laryngeal nerve), hematoma; after lumbar surgery: sensation/movement of legs, urinary retention, ileus, CSF leak (clear drainage, glucose-positive), logroll.
頸椎術後：觀察呼吸、聲音沙啞（喉返神經）、血腫；腰椎術後：下肢感覺活動、尿滯留、腸阻塞、腦脊髓液漏（清澈、葡萄糖陽性）、軸線翻身。
Complications: hemorrhage, infection, phantom pain, flexion contractures; diabetics prone to wound separation and infection.
併發症：出血、感染、幻肢痛、屈曲攣縮；糖尿病人易傷口裂開與感染。

Never place a pillow under the residual limb (risk of hip flexion contracture); for the first 24 h elevate the foot of the bed, not a pillow, to reduce edema, then keep the bed flat; prone positioning as prescribed after 24-48 h; wrap with elastic bandage or shrinker, and rewrap immediately if it slips.
殘肢下勿墊枕頭（避免髖屈曲攣縮）；最初24小時應抬高床尾而非用枕頭以減少腫脹，之後維持床平；24-48小時後依醫囑採俯臥；以彈性繃帶或殘肢套包紮，鬆脫時立即重新包紮。
Above-knee: prevent external rotation with trochanter roll; below-knee: do not let limb hang, avoid long sitting.
膝上截肢：以轉子捲防外旋；膝下截肢：殘肢勿下垂、避免久坐。
Traumatic amputation: call 911, direct pressure, elevate, wrap part in a sealed bag placed in ice water (not directly on ice).
外傷性截肢：呼叫119、直接加壓、抬高、離斷部位裝密封袋置於冰水中（不直接接觸冰）。
類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風

RA: systemic autoimmune inflammation, morning stiffness >30 min, symmetric joint deformity, elevated ESR, positive rheumatoid factor; NSAIDs, DMARDs, glucocorticoids; balance rest and activity, heat/cold, joint protection.
類風濕性關節炎：全身性自體免疫發炎、晨僵>30分鐘、對稱性關節變形、ESR升高、類風濕因子陽性；NSAID、DMARD、類固醇；休息與活動平衡、冷熱敷、保護關節。
類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風
OA: cartilage loss in weight-bearing joints; pain worse after activity, relieved by rest; Heberden and Bouchard nodes; acetaminophen first, weight control; joint replacement when other measures fail.
退化性關節炎：負重關節軟骨流失；活動後痛加劇、休息緩解；Heberden與Bouchard結節；首選acetaminophen、控制體重；其他方法無效時行關節置換。
類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風
Osteoporosis: demineralization, silent until fracture; kyphosis, height loss; calcium, vitamin D, protein; weight-bearing exercise; avoid alcohol/smoking/coffee; fall prevention.
骨質疏鬆：骨質流失、骨折前無症狀；駝背、身高變矮；補充鈣、維生素D、蛋白質；負重運動；避免酒精/吸菸/咖啡；預防跌倒。
類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風

Gout: uric acid crystals, acute great-toe pain, tophi, renal stones; low-purine diet (avoid organ meats, wine, aged cheese), fluids 2000 mL/day, avoid alcohol and starvation diets, uric acid normal 2.7-8.5 mg/dL.
痛風：尿酸結晶、大拇趾急性劇痛、痛風石、腎結石；低普林飲食（避免內臟、酒、陳年起司）、水分2000 mL/日、避免酒精與飢餓飲食，尿酸正常2.7-8.5 mg/dL。
類風濕性關節炎、退化性關節炎、骨質疏鬆與痛風
Compartment syndrome: pain out of proportion/unrelieved, pain on passive stretch, paresthesia; pulselessness is late; notify PHCP immediately, loosen constrictive dressing/cast.
腔室症候群：疼痛與傷勢不成比例/無法緩解、被動拉伸痛、感覺異常；無脈為晚期；立即通知醫師、鬆開束縛敷料/石膏。
Fat embolism: sudden dyspnea, chest pain, restlessness/confusion, hypoxemia, crackles after long-bone fracture; give oxygen, notify PHCP.
脂肪栓塞：長骨骨折後突發呼吸困難、胸痛、躁動/意識混亂、低血氧、囉音；給氧並通知醫師。
Neurovascular checks: color, temperature, pulses, capillary refill, movement, sensation distal to injury or cast.
神經血管評估：傷處或石膏遠端顏色、溫度、脈搏、微血管充填、活動、感覺。
Wet plaster cast: palms only, 24-72 h to dry, cool dryer only, nothing inside cast; hot spot suggests infection.
濕石膏：僅用手掌、24-72小時乾燥、僅冷風、勿塞物；熱點提示感染。
Traction weights must hang freely; never lift or remove without order; Buck's traction max 8-10 lb.
牽引重量需自由懸吊；未經醫囑勿提起或移除；Buck氏牽引最多8-10磅。
Skeletal traction pin site: purulent drainage = infection; mild serous drainage and slight redness expected.
骨骼牽引針孔：膿性分泌物＝感染；輕微漿液性分泌物與微紅屬預期。
Hip surgery precautions: no flexion >90 degrees, no crossing legs, no internal rotation, avoid low chairs.
髖部手術注意：勿屈曲>90度、勿翹腳、勿內旋、避免低椅。
Crutches: 2-3 finger widths from axilla; axillary weight causes brachial plexus damage; up with good leg, down with bad.
拐杖：腋下2-3指寬；腋下承重造成臂神經叢損傷；上樓先健腿、下樓先患腿。
Cane goes on the unaffected side and moves with the affected leg.
手杖放健側並與患腿同時移動。

Amputation: never place a pillow under the residual limb (hip flexion contracture risk) - elevate the foot of the bed instead for the first 24 h; rewrap immediately with elastic bandage if it slips; prone positioning after 24-48 h also helps prevent hip contracture.
截肢：殘肢下勿墊枕頭（避免髖屈曲攣縮）－最初24小時應改以抬高床尾；彈性繃帶鬆脫須立即重新包紮；24-48小時後俯臥亦有助預防髖攣縮。
Disc surgery: logroll, watch for CSF leak, hoarseness after cervical surgery, bowel/bladder dysfunction.
椎間盤手術：軸線翻身、注意腦脊髓液漏、頸椎術後聲音沙啞、大小便功能異常。
RA: morning stiffness >30 min, positive rheumatoid factor (<60 IU/mL normal), elevated ESR.
類風濕性關節炎：晨僵>30分鐘、類風濕因子陽性（<60 IU/mL為正常）、ESR升高。
Osteoarthritis pain worsens with activity and improves with rest; RA stiffness improves with activity.
退化性關節炎活動後疼痛加劇、休息緩解；類風濕晨僵活動後改善。
Osteoporosis risk: age, female/postmenopausal, low calcium, smoking, alcohol, sedentary lifestyle, steroids, anticonvulsants.
骨質疏鬆危險因子：年齡、女性/停經後、低鈣、吸菸、酒精、久坐、類固醇、抗癲癇藥。
Gout: elevated uric acid; low-purine diet, fluids 2000 mL/day, avoid alcohol.
痛風：尿酸升高；低普林飲食、水分2000 mL/日、避免酒精。
Open fracture: cover with sterile dressing and splint before moving; at the scene keep victim still and do not reduce.
開放性骨折：移動前以無菌敷料覆蓋並夾板固定；現場讓傷者保持不動且勿自行復位。
Radioisotope bone scan: drink fluids, void before scan; no radiation precautions afterward.
骨掃描：多喝水、掃描前排尿；之後無需輻射防護。
RICE for sprains/strains: Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation.
扭傷/拉傷RICE：休息、冰敷、加壓、抬高。
Compartment syndrome 6 Ps: pain, pallor, paresthesia, paralysis, pulselessness (late), pressure/poikilothermia.
腔室症候群6P：疼痛、蒼白、感覺異常、麻痺、無脈（晚期）、壓力/皮溫改變。
Crutch stairs: 'Up with the good, down with the bad.'
拐杖上下樓：上樓先健腿、下樓先患腿。

Examples: baclofen, carisoprodol, chlorzoxazone, cyclobenzaprine, dantrolene, diazepam, metaxalone, methocarbamol, orphenadrine, tizanidine.
Action: central (depress spinal/brain neurons) or peripheral (dantrolene blocks calcium release in muscle); relieve spasm and spasticity.
作用：中樞性（抑制脊髓/腦神經元）或周邊性（dantrolene阻斷肌肉鈣釋放）；緩解痙攣與痙直。

Adverse effects: drowsiness, dizziness, hypotension, weakness, dry mouth, GI upset, photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity. Avoid alcohol and other CNS depressants; no driving; take with food; monitor LFTs.
不良反應：嗜睡、頭暈、低血壓、無力、口乾、腸胃不適、光敏感、肝毒性。避免酒精與其他中樞抑制劑；勿開車；隨餐服用；監測肝功能。
Baclofen: drowsiness, constipation, urinary retention; intrathecal pump - keep refill appointments, abrupt withdrawal can be life-threatening.
Baclofen：嗜睡、便秘、尿滯留；脊髓腔幫浦－按時回診補藥，突然停藥可致命。

Cyclobenzaprine: contraindicated within 14 days of MAOIs and in cardiac disorders; anticholinergic (caution with urinary retention, angle-closure glaucoma); short-term use 2-3 weeks. Orphenadrine has similar anticholinergic effects.
Cyclobenzaprine：MAO抑制劑14天內及心臟疾病者禁用；有抗膽鹼作用（尿滯留、閉角型青光眼慎用）；短期使用2-3週。Orphenadrine有類似抗膽鹼作用。
Dantrolene: most serious effect is liver damage (check LFTs before and during), GI bleeding, photosensitivity; report rash, tarry stools, jaundice.
Dantrolene：最嚴重為肝損傷（治療前後檢查肝功能）、消化道出血、光敏感；皮疹、黑便、黃疸需通報。

Methocarbamol: IV form can cause hypotension, bradycardia, seizures if rapid, extravasation injury; urine may turn brown, black or green. Chlorzoxazone: urine orange/red, hepatotoxic. Diazepam: sedation. Tizanidine and metaxalone: liver damage.
Methocarbamol：靜脈過快可致低血壓、心搏過緩、癲癇，注意外滲；尿液可能變棕、黑或綠。Chlorzoxazone：尿液橘/紅、肝毒性。Diazepam：鎮靜。Tizanidine與metaxalone：肝損傷。
Allopurinol and febuxostat reduce uric acid production; probenecid increases uric acid excretion (uricosuric); colchicine, NSAIDs and glucocorticoids treat acute attacks.
Allopurinol與febuxostat減少尿酸生成；probenecid促進尿酸排泄（排尿酸藥）；colchicine、NSAID與類固醇治療急性發作。
Adverse effects: headache, GI upset, bone marrow depression, rash, flushing, uric acid stones, sore gums, metallic taste.
不良反應：頭痛、腸胃不適、骨髓抑制、皮疹、潮紅、尿酸結石、牙齦痛、金屬味。
Teaching: fluids 2000-3000 mL/day, avoid alcohol, caffeine and high-purine foods (organ meats, sardines, salmon, scallops, gravy); take with food; no aspirin (raises uric acid).
衛教：水分2000-3000 mL/日、避免酒精、咖啡因與高普林食物（內臟、沙丁魚、鮭魚、干貝、肉汁）；隨餐服用；避免aspirin（升高尿酸）。

Allopurinol: raises warfarin and oral hypoglycemic effect; avoid large vitamin C doses (stones); rare hypersensitivity (rash, fever, eosinophilia, liver/kidney changes) - withhold and report; sun protection and annual eye exam.
Allopurinol：增強warfarin與口服降血糖藥效果；避免大量維生素C（結石）；罕見過敏症候群（皮疹、發燒、嗜酸性球增多、肝腎異常）－停藥並通報；防曬並每年眼科檢查。
Colchicine: caution in older, debilitated, cardiac, renal or GI disease; if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or abdominal pain develop, withhold and notify PHCP.
Colchicine：老年、體弱、心、腎或胃腸疾病者慎用；出現噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉或腹痛時停藥並通報。
Monitor serum uric acid, I&O, CBC, renal and liver function.
監測血清尿酸、輸出入量、CBC、腎與肝功能。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）
RA therapy: NSAIDs, glucocorticoids, conventional DMARDs and biologic DMARDs; early aggressive treatment preserves joints.
類風濕性關節炎治療：NSAID、類固醇、傳統DMARD與生物性DMARD；早期積極治療可保護關節。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）
Conventional DMARDs: methotrexate, leflunomide, hydroxychloroquine, azathioprine, cyclosporine, sulfasalazine, penicillamine; risks: infection, neutropenia, low platelets, liver damage.
傳統DMARD：methotrexate、leflunomide、hydroxychloroquine、azathioprine、cyclosporine、sulfasalazine、penicillamine；風險：感染、嗜中性球低下、血小板低下、肝損傷。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）
Biologics: abatacept, adalimumab, anakinra, etanercept, infliximab, rituximab (tofacitinib is a JAK inhibitor): injection-site reactions, serious infection/TB, malignancy risk.
生物製劑：abatacept、adalimumab、anakinra、etanercept、infliximab、rituximab（tofacitinib為JAK抑制劑）：注射部位反應、嚴重感染/結核、惡性腫瘤風險。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）

Drug-specific: methotrexate - hepatic fibrosis, marrow suppression, GI ulcers, pneumonitis; hydroxychloroquine - retinal damage (report vision changes); cyclosporine - nephrotoxicity; azathioprine - hepatitis, blood dyscrasias; leflunomide - hepatotoxic, reversible hair loss; etanercept - heart failure risk, demyelination; adalimumab - neurological injury signs; infliximab - infusion reactions and hepatotoxicity.
藥物特點：methotrexate－肝纖維化、骨髓抑制、胃腸潰瘍、肺炎；hydroxychloroquine－視網膜損傷（視覺改變需通報）；cyclosporine－腎毒性；azathioprine－肝炎、血液惡病質；leflunomide－肝毒性、可逆性落髮；etanercept－心衰竭風險、去髓鞘；adalimumab－神經損傷徵象；infliximab－輸注反應與肝毒性。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）
Gold salts: toxicity = pruritus, rash, metallic taste, stomatitis, diarrhea; antidote dimercaprol.
金鹽：毒性＝搔癢、皮疹、金屬味、口腔炎、腹瀉；解毒劑dimercaprol。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）

Nursing: baseline and ongoing WBC, neutrophil, platelet counts; teach infection signs; no live vaccines without PHCP approval; tofacitinib contraindicated with active infection, recent live vaccine, hepatic impairment, lactation.
護理：基礎與持續監測WBC、嗜中性球、血小板；教導感染徵象；未經醫師同意勿接種活性疫苗；tofacitinib於活動性感染、近期活性疫苗、肝功能不全、哺乳期禁用。
抗關節炎藥（DMARD與生物製劑）
Calcium and vitamin D support bone; antiresorptives: bisphosphonates, raloxifene, calcitonin, denosumab; anabolic: teriparatide, abaloparatide, romosozumab.
鈣與維生素D支持骨骼；抗骨吸收：雙磷酸鹽、raloxifene、calcitonin、denosumab；促進骨形成：teriparatide、abaloparatide、romosozumab。

Bisphosphonates (alendronate, risedronate, ibandronate, pamidronate, zoledronic acid): morning on empty stomach with a full glass of water, stay upright 30 min (60 min ibandronate); risk esophagitis, muscle pain, ocular problems; contraindicated with esophageal disorders or inability to stay upright.
雙磷酸鹽（alendronate、risedronate、ibandronate、pamidronate、zoledronic acid）：早晨空腹以一整杯水服用、保持直立30分鐘（ibandronate為60分鐘）；風險為食道炎、肌肉痛、眼部問題；食道疾病或無法直立者禁用。
Raloxifene: avoid with history of venous thromboembolism; stop 72 h before prolonged immobilization; avoid long periods of restricted activity such as travel.
Raloxifene：有靜脈血栓病史者避免；長時間不動前72小時停藥；避免旅途等長期不動。
Calcitonin-salmon: inhibits osteoclasts; alternate nostrils for nasal form; monitor for hypocalcemia.
Calcitonin-salmon：抑制蝕骨細胞；鼻噴劑輪流使用左右鼻孔；監測低血鈣。

Teriparatide: PTH analog stimulating osteoblasts, for high fracture risk, associated with bone cancer concern; abaloparatide: contraindicated with hypercalcemia/hyperparathyroidism, watch orthostatic hypotension within 4 h; romosozumab: MI and stroke risk; denosumab: monoclonal antibody.
Teriparatide：PTH類似物刺激造骨細胞，用於高骨折風險者，與骨癌疑慮相關；abaloparatide：高血鈣/副甲狀腺機能亢進者禁用，4小時內注意姿位性低血壓；romosozumab：心肌梗塞與中風風險；denosumab：單株抗體。
First-line: NSAIDs (ibuprofen, naproxen, aspirin, diclofenac, meloxicam, indomethacin, celecoxib) and acetaminophen.
Adjuncts: skeletal muscle relaxants, antidepressants, opioids as needed (see chapters 60 and 69).
輔助：骨骼肌鬆弛劑、抗憂鬱藥、必要時鴉片類（見第60、69章）。
NSAID cautions: GI bleeding, renal impairment, take with food; acetaminophen: liver toxicity above 4000 mg/day.
NSAID注意：胃腸出血、腎功能受損、隨餐服用；acetaminophen：每日超過4000 mg有肝毒性。
Baclofen intrathecal pump: missed refill causes abrupt withdrawal that can be life-threatening.
Baclofen脊髓腔幫浦：未回診補藥導致突然停藥，可能危及生命。
Cyclobenzaprine: contraindicated with MAOIs (within 14 days) and in cardiac disease; anticholinergic - caution in glaucoma and urinary retention; use 2-3 weeks only.
Cyclobenzaprine：禁與MAO抑制劑（14天內）併用、心臟疾病者禁用；抗膽鹼－青光眼與尿滯留慎用；僅用2-3週。
Dantrolene: hepatotoxicity - monitor liver function tests before and during therapy.
Dantrolene：肝毒性－治療前後監測肝功能。
IV methocarbamol: hypotension and bradycardia; give slowly; watch for extravasation.
靜脈methocarbamol：低血壓與心搏過緩；緩慢給予；注意外滲。
All muscle relaxants: avoid alcohol/CNS depressants and driving; fall and safety risk.
所有肌肉鬆弛劑：避免酒精/中樞抑制劑與開車；跌倒與安全風險。
Gout drugs: fluids 2000-3000 mL/day, low-purine diet, no aspirin; allopurinol - stop and report rash or fever.
抗痛風藥：水分2000-3000 mL/日、低普林飲食、避免aspirin；allopurinol－出現皮疹或發燒須停藥並通報。
Colchicine: stop and notify PHCP for nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; caution in renal, cardiac, GI disease.
Colchicine：噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、腹痛時停藥並通報；腎、心、胃腸疾病者慎用。
Allopurinol: avoid large vitamin C doses; potentiates warfarin.
Allopurinol：避免大量維生素C；增強warfarin效果。
DMARDs/biologics: monitor CBC (neutrophils, WBC, platelets), infection risk, TB, no live vaccines.
DMARD/生物製劑：監測CBC（嗜中性球、WBC、血小板）、感染風險、結核、避免活性疫苗。
Hydroxychloroquine: retinal damage; methotrexate: hepatic fibrosis, marrow suppression; cyclosporine: nephrotoxicity; gold toxicity antidote dimercaprol.
Hydroxychloroquine：視網膜損傷；methotrexate：肝纖維化、骨髓抑制；cyclosporine：腎毒性；金中毒解毒劑dimercaprol。
Bisphosphonates: morning, empty stomach, full glass of water, upright at least 30 min (60 min ibandronate); contraindicated with esophageal disorders.
雙磷酸鹽：早晨空腹、一整杯水、至少直立30分鐘（ibandronate為60分鐘）；食道疾病者禁用。
Raloxifene: stop 72 h before prolonged immobilization; contraindicated with history of venous thrombosis.
Raloxifene：長期不動前72小時停藥；有靜脈血栓病史者禁用。
Teriparatide and abaloparatide: anabolic bone agents; abaloparatide - orthostatic hypotension within 4 h, contraindicated in hypercalcemia.
Teriparatide與abaloparatide：促骨形成；abaloparatide－4小時內姿位性低血壓、高血鈣者禁用。
Acetaminophen and NSAIDs are first-line for musculoskeletal pain.
Acetaminophen與NSAID為肌肉骨骼疼痛第一線用藥。
Bisphosphonate rule: 'Up, Water, Empty' - upright 30 min, full glass of water, empty stomach in the morning.
雙磷酸鹽口訣：直立、一整杯水、空腹（早晨）。
Allopurinol 'blocks production', probenecid 'pushes it out', colchicine 'calms the attack'.
Allopurinol＝阻止生成；probenecid＝促進排出；colchicine＝緩解發作。

免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
The immune system defends against outside microbes and removes dead or damaged cells.
免疫系統抵禦外來微生物並清除死亡或受損細胞。
免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
T and B lymphocytes arise in bone marrow; T cells include helper, suppressor and cytotoxic types.
T與B淋巴球源自骨髓；T細胞包括輔助型、抑制型與細胞毒性型。
免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
Humoral (B cell, antibody) response is immediate and protects against acute bacterial and viral infection.
體液性（B細胞、抗體）反應迅速，防禦急性細菌與病毒感染。
免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
Cellular response is delayed (delayed hypersensitivity); involved in slow bacterial infections, autoimmunity, some allergies and graft rejection.
細胞性反應延遲（遲發型過敏）；與緩慢細菌感染、自體免疫、部分過敏及移植排斥有關。
免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
Innate immunity is present at birth (barriers, inflammation); acquired immunity is passive (maternal antibodies, serum) or active (disease, immunization).
先天免疫出生即有（屏障、發炎）；後天免疫分被動（母體抗體、血清）與主動（疾病、疫苗）。
免疫功能、反應與免疫類型
ANA: negative at 1:40 dilution; positive in most SLE (also scleroderma, RA) but not diagnostic alone; false positives occur.
ANA：1:40稀釋時為陰性；多數SLE為陽性（硬皮症、RA亦可）但不能單獨診斷；可有偽陽性。
Anti-dsDNA: specific to SLE, tracks disease activity; normal under 70 U/mL by ELISA.
Anti-dsDNA：對SLE具特異性、可追蹤疾病活性；ELISA正常小於70 U/mL。
CD4+ count: normal 500-1600 cells/uL; 200-499 immune problems; below 200 severe (AIDS criteria). CD4:CD8 ratio normally about 2:1.
CD4+計數：正常500-1600 cells/µL；200-499免疫出現問題；低於200為嚴重（AIDS標準）。CD4:CD8比值正常約2:1。
HIV testing: maintain confidentiality; reactive screening test needs confirmation; viral load measures HIV RNA; p24 antigen assay; oral test uses oral transmucosal fluid and needs blood confirmation.
HIV檢測：保密；篩檢陽性需確認；病毒量測HIV RNA；p24抗原檢驗；口腔試驗用口腔黏膜滲出液，陽性需血液確認。

Skin testing: stop systemic steroids/antihistamines 5 days prior as prescribed; consent; observe 30 min; anaphylaxis equipment ready; measure wheal and erythema (1+ about 0.5 cm to 4+ about 2.0 cm); record site, date, time.
皮膚試驗：依醫囑前5天停用全身性類固醇/抗組織胺；同意書；觀察30分鐘；備妥過敏性休克急救設備；測量風團與紅暈（1+約0.5 cm至4+約2.0 cm）；記錄部位、日期、時間。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏
Allergy: abnormal response to normally harmless substances, often on second exposure; manage with allergen identification, antihistamines, anti-inflammatories, corticosteroids, desensitization.
過敏：對一般無害物質的異常反應，常於再次接觸時出現；處置包括辨識過敏原、抗組織胺、抗發炎藥、類固醇、減敏治療。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏
Anaphylaxis (type I, IgE-mediated): airway compromise, stridor, wheeze, hypotension, urticaria, angioedema, GI cramps, sense of doom.
過敏性休克（第一型、IgE媒介）：呼吸道受阻、喘鳴、哮鳴、低血壓、蕁麻疹、血管性水腫、腹絞痛、瀕死感。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏

Anaphylaxis actions: assess airway/breathing, stay with client, call PHCP and rapid response, stop the suspect infusion, start IV normal saline, oxygen, raise HOB if BP normal, prepare epinephrine and diphenhydramine, intubation equipment ready.
過敏性休克處置：評估呼吸道/呼吸、不離開病人、呼叫醫師與快速反應小組、停止可疑輸注、建立靜脈輸注生理食鹽水、給氧、血壓正常時抬高床頭、準備epinephrine與diphenhydramine、備妥插管設備。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏

Latex allergy: type I (anaphylaxis) or type IV delayed contact dermatitis (6-48 h); risk groups: health care workers, rubber industry, multiple surgeries, spina bifida, frequent glove users; cross-reactive foods: banana, kiwi, avocado, chestnut, tropical fruits.
乳膠過敏：第一型（過敏性休克）或第四型遲發接觸性皮膚炎（6-48小時）；高風險：醫療人員、橡膠工業、多次手術、脊柱裂、常戴手套者；交叉反應食物：香蕉、奇異果、酪梨、栗子、熱帶水果。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏
Latex precautions: ask about allergy, nonlatex gloves, latex-safe cart, glass ampules/avoid rubber-stopper vials, cloth barrier under BP cuff, MedicAlert bracelet, epinephrine pen.
乳膠防護：詢問過敏史、使用無乳膠手套、備乳膠安全物品車、使用玻璃安瓿/避免橡膠瓶塞、血壓計袖套下墊布、醫療警示手環、攜帶epinephrine筆。
過敏、過敏性休克與乳膠過敏
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
Immunodeficiency (primary or secondary): infection is the priority concern; strict asepsis, balanced diet, infection prevention teaching, MedicAlert.
免疫不全（原發或續發）：感染為首要顧慮；嚴格無菌技術、均衡飲食、感染預防衛教、醫療警示。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病

SLE: malar (butterfly) rash, discoid rash, photosensitivity, oral ulcers, joint pain, fatigue, anemia; positive ANA, anti-dsDNA, high ESR/CRP; lupus nephritis early (proteinuria, red cell casts, monitor BUN/creatinine).
SLE：蝶形紅斑、盤狀疹、光敏感、口腔潰瘍、關節痛、疲倦、貧血；ANA與anti-dsDNA陽性、ESR/CRP升高；狼瘡腎炎早期（蛋白尿、紅血球圓柱、監測BUN/肌酸酐）。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
SLE care: avoid sun/UV, mild soap, pace activity, avoid hot baths and long inactivity, corticosteroids, NSAIDs, hydroxychloroquine, plasmapheresis, emotional support.
SLE照護：避免日曬/紫外線、溫和肥皂、活動節奏、避免熱水澡與久不活動、類固醇、NSAID、hydroxychloroquine、血漿置換、情緒支持。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病

Scleroderma: taut shiny skin, pitting hand edema, dysphagia, contractures; small frequent meals, sit up 1-2 h after meals, constant room temperature, avoid fingersticks and cold extremes, no smoking, corticosteroids.
硬皮症：皮膚緊繃光亮、手部凹陷性水腫、吞嚥困難、攣縮；少量多餐、餐後直坐1-2小時、室溫恆定、避免指尖採血與極端低溫、戒菸、類固醇。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
Polyarteritis nodosa: systemic vasculitis; fever, severe abdominal pain, bloody diarrhea, high ESR; renal/cardiac involvement; treated like SLE.
結節性多動脈炎：全身性血管炎；發燒、劇烈腹痛、血便、ESR升高；腎臟/心臟受累；治療類似SLE。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
Pemphigus: autoimmune flaccid bullae, Nikolsky's sign, oral lesions, infection risk; corticosteroids, cytotoxics, antibiotics for secondary infection, oral hygiene.
天疱瘡：自體免疫鬆弛性水泡、Nikolsky氏徵象、口腔病灶、感染風險；類固醇、細胞毒性藥物、續發感染用抗生素、口腔衛生。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
Goodpasture's: antibodies against glomerular and alveolar basement membranes; hemoptysis, hematuria, dyspnea, edema, HTN; corticosteroids, plasmapheresis, azathioprine, stop smoking.
Goodpasture氏症候群：針對腎絲球與肺泡基底膜的自體抗體；咳血、血尿、呼吸困難、水腫、高血壓；類固醇、血漿置換、azathioprine、戒菸。
免疫不全與自體免疫疾病
Caused by Borrelia burgdorferi from tick bite; the ring-shaped rash (erythema migrans) does not always occur and may appear away from the bite.
由蜱（壁蝨）叮咬傳播的Borrelia burgdorferi所致；環狀紅斑（移行性紅斑）不一定出現，可出現在非叮咬處。
Stage 1: red papule/ring rash, flu-like symptoms; stage 2 (weeks): joint pain, meningitis, facial palsy, cardiac dysrhythmias; stage 3: large-joint arthritis.
第一期：紅丘疹/環狀紅斑、類流感症狀；第二期（數週）：關節痛、腦膜炎、顏面麻痺、心律不整；第三期：大關節關節炎。
Remove tick with tweezers close to the skin, pull steadily upward, clean with antiseptic; do not burn it. Blood test reliable 4-6 weeks after bite.
以鑷子貼近皮膚夾住蜱並穩定向上拔除、以消毒劑清潔；勿燒灼。血液檢驗於叮咬後4-6週較可靠。
Treatment: doxycycline, cefuroxime or amoxicillin; erythromycin if penicillin-allergic; start promptly.
治療：doxycycline、cefuroxime或amoxicillin；青黴素過敏者用erythromycin；及早開始。
Prevention: DEET repellent, long sleeves/pants, light-colored clothing, tuck pants into socks, permethrin on gear, tick checks, stay in trail center.
預防：DEET驅蟲劑、長袖長褲、淺色衣物、褲管塞入襪內、裝備噴permethrin、檢查蜱蟲、走在步道中央。
HIV destroys CD4 T cells; AIDS is diagnosed with CD4 <200 or an AIDS-defining opportunistic infection/cancer; long incubation period; now a chronic illness.
HIV破壞CD4 T細胞；CD4<200或出現AIDS定義之伺機性感染/癌症即診斷AIDS；潛伏期長；現為慢性疾病。
Findings: fever, malaise, weight loss, night sweats, lymphadenopathy >3 months, diarrhea, leukopenia, opportunistic infections.
表現：發燒、倦怠、體重減輕、盜汗、淋巴結腫大>3個月、腹瀉、白血球低下、伺機性感染。
Opportunistic: Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia (major cause of death), candidiasis, CMV, herpes, TB, toxoplasmosis, PML; Kaposi's sarcoma, lymphomas, invasive cervical cancer.
伺機性：肺囊蟲肺炎（主要死因）、念珠菌、CMV、疱疹、結核、弓漿蟲、進行性多灶性白質腦病；卡波西氏肉瘤、淋巴瘤、侵襲性子宮頸癌。
Labs: decreased CD4, reduced CD4:CD8 ratio, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, increased IgG/IgA, anergy; viral load measures therapy effectiveness.
檢驗：CD4下降、CD4:CD8比值降低、淋巴球減少、血小板低下、IgG/IgA上升、無反應性；病毒量評估治療效果。
Nursing: respiratory support, standard precautions, protective measures when immunosuppressed, skin care, nutrition, fluid balance, psychosocial support, confidentiality.
護理：呼吸支持、標準防護、免疫低下時保護措施、皮膚護理、營養、體液平衡、心理社會支持、保密。
Kaposi's sarcoma: raised purplish/red-brown lesions on skin and organs; radiation, chemotherapy, antivirals, keep lesions clean; use gown and gloves for bathing/linen if draining.
卡波西氏肉瘤：皮膚與內臟紫紅/紅褐色隆起病灶；放射、化療、抗病毒藥、保持病灶清潔；有滲液時沐浴/換床單穿隔離衣與戴手套。
Lifelong immunosuppressants prevent organ rejection but create secondary immunodeficiency.
終生免疫抑制劑可預防器官排斥，但造成續發性免疫不全。
Monitor renal and hepatic function, CBC with differential, body secretions for blood; assess for opportunistic infection and rejection.
監測腎肝功能、CBC與分類、體液是否有血；評估伺機性感染與排斥。
High-risk: history of malignancy, recent TB, herpes zoster or varicella exposure.
高風險：惡性腫瘤病史、近期結核、帶狀疱疹或水痘暴露。
Use strict asepsis, protective isolation as needed, and teach infection and rejection signs plus medication adherence.
嚴格無菌技術、必要時保護性隔離，並教導感染與排斥徵象及規則服藥。
Anaphylaxis: airway first, stay with client, stop the causative infusion, call rapid response, IV NS, oxygen, epinephrine, diphenhydramine; HOB up if BP normal.
過敏性休克：先顧呼吸道、不離開病人、停止致敏輸注、呼叫快速反應、靜脈生理食鹽水、給氧、epinephrine、diphenhydramine；血壓正常時抬高床頭。
Skin testing: observe 30 min with anaphylaxis equipment; hold steroids/antihistamines 5 days prior; measure (not estimate) wheal.
皮膚試驗：觀察30分鐘並備急救設備；前5天停類固醇/抗組織胺；測量（非估計）風團。
Latex allergy: nonlatex gloves, latex-safe cart, avoid rubber-stoppered vials; cross-reaction with banana, kiwi, avocado, chestnut.
乳膠過敏：無乳膠手套、乳膠安全車、避免橡膠瓶塞藥瓶；與香蕉、奇異果、酪梨、栗子交叉反應。
Immunodeficiency priority: protect from infection (strict asepsis).
免疫不全首要：預防感染（嚴格無菌技術）。
SLE: butterfly rash, photosensitivity, positive ANA and anti-dsDNA; monitor for lupus nephritis (BUN, creatinine, proteinuria).
SLE：蝶形紅斑、光敏感、ANA與anti-dsDNA陽性；監測狼瘡腎炎（BUN、肌酸酐、蛋白尿）。
SLE fatigue teaching: avoid hot baths and long inactivity, schedule exercise when not fatigued, conserve energy, avoid sun.
SLE疲倦衛教：避免熱水澡與久不活動、不疲倦時運動、節省體力、避免日曬。
Scleroderma: sit upright 1-2 h after meals, avoid fingersticks and cold, constant room temperature, corticosteroids.
硬皮症：餐後直坐1-2小時、避免指尖採血與寒冷、室溫恆定、類固醇。
Pemphigus: flaccid blisters, positive Nikolsky's sign; risk of infection; corticosteroids.
天疱瘡：鬆弛性水泡、Nikolsky氏徵象陽性；感染風險；類固醇。
Goodpasture's: lung plus kidney involvement (hemoptysis, hematuria); plasmapheresis; stop smoking.
Goodpasture氏：肺與腎受累（咳血、血尿）；血漿置換；戒菸。
Lyme disease: remove tick with tweezers, do not burn; test 4-6 weeks after bite; treat with doxycycline/cefuroxime/amoxicillin early.
萊姆病：以鑷子拔蜱、勿燒灼；叮咬後4-6週檢驗；及早以doxycycline/cefuroxime/amoxicillin治療。
CD4 normal 500-1600 cells/uL; <200 = AIDS criterion; viral load assesses treatment effectiveness.
CD4正常500-1600 cells/µL；<200＝AIDS標準；病毒量評估治療效果。
PCP (Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia) is a major cause of death in AIDS; Kaposi's sarcoma = purplish skin lesions, confirmed by punch biopsy.
肺囊蟲肺炎為AIDS主要死因之一；卡波西氏肉瘤＝紫紅皮膚病灶、以穿刺切片確診。
HIV confidentiality: positive tests need confirmation and state reporting per protocol.
HIV保密：陽性結果需確認並依規定通報。
Posttransplant: lifelong immunosuppression, strict asepsis, teach rejection and infection signs.
移植後：終生免疫抑制、嚴格無菌、教導排斥與感染徵象。
Draining Kaposi's lesions: gown and gloves for contact with drainage.
卡波西氏病灶有滲液：接觸滲液時穿隔離衣並戴手套。
Type I hypersensitivity = IgE on mast cells, immediate histamine release; type IV = delayed T-cell (6-48 h), e.g., latex contact dermatitis.
第一型過敏＝肥大細胞上IgE、立即釋放組織胺；第四型＝延遲T細胞反應（6-48小時），如乳膠接觸性皮膚炎。

Drug classes: NRTIs, NNRTIs, protease inhibitors (PIs), integrase inhibitors, fusion inhibitor (enfuvirtide) and the CCR5 antagonist maraviroc.
藥物類別：核苷(酸)類逆轉錄酶抑制劑 NRTI、非核苷類 NNRTI、蛋白酶抑制劑 PI、整合酶抑制劑、融合抑制劑 enfuvirtide，以及 CCR5 拮抗劑 maraviroc。

NRTIs and NNRTIs block reverse transcriptase; PIs block the enzyme protease; fusion inhibitors block HIV binding/entry into cells; maraviroc binds CCR5 and blocks viral entry; integrase inhibitors stop viral replication.
NRTI 與 NNRTI 抑制逆轉錄酶；PI 抑制蛋白酶；融合抑制劑阻止 HIV 與細胞結合；maraviroc 結合 CCR5 阻斷病毒進入；整合酶抑制劑阻止病毒複製。
Standard therapy is 3-4 drugs together (HAART). It is not a cure, but it delays or reverses immune loss and prolongs life.
標準治療是同時使用 3–4 種藥物（HAART）。它不能治癒，但可延緩或逆轉免疫功能喪失並延長壽命。
Other drugs treat complications and opportunistic infections; the client with HIV/AIDS is at high risk of opportunistic infection.
其他藥物用於治療併發症與伺機性感染；HIV/AIDS 客戶有高度伺機性感染風險。
Abacavir: nausea; watch for hypersensitivity (fever, rash, N/V/D, malaise, sore throat, cough, dyspnea).
Abacavir：噁心；監測過敏反應（發燒、皮疹、噁心嘔吐腹瀉、倦怠、喉痛、咳嗽、呼吸困難）。
Didanosine: peripheral neuropathy, hepatotoxicity, pancreatitis (rising serum amylase may mean drug must be stopped).
Didanosine：周邊神經病變、肝毒性、胰臟炎（血清澱粉酶上升可能需停藥）。
Stavudine: peripheral neuropathy and pancreatitis; check gait and paresthesias.
Stavudine：周邊神經病變與胰臟炎；評估步態與感覺異常。
Zidovudine and lamivudine/zidovudine: anemia, neutropenia/leukopenia, myopathy; combinations may add lactic acidosis with severe hepatomegaly.
Zidovudine 及 lamivudine/zidovudine：貧血、嗜中性球/白血球減少、肌病變；複方可能併有乳酸中毒與嚴重肝腫大。
Emtricitabine: headache, diarrhea, nausea, rash, palm/sole hyperpigmentation, lactic acidosis. Lamivudine: nausea, nasal congestion. Tenofovir: nausea and vomiting.
Emtricitabine：頭痛、腹瀉、噁心、皮疹、手掌腳底色素沉著、乳酸中毒。Lamivudine：噁心、鼻塞。Tenofovir：噁心嘔吐。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑
NNRTIs: rash is the common theme; nevirapine can cause Stevens-Johnson syndrome and hepatitis; efavirenz causes dizziness, confusion, abnormal dreams; etravirine adds hypertension and neuropathy.
NNRTI：共通特徵是皮疹；nevirapine 可致 Stevens-Johnson 症候群與肝炎；efavirenz 造成頭暈、意識混亂、怪夢；etravirine 另有高血壓與神經病變。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑
Protease inhibitors (-navir): GI upset, altered taste, circumoral paresthesia, hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, fat redistribution, liver effects.
蛋白酶抑制劑（-navir）：腸胃不適、味覺改變、口周感覺異常、高血糖、高血脂、脂肪重新分佈、肝功能異常。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑
Specific PIs: indinavir causes kidney stones/nephritis and hyperbilirubinemia; tipranavir is hepatotoxic; saquinavir causes photosensitivity; atazanavir raises bleeding risk in hemophilia.
特定 PI：indinavir 造成腎結石/腎炎與高膽紅素血症；tipranavir 有肝毒性；saquinavir 造成光敏感；atazanavir 使血友病患出血風險增加。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑
Integrase inhibitors (-gravir): nausea, diarrhea, headache, fatigue; dolutegravir: hypersensitivity and liver problems.
整合酶抑制劑（-gravir）：噁心、腹瀉、頭痛、疲倦；dolutegravir 可致過敏與肝問題。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑

Enfuvirtide (fusion inhibitor, injected): injection-site reactions, fatigue, insomnia, peripheral neuropathy. Maraviroc: cough, fever, rash, upper respiratory infection, liver injury, cardiovascular events.
Enfuvirtide（注射）：注射部位反應、疲倦、失眠、周邊神經病變。Maraviroc：咳嗽、發燒、皮疹、上呼吸道感染、肝損傷、心血管事件。
NNRTIs, protease inhibitors, integrase, fusion, CCR5
NNRTI、PI、整合酶、融合與 CCR5 抑制劑
Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia and toxoplasma encephalitis: sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim (also pentamidine, atovaquone).
肺囊蟲肺炎與弓形蟲腦炎：sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim（亦可用 pentamidine、atovaquone）。
Antifungals (amphotericin B, fluconazole, itraconazole, ketoconazole, voriconazole): candidiasis and cryptococcal meningitis.
抗黴菌藥（amphotericin B、fluconazole、itraconazole、ketoconazole、voriconazole）：念珠菌感染與隱球菌腦膜炎。
Antivirals (acyclovir, ganciclovir, foscarnet, valacyclovir): CMV retinitis, herpes simplex, varicella-zoster.
抗病毒藥（acyclovir、ganciclovir、foscarnet、valacyclovir）：CMV 視網膜炎、單純疱疹、水痘帶狀疱疹。
Fever during pentamidine therapy in AIDS suggests a new infection because the drug can cause leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and anemia.
AIDS 客戶使用 pentamidine 時發燒，應考慮新的感染，因藥物可造成白血球、血小板減少與貧血。
Uses: prevent organ/tissue rejection after transplant and treat autoimmune disease (e.g., lupus). Classes: calcineurin inhibitors, cytotoxic drugs, antibodies, mTOR/other drugs, glucocorticoids.
用途：預防移植排斥並治療自體免疫疾病（如狼瘡）。類別：calcineurin 抑制劑、細胞毒性藥、抗體、mTOR/其他、糖皮質激素。
Cyclosporine: nephrotoxicity, infection, hypertension, hirsutism. Tacrolimus: nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, hyperkalemia, hyperglycemia, hypertension, gum hyperplasia.
Cyclosporine：腎毒性、感染、高血壓、多毛。Tacrolimus：腎毒性、神經毒性、高血鉀、高血糖、高血壓、牙齦增生。

Azathioprine: neutropenia, thrombocytopenia (renal transplant). Cyclophosphamide: neutropenia, hemorrhagic cystitis. Methotrexate: hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis, bone marrow suppression, stomatitis, renal damage.
Azathioprine：嗜中性球與血小板減少（腎移植）。Cyclophosphamide：嗜中性球減少、出血性膀胱炎。Methotrexate：肝纖維化/肝硬化、骨髓抑制、口腔潰瘍、腎損傷。

Mycophenolate: diarrhea, vomiting, neutropenia, sepsis, lymphoma risk. Basiliximab: severe acute hypersensitivity, including anaphylaxis. Antithymocyte/lymphocyte immune globulin and muromonab-CD3: fever, chills, leukopenia, skin reactions, and anaphylactoid reactions.
Mycophenolate：腹瀉、嘔吐、嗜中性球減少、敗血症、淋巴瘤風險。Basiliximab：嚴重急性過敏反應，包括過敏性休克。抗胸腺細胞/淋巴細胞球蛋白與 muromonab-CD3：發燒、畏寒、白血球減少、皮膚反應，以及類過敏反應。
Sirolimus: infection, elevated cholesterol/triglycerides, renal injury, rash, anemia, thrombocytopenia, hypokalemia. Everolimus: mouth sores, edema, infection.
Sirolimus：感染、膽固醇與三酸甘油酯上升、腎損傷、皮疹、貧血、血小板減少、低血鉀。Everolimus：口腔潰瘍、水腫、感染。
Monitor all immunosuppressed clients closely for signs of infection.
所有免疫抑制客戶都要密切監測感染徵象。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Aminoglycosides (-mycin/-micin, e.g., gentamicin, amikacin): ototoxicity, nephrotoxicity, confusion, GI irritation, palpitations, BP changes, hypersensitivity. Report hearing loss at once.
胺基糖苷類（如 gentamicin、amikacin）：耳毒性、腎毒性、意識混亂、腸胃刺激、心悸、血壓變化、過敏。聽力減退須立即通報。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Cephalosporins (cef-/ceph-): GI upset, pseudomembranous colitis, nephrotoxicity, superinfection. Fluoroquinolones (-floxacin): CNS effects, photosensitivity, tendinopathy, GI effects.
頭孢菌素類：腸胃不適、偽膜性結腸炎、腎毒性、二重感染。氟喹諾酮類（-floxacin）：中樞神經效應、光敏感、肌腱病變、腸胃效應。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Macrolides (-thromycin) and lincosamides (clindamycin): GI effects, pseudomembranous colitis, superinfection.
大環內酯類（-thromycin）與林可醯胺類（clindamycin）：腸胃效應、偽膜性結腸炎、二重感染。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應

Penicillins: hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis, GI effects, sore mouth, furry tongue, superinfection. Sulfonamides: nephrotoxicity, hepatotoxicity, bone marrow suppression, rash/photosensitivity, neurologic symptoms.
青黴素類：過敏/過敏性休克、腸胃效應、口腔痛、毛舌、二重感染。磺胺類：腎毒性、肝毒性、骨髓抑制、皮疹/光敏感、神經症狀。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Tetracyclines (-cycline): tooth staining and bone damage, photosensitivity, hepatotoxicity, GI effects. Aztreonam: GI, hepatotoxicity, allergy.
四環黴素類（-cycline）：牙齒染色與骨骼傷害、光敏感、肝毒性、腸胃效應。Aztreonam：腸胃、肝毒性、過敏。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Antifungals: GI effects, headache, rash, anemia, hepatotoxicity, hearing loss, peripheral neuritis. Ketoconazole: give with food, avoid alcohol, antacids 2 h apart, avoid sun, monitor liver function.
抗黴菌藥：腸胃效應、頭痛、皮疹、貧血、肝毒性、聽力喪失、周邊神經炎。Ketoconazole：隨餐服用、避免酒精、制酸劑間隔 2 小時、避免日曬、監測肝功能。
抗微生物藥：類別與不良反應
Assess for allergies before the first dose and review baseline labs; monitor labs during therapy.
首次給藥前評估過敏史並檢視基準檢驗值；治療期間持續監測。
Report adverse effects to the primary health care provider; monitor intake and output and encourage fluids unless contraindicated.
通報不良反應給醫師；監測輸入輸出量，除非禁忌否則鼓勵飲水。
Institute safety precautions for CNS effects; teach how to take the drug and to finish the full course.
因可能有中樞神經效應，採取安全措施；教導用藥方式並強調完成整個療程。
Severe diarrhea on a cephalosporin: contact precautions, monitor fluid/electrolytes, oral fluids (avoid caffeine, sugar, fatty/spicy food), ask the provider about probiotics and antidiarrheals.
使用頭孢菌素後嚴重腹瀉：接觸隔離、監測體液電解質、口服補液（避免咖啡因、高糖、油膩辛辣）、詢問醫師是否使用益生菌與止瀉藥。
疫苗接種請見第 19 章。
Didanosine: pancreatitis. Serum amylase rising to 1.5-2x normal may require stopping the drug; also hepatotoxic.
Didanosine：胰臟炎。血清澱粉酶升到正常 1.5–2 倍可能需停藥；亦有肝毒性。
Stavudine and didanosine: peripheral neuropathy; assess gait and paresthesia.
Stavudine 與 didanosine：周邊神經病變；評估步態與麻木感。
Abacavir: hypersensitivity reaction (fever, rash, GI, respiratory symptoms) is the red flag.
Abacavir：過敏反應（發燒、皮疹、腸胃與呼吸症狀）為警訊。
Zidovudine: anemia and leukopenia (the lamivudine/zidovudine combination can also add neutropenia); monitor CBC.
Zidovudine：貧血與白血球減少（與 lamivudine 併用時可能再併發嗜中性球減少）；監測全血球計數。
NRTI combos: lactic acidosis with severe hepatomegaly.
NRTI 複方：乳酸中毒併嚴重肝腫大。
Nevirapine: rash can progress to Stevens-Johnson syndrome; also hepatitis.
Nevirapine：皮疹可進展為 Stevens-Johnson 症候群；亦可能肝炎。
Protease inhibitors: hyperglycemia, hyperlipidemia, fat redistribution; indinavir causes kidney stones (hydrate).
蛋白酶抑制劑：高血糖、高血脂、脂肪重新分佈；indinavir 造成腎結石（需充足補水）。
HAART is not a cure; it is lifelong, combination therapy.
HAART 非治癒，是終身的合併療法。
Cyclosporine and tacrolimus: nephrotoxicity and hypertension; a headache in a client on cyclosporine should prompt a BP check.
Cyclosporine 與 tacrolimus：腎毒性與高血壓；服用 cyclosporine 者頭痛應先量血壓。
Tacrolimus：亦可致高血鉀與高血糖。
Cyclophosphamide: hemorrhagic cystitis (hydrate). Methotrexate: liver, marrow, mucosa, kidney.
Cyclophosphamide：出血性膀胱炎（須補水）。Methotrexate：肝、骨髓、黏膜、腎。
Basiliximab and antithymocyte globulin: anaphylaxis risk; monitor during infusion.
Basiliximab 與抗胸腺細胞球蛋白：有過敏性休克風險；輸注期間監測。
Aminoglycosides: ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity. Report hearing loss, tinnitus, or decreased urine output immediately.
胺基糖苷類：耳毒性與腎毒性。聽力減退、耳鳴或尿量減少須立即通報。
Tetracyclines: teeth staining; avoid in pregnancy and young children; photosensitivity.
四環黴素類：牙齒染色；孕婦與幼童避免；光敏感。
Cephalosporins/clindamycin/macrolides: severe diarrhea may be pseudomembranous colitis (C. difficile) - contact precautions.
頭孢菌素/clindamycin/大環內酯類：嚴重腹瀉可能是偽膜性結腸炎（C. difficile）——接觸隔離。
Ketoconazole: hepatotoxic; give with food, avoid alcohol, sun and antacids.
Ketoconazole：肝毒性；隨餐服用，避免酒精、日曬與制酸劑。
Always check allergies first (especially penicillins and sulfonamides) and complete the entire antibiotic course.
務必先確認過敏史（尤其青黴素與磺胺類），並完成整個抗生素療程。

Drug-name stems: -navir = protease inhibitor; -vir (acyclovir etc.) = antiviral; -gravir = integrase inhibitor; -floxacin = fluoroquinolone; -cycline = tetracycline; -mycin/-micin = aminoglycoside (macrolides end -thromycin); cef-/ceph- = cephalosporin; -azole = antifungal.
藥名字尾：-navir＝蛋白酶抑制劑；-vir＝抗病毒；-gravir＝整合酶抑制劑；-floxacin＝氟喹諾酮；-cycline＝四環黴素；-mycin/-micin＝胺基糖苷（大環內酯為 -thromycin）；cef-/ceph-＝頭孢菌素；-azole＝抗黴菌。
Ototoxic/nephrotoxic pair for aminoglycosides: 'Ears and Kidneys'. Neuropathy pair: 'd4T and ddI hurt the nerves and pancreas' (stavudine, didanosine).
胺基糖苷「耳與腎」。周邊神經病變與胰臟炎：stavudine、didanosine（d4T、ddI）。
A client with AIDS who is receiving didanosine has laboratory results returned. Which result is most concerning and may lead to stopping the drug?
正在使用 didanosine 的 AIDS 客戶檢驗結果回報，哪一項最令人擔憂而可能需停藥？
Which adverse effects should the nurse monitor for in a client receiving an aminoglycoside? Select all that apply.
接受胺基糖苷類的客戶，護理師應監測哪些不良反應？（複選）
A client taking cyclosporine after a kidney transplant reports a headache. Which vital sign should the nurse check first?
腎移植後服用 cyclosporine 的客戶主訴頭痛，護理師應先檢查哪項生命徵象？
The nurse is teaching a client who will start ketoconazole for candidiasis. Which instructions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
護理師衛教即將因念珠菌感染使用 ketoconazole 的客戶，哪些指導適當？（複選）
A client on stavudine should be monitored most closely for which problem?
服用 stavudine 的客戶最需密切監測哪項問題？
A client taking amikacin should be told to contact the provider immediately for which symptom?
服用 amikacin 的客戶出現何種症狀應立即聯絡醫師？
A client taking an NNRTI begins to develop a diffuse rash with fever and mouth sores. Which drug is most likely responsible and what is the concern?
服用 NNRTI 的客戶出現廣泛皮疹、發燒與口腔潰瘍，最可能的藥物與疑慮為何？
A client on a cephalosporin develops profuse watery diarrhea. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
使用頭孢菌素的客戶發生大量水瀉，哪些護理措施適當？（複選）
Box 64.1 lists every HIV/AIDS drug by class, including opportunistic-infection drugs. Use it to sort names into classes.
方框 64.1 依類別列出所有 HIV/AIDS 藥物，包括伺機性感染用藥；可用來歸類藥名。
Box 64.2 lists immunosuppressant classes (calcineurin inhibitors, cytotoxic drugs, antibodies, others).
方框 64.2 列出免疫抑制劑類別（calcineurin 抑制劑、細胞毒性藥、抗體、其他）。
Box 64.3 and Table 64.1: antimicrobial classes with their adverse effects, the core review table.
方框 64.3 與表 64.1：抗微生物藥類別與其不良反應，為本章核心整理表。
Core qualities: genuineness, respect, empathic understanding; holistic care that respects culture and spirituality.
核心特質：真誠、尊重、同理；以整體觀照護並尊重文化與靈性。
Boundaries and limits define the relationship; honesty builds trust; confidentiality limits sharing to the interprofessional team.
界線與限制定義護病關係；誠實建立信任；保密僅限於跨專業團隊內分享。
Goal: help the client develop problem-solving and coping skills.
目標：協助客戶發展解決問題與因應能力。
Family is viewed as a collaborator (maintain confidentiality) and should be educated about the illness and symptom management.
家屬視為合作夥伴（仍須保密），並需接受疾病與症狀處理的衛教。
Preinteraction: before first contact; prepare the environment and examine your own biases.
互動前期：首次接觸前；準備環境並檢視自身偏見。
Orientation: introduce yourself by name and role, set purpose and time frame (contract), build trust, collect data, discuss termination in advance.
導入期：自我介紹姓名與角色、說明目的與時間架構（契約）、建立信任、收集資料、預先討論結束關係。
Working: explore concerns, problem-solve, identify coping strategies, encourage self-direction.
工作期：探索問題、解決問題、找出因應策略、鼓勵自我導向。
Termination: prepare from the first meeting, evaluate goals, expect anger, distancing, return of symptoms or dependency, refer to community resources.
結束期：從初次接觸就預先準備、評估目標、預期憤怒、疏離、症狀復發或依賴，並轉介社區資源。
Communication is verbal and nonverbal; messages pass through personal filters; anxiety impairs it (Fig. 65.1).
溝通包含語言與非語言；訊息會經過個人過濾；焦慮會妨礙溝通（圖 65.1）。

Therapeutic techniques: active listening, broad openings, clarifying, exploring, focusing, informing, offering self, open-ended questions, paraphrasing, reflecting, restating, silence, summarizing, validating.
治療性技巧：主動傾聽、廣泛開場、澄清、探索、聚焦、提供資訊、陪伴、開放式問句、換句話說、反映、重述、沉默、摘要、確認。

Nontherapeutic: approval/disapproval, excessive or closed-ended questions, changing the subject, disagreeing, false reassurance, giving advice, minimizing feelings, parroting, placing feelings on hold, value judgments, 'why' questions.
非治療性：贊同/不贊同、過多或封閉式問句、轉移話題、反對、錯誤安慰、給建議、貶低感受、鸚鵡式複述、擱置感受、價值判斷、問「為什麼」。
Mental health and mental health problems
心理健康與心理健康問題
Mental health is lifelong adaptation to internal and external change: in touch with reality, relates to others, solves conflicts, resilient.
心理健康是對內外環境變化的終身適應：與現實接觸、能與人相處、解決衝突、具復原力。
Mental health and mental health problems
心理健康與心理健康問題
Mental health lies on a continuum up to serious mental illness with major functional impairment.
心理健康是一個連續譜，另一端是造成功能嚴重損害的重大精神疾病。
Mental health and mental health problems
心理健康與心理健康問題
Features of illness: distorted self-concept, non-reality-based thinking, impaired meaning/purpose, poor self-care, ineffective coping, impaired relationships.
疾病特徵：自我概念扭曲、思考脫離現實、失去意義感、自我照顧不足、因應無效、人際關係受損。
Mental health and mental health problems
心理健康與心理健康問題
Coping is any effort to reduce anxiety; defense mechanisms protect the ego as anxiety rises.
因應是任何減輕焦慮的努力；焦慮升高時防衛機轉保護自我。
Interventions: identify the source of anxiety first, then explore ways to reduce it; assess whether defenses help or add distress.
處置：先找出焦慮來源，再探索減輕方式；評估防衛是否有效或增加困擾。
Never argue with or criticize a defense; do not remove it until healthier coping exists.
勿與客戶爭論或批評其防衛機轉；在建立較健康的因應前不要拿掉。

Table 65.2 defenses: compensation, conversion, denial, displacement, dissociation, identification, intellectualization, introjection, isolation, projection, rationalization, reaction formation, regression, repression.
表 65.2 防衛機轉：補償、轉化、否認、替代、解離、認同、理智化、內射、隔離、投射、合理化、反向作用、退化、潛抑。
The DSM from the American Psychiatric Association gives diagnostic criteria used in clinical, research and educational settings.
美國精神醫學會的 DSM 提供臨床、研究與教育使用的診斷準則。
Dual diagnosis (comorbidity) means a mental health problem plus a substance-related problem.
雙重診斷（共病）指同時有精神健康問題與物質相關問題。
Voluntary: client seeks care, keeps full civil rights, and may request release; detaining a voluntary client without legal grounds is false imprisonment.
自願入院：客戶自行求助，保有完整公民權，可要求出院；無法律依據扣留自願病人構成非法拘禁。

Involuntary: needed for danger to self/others or need for treatment; client keeps right to informed consent and to refuse treatment except in immediate danger; legal counsel, hearing, possible 72-hour hold, least restrictive setting.
非自願入院：因對自己/他人有危險或需治療；仍保有知情同意與拒絕治療的權利（立即危險除外）；有法律代表、聽證、可能 72 小時留置、最少限制環境。
HIPAA protects confidentiality; release only with informed consent, except emergencies; there is a duty to warn an identified intended victim.
HIPAA 保障隱私；除緊急情況外須經知情同意才能揭露；對明確的被威脅對象有警告義務。

Competence is presumed unless declared otherwise by a separate legal hearing. Conditional release and aftercare case managers support community reintegration; writ of habeas corpus allows judicial discharge hearing.
除非經另行法律聽證宣告，否則視為有行為能力。條件式出院與出院後個案管理協助重返社區；人身保護令可要求司法出院聽證。
Milieu therapy: safe therapeutic environment, safety first, all team members valued, community meetings and activity groups.
環境治療：安全的治療性環境，安全為首要，所有團隊成員同樣重要，含社區會議與活動團體。
Interpersonal psychotherapy: supportive, reeducative, reconstructive levels.
人際心理治療：支持性、再教育性、重建性三個層次。
Behavior therapy: operant conditioning (reinforcers), classical conditioning, desensitization, aversion therapy, modeling. Cognitive therapy: identify and correct distorted thoughts.
行為治療：操作制約（增強物）、古典制約、系統減敏、嫌惡治療、示範。認知治療：辨識並矯正扭曲的想法。
Group therapy (5-8 members): initial stage superficial talk and norms; working stage real work; termination begins at first meeting and explores feelings about ending.
團體治療（5–8 人）：初期為表淺交談與建立規範；工作期處理實質問題；結束從首次聚會就開始並探討結束的感受。
Self-help groups (AA, Al-Anon, NA, Gamblers Anonymous) rely on peer experience; family therapy treats the family as the unit and the symptomatic member as a signal.
自助團體（AA、Al-Anon、NA、嗜賭者匿名會）仰賴同儕經驗；家族治療以家庭為單位，症狀成員代表整個家庭的問題。
Use feeling-focused, open-ended, client-centered responses (restating, reflecting, exploring); avoid 'why', advice, false reassurance, and changing the subject.
使用聚焦感受、開放式、以客戶為中心的回應（重述、反映、探索）；避免問「為什麼」、給建議、錯誤安慰與轉移話題。
Safety is the priority in the milieu; physical safety precedes other goals.
環境治療中安全為首要；身體安全優先於其他目標。
Voluntary clients may request discharge; notify the provider first. Holding them without legal grounds is false imprisonment.
自願入院客戶可要求出院；先通知醫師。無法律依據扣留即非法拘禁。
Restraining a voluntary client without criteria risks assault, battery and false imprisonment.
對未達條件的自願客戶使用約束，可能構成恐嚇、傷害與非法拘禁。
Involuntary clients retain the right to refuse treatment unless in immediate danger; they have legal counsel and the right to a hearing and the least restrictive setting.
非自願客戶除非有立即危險，否則保有拒絕治療的權利；有法律代表、聽證權與最少限制環境。
Duty to warn: tell an identified intended victim of a threat; otherwise do not disclose without informed consent.
警告義務：對明確的被威脅對象須告知；其餘情況未經知情同意不得揭露。
Confidentiality: respond politely but firmly that you cannot discuss any client.
保密：禮貌而堅定地回應無法討論任何客戶。
Do not take away a defense mechanism until more adaptive coping is established; do not criticize it.
在建立較適應的因應之前不要拿掉防衛機轉；不要批評。
Priority in coping: identify the anxiety source first, then explore ways to reduce it.
因應優先順序：先找出焦慮來源，再探索減輕方式。
Orientation phase: introduce self, set the contract and time frame, and discuss termination early.
導入期：自我介紹、訂定契約與時間架構、及早討論結束。
Working phase: address the client's feelings that may block adaptive coping.
工作期：處理可能妨礙適應性因應的感受。
Termination begins at the first contact; expect anger, distancing, symptom return or dependency.
結束階段從初次接觸即開始；預期憤怒、疏離、症狀復發或依賴。
Group termination: evaluate the experience and explore feelings about separation.
團體結束期：評估經驗並探討對分離的感受。
Cognitive therapy targets dysfunctional thoughts/beliefs; first step of the 12-step program is admitting a problem exists.
認知治療針對失功能的想法與信念；12 步驟計畫的第一步是承認有問題。

Defense mechanism memory hooks: Projection = 'blame it on you'; Displacement = 'kick the dog'; Reaction formation = 'opposite of what I feel'; Regression = 'act like a child'; Rationalization = 'excuses'; Repression = 'forgotten unconsciously'; Denial = 'it isn't true'; Intellectualization = 'facts without feelings'.
防衛機轉口訣：投射＝怪別人；替代＝遷怒對象；反向作用＝表現與內心相反；退化＝像小孩；合理化＝找藉口；潛抑＝無意識遺忘；否認＝不承認；理智化＝只談事實不談感受。
Therapeutic = Open, Reflect, Clarify, Silence; Non-therapeutic = Why, Advice, Reassure, Change subject.
治療性：開放、反映、澄清、沉默；非治療性：為什麼、建議、安慰、轉移話題。
A client who attempted suicide says, 'I've always been a failure. Nothing ever goes right for me.' Which response is therapeutic?
一位自殺未遂的客戶說：「我一直都很失敗，什麼事都不順。」哪個回應具治療性？
A client admitted voluntarily to a mental health unit demands to leave. What is the nurse's initial action?
自願入院的客戶要求離開，護理師首先應做什麼？
Which actions represent therapeutic communication? Select all that apply.
哪些屬於治療性溝通？（複選）
A student fails an exam and says the lectures were disorganized. Which defense mechanism is this?
學生考試不及格，抱怨講課沒有條理。這是哪種防衛機轉？
A 4-year-old who was toilet trained begins wetting after a new sibling arrives. Which defense mechanism?
已訓練如廁的 4 歲幼兒在弟妹出生後又開始尿褲子。這是哪種防衛機轉？
A nurse restrains a voluntarily admitted client who is demanding discharge. Which legal consequences may result? Select all that apply.
護理師對要求出院的自願入院客戶使用約束。可能的法律後果有哪些？（複選）
Which goals fit the termination stage of group development? Select all that apply.
哪些屬於團體發展結束期的目標？（複選）
A neighbor asks the nurse in a grocery store how a clinic client is doing. What is the best response?
鄰居在超市詢問護理師某位診所客戶的近況。最佳回應是？

圖 65.1 顯示溝通歷程（傳送者、訊息、接收者、回饋與個人過濾）。
Table 65.1 lists therapeutic versus nontherapeutic communication techniques with definitions; high-yield for NCLEX.
表 65.1 列出治療性與非治療性溝通技巧及定義；NCLEX 高頻考點。
Table 65.2 gives each defense mechanism with a clinical example.
表 65.2 列出各防衛機轉與臨床例子。
Box 65.1 lists client rights, including refusing treatment and least restrictive setting.
方框 65.1 列出客戶權利，包括拒絕治療與最少限制環境。
