圖 65.2 比較反應性（古典）制約與操作制約。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care
Mild: heightened perception, motivates learning. Moderate: narrowed focus, selective inattention, can still learn; tachycardia, sweating, mild tremor.
輕度：感知增強，促進學習。中度：注意力縮窄、選擇性忽略，仍可學習；心跳加快、流汗、輕微顫抖。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care
Severe: very narrow field, scattered details, no learning or problem-solving; sympathetic symptoms, hyperventilation; needs direction.
重度：視野極窄、專注於零碎細節，無法學習或解決問題；交感症狀、換氣過度；需要引導。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care
Panic: terror, disorganization, distorted reality, cannot communicate; prolonged panic can cause exhaustion.
恐慌：恐懼、思緒紊亂、扭曲現實、無法溝通；持續太久可致衰竭。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care
First action: decrease stimuli and provide a calm, quiet environment; recognize anxiety, establish trust, protect the client, do not criticize coping, do not force anxiety-provoking situations.
首要措施：減少刺激並提供平靜安靜環境；辨識焦慮、建立信任、保護客戶、不批評因應方式、不強迫面對引發焦慮的情境。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care

Mild-moderate: identify source, talk, problem-solve, gross motor exercise. Severe-panic: stay with client, calm low-pitched voice, short simple statements, walk with the client, medications as prescribed.
輕中度：找出來源、談論感受、解決問題、大肌肉運動。重度至恐慌：陪伴、平穩低沉聲音、簡短語句、陪同走動、依醫囑給藥。
Anxiety: levels and general nursing care
廣泛性焦慮與恐慌發作

GAD: excessive worry on most days for 6 months or more with 3+ symptoms (restless, easily tired, poor concentration, irritable, muscle tension, sleep problems), not due to substances or medical cause (Box 66.1).
GAD：多數日子過度擔憂達 6 個月以上，並有 3 項以上症狀（坐立不安、易疲倦、注意力差、易怒、肌肉緊繃、睡眠問題），且非物質或醫療因素所致（方框 66.1）。
廣泛性焦慮與恐慌發作
Panic attack: sudden intense dread lasting about 5-30 minutes with choking sensation, pounding heart, chest pain, dizziness, paresthesias, fear of dying.
恐慌發作：突發強烈恐懼約 5–30 分鐘，伴窒息感、心悸、胸痛、頭暈、麻木、瀕死恐懼。
廣泛性焦慮與恐慌發作
Stay with the client, treat physical symptoms, use cognitive restructuring to replace distorted thoughts, give antianxiety drugs if prescribed.
陪伴客戶、處理身體症狀、用認知重建取代扭曲想法、依醫囑給抗焦慮藥。
廣泛性焦慮與恐慌發作
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害
PTSD follows trauma (disaster, combat, assault, abuse): re-experiencing (flashbacks, nightmares), avoidance, hyperarousal (startle, hypervigilance, irritability), guilt, detachment.
PTSD 發生於創傷後（災難、戰爭、暴力、虐待）：再經歷（閃回、夢魘）、迴避、過度警覺（驚嚇反應、警戒、易怒）、罪惡感、疏離。
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害
During a flashback: ensure safety, stay calm, reassure that the client is safe, do not startle. Monitor suicide risk, teach stress management, include family and support groups.
閃回時：確保安全、保持冷靜、告知客戶安全、避免驚嚇。監測自殺風險、教導壓力管理、納入家屬與支持團體。
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害
Evidence-based treatments: medication, CBT, prolonged exposure, EMDR.
實證治療：藥物、認知行為治療、延長暴露治療、眼動減敏與歷程更新（EMDR）。
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害
Trauma-informed care asks 'what happened to you?' rather than 'what is wrong with you?'; avoid restraints/coercion, collaborate, peer support, empowerment, cultural respect.
創傷知情照護問的是「你經歷了什麼？」而非「你哪裡不對勁？」；避免約束與強制，強調合作、同儕支持、賦權與文化尊重。
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害

Moral injury: distress from acts that violate one's moral beliefs (guilt, shame, disgust, anger, inability to self-forgive); not currently a mental disorder; fear-based hyperarousal is not characteristic. Assess depression and self-harm first; use nonjudgmental approach, group therapy, cognitive processing therapy.
道德傷害：因違背自身道德信念的行為而痛苦（罪惡感、羞愧、厭惡、憤怒、無法自我原諒）；目前不屬精神疾病；恐懼性過度警覺不是其特徵。優先評估憂鬱與自傷；採不批判態度、團體治療、認知處理治療。
PTSD, trauma-informed care and moral injury
創傷後壓力症、創傷知情照護與道德傷害
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患
Specific phobia: irrational fear with avoidance; stay with the client, never force contact; teach relaxation; gradual desensitization (Box 66.2).
特定畏懼症：非理性恐懼並迴避；陪伴、絕不強迫接觸；教導放鬆；漸進式減敏（方框 66.2）。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患

OCD: obsessions (intrusive thoughts) and compulsions (rituals) that reduce anxiety. Do not interrupt rituals unless unsafe; allow time, set limits, schedule distractions, written contract, reinforce non-ritual behavior (Box 66.3).
強迫症：強迫思考（侵入性想法）與強迫行為（儀式）以降低焦慮。除非危險否則不打斷儀式；給予時間、設限、安排分散活動、書面契約、強化非儀式行為（方框 66.3）。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患
相關疾患：囤積症、摳皮症、拔毛症。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患

Somatic symptom disorder: physical complaints without findings, anxiety redirected into body, secondary gain. Allow a limited time to discuss complaints, do not reinforce them, assess any new complaint, explore anxiety.
身體症狀疾患：無器質證據的身體不適，焦慮轉移至身體，有次級獲益。限定時間討論不適、不強化症狀、評估任何新主訴、探索焦慮。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患
Conversion disorder: sudden neurological deficit (blindness, paralysis, mutism) without organic cause, 'la belle indifference'; symptoms reduce anxiety; rule out physical causes first.
轉化症：突發神經功能缺損（失明、癱瘓、失語）但無器質原因，常有「泰然漠視」；症狀可減輕焦慮；須先排除生理原因。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患

Dissociative disorders: DID (host and alters, sudden switching), dissociative amnesia (localized, selective, generalized), depersonalization/derealization (reality testing intact). Orient, build trust, simple routines, let client set pace.
解離疾患：DID（主人格與次人格，突然轉換）、解離性失憶（局部、選擇性、廣泛性）、人格解體/現實解體（現實感仍完整）。給予定向、建立信任、簡單作息、依客戶步調進行。
Phobia, OCD, somatic and dissociative disorders
畏懼症、強迫症、身體症狀與解離疾患
Types: bipolar I (mania to depression), bipolar II (hypomania plus severe depression), cyclothymic, mixed features.
類型：雙相 I 型（躁症到憂鬱）、II 型（輕躁加重度憂鬱）、循環性情感疾患、混合特徵。
Lithium: toxic, needs regular serum level monitoring; keep sodium intake steady and fluids 2-3 L/day. Atypical antipsychotics also used; avoid antianxiety agents if substance abuse history.
鋰鹽：有毒性，需定期監測血中濃度；維持穩定鈉攝取與每日 2–3 公升水分。亦使用非典型抗精神病藥；有物質濫用史者避免抗焦慮藥。
Mania signs: flight of ideas, pressured speech, grandiosity, little sleep, excessive spending, distractibility, euphoria/irritability (Box 66.5).
躁症表現：意念飛躍、言語急迫、誇大、睡眠極少、過度消費、分心、欣快或易怒（方框 66.5）。

Interventions: safety first, low stimulation, private room, short calm interactions, do not argue, redirect grandiosity, high-calorie finger foods, rest, solitary or gross-motor non-competitive activities, set limits.
處置：安全為先、低刺激、單人房、簡短平穩互動、不爭辯、轉移誇大想法、高熱量手指食物、休息、獨自或非競爭性大肌肉活動、設限。
Manipulation: clear consistent limits, nonpunitive follow-through, avoid power struggles. Aggression: de-escalation, respect space, calm assertive tone (Box 66.6).
操弄行為：清楚一致的限制、非懲罰性執行、避免權力鬥爭。攻擊行為：降級技巧、尊重個人空間、平穩而果斷的語氣（方框 66.6）。

Major depression: depressed mood or anhedonia plus changes in appetite/weight, sleep, energy, concentration, worthlessness/guilt, thoughts of death for most days; rule out hypothyroidism and substances.
重度憂鬱：多數日子出現情緒低落或失去興趣，加上食慾/體重、睡眠、精力、專注力改變、無價值感/罪惡感、死亡念頭；須排除甲狀腺低下與物質。
Ask directly about self-harm. Suicide plan: one-to-one supervision, remove harmful objects. If an antidepressant begins to lift energy, watch closely - the client may now have energy to act.
直接詢問自傷念頭。有自殺計畫：一對一監視、移除危險物品。抗憂鬱藥開始增加精力時要密切觀察——客戶可能有力氣執行自殺。
Depression care: structured, achievable, simple activities, begin one-to-one then small groups, stay with client at meals, monitor hygiene, sleep, nutrition (Box 66.7).
憂鬱症照護：結構化、可達成的簡單活動，先一對一再進入小團體，用餐陪伴，監測衛生、睡眠與營養（方框 66.7）。

ECT: for severe/psychotic depression, suicidal, catatonia, treatment-resistant mania; course of 6-12 treatments every 2-5 days. Needs informed consent, NPO (after midnight or at least 4 h), void, remove dentures/hairpins/lenses.
ECT：用於重度/精神病性憂鬱、自殺、僵直症、難治性躁症；療程 6–12 次、每 2–5 天一次。需知情同意、禁食（午夜後或至少 4 小時）、排尿、取下假牙/髮夾/隱形眼鏡。

During ECT: anesthetic and muscle relaxant, oxygen, bite guard, seizure 15-70 seconds. After: recovery area with suction/O2, orient the client, expect confusion and short-term memory loss. Risk clients: recent MI, stroke, intracranial mass.
ECT 進行中：麻醉與肌肉鬆弛劑、給氧、咬合器、痙攣 15–70 秒。術後：於備有抽吸與氧氣的恢復區，持續定向，預期意識混亂與短期記憶喪失。高風險：近期心肌梗塞、中風、顱內腫塊。
Symptom domains: positive (hallucinations, delusions, disorganized speech, bizarre behavior), negative (blunted affect, anhedonia, avolition, alogia), cognitive, mood (Fig. 66.1).
症狀向度：陽性（幻覺、妄想、語言紊亂、怪異行為）、陰性（情感鈍化、失樂症、動機缺乏、言語貧乏）、認知、情緒（圖 66.1）。
Motor: catatonic posturing/excitement, waxy flexibility, echopraxia. Thought: loose associations, thought blocking, neologisms, word salad, echolalia, clang association (Boxes 66.9, 66.10, 66.13).
動作：僵直姿勢/興奮、蠟樣屈曲、仿作。思考：聯想鬆散、思考中斷、新語症、字詞沙拉、仿說、音韻聯想（方框 66.9、66.10、66.13）。
Delusions: reference, persecution, grandeur, somatic. Do not argue or try to convince; express feelings; reality-based topics; validate real parts (Box 66.11).
妄想：關係、被害、誇大、身體妄想。不爭辯或說服；表達感受；談現實話題；肯定真實部分（方框 66.11）。
Hallucinations: ask directly, do not treat as real or deny the experience, reduce stimuli, concrete activity, avoid touch; safety first - check for command hallucinations (Box 66.12).
幻覺：直接詢問、不當作真實也不否定經驗、降低刺激、安排具體活動、避免碰觸；安全為先——確認是否有命令式幻覺（方框 66.12）。

Care: safe, simple, structured routine; brief frequent contact; do not whisper; tell client when leaving; initially no choices; monitor suicide risk; withdrawn/catatonic clients: sit quietly with open-ended questions (Box 66.14).
照護：安全、簡單、有結構的作息；簡短頻繁接觸；不要耳語；離開時告知；初期不提供選擇；監測自殺風險；退縮/僵直者：安靜陪坐並使用開放式問句（方框 66.14）。
Inflexible maladaptive patterns, reality testing usually intact but poor insight; impulsivity, acting out, impaired judgment and relationships.
僵化不適應的模式，現實感通常完整但缺乏病識感；衝動、行動化、判斷與人際受損。
Cluster A (odd): schizoid, schizotypal, paranoid. Paranoid: do not whisper or laugh in front of client; be honest, brief frequent contact, keep commitments (Box 66.15).
A 群（怪異）：類分裂型、思覺失調型、猜疑型。猜疑型：勿在客戶面前耳語或笑；誠實、簡短頻繁接觸、遵守承諾（方框 66.15）。
Cluster B (dramatic): histrionic, narcissistic, antisocial (no remorse, manipulative), borderline (unstable relationships, self-harm, splitting, fear of abandonment).
B 群（戲劇化）：做作型、自戀型、反社會型（無悔意、操弄）、邊緣型（關係不穩、自傷、分裂、害怕被遺棄）。
Cluster C (anxious): obsessive-compulsive personality, avoidant (fear of rejection, social isolation), dependent.
C 群（焦慮）：強迫型人格、逃避型（怕被拒絕、社交孤立）、依賴型。
Care: safety, consistent team response, limits, written behavioral contract, identify splitting, encourage talking not acting out, praise nonmanipulative behavior.
照護：安全、團隊一致回應、設限、書面行為契約、辨識分裂、鼓勵說出而非行動化、讚美非操弄行為。
Dementia: progressive intellectual decline with memory loss, poor judgment, self-care deficit; rule out reversible physiological causes first. Alzheimer is the most common type, irreversible.
失智症：進行性智能退化，記憶喪失、判斷力差、自我照顧缺損；須先排除可逆的生理原因。阿茲海默症最常見且不可逆。
Stages: mild (forgetfulness), moderate (confusion), moderate-severe (ambulatory dementia), late (end stage). Aphasia, agnosia, apraxia, amnesia (Box 66.16).
分期：輕度（健忘）、中度（意識混亂）、中重度（能行走的失智）、末期。失語、失認、失用、失憶（方框 66.16）。
Safety is the priority: clutter-free environment, close supervision, secured doors, ID bracelet, lower water-heater temperature, remove throw rugs.
安全為首要：整潔無雜物、密切監督、鎖好門、識別手環、調低熱水溫度、移除地毯。
Sundowning: evening worsening. Use indirect light, consistent routine, afternoon rest, avoid hypnotics, allow safe wandering.
日落症候群：傍晚症狀加重。使用間接光源、固定作息、午後休息、避免安眠藥、允許在安全處走動。
Communication: face the client, short simple sentences, one question or direction at a time, repeat without rephrasing, allow time, don't argue; support caregivers.
溝通：面對客戶、短而簡單的句子、一次一個問題或指令、重複但不改述、給時間、不爭辯；支持照顧者。
Neurodevelopmental disorders (autism, ADHD) are covered in Chapter 39.
神經發展疾患（自閉症、ADHD）請見第 39 章。
Anxious client: first action is to reduce stimuli and provide a calm, quiet environment; stay with the client in severe anxiety/panic.
焦慮客戶：首要行動是降低刺激並提供平靜環境；重度焦慮/恐慌時陪伴客戶。
Severe anxiety and panic block learning; teach only when anxiety is mild-moderate.
重度焦慮與恐慌無法學習；僅在輕中度焦慮時衛教。
Never force a phobic client into contact with the feared object; use gradual desensitization.
絕不強迫畏懼症客戶接觸害怕的對象；使用漸進式減敏。
OCD: do not interrupt rituals unless unsafe; allow time and set limits.
強迫症：除非不安全否則不打斷儀式；給予時間並設限。
Conversion disorder: sudden deficit without organic cause, calm indifference; rule out physical illness; do not reinforce the symptom.
轉化症：無器質原因的突發缺損、泰然漠視；先排除生理疾病；不強化症狀。
Somatic symptom disorder: allow a limited time to discuss complaints; do not stop it completely.
身體症狀疾患：限定時間討論不適；不要完全禁止。
PTSD flashback: ensure safety, stay calm, don't startle, remind client they are safe.
PTSD 閃回：確保安全、保持冷靜、不要驚嚇、提醒客戶是安全的。
Mania: low stimulation, do not argue, set limits, finger foods, non-competitive solitary activities; safety of client and others is the immediate priority.
躁症：低刺激、不爭辯、設限、手指食物、非競爭性獨自活動；客戶與他人安全為首要。
Lithium requires regular serum level checks, steady sodium and 2-3 L fluid daily to avoid toxicity.
鋰鹽需定期監測血中濃度，並維持穩定鈉攝取與每日 2–3 公升水分以避免中毒。
Depression: ask directly about suicidal thoughts; increased energy after starting an antidepressant is a warning sign.
憂鬱症：直接詢問自殺念頭；開始抗憂鬱藥後精力增加為警訊。
ECT: informed consent, NPO, expect transient confusion and short-term memory loss; seizure lasts 15-70 seconds; 6-12 treatments.
ECT：知情同意、禁食、預期暫時性意識混亂與短期記憶喪失；痙攣 15–70 秒；6–12 次療程。
Hallucinations: first priority is safety; check for command hallucinations to harm self/others.
幻覺：首要為安全；確認有無傷害自己/他人的命令式幻覺。
Delusions: don't argue or confirm; respond to the feeling and refocus on reality.
妄想：不爭辯也不附和；回應其感受並導回現實。
Paranoid client: do not whisper or laugh in front of them; be honest and keep promises.
猜疑型客戶：勿在其面前耳語或笑；誠實並信守承諾。
Borderline: splitting, self-harm, fear of abandonment; consistent team and limits.
邊緣型：分裂、自傷、害怕被遺棄；團隊一致並設限。
Alzheimer: safety first; one direction at a time; avoid hypnotics; sundowning management; support caregivers.
阿茲海默：安全為先；一次一個指令；避免安眠藥；處理日落症候群；支持照顧者。
Delirium/confusion at night: indirect light, no TV, consistent routine.
夜間譫妄/混亂：間接光源、關掉電視、固定作息。
Anxiety levels: Mild = motivates; Moderate = narrows; Severe = scattered; Panic = terror. Learning stops at severe.
焦慮程度：輕度＝激勵；中度＝縮窄；重度＝零散；恐慌＝恐懼。重度起學習停止。

Schizophrenia '4 A's' (Bleuler): Affect (blunted), Associations (loose), Ambivalence, Autism (withdrawal). Positive symptoms = 'added' (hallucinations/delusions); negative = 'lost' (motivation, pleasure, speech).
思覺失調「4A」：情感、聯想、矛盾、自閉。陽性症狀＝「多出來」（幻覺/妄想）；陰性＝「少了」（動機、愉悅、言語）。
Personality clusters: A = Odd (Weird), B = Dramatic (Wild), C = Anxious (Worried). 'ABC = Weird, Wild, Worried'.
人格群：A＝怪異；B＝戲劇化；C＝焦慮。口訣：怪、狂、怕。
A client says, 'The federal guards were sent to kill me.' Which response is best?
客戶說：「聯邦警衛被派來殺我。」哪個回應最好？
A client with delirium is confused at night. What does the nurse implement first?
譫妄客戶夜間意識混亂。護理師首先應做什麼？
A client with mania repeatedly dominates a group session. What should the nurse do first?
躁症客戶不斷主導團體治療。護理師首先該做什麼？
A client with acute blindness after an accident has no organic cause found. The nurse plans care for which condition?
客戶在意外後突然失明，查無器質原因。護理師依哪種疾患計畫照護？
Which interventions suit a client with mania who is manipulative? Select all that apply.
哪些處置適合有操弄行為的躁症客戶？（複選）
A client with schizophrenia and command hallucinations is being discharged. Which statement needs further teaching?
有命令式幻覺的思覺失調症客戶準備出院。哪句話顯示需要再衛教？
A client is homebound for fear of the ex-spouse's ridicule and is hypersensitive to criticism. Which personality disorder?
客戶因怕前配偶嘲笑而足不出戶，對批評過度敏感。屬於哪種人格疾患？
Which are appropriate for a client with Alzheimer disease who wanders? Select all that apply.
哪些適用於會徘徊的阿茲海默症客戶？（複選）
Box 66.1 lists the diagnostic criteria for generalized anxiety disorder.
方框 66.1 列出廣泛性焦慮疾患的診斷準則。
Box 66.5 contrasts the assessment findings of mania and depression side by side.
方框 66.5 並列比較躁症與憂鬱的評估表現。
Fig. 66.1 shows the four symptom dimensions of schizophrenia (positive, negative, cognitive, mood).
圖 66.1 顯示思覺失調症的症狀向度（陽性、陰性、認知、情緒）。
Boxes 66.9-66.10: abnormal motor behaviors and thought-process terms (echolalia, flight of ideas, word salad, etc.).
方框 66.9–66.10：異常動作與思考歷程名詞（仿說、意念飛躍、字詞沙拉等）。
Boxes 66.11-66.13: delusion and hallucination types with interventions, and language disturbance terms.
方框 66.11–66.13：妄想與幻覺類型與處置，以及語言障礙名詞。
Compulsive overeating: binge-like eating without purging, done secretly, relieves tension but brings guilt and depression; repeated failed diets.
強迫性暴食：暴食但不催吐，常偷偷進行，可緩解緊張但帶來罪惡感與憂鬱；多次節食失敗。
Anorexia nervosa: intense fear of obesity, distorted body image, refusal to eat, compulsive exercise, perfectionism; can be fatal (starvation, suicide, cardiomyopathy, electrolyte imbalance).
神經性厭食症：極度害怕肥胖、身體意象扭曲、拒食、強迫運動、完美主義；可致命（飢餓、自殺、心肌病變、電解質失衡）。
Anorexia physical findings: low temperature, pulse and BP, constipation, lanugo, dry scaly skin, amenorrhea (3+ cycles), electrolyte imbalance, bone loss, tooth and gum damage.
厭食症生理表現：體溫、脈搏、血壓偏低、便秘、胎毛、皮膚乾燥脫屑、閉經（連續 3 次以上）、電解質失衡、骨質流失、牙齒與牙齦受損。
Bulimia nervosa: binge followed by purging (vomiting, laxatives, diuretics, starvation); usually normal weight; secret eating, low self-esteem, electrolyte imbalance, dental erosion.
神經性暴食症：暴食後催吐（嘔吐、瀉藥、利尿劑、禁食）；體重通常正常；偷偷進食、自尊低、電解質失衡、牙齒侵蝕。
Cycle of eating disorders is shown in Fig. 67.1 (dieting, loss of control, binge, purge).
飲食疾患循環見圖 67.1（節食、失控、暴食、催吐）。
Build trust in a one-to-one relationship; accepting, nonjudgmental; explore feelings about body and eating; behavior modification; individual, group and family therapy.
在一對一關係中建立信任；接納、不批判；探索對身體與飲食的感受；行為修正；個別、團體與家族治療。
Set a daily nutrition plan, supervise meals and a period afterward, time-limit meals, pleasant relaxed setting, monitor intake and output.
訂定每日營養計畫、督導用餐及餐後一段時間、限制用餐時間、營造愉快放鬆環境、監測輸入輸出量。
Below 75% of ideal body weight: immediate inpatient medical stabilization.
體重低於理想體重 75%：須立即住院做醫療穩定。
Weigh daily, same time, same scale, after voiding, same clothing. Monitor and restore fluids and electrolytes; assess and limit activity; assess suicide risk; give antidepressants if prescribed.
每日同時間、同一磅秤、排尿後、穿相同衣物測體重。監測並矯正體液電解質；評估並限制活動；評估自殺風險；依醫囑給抗憂鬱藥。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Dependence: repeated use leading to tolerance, withdrawal and compulsive use; larger amounts than intended; failed attempts to cut down.
依賴：反覆使用導致耐受、戒斷與強迫使用；用量超過預期；減量失敗。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Tolerance: needing more for the same effect. Withdrawal: symptoms when blood levels fall in a dependent person.
耐受：需要更多劑量才有相同效果。戒斷：依賴者血中濃度下降時出現的症狀。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Screening tools: CAGE (Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener), MAST, DAST.
篩檢工具：CAGE（減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒）、MAST、DAST。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Dysfunctional behaviors: denial, rationalization, projection, manipulation, impulsiveness, anger, low self-esteem, depression.
失功能行為：否認、合理化、投射、操弄、衝動、憤怒、低自尊、憂鬱。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Codependency: the significant other enables use (paying bills, bailing out, calling in sick); address it with the family.
共依附：重要他人縱容使用（付帳單、保釋、代請病假）；需與家屬一起處理。
物質使用疾患：基本概念
Alcohol is a CNS depressant. Signs: slurred speech, unsteady gait, confusion, blackouts, morning drinking, increased tolerance; intoxication BAC 0.1% (100 mg/dL) or more.
酒精為中樞神經抑制劑。表現：口齒不清、步態不穩、意識混亂、斷片、晨間飲酒、耐受性增加；中毒 BAC 達 0.1%（100 mg/dL）以上。
Assess type, amount, duration and time of last drink.
評估酒類、飲用量、時間長度與最後一次飲酒時間。
Complications: thiamine deficiency (Wernicke encephalopathy, Korsakoff), B-vitamin neuropathy, hepatitis, cirrhosis, esophagitis, gastritis, pancreatitis, anemia, cardiac disease, brain damage.
併發症：硫胺素缺乏（Wernicke 腦病變、Korsakoff）、B 群缺乏神經病變、肝炎、肝硬化、食道炎、胃炎、胰臟炎、貧血、心臟疾病、腦損傷。
Dealing with the client: direct focus on the substance use, firm consistent limits, hold accountable, motivational interviewing, group and support groups (Boxes 67.3, 67.4).
與客戶互動：將焦點放在物質使用、堅定一致的限制、要求負責、動機式晤談、團體與支持團體（方框 67.3、67.4）。
Onset within hours of stopping; peaks 24-48 hours; untreated can progress to seizures and delirium tremens (DTs). Use CIWA to assess.
停酒後數小時內開始；24–48 小時達高峰；未治療可進展為痙攣與震顫譫妄（DTs）。使用 CIWA 評估。
Signs: hypertension, tachycardia, tremors, sweating, nausea/vomiting, anxiety, agitation, tactile/auditory/visual disturbances, headache, disorientation.
表現：高血壓、心搏過速、顫抖、流汗、噁心嘔吐、焦慮、躁動、觸覺/聽覺/視覺異常、頭痛、定向感障礙。

DTs peak 48-72 hours, last 2-3 days; fever 100-103 F (37.8-39.4 C), hallucinations, fluctuating consciousness; a medical emergency (death from MI, collapse, electrolyte imbalance, aspiration, suicide).
DTs 於 48–72 小時達高峰，持續 2–3 天；發燒 100–103°F（37.8–39.4°C）、幻覺、意識波動；屬醫療急症（可因心肌梗塞、循環衰竭、電解質失衡、吸入性肺炎、自殺致死）。

Care: medications as prescribed, VS and neuro checks (every 15 min in severe withdrawal), one-to-one supervision, seizure precautions, quiet low-stimulation room, frequent orientation, monitor glucose/magnesium/electrolytes, small frequent high-carbohydrate meals, I&O.
照護：依醫囑給藥、生命徵象與神經學檢查（嚴重戒斷每 15 分鐘）、一對一監視、癲癇預防、安靜低刺激環境、頻繁定向、監測血糖/鎂/電解質、少量多餐高碳水飲食、記錄輸入輸出。
中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類

CNS depressants (alcohol, benzodiazepines, barbiturates): overdose causes respiratory/cardiovascular depression, coma, seizures. Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepine overdose. Withdrawal is treated with a titrated similar drug; abrupt withdrawal can be fatal.
中樞神經抑制劑（酒精、苯二氮平類、巴比妥類）：過量造成呼吸/循環抑制、昏迷、痙攣。Flumazenil 可逆轉苯二氮平類過量。戒斷以逐漸調整的類似藥物治療；突然戒斷可能致命。
中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類

Stimulants (amphetamines, cocaine, crack): euphoria, dilated pupils, hypertension, tachycardia, dysrhythmias, paranoia; overdose can cause hyperpyrexia, seizures, stroke, MI. Withdrawal: depression and suicidal ideation, fatigue, hypersomnia.
興奮劑（安非他命、古柯鹼、快克）：欣快、瞳孔放大、高血壓、心搏過速、心律不整、妄想；過量可致高熱、痙攣、中風、心肌梗塞。戒斷：憂鬱與自殺意念、疲倦、嗜睡。
中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類

Opioids: intoxication has constricted pupils, bradypnea, hypotension, drowsiness. Overdose: respiratory depression, coma. Naloxone (e.g., nasal spray) is the antagonist. Withdrawal (COWS): dilated pupils, rhinorrhea, lacrimation, yawning, piloerection, diarrhea, body aches.
鴉片類：中毒時瞳孔縮小、呼吸過慢、低血壓、嗜睡。過量：呼吸抑制、昏迷。Naloxone（如鼻噴劑）為拮抗劑。戒斷（COWS）：瞳孔放大、流鼻水、流淚、打哈欠、起雞皮疙瘩、腹瀉、身體痠痛。
中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類
Opioid overdose crisis (Box 67.5): risk factors include prior overdose, high doses, co-prescribed benzodiazepines, respiratory disease, alcohol use; use screening tools such as the Opioid Risk Tool.
鴉片類過量危機（方框 67.5）：風險因子包括曾過量、高劑量、併用苯二氮平類、呼吸疾病、飲酒；使用 Opioid Risk Tool 等篩檢工具。
中樞神經抑制劑、興奮劑與鴉片類
Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs
迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物

Hallucinogens (LSD, mescaline, psilocybin, PCP): low stimulation, speak slowly and quietly, treat anxiety. PCP overdose: psychosis, hypertensive crisis, hyperthermia, seizures, respiratory arrest; acidify urine. Flashbacks can occur - safety is the priority.
迷幻劑（LSD、仙人掌毒鹼、裸蓋菇素、PCP）：低刺激、緩慢輕聲說話、處理焦慮。PCP 過量：精神病、高血壓危象、高體溫、痙攣、呼吸停止；酸化尿液。可能出現閃回——安全為先。
Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs
迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物
Inhalants (butane, paint thinner, glue, nitrous oxide): euphoria then drowsiness; can damage the nervous system and cause death; supportive care.
吸入劑（丁烷、油漆稀釋劑、膠水、笑氣）：先欣快後嗜睡；可損傷神經系統並致死；支持性照護。
Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs
迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物
Marijuana: heightened sensations, red eyes, dry mouth, increased appetite, tachycardia; long-term amotivation, memory loss, respiratory problems.
大麻：感覺增強、眼睛紅、口乾、食慾增加、心搏過速；長期使用導致動機缺乏、記憶喪失、呼吸問題。
Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs
迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物
Club drugs (MDMA, GHB, methamphetamine, ketamine): hyperthermia, rhabdomyolysis, kidney failure, hepatotoxicity, psychosis, cardiovascular collapse. Nicotine: patches, inhalers, bupropion.
俱樂部藥物（MDMA、GHB、甲基安非他命、氯胺酮）：高體溫、橫紋肌溶解、腎衰竭、肝毒性、精神病、心血管衰竭。尼古丁：貼片、吸入器、bupropion。
Hallucinogens, inhalants, marijuana and club drugs
迷幻劑、吸入劑、大麻與俱樂部藥物
Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses
戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師
Withdrawal care: seizure precautions, hydration, hourly vital signs with cardiac monitoring, I&O, orientation, minimal stimuli, remove hazards, one-to-one if needed, drug screens (Box 67.6).
戒斷照護：癲癇預防、補水、每小時生命徵象與心臟監測、輸入輸出、定向、最少刺激、移除危險物、必要時一對一、藥物篩檢（方框 67.6）。
Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses
戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師
Be accepting, hold client accountable, set limits on manipulation, teach assertiveness, encourage groups and 12-step programs (AA, NA, Al-Anon, Alateen, Nar-Anon, halfway houses).
接納、要求客戶負責、對操弄設限、教導自我肯定、鼓勵團體與 12 步驟計畫（AA、NA、Al-Anon、Alateen、Nar-Anon、中途之家）。
Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses
戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師
Dual diagnosis: substance use can mask or trigger psychiatric illness; true separation requires sustained abstinence.
雙重診斷：物質使用可能掩蓋或誘發精神疾病；需持續戒斷才能區分。
Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses
戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師

Impaired nurse red flags: frequent unwitnessed wastage, giving maximum doses, clients with poor pain relief, always volunteering for narcotic keys, seeking low-supervision shifts. Nurses must report; recovery programs through the Board of Nursing.
受損護理師警訊：常見未被見證的丟棄藥物、報告給予最大劑量、病人止痛效果差、總是主動拿管制藥鑰匙、選擇少監督的班別。護理師有義務通報；可透過護理委員會的復健方案返回工作。
Withdrawal care, dual diagnosis, impaired nurses
戒斷照護、雙重診斷與受損護理師
Alcohol withdrawal: hypertension, tachycardia, tremor, diaphoresis, agitation, hallucinations. Peak 24-48 h; DTs at 48-72 h.
酒精戒斷：高血壓、心搏過速、顫抖、盜汗、躁動、幻覺。24–48 小時高峰；DTs 於 48–72 小時。
DTs are a medical emergency: seizure precautions, one-to-one, VS/neuro checks, electrolytes (including magnesium and glucose).
DTs 為醫療急症：癲癇預防、一對一、生命徵象/神經學檢查、電解質（含鎂與血糖）。
Use CIWA for alcohol withdrawal and COWS for opioid withdrawal.
酒精戒斷用 CIWA，鴉片類戒斷用 COWS。
Abrupt withdrawal of CNS depressants can be fatal; treat with a carefully titrated similar drug.
突然停用中樞神經抑制劑可能致命；以謹慎調整的類似藥物治療。
Flumazenil reverses benzodiazepine overdose; naloxone reverses opioid overdose.
Flumazenil 逆轉苯二氮平類過量；naloxone 逆轉鴉片類過量。
Opioid intoxication: pinpoint pupils, slow breathing. Opioid withdrawal: dilated pupils, rhinorrhea, yawning, piloerection, diarrhea.
鴉片類中毒：針尖瞳孔、呼吸慢。鴉片類戒斷：瞳孔放大、流鼻水、打哈欠、雞皮疙瘩、腹瀉。
Stimulant withdrawal: severe depression and suicidal ideation - monitor closely.
興奮劑戒斷：嚴重憂鬱與自殺意念——須密切監測。
Hallucinogen flashbacks can occur long after use; safety first, low stimuli.
迷幻劑閃回可在使用後長期發生；安全為先、低刺激。
Anorexia: weight below 75% ideal needs inpatient medical stabilization; limit rigorous exercise without humiliating, offer alternatives.
厭食症：體重低於理想 75% 需住院醫療穩定；限制劇烈運動但不羞辱，並提供替代活動。
Bulimia: normal weight, dental erosion, electrolyte imbalance; anorexia: lanugo, bradycardia, hypotension, amenorrhea.
暴食症：體重正常、牙齒侵蝕、電解質失衡；厭食症：胎毛、心搏過慢、低血壓、閉經。
Anorexia care: supervise meals and after-meal period, weigh consistently, do not place with infection-risk roommate or one who needs to be 'managed'.
厭食症照護：督導用餐與餐後、一致測體重，勿與有感染風險或需被照顧的病人同房。
CAGE questionnaire: Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener.
CAGE 問卷：減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒。
Wernicke/Korsakoff arise from thiamine deficiency in chronic alcohol use.
慢性酒精使用造成硫胺素缺乏，導致 Wernicke/Korsakoff。
A voluntary client who wants to leave AMA cannot be physically held; notify the PHCP/supervisor (false imprisonment otherwise).
要求離院（AMA）的自願客戶不可被強制留下；通知醫師/主管（否則為非法拘禁）。
Al-Anon benefit: spouse recognizes the partner is responsible for the drinking and that abuse is undeserved.
Al-Anon 的助益：配偶了解飲酒責任在伴侶，且不應承受暴力。
Report impaired colleagues; do not cover for them.
通報受損同事；不要包庇。
CAGE = Cut down, Annoyed, Guilty, Eye-opener (2 or more yes answers suggests a problem).
CAGE＝減量、被煩擾、罪惡感、晨間飲酒（答「是」兩題以上提示有問題）。
Opioid intoxication vs withdrawal: 'Intoxication = slow and small (pupils, breathing); withdrawal = wet and wide (rhinorrhea, dilated pupils, diarrhea)'.
鴉片類：中毒＝慢而小（呼吸、瞳孔）；戒斷＝濕而大（流鼻水、瞳孔放大、腹瀉）。
Alcohol withdrawal timeline: 6-24 h tremor/anxiety, 24-48 h seizures risk, 48-72 h DTs (approximate memory aid; chapter text gives peak 24-48 h and DTs 48-72 h).
酒精戒斷時間軸：6–24 小時顫抖/焦慮、24–48 小時痙攣風險、48–72 小時 DTs（輔助記憶，章節明載高峰 24–48 小時、DTs 48–72 小時）。
Which findings suggest alcohol withdrawal delirium in a client hospitalized 24 hours for a fractured humerus?
因肱骨骨折住院 24 小時的客戶，哪些表現提示酒精戒斷譫妄？
Which interventions are appropriate for a client in alcohol withdrawal? Select all that apply.
哪些處置適用於酒精戒斷客戶？（複選）
Which assessment findings are expected in a client with bulimia nervosa? Select all that apply.
神經性暴食症客戶預期有哪些評估發現？（複選）
A client with anorexia nervosa is doing rigorous push-ups. What is the nurse's best action?
神經性厭食症客戶正在做劇烈伏地挺身。護理師最佳做法是？
A client has respirations of 8/min, pinpoint pupils and is hard to arouse after taking heroin. Which drug does the nurse expect to be prescribed?
客戶使用海洛因後呼吸 8 次/分、瞳孔針尖大小且難以喚醒。預期醫囑為哪種藥物？
A hospitalized client with alcohol use disorder, not yet discharged, begins to walk out before a scheduled test. What does the nurse do?
尚未出院的酒精使用疾患住院客戶在檢查前欲離開。護理師應做什麼？
Which behaviors by a nurse suggest possible drug diversion? Select all that apply.
護理師的哪些行為提示可能有藥物轉用？（複選）
Which statement shows an Al-Anon member's spouse is benefitting?
哪句話顯示 Al-Anon 成員的配偶有受益？
Fig. 67.1 illustrates the cycle of anorexia and bulimia nervosa.
圖 67.1 顯示神經性厭食與暴食的循環。
Box 67.1: CAGE screening questions for substance use.
方框 67.1：物質使用 CAGE 篩檢問題。
Box 67.2: manifestations of alcohol withdrawal delirium (delirium tremens).
方框 67.2：酒精戒斷譫妄（震顫譫妄）表現。
Table 67.1: intoxication and withdrawal signs for each substance class - the key comparison table.
表 67.1：各類物質中毒與戒斷徵象——核心比較表。
Box 67.5: opioid overdose crisis, risk factors, naloxone nasal spray.
方框 67.5：鴉片類過量危機、風險因子與 naloxone 鼻噴劑。
Crisis is a temporary state of severe emotional disorganization after a threatening event; problem-solving ability is inadequate; it is not itself a mental illness.
危機是遭遇威脅事件後暫時性的嚴重情緒失序；解決問題能力不足；本身並非精神疾病。
Phases: 1 precipitating event; 2 perceived threat and rising anxiety; 3 failed coping, disorganization, physical symptoms; 4 mobilizing resources, goal is return to at least precrisis functioning.
階段：1 誘發事件；2 感知威脅、焦慮上升；3 因應失敗、失序、出現身體症狀；4 動員資源，目標是回到至少危機前的功能。
Types (Box 68.1): maturational (developmental, e.g., retirement), situational (external, e.g., job loss, death, divorce), adventitious (disaster, war, violent crime).
類型（方框 68.1）：成熟性（發展，如退休）、情境性（外在，如失業、死亡、離婚）、意外性（災難、戰爭、暴力犯罪）。
Intervention is immediate, supportive, goal-directed: acknowledge feelings, validate, link event meaning to crisis, explore and try new coping.
介入是立即、支持性且目標導向：承認感受、確認、連結事件意義與危機、探索並嘗試新的因應。
Initial assessment: ask what led the client to seek help now (precipitating event) before asking about supports and coping.
初步評估：先詢問促使客戶此時求助的原因（誘發事件），再詢問支持系統與因應方式。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role
Grief is the natural response to loss. Three-stage response (Box 68.2): shock/disbelief; experiencing the loss (anger, guilt, bargaining, depression); reintegration.
悲傷是對失落的自然反應。三階段反應（方框 68.2）：震驚與難以置信；經歷失落（憤怒、罪惡感、討價還價、憂鬱）；重新整合。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role
Types: normal, anticipatory, disenfranchised (cannot be openly acknowledged), dysfunctional (prolonged, no progress), and child grief by developmental level.
類型：正常、預期性、被剝奪的（無法公開承認）、失功能（持續且無進展），以及依發展階段的兒童悲傷。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role
Loss: actual, perceived (only felt by the person), anticipatory. Mourning = outward social expression, shaped by culture/religion. Bereavement = grief plus mourning.
失落：實際、感知（僅當事人感受）、預期。哀悼＝外在的社會表達，受文化/宗教影響。喪親＝悲傷加哀悼。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role

Children's grief (Box 68.3): infants react to caregiver loss; toddlers/preschoolers see death as reversible and may regress; 5-9 years begin to see it as permanent and may feel responsible; adolescents see it as permanent with strong reactions.
兒童悲傷（方框 68.3）：嬰兒對照顧者失去有反應；幼兒/學齡前視死亡為可逆且可能退化；5–9 歲開始理解永久性並可能覺得自己有責任；青少年理解永久性且情緒強烈。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role
Nurse's role: trusting, nonjudgmental environment; listen, silence, touch if appropriate; be honest, do not abandon; respect culture; avoid personal opinions; acknowledge own feelings (Box 68.4).
護理角色：建立信任、不批判的環境；傾聽、沉默、適當時給予碰觸；誠實並不離棄；尊重文化；避免個人意見；承認自己的感受（方框 68.4）。
Grief, loss and the nurse's role
The pandemic is a real threat to physical and emotional well-being; expect anxiety, fear of the unknown, isolation stress, grief, survival guilt, depression, suicide risk.
疫情是對身心健康的真實威脅；預期焦慮、對未知的恐懼、隔離壓力、悲傷、倖存者罪惡感、憂鬱與自殺風險。
Moral injury is a concern for health care workers forced into impossible choices and for families unable to be with loved ones.
道德傷害是醫療人員被迫做艱難抉擇、以及家屬無法陪伴親人時的重要議題。

Interventions: assess for stress, depression and suicidality; foster hope and resilience; cognitive reappraisal; list what can be controlled; safety behaviors (distancing, handwashing, masks); limit media; stay connected; eat, sleep, exercise.
處置：評估壓力、憂鬱與自殺風險；培養希望與復原力；認知重新評價；列出可控制的事；安全行為（保持距離、洗手、戴口罩）；限制媒體接觸；保持聯繫；規律飲食、睡眠與運動。

Always consider suicide in a depressed client. Risk groups: prior attempts, family history, adolescents, older adults, disabled/terminally ill, personality disorders, dementia, depression/psychosis, substance abuse, bullied, abuse history, past hospitalizations.
憂鬱客戶一律要考慮自殺。高風險族群：曾嘗試自殺、家族史、青少年、老年人、身心障礙/末期病人、人格疾患、失智、憂鬱/精神病、物質濫用、被霸凌、受虐史、曾住院。
Cues (Box 68.5): giving away possessions, will/insurance changes, canceling plans, statements of intent, asking about lethal means, sudden calm or improvement.
警訊（方框 68.5）：送出財物、修改遺囑/保險、取消約定、表達意圖、詢問致命工具、突然平靜或好轉。
Assess plan, means and timing, prior attempts and increasing lethality, hallucinations (command), substance use, recent losses, isolation (Box 68.6).
評估計畫、方法與時間、過去嘗試與致命性增加、幻覺（命令式）、物質使用、近期失落、孤立（方框 68.6）。

Interventions: ask directly; suicide precautions; document every 15 min; remove harmful objects; never leave alone (one-to-one for those at risk); nonjudgmental; support systems; staff accompany off unit; check visitors' items.
處置：直接詢問；自殺防範；每 15 分鐘記錄；移除危險物；絕不單獨留置（高風險者一對一）；不批判；找出支持系統；離開病房需工作人員陪同；檢查訪客物品。
Warning signs of violence: history of violence, poor impulse control, raised voice, threats, pacing, muscle rigidity, flushed face, glaring.
暴力警訊：暴力史、衝動控制差、提高音量、威脅、踱步、肌肉僵硬、臉紅、怒視。

De-escalation: low-stimuli safe setting, calm clear voice, large personal space, nonaggressive posture, listen, acknowledge anger, clear options and limits, problem-solve. Use least restrictive measures first.
降級：低刺激安全環境、平穩清楚語氣、保持較大個人空間、非攻擊性姿勢、傾聽、承認憤怒、給予清楚選項與限制、一起解決問題。先使用最少限制措施。
Restraints/seclusion: never for punishment or staff convenience; only when behavior is physically harmful and less restrictive measures fail; document the behavior.
約束/隔離：絕不用於懲罰或方便工作人員；僅在行為造成身體傷害且較少限制措施無效時使用；須記錄行為。

PHCP prescription is normally required (specifying type, duration, release criteria); in an emergency the nurse may act and then obtain the order promptly; face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour; one-to-one observation; assess needs every 15-30 min.
通常須醫囑（註明種類、時間長度與解除條件）；緊急時護理師可先處置再儘快取得醫囑；1 小時內須面對面評估；一對一觀察；每 15–30 分鐘評估需求。
Bullying is repeated aggressive acts by someone using power over another (physical, relational, verbal, cyberbullying).
霸凌是以權力壓制他人的重複攻擊行為（身體、關係、言語、網路霸凌）。
Victims can develop depression, low self-esteem, isolation, self-harm, suicide.
受害者可能出現憂鬱、低自尊、孤立、自傷與自殺。
Nurse's role: observe for signs and educate teachers, administrators and parents.
護理角色：觀察徵象並教育老師、行政人員與家長。
Cycle of violence (Fig. 68.1): tension building, acute battering, honeymoon/calm with undoing behavior; victim blames self, isolation is common.
暴力循環（圖 68.1）：張力累積、急性毆打、蜜月/平靜期（含補償行為）；受害者自責，常見孤立。
Types (Box 68.7): physical, sexual, emotional violence, physical/developmental/educational neglect, economic exploitation. Children and older adults are most vulnerable.
類型（方框 68.7）：身體、性、情緒暴力，身體/發展/教育忽視，經濟剝削。兒童與老人最脆弱。

Care: private, confidential, nonjudgmental assessment; assess injuries, suicide and homicide potential, substance use; help make a specific safety plan and give hotline/shelter information; report suspected child/elder abuse; accurate records.
照護：在隱密、保密、不批判的情況下評估；評估傷勢、自殺與他殺風險、物質使用；協助訂定具體安全計畫並提供熱線/庇護所資訊；通報疑似兒童/老人虐待；正確記錄。
Abuser traits: low self-esteem, dependency, history of childhood abuse, sees victim as property. Offer therapy to both victim and abuser.
施虐者特徵：自尊低、依賴性強、童年受虐史、視受害者為財產。對受害者與施虐者都提供治療。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童

Child abduction: by strangers or a non-custodial parent; teach children safety rules (don't go alone, tell an adult, say no, no secrets, don't accept gifts, go to a clerk if lost, know name/address/phone). Watch for PTSD after abduction.
兒童誘拐：陌生人或無監護權的父母所為；教導兒童安全守則（不單獨外出、告知大人、說不、不保守秘密、不收禮物、走失找店員、記得姓名/地址/電話）。誘拐後留意 PTSD。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童

Child abuse includes neglect and physical, sexual, emotional maltreatment. Shaken baby: subdural hemorrhage, retinal hemorrhages, bulging fontanel, decreased consciousness (rising ICP), usually no external signs.
兒童虐待包含忽視與身體、性、情緒傷害。嬰兒搖晃症候群：硬腦膜下出血、視網膜出血、囟門膨出、意識下降（顱內壓上升），常無外傷。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童

Physical abuse cues (Box 68.9): unexplained bruises, burns, fractures, spiral fractures, bald spots, apprehensive child, lack of crying with strangers. Neglect: poor hygiene, hunger, inadequate weight gain.
身體虐待線索（方框 68.9）：不明瘀青、燒燙傷、骨折、螺旋骨折、禿斑、畏縮、對陌生人不哭。忽視：衛生差、飢餓、體重增加不足。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童
Nurses are legally required to report suspected child abuse; protect the child, document objectively, support the family and refer to resources.
護理師依法必須通報疑似兒童虐待；保護兒童、客觀記錄、支持家庭並轉介資源。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童
Latchkey children lack adult supervision; teach self-care skills and refer to after-school programs.
鑰匙兒童缺乏成人監督；教導自我照顧技能並轉介課後方案。
Child abduction, child abuse, latchkey children
兒童誘拐、兒童虐待與鑰匙兒童

Forms: physical, emotional, sexual abuse, neglect, economic exploitation; risk is highest for dependent elders with illness, immobility or confusion; caregiver stress and family violence history contribute.
形式：身體、情緒、性虐待、忽視、經濟剝削；依賴的老人（疾病、行動不便、意識混亂）風險最高；照顧者壓力與家庭暴力史為促成因素。
Signs: fractures, bruises, pressure sores, burns, torn underclothing, dehydration, malnutrition, missing glasses/dentures, medication overdose, unpaid bills.
徵象：骨折、瘀青、壓瘡、燒傷、內衣破損、脫水、營養不良、缺少眼鏡/假牙、藥物過量、帳單未付。

Care: treat injuries, ask if someone is harming them, report to authorities, separate from abuser if possible and contact adult protective services, least restrictive placement, caregiver respite/counseling.
照護：治療傷勢、詢問是否有人傷害、通報主管機關、可能時與施虐者分開並聯絡成人保護服務、採最少限制的安置、為照顧者提供喘息或諮商。
Rape = sexual act through force/coercion without consent. Includes acquaintance, statutory, same-gender and marital rape. The victim is not legally required to report.
強暴＝以強迫或脅迫未經同意進行性行為。包含熟人、法定、同性與婚內強暴。受害者無法律上報案義務。
Responses: shame, humiliation, anger, fear of not being believed, self-blame. Rape trauma syndrome: sleep disturbance, nightmares, fear, somatic complaints, relationship disruption; see PTSD.
反應：羞愧、屈辱、憤怒、害怕不被相信、自責。強暴創傷症候群：睡眠障礙、夢魘、恐懼、身體不適、關係受損；參見 PTSD。

ED care: private quiet area, stay with the victim, treat injuries, written consent, explain why not to shower/douche/change clothes before exam, preserve evidence, offer shower afterward, refer to SADV nurse and support groups.
急診照護：安靜隱私區域、陪伴受害者、治療傷勢、書面同意、解釋檢查前不可淋浴/沖洗/換衣、保存證據、檢查後提供淋浴、轉介 SADV 護理師與支持團體。
Reinforce that surviving was what mattered: the victim did what was necessary to stay alive. Respond to feelings with open-ended therapeutic communication.
強調存活最重要：受害者做了讓自己活下來所需的事。以開放式治療性溝通回應感受。
A client in crisis is not necessarily mentally ill; responses are individual. Goal: return to at least precrisis functioning.
處於危機的客戶不一定有精神疾病；反應因人而異。目標：回到至少危機前的功能。
Situational crisis = external life event (death, job loss, divorce); adventitious crisis = disaster, violence, rape, war.
情境性危機＝外在生活事件（死亡、失業、離婚）；意外性危機＝災難、暴力、強暴、戰爭。
In crisis assessment, first identify the precipitating event ('What led you to seek help now?').
危機評估先找出誘發事件（「是什麼讓你現在來求助？」）。
Ask directly about suicide: 'Are you thinking of hurting yourself?'; assess plan, means, timing.
直接詢問自殺：「你有想傷害自己嗎？」；評估計畫、方法與時間。
Sudden calm or improvement in a depressed client may signal a decision to attempt suicide - increase precautions.
憂鬱客戶突然平靜或好轉，可能代表已決定自殺——應加強防範。
Giving away possessions is a suicide cue.
After a suicide attempt: one-to-one constant supervision; treat physical injury first (airway/bleeding) in the ED.
自殺未遂後：一對一持續監視；急診先處理生理傷害（呼吸道/出血）。
Escalating aggression: acknowledge behavior, quiet area, safe distance, least restrictive first; confinement only in the crisis period.
攻擊行為升高：承認行為、移至安靜區域、保持安全距離、先用最少限制措施；僅於危機期才使用隔離。
Restraints/seclusion: never as punishment; PHCP order; face-to-face evaluation within 1 hour; one-to-one observation; check needs every 15-30 min.
約束/隔離：不得作為懲罰；需醫囑；1 小時內面對面評估；一對一觀察；每 15–30 分鐘評估需求。
Mandatory reporting of suspected child abuse and elder abuse; document objectively.
疑似兒童與老人虐待須強制通報；客觀記錄。
Shaken baby syndrome: retinal hemorrhage, bulging fontanel, decreasing LOC (increased ICP), few external signs.
嬰兒搖晃症候群：視網膜出血、囟門膨出、意識下降（顱內壓上升）、外傷少。
Family violence discharge: give specific safety plan and shelter/hotline information, not just 'leave' or 'call the police'.
家暴出院指導：提供具體安全計畫與庇護所/熱線資訊，而非僅叫對方離開或報警。
Cycle of violence: tension-building, acute battering, honeymoon (loving, contrite).
暴力循環：張力累積、急性毆打、蜜月期（討好、悔過）。
Rape victim: stay with the victim, private area, do not bathe/douche/change clothes before exam, preserve evidence, written consent.
強暴受害者：陪伴、隱私空間、檢查前不可洗澡/沖洗/更衣、保存證據、書面同意。
Grief stages: shock/disbelief, experiencing the loss, reintegration; respond to feelings and do not give false reassurance.
悲傷階段：震驚與難以置信、經歷失落、重新整合；回應感受，不給錯誤安慰。
Children under about 5 may view death as reversible; 5-9 begin to see it as permanent and may feel responsible.
約 5 歲以下兒童可能視死亡為可逆；5–9 歲開始理解永久性並可能覺得自己有責任。

Suicide warning: 'SAD PERSONS'-style recall - Sex (male), Age, Depression, Previous attempt, Ethanol, Rational thinking loss, Social support lacking, Organized plan, No spouse, Sickness (external mnemonic, not from the chapter).
自殺風險記憶法「SAD PERSONS」：性別（男）、年齡、憂鬱、曾嘗試、酒精、理性喪失、缺乏支持、有計畫、無配偶、疾病（外部口訣，非本章內容）。
Crisis priority: Safety first, then feelings, then problem-solving. For violence: least restrictive first (talk, space, quiet area, medicate) before seclusion/restraint.
危機優先順序：先安全，再感受，後解決問題。暴力處理：先最少限制（談話、空間、安靜區、用藥），再隔離/約束。
A depressed inpatient says, 'My family would be better off without me.' What is the nurse's best response?
憂鬱住院客戶說：「沒有我，家人會過得更好。」護理師最佳回應是？
A moderately depressed client hospitalized 2 days suddenly smiles and says, 'I'm finally cured.' What should the nurse do?
中度憂鬱客戶住院 2 天後突然微笑說：「我終於痊癒了。」護理師該怎麼做？
Which is the priority intervention for a client admitted after a suicide attempt by hanging?
因上吊自殺未遂入院的客戶，哪項為優先處置？
A client's behavior is escalating toward aggression. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
客戶行為逐漸升級為攻擊。哪些處置適當？（複選）
Which event is a situational crisis?
哪一事件屬於情境性危機？
What priority information belongs in the discharge teaching of an adult victim of family violence?
成人家暴受害者的出院衛教，哪項為優先？
A rape survivor in the ED asks to shower. Which are appropriate nursing actions? Select all that apply.
急診中的強暴倖存者想淋浴。哪些護理處置適當？（複選）
An infant has bulging fontanels, retinal hemorrhages and decreasing responsiveness with no external injuries. What does the nurse suspect and monitor?
嬰兒囟門膨出、視網膜出血、反應下降但無外傷。護理師應懷疑什麼並監測什麼？
Box 68.1 (types of crises), Box 68.2 (grief stages) and Box 68.3 (children's grief by age).
方框 68.1（危機類型）、68.2（悲傷階段）與 68.3（各年齡兒童悲傷）。
Box 68.4: communication guidance during grief and loss.
方框 68.4：悲傷與失落期的溝通指引。
Box 68.5 suicidal cues and Box 68.6 suicide assessment questions.
方框 68.5 自殺警訊與方框 68.6 自殺評估問題。
Fig. 68.1: the cycle of violence, and Box 68.7 types of violence.
圖 68.1：暴力循環，與方框 68.7 暴力類型。
Box 68.8: sample assessment questions for violence and abuse.
方框 68.8：暴力與虐待的評估問句範例。
Box 68.9: child neglect and abuse assessment findings, including shaken baby syndrome.
方框 68.9：兒童忽視與虐待評估發現，含嬰兒搖晃症候群。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI

Action: block serotonin reuptake; first-line for depression with anxiety or agitation. Examples: citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, sertraline. SNRIs (venlafaxine, duloxetine) also block norepinephrine.
作用：抑制血清素再吸收，為合併焦慮或躁動之憂鬱症的首選。例：citalopram、escitalopram、fluoxetine、paroxetine、sertraline；SNRI（venlafaxine、duloxetine）另可抑制正腎上腺素再吸收。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI
Fewer anticholinergic effects than TCAs. Common effects: insomnia or somnolence, nervousness, tremor, weight change, decreased libido, BP changes, dry mouth.
抗膽鹼作用比 TCA 少。常見副作用：失眠或嗜睡、神經質、顫抖、體重改變、性慾下降、血壓變化、口乾。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI

Serotonin syndrome (excess serotonin, especially SSRI + MAOI or OTC cold medicines/St. John's wort): restlessness, tachycardia, fever, high BP, delirium, myoclonus, rigidity, seizures, abdominal pain/diarrhea.
血清素症候群（SSRI 合併 MAOI、感冒成藥或聖約翰草）：躁動、心搏過速、發燒、高血壓、譫妄、肌躍症、僵硬、抽搐、腹痛腹瀉。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI

Teaching: give with food or a snack; takes 2-4 weeks for full effect; avoid alcohol; do not stop abruptly (discontinuation syndrome: GI upset, movement disorders, insomnia, sensory disturbance); ibuprofen/NSAIDs raise upper GI bleeding risk.
衛教：隨餐或點心服用；2–4 週才達完整療效；避免酒精；不可驟停（停藥症候群：腸胃不適、動作異常、失眠、感覺異常）；併用 ibuprofen／NSAID 會增加上消化道出血風險。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI

Monitor suicidality closely, especially when mood and energy begin to improve; monitor WBC/neutrophils, liver and renal function with long-term use; interacts with digoxin and warfarin; extra caution in children, adolescents, older adults, and pregnancy.
密切監測自殺風險，特別是情緒與精力開始改善時；長期使用需監測白血球／嗜中性球及肝腎功能；可與 digoxin、warfarin 交互作用；兒童、青少年、老年人及孕婦需特別謹慎。
選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑（SSRI）與 SNRI
Action: block norepinephrine and serotonin reuptake. Examples: amitriptyline, imipramine, nortriptyline, doxepin; clomipramine is used for OCD.
作用：抑制正腎上腺素與血清素再吸收。例：amitriptyline、imipramine、nortriptyline、doxepin；clomipramine 用於強迫症。
Anticholinergic effects: dry mouth, blurred vision, constipation, urinary retention; also orthostatic hypotension, tachycardia/dysrhythmias, sedation, lowered seizure threshold.
抗膽鹼作用：口乾、視力模糊、便秘、尿滯留；另有姿勢性低血壓、心搏過速／心律不整、鎮靜、降低癲癇閾值。
Cardiac toxicity: obtain ECG before and periodically during therapy. Overdose is life-threatening: airway, oxygen, cardiac monitoring, ECG, activated charcoal/lavage if within 2 hours, IV fluids.
心臟毒性：治療前及期間定期做心電圖。過量可致命：維持呼吸道、給氧、心電監視、心電圖、2 小時內可做洗胃／活性碳、靜脈輸液。
Give the whole daily dose at bedtime (sedating). Teach slow position changes, high-fiber diet and fluids, oral hygiene/hard candy for dry mouth, no alcohol/OTC cold meds, taper gradually.
每日全量於睡前服用（有鎮靜作用）。衛教緩慢改變姿勢、高纖與多喝水、口腔衛生及硬糖緩解口乾、避免酒精與非處方感冒藥、需逐步減藥。

Concurrent MAOI can cause hypertensive crisis; alcohol/antihistamines add CNS depression; may reduce antihypertensive effect. Therapeutic effect takes 2-4 weeks. Watch for suicide risk as energy returns.
併用 MAOI 可致高血壓危象；酒精與抗組織胺加重中樞抑制；可能降低降血壓藥效果。療效需 2–4 週。精力恢復時留意自殺風險。

Action: inhibit MAO, raising dopamine, norepinephrine, serotonin and tyramine levels. Examples: isocarboxazid, phenelzine, selegiline, tranylcypromine. Reserved for depression not responding to other therapy.
作用：抑制 MAO，使多巴胺、正腎上腺素、血清素及酪胺升高。例：isocarboxazid、phenelzine、selegiline、tranylcypromine。用於其他治療無效的憂鬱症。
Hypertensive crisis: severe hypertension, occipital headache, neck stiffness, N/V, sweating, fever, dilated pupils, palpitations, chest pain. Antidote: IV phentolamine.
高血壓危象：嚴重高血壓、後枕部頭痛、頸部僵硬、噁心嘔吐、冒汗、發燒、瞳孔放大、心悸、胸痛。解毒劑：靜脈注射 phentolamine。

Avoid tyramine-rich foods: aged cheese, wine/beer, sausage/salami, sauerkraut, soy sauce, avocado, banana, figs, raisins, yogurt, sour cream, liver, caffeine/chocolate. Avoid amphetamines, decongestants, other antidepressants, levodopa, meperidine/opioids.
避免高酪胺食物：陳年乳酪、紅酒／啤酒、香腸／臘腸、酸菜、醬油、酪梨、香蕉、無花果、葡萄乾、優格、酸奶油、肝臟、咖啡因／巧克力。避免安非他命、鼻充血劑、其他抗憂鬱劑、levodopa、meperidine／鴉片類。

Teaching: BP monitoring; report headache, neck stiffness or palpitations immediately; change positions slowly; carry a MedicAlert card; take in the morning (insomnia); missed dose may be taken within 3 hours; benefit may need up to 3 weeks; taper gradually.
衛教：監測血壓；頭痛、頸部僵硬或心悸立即通報；緩慢改變姿勢；隨身攜帶醫療警示卡；早上服用（避免失眠）；漏服 3 小時內可補服；療效最多需 3 週；需逐步減藥。
Atypical Antidepressants and Other Mood Stabilizers
非典型抗憂鬱劑與其他情緒穩定劑
Atypical antidepressants listed: bupropion, mirtazapine, trazodone, nefazodone, vortioxetine, brexanolone. Bupropion lowers seizure threshold; seizures signal excess dose.
非典型抗憂鬱劑：bupropion、mirtazapine、trazodone、nefazodone、vortioxetine、brexanolone。bupropion 降低癲癇閾值，出現抽搐表示劑量過高。
Atypical Antidepressants and Other Mood Stabilizers
非典型抗憂鬱劑與其他情緒穩定劑

Other mood stabilizers: anticonvulsants (valproate, carbamazepine, lamotrigine, oxcarbazepine, gabapentin) and atypical antipsychotics (olanzapine, quetiapine, risperidone, aripiprazole, ziprasidone, etc.).
其他情緒穩定劑：抗癲癇藥（valproate、carbamazepine、lamotrigine、oxcarbazepine、gabapentin）及非典型抗精神病藥（olanzapine、quetiapine、risperidone、aripiprazole、ziprasidone 等）。
Atypical Antidepressants and Other Mood Stabilizers
非典型抗憂鬱劑與其他情緒穩定劑
Therapeutic serum level 0.6-1.2 mEq/L; margin to toxicity is narrow. Draw level in the morning 12 hours after the last dose; check frequently at start, then every 1-2 months or when behavior changes.
治療血中濃度 0.6–1.2 mEq/L，與中毒濃度很接近。於末次給藥後 12 小時的早晨抽血；起始時頻繁檢測，之後每 1–2 個月或行為改變時檢測。
Levels rise with low sodium intake, dehydration, sweating, vomiting/diarrhea, diuretics, NSAIDs, fluoxetine. Never give diuretics with lithium. Keep fluids 6-8 glasses/day and normal salt intake.
低鈉攝取、脫水、大量流汗、嘔吐腹瀉、利尿劑、NSAID、fluoxetine 會使濃度上升。鋰鹽期間不可給利尿劑。每日飲水 6–8 杯並維持正常鹽分攝取。
Expected effects: polyuria, polydipsia, fine hand tremor, nausea, soft stools, weight gain, hypothyroidism/goiter. Baseline ECG, renal and thyroid tests needed. Crosses the placenta (fetal toxicity).
預期副作用：多尿、多渴、手部細微顫抖、噁心、軟便、體重增加、甲狀腺低下／甲狀腺腫。治療前需基礎心電圖、腎功能及甲狀腺檢查。可通過胎盤（胎兒毒性）。

Toxicity begins at about 1.5 mEq/L. Mild (1.5): lethargy, coarse tremor, mild ataxia. Moderate (1.5-2.0): vomiting, severe diarrhea, slurred speech, tinnitus, blurred vision. Severe (>2.0): nystagmus, fasciculations, hyperreflexia, oliguria, seizures, coma.
約 1.5 mEq/L 開始中毒。輕度（1.5）：倦怠、粗顫、輕度共濟失調。中度（1.5–2.0）：嘔吐、嚴重腹瀉、言語不清、耳鳴、視力模糊。重度（>2.0）：眼球震顫、肌束顫動、反射亢進、少尿、抽搐、昏迷。

Toxicity actions: withhold lithium, notify provider, monitor VS, LOC and ECG, obtain lithium, electrolytes, BUN/creatinine, CBC; seizure and suicide precautions. Missed dose: take within 2 hours, otherwise skip. Do not stop abruptly.
中毒處置：停藥並通知醫師，監測生命徵象、意識與心電圖，抽鋰濃度、電解質、BUN／肌酸酐、全血球計數；採取抽搐與自殺防範。漏服 2 小時內可補服，否則跳過。不可驟停。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥

Benzodiazepines (alprazolam, lorazepam, diazepam, clonazepam, midazolam...) enhance GABA: anxiolytic, sedative, muscle relaxant, anticonvulsant. Contraindicated in acute narrow-angle glaucoma; cautious use in older adults and liver impairment; short-term use.
苯二氮平類（alprazolam、lorazepam、diazepam、clonazepam、midazolam 等）增強 GABA：抗焦慮、鎮靜、肌肉鬆弛、抗痙攣。急性窄角青光眼禁用；老年人與肝功能不全者慎用；宜短期使用。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥

Adverse effects: sedation, dizziness, hypotension, amnesia, slurred speech, paradoxical excitement (older adults). Antidote for overdose: flumazenil IV (acts within about 5 minutes; may cause agitation or seizures).
不良反應：鎮靜、頭暈、低血壓、失憶、言語不清、老年人矛盾性興奮。過量解毒劑：flumazenil 靜脈注射（約 5 分鐘起效）。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥
Never stop abruptly (seizures). Taper over 2-6 weeks; withdrawal: restlessness, irritability, insomnia, tremor, cramps, sweating, vomiting, seizures. Avoid alcohol; fall precautions.
不可驟停（抽搐）。應在 2–6 週內逐步減量；戒斷症狀：不安、易怒、失眠、顫抖、痙攣、冒汗、嘔吐、抽搐。避免酒精；防跌。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥
Buspirone is a non-benzodiazepine anxiolytic; effective when anxiety signs such as rapid heartbeat and tension are absent after several weeks; no sedation or dependence.
buspirone 為非苯二氮平類抗焦慮藥，數週後心跳加速、緊張等焦慮表現消失代表有效；無明顯鎮靜與依賴。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥

Barbiturates (phenobarbital, pentobarbital) and hypnotics (zolpidem, eszopiclone, zaleplon, ramelteon, chloral hydrate): depress the CNS via GABA. Overdose: respiratory depression, hypotension, shock, coma. Withdrawal within 24 hours in dependent clients: tremor, delirium, seizures. Avoid alcohol; take 30 minutes before bed; morning hangover possible.
巴比妥類（phenobarbital、pentobarbital）及安眠藥（zolpidem、eszopiclone、zaleplon、ramelteon、chloral hydrate）經 GABA 抑制中樞。過量：呼吸抑制、低血壓、休克、昏迷。依賴者 24 小時內可出現戒斷：顫抖、譫妄、抽搐。避免酒精；睡前 30 分鐘服用；隔日可能宿醉感。
苯二氮平類、buspirone、巴比妥類與鎮靜安眠藥
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

Block dopamine receptors. Typical (haloperidol, chlorpromazine, fluphenazine): better for positive symptoms (hallucinations, delusions, aggression). Atypical (risperidone, olanzapine, clozapine, quetiapine, aripiprazole): also help negative symptoms (apathy, avolition, alogia).
阻斷多巴胺受體。典型藥（haloperidol、chlorpromazine、fluphenazine）對陽性症狀（幻覺、妄想、攻擊）較有效；非典型藥（risperidone、olanzapine、clozapine、quetiapine、aripiprazole）對陰性症狀（冷漠、無意志、言語貧乏）亦有效。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

Extrapyramidal effects: parkinsonism (tremor, rigidity, shuffling gait, drooling), dystonia (oculogyric crisis, grimacing, torso twisting), akathisia (restlessness), tardive dyskinesia (tongue protrusion, chewing, involuntary movements).
錐體外症狀：類帕金森氏症（顫抖、僵硬、拖曳步態、流口水）、急性肌張力不全（眼動危象、扮鬼臉、軀幹扭曲）、靜坐不能（坐立不安）、遲發性運動障礙（吐舌、咀嚼、不自主運動）。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

Other effects: anticholinergic effects, orthostatic hypotension, photosensitivity, weight gain and hyperglycemia, agranulocytosis (sore throat, fever, malaise; clozapine: stop if WBC < 3000/mm3), jaundice, impaired temperature regulation, gynecomastia/lactation.
其他：抗膽鹼作用、姿勢性低血壓、光敏感、體重增加與高血糖、顆粒性白血球缺乏（喉嚨痛、發燒、不適；clozapine 白血球 < 3000/mm3 須停藥）、黃疸、體溫調節受損、男性女乳症／泌乳。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

Teaching: onset in 7-10 days, full effect 3-6 weeks; sunscreen and protective clothing; rise slowly; no alcohol; dilute liquid concentrate in juice, avoid skin contact; urine may turn pink to red-brown; taper gradually; long-acting injectables help adherence; monitor glucose and urine output.
衛教：7–10 天見初效、3–6 週完整療效；使用防曬與防護衣物；緩慢改變姿勢；避免酒精；濃縮液以果汁稀釋並避免接觸皮膚；尿液可能變粉紅至紅褐色；需逐步減藥；長效針劑可提升服藥順從性；監測血糖與尿量。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）

NMS (rare, life-threatening; usually with first-generation drugs, at start, dose increase or switch): hyperpyrexia, severe muscle rigidity, autonomic instability (labile BP, tachycardia, diaphoresis, drooling), altered LOC, dysphagia, elevated WBC, CPK and LFTs.
NMS（罕見、危及生命；多見於第一代藥物，開始、增量或換藥時）：高熱、嚴重肌肉僵硬、自律神經不穩（血壓波動、心搏過速、冒汗、流口水）、意識改變、吞嚥困難、白血球、CPK 及肝功能升高。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）
NMS actions: stop the drug, notify provider, VS and LOC monitoring, seizure precautions, antipyretics and cooling blanket, IV fluids/electrolytes; watch for DVT and rhabdomyolysis.
NMS 處置：停藥、通知醫師、監測生命徵象與意識、抽搐防範、退燒藥及冷卻毯、靜脈輸液與電解質；注意深部靜脈栓塞與橫紋肌溶解。
抗精神病藥與抗精神病藥惡性症候群（NMS）
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥

Benzodiazepines (chlordiazepoxide, diazepam, lorazepam, oxazepam) are the most effective for withdrawal: stabilize vital signs and reduce seizure and delirium tremens risk; long half-life agents give best protection.
苯二氮平類（chlordiazepoxide、diazepam、lorazepam、oxazepam）為戒斷首選：穩定生命徵象、降低抽搐與震顫譫妄風險；長半衰期藥物保護最佳。
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥
Atenolol/propranolol and clonidine reduce autonomic symptoms but only as adjuncts to benzodiazepines.
atenolol／propranolol 與 clonidine 可減少自律神經症狀，但只能作為苯二氮平的輔助。
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥
Thiamine (B1) IM then oral to prevent Wernicke's encephalopathy; also folic acid, multivitamin, magnesium if low.
先肌肉注射再口服 thiamine（B1）預防 Wernicke 腦病變；另補葉酸、綜合維他命，鎂低時補鎂。
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥

Maintaining abstinence (only after withdrawal is over): naltrexone blocks the pleasurable effect of alcohol; acamprosate reduces discomfort of abstinence; disulfiram causes a severe reaction if alcohol is ingested.
維持戒酒（須戒斷結束後才用）：naltrexone 阻斷飲酒愉悅感；acamprosate 減輕戒酒不適；disulfiram 一旦飲酒會引起嚴重反應。
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥

Disulfiram reaction: flushing, throbbing headache, nausea/vomiting, sweating, hypotension, tachycardia; begins within minutes, lasts 30 min-2 hr. Abstain at least 12 hours before first dose; avoid alcohol in cough medicines, mouthwash, aftershave, vinegar, rubbing alcohol; effect can persist several days after stopping.
disulfiram 反應：臉潮紅、搏動性頭痛、噁心嘔吐、冒汗、低血壓、心搏過速；數分鐘內出現，持續 30 分鐘至 2 小時。首次用藥前至少戒酒 12 小時；避免含酒精之咳嗽藥、漱口水、刮鬍水、醋、消毒酒精；停藥後數天仍可能反應。
Alcohol Withdrawal and Alcohol Use Disorder Drugs
酒精戒斷與酒精使用障礙用藥
Methadone: full opioid agonist replacing the abused opioid; prevents withdrawal; given only under close supervision (overdose risk: bradypnea, cyanosis, stupor, coma).
methadone：完全鴉片類促效劑，取代濫用的鴉片；預防戒斷；須嚴密監督使用（過量風險：呼吸過慢、發紺、木僵、昏迷）。
Buprenorphine: partial agonist-antagonist for maintenance or detox; can be prescribed in general medical settings; low overdose and abuse potential but suppresses cravings.
buprenorphine：部分促效／拮抗劑，用於維持治療或戒毒；可於一般醫療場所開立；濫用與過量風險低但可抑制渴求。
Naltrexone: opioid antagonist used after detoxification to block euphoria and discourage relapse.
naltrexone：鴉片類拮抗劑，戒毒後使用，阻斷欣快感以防復發。
Clonidine decreases autonomic withdrawal symptoms (fatigue, dizziness, dry mouth).
clonidine 減輕自律神經戒斷症狀（疲倦、頭暈、口乾）。
ADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物

ADHD CNS stimulants (methylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, amphetamine salts, lisdexamfetamine; also atomoxetine, guanfacine) calm children and lengthen attention span. Effects: tachycardia, high BP, anorexia and weight loss, insomnia, agitation.
ADHD 中樞刺激劑（methylphenidate、dexmethylphenidate、安非他命鹽類、lisdexamfetamine；另有 atomoxetine、guanfacine）使兒童穩定並延長專注。副作用：心搏過速、高血壓、食慾不振與體重下降、失眠、躁動。
ADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物
Nursing: baseline ECG, BP, height and weight; last dose at least 6 hours before bedtime (14 hours for extended release); avoid OTC drugs; drug holidays may be used; benefit takes weeks.
護理：基礎心電圖、血壓、身高體重；最後一劑至少於睡前 6 小時（長效劑型 14 小時）；避免非處方藥；可安排藥物假期；療效需數週。
ADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物

Cholinesterase inhibitors for mild to moderate Alzheimer disease: donepezil (bradycardia), galantamine (bronchoconstriction; caution in asthma/COPD), rivastigmine (give with food; caution in ulcer, bradycardia, sick sinus, urinary obstruction). Common: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, anorexia, weight loss.
輕中度阿茲海默症之膽鹼酯酶抑制劑：donepezil（心搏過緩）、galantamine（支氣管收縮；氣喘／COPD 慎用）、rivastigmine（隨餐服用；潰瘍、心搏過緩、病竇症候群、尿路阻塞者慎用）。常見：噁心、嘔吐、腹瀉、食慾不振、體重下降。
ADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物

Memantine: NMDA antagonist for moderate to severe disease; dizziness, headache, confusion, constipation; avoid with amantadine or ketamine; urine-alkalinizing drugs (sodium bicarbonate) and renal impairment raise levels.
memantine：NMDA 受體拮抗劑，用於中重度；副作用頭暈、頭痛、混亂、便秘；避免與 amantadine 或 ketamine 併用；鹼化尿液藥物（碳酸氫鈉）及腎功能不全會使濃度上升。
ADHD 刺激劑與阿茲海默症藥物
Lithium therapeutic range 0.6-1.2 mEq/L; toxicity signs begin at 1.5 mEq/L; at 2.5 mEq/L with vomiting, diarrhea, tinnitus, blurred vision and tremor, treat as toxic.
鋰鹽治療濃度 0.6–1.2 mEq/L；1.5 mEq/L 開始出現中毒症狀；2.5 mEq/L 並有嘔吐、腹瀉、耳鳴、視力模糊、顫抖，視為中毒。
Lithium: maintain 6-8 glasses of water and adequate sodium; no diuretics or NSAIDs; draw level 12 hours after the last dose.
鋰鹽：每日喝水 6–8 杯並維持足夠鈉攝取；避免利尿劑與 NSAID；於末次給藥 12 小時後抽血。

MAOI plus tyramine foods (aged cheese, wine, cured meats, soy sauce, sauerkraut, avocado, banana) can cause hypertensive crisis; antidote is IV phentolamine; report headache and neck stiffness at once.
MAOI 加高酪胺食物（陳年乳酪、酒、醃肉、醬油、酸菜、酪梨、香蕉）可致高血壓危象；解毒劑為靜脈 phentolamine；頭痛與頸部僵硬須立即通報。
Never combine SSRIs with MAOIs (serotonin syndrome); OTC cold medicines and St. John's wort also raise risk.
SSRI 絕不可與 MAOI 併用（血清素症候群）；非處方感冒藥與聖約翰草亦增加風險。
Antidepressants take 2-4 weeks for full effect (MAOI up to 3 weeks); monitor for suicide as energy improves before mood; do not stop abruptly.
抗憂鬱劑需 2–4 週才達療效（MAOI 最多 3 週）；精力先於情緒改善時須留意自殺風險；不可驟停。
TCA overdose: ABCs, oxygen, cardiac monitor and ECG, charcoal/lavage if within 2 hours, IV fluids. Baseline ECG for all TCA clients.
TCA 過量：維持 ABC、給氧、心電監視與心電圖、2 小時內活性碳／洗胃、靜脈輸液。所有 TCA 使用者需基礎心電圖。
Bupropion excess presents as seizures; TCAs and bupropion lower seizure threshold.
bupropion 過量表現為抽搐；TCA 與 bupropion 皆降低癲癇閾值。
Benzodiazepine antidote is flumazenil; abrupt withdrawal can cause seizures, so taper over 2-6 weeks.
苯二氮平解毒劑為 flumazenil；驟停可致抽搐，應 2–6 週逐步減量。
Avoid alcohol with all CNS depressants (benzodiazepines, barbiturates, hypnotics, antipsychotics, TCAs).
所有中樞抑制劑（苯二氮平、巴比妥、安眠藥、抗精神病藥、TCA）皆須避免酒精。
Clozapine: monitor WBC for agranulocytosis; interrupt therapy if WBC falls below 3000/mm3.
clozapine：監測白血球以防顆粒性白血球缺乏；低於 3000/mm3 須中斷治療。
Tardive dyskinesia (tongue protrusion, chewing, grimacing) is a late antipsychotic effect; dystonia and akathisia occur earlier; assess for EPS regularly.
遲發性運動障礙（吐舌、咀嚼、扮鬼臉）為抗精神病藥晚期副作用；肌張力不全與靜坐不能較早出現；需定期評估錐體外症狀。
NMS red flags: high fever, lead-pipe rigidity, autonomic instability, altered LOC, elevated CPK and WBC; stop the drug, cool, IV fluids.
NMS 警訊：高熱、鉛管樣僵硬、自律神經不穩、意識改變、CPK 與白血球升高；停藥、降溫、靜脈輸液。
Disulfiram: abstain from alcohol at least 12 hours before the first dose and avoid alcohol-containing products (mouthwash, cough syrup, vinegar, aftershave).
disulfiram：首次用藥前至少戒酒 12 小時，並避免含酒精產品（漱口水、咳嗽糖漿、醋、刮鬍水）。
Naltrexone and acamprosate are started only after withdrawal is over; benzodiazepines are first-line for alcohol withdrawal; give thiamine to prevent Wernicke encephalopathy.
naltrexone 與 acamprosate 須戒斷結束後才開始；酒精戒斷首選苯二氮平；給 thiamine 預防 Wernicke 腦病變。
Methadone is a full agonist, buprenorphine a partial agonist-antagonist, naltrexone an antagonist for opioid use disorder.
鴉片類使用障礙：methadone 為完全促效劑，buprenorphine 為部分促效／拮抗劑，naltrexone 為拮抗劑。
ADHD stimulants: last dose 6 hours before bedtime (14 hours for extended release); monitor BP, ECG, height and weight.
ADHD 刺激劑：最後一劑於睡前至少 6 小時（長效 14 小時）；監測血壓、心電圖、身高體重。
Donepezil slows the heart rate; galantamine can bronchoconstrict; rivastigmine with food; memantine is an NMDA antagonist for moderate to severe disease.
donepezil 會減慢心率；galantamine 可致支氣管收縮；rivastigmine 隨餐；memantine 為 NMDA 拮抗劑，用於中重度。
Lithium toxicity ladder: 1.5 = coarse tremor and lethargy; 2.0 = GI upset, slurred speech, tinnitus; above 2.0 = seizures and coma. 'Lithium needs Na and H2O to leave.'
鋰中毒階梯：1.5＝粗顫與倦怠；2.0＝腸胃不適、言語不清、耳鳴；>2.0＝抽搐昏迷。記憶：鋰鹽需要鈉與水才排得出去。
TCA anticholinergic effects: 'dry as a bone, blind as a bat, red as a beet (flushed), mad as a hatter, full as a flask (retention)'.
TCA 抗膽鹼效應口訣：乾如骨（口乾）、盲如蝙蝠（視力模糊）、紅如甜菜（潮紅）、瘋如帽匠（混亂）、滿如燒瓶（尿滯留／便秘）。
Antipsychotic EPS: 'Fast to slow' timing - dystonia (hours-days), akathisia, parkinsonism, then tardive dyskinesia (months-years).
錐體外症狀出現時間由快到慢：肌張力不全（數小時至數天）→靜坐不能→類帕金森→遲發性運動障礙（數月至數年）。
NMS = 'FEVER': Fever, Encephalopathy, Vitals unstable, Elevated enzymes (CPK), Rigidity.
NMS 口訣 FEVER：發燒、腦病變、生命徵象不穩、酵素升高（CPK）、僵硬。
A client taking lithium reports vomiting, severe diarrhea, tinnitus, blurred vision and coarse tremors. The serum lithium level is 2.0 mEq/L. What is the nurse's priority action?
服用鋰鹽的個案出現嘔吐、嚴重腹瀉、耳鳴、視力模糊及粗顫，血中鋰濃度 2.0 mEq/L。護理師首要行動為何？
A client starting phenelzine asks which foods to avoid. Which choices indicate the client needs further teaching? Select all that apply.
開始服用 phenelzine 的個案詢問飲食禁忌。下列哪些選擇顯示需要再衛教？（複選）
A client on an MAOI develops a severe occipital headache, neck stiffness, palpitations and BP 210/120 mm Hg. Which medication does the nurse anticipate?
服用 MAOI 的個案出現嚴重後枕部頭痛、頸部僵硬、心悸，血壓 210/120 mm Hg。護理師預期使用哪種藥物？
A client taking haloperidol develops high fever, severe muscle rigidity, diaphoresis, labile blood pressure and confusion. Which action is first?
服用 haloperidol 的個案出現高熱、嚴重肌肉僵硬、冒汗、血壓不穩及意識混亂。首先應採取何行動？
A client with schizophrenia taking an antipsychotic is observed protruding the tongue, chewing and grimacing while watching television. The nurse identifies this as:
服用抗精神病藥的思覺失調症個案看電視時出現吐舌、咀嚼、扮鬼臉。護理師判斷為：
Which statements by a client prescribed amitriptyline indicate understanding of the teaching? Select all that apply.
下列哪些個案陳述顯示對 amitriptyline 衛教理解正確？（複選）
A client has taken lorazepam daily for several months for anxiety and wants to stop it today because of drowsiness. What is the best nurse response?
個案每日服用 lorazepam 治療焦慮已數月，因嗜睡想今天起停藥。護理師最佳回應為何？
A client with a history of alcohol use disorder is prescribed disulfiram. Which instruction is most important?
有酒精使用障礙病史的個案獲開立 disulfiram。哪項衛教最重要？
Box 69.1 and 69.2 list SSRI/SNRI/atypical and TCA drug names to recognize by generic name; Take Action box gives TCA overdose steps.
Box 69.1、69.2 列出 SSRI／SNRI／非典型及 TCA 藥名，並有 TCA 過量處置步驟（Take Action）。
Box 69.4 foods containing tyramine and Fig. 69.1 showing how MAOIs let dietary tyramine reach the circulation and trigger norepinephrine release; Box 69.5 lists mood stabilizers.
Box 69.4 高酪胺食物與圖 69.1：MAOI 使膳食酪胺進入循環並釋放正腎上腺素；Box 69.5 列出情緒穩定劑。
Box 69.6 benzodiazepine list and Clinical Judgment box on tapering alprazolam over 2-6 weeks.
Box 69.6 苯二氮平藥名及 alprazolam 2–6 週減量之臨床判斷。
Box 69.9 groups antipsychotic side effects: anticholinergic, extrapyramidal, dystonias, akathisia, tardive dyskinesia.
Box 69.9 將抗精神病藥副作用分為抗膽鹼、錐體外、肌張力不全、靜坐不能、遲發性運動障礙。
